Query_Text_en: h The conditions on which the initial subscriptions of members other than original members may be made and the amounts and the terms of payment thereof shall be determined by the Association pursuant to Section 1 b of this Article
Translation: 除原始成员以外的其他成员初始认缴份额的条件、金额及其支付条款，应由本协会根据本条第1(b)款的规定确定。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Limitation on liabilityNo member shall be liable by reason of its membership for obligations of the Association
Translation:
第三条 责任限制  
任何成员因其会员身份不对协会的义务承担责任。

Query_Text_en: a The Association shall at such time as it deems appropriate in the light of the schedule for completion of payments on initial subscriptions of original members and at intervals of approximately five years thereafter review the adequacy of its resources and if it deems desirable shall authorize a general increase in subscriptions Notwithstanding the foregoing general or individual increases in subscriptions may be authorized at any time provided that an individual increase shall be considered only at the request of the member involved Subscriptions pursuant to this Section are herein referred to as additional subscriptions
Translation: 本协会应在其认为适当的时间，根据原始成员初始认缴出资的完成进度安排，并此后大致每五年，审查其资源的充足性。如认为有必要，应授权进行普遍增资。尽管有上述规定，普遍或个别增资可在任何时间获授权，但个别增资仅在相关成员提出请求时予以考虑。根据本条规定的认缴出资，以下称为追加认缴出资。

Query_Text_en: b Subject to the provisions of paragraph c below when additional subscriptions are authorized the amounts authorized for subscription and the terms and conditions relating thereto shall be as determined by the Association
Translation: b 在符合下述c款规定的前提下，若批准追加认购，认购金额及相关条款和条件应由协会决定。

Query_Text_en: c When any additional subscription is authorized each member shall be given an opportunity to subscribe under such conditions as shall be reasonably determined by the Association an amount which will enable it to maintain its relative voting power but no member shall be obligated to subscribe
Translation: 当任何新增认购获得批准时，应给予每一成员在协会合理确定的条件下认购的机会，以使其能够维持其相对表决权，但任何成员均无义务认购。

Query_Text_en: d All decisions under this Section shall be made by a two thirds majority of the total voting power
Translation: 本节下的所有决定须经总投票权三分之二多数通过。

Query_Text_en: a The Association may enter into arrangements on such terms and conditions consistent with the provisions of this Agreement as may be agreed upon to receive from any member in addition to the amounts payable by such member on account of its initial or any additional subscription supplementary resources in the currency of another member provided that the Association shall not enter into any such arrangement unless the Association is satisfied that the member whose currency is involved agrees to the use of such currency as supplementary resources and to the terms and conditions governing such use The arrangements under which any such resources are received may include provisions regarding the disposition of earnings on the resources and regarding the disposition of the resources in the event that the member providing them ceases to be a member or the Association permanently suspends its operations
Translation: 本协会可在与本协定条款一致的前提下，与任何成员达成协议，接受该成员除其初始或追加认缴份额外，按双方商定的条款和条件，以其他成员货币提供的补充资源。但协会不得达成任何此类安排，除非协会确信所涉货币的成员同意将其货币作为补充资源使用，并同意有关该等使用的条款和条件。接收此类资源的安排可包括关于资源收益的处置，以及在提供资源的成员终止成员资格或协会永久中止运作时资源处置的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: b The Association shall deliver to the contributing member a Special Development Certificate setting forth the amount and currency of the resources so contributed and the terms and conditions of the arrangement relating to such resources A Special Development Certificate shall not carry any voting rights and shall be transferable only to the Association
Translation: 协会应向出资会员颁发特别发展证书，载明所出资资源的金额、币种及相关安排的条款和条件。特别发展证书不附带任何表决权，仅可转让给协会。

Query_Text_en: c Nothing in this Section shall preclude the Association from accepting resources from a member in its own currency on such terms as may be agreed upon
Translation: 本条款的任何内容均不应妨碍协会根据双方协商一致的条款，接受会员以其本国货币提供的资源。

Query_Text_en: a Currency of any member listed in Part of Schedule A whether or not freely convertible received by the Association pursuant to Article Section 2 d in payment of the ninety percent portion payable thereunder in the currency of such member and currency of ` such member derived therefrom as principal interest or other charges may be used by the Association for administrative expenses incurred by the Association in the territories of such member and insofar as consistent with sound monetary policies in payment for goods and services produced in the territories of such member and required for projects financed by the Association and located in such territories ;
Translation: 任何在附表A部分所列成员的货币，无论是否可自由兑换，由协会根据第2条第d款收到，用于支付其中九十个百分点的款项，并以该成员的货币支付，以及由该货币所产生的本金、利息或其他费用，协会可将其用于在该成员领土内发生的行政开支，并在符合健全货币政策的前提下，用于支付在该成员领土内生产、且为协会资助并位于该领土内项目所需的商品和服务。

Query_Text_en: and in addition when and to the extent justified by the economic and financial situation of the member concerned as determined by agreement between the member and the Association such currency shall be freely convertible or otherwise usable for projects financed by the Association and located outside the territories of the member
Translation: 此外，在成员国的经济和金融状况允许且经成员国与协会协商确定的情况下，该货币应可自由兑换，或以其他方式用于协会资助的、位于成员国境外的项目。

Query_Text_en: b The usability of currencies received by the Association in payment of subscriptions other than initial subscriptions of original members and currencies derived therefrom as principal interest or other charges shall be governed by the terms and conditions on which such subscriptions are authorized
Translation: b 协会收到的除原始成员初始认股以外的认股款项，以及由此产生的本金、利息或其他费用所涉及的货币的可用性，应按照该认股获授权时的条款和条件进行管理。

Query_Text_en: c The usability of currencies received by the Association as supplementary resources other than subscriptions and currencies derived therefrom as principal interest or other charges shall be governed by the terms of the arrangements pursuant to which such currencies are received
Translation: 协会作为补充资源收到的货币（除认购及由认购产生的本金、利息或其他费用之外的货币）的可用性，应按照相关安排的条款进行管理。

Query_Text_en: d All other currencies received by the Association may be freely used and exchanged by the Association and shall not be subject to any restriction by the member whose currency is used or exchanged ; provided that the foregoing shall not preclude the Association from entering into any arrangements with the member in whose territories any project financed by the Association is located restricting the use by the Association of such member 's currency received as principal interest or other charges in connection with such financing
Translation: d 除此之外，协会收到的所有其他货币可由协会自由使用和兑换，不受该货币所属成员国的任何限制；但前述规定不妨碍协会与任何由协会资助项目所在成员国达成协议，对协会因该项资助而收到的该成员国货币（包括本金、利息或其他费用）的使用加以限制。

Query_Text_en: e The Association shall take appropriate steps to ensure that over reasonable intervals of time the portions of the subscriptions paid under Article 11 Section 2 d by members listed in Part of Schedule A shall be used by the Association on an approximately pro rata basis provided however that such portions of such subscriptions as are paid in gold or in a currency other than that of the subscribing member may be used more rapidly
Translation: 协会应采取适当措施，确保在合理的时间间隔内，附表A第一部分所列成员根据第11条第2款(d)项支付的会费部分由协会按大致比例使用；但前提是，以黄金或非该成员本国货币支付的会费部分可以更快地被使用。

Query_Text_en: a Whenever the par value of a member 's currency is reduced or the foreign exchange value of a member 's currency has in the opinion of the Association depreciated to a significant extent within that member 's territories the member shall pay to the Association within a reasonable time an additional amount of its own currency sufficient to maintain the value as of the time of subscription of the amount of the currency of such member paid in to the Association by the member under Article Section 2 d and currency furnished under the provisions of the present paragraph whether or not such currency is held in the form of notes accepted pursuant to Article Section 2 e provided however that the foregoing shall apply only so long as and to the extent that such currency shall not have been initially disbursed or exchanged for the currency of another member
Translation: a. 每当某一成员国货币的平价被下调，或协会认为该成员国货币在其境内的对外汇价值已显著贬值时，该成员国应在合理期限内向协会补缴足够数量的本国货币，以维持其根据本协定第2条第d款缴纳给协会的货币金额在认购时的价值，以及根据本段规定补缴的货币价值，无论该货币是否以根据第2条第e款接受的票据形式持有；但前述规定仅适用于且仅在该货币尚未被初次拨付或兑换为其他成员国货币的情况下。

Query_Text_en: b Whenever the par value of a member 's currency is increased or the foreign exchange value of a member 's currency has in the opinion of the Association appreciated to a significant extent within that member 's territories the Association shall return to such member within a reasonable time an amount of that member 's currency equal to the increase in the value of the amount of such currency to which the provisions of paragraph a of this Section are applicable
Translation: b 每当一国成员货币的平价上调，或协会认为该成员货币在其境内的外汇价值已显著升值时，协会应在合理期限内，向该成员返还相当于本条第a款所适用货币金额增值部分的本国货币。

Query_Text_en: c The provisions of the preceding paragraphs may be waived by the Association when a uniform proportionate change in the par value of the currencies of all its members is made by the International Monetary Fund
Translation: 如果国际货币基金组织对所有成员国货币的平价进行统一比例调整，协会可免除前述条款的适用。

Query_Text_en: d Amounts furnished under the provisions of paragraph a of this Section to maintain the value of any currency shall be convertible and usable to the same extent as such currency
Translation: 根据本条第a款规定为维持任何货币价值而提供的金额，应具有与该货币相同的可兑换性和可使用性。

Query_Text_en: a The Association shall provide financing to further development in the less developed areas of the world included within the Association 's membership
Translation: 协会应为其成员范围内较不发达地区的进一步发展提供资金支持。

Query_Text_en: b Financing provided by the Association shall be for purposes which in the opinion of the Association are of high developmental priority in the light of the needs of the area or areas concerned and except in special circumstances shall be for specific projects
Translation: 协会提供的融资应用于协会认为具有高度发展优先性的用途，考虑到相关地区的需求，除特殊情况外，融资应专用于具体项目。

Query_Text_en: c The Association shall not provide financing if in its opinion such financing is available from private sources on terms which are reasonable for the recipient or could be provided by a loan of the type made by the Bank
Translation: 本协会不得提供融资，如果其认为受援方能够以合理条件从私人渠道获得此类融资，或可通过银行提供的同类贷款获得该融资。

Query_Text_en: d The association shall not provide financing except upon the recommendation of a competent committee made after a careful study of the merits of the proposal Each such committee shall be appointed by the Association and shall include a nominee of the Governor or Governors representing the member or members in whose territories the project under consideration is located and one or more members of the technical staff of the Association The requirement that the committee include the nominee of a Governor or Governors shall not apply in the case of financing provided to a public international or regional organization
Translation: 本协会不得提供融资，除非经有权委员会在对提案优劣进行认真研究后提出建议。每个此类委员会均由协会任命，并应包括代表项目所在成员国或成员国的理事指定人员，以及一名或多名协会技术人员。对于向公共国际或区域性组织提供的融资，不适用委员会须包括理事指定人员的要求。

Query_Text_en: e The Association shall not provide financing for any project if the member in whose territories the project is located objects to such financing except that it shall not be necessary for the Association to assure itself that individual members do not object in the case of financing provided to a public international or regional organization
Translation: 除非项目所在成员国表示反对，否则本协会不得为任何项目提供融资；但若融资对象为某一公共国际或区域性组织，则本协会无须确保各成员国均无异议。

Query_Text_en: f The Association shall impose no conditions that the proceeds of its financing shall be spent in the territories of any particular member or members The foregoing shall not preclude the Association from complying with any restrictions on the use of funds imposed in accordance with the provisions of these Articles including restrictions attached to supplementary resources pursuant to agreement between the Association and the contributor
Translation: 协会不得附加任何条件，要求其融资所得必须在任何特定成员或成员的领土内使用。上述规定不妨碍协会遵守本章程规定的任何资金使用限制，包括根据协会与出资方协议对补充资源所附加的限制。

Query_Text_en: g The Association shall make arrangements to ensure that the proceeds of any financing are used only for the purposes for which the financing was provided with due attention to considerations of economy efficiency and competitive international trade and without regard to political or other non economic influences or considerations
Translation: 本协会应作出安排，确保任何融资所得仅用于融资所规定的用途，并充分考虑经济性、效率和国际贸易的竞争性，不受政治或其他非经济因素的影响。

Query_Text_en: h Funds to be provided under any financing operation shall be made available to the recipient only to meet expenses in connection with the project as they are actually incurred
Translation: 在任何融资操作中提供的资金，仅可用于支付受援方在项目实施过程中实际发生的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: a Financing by the Association shall take the form of loans The Association may however provide other financing either
Translation: 协会提供的融资应以贷款形式为主，但协会也可提供其他类型的融资。

Query_Text_en: ii in special circumstances out of supplementary resources furnished to the Association and funds derived therefrom as principal interest or other charges if the arrangements under which such resources are furnished expressly authorize such financing
Translation: 在特殊情况下，协会可使用补充资源及其所产生的本金、利息或其他费用进行融资，前提是提供该等资源的安排明确授权此类融资。

Query_Text_en: b Subject to the foregoing paragraph the Association may provide financing in such forms and on such terms as it may deem appropriate having regard to the economic position and prospects of the area or areas concerned and to the nature and requirements of the project
Translation: 在不违反前述条款的前提下，协会可根据其认为适当的方式和条件提供融资，并充分考虑相关地区的经济状况与前景，以及项目的性质和需求。

Query_Text_en: c The Association may provide financing to a member the government of a territory included within the Association 's membership a political subdivision of any of the foregoing a public or private entity in the territories of a member or members or to a public international or regional organization
Translation: 本协会可向成员国、协会成员范围内的地区政府、上述任何政府的政治分支、成员国或成员国地区的公共或私人实体，或向公共国际或区域组织提供融资。

Query_Text_en: d In the case of a loan to an entity other than a member the Association may in its discretion require a suitable governmental or other guarantee or guarantees
Translation: 对于向非成员实体提供贷款的情况，协会可酌情要求提供适当的政府或其他担保。

Query_Text_en: e The Association in special cases may make foreign exchange available for local expenditures
Translation: 在特殊情况下，本协会可为本地支出提供外汇。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Modifications of terms of financingThe Association may when and to the extent it deems appropriate in the light of all relevantcircumstances including the financial and economic situation and prospects of the member concerned and on such conditions as it may determine agree to a relaxation or other modification of the terms on which any of its financing shall have been provided
Translation:
第三条 融资条款的调整  
本协会可根据相关成员的财务和经济状况及前景等所有相关情况，在其认为适当的时间和范围内，并按照其所设定的条件，同意放宽或以其他方式调整其所提供融资的条款。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Cooperation with other international organizations and members providing development assistanceThe Association shall cooperate with those public international organizations and members which provide financial and technical assistance to the less developed areas of the world
Translation:
第四节 与其他国际组织及提供发展援助的成员的合作  
本协会应与那些向世界欠发达地区提供资金和技术援助的公共国际组织及成员开展合作。

Query_Text_en: vi exercise such other powers incidental to its operations as shall be necessary or desirable in furtherance of its purposes
Translation: 行使与其运作相关的其他附带权力，只要这些权力对于实现其宗旨是必要或可取的。

Query_Text_en: nor shall they be influenced in their decisions by the political character of the member or members concerned Only economic considerations shall be relevant to their decisions and these considerations shall be weighed impartially in order to achieve the purposes stated in this Agreement
Translation: 他们在作出决定时，不得受相关成员的政治属性影响。其决定应仅以经济因素为依据，并应公正权衡这些因素，以实现本协定所述目标。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Structure of the AssociationThe Association shall have a Board of Governors Executive Directors a President and such other officers and staff to perform such duties as the Association may determine
Translation:
第一节 协会的组织结构

协会设理事会、执行董事会、会长，以及协会根据需要设立的其他职员和工作人员，负责履行协会规定的各项职责。

Query_Text_en: a All the powers of the Association shall be vested in the Board of Governors
Translation: 协会的所有权力均归理事会行使。

Query_Text_en: b Each Governor and Alternate Governor of the Bank appointed by a member of the Bank which is also a member of the Association shall ex officio be a Governor and Alternate Governor respectively of the Association No Alternate Governor may vote except in the absence of his principal The Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Bank shall ex officio be Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Association except that if the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Bank shall represent a state which is not a member of the Association then the Board of Governors shall select one of the Governors as Chairman of the Board of Governors Any Governor or Alternate Governor shall cease to hold office if the member by which he was appointed shall cease to be a member of the Association
Translation: 由同时为本行成员和本协会成员的国家所任命的本行每一位理事及副理事，当然也分别为本协会的理事及副理事。除非其正职缺席，副理事不得行使表决权。本行理事会主席当然为本协会理事会主席，但如本行理事会主席代表的国家并非本协会成员，则理事会应从理事中选举一人担任理事会主席。任何理事或副理事，如其任命国不再为本协会成员，则其职务即告终止。

Query_Text_en: viii approve proposed amendments to this Agreement
Translation: 八、批准对本协议的拟议修订。

Query_Text_en: d The Board of Governors shall hold an annual meeting and such other meetings as may be provided for by the Board of Governors or called by the Executive Directors
Translation: 董事会应每年召开一次年度会议，并根据董事会的规定或执行董事的召集，召开其他会议。

Query_Text_en: e The annual meeting of the Board of Governors shall be held in conjunction with the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the Bank
Translation: 理事会年会应与银行理事会年会同时举行。

Query_Text_en: f A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Governors shall be a majority of the Governors exercising not less than two thirds of the total voting power
Translation: 任何一次理事会会议的法定人数应为拥有不少于三分之二总投票权的多数理事。

Query_Text_en: g The Association may by regulation establish a procedure whereby the Executive Directors may obtain a vote of the Governors on a specific question without calling a wee ting of the Board of Governors
Translation: 本协会可通过规章制定程序，使执行董事在无需召开理事会会议的情况下，就某一特定事项征求理事的表决意见。

Query_Text_en: h The Board of Governors and the Executive Directors to the extent authorized may adopt such rules and regulations as may be necessary or appropriate to conduct the business of the Association
Translation: 董事会和执行董事在授权范围内，可以制定为协会业务开展所必需或适当的规章制度。

Query_Text_en: i Governors and Alternate Governors shall serve as such without compensation from the Association
Translation: 各理事及副理事在协会任职期间不领取协会的任何报酬。

Query_Text_en: a Each original member shall in respect of its initial subscription have 500 votes plus one additional vote for each $ 5000 of its initial subscription Subscriptions other than initial subscriptions of original members shall carry such voting rights as the Board of Governors shall determine pursuant to the provisions of Article Section 1 b or Article Section 1 b and c as the case may be Additions to resources other than subscriptions under Article Section 1 b and additional subscriptions under Article Ill Section 1 shall not carry voting rights
Translation: 每一原始成员在其初始认缴出资方面应拥有500票的基本表决权，并且每增加5,000美元的初始认缴出资，增加一票。原始成员的初始认缴出资以外的认缴出资，其表决权应由理事会根据本协定第___条第1款(b)项或第___条第1款(b)项和(c)项的规定决定，视具体情况而定。根据第___条第1款(b)项规定的认缴出资以外的资源增加，以及根据第___条第1款规定的追加认缴出资，不享有表决权。

Query_Text_en: b Except as otherwise specifically provided all matters before the Association shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast
Translation: 除非另有明确规定，协会所有事项均应以投票多数决定。

Query_Text_en: a The Executive Directors shall be responsible for the conduct of the general operations of the Association and for this purpose shall exercise all the powers given to them by this Agreement or delegated to them by the Board of Governors
Translation: 执行董事负责协会的日常运营，并为此行使本协议赋予或理事会授权的所有权力。

Query_Text_en: b The Executive Directors of the Association shall be composed ex officio of each Executive Director of the Bank who shall have been i appointed by a member of the Bank which is also a member of the Association or ii elected in an election in which the votes of at lest one member of the Bank which is also a member of the Association shall have counted toward his election The Alternate to each such Executive Director of the Bank shall ex officio be an Alternate Director of the Association Any Director shall cease to hold office if the member by which he was appointed or if all the members whose votes counted toward his election shall cease to be members of the Association
Translation: 协会的执行董事由银行的每一位执行董事当然组成，前提是该执行董事是由同时为银行和协会成员的成员国任命，或是在选举中至少有一个同时为银行和协会成员的成员国的选票计入其当选。银行每位执行董事的副董事当然也为协会的副董事。任何董事若其任命成员国，或所有在其当选过程中计入选票的成员国不再是协会成员，则该董事即自动丧失其职务。

Query_Text_en: c Each Director who is an appointed Executive Director of the Bank shall be entitled to cast the number of votes which the member by which he was appointed is entitled to cast in the Association Each Director who is an elected Executive Director of the Bank shall be entitled to cast the number of votes which the member or members of the Association whose votes counted toward his election in the Bank are entitled to cast in the Association All the votes which a Director is entitled to cast shall be cast as a unit
Translation: 每一位由成员任命的银行执行董事，均有权在协会中投出该成员所拥有的票数。每一位由选举产生的银行执行董事，均有权在协会中投出在银行选举中为其投票的成员或成员在协会中所拥有的票数。董事有权投出的所有票数须作为一个整体进行投票。

Query_Text_en: d An Alternate Director shall have full power to act in the absence of the Director who shall have appointed him When a Director is present his Alternate may participate in meetings but shall not vote
Translation: 替代董事在其任命的董事缺席时，拥有全权行使职权。当董事出席会议时，其替代董事可以参与会议，但不得投票。

Query_Text_en: e A quorum for any meeting of the Executive Directors shall be a majority of the Directors exercising not less than one half of the total voting power
Translation: 任何执行董事会会议的法定人数应为多数董事，并且其所行使的表决权不少于全部表决权的一半。

Query_Text_en: f The Executive Directors shall meet as often as the business of the Association may require
Translation: 执行董事应根据协会业务需要随时召开会议。

Query_Text_en: g The Board of Governors shall adopt regulations under which a member of the Association not entitled to appoint an Executive Director of the Bank may send a representative to attend any meeting of the Executive Directors of the Association when a request made by or a matter particularly affecting that member is under consideration
Translation: 理事会应制定相关规章，允许无权任命银行执行董事的协会成员，在其提出请求或涉及该成员的特殊事项被审议时，派代表参加协会执行董事的任何会议。

Query_Text_en: a The President of the Bank shall be ex officio President of the Association The President shall be Chairman of the Executive Directors of the Association but shall have no vote except a declining vote in case of an equal division He may participate in meetings of the Board of Governors but shall not vote at such meetings
Translation: 银行行长应当然担任协会主席。主席应担任协会执行董事会主席，但除在表决结果出现平局时拥有决定性投票权外，不享有其他投票权。主席可参加理事会会议，但不得在该会议上投票。

Query_Text_en: b The President shall be chief of the operating staff of the Association Under the direction of the Executive Directors he shall conduct the ordinary business of the Association and under their general control shall be responsible for the organization appointment and dismissal of the officers and staff To the extent practicable officers and staff of the Bank shall be appointed to serve concurrently as officers and staff of the Association
Translation: b. 协会主席为协会运营团队的首席负责人。在执行董事的指导下，主席负责处理协会的日常事务，并在其总体监督下，负责协会管理人员和员工的组织、任命及解聘工作。在可行的范围内，银行的管理人员和员工应同时担任协会的管理人员和员工。

Query_Text_en: c The President officers and staff of the Association in the discharge of their offices owe their duty entirely to the Association and to no other authority Each member of the Association shall respect the international character of this duty and shall refrain from all attempts to influence any of them in the discharge of their dutieS
Translation: 协会的主席、各级管理人员及工作人员在履行其职责时，应完全忠于协会本身，而不受任何其他权威的指使。协会每一成员都应尊重这一职责的国际性质，并应避免以任何方式试图影响上述人员履行其职责。

Query_Text_en: d In appointing officers and staff the President shall subject to the paramount importance of securing the highest standards of efficiency and of technical competence pay due regard to the importance of recruiting personnel on as wide a geographical basis as possible
Translation: 在任命官员和工作人员时，主席应以确保最高效率和专业能力为首要原则，同时充分重视在尽可能广泛的地域范围内招聘人员的重要性。

Query_Text_en: a The Association shall be an entity separate and distinct from the Bank and the funds of the Association shall be kept separate and apart from those of the Bank The Association shall not borrow from or lend to the Bank except that this shall not preclude the Association from investing funds not needed in its financing operations in obligations of the Bank
Translation: 协会应当作为一个独立于银行的实体，其资金应与银行的资金分开管理。协会不得向银行借款或向银行贷款，但这并不妨碍协会将其在融资业务中暂时不需要的资金投资于银行的债务。

Query_Text_en: b The Association may make arrangements with the Bank regarding facilities personnel and services and arrangements for reimbursement of administrative expenses paid in the first instance by either organization on behalf of the other
Translation: 协会可与银行就设施、人员和服务，以及由任一方代表对方先行支付的行政费用的报销安排达成协议。

Query_Text_en: c Nothing in this Agreement shall make the Association liable for the acts or obligations of the Bank or the Bank liable for the acts or obligations of the Association
Translation: 本协议中的任何内容均不应使协会对银行的行为或义务承担责任，亦不应使银行对协会的行为或义务承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 Relations with other international organizationsThe Association shall enter into formal arrangements with the United Nations and may enter into such arrangements with other public international organizations having specialized responsibilities in related fields
Translation:
第七条 与其他国际组织的关系  
本协会应与联合国建立正式合作关系，并可与在相关领域具有专门职责的其他公共国际组织建立类似合作关系。

Query_Text_en: Section 8 Location of officesThe principal office of the Association shall be the principal office of the Bank The Association may establish other offices in the territories of any member
Translation:
第八条 办公地点  
协会的主要办事处应设在银行的主要办事处。协会可在任何成员国境内设立其他办事处。

Query_Text_en: Section 9 DepositoriesEach member shall designate its central bank as a depository in which the Association may keep holdings of such member 's currency or other assets of the Association or if it has no central bank it shall designate for such purpose such other institution as may be acceptable to the Association In the absence of any different designation the depository designated for the Bank shall be the depository for the Association
Translation:
第九节 存款机构  
每个成员应指定其中央银行作为存款机构，协会可在该机构中存放该成员的货币或协会的其他资产；如该成员没有中央银行，则应为此目的指定其他经协会认可的机构。若未另行指定，则为银行指定的存款机构即为协会的存款机构。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 Channel of communicationEach member shall designate an appropriate authority with which the Association may communicate in connection with any matter arising under this Agreement In the absence of any different designation the channel of communication designated for the Bank shall be the channel for the Association
Translation:
第十条 通讯渠道  
每一成员应指定一个适当的机构，作为协会就本协议项下任何事项进行沟通的渠道。如未另行指定，银行所指定的通讯渠道即为协会的通讯渠道。

Query_Text_en: a The Association shall publish an annual report containing an audited statement of its accounts and shall circulate to members at appropriate intervals a summary statement of its financial position and of the results of its operations
Translation: 协会应发布年度报告，其中包括经审计的财务报表，并应在适当的时间向会员通报其财务状况摘要及经营成果。

Query_Text_en: b The Association may publish such other reports as it deems desirable to carry out its purposes
Translation: 协会可根据需要发布其他其认为有助于实现宗旨的报告。

Query_Text_en: c Copies of all reports statements and publications made under this Section shall be distributed to members
Translation: 本条款下所作的所有报告、声明和出版物的副本应分发给各成员。

Query_Text_en: Section 12 Disposition of net incomeThe Board of Governors shall determine from time to time the disposition of the Association 's net income having due regard to provision for reserves and contingencies
Translation:
第十二条 净收入的处置

理事会应根据储备和应急事项的安排，适时决定协会净收入的处置方式。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Withdrawal by membersAny member may withdraw from membership in the Association at any time by transmitting a notice in writing to the Association at its principal office Withdrawal shall become effective upon the date such notice is received
Translation:
第一节 会员退出  
任何会员可随时通过向协会总部提交书面通知的方式退出协会。退出自协会收到该通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: a If a member fails to fulfil any of its obligations to the Association the Association may suspend its membership by decision of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power The member so suspended shall automatically cease to be a member one year from the date of its suspension unless a decision is taken by the same majority to restore the member to good standing
Translation: 如果任何成员未能履行其对本协会的任何义务，经拥有多数表决权的理事以多数票决定，本协会可暂停该成员的会籍。被暂停的成员自暂停之日起一年后将自动丧失会员资格，除非由同样多数的理事作出决定，恢复该成员的良好信誉。

Query_Text_en: b While under suspension a member shall not be entitled to exercise any rights under this Agreement except the right of withdrawal but shall remain subject to all obligations
Translation: 在被暂停期间，成员无权行使本协定项下的任何权利，但保留退出权，同时仍须履行所有义务。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Suspension or cessation of membership in the BankAny member which is suspended from membership in or ceases to be a member of the Bank shall automatically be suspended from membership in or cease to be a member of the Association as the case may be
Translation:
第三条 暂停或终止在银行的会员资格  
任何被暂停或终止银行会员资格的成员，将自动相应地被暂停或终止在本协会的会员资格。

Query_Text_en: a When a government ceases to be a member it shall have no rights under this Agreement except as provided in this Section and in Article c but it shall except as in this Section otherwise provided remain liable for all financial obligations undertaken by it to the Association whether as a member borrower guarantor or otherwise
Translation: 当一国政府不再是本协定的成员时，除本条和第c条另有规定外，其在本协定项下不再享有任何权利，但除本条另有规定外，该政府作为成员、借款方、担保方或以其他身份对协会承担的所有财务义务仍须履行。

Query_Text_en: b When a government ceases to be a member the Association and the government shall proceed to a settlement of accounts As part of such settlement of accounts the Association and the government may agree on the amounts to be paid to the government on account of its subscription and on the time and currencies of payment The term subscription when used in relation to any member government shall for the purposes of this Article be deemed to include both the initial subscription and any additional subscription of such member government
Translation: 当一个政府不再是本协会成员时，协会与该政府应进行账目结算。作为账目结算的一部分，协会与该政府可就其认缴份额应支付的金额，以及支付的时间和币种达成一致。就本条而言，凡提及任何成员政府的认缴份额，均视为包括该成员政府的初始认缴份额及任何追加认缴份额。

Query_Text_en: i The government shall be relieved of any further liability to the Association on account of its subscription except that the government shall pay to the Association forthwith amounts due and unpaid on the date when the government ceased to be a member and which in the opinion of the Association are needed by it to meet its commitments as of that date under its financing operations
Translation: 政府除应立即向协会支付其终止会员资格之日尚未支付且到期的款项，并且该等款项经协会认定为其在该日期根据融资业务履行承诺所需外，无需就其出资对协会承担进一步责任。

Query_Text_en: ii The Association shall return to the government funds paid in by the government on account of its subscription or derived therefrom as principal repayments and held by the Association on the date when the government ceased to be a member except to the extent that in the opinion of the Association such funds will be needed by it to meet its commitments as of that date under its financing operations
Translation: ii 除非协会认为截至该日期根据其融资业务所承担的义务需要使用相关资金，否则，协会应向政府返还政府因其出资认缴而支付或由此产生并作为本金偿还、且在政府终止会员资格之日由协会持有的资金。

Query_Text_en: iii The Association shall pay over to the government a pro rata share of all principal repayments received by the Association after the date on which the government ceases to be a member on loans contracted prior thereto except those made out of supplementary resources provided to the Association under arrangements specifying special liquidation rights Such share shall be such proportion of the total principal amount of such loans as the total amount paid by the government on account of its subscription and not returned to it pursuant to clause ii above shall bear to the total amount paid by all members on account of their subscriptions which shall have been used or in the opinion of the Association will be needed by it to meet its commitments under its financing operations as of the date on which the government ceases to be a member Such payment by the Association shall be made in instalments when and as such principal repayments are received by the Association but not more frequently than annually Such instalments shall be paid in the currencies received by the Association except that the Association may in its discretion make payment in the currency of the government concerned
Translation: 三、协会应向政府支付其按比例分配的所有本金偿还款项，这些款项是协会在政府终止会员资格之日后收到的，且系在该日期之前签订的贷款合同项下的本金偿还，惟由补充资源提供且根据安排规定有特殊清算权的贷款除外。该比例应为政府因其认购而支付且根据上述第二款未归还给政府的总金额，占所有成员因其认购而支付且已被协会用于或协会认为将需用于履行其融资业务承诺的总金额（以政府终止会员资格之日为准）的比例。协会应在收到本金偿还款项时分期支付上述款项，但支付频率不得高于每年一次。各期款项应以协会收到的货币支付，但协会可自行决定以有关政府的货币支付。

Query_Text_en: iv Any amount due to the government on account of its subscription may be withheld so long as that government or the government of any territory included within its membership or any political subdivision or any agency of any of the foregoing remains liable as borrower or guarantor to the Association and such amount may at the option of the Association be applied against any such liability as it matures
Translation: 四、凡因政府认购而应支付给协会的任何款项，在该政府、其成员范围内的任何领土政府、任何政治分支机构或上述任何一方的任何机构，作为借款人或担保人对协会仍负有责任期间，均可予以扣留。协会可自行决定将该等款项用于抵偿上述责任项下到期的任何债务。

Query_Text_en: a the amount paid by the government on account of its subscription or b such proportion of the net assets of the Association as shown on the books of the Association as of the date on which the government ceased to be a member as the amount of its subscription shall bear to the aggregate amount of the subscriptions of all members
Translation:
a. 政府因其认购而支付的金额，或  
b. 协会账簿上显示的净资产中，按政府停止成为会员之日，其认购金额占所有会员认购总额的比例所对应的部分。

Query_Text_en: vi All calculations required hereunder shall be made on such basis as shall be reasonably determined by the Association
Translation: 所有本协议项下所需的计算，均应按照协会合理确定的标准进行。

Query_Text_en: d In no event shall any amount due to a government under this Section be paid until six months after the date upon which the government ceases to be a member If within six months of the date upon which any government ceases to be a member the Association suspends operations under Section 5 of this Article all rights of such government shall be determined by the provisions of such Section 5 and such government shall be considered a member of the Association for purposes of such Section 5 except that it shall have no voting fights
Translation: 在任何情况下，根据本条款应支付给某一政府的任何款项，均不得在该政府终止成员资格之日起六个月内支付。如果在任何政府终止成员资格之日起六个月内，本协会根据本条第5款暂停业务，则该政府的所有权利应按照该第5款的规定予以确定，并且在适用该第5款时，该政府应被视为本协会成员，但不享有表决权。

Query_Text_en: a The Association may permanently suspend its operations by vote of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power After such suspension of operations the Association shall forthwith cease all activities except those incident to the orderly realization conservation and preservation of its assets and settlement of its obligations Until Final settlement of such obligations and distribution of such assets the Association shall remain in existence and all mutual rights and obligations of the Association and its members under this Agreement shall continue unimpaired except that no member shall be suspended or shall withdraw and that no distribution shall be made to members except as in this Section provided
Translation: 本协会可经行使多数表决权的理事会成员以多数票决定，永久中止其业务。业务中止后，协会应立即停止除为有序实现、保全和保存其资产及清偿其债务所必需的活动之外的所有活动。在最终清偿上述债务并分配资产之前，协会应继续存在，协会与其成员根据本协议享有的所有相互权利和义务应继续有效，但不得暂停任何成员资格或允许成员退出，亦不得向成员进行除本条规定之外的任何分配。

Query_Text_en: b No distribution shall be made to members on account of their subscriptions until all liabilities to creditors shall have been discharged or provided for and until the Board of Governors by vote of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power shall have decided to make such distribution
Translation: 在所有对债权人的负债被清偿或作出安排之前，并且在理事会经多数理事、代表多数总投票权投票决定进行分配之前，不得因成员的认购向其进行任何分配。

Query_Text_en: c Subject to the foregoing and to any special arrangements for the disposition of supplementary resources agreed upon in connection with the provision of such resources to the Association the Association shall distribute its assets to members pro rata in proportion to amounts paid in by them on account of their subscriptions Any distribution pursuant to the foregoing provision of this paragraph c shall be subject in the case of any member to prior settlement of all outstanding claims by the Association against such member Such distribution shall be made at such times in such currencies and in cash or other assets as the Association shall deem fair and equitable Distribution to the several members need not be uniform in respect of the type of assets distributed or of the currencies in which they are expressed
Translation: 在遵循上述规定以及与向协会提供补充资源相关的任何特殊处置安排的前提下，协会应按各成员根据其认缴份额实际支付的金额比例，向成员分配其资产。根据本款前述规定进行的任何分配，须以协会与有关成员之间所有未结清债权的优先清算为前提。此类分配应在协会认为公平合理的时间、以协会认为公平合理的货币，并以现金或其他资产进行。向各成员的分配在所分配资产的类型或所用货币方面无需保持一致。

Query_Text_en: d Any member receiving assets distributed by the Association pursuant to this Section or Section 4 shall enjoy the same rights with respect to such assets as the Association enjoyed prior to their distribution
Translation: 任何根据本条或第4条获得协会分配资产的成员，均享有与协会在分配前对该资产所享有的相同权利。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Purposes of ArticleTo enable the Association to fulfill the functions with which it is entrusted the status immunities and privileges provided in this Article shall be accorded to the Association in the territories of each member
Translation:
第一节  本条宗旨

为使本协会能够履行其所承担的职责，各成员应在其境内给予本协会本条所规定的地位、豁免和特权。

Query_Text_en: iii to institute legal proceedings
Translation: 三、提起法律诉讼

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Position of the Association with regard to judicial processActions may be brought against the Association only in a court of competent jurisdiction in the territories of a member in which the Association has an office has appointed an agent for the purpose of accepting service or notice of process or has issued or guaranteed securities No actions shall however be brought by members or persons acting for or deriving claims from members The property and assets of the Association shall wheresoever located and by whomsoever held be immune from all forms of seizure attachment or execution before the delivery of final judgment against the Association
Translation:
第三节 协会在司法程序中的地位

只有在协会设有办事处、为接受送达或通知程序指定代理人或发行或担保证券的成员国辖区内的有管辖权法院，才能对协会提起诉讼。然而，成员或代表成员行事或从成员处获得权利的人不得对协会提起诉讼。协会的财产和资产，无论位于何处、由谁持有，在对协会作出最终判决之前，均享有免于任何形式的扣押、查封或强制执行的豁免权。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Immunity of assets from seizureProperty and asset of the Association wherever located and by whomsoever held shall be immune from search requisition confiscation expropriation or any other form of seizure by executive or legislative action
Translation:
第四条 资产免于扣押

协会的财产和资产，无论位于何处、由谁持有，均免于因行政或立法行为而被搜查、征用、没收、征收或以任何其他形式扣押。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 Immunity of archivesThe archives of the Association shall be inviolable
Translation:
第五条 档案豁免权  
本协会的档案应享有不可侵犯权。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 Freedom of assets from restrictionsTo the extent necessary to carry out the operations provided for in this Agreement and subject to the provisions of this Agreement all property and assets of the Association shall be free from restrictions regulations controls and moratoria of any nature
Translation:
第六条 资产自由不受限制

在本协定规定的业务范围内，并遵守本协定的相关规定，协会的所有财产和资产应免受任何形式的限制、规章、管制或延期措施的约束。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 Privilege for communicationsThe official communications of the Association shall be accorded by each member the same treatment that it accords to the official communications of other members
Translation:
第七条 通信特权  
各成员应给予协会官方通信与其对其他成员官方通信相同的待遇。

Query_Text_en: i shall be immune from legal process with respect to acts performed by them in their official capacity except when the Association waives this immunity ;
Translation: 对于其以公务身份所执行的行为，本人应享有法律程序豁免权，除非协会放弃该豁免权。

Query_Text_en: iii shall be granted the same treatment in respect of traveling facilities as is accorded by members to representatives officials and employees of comparable rank of other members
Translation: 在旅行便利方面，第三条应享有与成员国对其他成员国具有相当级别的代表、官员和雇员所给予的同等待遇。

Query_Text_en: a The Association its assets property income and its operations and transactions authorized by this Agreement shall be immune from all taxation and from all customs duties The Association shall also be immune from liability for the collection or payment of any tax or duty
Translation: 本协会及其资产、财产、收入，以及根据本协议授权的运营和交易，均享有免除一切税收和关税的豁免权。协会亦免于承担任何税款或关税的征收或支付责任。

Query_Text_en: b No tax shall be levied on or in respect of salaries and emoluments paid by the Association to Executive Directors Alternates officials or employees of the Association who are not local citizens local subjects or other local nationals
Translation: 协会向执行董事、候补董事、协会官员或雇员支付的薪金和报酬，凡受薪者并非当地公民、当地臣民或其他当地国民，均不得征收任何税款。

Query_Text_en: ii if the sole jurisdictional basis for such taxation is the place or currency in which it is issued made payable or paid or the location of any office or place of business maintained by the Association
Translation: 二、如果对该项征税的唯一管辖依据仅为其发行、支付或付款的地点或货币，或仅为协会设立的任何办事处或营业场所的所在地。

Query_Text_en: ii if the sole jurisdictional basis of such taxation is the location of any office or place of business maintained by the Association
Translation: 二、如果该项税收的唯一管辖依据仅为协会设立的任何办事处或营业场所的所在地。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 Application of ArticleEach member shall take such action as is necessary in its own territories for the purpose of making effective in terms of its own law the principles set forth in this Article and shall inform the Association of the detailed action which it has taken
Translation:
第十条的适用  
各成员应在其本国境内采取必要措施，以使本条所规定的原则根据本国法律得到有效实施，并应将其所采取的具体措施通报协会。

Query_Text_en: a Any proposal to introduce modifications in this Agreement whether emanating from a member a Governor or the Executive Directors shall be communicated to the Chairman of the Board of Governors who shall bring the proposal before the Board If the proposed amendment is approved by the Board the Association shall by circular letter or telegram ask all members whether they accept the proposed amendment When three fifths of the members having four fifths of the total voting power have accepted the proposed amendments the Association shall certify the fact by formal communication addressed to all members
Translation: 任何对本协议提出修改建议，无论是由成员、理事还是执行董事提出，均应通知理事会主席，由主席提交理事会审议。如果理事会批准该项修改建议，协会将通过通函或电报询问所有成员是否接受该项修改。当拥有四分之五总投票权的五分之三成员接受该项修改后，协会将通过正式通知向所有成员确认该事实。

Query_Text_en: iii the limitation on liability provided in Article U Section 3
Translation: iii 《U条》第3款所规定的责任限制

Query_Text_en: c Amendments shall enter into force for all members three months after the date of the formal communication unless a shorter period is specified in the circular letter or telegram
Translation: c 修正案应在正式通知发出之日起三个月后对所有成员生效，除非通报函或电报中另有规定较短期限。

Query_Text_en: a Any question of interpretation of the provisions of this Agreement arising between any member and the Association or between any members of the Association shall be submitted to the Executive Directors for their decision If the question particularly affects any member of the Association not entitled to appoint an Executive Director of the Bank it shall be entitled to representation in accordance with Article VI Section 4 g
Translation: 凡本协议条款的解释问题，无论是成员与协会之间，还是协会成员之间发生的，均应提交执行董事会裁决。如果该问题特别涉及无权指派银行执行董事的协会成员，该成员有权根据第六条第四款（g）规定获得代表权。

Query_Text_en: b In any case where the Executive Directors have given a decision under a above any member may require that the question be referred to the Board of Governors whose decision shall be final Pending the result of the reference to the Board of Governors the Association may so far as it deems necessary act on the basis of the decision of the Executive Directors
Translation: 在执行董事根据上述条款作出决定的任何情况下，任何成员均可要求将该问题提交理事会裁决，理事会的决定为最终决定。在提交理事会裁决结果未出之前，协会可根据执行董事的决定，在其认为必要的范围内采取行动。

Query_Text_en: c Whenever a disagreement arises between the Association and a country which has ceased to be a member or between the Association and any member during the permanent suspension of the Association such disagreement shall be submitted to arbitration by a tribunal of three arbitrators one appointed by the Association another by the country involved and an umpire who unless the parties otherwise agree shall be appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice or such other authority as may have been prescribed by regulation adopted by the Association The umpire shall have full power to settle all questions of procedure in any case where the parties are in disagreement with respect thereto
Translation: 每当协会与已不再是会员的国家之间，或协会与任何会员在协会永久暂停期间之间发生争议时，该争议应提交由三名仲裁员组成的仲裁庭进行仲裁。其中一名仲裁员由协会指定，另一名由相关国家指定，第三名仲裁员为裁决员，除非双方另有约定，否则裁决员应由国际法院院长或协会根据其通过的规章所规定的其他权威机构任命。裁决员在双方对程序问题存在分歧时，拥有全权决定所有程序事项。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Entry into forceThis Agreement shall enter into force when it has been signed on behalf of governments whose subscriptions comprise not less than sixty five percent of the total subscriptions set forth in Schedule A and when the instruments referred to in Section 2 a of this Article have been deposited on their behalf but in no event shall this Agreement enter into force before 15 September 1960
Translation:
第一条 生效

本协议在代表其认购总额不低于附表A所列总认购额百分之六十五的各国政府签署，并且根据本条第二款a项所述文件已由其代表提交后生效，但无论如何，本协议不得早于1960年9月15日生效。

Query_Text_en: a Each government on whose behalf this Agreement is signed shall deposit with the Bank an instrument setting forth that it has accepted this Agreement in accordance with its law and has taken all steps necessary to enable it to carry out all of its obligations under this Agreement
Translation: 每个代表其签署本协议的政府，均应向银行提交一份文件，说明其已根据本国法律接受本协议，并已采取所有必要措施，以履行本协议项下的全部义务。

Query_Text_en: b Each government shall become a member of the Association as from the date of the deposit on its behalf of the instrument referred to in paragraph a above except that no government shall become a member before this Agreement enters into force under Section 1 of this Article
Translation: 每个政府自代表其提交上述第a款所述文件之日起，成为本协会成员，但在本协议根据本条第1节生效之前，任何政府不得成为成员。

Query_Text_en: c This Agreement shall remain open for signature until the close of business on 31 December 1960 at the principal office of the Bank on behalf of the governments of the states whose names are set forth in Schedule A provided that if this Agreement shall not have entered into force by that date the Executive Directors of the Bank may extend the period during which this Agreement shall remain open for signature by not more than six months
Translation: 本协定自签署之日起，至1960年12月31日营业结束时止，在银行总行供附表A所列国家政府签署；但如本协定届时尚未生效，银行执行董事会可将本协定的签署期限延长不超过六个月。

Query_Text_en: d After this Agreement shall have entered into force it shall be open for signature on behalf of the government of any state whose membership shall have been approved pursuant to Article Section 1 b
Translation: 本协议生效后，任何根据第1条第b款批准加入的国家政府均可签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Territorial applicationBy its signature of this Agreement each government accepts it both on its own behalf and in respect of all territories for whose international relations such government is responsible except those which are excluded by such government by written notice to the Association
Translation:
第三条 适用范围  
各缔约国在签署本协议时，既代表本国，也代表其负责处理国际关系的所有领土接受本协议，除非该国通过书面通知协会明确排除某些领土。

Query_Text_en: a As soon as this Agreement enters into force under Section 1 of this Article the President shall call a meeting of the Executive Directors
Translation: 本协议根据本条第1款生效后，总裁应召集执行董事会议。

Query_Text_en: b The Association shall begin operations on the date when such meeting is held
Translation: 协会自该会议召开之日起开始运作。

Query_Text_en: c Pending the first meeting of the Board of Governors the Executive Directors may exercise all the powers of the Board of Governors except those reserved to the Board of Governors under this Agreement
Translation: 在理事会首次会议召开之前，执行董事可行使理事会除本协议规定专属理事会的所有权力。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 RegistrationThe Bank is authorized to register this Agreement with the Secretariat of the United Nations in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations and the Regulations thereunder adopted by the General Assembly DONE at Washington in a single copy which shall remain deposited in the archives of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development which has indicated by its signature below its agreement to act as depository of this Agreement to register this Agreement with the Secretariat of the United Nations and to notify all governments whose names are set forth in Schedule A of the date when this Agreement shall have entered into force under Article Section 1 hereof
Translation:
第五节 注册  
本银行被授权根据《联合国宪章》第102条及联合国大会通过的相关条例，将本协议向联合国秘书处进行注册。本协议在华盛顿签署，仅有一份，存放于国际复兴开发银行档案中。国际复兴开发银行已在下方签署，表示同意作为本协议的保管方，负责将本协议向联合国秘书处注册，并通知附表A所列所有政府本协议根据第一节规定生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: Article PurposeThe purpose of the Corporation is to further economic development by encouraging the growth of productive private enterprise in member countries particularly in the less developed areas thus supplementing the activities of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development hereinafter called the Bank In carrying out this purpose the Corporation shall :
Translation:
宗旨  
本公司的宗旨是通过鼓励成员国，特别是欠发达地区的生产性私营企业的发展，促进经济发展，从而补充国际复兴开发银行（以下简称“银行”）的相关活动。为实现上述宗旨，公司应：

Query_Text_en: and iii seek to stimulate and to help create conditions conducive to the flow of private capital domestic and foreign into productive investment in member countries The Corporation shall be guided in all its decisions by the provisions of this Article
Translation: 三、努力促进并协助创造有利条件，推动国内外私人资本流入成员国的生产性投资。公司在作出所有决策时，应以本条款的规定为指导。

Query_Text_en: a The original members of the Corporation shall be those members of the Bank listed in Schedule A hereto which shall on or before the date specified in Article Section 2 c accept membership in the Corporation
Translation: 公司原始成员应为本附件A所列银行成员，这些成员须在第2条第c款规定的日期或之前接受公司成员资格。

Query_Text_en: b Membership shall be open to other members of the Bank at such times and in accordance with such terms as may be prescribed by the Corporation
Translation: b 银行的其他成员可在公司规定的时间和条件下申请加入成为会员。

Query_Text_en: a The authorized capital stock of the Corporation shall be $ 100 000 000 in terms of United states dollars
Translation: 公司的授权股本为1亿美元，计价单位为美元。

Query_Text_en: b The authorized capital stock shall be divided into 100 000 shares having a par value of one thousand United States dollars each Any such shares not initially subscribed by original members shall be available for subsequent subscription in accordance with Section 3 d of this Article
Translation: b. 授权股本应分为100,000股，每股面值为1,000美元。原始成员未初始认购的任何股份，可根据本条第3(d)款的规定，供后续认购。

Query_Text_en: i by a majority of the votes cast in case such increase is necessary for the purpose of issuing shares of capital stock on initial subscription by members other than original members provided that the aggregate of any increases authorized pursuant to this subparagraph shall not exceed 10 000 shares ;
Translation: 如需向除原始成员以外的成员首次发行资本股票，须经多数投票通过，方可增加股份；但根据本款授权的所有增发股份总数不得超过10,000股。

Query_Text_en: ii in any other case by a three fourths majority of the total voting power d In case of an increased authorized pursuant to paragraph c ii above each member shall have a reasonable opportunity to subscribe under such conditions as the Corporation shall decide to a proportion of the increase of stock equivalent to the proportion which its stock theretofore subscribed bears to the total capital stock of the Corporation but no member shall be obligated to subscribe to any part of the increased capital
Translation:
ii 在其他任何情况下，须经总表决权四分之三多数通过。

d. 根据上述第c款ii项增加授权资本的情况下，每一成员应有合理机会，按照公司决定的条件，认购与其先前所认购股份占公司总股本比例相当的新增股份，但任何成员均无义务认购新增资本的任何部分。

Query_Text_en: e Issuance of shares of stock other than those subscribed either on initial subscription or pursuant to paragraph d above shall require a three fourths majority of the total voting power
Translation: 除首次认购或根据上述第d款认购的股份外，其他股份的发行须经总表决权三分之四多数通过。

Query_Text_en: f Shares of stock of the Corporation shall be available for subscription only by and shall be issued only to members
Translation: 公司的股票仅限会员认购，并只向会员发行。

Query_Text_en: a Each original member shall subscribe to the number of shares of stock set forth opposite its name in Schedule A The number of shares of stock to be subscribed by other members shall be determined by the Corporation
Translation: 每个创始成员应认购附表A中其名称对应的股份数额。其他成员认购的股份数额由公司决定。

Query_Text_en: b Shares of stock initially subscribed by original members shall be issued at par
Translation: b 原始成员最初认购的股份应按面值发行。

Query_Text_en: c The initial subscription of each original member shall be payable in full within 30 days after either the date on which the Corporation shall begin operations pursuant to Article Section 3 b or the date on which such original member becomes a member whichever shall be later or at such date thereafter as the Corporation shall determine Payment shall be made in gold or United States dollars in response to a call by the Corporation which shall specify the place or places of payment
Translation: 每个创始成员的初始认购款项应在公司根据第3条第b款开始运营之日或该创始成员成为成员之日（以较晚者为准）后的30天内全额支付，或在公司另行确定的日期支付。付款应以黄金或美元形式，根据公司发出的通知进行，通知中将指定付款地点。

Query_Text_en: d The price and other terms of subscription of shares of stock to be subscribed otherwise than on initial subscription by original members shall be determined by the Corporation
Translation: 由公司决定除原始成员首次认购外的股份认购价格及其他条款。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Limitation on liabilityNo member shall be liable by reason of its membership for obligations of the Corporation
Translation:
第四条 责任限制  
任何成员因其成员身份对本公司的义务不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 Restriction on transfers and pledges of sharesShares of stock shall not be pledged or encumbered in any manner whatever and shall be transferable only to the Corporation
Translation:
第五条 股份转让及质押的限制  
公司股份不得以任何方式进行质押或设定其他权利负担，且仅可转让给公司。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Financing operationsThe Corporation may make investments of its funds in productive private enterprises in the territories of its members The existence of a government or other public interest in such an enterprise shall not necessarily preclude the Corporation from making an investment therein
Translation:
第一节 融资业务

公司可以将其资金投资于成员国境内的有生产力的私营企业。即使政府或其他公共利益参与该企业，也不一定会阻止公司对其进行投资。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 Forms of financingThe Corporation may make investments of its funds in such form or forms as it may deem appropriate in the circumstances Amended September 21 1961
Translation:
第二节 融资形式  
公司可根据具体情况，以其认为适当的形式对其资金进行投资。  
（1961年9月21日修订）

Query_Text_en: iv the Corporation shall not assume responsibility for managing any enterprise in which it has invested ;
Translation: 四、本公司不承担对其所投资企业的经营管理责任。

Query_Text_en: vii the Corporation shall seek to maintain a reasonable diversification in its investments
Translation: 公司应力求在其投资中保持合理的多元化。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Protection of interestsNothing in this Agreement shall prevent the Corporation in the event of actual or threatened default on any of its investments actual or threatened insolvency of the enterprise in which such investment shall have been made or other situations which in the opinion of the Corporation threaten to jeopardize such investment from taking such action and exercising such fights as it may deem necessary for the protection of its interests
Translation:
第四节 利益保护

本协议的任何条款均不应妨碍公司在其任何投资实际或可能违约、所投资企业实际或可能出现资不抵债，或公司认为其他可能危及该投资的情形下，采取其认为必要的措施并行使相关权利，以保护自身利益。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 Applicability of certain foreign exchange restrictionsFunds received by or payable to the Corporation in respect of an investment of the Corporation made in any member 's territories pursuant to Section 1 of this Article shall not be free solely by reason of any provision of this Agreement from generally applicable foreign exchange restrictions regulations and controls in force in the territories of that member
Translation:
第五节 某些外汇限制的适用性

根据本条第一节，凡公司因在任何成员国领土内进行投资而收到或应支付的资金，不得仅因本协议的任何条款而免于该成员国领土内普遍适用的外汇限制、法规和管控。

Query_Text_en: i borrow funds and in that connection to furnish such collateral or other security therefor as it shall determine ;
Translation: 我借入资金，并为此按其决定提供相应的抵押品或其他担保。

Query_Text_en: ii invest funds not needed ha its financing operations in such obligations as it may determine and invest funds held by it for pension or similar purposes in any marketable securities all without being subject to the restrictions imposed by other sections of this Article ;
Translation: ii. 投资其融资运营中不需要的资金于其认为合适的债务工具，并将其为养老金或类似目的持有的资金投资于任何可流通证券，且上述投资不受本条其他条款所施加的限制。

Query_Text_en: v exercise such other powers incidental to its business as shall be necessary or desirable in furtherance of its purposes
Translation: 行使与其业务相关的其他附带权力，只要这些权力对于实现其宗旨是必要或可取的。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 Valuation of currenciesWhenever it shall become necessary under this Agreement to value any currency in terms of the value of another currency such valuation shall be as reasonably determined by the Corporation after consultation with the International Monetary Fund
Translation:
第七条 货币估值

凡根据本协议需要以一种货币的价值衡量另一种货币时，估值应由公司在与国际货币基金组织协商后合理确定。

Query_Text_en: Section 8 Warning to be placed on securitiesEvery security issued or guaranteed by the Corporation shall bear on its face a conspicuous statement to the effect that it is not an obligation of the Bank or unless expressly stated on the security of any government
Translation:
第八条 证券警示声明  
公司发行或担保的每一项证券，其正面应显著标明如下声明：该证券并非银行的债务，除非证券上明确注明，否则也不是任何政府的债务。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Structure of the CorporationThe Corporation shall have a Board of Governors a Board of Directors a Chairman of the Board of Directors a President and such other officers and staff to perform such duties as the Corporation may determine
Translation:
第一节 公司组织结构

公司应设立理事会、董事会、董事会主席、总裁，以及公司认为必要的其他高级管理人员和员工，负责履行相关职责。

Query_Text_en: a All the powers of the Corporation shall be vested in the Board of Governors
Translation: 公司的所有权力均归董事会所有。

Query_Text_en: b Each Governor and Alternate Governor of the Bank appointed by a member of the Bank which is also a member of the Corporation shall ex officio be a Governor or Alternate Governor respectively of the Corporation No Alternate Governor may vote except in the absence of his principal The Board of Governors shall select one of the Governors as Chairman of the Board of Governors Any Governor or Alternate Governor shall cease to hold office if the member by which he was appointed shall cease to be a member of the Corporation
Translation: 由同时为银行和公司成员的成员所任命的每一位银行理事及副理事，均当然成为公司理事或副理事。除非其正职理事缺席，副理事不得行使表决权。理事会应从理事中选举一位担任理事会主席。任何理事或副理事，若其任命成员不再是公司成员，则其职务随即终止。

Query_Text_en: viii amend this Agreement
Translation: 修改本协议

Query_Text_en: d The Board of Governors shall hold an annual meeting and such other meetings as may be provided for by the Board of Governors or called by the Board of Directors
Translation: 董事会应每年召开一次年度会议，并根据董事会的规定或董事局的召集，召开其他会议。

Query_Text_en: g The Corporation may by regulation establish a procedure whereby the Board of Directors may obtain a vote of the Governors on a specific question without calling a meeting of the Board of Governors
Translation: 公司可通过规章制度设立程序，使董事会能够就特定事项征求理事会成员的表决意见，而无需召开理事会会议。

Query_Text_en: h The Board of Governors and the Board of Directors to the extent authorized may adopt such rules and regulations as may be necessary or appropriate to conduct the business of the Corporation
Translation: 董事会和理事会在授权范围内，可以制定为公司业务开展所必需或适当的规章制度。

Query_Text_en: i Governors and Alternate Governors shall serve as such without compensation from the Corporation
Translation: 董事及副董事在公司任职期间不从公司获得任何报酬。

Query_Text_en: a Each member shall have two hundred fifty votes plus one additional vote for each share of stock held
Translation: 每个成员应拥有250票，并且每持有一股股票可额外获得一票。

Query_Text_en: b Except as otherwise expressly provided all matters before the Corporation shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast
Translation: 除非另有明确规定，公司的一切事项均应以投票所获多数票决定。

Query_Text_en: a The Board of Directors shall be responsible for the conduct of the general operations of the Corporation and for this purpose shall exercise all the powers given to it by this Agreement or delegated to it by the Board of Governors
Translation: 董事会负责公司一般运营的管理，并为此行使本协议授予或理事会授权的所有权力。

Query_Text_en: b The Board of Directors of the Corporation shall be composed ex officio of each Executive Director of the Bank who shall have been either i appointed by a member of the Bank which is also a member of the Corporation or ii elected in an election in which the votes of at least one member of the Bank which is also a member of the Corporation shall have counted toward his election The Alternate to each such Executive Director of the Bank shall ex officio be an Alternate Director of the Corporation Any Director shall cease to hold office if the member by which he was appointed or if all the members whose votes counted toward his election shall cease to be members of the Corporation
Translation: 公司董事会应由银行每一位执行董事当然组成，该执行董事须为以下两类之一：（一）由同时为公司成员的银行成员任命；（二）在选举中，至少有一个同时为公司成员的银行成员的选票计入其当选。银行每一位执行董事的副职当然为公司的副董事。任何董事如其任命成员或所有在其当选过程中计入选票的成员不再为公司成员，则其董事职务随即终止。

Query_Text_en: c Each Director who is an appointed Executive Director of the Bank shall be entitled to cast the number of votes which the member by which he was so appointed is entitled to cast in the Corporation Each Director who is an elected Executive Director of the Bank shall be entitled to cast the number of votes which the member or members of the Corporation whose votes counted toward his election in the Bank are entitled to cast in the Corporation All the votes which a Director is entitled to cast shall be cast as a unit
Translation: 每一位由成员任命为银行执行董事的董事，有权在公司中投出该成员在公司中应有的票数。每一位由选举产生的银行执行董事，有权在公司中投出在银行选举中为其投票的公司成员或成员在公司中应有的票数。董事有权投出的所有票数须作为一个整体进行投票。

Query_Text_en: e A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Directors shall be a majority of the Directors exercising not less than one half of the total voting power
Translation: 董事会任何会议的法定人数为多数董事，且其行使的表决权不少于总表决权的一半。

Query_Text_en: f The Board of Directors shall meet as often as the business of the Corporation may require
Translation: 董事会应根据公司业务需要随时召开会议。

Query_Text_en: g The Board of Governors shall adopt regulations under which a member of the Corporation not entitled to appoint an Executive Director of the Bank may send a representative to attend any meeting of the Board of Directors of the Corporation when a request made by or a matter particularly affecting that member is under consideration
Translation: 董事会应制定相关规章，规定在银行无权任命执行董事的公司成员，在其提出请求或涉及其特殊事项被审议时，可以派代表出席公司董事会的任何会议。

Query_Text_en: a The President of the Bank shall be ex officio Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Corporation but shall have no vote except a deciding vote in case of an equal division He may participate in meetings of the Board of Governors but shall not vote at such meetings
Translation: 银行行长应当当然担任公司董事会主席，但除在表决结果出现平局时拥有决定票外，不享有投票权。行长可以参加理事会会议，但不得在该会议上投票。

Query_Text_en: b The President of the Corporation shall be appointed by the Board of Directors on the recommendation of the Chairman The President shall be chief of the operating staff of the Corporation Under the direction of the Board of Directors and the general supervision of the Chairman he shall conduct the ordinary business of the Corporation and under their general control shall be responsible for the organization appointment and dismissal of the officers and staff The President may participate in meetings of the Board of Directors but shall not vote at such meetings The President shall cease to hold office by decision of the Board of Directors in which the Chairman concurs
Translation: 公司总裁由董事会根据董事长的提名任命。总裁为公司经营班子的负责人，在董事会的指导和董事长的全面监督下，负责公司日常业务的开展，并在其总体控制下，负责公司管理人员和员工的组织、任免。总裁可以列席董事会会议，但无表决权。总裁的免职须经董事会决定，并经董事长同意。

Query_Text_en: c The President officers and staff of the Corporation in the discharge of their offices owe their duty entirely to the Corporation and to no other authority Each member of the Corporation shall respect the international character of this duty and shall refrain from all attempts to influence any of them in the discharge of their duties
Translation: 公司总裁、高级职员及员工在履行职务时，完全以公司利益为依归，不受其他任何权力约束。公司每一成员都应尊重这一职责的国际性质，并应避免以任何方式影响上述人员履行其职责。

Query_Text_en: d Subject to the paramount importance of securing the highest standards of efficiency and of technical competence due regard shall be paid in appointing the officers and staff of the Corporation to the importance of recruiting personnel on as wide a geographical basis as possible
Translation: 在任命公司高级职员和员工时，在确保最高效率和专业能力为首要前提的基础上，应充分考虑尽可能广泛地从不同地域招聘人员的重要性。

Query_Text_en: a The Corporation shall be an entity separate and distinct from the Bank and the funds of the Corporation shall be kept separate and apart from those of the Bank The Corporation shall not lend to or borrow from the Bank The provisions of this Section shall not prevent the Corporation from making arrangements with the Bank regarding facilities personnel and services and arrangements for reimbursement of administrative expenses paid in the first instance by either organization on behalf of the other
Translation: 公司应为独立于银行的实体，其资金应与银行的资金分开管理。公司不得向银行贷款，也不得从银行借款。本条款的规定不妨碍公司与银行就设施、人员和服务等事项作出安排，以及就任何一方代表对方先行支付的管理费用进行报销的安排。

Query_Text_en: b Nothing in this Agreement shall make the Corporation liable for the acts or obligations of the Bank or the Bank liable for the acts or obligations of the Corporation
Translation: 本协议中的任何条款均不应使公司对银行的行为或义务承担责任，亦不应使银行对公司的行为或义务承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 Relations with other international organizationsThe Corporation acting through the Bank shall enter into formal arrangements with the United Nations and may enter into such arrangements with other public international organizations having specialized responsibilities in related fields
Translation:
第七节 与其他国际组织的关系

公司通过银行与联合国建立正式合作关系，并可与其他在相关领域具有专门职责的公共国际组织建立类似合作关系。

Query_Text_en: Section 8 Location of officesThe principal office of the Corporation shall be in the same locality as the principal office of the Bank The Corporation may establish other offices in the territories of any member
Translation:
第八条 办事处的设立

公司的主要办事处应设在与银行主要办事处相同的地区。公司可在任何成员国境内设立其他办事处。

Query_Text_en: Section 9 DepositoriesEach member shall designate its central bank as a depository in which the Corporation may keep holdings of such member 's currency or other assets of the Corporation or if it has no central bank it shall designate for such purpose such other institution as may be acceptable to the Corporation
Translation:
第九条 存款机构  
每一成员应指定其中央银行作为存款机构，供本公司存放该成员货币或本公司其他资产；如无中央银行，则应为此目的指定经本公司认可的其他机构。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 Channel of communicationEach member shall designate an appropriate authority with which the Corporation may communicate in connection with any matter arising under this Agreement
Translation:
第十条 通讯渠道  
每一成员应指定一个适当的主管机构，作为公司在本协议项下任何事项中进行沟通的联系人。

Query_Text_en: a The Corporation shall publish an annual report containing an audited statement of its accounts and shall circulate to members at appropriate intervals a summary statement of its financial position and a profit and loss statement showing the results of its operations
Translation: 公司应当公布年度报告，其中包括经审计的财务报表，并应在适当的时间间隔向成员分发其财务状况摘要及显示经营成果的损益表。

Query_Text_en: b The Corporation may publish such other reports as it deems desirable to carry out its purposes
Translation: 本公司可根据自身宗旨，酌情发布其他认为必要的报告。

Query_Text_en: a The Board of Governors may determine from time to time what part of the Corporation 's net income and surplus after making appropriate provision for reserves shall be distributed as dividends
Translation: 董事会可不时决定，在为准备金作出适当提取后，公司净收入和盈余中应分配为股息的部分。

Query_Text_en: b Dividends shall be distributed pro rata in proportion to capital stock held by members
Translation: b. 股息应按成员所持股本比例进行同比例分配。

Query_Text_en: c Dividends shall be paid in such manner and in such currency or currencies as the Corporation shall determine
Translation: c 股息的支付方式及币种由公司自行决定。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Withdrawal by membersAny member may withdraw from membership in the Corporation at any time by transmitting a notice in writing to the Corporation at its principal office Withdrawal shall become effective upon the date such notice is received
Translation:
第一节 会员退出  
任何会员可随时通过书面通知向公司总部提出退出申请。退出自公司收到该通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: a If a member fails to fulfill any of its obligations to the Corporation the Corporation may suspend its membership by decision of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power The member so suspended shall automatically cease to be a member one year from the date of its suspension unless a decision is taken by the same majority to restore the member to good standing
Translation: 如果某一成员未能履行其对公司的任何义务，公司可由行使多数总投票权的多数理事决定暂停其成员资格。被暂停的成员自暂停之日起一年后将自动失去成员资格，除非由同样多数决定恢复其良好成员状态。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Suspension or cessation of membership in the BankAny member which is suspended from membership in or ceases to be a member of the Bank shall automatically be suspended from membership in or cease to be a member of the Corporation as the case may be
Translation:
第三条 暂停或终止银行成员资格  
任何成员如被暂停或终止其在银行的成员资格，则其在本公司的成员资格亦将自动相应被暂停或终止。

Query_Text_en: a When a government ceases to be a member it shall remain liable for all amounts due from it to the Corporation The Corporation shall arrange for the repurchase of such government 's capital stock as a part of the settlement of accounts with it in accordance with the provisions of this Section but the government shall have no other rights under this Agreement except as provided in this Section and in Article c
Translation: 当一国政府不再是成员时，仍须对其应向公司支付的所有款项承担责任。公司应根据本条规定，在与该政府结算账户时安排回购其所持有的公司股本，但除本条及第c条另有规定外，该政府不再享有本协议项下的其他权利。

Query_Text_en: b The Corporation and the government may agree on the repurchase of the capital stock of the government on such terms as may be appropriate under the circumstances without regard to the provisions of paragraph c below Such agreement may provide among other things for a final settlement of all obligations of the government to the Corporation
Translation: 公司与政府可以协商以适当条件回购政府持有的公司资本股票，且无需遵循下文c款的规定。该协议可包括但不限于对政府与公司之间所有债务的最终结算。

Query_Text_en: c If such agreement shall not have been made within six months after the government ceases to be a member or such other time as the Corporation and such government may agree the repurchase price of the government 's capital stock shall be the value thereof shown by the books of the Corporation on the day when the government ceases to be a member The repurchase of the capital stock shall be subject to the following conditions :
Translation: 如果在政府不再是成员后六个月内，或公司与该政府另行约定的时间内，未能达成上述协议，则该政府资本股的回购价格应以其在政府不再是成员当天公司账簿所显示的价值为准。资本股的回购须遵守以下条件：

Query_Text_en: ii any amount due to the government for its capital stock shall be withheld so long as the government or any of its agencies remains liable to the Corporation for payment of any amount and such amount may at the option of the Corporation be set off as it becomes payable against the amount due from the Corporation ;
Translation: 政府因其资本股份应支付的任何款项，在政府或其任何机构仍对公司负有任何款项支付责任期间，应予以扣留。公司可选择将该款项在到期时与公司应支付的款项进行抵销。

Query_Text_en: iii if the Corporation sustains a net loss on the investments made pursuant to Article Section 1 and held by it on the date when the government ceases to be a member and the amount of such loss exceeds the amount of the reserves provided therefore on such date such government shall repay on demand the amount by which the repurchase price of its shares of stock would have been reduced if such loss had been taken into account when the repurchase price was determined
Translation: 三、如果公司根据第一条款进行的投资在政府不再是成员的当天出现净亏损，且该亏损金额超过该日为此所设立的储备金，则该政府应按要求偿还其股份回购价格在确定时若已考虑该亏损而应减少的金额。

Query_Text_en: d In no event shall any amount due to a government for its capital stock under this Section be paid until six months after the date upon which the government ceases to be a member If within six months of the date upon which any government ceases to be a member the Corporation suspends operations under Section 5 of this Article all rights of such government shall be determined by the provisions of such Section 5 and such government shall be considered still a member of the Corporation for purposes of such Section 5 except that it shall have no voting rights
Translation: 在任何情况下，根据本条规定应支付给某一政府的股本金，均不得在该政府终止成员资格之日起六个月内支付。如果在任何政府终止成员资格之日起六个月内，公司根据本条第5款暂停运营，则该政府的所有权利应按照第5款的规定确定，并且在适用第5款时，该政府应视为公司成员，但不享有表决权。

Query_Text_en: a The Corporation may permanently suspend its operations by vote of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power After such suspension of operations the Corporation shall forthwith cease all activities except those incident to the orderly realization conservation and preservation of its assets and settlement of its obligations Until final settlement of such obligations and distribution of such assets the Corporation shall remain in existence and all mutual rights and obligations of the Corporation and its members under this Agreement shall continue unimpaired except that no member shall be suspended or withdraw and that no distribution shall be made to members except as in this Section provided
Translation: 公司可经行使多数总投票权的多数理事投票，永久停止运营。运营暂停后，公司应立即停止除有序实现、保全和维护其资产及清偿其债务相关活动之外的所有业务。在债务最终清偿及资产分配完成之前，公司仍将继续存在，公司与其成员在本协议下的所有相互权利和义务将保持不受影响，但任何成员不得被暂停或退出，且除本条规定外，不得向成员进行分配。

Query_Text_en: b No distribution shall be made to members on account of their subscriptions to the capital stock of the Corporation until all liabilities to creditors shall have been discharged or provided for and until the Board of Governors by vote of a majority of the Governors exercising a majority of the total voting power shall have decided to make such distribution
Translation: 在所有对债权人的债务尚未清偿或作出妥善安排之前，且须经行使多数总表决权的理事中多数通过，理事会决定进行此类分配，方可就成员对公司股本的出资进行分配。

Query_Text_en: c Subject to the foregoing the Corporation shall distribute the assets of the Corporation to members pro rata in proportion to capital stock held by them subject in the case of any member to prior settlement of all outstanding claims by the Corporation against such member Such distribution shall be made at such times in such currencies and in cash or other assets as the Corporation shall deem fair and equitable The shares distributed to the several members need not necessarily be uniform in respect of the type of assets distributed or of the currencies in which they are expressed
Translation: 在遵循上述规定的前提下，公司应按各成员所持资本股份的比例，将公司资产按比例分配给成员，但对于任何成员，须先结清公司对该成员的所有未决债权。此类分配应在公司认为公平合理的时间，以公司认为公平合理的货币，并以现金或其他资产进行。分配给各成员的资产类型或所用货币不必完全一致。

Query_Text_en: d Any member receiving assets distributed by the Corporation pursuant to this Section shall enjoy the same rights with respect to such assets as the Corporation enjoyed prior to their distribution
Translation: 根据本条款收到公司分配资产的任何成员，应当享有公司在分配前对该等资产所享有的同等权利。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 Purposes of ArticleTo enable the Corporation to fulfill the functions with which it is entrusted the status immunities and privileges set forth in this Article shall be accorded to the Corporation in the territories of each member
Translation:
第一节  本条宗旨  
为使公司能够履行其所承担的职能，各成员应在其境内赋予公司本条所规定的地位、豁免和特权。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Position of the Corporation with regard to judicial processActions may be brought against the Corporation only in a court of competent jurisdiction in the territories of a member in which the Corporation has an office has appointed an agent for the purpose of accepting service or notice of process or has issued or guaranteed securities No actions shall however be brought by members or persons acting for or deriving claims from members The property and assets of the Corporation shall wheresoever located and by whomsoever held be immune from all forms of seizure attachment or execution before the delivery of final judgment against the Corporation
Translation:
第三条 公司在司法程序中的地位

对公司的诉讼只能在公司设有办事处、已为接受送达或通知程序指定代理人，或已发行或担保证券的成员国境内具备相应管辖权的法院提起。然而，成员国或代表成员国行事或从成员国取得权利的人不得对公司提起诉讼。公司的财产和资产，无论位于何处、由何人持有，在对公司作出最终判决前，均享有免于任何形式的扣押、查封或强制执行的豁免权。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Immunity of assets from seizureProperty and assets of the Corporation wherever located and by whomsoever held shall be immune from search requisition confiscation expropriation or any other form of seizure by executive or legislative action
Translation:
第四条 资产豁免权

无论财产和资产位于何处、由何人持有，本公司财产和资产均应免受任何行政或立法行为下的搜查、征用、没收、征收或任何其他形式的扣押。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 Immunity of archivesThe archives of the Corporation shall be inviolable
Translation:
第五条 档案豁免权

公司的档案应享有不可侵犯的权利。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 Freedom of assets from restrictionsTo the extent necessary to carry out the operations provided for in this Agreement and subject to the provisions of Article Section 5 and the other provisions of this Agreement all property and assets of the Corporation shall be free from restrictions regulations controls and moratoria of any nature
Translation:
第六条 资产自由不受限制

在本协议规定的业务范围内，并遵守第五条及本协议其他条款的前提下，公司的一切财产和资产应免受任何形式的限制、规章、管制或延期措施的约束。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 Privilege for communicationsThe official communications of the Corporation shall be accorded by each member the same treatment that it accords to the official communications of other members
Translation:
第七条 通信特权  
公司官方通信应由各成员给予与其他成员官方通信同等的待遇。

Query_Text_en: a The corporation its assets property income and its operations and transactions authorized by this Agreement shall be immune from all taxation and from all customs duties The Corporation shall also be immune from liability for the collection or payment of any tax or duty
Translation: 公司及其资产、财产、收入，以及根据本协议授权的经营和交易，均享有免除一切税收和关税的豁免权。公司同时免于承担任何税收或关税的征收或支付责任。

Query_Text_en: b No tax shall be levied on or in respect of salaries and emoluments paid by the Corporation to Directors Alternates officials or employees of the Corporation who are not local citizens local subjects or other local nationals
Translation: 公司向董事、候补董事、公司官员或员工支付的薪金和报酬，若其并非本地公民、本地臣民或其他本地国民，则不得征收任何税款。

Query_Text_en: ii if the sole jurisdictional basis for such taxation is the place or currency in which it is issued made payable or paid or the location of any office or place of business maintained by the Corporation
Translation: 二、如果对该项征税的唯一司法依据仅为其发行、支付或偿付的地点或货币，或公司所设立的任何办事处或营业地点的所在地。

Query_Text_en: or ii if the sole jurisdictional basis for such taxation is the location of any office or place of business maintained by the Corporation
Translation: 或二，如果该税收的唯一管辖依据是公司所设立的任何办事处或营业场所的所在地。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 Application of ArticleEach member shall take such action as is necessary in its own territories for the purpose of making effective in terms of its own law the principles set forth in this Article and shall inform the Corporation of the detailed action which it has taken
Translation:
第十条的适用  
各成员应在其本国境内采取必要措施，以使本条所规定的原则根据本国法律得到有效实施，并应将其所采取的具体措施通知本公司。

Query_Text_en: Section 11 WaiverThe Corporation in its discretion may waive any of the privileges and immunities conferred under this Article to such extent and upon such conditions as it may determine
Translation:
第十一条 豁免权  
公司可自行决定在其认为适当的范围和条件下，放弃本条所赋予的任何特权与豁免权。

Query_Text_en: a This Agreement may be amended by vote of three fifths of the Governors exercising four fifths of the total voting power
Translation: 本协定可经拥有五分之四总表决权的理事中五分之三的投票通过予以修订。

Query_Text_en: iii the limitation on liability provided in Article Section 4
Translation: 第三条第四款所规定的责任限制
