Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those applicable to any airline of other States engaged in international air services for the use of similar equipment , facilities and services .
Translation: 该费率不得高于其他国家从事国际航空运输业务的航空公司在使用类似设备、设施和服务时所适用的费率。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of one Contracting Party , as well as their regular equipment , spare parts [ including engines ] , fuels , oil [ including hydraulic fluids , lubricants ] and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on arriving in the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation: [1] 一方缔约国指定航空公司运营的国际航空服务所使用的航空器及其常规设备、备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油品（包括液压液、润滑油）以及航空器储备物资（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在抵达另一方缔约国领土时，依据互惠原则，免征所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，前提是上述设备和物品在航空器上保留至其被重新出口为止。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] spare parts [ including engines ] introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft engaged in operation of international services .
Translation: [ b ] 由一缔约方指定的航空公司为执行国际航班任务而引进至另一缔约方境内、用于飞机维护或修理的备件（包括发动机）。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Printed ticket stock , air waybills and publicity materials introduced into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges .
Translation: [3] 一方缔约国指定航空公司运入另一方缔约国境内的印制票据、航空运单及宣传资料，应在互惠基础上免征所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the approval of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本条第[1]和第[2]款所指的设备和物品，经对方缔约方海关当局批准后，可以在对方缔约方境内卸载。

Query_Text_en: Such equipment and items shall be kept under the supervision or control of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party up to such time as they are re-exported , or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the Customs regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类设备和物品应由另一缔约方海关监管或控制，直至其被复出口或按照另一缔约方海关法规作其他处置。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The exemption provided for in paragraph [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall also be available where a designated airline of one Contracting Party has contracted with another airline , which similarly enjoys such exemptions in the territory of the other Contracting Party , for the loan or transfer in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the equipment and items specified in paragraph [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article .
Translation: 本条第[1]款和第[2]款所规定的免税待遇，同样适用于一缔约方指定的航空公司与另一家同样在对方缔约方领土内享有此类免税待遇的航空公司签订合同，在对方缔约方领土内借用或转让本条第[1]款和第[2]款所列设备和物品的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all the customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on the basis of reciprocity with the exception of the charges corresponding to the services provided .
Translation: [6] 直接过境的行李、货物和邮件应在互惠基础上免除所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，但因所提供服务而产生的费用除外。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The revenues and profit realized by the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party in connection with operation of the agreed services shall be exempt from all taxes .
Translation: 一方缔约国指定航空公司因经营约定航班在另一方缔约国境内所获得的收入和利润，应免于征收一切税费。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The property of the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on the basis of reciprocity .
Translation: 双方缔约国指定航空公司在对方缔约国境内的财产，基于互惠原则，免征所有税费。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Wages , salaries and other similar remuneration received by the employees of the representation of the designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party , who are nationals of the first Contracting Party , shall be exempt from all taxes on the basis of reciprocity by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: [3] 任一缔约方指定航空公司代表机构的员工，如为第一缔约方国民，其所获得的工资、薪金及其他类似报酬，基于互惠原则，应免于被另一缔约方征收任何税款。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] For the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have the right , on reciprocal basis , to set up representation at the point [ s ] of call on the specified route within the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 为在指定航线上运营双方商定的服务，每一缔约方指定的航空公司均有权在互惠基础上，在对方缔约方境内指定航线的经停点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The staff members of the representation of the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party ; the number of such staff shall be determined between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: [2] 一方缔约方指定航空公司的代表机构工作人员，应为任一缔约方的国民；其人数由双方民航主管当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Such staff shall be subject to the laws and regulations in force of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类人员应遵守另一缔约方现行的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The crew members of the designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party on the agreed services shall be nationals of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司的机组人员，在执行双方商定航班时，应为第一缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: If a designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party desires to employ crew members of any other nationality on the agreed services , prior approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 如果任一缔约方指定的航空公司希望在双方约定的航线上聘用其他国籍的机组人员，须事先获得另一缔约方的批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Certificates of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licences issued or rendered valid by either of the Contracting Parties shall , during the period of their validity , be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party , provided that the requirements under which such certificates or licences were issued or rendered valid are equal to or above the minimum standards which are established pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: [1] 由任一缔约方签发或认可有效的适航证书、合格证书和执照，在其有效期内，另一缔约方应予以承认其有效性，前提是该等证书或执照的签发或认可条件不低于根据本公约所制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party reserves the right , however , to refuse to recognize as valid , for the purpose of flights over its own territory , certificates of competency and licences granted to or rendered valid for its own nationals by the other Contracting Party or by any other State .
Translation: 然而，每一缔约方均保留以下权利：对于另一缔约方或任何其他国家为其本国国民颁发或认可的合格证书和执照，有权拒绝承认其在本国领土上飞行时的有效性。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have on the reciprocal basis the right to remit to the Contracting Party designating the airline its revenue received in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司均有权在互惠基础上，将其在另一缔约方领土内获得的收入汇回指定该航空公司的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the conversion and remittance of the revenue received in its territory by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party , and assist the said airline [ s ] in attending to the relevant formalities .
Translation: 每一缔约方应便利另一缔约方指定航空公司在其领土内所获得收入的兑换和汇出，并协助该航空公司办理相关手续。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Consistent with their rights and obligations under international law , the Parties reaffirm that their obligation to each other to protect the security of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference forms an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: [1] 根据国际法赋予的权利和义务，双方重申彼此有义务保护民用航空安全，防止非法干扰行为，这一义务是本协议不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Without limiting the generality of their rights and obligations under international law , the Parties shall in particular act in conformity with the provisions of the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft , signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963 , the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft , signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970 and the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971 , its Supplementary Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 24 February 1988 as well as with any other convention and protocol relating to the security of civil aviation which both Parties adhere to .
Translation: 在不限制双方根据国际法所享有的一般权利和义务的前提下，双方尤其应遵守《1963年9月14日于东京签署的关于在航空器上犯罪及某些其他行为的公约》、《1970年12月16日于海牙签署的关于打击非法劫持航空器的公约》、《1971年9月23日于蒙特利尔签署的关于打击危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》及其《1988年2月24日于蒙特利尔签署的关于打击在服务国际民用航空的机场实施非法暴力行为的补充议定书》，以及双方共同加入的任何其他有关民用航空安全的公约和议定书的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Parties shall provide upon request all necessary assistance to each other to prevent acts of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports and air navigation facilities , and any other threat to the security of civil aviation .
Translation: 双方应根据请求，向对方提供一切必要协助，以防止非法劫持民用航空器及其他危害航空器、其乘客和机组人员、机场及航空导航设施安全的非法行为，以及任何其他威胁民用航空安全的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Parties shall , in their mutual relations , act in conformity with the aviation security provisions established by ICAO and designated as Annexes to the Convention ;
Translation: [3] 双方在相互关系中应遵守国际民航组织制定并作为《公约》附件的航空安全规定。

Query_Text_en: they shall require that operators of aircraft of their registry or operators of aircraft who have their principal place of business or permanent residence in their territory and the operators of airports in their territory act in conformity with such aviation security provisions .
Translation: 他们应要求在其登记册上的航空器运营人、主要营业地或永久居住地位于其领土内的航空器运营人，以及其领土内的机场运营人，遵守相关航空安全规定。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall advise the other Contracting Party of any difference between its national regulations and practices and the aviation security standards of the Annexes .
Translation: 任何一缔约方应将其国家法规和做法与附件所规定的航空安全标准之间的任何差异，通知另一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Either Contracting Party may request immediate consultations with the other Contracting Party at any time to discuss any such differences .
Translation: 任何一方缔约方可随时要求与另一方缔约方立即磋商，以讨论任何此类分歧。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Each Contracting Party agrees that such operators of aircraft shall be required to observe the aviation security provisions referred to in paragraph [ 3 ] above required by the other Contracting Party for entry into , departure from , or while within , the territory of that other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方同意，航空器运营人必须遵守另一缔约方为进入、离开或在其领土内活动所要求的航空安全规定，如上文第[3]款所述。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall also give consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for reasonable special security measures to meet a particular threat .
Translation: 缔约方还应考虑另一缔约方提出的为应对特定威胁而采取合理特殊安全措施的请求。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] When an incident or threat of an incident of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports or air navigation facilities occurs , the Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and other appropriate measures intended to terminate rapidly and safely such incident or threat thereof .
Translation: [5] 当发生或有发生非法劫持民用航空器，或针对此类航空器、其乘客和机组人员、机场或航空导航设施的其他危害安全的非法行为的威胁时，双方应通过便利通信及其他适当措施，协助对方迅速且安全地终止该事件或威胁。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right , within sixty [ 60 ] days following notice [ or such shorter period as may be agreed between the aeronautical authorities ] , for its aeronautical authorities to conduct an assessment in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the security measures being carried out , or planned to be carried out , by aircraft operators in respect of flights arriving from , or departing to the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方均有权在收到通知后六十（60）天内（或缔约双方航空主管当局商定的更短期限内），由其航空主管当局在另一缔约方境内对航空运营人针对来自或前往本方领土航班所实施或计划实施的安保措施进行评估。

Query_Text_en: The administrative arrangements for the conduct of such assessments shall be agreed between the aeronautical authorities and implemented without delay so as to ensure that assessments will be conducted expeditiously .
Translation: 此类评估的管理安排应由航空主管当局协商一致，并立即实施，以确保评估工作能够迅速开展。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] When a Contracting Party has reasonable grounds to believe that the other Contracting Party has departed from the provisions of this Article , the first Contracting Party may request consultations .
Translation: 当一缔约方有合理理由认为另一缔约方未遵守本条规定时，前者可以请求进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultations shall start within fifteen [ 15 ] days of receipt of such a request from either Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类磋商应在任一缔约方收到该请求后十五（15）日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Failure to reach a satisfactory agreement within fifteen [ 15 ] days from the start of consultations shall constitute grounds for withholding , revoking , suspending or imposing conditions on the authorizations of the airline or airlines designated by the other Party .
Translation: 如果在协商开始后十五（15）天内未能达成令人满意的协议，则可作为暂停、撤销、中止或对对方指定航空公司授权施加条件的依据。

Query_Text_en: When justified by an emergency , or to prevent further non-compliance with the provisions of this Article , the first Party may take interim action at any time .
Translation: 在遇有紧急情况或为防止进一步违反本条规定时，第一方可随时采取临时措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If , following such consultations , one Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party does not effectively maintain and administer safety standards in the areas referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] that meet the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention , the other Contracting Party shall be informed of such findings and of the steps considered necessary to conform with the ICAO Standards .
Translation: 如果在上述协商之后，一方缔约方发现另一方缔约方未能有效维持和管理第[1]款所述领域的安全标准，且该标准未达到当时根据公约制定的标准，则应将此发现及为符合国际民航组织标准所需采取的措施通知另一方缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Any action by one Contracting Party in accordance with paragraph 4 above shall be discontinued once the basis for the taking of that action ceases to exist .
Translation: [5] 一旦采取上述第4款所规定措施的理由不复存在，任何一方当事国应终止该措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] With reference to paragraph [ 2 ] , if it is determined that one Contracting Party remains in non-compliance with ICAO Standards when the agreed time period has lapsed , the Secretary General of ICAO should be advised thereof .
Translation: [6] 参照第[2]段，如果在约定期限届满后，确定一缔约方仍未遵守国际民航组织标准，应将此情况通报国际民航组织秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Provision of Statistical DataThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistical data as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the agreed services operated by the designated airline [ s ] of the first Contracting Party on the specified route . Such data shall include all information required to determine the amount of traffic carried by the said airline [ s ] on the agreed services .
Translation:
第十七条 统计数据的提供  
任一缔约方的航空主管部门应根据另一缔约方航空主管部门的请求，提供合理所需的统计数据，以便审查由第一缔约方指定航空公司在指定航线上运营的协议航班的运力。此类数据应包括所有用于确定上述航空公司在协议航班上所承运客货量的信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The Contracting Parties shall , in the spirit of close cooperation and mutual support , ensure the correct implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约方应本着密切合作与相互支持的精神，确保协议条款得到正确实施和令人满意的遵守。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party concerning the Agreement .
Translation: 任何一方缔约国可随时请求与另一方缔约国就本协议进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation shall begin as soon as possible , and at least within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party unless otherwise agreed to .
Translation: 此类磋商应尽快启动，且除非另有协议，最迟应在另一缔约方收到请求之日起六十天内进行。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to amend any provision of this Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party , and such consultation , which may be between aeronautical authorities and which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of ninety days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party , unless both Parties agree to an extension of this period .
Translation: 如缔约任何一方认为有必要修改本协定或其附件的任何条款，可随时请求与另一缔约方协商。此类协商可由航空主管当局进行，方式包括会谈或函件交流，并应自另一缔约方收到协商请求之日起九十天内开始，除非双方同意延长该期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Any amendment to this Agreement or its Annex agreed upon as a result of the consultation referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall come into force when it has been confirmed by an exchange of notes through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 根据本条第[1]款所述协商达成的对本协议或其附件的任何修订，应在通过外交渠道换文确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach a settlement of the said dispute , the dispute shall then be settled through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如果缔约方的航空主管部门未能解决上述争议，该争议应通过外交途径予以解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 TerminationEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels of its decision to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十一条 终止

任何一缔约方可随时通过外交途径通知另一缔约方其决定终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall then terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party unless such notice is withdrawn by agreement between the Contracting Parties before the expiry of this period .
Translation: 本协议将在另一缔约方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非双方在该期限届满前协商同意撤回该通知。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 RegistryThis Agreement or any amendment thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization .
Translation:
第二十二条 登记  
本协议或其任何修订应在国际民用航空组织进行登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 TitlesThe title of each article of this Agreement is for the purpose of reference and convenience and in no way to define , limit or describe the scope or intent of the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十三条 标题  
本协议各条款的标题仅为参考和方便之用，绝不用于界定、限制或描述本协议条款的范围或意图。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Entry into ForceThis Agreement shall come into force on the date when the Contracting Parties have notified each other through diplomatic channels that their respective legal procedures for entry into force of the Agreement have been completed .
Translation:
第二十四条 生效

本协议自缔约双方通过外交渠道相互通知已完成各自关于本协议生效的法律程序之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Done in Lusaka on the third day of February , 2007 in original copies in the Chinese and English languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于2007年2月3日在卢萨卡签署，中文和英文原件各一份，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party may omit on any or all flights , any point on the specified route , provided that the agreed services begin and terminate in the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline [ s ] .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定的航空公司可在任何航班上省略指定航线上的任何航点，前提是所约定的服务须始于并终止于指定该航空公司的缔约方领土。

Query_Text_en: a ] `` air transportation '' means the public carriage by aircraft of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail , separately or in combination , for remuneration or hire ;
Translation: a）“航空运输”是指以获得报酬或租金为目的，使用航空器对旅客、行李、货物和邮件进行单独或联合的公共运输。

Query_Text_en: b ] `` aeronautical authorities '' means , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China ; in the case of the Union of Myanmar , the Department of Civil Aviation of the Ministry of Transport ; or in both cases any other authority or person empowered to perform the functions now exercised by the said authorities ;
Translation: b ] “航空主管部门”指中华人民共和国的中国民用航空总局；缅甸联邦的交通部民航局；或在两国中任何被授权执行上述主管部门现行职能的其他机构或人员。

Query_Text_en: c ] `` Agreement '' means this Agreement , its Annex , and any amendments thereto ;
Translation: “协议”指本协议、其附件及任何修订。

Query_Text_en: d ] `` capacity '' [ i ] in relation to an aircraft , means the payload of that aircraft available on a route or section of a route ;
Translation: “容量”在与航空器相关的语境下，是指该航空器在某条航线或航线某一段上可用的有效载荷。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in relation to an air service , means the capacity of the aircraft used on such service multiplied by the frequency operated by such aircraft over a given period on a route or section of a route ;
Translation: [ ii ] 关于航空服务，是指在某一航线或航段上，所使用飞机的运力与该飞机在一定时期内的运营频率的乘积。

Query_Text_en: e ] `` Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December , 1944 , and includes any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention , and any amendment of the Annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 , insofar as such Annexes and amendments have become effective for both Parties ;
Translation: “公约”是指于1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第90条通过的任何附件，以及根据第90条和第94条对附件或公约所作的任何修正，前提是上述附件和修正已对双方生效。

Query_Text_en: f ] `` designated airline '' means an airline which has been designated and authorised in accordance with Article 3 of this Agreement ;
Translation: “指定航空公司”是指根据本协议第三条被指定并授权的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: g ] `` domestic air transportation '' is air transportation in which passengers , baggage , cargo and mail which are taken on board in a State 's territory are destined to another point in that same State 's territory ;
Translation: “国内航空运输”是指在一国领土内搭载的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，其目的地也在该国领土内的另一地点。

Query_Text_en: h ] `` ICAO '' means the International Civil Aviation Organisation ;
Translation: h ] “ICAO”指国际民用航空组织；

Query_Text_en: i ] `` international air transportation '' is air transportation in which the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail which are taken on board in the territory of one State are destined to another State ;
Translation: i ] “国际航空运输”是指在一国境内搭载的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，目的地为另一国的航空运输。

Query_Text_en: j ] `` Party '' is a State which has formally agreed to be bound by this agreement ;
Translation: “缔约方”是指已正式同意受本协议约束的国家。

Query_Text_en: k ] `` tariff '' means any fare , rate or charge for the carriage of passengers , baggage and\/or cargo [ excluding mail ] in air transportation [ including any other mode of transportation in connection therewith ] charged by airlines , including their agents , and the conditions governing the availability of such fare , rate or charge ;
Translation: k ] “运价”是指航空公司（包括其代理人）对旅客、行李和/或货物（不包括邮件）运输所收取的任何票价、费率或费用（包括与之相关的任何其他运输方式），以及适用于该票价、费率或费用的适用条件。

Query_Text_en: 1 ] `` Territory '' in relation to a State means the land areas and territorial waters adjacent and airspace thereabove under the sovereignty of that State .
Translation: “领土”在国家层面上，是指该国拥有主权的陆地、毗邻的领海及其上空。

Query_Text_en: m ] `` user charges '' means a charge made to airlines by the competent authorities , or permitted by them to be made , for the provision of airport property or facilities or of air navigation facilities , or aviation security facilities or services , including related services and facilities , for aircraft , their crews , passengers and cargo ;
Translation: “用户收费”是指主管当局向航空公司收取的，或经其许可收取的，为航空器、机组人员、旅客和货物提供机场资产或设施、航空导航设施、航空安保设施或服务（包括相关服务和设施）所产生的费用。

Query_Text_en: andn ] `` air service '' , `` international air service '' , `` airline '' , and `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' , have the meanings assigned to them in Article 96 of the Convention .
Translation: “航空运输”、“国际航空运输”、“航空公司”以及“非运输目的的经停”均具有《公约》第96条所赋予的含义。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Grant of Rights1 . Each Party grants to the other Party the rights specified in this Agreement for the purpose of operating international air services on the routes specified in the Route Schedule .
Translation:
第二条 权利授予

1. 各方根据本协议，授予对方在航线计划所列航线上运营国际航空服务的相关权利。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the right to make stops at the point [ s ] on the route [ s ] specified in the Route Schedule to this Agreement in the territory of the other Party for the purpose of taking on board and discharging international traffic in passengers , cargo or mail separately or in combination originating in or destined for the first Party .
Translation: [ c ] 有权在本协议航线时刻表中指定的另一方领土内的航线点 [ s ] 停靠，以搭载或卸载起始于或目的地为第一方的国际旅客、货物或邮件，可以分别或组合进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The airlines of each Party , other than those designated under Article 3 of this Agreement , shall also enjoy the rights specified in paragraphs 2 [ a ] and [ b ] of this Article .
Translation: 3. 除根据本协定第三条指定的航空公司外，一方的其他航空公司亦应享有本条第2款[a]和[b]项所规定的权利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Nothing in paragraph 2 shall be deemed to confer on the designated airline [ s ] of one Party the privilege of taking on board , in the territory of the other Party , passengers , cargo and mail for remuneration and destined for another point in the territory of the other Party
Translation: 4. 第二款的任何内容均不得被视为赋予一方指定航空公司在另一方领土内装载乘客、货物和邮件，并以有偿方式运送至该另一方领土内其他地点的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Designation and Authorization1 . Each Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Party one or more airlines to operate the agreed services in accordance with this Agreement and to withdraw or alter such designation .
Translation:
第三条 指定与授权

1. 每一方均有权以书面形式向另一方指定一家或多家航空公司，按照本协议运营双方商定的航班，并有权撤回或更改该项指定。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] the designated airline is qualified to meet other conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally applied to the operation of international air transport services by the Party receiving the designation .
Translation: 并且 [c] 被指定的航空公司符合接受指定一方通常适用于国际航空运输服务运营的法律法规所规定的其他条件。

Query_Text_en: 3 . On receipt of the operating authorization of paragraph 2 , a designated airline may at any time begin to operate the agreed services for which it is so designated , provided that the airline complies with the applicable provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 3. 在收到第二款所述的运营授权后，被指定的航空公司可随时开始运营其被指定的约定航线服务，前提是该航空公司遵守本协议的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] in the event of failure that such designated airline is qualified to meet other conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally applied to the operation of international air transport services by the Party receiving the designation .
Translation: 并且 [c] 在指定航空公司未能履行相关义务时，该航空公司应符合接受指定一方通常适用于国际航空运输服务运营的法律法规所规定的其他条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless immediate action is essential to prevent infringement of the laws and regulations referred to above or unless safety or security requires action in accordance with the provisions of Article 7 or Article 8 , the rights enumerated in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be exercised only after consultations between the aeronautical authorities in conformity with Article 19 of this Agreement .
Translation: 除非为防止上述法律法规被侵犯而必须立即采取行动，或除非根据本协议第7条或第8条的规定，出于安全或安保需要必须采取措施，否则本条第1款所列权利应仅在航空主管部门按照本协议第19条进行协商后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Application of Laws1 . The laws and regulations of one Party governing entry into and departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services , or the operation and navigation of such aircraft while within its territory , shall be applied to aircraft of the designated airline of the other Party .
Translation:
第五条 法律适用

一方关于国际航空服务飞机进出其领土、在其领土内运营和航行的法律法规，应适用于对方指定航空公司的飞机。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The laws and regulations of one Party relating to the entry into , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage and cargo including mail such as those regarding entry , clearance , immigration , passports , customs , currency and health and quarantine shall apply to passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail carried by the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Party while they are entering , staying in and departing from the said territory .
Translation: 一方关于旅客、机组人员、行李和货物（包括邮件）进入、停留和离开其领土的法律法规，包括入境、通关、移民、护照、海关、货币、卫生和检疫等规定，均适用于另一方指定航空公司所运营的航空器所载旅客、机组人员、行李、货物和邮件在进入、停留和离开该领土期间。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Neither Party shall give preference to its own or any other airline over a designated airline of the other Party engaged in similar international air transportation in the application of its immigration , customs , quarantine and similar regulations .
Translation: 3. 任何一方在适用其移民、海关、检疫及类似规定时，不得对本国或任何其他航空公司给予优先于对方指定航空公司（从事类似国际航空运输）的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Passengers , baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be subject to no more than a simplified control .
Translation: 4. 对于直接过境的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，只需进行简化的检查。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Recognition of Certificates1 . Certificates of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licenses issued or rendered valid by one Party and still in force shall be recognized as valid by the other Party for the purpose of operating the agreed services provided that the requirements under which such certificates and licenses were issued or rendered valid are equal to or above the minimum standards which may be established pursuant to the Convention .
Translation:
第六条 证书的认可

一方颁发或认可并仍然有效的适航证书、资格证书和执照，应被另一方视为有效，用于运营双方商定的航班服务，前提是这些证书和执照的颁发或认可所依据的要求等同于或高于《公约》可能制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the privileges or conditions of the licenses or certificates referred to in paragraph 1 above , issued by the aeronautical authorities of one Party to any person or designated airline or in respect of an aircraft used in the operation of the agreed services , should permit a difference from the minimum standards established under the Convention , and which difference has been filed with the International Civil Aviation Organization , the other Party may request consultations between the aeronautical authorities with a view to clarifying the practice in question .
Translation: 2. 如果一方民航当局根据本条第1款向任何个人、指定航空公司或用于执行双方商定航班的航空器颁发的执照或证书，其所赋予的权利或条件允许与《公约》规定的最低标准存在差异，并且该差异已向国际民用航空组织备案，另一方可要求双方民航当局就有关做法进行磋商，以澄清相关情况。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Party reserves the right , however , to refuse to recognize for the purpose of flights above or landing within its own territory , certificates of competency and licenses granted to its own nationals by the other Party .
Translation: 3. 但各方保留权利，可以拒绝承认对方为本国国民颁发的资格证书和执照，用于在本国领土上空飞行或在本国境内降落的目的。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Safety1 . Each Party may request consultations at any time concerning the safety standards maintained by the other Party in areas relating to aeronautical facilities , flight crew , aircraft and the operation of aircraft .
Translation:
第七条 安全  
任何一方均可随时就与航空设施、飞行机组、航空器及其运行相关的安全标准，要求与另一方进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If , following such consultations , one Party finds that the other Party does not effectively maintain and administer safety standards in the areas referred to in paragraph 1 that meet the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention on International Civil Aviation [ Doc 7300 ] , the other Party shall be informed of such findings and of the steps considered necessary to conform with the ICAO Standards .
Translation: 2. 如果在上述协商后，一方发现另一方未能有效维持和管理第1款所述领域的安全标准，且该标准未达到根据《国际民用航空公约》（Doc 7300）当时制定的标准，则应将该发现及为符合国际民航组织标准所需采取的措施通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: The other Party shall then take appropriate corrective action within an agreed time period .
Translation: 另一方应在商定的期限内采取适当的纠正措施。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Pursuant to Article 16 of the Convention , it is further agreed that , any aircraft operated by , or on behalf of an airline of one Party , on service to or from the territory of another Party , may , while within the territory of the other Party be the subject of a search by the authorized representatives of the other Party , provided this does not cause unreasonable delay in the operation of the aircraft .
Translation: 3. 根据本公约第16条的规定，双方进一步同意，一方航空公司运营或代表其运营的任何航空器，在往返另一方领土的航班中，均可在另一方领土内由其授权代表进行检查，前提是该检查不会对航空器的运行造成不合理的延误。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the obligations mentioned in Article 33 of the Chicago Convention , the purpose of this search is to verify the validity of the relevant aircraft documentation , the licensing of its crew , and that the aircraft equipment and the condition of the aircraft conform to the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: 尽管《芝加哥公约》第33条规定了相关义务，本次检查的目的是核实有关航空器文件的有效性、机组人员的执照情况，以及航空器设备和状态是否符合当时根据公约制定的标准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . When urgent action is essential to ensure the safety of an airline operation , each Party reserves the right to immediately suspend or vary the operating authorization of an airline or airlines of the other Party .
Translation: 4. 当采取紧急措施对于确保航空运营安全至关重要时，每一方均有权立即暂停或调整对另一方航空公司或航空公司的运营授权。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any action by one Party in accordance with paragraph 4 above shall be discontinued once the basis for the taking of that action ceases to exist .
Translation: 5. 一方根据上述第4款采取的任何措施，应在其采取该措施的依据不复存在时终止。

Query_Text_en: 6 . With reference to paragraph 2 , if it is determined that one arty remains in non-compliance with ICAO Standards when the agreed time period has lapsed , the Secretary General of ICAO should be advised thereof .
Translation: 6. 根据第2段，如果在约定期限届满后，确定一方仍未遵守ICAO标准，应将此情况通知ICAO秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Aviation Security1 . Consistent with their rights and obligations under international law , the Parties reaffirm that their obligation to each other to protect the security of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference forms an integral part of this Agreement Without limiting the generality of their rights and obligations under international law , the Parties shall in particular act in conformity with the provisions of the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft , signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963 , the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft , signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970 and the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971 , its Supplementary Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 24 February 1988 as well as with any other convention and protocol relating to the security of civil aviation which both Parties adhere to .
Translation:
第八条 航空安全

1. 根据国际法赋予的权利和义务，双方重申彼此有义务保护民用航空安全，防止非法干扰行为，此项义务构成本协议不可分割的一部分。在不限制双方根据国际法享有的一般权利和义务的前提下，双方特别应遵守以下公约的规定：1963年9月14日在东京签署的《机上犯罪及某些其他行为公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签署的《制止非法劫持航空器公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签署的《制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为公约》、1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签署的《制止在服务国际民用航空的机场实施暴力非法行为的补充议定书》，以及双方共同加入的任何其他涉及民用航空安全的公约和议定书。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall provide upon request all necessary assistance to each other to prevent acts of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports and air navigation facilities , and any other threat to the security of civil aviation .
Translation: 双方应根据请求，向对方提供一切必要协助，以防止对民用航空器的非法劫持及其他危害航空器、乘客和机组人员、机场及航空导航设施安全的非法行为，以及任何对民用航空安全构成威胁的行为。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Parties shall , in their mutual relations , act in conformity with the aviation security provisions established by ICAO and designated as Annexes to the Convention to the extent that such Standards and Recommended Practices are applicable to the Parties ;
Translation: 3. 双方在相互关系中，应遵守国际民航组织制定并作为《公约》附件的航空安全规定，前提是这些标准和建议措施适用于双方。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Party agrees that such operators of aircraft may be required to observe the aviation security provisions referred to in paragraph 3 above required by the other Party for entry into , departure from , or wh ile within , the territory of that other Party .
Translation: 4. 各方同意，航空器运营人可被要求遵守对方为进入、离开或在其领土内所规定的、上述第3款所提及的航空安全规定。

Query_Text_en: Each Party shall ensure that adequate measures are effectively applied within its territory to protect the aircraft and to inspect passengers , crew , carry-on items , baggage , cargo and aircraft stores prior to and during boarding or loading .
Translation: 各方应确保在其境内有效采取充分措施，以保护航空器，并在登机或装载前及过程中，对旅客、机组人员、随身物品、行李、货物和航空器用品进行检查。

Query_Text_en: Each Party shall also give sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Party for reasonable special security measures to meet a particular threat .
Translation: 缔约双方还应对另一方提出的、为应对特定威胁而采取合理特殊安全措施的任何请求给予积极考虑。

Query_Text_en: 5 . When an incident or threat of an incident of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports or air navigation facilities occurs , the Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and other appropriate measures intended to terminate rapidly and safely such incident or threat thereof .
Translation: 5. 一旦发生或出现非法劫持民用航空器事件或威胁，或其他危及该航空器、其乘客和机组人员、机场或航空导航设施安全的非法行为，缔约双方应通过便利沟通及采取其他适当措施，相互协助，力求迅速、安全地终止该事件或威胁。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 User Charges1 . The charges imposed on a designated airline of one Party by the responsible charging authorities of the other Party for the use by that designated airline of airport , airways and other civil aviation facilities shall not be higher than those imposed by such Party on designated airlines of other States engaged in similar international operations using similar aircraft and associated facilities .
Translation:
第九条 用户收费

一方指定航空公司因使用另一方主管收费机构所提供的机场、航路及其他民用航空设施所需缴纳的费用，不得高于该方对从事类似国际运营、使用类似飞机及相关设施的其他国家指定航空公司所收取的费用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall encourage consultations on user charges between its competent charging authority and airlines using the service and facilities provided by those charging authorities , where practicable through those airlines ' representative organizations .
Translation: 2. 各方应鼓励其主管收费机构与使用其所提供服务和设施的航空公司进行关于用户收费的协商，并在可行的情况下通过这些航空公司的代表组织进行协商。

Query_Text_en: Reasonable notice of any proposals for changes in user charges should be given to such users to enable them to express their views before changes are made .
Translation: 应当向相关用户提前合理通知任何用户收费变动的提议，以便他们在变动实施前表达意见。

Query_Text_en: Each Party shall further encourage its competent charging authority and such users to exchange appropriate information concerning user charges .
Translation: 各方还应鼓励其主管收费机构及相关用户相互交流有关用户收费的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Customs Duties1 . When an aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of one Party arrives in the territory of the other Party , the said aircraft and its regular equipment , spare parts [ including engines ] , fuels , oil [ including hydraulic fluids , lubricants ] and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges , provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation:
第十条 关税

当一方指定航空公司运营的飞机抵达另一方领土时，该飞机及其常规设备、备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油品（包括液压液、润滑油）以及机上储备物资（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在互惠基础上，均免除所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，前提是上述设备和物品在飞机上保留至其被重新出口为止。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] spare parts [ including engines ] introduced into the territory of the other Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline .
Translation: [ b ] 由指定航空公司运营的协议航线飞机，为维护或修理而带入另一方境内的备件（包括发动机）。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Party with the approval of the Customs authorities of the other Party .
Translation: 本条第1款和第2款所述的设备和物品，经对方海关当局批准后，可以在对方境内卸载。

Query_Text_en: Such equipment and items shall be kept under the supervision or control of the Customs authorities of the other Party up to such time as they are re-exported , or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the customs regulations of the other Party .
Translation: 此类设备和物品应由另一方海关当局监管或控制，直至其被重新出口或按照另一方海关法规进行其他处置。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The exemption provided for in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall also be available where a designated airline of one Party has contracted with other airline [ s ] , which similarly enjoy [ s ] such exemptions in the territory of the other Party , for the loan or transfer in the territory of the other Party of the equipment and items specified in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article .
Translation: 4. 本条第1款和第2款所规定的免税待遇，同样适用于一方指定的航空公司在对方境内与其他同样享有该项免税待遇的航空公司签订合同，将本条第1款和第2款所列设备和物品在对方境内借用或转让的情形。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Printed ticket stock , air waybills and publicity materials introduced by the designated airline of one Party into the territory of the other Party , shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges .
Translation: 5. 一方指定航空公司带入另一方领土的印刷票据、航空运单及宣传资料，基于互惠原则，免除所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on the basis of reciprocity with the exception of the charges corresponding to the services provided .
Translation: 6. 行李、货物和邮件在直接过境时，应在互惠基础上免除所有关税、税费、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，但因所提供服务而产生的费用除外。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] to take action to eliminate all forms of discrimination or unfair competitive practices adversely affecting the competitive position of a designated airline of the other Party .
Translation: 并采取措施消除所有影响另一方指定航空公司竞争地位的不公平竞争行为或各种形式的歧视。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Capacity1 . The total capacity to be provided on the agreed services by the designated airlines of the Parties shall be agreed between , or approved by , the aeronautical authorities of the Parties before the commencement of the operations , and thereafter according to anticipated traffic requirements .
Translation:
第十二条 运力

双方指定航空公司在约定航线上提供的总运力，应在运营开始前由双方民航主管当局协商一致或批准，并根据预期的客货运输需求进行调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The agreed services to be operated by the designated airlines of the Parties shall have as their primary objective the provision at reasonable load factors of capacity adequate to meet the traffic requirements between the territories of the two Parties .
Translation: 双方指定航空公司运营的约定服务，其主要目标应是在合理的载客率下，提供足以满足双方领土间交通需求的运力。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Party shall allow fair and equal opportunity for the designated airlines of both Parties to operate the agreed services between their respective territories so as to achieve equality and mutual benefit .
Translation: 3. 各缔约方应为双方指定的航空公司在各自领土之间运营商定航班提供公平平等的机会，以实现平等互利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Party and its designated airline [ s ] shall take into consideration the interests of the other Party and its designated airline [ s ] so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides .
Translation: 4. 各方及其指定的航空公司应充分考虑对方及其指定航空公司的利益，避免对后者提供的服务造成不当影响。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If , on review , the Parties fail to agree on the capacity to be provided on the agreed services , the capacity that may be provided by the designated airlines of the Parties shall not exceed the total capacity [ including seasonal variations ] previously agreed to be provided .
Translation: 5. 如果在复审时，双方未能就约定航线的运力达成一致，双方指定航空公司所提供的运力不得超过此前已达成一致的总运力（包括季节性变化）。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Tariffs1 . The tariffs to be applied by the designated airline or airlines of a Party for services covered by this Agreement shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including interests of users , cost of operation , characteristics of service , reasonable profit , tariffs of other airlines and other commercial considerations in the market-place .
Translation:
第十三条 关税  
一、缔约一方指定的航空公司针对本协议所涵盖服务所适用的关税，应在合理水平上制定，并充分考虑所有相关因素，包括用户利益、运营成本、服务特点、合理利润、其他航空公司的关税以及市场中的其他商业因素。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs shall , wherever possible , be agreed by the designated airlines concerned of both Parties , after discussion as required with their respective governments and , if applicable , consultation with other airlines .
Translation: 2. 关税应由双方指定的航空公司在与各自政府进行必要磋商，并在适用情况下与其他航空公司协商后，尽可能达成一致。

Query_Text_en: Such agreement shall , wherever possible , be reached by the use of the appropriate international tariff coordination mechanism .
Translation: 应尽可能通过适当的国际关税协调机制达成此类协议。

Query_Text_en: Failing any multilateral or bilateral agreement , each designated airline may develop tariffs individually .
Translation: 在未达成任何多边或双边协议的情况下，每家指定航空公司可自行制定运价。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Party may require notification or filing of tariffs proposed by the designated airline [ s ] of both Parties for carriage to or from its territory .
Translation: 3. 每一方均可要求对双方指定航空公司拟定的进出其领土的运价进行通知或备案。

Query_Text_en: Such notification or filing may be required not more than 60 days before the proposed date of introduction .
Translation: 此类通知或备案的要求时间不得早于拟引入日期前60天。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this period may be reduced .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，该期限可以缩短。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The tariffs to be charged by the designated airlines of the Parties for carriage between their territories shall be subject to the approval of both Parties .
Translation: 4. 双方指定航空公司在两国领土间运输所收取的运价，须经双方批准。

Query_Text_en: The tariffs to be charged by a designated airline of one Party for carriage between the territory of the other Party and that of a third State on services covered by this agreement shall be subject to the approval requirements of the other Party .
Translation: 一方指定航空公司在本协议涵盖的航班上，承担从另一方领土至第三国之间运输所收取的运价，须经另一方批准。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Approval of tariffs consequent upon the provisions of Paragraph 4 above may be given expressly by either Party to the airline [ s ] filing the tariffs .
Translation: 5. 根据上述第4款的规定，任何一方均可明确批准由航空公司提交的相关运价。

Query_Text_en: However , if a Party has not given in writing to the other Party and\/or the airline [ s ] concerned notice of disapproval of such tariffs of the airline [ s ] of the other Party within 45 days from the date of submission , the tariffs concerned shall be considered approved .
Translation: 然而，如果一方在自提交之日起45天内，未以书面形式向另一方和/或相关航空公司发出对另一方航空公司该等运价的不批准通知，则相关运价应视为已获批准。

Query_Text_en: In the event of the period of submission being reduced in accordance with Paragraph 3 , the Parties may agree that the period within which any disapproval shall be given be reduced accordingly .
Translation: 如根据第3款规定缩短提交期限，双方可协商相应缩短提出异议的期限。

Query_Text_en: No tariff shall come into force if either Party has given notice of disapproval except as provided in Paragraph 6 below .
Translation: 除非下文第六款另有规定，任何一方如提出异议通知，关税不得生效。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Each Party may request consultation regarding any tariff of an airline of either Party for services covered by this Agreement , including where the tariff concerned has been subject to a notice of disapproval .
Translation: 6. 任何一方均可就本协议所涵盖服务的任一方航空公司所制定的任何运价请求协商，包括该运价已收到不批准通知的情形。

Query_Text_en: Such consultations shall be held not later than 30 days after receipt of the request .
Translation: 此类磋商应在收到请求后不迟于30天内举行。

Query_Text_en: The Parties shall cooperate in securing information necessary for reasoned resolution of the issues .
Translation: 双方应合作获取为合理解决相关问题所需的信息。

Query_Text_en: If the Parties reach agreement , each Party shall use its best efforts to put that agreement into effect .
Translation: 如双方达成协议，双方应尽最大努力推动协议的实施。

Query_Text_en: If no agreement is reached any decision to disapprove a tariff shall prevail .
Translation: 如未达成协议，任何关于否决关税的决定均应优先适用。

Query_Text_en: 7 . If the Parties can not resolve an issue with respect to the tariffs mentioned in paragraph 4 , the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 20 of this Agreement .
Translation: 7. 如双方无法就第4款所述关税问题达成一致，争议应按照本协议第20条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 8 . A tariff established in accordance with the provisions of this clause shall remain in force , unless withdrawn by the airline [ s ] concerned or until a new tariff has been approved .
Translation: 根据本条款规定制定的运价应持续有效，除非相关航空公司撤回，或有新的运价获得批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 Transfer of EarningsEach designated airline shall have the right to convert and remit to its country on demand local revenues in excess of sums locally disbursed .
Translation:
第十四条 收益汇兑  
每一指定航空公司有权将其在当地收入中超过当地支出部分的款项，按需兑换并汇回本国。

Query_Text_en: Conversion and remittance shall be permitted at the effective rate of exchange prevailing on the date of remittance , and shall not be subject to any charges except those normally made by banks for carrying out such conversion and remittance .
Translation: 兑换和汇款应按汇款当日的有效汇率进行，除银行在办理此类兑换和汇款时通常收取的费用外，不得收取任何其他费用。

Query_Text_en: Such transfer shall be in accordance with the provisions of the foreign exchange control regulations of that Party .
Translation: 此类转移应遵守该方外汇管制法规的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Representation1 . The designated airline of one Party shall be allowed , on the basis of reciprocity and in accordance with the laws and regulations relating to entry , residence and employment of the other Party , to bring in and maintain in the territory of the other Party their representatives and commercial , operational and technical staff as required in connection with the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第十五条 代表

一方指定的航空公司应被允许在互惠基础上，并按照另一方关于入境、居留和就业的法律法规，进入并在另一方领土内保留其代表及与运营商定航班有关的商业、运营和技术人员。

Query_Text_en: These staff shall be chosen among nationals of either or both Parties as necessary .
Translation: 这些工作人员应根据需要从双方或任一方的本国人员中选拔。

Query_Text_en: 2 . These staff requirements may , at the option of the designated airline , be satisfied by its own personnel or by using the services of another organization , company or airline operating in the territory of the other Party , and authorized to perform such services in the territory of that Party .
Translation: 2. 这些人员需求可由指定航空公司自行决定，通过其自有人员，或利用在对方领土内运营并获准在该领土提供此类服务的其他组织、公司或航空公司的服务予以满足。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of each Party shall , subject to the respective Party 's rules and regulations , have the right to engage in the sale of air transportation in the territory of the other Party , either directly or through authorized agents appointed by the designated airline .
Translation: 3. 每一方指定的航空公司，须遵守各自的法律法规，有权在对方领土内直接或通过其授权代理人销售航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Ban on Smoking1 . Each Party shall prohibit or cause their airlines to prohibit smoking on all flights carrying passengers operated by its airlines between the territories of the Parties .
Translation:
第十六条 禁止吸烟

1. 各缔约方应禁止或促使其航空公司禁止在由其航空公司运营、往返缔约方领土之间的所有载客航班上吸烟。

Query_Text_en: This prohibition shall apply to all locations within the aircraft and shall be in effect from the time an aircraft commences enplanement of passengers to the time deplanement of passengers is completed .
Translation: 本项禁令适用于飞机上的所有区域，并自乘客开始登机起至乘客全部下机结束时止，始终有效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall take all measures that it considers reasonable to secure compliance by its airlines and by their passengers and crew members with the provisions of this Article , including the imposition of appropriate penalties for non-compliance .
Translation: 2. 各方应采取其认为合理的一切措施，确保其航空公司及其乘客和机组人员遵守本条规定，包括对违规行为施加适当的处罚。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 StatisticsThe aeronautical authorities of each Party shall provide or cause its designated airline or airlines to provide the aeronautical authorities of the other Party , upon request , periodic or other statements of statistics as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided on the agreed services operated by the designated airline [ s ] of the first Party .
Translation:
第十七条 统计  
一方的航空主管部门应向另一方的航空主管部门提供，或促使其指定的航空公司向另一方的航空主管部门提供，按照合理要求定期或其他形式的统计报表，以便审查由该方指定航空公司运营的双方约定航班的运力情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Approval of Schedules1 . The designated airline of each Party shall submit its envisaged flight schedules for approval to the aeronautical authorities of the other Party at least sixty [ 60 ] days prior to the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第十八条 航班时刻表的批准

每一方指定的航空公司应在拟定的航班服务开始前至少六十（60）天，将其计划的航班时刻表提交给另一方的航空主管部门审批。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For supplementary flights which the designated airline of one Party wishes to operate on the agreed services outside the approved timetable , that airline must request prior permission from the aeronautical authorities of the other Party .
Translation: 2. 对于一方指定航空公司希望在批准的航班时刻表之外运营的补充航班，该航空公司必须事先向另一方的航空主管部门申请许可。

Query_Text_en: Such requests shall usually be submitted at least fourteen [ 14 ] working days prior to the operation of such flights .
Translation: 此类申请通常应在该航班运营前至少十四（14）个工作日提交。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Consultations1 . Either Party may , at any time , request consultation on the interpretation , application , implementation or amendment of this Agreement or compliance with this Agreement .
Translation:
第十九条 协商

任何一方均可随时就本协议的解释、适用、执行或修订，以及对本协议的遵守情况，提出协商请求。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such consultations which may be through discussion or by correspondence shall begin within a period of 60 days from the date the other Party receives a request , unless otherwise agreed by the Parties .
Translation: 2. 此类协商可以通过讨论或书面通信进行，除非双方另有约定，应在另一方收到请求之日起60天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Settlement of Disputes1 . Any dispute arising between the Parties relating to the interpretation or application of this Agreement , the Parties shall in the first place endeavor to settle it amicably by consultations and negotiation .
Translation:
第二十条 争议解决

凡因本协议的解释或适用而引发的争议，双方应首先通过协商和谈判以友好方式予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the aeronautical authorities of the Parties fail to reach a settlement of the said dispute , the Parties shall settle such dispute through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 2. 如果双方的航空主管当局未能就上述争议达成解决方案，双方应通过外交渠道解决该争议。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Amendments1 . Either Party may at any time request consultation with the other Party for the purpose of amending the present Agreement or its Annex .
Translation:
第二十一条 修订  
任何一方均可随时请求与另一方协商，以修订本协议或其附件。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of receipt of such request . Such consultations may be conducted through discussion or by correspondence .
Translation: 此类磋商应自收到该请求之日起六十（60）天内开始。磋商可以通过会谈或书面通信方式进行。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any amendment shall enter into force when confirmed by an exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 2. 任何修正案经外交照会确认后即生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any amendment of the Annex may be made by written agreement between the aeronautical authorities of the Parties and shall come into force when confirmed by an exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 附件的任何修订，须经双方民航当局书面协议，并在通过外交照会确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Multilateral AgreementsIf a multilateral agreement concerning air transport comes into force in respect of both Parties , the present Agreement shall be amended so far as is necessary to conform with the provisions of that multilateral agreement .
Translation:
第二十二条 多边协定  
如有关于航空运输的多边协定对双方均生效，本协议应在必要范围内进行修订，以符合该多边协定的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 TerminationEither Party may , at any time , give notice in writing , through diplomatic channels , to the other Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十三条 终止  
任何一方均可随时通过外交渠道向另一方发出书面通知，表达终止本协议的意愿。

Query_Text_en: Such notice shall be simultaneously communicated to ICAO .
Translation: 该通知应同时通报国际民航组织。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Party , unless the notice is withdrawn by agreement before the end of this period .
Translation: 本协议自另一方收到通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非双方在该期限结束前协商撤回该通知。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of acknowledgement of receipt by the other Party , the notice shall be deemed to have been received fourteen [ 14 ] days after receipt of the notice by ICAO .
Translation: 如未收到对方的收讫确认，通知在国际民航组织（ICAO）收到该通知后十四（14）天视为已送达。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Registration with ICAOThis Agreement and any amendment thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization by the Government of the People 's Republic of China .
Translation:
第二十四条 向国际民航组织登记

本协议及其任何修订应由中华人民共和国政府向国际民航组织进行登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Entry into ForceThis Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature and shall supersede the Air Transport Agreement signed on the 8th November 1955 between the two Governments .
Translation:
第二十五条 生效

本协议自签署之日起生效，并取代两国政府于1955年11月8日签署的航空运输协定。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the undersigned , duly authorized thereto by their respective Government , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 为此，双方经各自政府正式授权的签署人已在本协议上签字，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: DONE in duplicate at Beijing on this 14th day of February , 2006 in the Chinese , Myanmar and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于2006年2月14日在北京一式两份签署，分别以中文、缅甸文和英文书写，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: In the event of any inconsistencies the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如有任何不一致之处，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: 2 ] In relation to an agreed air service , the capacity of aircraft used on such air service multiplied by frequency operated by such aircraft over a given period on a route or section of a route .
Translation: 对于双方同意的航空服务，运力指在某一航线或航段上，所使用的飞机的载客量与该飞机在一定时期内的运营频次的乘积。

Query_Text_en: h ] the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the condition under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary services , but excluding remuneration or conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation: h ] “关税”一词指的是旅客、行李和货物运输所需支付的价格及其适用条件，包括代理及其他辅助服务的价格和条件，但不包括邮政运输的报酬或条件。

Query_Text_en: i ] the term `` Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December 1944 , including any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 [ a ] thereof , so far as those Annexes and amendments have been adopted by both Parties .
Translation: “公约”一词是指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第90条通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第90条和第94条通过的对附件或公约本身的任何修正，但仅限于双方均已采纳的附件和修正。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Annexes form an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation: 2. 附件构成本协议不可分割的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in the present Agreement to enable its designated airline to establish and operate international air services on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement .
Translation: 1. 每一缔约方均授予另一缔约方本协议所规定的权利，以便其指定的航空公司在本协议附件所列航线上建立并运营国际航空服务。

Query_Text_en: Such services and routes are hereinafter called `` the agreed services '' and `` the specified routes '' respectively .
Translation: 此类服务和航线在下文中分别称为“约定服务”和“指定航线”。

Query_Text_en: c ] to make stops at the point [ s ] on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on board and discharging international traffic of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: c）在另一缔约方领土内的指定航线上，在指定地点停靠，以搭载和卸载国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: No fifth freedom traffic rights are however granted in this paragraph .
Translation: 但本段未授予第五航权。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall not be entitled to carry traffic between two points in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 3. 任何一方缔约国指定的航空公司无权承运在另一方缔约国境内两点之间的旅客、货物或邮件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The right of the designated airline of one Contracting Party to take on board and discharge at point [ s ] in the territory of the other Contracting Party international traffic to or from a third country shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties . [ Fifth Freedom Traffic Rights ]
Translation: 4. 一方缔约国指定的航空公司在另一方缔约国境内的地点搭载和卸载来自或前往第三国的国际运输权利，应由双方缔约国的航空主管当局协商一致。 [第五航权]

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline for the purpose of operating the agreed services on the specified route .
Translation: 1. 每一缔约方均有权以书面形式向另一缔约方指定一家航空公司，以运营在指定航线上商定的航班服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The substantial ownership and effective control of the airline designated by each Contracting Party shall remain vested in such Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 由各缔约方指定的航空公司的实质所有权和有效控制权应始终归属于该缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party may require an airline designated by the other Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfill the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air service by the said authorities .
Translation: 一缔约方的航空主管当局可要求另一缔约方指定的航空公司，证明其有能力满足该主管当局根据法律法规对国际航空运输业务通常和合理适用的各项条件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . On receipt of such designation , the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article , without delay grant to the designated airline the appropriate operating authorizations .
Translation: 4. 一经收到此类指定，另一缔约方的民航当局应根据本条第2款和第3款的规定，毫不延误地向被指定的航空公司授予相应的经营许可。

Query_Text_en: 5 . When an airline has been so designated and authorized , it may begin at any time to operate the agreed service , provided that tariffs and schedules established in accordance with the provisions of Articles 10 and 11 of the present Agreement are in force in respect of that service .
Translation: 5. 一旦某航空公司被指定并获得授权，便可随时开始运营双方约定的航线服务，前提是该服务所适用的运价和班期已按照本协议第十条和第十一条的规定生效。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The designated airline of either Contracting Party may operate the agreed services on the specified route [ s ] with aircraft leased from a third country , provided that prior notice shall be furnished to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least 30 days before the commencement of the proposed operation .
Translation: 6. 任何一方缔约国指定的航空公司可在指定航线上使用从第三国租赁的飞机运营双方商定的航班，但须至少在拟议运营开始前30天，将有关情况提前通知另一方缔约国的航空主管当局。

Query_Text_en: Under special circumstances , this period may be reduced subject to the concurrence of the said authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，经相关主管部门同意，该期限可以缩短。

Query_Text_en: c ] in case the airline otherwise fails to operate the agreed services in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement .
Translation: c ] 如果航空公司未能按照本协议规定的条件运营约定的服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless immediate revocation , suspension or imposition of the conditions mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws or regulations , such rights shall be exercised only after consultation with the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 除非为防止进一步违反法律或法规，必须立即撤销、暂停或施加本条第1款所述条件，否则应在与另一缔约方民航当局协商后方可行使上述权利。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation between the aeronautical authorities shall begin within a period of thirty [ 30 ] days from the date of the request .
Translation: 双方民航主管当局应自收到请求之日起三十（30）天内开始协商。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Aircraft operated on international air services by the designated airline of one Contracting Party , as well as their regular equipment , spare parts , supplies of fuels , oils [ including hydraulic fluids ] , lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt from customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes on arriving in the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation: 一方缔约国指定航空公司运营的国际航班所使用的飞机及其常规设备、备件、燃料、油品（包括液压油）、润滑剂和机上储备物资（包括食品、饮料和烟草），在抵达另一方缔约国领土时，均免征关税、检验费及其他税费，前提是上述设备和物资在飞机上保留至其再次出口为止。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Supplies of fuels , oils [ including hydraulic fluids ] , lubricants , spare parts , regular equipment and aircraft stores introduced into the territory of each Contracting Party by or on behalf of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party or taken on board the aircraft of such designated airline in the said territory shall be exempt from all duties and charges including customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes imposed in the territory of the first Contracting Party even when those supplies are to be used on parts of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 2. 由一方缔约国指定的航空公司或其代表引进至另一方缔约国领土的燃料、油品（包括液压油）、润滑剂、备件、常规设备及航空器用品，或在该领土内装载至上述指定航空公司航空器上的上述物品，均应免除所有关税及费用，包括关税、检验费及在该缔约国领土内征收的其他税费，即使这些物品将在航空器飞行经过装载地所在缔约国领土的航段中使用。

Query_Text_en: The materials referred to above shall be kept under customs supervision or control .
Translation: 上述材料应在海关监管或控制下保存。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The regular airborne equipment , spare parts , aircraft stores , and supplies of fuels , oils [ including hydraulic fluids ] , and lubricants retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of that other Contracting Party , who may require that those materials be placed under customs supervision and control up to such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with customs regulations .
Translation: 3. 任何一方指定航空公司的飞机上所携带的常规机载设备、备件、航空物资以及燃料、油料（包括液压油）和润滑剂，只有在另一方海关当局批准的情况下，方可在对方领土上卸载。对方海关当局可要求上述物品在重新出口或依照海关规定作其他处理之前，须接受海关监管和控制。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Passenger tickets , airway bills , timetables , publicity materials and give-aways introduced into the territory of either Contracting Party by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes .
Translation: 4. 由一方缔约国指定航空公司带入另一方缔约国境内的客票、航空货运单、时刻表、宣传资料及赠品，应免征关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Furnitures and equipment for office use as well as communications facilities and vehicles required by the representative office of the designated airline of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services shall also be exempt from customs duties and other duties or taxes .
Translation: 5. 一方缔约国指定航空公司代表机构在另一方缔约国境内为运营双方商定航班所需的办公家具、设备、通信设施及车辆，也应免征关税及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to or departure from its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services , or to the operation and navigation of such aircraft therein , shall be complied with by the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party while entering , within and departing from the territory of that other Contracting Party .
Translation: 一方缔约国关于国际航空服务飞机进出其领土、在其境内运营和航行的法律法规，须由另一方缔约国指定航空公司的飞机在进入、停留及离开该缔约国领土时予以遵守。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to immigration , customs and quarantine shall be applied to the crews , passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party upon their arrival in , presence within and departure from the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 任何一方缔约国关于移民、海关和检疫的法律法规，均适用于对方缔约国指定航空公司所承运的机组人员、旅客、行李、货物和邮件，在其抵达、停留及离开该缔约国领土时。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Passengers in direct transit across the territory of either Contracting Party shall be subject to no more than very simplified formalities .
Translation: 3. 对于在任一缔约方领土上直接过境的旅客，只需履行极为简化的手续。

Query_Text_en: Baggage and cargo , if in direct transit , shall be exempt from customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or charges .
Translation: 行李和货物，如为直接过境运输，应免征关税、检验费及其他税费或收费。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party operating on the specified route shall bear its nationality and registration marks and carry on board appropriate documents .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司的飞机在规定航线上运营时，应标明其国籍和注册标志，并随身携带相关证件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Certificates of the airworthiness , certificates of competency and licenses issued , or validated , by one Contracting Party and unexpired shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 一方缔约国颁发或认可的有效适航证书、合格证书及执照，应被另一方缔约国视为有效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party , however , reserves the right to refuse to recognize , for flights above its own territory , certificates of competency and licenses granted to its own nationals by the other Contracting party .
Translation: 3. 但各缔约方保留拒绝承认另一缔约方颁发给其本国国民的合格证书和执照在其本国领土上空飞行时有效的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Consistent with their rights and obligations under international law , the Contracting Parties reaffirm their obligation to each other to protect the security of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference forms an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: 1. 根据国际法赋予的权利和义务，缔约双方重申彼此有义务保护民用航空安全，防止非法干扰行为，这一义务构成本协议不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Contracting Parties shall in particular act in conformity with the provisions of the Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft , signed at Tokyo on September 14 , 1963 the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft , signed at The Hague on December 16 , 1970 , the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on September 23 , 1971 and the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on February 24 , 1988 and any other multilateral agreement governing aviation security binding upon both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 2. 缔约双方尤其应遵守以下公约的规定：1963年9月14日在东京签署的《关于在航空器上所犯某些罪行及其他行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签署的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签署的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》、1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签署的《关于制止危害服务国际民用航空机场的暴力非法行为的议定书》，以及对双方均有约束力的任何其他有关航空安全的多边协议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Contracting Parties shall provide upon request all necessary assistance to each other to prevent acts of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft and other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports and air navigation facilities , and any other threat to the security of civil aviation .
Translation: 3. 缔约双方应根据请求，向对方提供一切必要协助，以防止对民用航空器的非法劫持及其他危害航空器、乘客和机组人员、机场及航空导航设施安全的非法行为，以及任何对民用航空安全构成威胁的行为。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Contracting Parties shall , in their mutual relations , act in conformity with the aviation security provisions established by the International Civil Aviation Organization and designated as annexes to the Convention to the extent that such security provisions are applicable to the Contracting Parties ;
Translation: 4. 缔约双方在相互关系中，应遵守国际民用航空组织制定并作为《公约》附件的航空安全规定，前提是该等安全规定适用于缔约双方。

Query_Text_en: they shall require that operators of aircraft who have their principal place of business or permanent residence in their territory and the operators of airports in their territory act in conformity with such aviation security provisions .
Translation: 他们应要求在其领土内设有主要营业地或永久居所的航空器运营人，以及其领土内的机场运营人，遵守相关航空安全规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Contracting Party agrees that such operators of aircraft may be required to observe the aviation security provisions referred to in paragraph [ 4 ] above required by the other Contracting Party for entry into , departure from or while within the territory of that other Contracting Party .
Translation: 5. 每一缔约方同意，前述航空器经营人可被要求遵守另一缔约方为进入、离开或在其领土内期间所规定的航空安全条款。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Each Contracting Party shall ensure that adequate measures are effectively applied within its territory to protect the aircraft and to inspect passengers , crew , carry-on items , baggage , cargo and aircraft stores prior to and during boarding or loading .
Translation: 6. 各缔约方应确保在其境内有效采取充分措施，以保护航空器，并在登机或装载前及过程中对旅客、机组人员、随身物品、行李、货物和航空器用品进行检查。

Query_Text_en: When an incident or threat of an incident of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports or air navigation facilities occurs , the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and other appropriate measures intended to terminate rapidly and safely such incident or threat thereof .
Translation: 当发生或有发生非法劫持民用航空器或其他危害该航空器、其乘客和机组人员、机场或航空导航设施安全的非法行为的威胁时，缔约双方应通过便利通信及其他适当措施互相协助，以便迅速且安全地终止该事件或威胁。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Each Contracting Party shall also give a sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for reasonable security measures to meet a particular threat .
Translation: 7. 每一缔约方还应认真考虑另一缔约方提出的针对特定威胁采取合理安全措施的请求。

Query_Text_en: 8 . When an incident or threat of an incident of unlawful seizure of civil aircraft or other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports or air navigation facilities occurs , the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and other appropriate measures intended to terminate rapidly and safely such incident or threat thereof .
Translation: 8. 当发生或威胁发生对民用航空器的非法劫持，或其他危害该航空器、其乘客和机组人员、机场或航空导航设施安全的非法行为时，缔约双方应通过便利通信及其他适当措施互相协助，以期迅速且安全地终止该事件或其威胁。

Query_Text_en: 9 . When a Contracting Party has reasonable grounds to believe that the other Contracting Party has departed from the aviation security provisions of this Article , the aeronautical authorities of that Contracting Party may request immediate consultations with the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 9. 当一缔约方有合理理由认为另一缔约方未遵守本条航空安全规定时，该缔约方的航空主管当局可要求与另一缔约方的航空主管当局立即进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Failure to reach a satisfactory agreement within a month of the date of such request shall constitute grounds for application of Article 4 of this Agreement .
Translation: 如在提出该请求之日起一个月内未能达成令人满意的协议，即构成本协议第四条适用的依据。

Query_Text_en: If required by a serious emergency , either Contracting Party may take interim action prior to the expire of a month period .
Translation: 如遇重大紧急情况，任何一方缔约国均可在一个月期限届满前采取临时措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting Party may request consultations at any time concerning the safety standards in areas relating to aircrew , aircraft and their operation adopted by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 1. 任何一方缔约国均可随时就另一方缔约国在与机组人员、航空器及其运行相关领域所采纳的安全标准提出磋商请求。

Query_Text_en: Such consultations shall take place within thirty [ 30 ] days of receipt of that request .
Translation: 此类磋商应在收到该请求后三十（30）天内进行。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If , following such consultations , one Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party does not effectively maintain and administer safety standards in any such area that are at least equal to the minimum standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention , the first Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party of those findings and the steps considered necessary to conform with those minimum standards , and that other Contracting Party shall take appropriate corrective action .
Translation: 2. 如果在上述磋商之后，一方缔约国发现另一方缔约国在相关领域未能有效维持和管理至少等同于当时根据公约所制定的最低安全标准，该缔约国应将其发现及为符合最低标准所需采取的措施通知对方缔约国，后者应采取适当的纠正措施。

Query_Text_en: Failure by the other Contracting Party to take appropriate action within fifteen [ 15 ] days or such longer period as may be agreed , shall be grounds for the application of Article 4 of this Agreement .
Translation: 如另一缔约方未能在十五（15）日内或双方同意的更长期限内采取适当措施，即可依据本协议第四条予以适用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the obligations mentioned in Article 33 of the Convention , it is agreed that any aircraft operated by airlines , or on behalf of an airline of one Contracting Party , on services to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party may , while within the territory of the other Contracting Party , be made the subject of an examination by the authorized representatives of the other Contracting Party , on board and around the aircraft to check both the validity of the aircraft documents and those of its crew and the apparent condition of the aircraft and its equipment [ in this Article called `` ramp inspection '' ] , provided that this does not lead to unreasonable delay in the operation of the aircraft .
Translation: 3. 尽管《公约》第33条规定了相关义务，双方一致同意，一方缔约国的航空公司运营的或代表其航空公司运营的任何航空器，在往返另一方缔约国领土的航班中，均可在另一方缔约国领土内由其授权代表对航空器进行检查，包括在机上及机身周围检查航空器文件及机组人员证件的有效性，以及航空器及其设备的表面状况（在本条中称为“停机坪检查”），但前提是此类检查不得导致航空器运行出现不合理延误。

Query_Text_en: b ] serious concerns that there is a lack of effective maintenance and administration of safety standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention , the Contracting Party carrying out the inspection shall , for the purposes of Article 33 of the Convention , be free to conclude that the requirements under which the certificate or licenses in respect of that aircraft or in respect of the crew of that aircraft had been issued or rendered valid , or that the requirements under which that aircraft is operated , are not equal to or above the minimum standards established pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: 如果存在严重担忧，认为根据公约当时所制定的安全标准缺乏有效的维护和管理，则进行检查的缔约方可根据公约第33条，自由认定该航空器或其机组人员所持证书或执照的颁发或有效所依据的要求，或该航空器运营所依据的要求，并未达到或高于根据公约制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: 5 . In the event that access for the purpose of undertaking a ramp inspection of an aircraft operated by or on behalf of the airline or airlines of one Contracting Party in accordance with paragraph 3 above is denied by the representative of that airline or airlines , the other Contracting Party shall be free to infer that serious concerns of the type referred to in paragraph 4 above arise and draw the conclusions referred to in that paragraph .
Translation: 5. 如果一方缔约国的航空公司或其代表拒绝根据上述第3款进行飞机停机坪检查，另一方缔约国有权认为出现了上述第4款所指的严重关切，并据此作出第4款所述的结论。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Each Contracting Party reserves the right to suspend or vary the operating authorization of an airline or airlines of the other Contracting Party immediately in the event the first Contracting Party concludes , whether as a result of access for ramp inspection , a series of ramp inspections , a denial of access for ramp inspection , consultation or otherwise , that immediate action is essential to the safety of the airline operation .
Translation: 6. 每一缔约方均保留在以下情况下，立即暂停或调整另一缔约方航空公司运营许可的权利：如果该缔约方通过停机坪检查、连续停机坪检查、拒绝停机坪检查、协商或其他方式认定，采取即时措施对于航空公司运营安全至关重要。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Any action by one Contracting Party in accordance with paragraphs 2 or 6 above shall be discontinued once the basis for the taking of that action ceases to exist .
Translation: 一方缔约国根据上述第2或第6款采取的任何措施，应在采取该措施的依据不复存在时予以终止。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airports and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and shall provide that airline with such communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 1. 每一缔约方应在其领土内指定常用机场和备降机场，供另一缔约方指定的航空公司运营所规定航线，并应为该航空公司在其领土内提供运营双方同意航班所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。

Query_Text_en: Detailed arrangements relating to above may be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 上述具体安排可由双方缔约国的航空主管当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports , facilities and technical services of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 2. 一方缔约方指定的航空公司在使用另一方缔约方的机场、设施及技术服务时，应按照另一方缔约方主管当局规定的公平合理的费率支付相关费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those imposed on airlines of other States engaged in international air services for the use of similar facilities and services .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于对其他从事国际航空运输业务的国家航空公司使用类似设施和服务所征收的费率。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right , on reciprocal basis , to set up representation at the point of call on the specified route within the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 1. 为在指定航线上运营双方约定的服务，每一缔约方的指定航空公司均有权在对方缔约方境内的指定航线停靠点设立代表机构，且该权利应以互惠为原则。

Query_Text_en: The staff of the representation shall comply with the laws and regulations in force in the country where such representation is located .
Translation: 代表机构工作人员应遵守该代表机构所在国的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The staff members of the representation of the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party . The number of such staff shall be determined on reciprocal basis between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
