Query_Text_en: Article 6 The Contracting Parties affirm that the two sections of the boundary from the High Conical Peak to the junction of the Nam Hpa and the Nam Ting Rivers and from the junction of the Nam Hka and the Nam Yung Rivers to the southeastern extremity of the SinoBurmese boundary at the junction of the Nam La and the Lanchang Mekong Rivers were already delimited in the past and require no change the boundary being as delineated in the maps attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 第六条 缔约双方确认，从高锥峰至南帕河与南定河汇合处，以及从南卡河与南勇河汇合处至中缅边界东南端南拉河与澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处的两段边界，均已在过去划定，无需变更，边界线以本条约所附地图所示为准。

Query_Text_en: 1 From the High Conical Peak Mu Lang Pum Manang Pure the line runs northwards then southeastwards and then northeastwards along the watershed between the Taping River Ta Ying Chiang the Lung Chuan Chiang Shweli and the Nu Salween River on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Shuei Cheng Machyi Chet Pass Panwa Pass Tasamin Shan Hpare Yemawlaunggu Hkyet Pass and Chitsu Lagwi Pass to the source of the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho
Translation: 1 从高耸的锥形山峰穆朗普曼昂普尔出发，界线向北延伸，随后向东南，再向东北，沿着大盈江（Taping River）、陇川江（Lung Chuan Chiang）、瑞丽江（Shweli）与怒江（萨尔温江）（Nu Salween River）一侧，以及恩梅开江（Nmai Hka River）另一侧的分水岭，依次经过水城、马奇切特山口、潘瓦山口、塔萨敏山、哈帕雷、耶茂朗古、凯特山口和奇苏拉圭山口，直至楚伊大河（Chu i Ta Ho）的源头。

Query_Text_en: 2 From the source of the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho the line runs northwestwards along the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho to its junction with its tributary flowing in from the north thence northwards along this tributary to a point on the watershed between the tributaries of the Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung River on the one hand and the Wang Ke Moku Kyaung River and its tributary the Chu i Ta Ho Chu iho Ta Ho on the other thence westwards along this watershed passing through Ma Chu Lo Waddy height 2423 metres 7950 feet thence northwards till it crosses the Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung River west of Hpimaw Village ; thence northwards along the ridge passing through Luksang Bum and crossing the Gan Kang Hao River to reach the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River ; thence westwards along the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River to its junction with the Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka River ; thence northwards up the Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka River to its junction with the Ta Hpawte Hpawte Kyaung River
Translation: 2 从楚伊大河（Chu i Ta Ho / Chu iho Ta Ho）的源头起，沿楚伊大河向西北延伸至其与来自北方的支流汇合处；再沿该支流向北，至位于Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung河各支流与Wang Ke Moku Kyaung河及其支流楚伊大河之间分水岭上的一点；随后沿该分水岭向西，经过Ma Chu Lo Waddy高地（海拔2423米/7950英尺）；再向北，直至在Hpimaw村以西穿越Hpimaw Htangkyam Kyaung河；接着沿山脊向北，经过Luksang Bum并穿越Gan Kang Hao河，抵达Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung河；然后沿Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung河向西，至其与Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka河的汇合处；最后沿Hsiao Chiang Ngawchang Hka河向北，至其与Ta Hpawte Hpawte Kyaung河的汇合处。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs north of Kangfang Village generally eastwards and then southeastwards along the watershed between the Hsiao Hpawte Hpawshi Kyaung River and the Wu Chung Wasok Kyaung River on the one hand and the Ta Hpawte Hpawte Kyaung River on the other to a point on the watershed between the Nu Salween and the Nmai Hka Rivers
Translation: 自此，界线自康方村以北大致向东，随后沿着小帕特帕希江与乌中瓦索克江一侧，以及大帕特帕特江另一侧的分水岭，转向东南，直至怒江—萨尔温江与恩梅开江分水岭上的一点。

Query_Text_en: 3 From the above mentioned point on the watershed between the Nu Salween and the Nmai Hka Rivers the line runs generally northwards along the watershed between the Nu Salween River and the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the one hand and the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Kia Ngo Tu Sajyang Pass Sala Pass Ming Ke Nahke Pass Ni Chi Ku Gi Gi Thara Pass Kawchi Thara Pass Jongit L'ka and Maguchi Pass ; thence the line continues to run northwards and then generally westwards passing through Alang L'ka Mawa L'ka Pang Tang Shan Pumtang Razi Lonlang L'ka Hkora Razi to Tusehpong Razi
Translation: 3. 从上述怒江与恩梅开江分水岭的点起，界线大致沿怒江与恩梅开江之间的分水岭向北延伸，一方面沿怒江与位于西清当村以上段的图龙塔龙河之间的分水岭，另一方面沿恩梅开江，途经Kia Ngo Tu、Sajyang垭口、Sala垭口、Ming Ke Nahke垭口、Ni Chi Ku、Gi Gi Thara垭口、Kawchi Thara垭口、Jongit L'ka和Maguchi垭口；随后界线继续向北延伸，然后大致向西，途经Alang L'ka、Mawa L'ka、Pang Tang Shan、Pumtang Razi、Lonlang L'ka、Hkora Razi，直至Tusehpong Razi。

Query_Text_en: 4 From Tusehpong Razi the line runs generally northwestwards along the ridge passing through height 2892 metres and height 2140 3 metres to a point on the south bank of the Tulung Taron River west of Western Chingdam Village Thence it crosses the Tulung Taron River to its junction with its tributary on its northern bank and thence northwestwards along the ridge to Kundam Razi Lungawng Hpong
Translation: 4 从图谢蓬拉齐起，边线大致沿山脊向西北延伸，经过海拔2892米和2140.3米的高地，至图隆塔隆河南岸、位于西青丹村以西的一个点。随后，边线穿过图隆塔隆河，至其北岸支流的汇合处，再沿山脊向西北延伸至昆丹拉齐隆旺洪。

Query_Text_en: 5 From Kundam Razi Lungawng Hpong the line runs generally northwards and northwestwards along the watershed between the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village on the one hand and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River [ excluding the section of the Tulung Taron River above Western Chingdam Village ] on the other passing through Thala Pass Sungya Amansan L'ka to Yulang Pass
Translation: 5 从昆丹拉齐隆旺峰起，界线大致向北及西北沿着分水岭延伸，一侧为图隆塔隆河在西清丹村以上的河段，另一侧为伊洛瓦底江的上游支流（不包括图隆塔隆河在西清丹村以上的河段），经塔拉山口、松亚、阿曼桑、勒卡，至玉朗山口。

Query_Text_en: 6 From Yulang Pass the line runs generally southwestwards along the watershed between the Tsayul Zayul River on the one hand and the upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River on the other passing through Gamlang L'ka to the western extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary
Translation: 6 从玉郎山口起，边界线大致向西南沿着察隅河与伊洛瓦底江上游支流之间的分水岭延伸，经过甘朗拉卡，直至中缅边界的最西端。

Query_Text_en: 1 From the High Conical Peak the line runs generally southwestwards along the watershed between the upper tributaries of the Taping River the Mong Ka Hka and the upper tributaries of the Ta Pa Chiang Tabak Hka Rivers on the one hand and the lower tributaries of the Nmai Hka River on the other passing through Ta Ya Kou Lunghkyen Hkyet and thence northwestwards to Hsiao Chueh Pass Tabak Hku Hkyet
Translation: 1. 从高锥峰起，界线大致沿着塔平河上游支流蒙卡哈河及塔帕江塔巴哈河上游支流与恩迈哈河下游支流之间的分水岭向西南延伸，途经塔雅口、龙克延凯特，然后向西北至小却关、塔巴库凯特。

Query_Text_en: 2 From Hsiao Chueh Pass Tabak Hku Hkyet the line runs down the Ta Pa Chiang Tabak Hka the Mong Ka Hka and up the Shih Tzu Paknoi Hka River the upper stretch of which is known as the Hkatong Hka River to its source
Translation: 2 从萧却关塔巴克库克叶起，边界线沿大巴江塔巴克哈、孟卡哈下行，再沿石子白诺伊哈河上行，该河上游段称为哈通哈河，直至其源头。

Query_Text_en: 3 From the source of the Shih Tzu Paknoi Hka River the line runs southwestwards and then westwards along the watershed between the Monglai Hka on the one hand and the Pajao Hka the Ma Li Ka River and the Nan Shan Namsang Hka River on the other to the source of the Laisa Stream
Translation: 3. 自狮子白诺伊卡河的源头起，界线向西南方向延伸，随后沿着蒙莱卡河与帕觉卡河、马利卡河及南山南桑卡河之间的分水岭向西，直至莱萨溪的源头。

Query_Text_en: 4 From the source of the Laisa Stream the line runs down the Laisa Stream and up the Mu Lei Chiang Mole Chaung and the Ga Yang Hka Cheyang Hka passing through Ma Po Tzu A law Hkyet and then runs southwards down the Nan Pen Chiang Nampaung Hka to its junction with the Taping River ; thence eastwards up the Taping River to the point where the Taping River meets a small ridge west of the junction of the Kuli Hka Stream with the Taping River
Translation: 4. 从赖萨溪的源头起，沿赖萨溪下行，再沿穆雷江、莫勒江、嘎扬哈、切扬哈上行，经过马坡子、阿劳凯，随后向南沿南本江、南邦哈下行至其与大平江的汇合处；然后向东沿大平江上行，至大平江与库里哈溪汇合处以西的一条小山脊交汇点。

Query_Text_en: 5 From the point where the Taping River meets the above mentioned small ridge the line runs along the watershed between the Kuli Hka Stream the Husa Namsa Hka River and the tributaries of the Namwan River on the one hand and the tributaries of the Taping River west of the Kuli Hka Stream on the other up to Pang Chien Shan Pan Teng Shah
Translation: 5 自大平江与上述小山脊交汇处起，界线沿库利卡溪、户撒南萨卡河及南宛江支流与大平江库利卡溪以西支流之间的分水岭，延伸至邦千山（潘腾沙）。

Query_Text_en: 6 From Pang Chien Shan Pan Teng Shan the line runs southwards to join the Kindit Hka then down the Kindit Hka and the Nam Wa Hka Pang Ling River to a point on the south bank of the Nam Wa Hka Pang Ling River southeast of Man Yung Hai Village and north of Nawng Sa Village thence in a straight line southwestwards and then southwards to the Nan Sah Manting Hka River ; then it runs down the course of the Nan Sah Manting Hka River as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past to its junction with the Namwan River thence down the course of the Namwan River as it was at that time to its junction with the course of the Shweli River as it was at that time
Translation: 6 从庞建山、潘腾山起，界线向南延伸，连接金迪河，然后沿金迪河和南瓦河（庞岭河）向下，至南瓦河（庞岭河）南岸的一个点，该点位于曼永海村东南、诺昂萨村以北；随后界线以直线向西南，再向南延伸至南萨曼廷河；然后沿南萨曼廷河的河道（以界线划定时的河道为准）向下，至其与南湾河的汇合处；再沿南湾河的河道（以当时的河道为准）向下，至其与瑞丽河的河道（以当时的河道为准）汇合处。

Query_Text_en: 7 From the junction of the courses of the Namwan River and the Shweli River as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past to the junction of the Shweli and the Wanting Nam Yang Rivers the location of the line shall be as delineated on the maps attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 7 自南宛河与瑞丽江在以往划定边界时的汇合处起，至瑞丽江与畹町南洋河的汇合处止，界线位置应按照本条约所附地图所标示的线路确定。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs up the course ot the Wanting Nam Yang River as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past and the Weishang Hka then turns northwestwards along a tributary of the Nam Che Hka Nam Hse River to its junction with the Nam Che Hka Nam Hse River thence eastwards up the Nam Che Hka Nam Hse River passing through Ching Shu Pass and thence along the Monglong Hka and the course of the Mong Ko Nam Ko River as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past thence up the Nam Hkai and the Nam Pang Wa Rivers passing through a pass and then along the Man Hsing Nam Hpawn River [ whose upper stretch is known as the Nam Tep Nam Lep River ] to its junction with the Nu Salween River thence eastwards up the Nu Salween River to its junction with the Ti Kai Kou Nan Men Stream
Translation: 自此，界线沿着旺廷南养河的河道上溯，按照以往划定边界时的河道走向，随后韦尚哈河转向西北，沿南车哈南西河的一条支流至其与南车哈南西河的汇合处，再沿南车哈南西河向东上溯，经过青树关，继而沿孟龙哈河及孟科南科河的河道上溯，仍以以往划定边界时的河道为准，随后上溯南开河和南邦瓦河，经过一处山口，再沿曼兴南帕恩河（其上游称为南帖南列河）至其与怒江（萨尔温江）的汇合处，然后沿怒江向东上溯，至其与提开口南门溪的汇合处。

Query_Text_en: 8 From the junction of the Nu Salween River with the Ti Kai Kou Nan Men Stream the line runs southwards along the Ti Kai Kou Nan Men Stream then southwestwards then southwards along the watershed between the Meng Peng Ho the upper stretch of the Nam Peng River on the one hand and the tributaries of the Nu Salween River on the other up to Pao Lou Shan
Translation: 8 从怒江与提开口南门溪的汇合处，界线沿提开口南门溪向南延伸，随后向西南，再向南沿孟鹏河（即南鹏河上游）与怒江支流之间的分水岭延伸，直至保楼山。

Query_Text_en: 9 From Pao Lou Shan the line runs southeastwards along the Wa Yao Kou Stream the ridge south of the Mai Ti Mai Ti Ho River the Pan Chiao Ho and the Hsiao Lu Chang Hsin Chai Kou Stream up to the source of the Hsiao Lu Chang Hsin Chai Kou Stream
Translation: 9. 从炮楼山起，沿瓦窑口溪、麦提麦提河以南的山脊、板桥河以及小鹿场新寨口溪，向东南方向延伸，直至小鹿场新寨口溪的源头。

Query_Text_en: From the source of the above stream to the junction of the Nam Hpa and the Nam Ting Rivers the location of the line shall be as delineated on the maps attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 从上述河流的源头到南帕河与南丁河的汇合处，界线的位置应按照本条约所附地图所标示的范围确定。

Query_Text_en: The line then runs eastwards for about four kilometres about three miles up the Nam Ting River and thence southeastwards along the northwest slope of Kummuta Shan Loi Hseng to the top of Kummuta Shan Loi Hseng
Translation: 该界线随后向东延伸约四公里（约三英里），沿南定河上游，继而沿库姆塔山洛伊盛的西北坡向东南方向延伸，直至库姆塔山洛伊盛的山顶。

Query_Text_en: 10 From the top of Kummuta Shan Loi Hseng the line runs southeastwards along a tributary of the Kung Meng Ho Nam Loi hsa River to its junction with another tributary flowing in from the southeast ;
Translation: 10 从贡木塔山洛伊亨的山顶起，界线沿功孟河南洛伊哈河的一条支流向东南延伸，至其与另一条自东南方向流入的支流的汇合处。

Query_Text_en: thence up the latter tributary to a point northwest of Maklawt Ma Law Village Thence the line runs in a straight line to a point southwest of Maklawt Ma Law Village and again in a straight line across a tributary of the Yun Hsing Nam Tap River to Shien Jen Shan located east of the junction of the abovementioned tributary with another tributary of the Yun Hsing Nam Tap River ;
Translation: 然后沿该支流上行至马劳村西北方向的一点；再由此点沿直线延伸至马劳村西南方向的一点，并再次沿直线穿越云兴南塔河的一条支流，至位于上述支流与云兴南塔河另一支流汇合处以东的仙人山。

Query_Text_en: thence along the watershed between the above two tributaries of the Yun Hsing Nam Tap River to the source of the one to the west and then turns westwards and southwestwards along the Mong Ling Shan ridge up to the top of Mong Ling Shan Thence it runs eastwards and southeastwards along the Nam Pan River to its junction with a tributary northeast of Yakaw Chai Ya Kou Sai Village which flows in from the southwest ; thence in a southwesterly direction up that tributary to a point northeast of Yakaw Chai Ya Kou Sai Village from where it turns southwards passing through a point east of Yakaw Chai Ya Kou Sai Village and crosses a tributary of the Nam Pan River south of Yakaw Chai Ya Kou Sai Village thence westwards to the source of the Nam It River a little east of Chao Pao Taklyet No Village
Translation: 然后沿着上述两条云兴南塔河支流之间的分水岭，至西侧支流的源头，再向西和西南沿蒙岭山脊至蒙岭山顶。随后向东和东南沿南潘河至其与雅考寨雅口赛村东北的一条从西南流入的支流的汇合处；再沿该支流向西南至雅考寨雅口赛村东北的一点，从此转向南，经过雅考寨雅口赛村以东的一点，并穿过南潘河在雅考寨雅口赛村以南的一条支流，然后向西至南伊河源头，位于朝保塔克列村以东不远处。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs southwards along the Nam It and the Nam Mu Rivers and then turns eastwards along the Nam Kunglong and the Chawk Hkrak Rivers to the northeast source of the Chawk Hkrak River
Translation: 自此，界线沿南伊河和南木河向南延伸，随后沿南孔龙河和乔克克拉克河向东，直至乔克克拉克河的东北源头。

Query_Text_en: 11 From the northeast source of the Chawk Hkrak River the line runs southwards and eastwards along the watershed between the upper tributaries of the Nam Kunglong River on the one hand and the southern tributaries of the Chawk Hkrak River and the Nan Tin Nam Htung River on the other to a point on the west side of Umhpa Village Thence it runs eastwards passing a point 100 metres north of Umhpa Village and then eastwards up to the source of a small river on the above mentioned watershed ; thence along the ridge eastwards to the source of a tributary of the Mongtum Nam Tum River the upper stretch of which is called the Ta Tung River which it follows in an easterly and north easterly direction to its junction with another tributary of the Mongtum Nam Turn River flowing in from the southeast ;
Translation: 11 自Chawk Hkrak河东北源头起，界线沿Nam Kunglong河上游支流与Chawk Hkrak河南部支流及Nan Tin Nam Htung河之间的分水岭向南、向东延伸，至Umhpa村西侧一点。随后，界线向东延伸，经过Umhpa村以北100米处，再向东延伸至上述分水岭上一条小河的源头；继而沿山脊向东至Mongtum Nam Tum河一支流的源头，该支流上游称为Ta Tung河，界线沿该河向东及东北方向延伸，直至与另一条自东南流入的Mongtum Nam Tum河支流汇合处。

Query_Text_en: thence it follows this tributary to its source on the watershed between the Mongtum Nam Tum and the Lung Ta Hsiao Ho Nam Lawng Rivers It then crosses the watershed in an easterly direction to the source of the Lung Ta Hsiao Ho Nam Lawng River which it follows to its junction with its tributary flowing in from the north thence in a northerly direction along the above mentioned tributary passing through a point on the Kanpinau Ridge thence generally eastwards along a valley crossing the junction of two subtributaries of a tributary of the Lung Ta Hsiao Ho Nam Lawng River then northeastwards to the watershed between the Mongtum Nam Tum River on the one hand and the Nam Ma River on the other until it reaches height 1941 8 metres 6370 feet
Translation: 随后，界线沿该支流溯源而上，至蒙通南通河与龙塔小河南朗河之间的分水岭。然后，界线向东穿越分水岭，至龙塔小河南朗河的源头，并沿该河而下，至其与自北方流入的支流汇合处。继而，界线沿上述支流向北，经过甘皮瑙岭上的一点，随后大致向东沿一山谷，穿越龙塔小河南朗河一支流的两条子支流汇合处，再向东北至蒙通南通河与南马河之间的分水岭，直至海拔1941.8米（6370英尺）处。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs eastwards then southwards and then northwestwards along the watershed between the Mongtum Nam Tum the La Meng Nam Meng Ho the He He Ho the Ku Hsing Ho Nam Hka Lam and the Nam Hka Hkao Nam Hsiang Ho Rivers on the one hand and the Nam Ma River on the other up to a point on this watershed northwest of La Law Village
Translation: 自此，界线沿分水岭向东、向南，再向西北延伸，该分水岭一侧为蒙东南通河、拉孟南孟河、和和河、库兴河、南哈兰河及南哈考南香河，另一侧为南马河，直至该分水岭上拉劳村西北方向的一个点。

Query_Text_en: 12 From the point on the above mentioned watershed northwest of La Law Village the line runs down the nearest tributary of the Nam Hka Hkao River and thence down the Nam Hka Hkao River to its junction with a tributary flowing in from the southwest Thence the line runs generally southwestwards up that tributary to its source which is northeast of and nearest to height 2180 metres 7152 feet Thence it crosses the ridge at a point 150 metres 492 feet southeast of the above mentioned height and then turns southwards to the source of the nearest tributary of the Nam Lung Nam Sak River rising at the above mentioned height Thence it runs along this tributary to its junction with the Nam Lung Nam Sak River from where it proceeds along the Nam Lung Nam Sak the Nam Hse and the Nam Hka Rivers to the junction of the Nam Hka and the Nam Yung Rivers and thence up the Nam Yung River to its source
Translation: 12 自上述分水岭位于拉劳村西北的点起，界线沿最近的南哈哈河支流下行，继而顺南哈哈河而下，至其与一条自西南方向流入的支流汇合处。自此，界线大致向西南沿该支流上溯至其源头，该源头位于2180米（7152英尺）高程点的东北方且距离最近。随后，界线自该高程点东南150米（492英尺）处越过山脊，转向南行至发源于上述高程点、为南龙南萨河最近的支流的源头。界线沿该支流下行至其与南龙南萨河的汇合处，继而顺南龙南萨河、南谢河及南哈河而下，至南哈河与南永河的汇合处，再沿南永河上溯至其源头。

Query_Text_en: 13 From the source of the Nam Yung River the line runs in a south easterly direction to the watershed between the Na Wu Nam Wong and the Nam Pei Nam Hpe Rivers ; thence generally eastwards along the above mentioned watershed and then eastwards along the Na Wu Nam Wong River which it follows to its junction with the Nan Lai Nam Lai River thence along the watershed between the Na Wu Nam Wong and the Nan Lai Nam Lai Rivers to the Anglang Shan Loi Ang Lawng ridge ; thence northwards along the ridge to the top of Anglang Shan Loi Ang Lawng thence generally eastwards along the ridge crosses the Nam Tung Chik Nam Tonghkek River and then follows the watershed between the tributaries on the west bank of the Nam Lei Nam Lwe River at the north of the La Ting Hwe kye tai River and the Nan La Ho [ a tributary of the Nan Ma Nam Ma River ] on the one hand and the tributaries on the west bank of the Nam Lei Nam Lwe River at the south of the La Ting Hwe kye tai River on the other up to the top of Pang Shun Shan Loi Pang Hsun
Translation: 13 从南勇河的源头起，界线向东南方向延伸至纳乌南翁河与南培南赫河之间的分水岭；随后大致沿上述分水岭向东，再沿纳乌南翁河向东，至其与南赖南赖河的汇合处；接着沿纳乌南翁河与南赖南赖河之间的分水岭至昂朗山洛昂朗岭；再沿该岭向北至昂朗山洛昂朗的顶峰；随后大致沿该岭向东，跨过南通吉克南通克河，然后沿南雷南雷河西岸支流的分水岭，分界于拉廷辉凯泰河以北的南拉霍（南马南马河的支流）及南雷南雷河西岸支流与拉廷辉凯泰河以南的南雷南雷河西岸支流之间，直至庞顺山洛庞顺的顶峰。

Query_Text_en: 14 From the top of Pang Shun Shan Loi Pang Hsun the line runs generally eastwards along the La Ting Hwe kye tai River the Nam Lei Nam Lwe River the course of the Nan Lo Nam Law Stream as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past and the Nan Wo Nambok River to the source of the Nan Wo Nambok River at Nan Wo Kai Nan Shan Loi Kwainang
Translation: 14 从邦顺山顶洛邦顺起，界线大致向东沿拉丁会溪台河、南雷南雷河、界线划定时的南洛南洛溪流流向，以及南窝南博河，至南窝南博河源头南窝凯南山洛快南。

Query_Text_en: 15 From the source of the Nan Wo Nambok River at Nan Wo Kai Nan Shan Loi Kwainang the line runs generally eastwards along the watershed between the Nan La Nam Lak [ a tributary of the Nam Lei Nam Lwe River ] the Nan Pai Nam Hpe and the Nan Hsi Nam Hok Rivers on the one hand and the Nan Ping Nam Hpen the Nan Mau Nam Mawng and the Nan Hsi Pang Nam Hsi Pang Rivers on the other up to San Min Po Loi Hsammong
Translation: 15 从南窝楠博河源头（位于南窝楠山洛夸南）起，界线大致沿着南拉楠拉克河（楠雷楠勒河的支流）、南派楠佩河和南西楠霍河与南平楠本河、南茂楠芒河及南西庞楠西庞河之间的分水岭向东延伸，直至三民坡洛萨蒙。

Query_Text_en: 16 From San Min Po Loi Hsammong the line runs in a general north easterly direction to a point on the west bank of the Nam Lam River Thence it descends the Nam Lam River to the foot of Chiu Na Shan Kyu nak on the south bank of the Nam Lam River and then runs in a general south easterly direction passing through Hue Ling Lang Hwe Mawk hkio La Ti La Tip Nan Meng Hao Nam mong Hau to Mai Niu Tung Mai Niutawng ; thence the line runs in a general north easterly direction passing through Lung Man Tang Long man tang to the Hui La Hwe La Stream which it follows northwards to its junction with the Nam Lam River
Translation: 16 从三民坡来三蒙起，界线大致向东北方向延伸，至南腊河西岸的一点；继而沿南腊河下行，至南腊河南岸的九那山（Kyu nak）山脚；然后大致向东南方向延伸，依次经过会岭朗、会冒、桥拉、提拉、提南、勐浩、南冒浩，至麦牛通（Mai Niu Tung，Mai Niutawng）；随后，界线大致向东北方向延伸，经过龙满塘（Lung Man Tang，Long man tang），至会拉溪（Hui La Hwe La Stream），沿该溪向北，至其与南腊河的汇合处。

Query_Text_en: Thence the line runs eastwards and southwards along the Nam Lam the Nan Chih Nam Se Rivers and the Nam Chia Hwe Sak Stream to Lei Len Ti Fa Shan Loi Len Ti Hpa
Translation: 随后，界线沿南览河、南池南色河和南加会萨溪向东南方向延伸，直至雷伦提法山（雷伦提帕）。

Query_Text_en: The line then follows the Nam Mot Nan Mai the Nan Tung Nam Tung and the Nam Ta Rivers to Hsing Kang Lei Shan Loi Makhinkawng
Translation: 该界线随后沿着南莫南迈河、南通南通河和南塔河延伸至兴岗雷山洛伊马金康。

Query_Text_en: 17 From Hsing Kang Lei Shan Loi Makhinkawng the line runs eastwards along the watershed between the Nam Nga River and its upper tributaries on the one hand and the Nam Loi River including its tributary the Nam He River on the other to the top of Kwang Pien Nei Shan Kwang Peknoi
Translation: 17 从兴岗雷山雷马金岗起，界线沿南雅河及其上游支流与南雷河及其支流南黑河之间的分水岭向东延伸，至广边内山（广佩内）顶。

Query_Text_en: 18 From the top of Kwang Pien Nei Shan Kwang Peknoi the line runs generally northeastwards along the Hue Le Nam Luk River and the course of the Nam Nga River as at the time when the boundary was demarcated in the past to the junction of the Nam Nga and the Lanchang Mekong Rivers ; thence down the Lanchang Mekong River up to the southeastern extremity of the Sino Burmese boundary line at the junction of the Nam La and the Lanchang Mekong Rivers
Translation: 18 从广边内山顶出发，广边内山线大致沿着会乐南禄河和南雅河的河道，按照过去划定边界时的河流走向，延伸至南雅河与澜沧湄公河的汇合处；随后顺澜沧湄公河而下，直至南拉河与澜沧湄公河交汇处的中缅边界线东南端。

Query_Text_en: 3 The alignment of the entire boundary line between the two countries described in this Article and the location of the temporary boundary marks erected by both sides during joint survey are shown on the 1 250 000 maps indicating the entire boundary and on the 1 50 000 maps of certain areas which are attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 本条所述两国全部边界线的走向，以及双方在联合勘测期间设立的临时界标位置，均标示于附属于本条约的1:250,000比例尺的全境边界地图和部分地区的1:50,000比例尺地图上。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 The Contracting Parties agree that wherever the boundary follows a river the midstream line shall be the boundary in the case of an unnavigable river and the middle line of the main navigational channel the deepest watercourse shall be the boundary in the case of a navigable river In case the boundary river changes its course the boundary line between the two countries shall remain unchanged in the absence of other agreements between the two sides
Translation: 第八条 缔约双方同意，凡边界沿河流划定时，若为不可航行的河流，则以河流中线为边界；若为可航行的河流，则以主要航道的中线，即最深水道为边界。若边界河流改道，除双方另有协议外，两国之间的边界线保持不变。

Query_Text_en: 1 Upon the coming into force of the present Treaty the Meng Mao Triangular Area to be turned over to Burma under Article 2 of the present Treaty shall become territory of the Union of Burma ;
Translation: 本条约生效后，根据本条约第二条应移交给缅甸的猛卯三角地区，将成为缅甸联邦的领土。

Query_Text_en: 2 The area of Hpimaw Gawlum and Kangfang to be returned to China under Article 1 of the present Treaty and the areas under the jurisdiction of the Panhung and Panlao tribes to be turned over to China under Article 2 shall be handed over by the Burmese Government to the Chinese Government within four months after the present Treaty comes into force ;
Translation: 根据本条约第一条应归还中国的Hpimaw Gawlum和Kangfang地区，以及根据第二条应移交中国的Panhung和Panlao部族管辖地区，缅甸政府应在本条约生效后四个月内移交给中国政府。

Query_Text_en: 3 The areas to be adjusted under Article 3 of the present Treaty shall be handed over respectively by the Government of one Contracting Party to that of the other within four months after the present Treaty comes into force
Translation: 本条约第三条所规定需调整的地区，应在本条约生效后四个月内，由一缔约方政府分别移交给另一缔约方政府。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 After the signing of the present Treaty the Chinese Burmese Joint Boundary Committee constituted in pursuance of the Agreement between the two Parties on the Question of the Boundary Between the Two Countries of January 28 1960 shall continue to carry out necessary surveys of the boundary line between the two countries to set up new boundary markers and to examine repair and remould old boundary markers and shall then draft a protocol setting forth in detail the alignment of the entire boundary line and the location of all the boundary markers with detailed maps attached showing the boundary line and the location of the boundary markers
Translation: 第十条 本条约签署后，根据双方于1960年1月28日关于两国边界问题的协议成立的中缅联合边界委员会，应继续对两国边界线进行必要的勘测，设置新的界标，并对旧界标进行检查、修缮和改造。随后，委员会应起草一份议定书，详细规定整个边界线的走向及所有界标的位置，并附上详细地图，标明边界线及界标的位置。

Query_Text_en: The above mentioned protocol upon being concluded by the Governments of the two countries shall become an annex to the present Treaty and the detailed maps shall replace the maps attached to the present Treaty
Translation: 上述议定书经两国政府签署后，将作为本条约的附件，其详细地图将取代本条约所附地图。

Query_Text_en: Upon the conclusion of the above mentioned protocol the tasks of the Chinese Burmese Joint Boundary Committee shall be terminated and the Agreement between the two Parties on the Question of the Boundary Between the Two Countries of January 28 1960 shall cease to be in force
Translation: 在上述议定书签署后，中缅联合边界委员会的任务即告终止，双方于1960年1月28日就两国边界问题签署的协议亦随之失效。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 The Contracting Parties agree that any dispute concerning the boundary which may arise after the formal delimitation of the boundary between the two countries shall be settled by the two sides through friendly consultations
Translation: 第十一条 缔约双方同意，正式划定两国边界后，如出现任何有关边界的争议，双方应通过友好协商予以解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 The present Treaty is subject to ratification and the instruments of ratification will be exchanged in Rangoon as soon as possible
Translation: 第十二条 本条约须经批准，批准书应尽快在仰光交换。

Query_Text_en: The present Treaty shall come into force on the day of the exchange of the instruments of ratification
Translation: 本条约自批准书互换之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Upon the coming into force of the present Treaty all past treaties exchanged notes and other documents relating to the boundary between the two countries shall be no longer in force except as otherwise provided in Article 10 of the present Treaty with regard to the Agreement between the two Parties on the Question of the Boundary Between the Two Countries of January 28 1960
Translation: 本条约生效后，除本条约第十条关于双方于1960年1月28日签署的《两国边界问题协议》另有规定外，双方之间以往关于边界的所有条约、换文及其他文件均不再有效。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicate in Peking on October 1 1960 in the Chinese Burmese and English languages all three texts being equally authentic
Translation: 本文件于1960年10月1日在北京一式两份签署，分别以中文、缅甸文和英文书写，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Establishment of a UnionThe States party to this Treaty hereinafter called `` the Contracting States '' constitute a Union for the international recognition of the deposit of microorganisms for the purposes of patent procedure
Translation:
第一条 联盟的建立  
本条约的缔约国（以下简称“缔约国”）为专利程序中微生物保藏的国际承认而组成一个联盟。

Query_Text_en: xv Regulations means the Regulations referred to in Article 12
Translation: xv “规章”是指第12条所提及的规章

Query_Text_en: 1 a Contracting States which allow or require the deposit of microorganisms for the purposes of patent procedure shall recognize , for such purposes , the deposit of a microorganism with any international depositary authority Such recognition shall include the recognition of the fact and date of the deposit as indicated by the international depositary authority as well as the recognition of the fact that what is furnished as a sample is a sample of the deposited microorganism
Translation: 允许或要求为专利程序目的进行微生物保藏的缔约国，应当承认在任何国际保藏机构进行的微生物保藏用于该等目的。此种承认应包括承认国际保藏机构所注明的保藏事实和日期，以及承认所提供的样品即为所保藏微生物的样品。

Query_Text_en: b Any Contracting State may require a copy of the receipt of the deposit referred to in subparagraph a , issued by the international depositary authority
Translation: b 任何缔约国均可要求提供由国际保管机构出具的、与a项所述存款相关的收据副本。

Query_Text_en: 2 As far as matters regulated in This Treaty and the Regulations are concerned , no Contracting State may require compliance with requirements different from or additional to those which are provided in this Treaty and the Regulations
Translation: 就本条约及其规章所规范的事项而言，任何缔约国不得要求遵守本条约及规章规定之外的不同或额外要求。

Query_Text_en: i where such microorganism is no longer viable , or ii where the furnishing of samples would require that they be sent abroad and the sending or the receipt of the samples abroad is prevented by export or import restrictions , that authority shall , promptly after having noted its inability to furnish samples , notify the depositor of such inability , indicating the cause thereof , and the depositor , subject to paragraph 2 and as provided in this paragraph , shall have the right to make a new deposit of the microorganism which was originally deposited
Translation: i 如果该微生物已不再具有活性，或 ii 如果提供样品需将其寄往国外，而因出口或进口限制导致样品无法寄出或接收，则该主管机关应在发现无法提供样品后，立即将此情况及其原因通知存储人。根据本条第2款及本款规定，存储人有权重新存储最初存储的该微生物。

Query_Text_en: ii it may be made with another international depositary authority in the case referred to in subparagraph a ii
Translation: 在a项ii款所述情形下，可以向另一国际保管机构进行存储。

Query_Text_en: c Any new deposit shall be accompanied by a statement signed by the depositor alleging that the newly deposited microorganism is the same as that originally deposited If the allegation of the depositor is contested , the burden of proof shall be governed by the applicable law
Translation: 任何新的存储应附有由存储人签署的声明，声明新存储的微生物与最初存储的微生物相同。如果存储人的声明受到质疑，举证责任应按照适用法律进行。

Query_Text_en: d Subject to subparagraph a to subparagraph c and subparagraph e , the new deposit shall be treated as if it had been made on the date on which the original deposit was made where all the preceding statements concerning the viability of the originally deposited microorganism indicated that the microorganism was viable and where the new deposit was made within three months after the date on which the depositor received the notification referred to in subparagraph a
Translation: 在遵守a至c款及e款规定的前提下，如果所有关于原始保藏微生物活性的前述声明均表明该微生物具有活性，并且新保藏是在保藏人收到a款所述通知之日起三个月内进行的，则新保藏应视同为在原始保藏日期进行。

Query_Text_en: e Where subparagraph b i applies and the depositor does not receive the notification referred to in subparagraph a within six months after the date on which the termination , limitation or discontinuance referred to in subparagraph b i was published by the International Bureau , the three month time limit referred to in subparagraph d shall be counted from the date of the said publication
Translation: 如适用第b项第i目，且存款人未在国际局公布第b项第i目所述终止、限制或中止之日起六个月内收到第a项所述通知，则第d项所述三个月期限应自上述公布之日起计算。

Query_Text_en: 2 The right referred to in paragraph 1 a shall not exist where the deposited microorganism has been transferred to another international depositary authority as long as that authority is in a position to furnish samples of such microorganism
Translation: 第1(a)款所述的权利在所存微生物已转交至另一国际保藏机构且该机构能够提供该微生物样本的情况下，不再适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Export and Import RestrictionsEach Contracting State recognizes that it is highly desirable that , if and to the extent to which the export from or import into its territory of certain kinds of microorganisms is restricted , such restriction should apply to microorganisms deposited , or destined for deposit , under this Treaty only where the restriction is necessary in view of national security or the dangers for health or the environment
Translation:
第五条 出口和进口限制  
各缔约国认识到，如果对某些类型微生物的出口或进口实施限制，并且在其领土范围内适用该限制，极为重要的是，此类限制仅在出于国家安全或对健康、环境存在危险的必要情况下，才适用于根据本条约已存放或拟存放的微生物。

Query_Text_en: 1 In order to qualify for the status of international depositary authority , any depositary institution must be located on the territory of a Contracting State and must benefit from assurances furnished by that State to the effect that the said institution complies and will continue to comply with the requirements specified in paragraph 2 The said assurances may be furnished also by an intergovernmental industrial property organization ;
Translation: 1 为获得国际保管机构资格，任何保管机构必须设立在一项缔约国的领土上，并须获得该国提供的保证，证明该机构已符合并将继续符合第二款所规定的要求。上述保证也可由政府间工业产权组织提供。

Query_Text_en: in that case , the depositary institution must be located on the territory of a State member of the said organization
Translation: 在这种情况下，保管机构必须设立在该组织成员国的境内。

Query_Text_en: viii furnish samples of any deposited microorganism under the conditions and in conformity with the procedure prescribed in the Regulations
Translation: 在规定条件下并按照法规所规定的程序，提供任何已存微生物的样品。

Query_Text_en: ii in case of the termination or limitation of the status of international depositary authority of an international depositary authority
Translation: 二、如国际保管机构的国际保管机构身份被终止或受限

Query_Text_en: 1 a A depositary institution shall acquire the status of international depositary authority by virtue of a written communication addressed to the Director General by the Contracting State on the territory of which the depositary institution is located and including a declaration of assurances to the effect that the said institution complies and will continue to comply with the requirements specified in Article 6 2 The said status may be acquired also by virtue of a written communication addressed to the Director General by an intergovernmental industrial property organization and including the said declaration
Translation:
1. 存储机构可通过缔约国向总干事提交书面通知而获得国际存储机构资格，该通知须声明该机构符合并将持续符合第六条规定的要求。该存储机构须位于该缔约国境内。

2. 此资格亦可由政府间工业产权组织向总干事提交书面通知并包含上述声明而获得。

Query_Text_en: b The communication shall also contain information on the depositary institution as provided in the Regulations and may indicate the date on which the status of international depositary authority should take effect
Translation: 该通知还应包含法规规定的保管机构信息，并可注明国际保管机构资格生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: 2 a If the Director General finds that the communication includes the required declaration and that all the required information has been received , the communication shall be promptly published by the International Bureau
Translation: 2 a 如果总干事认定该通报包含所需声明且所有必要信息均已收到，国际局应当及时予以公布。

Query_Text_en: b The status of international depositary authority shall be acquired as from the date of publication of the communication or , where a date has been indicated under paragraph 1 b and such date is later than the date of publication of the communication , as from such date
Translation: 国际保管机构的地位自公告发布之日起取得；如根据第1款b项指明了日期且该日期晚于公告发布之日，则自该日期取得该地位。

Query_Text_en: 3 The details of the procedure under paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 are provided in the Regulations
Translation: 第1款和第2款所述程序的具体细节在相关法规中予以规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 a Any Contracting State or any intergovernmental industrial property organization may request the Assembly to terminate , or to limit to certain kinds of microorganisms , any authority 's status of international depositary authority on the ground that the requirements specified in Article 6 have not been or are no longer complied with However , such a request may not be made by a Contracting State or intergovernmental industrial property organization in respect of an international depositary authority for which it has made the declaration referred to in Article 7 1 a
Translation: 任何缔约国或任何政府间工业产权组织均可请求大会终止或限制某一机构作为国际保藏机构的资格，仅限于某些类型的微生物，理由是该机构未能或不再符合第六条规定的要求。然而，对于其已根据第七条第一款（a）作出声明的国际保藏机构，缔约国或政府间工业产权组织不得提出此类请求。

Query_Text_en: b Before making the request under subparagraph a , the Contracting State or the intergovernmental industrial property organization shall , through the intermediary of the Director General , notify the reasons for the proposed request to the Contracting State or the intergovernmental industrial property organization which has made the communication referred to in Article 7 1 so that that State or organization may , within six months from the date of the said notification , take appropriate action to obviate the need for making the proposed request
Translation: 在根据a项提出请求之前，缔约国或政府间工业产权组织应通过总干事向已根据第7条第1款作出通报的缔约国或政府间工业产权组织通知拟提出请求的理由，以便该国或组织自收到该通知之日起六个月内采取适当措施，避免提出该请求的必要。

Query_Text_en: c Where the Assembly finds that the request is well founded , it shall decide to terminate , or to limit to certain kinds of microorganisms , the status of international depositary authority of the authority referred to in subparagraph a The decision of the Assembly shall require that a majority of two thirds of the votes cast be in favor of the request
Translation: c. 如果大会认定该请求理由充分，应决定终止或将所述机构作为国际保藏机构的资格限定于某些特定类型的微生物。大会的决定须经投票所获赞成票达到三分之二多数方可通过。

Query_Text_en: 2 a The Contracting State or intergovernmental industrial property organization having made the declaration referred to in Article 7 1 a may , by a communication addressed to the Director General , withdraw its declaration either entirely or in respect only of certain kinds of microorganisms and in any event shall do so when and to the extent that its assurances are no longer applicable
Translation: 2 a 已作出第7条第1款a项所述声明的缔约国或政府间工业产权组织，可以通过向总干事发出通知，全部或仅针对某些类型的微生物撤回其声明；无论如何，在其承诺不再适用时，应当撤回声明，并且撤回的范围应与承诺不再适用的程度相一致。

Query_Text_en: b Such a communication shall , from the date provided for in the Regulations , entail , where it relates to the entire declaration , the termination of the status of international depositary authority or , where it relates only to certain kinds of microorganisms , a corresponding limitation of such status
Translation: 自条例规定的日期起，此类通知若涉及整个声明，将导致国际保管机构资格的终止；若仅涉及某些类型的微生物，则相应限制该资格。

Query_Text_en: 3 The details of the procedure under paragraph l and paragraph 2 are provided in the Regulations
Translation: 第1款和第2款所涉程序的具体细节已在相关条例中作出规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 a Any intergovernmental organization to which several States have entrusted the task of granting regional patents and of which all the member States are members of the International Paris Union for the Protection of Industrial Property may file with the Director General a declaration that it accepts the obligation of recognition provided for in Article 3 1 a , the obligation concerning the requirements referred to in Article 3 2 and all the effects of the provisions of this Treaty and the Regulations applicable to intergovernmental industrial property organizations If filed before the entry into force of this Treaty according to Article 16 1 , the declaration referred to in the preceding sentence shall become effective on the date of the said entry into force If filed after such entry into force , the said declaration shall become effective three months after its filing unless a later date has been indicated in the declaration In the latter case , the declaration shall take effect on the date thus indicated
Translation: 任何由多个国家授权负责授予区域性专利的政府间组织，且其所有成员国均为《巴黎公约》国际联盟成员国，可以向总干事提交声明，表示接受本条约第3条第1款a项规定的认可义务、第3条第2款所述要求的相关义务，以及本条约和适用于政府间工业产权组织的规章所规定的全部效力。如果该声明在根据第16条第1款本条约生效之前提交，则声明自本条约生效之日起生效；如在本条约生效之后提交，则声明自提交之日起三个月后生效，除非声明中另行注明生效日期。在后一种情况下，声明自所注明的日期起生效。

Query_Text_en: b The said organization shall have the right provided for in Article 3 1 b
Translation: 该组织应享有《第3条第1款b项》规定的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 Where any provision of this Treaty or of the Regulations affecting intergovernmental industrial property organizations is revised or amended , any intergovernmental industrial property organization may withdraw its declaration referred to in paragraph 1 by notification addressed to the Director General The withdrawal shall take effect :
Translation: 凡本条约或规章中涉及政府间工业产权组织的任何条款被修订或修改时，任何政府间工业产权组织均可通过向总干事发出通知，撤回其根据第1款作出的声明。撤回自以下时间起生效：

Query_Text_en: ii where the notification has been received after the date referred to in i , on the date indicated in the notification or , in the absence of such indication , three months after the date on which the notification was received
Translation: ii 如果通知是在第i项所述日期之后收到的，则以通知中注明的日期为准；如未注明日期，则以收到通知之日起三个月后为准。

Query_Text_en: 3 In addition to the case referred to in paragraph 2 , any intergovernmental industrial property organization may withdraw its declaration referred to in paragraph 1 a by notification addressed to the Director General The withdrawal shall take effect two years after the date on which the Director General has received the notification No notification of withdrawal under this paragraph shall be receivable during a period of five years from the date on which the declaration took effect
Translation: 3 除第2款所述情形外，任何政府间工业产权组织均可通过向总干事发出通知，撤回其根据第1款a项作出的声明。撤回自总干事收到通知之日起两年后生效。在声明生效之日起五年内，不得根据本款提交撤回通知。

Query_Text_en: 4 The withdrawal referred to in paragraph 2 and paragraph 3 by an intergovernmental industrial property organization whose communication under Article 7 1 has led to the acquisition of the status of international depositary authority by a depositary institution shall entail the termination of such status one year after the date on which the Director General has received the notification of withdrawal
Translation: 4. 第2款和第3款所指的撤回，由根据第7条第1款的通知使保藏机构获得国际保藏机构资格的政府间工业产权组织提出时，该撤回应导致该保藏机构的国际保藏机构资格自总干事收到撤回通知之日起一年后终止。

Query_Text_en: 5 Any declaration referred to in paragraph 1 a , notification of withdrawal referred to in paragraph 2 or paragraph 3 , assurances furnished under Article 6 1 , second sentence , and included in a declaration made in accordance with Article 7 1 a , request made under Article 8 1 and communication of withdrawal referred to in Article 8 2 shall require the express previous approval of the supreme governing organ of the intergovernmental industrial property organization whose members are all the States members of the said organization and in which decisions are made by the official representatives of the governments of such States
Translation: 凡第1款a项所述的任何声明、第2款或第3款所述的退出通知、根据第6条第1款第二句提供的保证并包含在根据第7条第1款a项作出的声明中、根据第8条第1款提出的请求以及根据第8条第2款所述的退出通知，均须经该政府间工业产权组织最高管理机构的明确事先批准。该组织的成员均为上述组织的成员国，并且决策由这些国家政府的正式代表作出。

Query_Text_en: 1 a The Assembly shall consist of the Contracting States
Translation: 1 a 大会由缔约国组成。

Query_Text_en: b Each Contracting State shall be represented by one delegate , who may be assisted by alternate delegates , advisors , and experts
Translation: 每一缔约国应由一名代表出席，并可由候补代表、顾问及专家协助。

Query_Text_en: c Each intergovernmental industrial property organization shall be represented by special observers in the meetings of the Assembly and any committee and working group established by the Assembly
Translation: 每个政府间工业产权组织应由特别观察员代表，出席大会及大会设立的任何委员会和工作组的会议。

Query_Text_en: d Any State not member of the Union which is a member of the Organization or of the International Paris Union for the Protection of Industrial Property and any intergovernmental organization specialized in the field of patents other than an intergovernmental industrial property organization as defined in Article 2 v may be represented by observers in the meetings of the Assembly and , if the Assembly so decides , in the meetings of any committee or working group established by the Assembly
Translation: 任何不是本联盟成员的国家，但属于本组织或国际巴黎工业产权保护联盟成员，以及任何专门从事专利领域的政府间组织（但不包括第2条第v款所定义的政府间工业产权组织），均可由观察员代表出席大会会议，并在大会决定的情况下，出席大会设立的任何委员会或工作组的会议。

Query_Text_en: viii perform such other functions as are appropriate under this Treaty
Translation: 八、履行本条约规定的其他适当职能。

Query_Text_en: 3 A delegate may represent , and vote in the name of , one State only
Translation: 3 代表只能代表一个国家，并以该国的名义进行投票。

Query_Text_en: 4 Each Contracting State shall have one vote
Translation: 4 每一缔约国应有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: 5 a Onehalf of the Contracting States shall constitute a quorum
Translation: 五、合同国的一半构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: b In the absence of the quorum , the Assembly may make decisions but , with the exception of decisions concerning its own procedure , all such decisions shall take effect only if the quorum and the required majority are attained through voting by correspondence as provided in the Regulations
Translation: 在未达到法定人数的情况下，大会可以作出决定，但除涉及本身议事程序的决定外，所有此类决定仅在通过章程规定的通讯投票达到法定人数和所需多数时方可生效。

Query_Text_en: 6 a Subject to Article 8 1 c and Article 12 4 and Article 14 2 b , the decisions of the Assembly shall require a majority of the votes cast
Translation: 在遵守第8条第1款(c)、第12条第4款和第14条第2款(b)的前提下，大会的决定须经所投票数的多数通过。

Query_Text_en: b Abstentions shall not be considered as votes
Translation: b 弃权票不计入表决结果

Query_Text_en: 7 a The Assembly shall meet once in every second calendar year in ordinary session upon convocation by the Director General , preferably during the same period and at the same place as the General Assembly of the Organization
Translation: 7 a 大会应由总干事召集，每两年召开一次例行会议，最好与本组织大会在同一时期、同一地点举行。

Query_Text_en: b The Assembly shall meet in extraordinary session upon convocation by the Director General , either on his own initiative or at the request of onefourth of the Contracting States
Translation: b 大会应由总干事召集举行特别会议，召集可由总干事自行决定，或应四分之一缔约国的请求而为之。

Query_Text_en: 8 The Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure
Translation: 大会应制定自己的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: ii provide the secretariat of revision conferences , of the Assembly , of committees and working groups established by the Assembly , and of any other meeting convened by the Director General and dealing with matters of concern to the Union
Translation: 二、为修订会议、全体大会、由大会设立的委员会和工作组，以及由总干事召集并涉及联盟事务的其他会议提供秘书处服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Director General shall be the chief executive of the Union and shall represent the Union
Translation: 总干事为联盟的首席执行官，并代表联盟行

Query_Text_en: 3 The Director General shall convene all meetings dealing with matters of concern to the Union
Translation: 总干事应召集所有涉及联盟事务的会议。

Query_Text_en: 4 a The Director General and any staff member designated by him shall participate , without the right to vote , in all meetings of the Assembly , the committees and working groups established by the Assembly , and any other meeting convened by the Director General and dealing with matters of concern to the Union
Translation: 4 a 总干事及其指定的任何工作人员应参加大会、由大会设立的委员会和工作组，以及由总干事召集并涉及联盟事务的任何其他会议，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: b The Director General , or a staff member designated by him , shall be ex officio secretary of the Assembly , and of the committees , working groups and other meetings referred to in subparagraph a
Translation: 总干事或其指定的工作人员应当当然担任大会及第a项所述委员会、工作组和其他会议的秘书。

Query_Text_en: 5 a The Director General shall , in accordance with the directions of the Assembly , make the preparations for revision conferences
Translation: 5 a 总干事应按照大会的指示，为修订会议做好准备。

Query_Text_en: b The Director General may consult with intergovernmental and international nongovernmental organizations concerning the preparations for revision conferences
Translation: 总干事可就修订会议的筹备工作与政府间组织和国际非政府组织进行协商。

Query_Text_en: c The Director General and persons designated by him shall take part , without the right to vote , in the discussions at revision conferences
Translation: 总干事及其指定人员应参加修订会议的讨论，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: d The Director General , or a staff member designated by him , shall be ex officio secretary of any revision conference
Translation: 总干事或其指定的工作人员应当当然担任任何修订会议的秘书。

Query_Text_en: iii any details useful in the implementation of this Treaty
Translation: iii 本条约实施所需的任何有用细节

Query_Text_en: 2 The Regulations adopted at the same time as this Treaty are annexed to this Treaty
Translation: 2 与本条约同时通过的条例作为附件附于本条约之后。

Query_Text_en: 3 The Assembly may amend the Regulations
Translation: 大会可对条例进行修订

Query_Text_en: 4 a Subject to subparagraph b , adoption of any amendment of the Regulations shall require twothirds of the votes cast
Translation: 4 a 除非第b项另有规定，对本条例的任何修订须经投票总数三分之二通过方可采纳。

Query_Text_en: b Adoption of any amendment concerning the furnishing of samples of deposited microorganisms by the international depositary authorities shall require that no Contracting State vote against the proposed amendment
Translation: 关于国际保藏机构提供已存微生物样品的任何修正案，须确保没有任何缔约国投反对票，方可通过。

Query_Text_en: 5 In the case of conflict between the provisions of this Treaty and these of the Regulations , the provisions of this Treaty shall prevail
Translation: 如本条约的规定与规章的规定发生冲突，应以本条约的规定为准。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Treaty may be revised from time to time by conferences of the Contracting States
Translation: 本条约可由缔约国会议不时修订。

Query_Text_en: 2 The convocation of any revision conference shall be decided by the Assembly
Translation: 2 任何修订会议的召开应由大会决定。

Query_Text_en: 3 Article 10 and Article 11 may be amended either by a revision conference or according to Article 14
Translation: 第10条和第11条可以通过修订会议或依照第14条进行修改。

Query_Text_en: 1 a Proposals under this Article for the amendment of Article 10 and Article 11 may be initiated by any Contracting State or by the Director General
Translation: 根据本条提出对第10条和第11条的修正建议，可由任何缔约国或总干事提出。

Query_Text_en: b Such proposals shall be communicated by the Director General to the Contracting States at least six months in advance of their consideration by the Assembly
Translation: 此类提案须由总干事在大会审议前至少六个月通知缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 2 a Amendments to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall be adopted by the Assembly
Translation: 第2条第a款：对第1款所述条款的修正案应由大会通过。

Query_Text_en: adoption of any amendment to Article 11 shall require threefourths of the votes cast
Translation: 对第11条的任何修正案的通过须经投票总数的四分之三赞成。

Query_Text_en: 3 a Any amendment to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall enter into force one month after written notifications of acceptance , effected in accordance with their respective constitutional processes , have been received by the Director General from threefourths of the Contracting States members of the Assembly at the time the Assembly adopted the amendment
Translation: 对第1款所述条款的任何修正案，在大会通过修正案时属于大会成员的缔约国中，四分之三的国家按照各自的宪法程序完成书面接受通知，并由总干事收到后，一个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: b Any amendment to the said Articles thus accepted shall bind all the Contracting States which were Contracting States at the time the amendment was adopted by the Assembly , provided that any amendment creating financial obligations for the said Contracting States or increasing such obligations shall bind only those Contracting States which have notified their acceptance of such amendment
Translation: 任何经大会通过的上述条款修正案，均对通过修正案时为缔约国的所有缔约国具有约束力；但凡涉及为上述缔约国增加财务义务或加重现有财务义务的修正案，仅对已通知接受该修正案的缔约国具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: c Any amendment which has been accepted and which has entered into force in accordance with subparagraph a shall bind all States which become Contracting States after the date on which the amendment was adopted by the Assembly
Translation: 任何已被接受并根据a项规定生效的修正案，对在大会通过该修正案之后成为缔约国的所有国家均具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: i signature followed by the deposit of an instrument of ratification , or ii deposit of an instrument of accession
Translation:
一、签署后交存批准书，或  
二、交存加入书

Query_Text_en: 2 Instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Director General
Translation: 2. 批准书或加入书应提交总干事。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Treaty shall enter into force , with respect to the first five States which have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession , three months after the date on which the fifth instrument of ratification or accession has been deposited
Translation: 本条约自第五份批准书或加入书交存之日起三个月后，对最先交存批准书或加入书的五个国家生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 This Treaty shall enter into force with respect to any other State three months after the date on which that State has deposited its instrument of ratification or accession unless a later date has been indicated in the instrument of ratification or accession In the latter case , this Treaty shall enter into force with respect to that State on the date thus indicated
Translation: 本条约对任何其他国家的生效日期为该国交存批准书或加入书之日起三个月后，除非该批准书或加入书中另有注明较晚的日期。在后一种情况下，本条约自该国所注明的日期起对其生效。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any Contracting State may denounce this Treaty by notification addressed to the Director General
Translation: 任何缔约国均可向总干事发出通知，宣布退出本条约。

Query_Text_en: 2 Denunciation shall take effect two years after the day on which the Director General has received the notification
Translation: 2. 退出声明自总干事收到通知之日起两年后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 The right of denunciation provided for in paragraph 1 shall not be exercised by any Contracting State before the expiration of five years from the date on which it becomes party to this Treaty
Translation: 任何缔约国在成为本条约缔约方之日起满五年之前，不得行使第一款规定的退出权。

Query_Text_en: 4 The denunciation of this Treaty by a Contracting State that has made a declaration referred to in Article 7 1 a with respect to a depositary institution which thus acquired the status of international depositary authority shall entail the termination of such status one year after the day on which the Director General received the notification referred to in paragraph 1
Translation: 4 一缔约国如根据第7条第1款(a)项对某保管机构作出声明，使其获得国际保管机构地位后，又宣布退出本条约，则自总干事收到第1款所述通知之日起一年后，该机构的国际保管机构地位即告终止。

Query_Text_en: 1 a This Treaty shall be signed in a single original in the English and French languages , both texts being equally authentic
Translation: 本条约应以英文和法文各一份正本签署，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: b Official texts of this Treaty shall be established by the Director General , after consultation with the interested Governments and within two months from the date of signature of this Treaty , in the other languages in which the Convention Establishing the World Intellectual Property Organization was signed
Translation: 本条约的正式文本，应由总干事在与有关政府协商后，并自本条约签署之日起两个月内，以《建立世界知识产权组织公约》签署时所用的其他语言制定。

Query_Text_en: c Official texts of this Treaty shall be established by the Director General , after consultation with the interested Governments , in the Arabic , German , Italian , Japanese and Portuguese languages , and such other languages as the Assembly may designate
Translation: 本条约的正式文本应由总干事在与相关政府协商后，以阿拉伯语、德语、意大利语、日语和葡萄牙语，以及大会指定的其他语言制定。

Query_Text_en: 2 This Treaty shall remain open for signature at Budapest until December 31,1977
Translation: 本条约自签署之日起至1977年12月31日止，在布达佩斯开放供签署。

Query_Text_en: 1 The original of this Treaty , when no longer open for signature , shall be deposited with the Director General
Translation: 本条约原件在停止开放签署后，应由总干事保存。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Director General shall transmit two copies , certified by him , of this Treaty and the Regulations to the Governments of all the States referred to in Article 15 1 , to the intergovernmental organizations that may file a declaration under Article 9 1 a and , on request , to the Government of any other State
Translation: 总干事应将本条约及其规章的两份经其认证的副本，发送给第15条第1款所述所有国家的政府、可根据第9条第1款（a）提交声明的政府间组织，并根据请求，发送给任何其他国家的政府。

Query_Text_en: 3 The Director General shall register this Treaty with the Secretariat of the United Nations
Translation: 3. 总干事应将本条约在联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: 4 The Director General shall transmit two copies , certified by him , of any amendment to this Treaty and to the Regulations to all Contracting States , to all intergovernmental industrial property organizations and , on request , to the Government of any other State and to any other intergovernmental organization that may file a declaration under Article 9 1 a
Translation: 总干事应将本条约及其规章的任何修正案，经其认证后，向所有缔约国、所有政府间工业产权组织各发送两份，并应请求，向任何其他国家政府以及根据第9条第1款(a)项可提交声明的任何其他政府间组织发送两份。

Query_Text_en: ix denunciations received under Article 17
Translation: 根据第17条收到的六项举报

Query_Text_en: ? Article 1 PurposeThe purpose of the present Convention is to promote , protect and ensure the full and equal enjoyment of all human rights and fundamental freedoms by all persons with disabilities , and to promote respect for their inherent dignity .
Translation:
第一条 目的

本公约的目的是促进、保护和确保所有残疾人充分和平等地享有一切人权和基本自由，并促进对其固有尊严的尊重。

Query_Text_en: Persons with disabilities include those who have long-term physical , mental , intellectual or sensory impairments which in interaction with various barriers may hinder their full and effective participation in society on an equal basis with others .
Translation: 残疾人是指那些具有长期的身体、精神、智力或感官障碍，并因与各种障碍因素的相互作用，可能妨碍其平等参与社会生活、充分发挥作用的人士。

Query_Text_en: `` Discrimination on the basis of disability '' means any distinction , exclusion or restriction on the basis of disability which has the purpose or effect of impairing or nullifying the recognition , enjoyment or exercise , on an equal basis with others , of all human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political , economic , social , cultural , civil or any other field .
Translation: “基于残疾的歧视”是指任何以残疾为理由的区别、排斥或限制，其目的或结果是妨碍或否定残疾人在政治、经济、社会、文化、民事或其他领域中，平等享有或行使所有人权和基本自由。

Query_Text_en: `` Universal design '' means the design of products , environments , programs and services to be usable by all people , to the greatest extent possible , without the need for adaptation or specialized design .
Translation: “无障碍设计”是指在最大程度上使所有人都能使用的产品、环境、项目和服务的设计，无需进行适应性调整或专门设计。

Query_Text_en: `` Universal design '' shall not exclude assistive devices for particular groups of persons with disabilities where this is needed .
Translation: “普遍设计”并不排除在必要时为特定残障群体提供辅助设备。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] Respect for the evolving capacities of children with disabilities and respect for the right of children with disabilities to preserve their identities .
Translation: 尊重残疾儿童不断发展的能力，尊重残疾儿童保持其自身身份的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties undertake to ensure and promote the full realization of all human rights and fundamental freedoms for all persons with disabilities without discrimination of any kind on the basis of disability .
Translation: 缔约国承诺确保并促进所有残疾人充分享有一切人权和基本自由，不因残疾而受到任何形式的歧视。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] To promote the training of professionals and staff working with persons with disabilities in the rights recognized in this Convention so as to better provide the assistance and services guaranteed by those rights .
Translation: 促进对从事残疾人工作的专业人员和工作人员进行本公约所承认权利的培训，以更好地提供这些权利所保障的援助和服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . With regard to economic , social and cultural rights , each State Party undertakes to take measures to the maximum of its available resources and , where needed , within the framework of international cooperation , with a view to achieving progressively the full realization of these rights , without prejudice to those obligations contained in the present Convention that are immediately applicable according to international law .
Translation: 2. 关于经济、社会和文化权利，每一缔约国承诺在其可用资源的最大范围内，并在必要时在国际合作框架内，采取措施，旨在逐步实现这些权利的充分实现，同时不影响本公约中根据国际法应立即适用的义务。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the development and implementation of legislation and policies to implement the present Convention , and in other decision-making processes concerning issues relating to persons with disabilities , States Parties shall closely consult with and actively involve persons with disabilities , including children with disabilities , through their representative organizations .
Translation: 在制定和实施本公约相关立法和政策，以及在涉及残疾人事务的其他决策过程中，缔约国应通过其代表性组织，密切协商并积极让残疾人，包括残疾儿童，参与相关工作。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Nothing in the present Convention shall affect any provisions which are more conducive to the realization of the rights of persons with disabilities and which may be contained in the law of a State Party or international law in force for that State .
Translation: 4. 本公约的任何规定不得影响缔约国法律或对该国现行的国际法中任何更有利于实现残疾人权利的条款。

Query_Text_en: There shall be no restriction upon or derogation from any of the human rights and fundamental freedoms recognized or existing in any State Party to the present Convention pursuant to law , conventions , regulation or custom on the pretext that the present Convention does not recognize such rights or freedoms or that it recognizes them to a lesser extent .
Translation: 任何缔约国不得以本公约未承认某项人权或基本自由，或承认程度较低为由，对其根据法律、惯例、规章或习惯所认可或现有的人权和基本自由加以限制或削弱。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of the present Convention shall extend to all parts of federal states without any limitations or exceptions .
Translation: 5. 本公约的规定应在联邦制国家的所有地区无任何限制或例外地适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties recognize that all persons are equal before and under the law and are entitled without any discrimination to the equal protection and equal benefit of the law .
Translation: 缔约国承认，所有人在法律面前及法律之下均一律平等，并有权在无任何歧视的情况下，享受法律的平等保护和平等利益。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall prohibit all discrimination on the basis of disability and guarantee to persons with disabilities equal and effective legal protection against discrimination on all grounds .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应禁止一切基于残疾的歧视，并保障残疾人获得平等且有效的法律保护，防止任何理由的歧视。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In order to promote equality and eliminate discrimination , States Parties shall take all appropriate steps to ensure that reasonable accommodation is provided .
Translation: 3. 为促进平等并消除歧视，缔约国应采取一切适当措施，确保提供合理便利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Specific measures which are necessary to accelerate or achieve de facto equality of persons with disabilities shall not be considered discrimination under the terms of the present Convention .
Translation: 为加速实现或实际实现残疾人平等所采取的具体措施，不应被视为本公约项下的歧视。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties recognize that women and girls with disabilities are subject to multiple discrimination , and in this regard shall take measures to ensure the full and equal enjoyment by them of all human rights and fundamental freedoms .
Translation: 缔约国承认残疾妇女和女孩面临多重歧视，并应采取措施，确保她们充分平等地享有所有人权和基本自由。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to ensure the full development , advancement and empowerment of women , for the purpose of guaranteeing them the exercise and enjoyment of the human rights and fundamental freedoms set out in the present Convention .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应采取一切适当措施，确保妇女的全面发展、进步和赋权，以保障她们能够行使和享有本公约所规定的人权和基本自由。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties shall take all necessary measures to ensure the full enjoyment by children with disabilities of all human rights and fundamental freedoms on an equal basis with other children .
Translation: 缔约国应采取一切必要措施，确保残障儿童能够平等于其他儿童，充分享有所有人权和基本自由。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In all actions concerning children with disabilities , the best interests of the child shall be a primary consideration .
Translation: 在涉及残障儿童的所有事务中，应将儿童的最大利益作为首要考虑。

Query_Text_en: 3 . States Parties shall ensure that children with disabilities have the right to express their views freely on all matters affecting them , their views being given due weight in accordance with their age and maturity , on an equal basis with other children , and to be provided with disability and age-appropriate assistance to realize that right .
Translation: 3. 缔约国应确保残障儿童在所有影响其自身事务中享有自由表达意见的权利，其意见应根据其年龄和成熟程度予以充分重视，并与其他儿童享有平等权利。同时，应为他们提供与残障状况和年龄相适应的协助，以实现这一权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] To promote awareness of the capabilities and contributions of persons with disabilities .
Translation: [3] 提高对残疾人能力和贡献的认识。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Promoting awareness-training programs regarding persons with disabilities and the rights of persons with disabilities .
Translation: [4] 推广关于残疾人及其权利的宣传与培训项目。

Query_Text_en: 1 . To enable persons with disabilities to live independently and participate fully in all aspects of life , States Parties shall take appropriate measures to ensure to persons with disabilities access , on an equal basis with others , to the physical environment , to transportation , to information and communications , including information and communications technologies and systems , and to other facilities and services open or provided to the public , both in urban and in rural areas .
Translation: 1. 为使残疾人能够独立生活并充分参与社会生活的各个方面，缔约国应采取适当措施，确保残疾人在与他人平等的基础上，能够无障碍地进入和使用物理环境、交通运输、信息与通信（包括信息与通信技术及系统）以及城市和农村地区向公众开放或提供的其他设施和服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Information , communications and other services , including electronic services and emergency services .
Translation: [2] 信息、通信及其他服务，包括电子服务和应急服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] Promote the design , development , production and distribution of accessible information and communications technologies and systems at an early stage , so that these technologies and systems become accessible at minimum cost .
Translation: 促进信息与通信技术及系统在早期阶段的无障碍设计、开发、生产和分发，使这些技术和系统能够以最低成本实现无障碍。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 10 Right to lifeStates Parties reaffirm that every human being has the inherent right to life and shall take all necessary measures to ensure its effective enjoyment by persons with disabilities on an equal basis with others .
Translation:
第十条 生命权

缔约国重申每个人都享有与生俱来的生命权，并应采取一切必要措施，确保残疾人能够与他人平等地切实享有这一权利。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 11 Situations of risk and humanitarian emergenciesStates Parties shall take , in accordance with their obligations under international law , including international humanitarian law and international human rights law , all necessary measures to ensure the protection and safety of persons with disabilities in situations of risk , including situations of armed conflict , humanitarian emergencies and the occurrence of natural disasters .
Translation:
第十一条 风险情境与人道主义紧急状况

缔约国应根据其在国际法，包括国际人道主义法和国际人权法下的义务，采取一切必要措施，确保在风险情境下，包括武装冲突、人道主义紧急状况和自然灾害发生时，残疾人的保护与安全。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties reaffirm that persons with disabilities have the right to recognition everywhere as persons before the law .
Translation: 缔约国重申，残疾人有权在任何地方被承认为法律上的人格。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall recognize that persons with disabilities enjoy legal capacity on an equal basis with others in all aspects of life .
Translation: 缔约国应承认，残疾人在生活的各个方面与其他人享有平等的法律能力。

Query_Text_en: 3 . States Parties shall take appropriate measures to provide access by persons with disabilities to the support they may require in exercising their legal capacity .
Translation: 3. 缔约国应采取适当措施，确保残疾人在行使其法律能力时能够获得所需的支持。

Query_Text_en: 4 . States Parties shall ensure that all measures that relate to the exercise of legal capacity provide for appropriate and effective safeguards to prevent abuse in accordance with international human rights law .
Translation: 4. 缔约国应确保所有涉及行使法律能力的措施，均根据国际人权法规定，设有适当且有效的保障措施，以防止滥用。

Query_Text_en: Such safeguards shall ensure that measures relating to the exercise of legal capacity respect the rights , will and preferences of the person , are free of conflict of interest and undue influence , are proportional and tailored to the person 's circumstances , apply for the shortest time possible and are subject to regular review by a competent , independent and impartial authority or judicial body .
Translation: 此类保障措施应确保与法律行为能力行使相关的措施尊重个人的权利、意愿和偏好，不受利益冲突和不当影响，具有相称性并根据个人情况量身定制，适用时间尽可能短，并由有能力、独立且公正的权威或司法机构定期审查。

Query_Text_en: The safeguards shall be proportional to the degree to which such measures affect the person 's rights and interests .
Translation: 相关保障措施应与该措施对个人权利和利益的影响程度相适应。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Subject to the provisions of this article , States Parties shall take all appropriate and effective measures to ensure the equal right of persons with disabilities to own or inherit property , to control their own financial affairs and to have equal access to bank loans , mortgages and other forms of financial credit , and shall ensure that persons with disabilities are not arbitrarily deprived of their property .
Translation: 5. 在本条规定的前提下，缔约国应采取一切适当且有效的措施，确保残疾人享有平等的权利，包括拥有或继承财产、管理自身财务事务，以及平等获得银行贷款、抵押和其他形式的金融信贷，并应确保残疾人不被任意剥夺其财产。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties shall ensure effective access to justice for persons with disabilities on an equal basis with others , including through the provision of procedural and age-appropriate accommodations , in order to facilitate their effective role as direct and indirect participants , including as witnesses , in all legal proceedings , including at investigative and other preliminary stages .
Translation: 1. 缔约国应确保残疾人能够平等有效地获得司法救济，包括通过提供程序性和适龄的便利措施，以便在所有法律程序中，包括调查及其他初步阶段，促进他们作为直接或间接参与者（包括证人）发挥有效作用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In order to help to ensure effective access to justice for persons with disabilities , States Parties shall promote appropriate training for those working in the field of administration of justice , including police and prison staff .
Translation: 2. 为确保残疾人能够有效获得司法救助，缔约国应推动为司法行政领域工作人员，包括警察和监狱人员，提供适当的培训。

Query_Text_en: Are not deprived of their liberty unlawfully or arbitrarily , and that any deprivation of liberty is in conformity with the law , and that the existence of a disability shall in no case justify a deprivation of liberty .
Translation: 不得被非法或任意剥夺人身自由，任何对人身自由的剥夺都必须符合法律规定，残疾的存在在任何情况下都不得成为剥夺人身自由的理由。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall ensure that if persons with disabilities are deprived of their liberty through any process , they are , on an equal basis with others , entitled to guarantees in accordance with international human rights law and shall be treated in compliance with the objectives and principles of this Convention , including by provision of reasonable accommodation .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应确保，残疾人在任何程序下被剥夺人身自由时，能够在与其他人平等的基础上，享有符合国际人权法的保障，并应根据本公约的宗旨和原则予以对待，包括提供合理便利。

Query_Text_en: 1 . No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel , inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment .
Translation: 任何人不得遭受酷刑或残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或惩罚。

Query_Text_en: In particular , no one shall be subjected without his or her free consent to medical or scientific experimentation .
Translation: 特别是，任何人未经其自由同意，不得被强制进行医学或科学实验。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall take all effective legislative , administrative , judicial or other measures to prevent persons with disabilities , on an equal basis with others , from being subjected to torture or cruel , inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应采取一切有效的立法、行政、司法或其他措施，防止残疾人在平等基础上遭受酷刑或残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或惩罚。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties shall take all appropriate legislative , administrative , social , educational and other measures to protect persons with disabilities , both within and outside the home , from all forms of exploitation , violence and abuse , including their gender-based aspects .
Translation: 缔约国应采取一切适当的立法、行政、社会、教育及其他措施，保护残疾人在家庭内外免受各种形式的剥削、暴力和虐待，包括基于性别的相关内容。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall also take all appropriate measures to prevent all forms of exploitation , violence and abuse by ensuring , inter alia , appropriate forms of gender - and age-sensitive assistance and support for persons with disabilities and their families and caregivers , including through the provision of information and education on how to avoid , recognize and report instances of exploitation , violence and abuse .
Translation: 2. 缔约国还应采取一切适当措施，防止一切形式的剥削、暴力和虐待，包括但不限于为残疾人及其家庭和照护者提供适合性别和年龄特点的援助与支持，并通过提供有关如何避免、识别和报告剥削、暴力和虐待行为的信息和教育，实现上述目标。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall ensure that protection services are age - , gender - and disability-sensitive .
Translation: 缔约国应确保保护服务充分考虑年龄、性别和残疾等因素。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In order to prevent the occurrence of all forms of exploitation , violence and abuse , States Parties shall ensure that all facilities and programs designed to serve persons with disabilities are effectively monitored by independent authorities .
Translation: 3. 为防止各种形式的剥削、暴力和虐待，缔约国应确保所有为残疾人服务的设施和项目均由独立机构进行有效监督。

Query_Text_en: 4 . States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to promote the physical , cognitive and psychological recovery , rehabilitation and social reintegration of persons with disabilities who become victims of any form of exploitation , violence or abuse , including through the provision of protection services .
Translation: 4. 缔约国应采取一切适当措施，促进因遭受任何形式的剥削、暴力或虐待而成为受害者的残疾人在身体、认知和心理方面的恢复、康复及社会融入，包括通过提供保护服务。

Query_Text_en: Such recovery and reintegration shall take place in an environment that fosters the health , welfare , self-respect , dignity and autonomy of the person and takes into account gender - and age-specific needs .
Translation: 此类康复和重新融入应在有利于个人健康、福祉、自尊、尊严和自主的环境中进行，并充分考虑性别和年龄的特殊需求。

Query_Text_en: 5 . States Parties shall put in place effective legislation and policies , including women - and child-focused legislation and policies , to ensure that instances of exploitation , violence and abuse against persons with disabilities are identified , investigated and , where appropriate , prosecuted .
Translation: 5. 缔约国应制定有效的法律和政策，包括以妇女和儿童为重点的法律和政策，以确保对残疾人遭受剥削、暴力和虐待的情况能够被及时发现、调查，并在适当情况下予以起诉。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 17 Protecting the integrity of the personEvery person with disabilities has a right to respect for his or her physical and mental integrity on an equal basis with others .
Translation:
第十七条 保护人的完整性

每个残疾人都有权在与他人平等的基础上，受到对其身心完整性的尊重。

Query_Text_en: Are not deprived , arbitrarily or on the basis of disability , of the right to enter their own country .
Translation: 不得因残疾或其他任意理由被剥夺进入本国的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Children with disabilities shall be registered immediately after birth and shall have the right from birth to a name , the right to acquire a nationality and , as far as possible , the right to know and be cared for by their parents .
Translation: 2. 残疾儿童应在出生后立即进行登记，自出生之日起享有姓名权、取得国籍的权利，并在可能的范围内，有权了解其父母并由其父母照料。

Query_Text_en: Community services and facilities for the general population are available on an equal basis to persons with disabilities and are responsive to their needs .
Translation: 面向普通公众的社区服务和设施对残疾人同样开放，并能够回应他们的需求。

Query_Text_en: Encouraging entities that produce mobility aids , devices and assistive technologies to take into account all aspects of mobility for persons with disabilities .
Translation: 鼓励生产助行器具、设备和辅助技术的相关实体全面考虑残疾人出行的各个方面。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing and promoting the use of sign languages .
Translation: 承认并推广手语的使用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . No person with disabilities , regardless of place of residence or living arrangements , shall be subjected to arbitrary or unlawful interference with his or her privacy , family , home or correspondence or other types of communication or to unlawful attacks on his or her honor and reputation .
Translation: 任何残疾人士，无论其居住地或生活安排如何，均不得遭受对其隐私、家庭、住所、通信或其他交流方式的任意或非法干涉，或对其名誉和声望的非法攻击。

Query_Text_en: Persons with disabilities have the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks .
Translation: 残疾人有权依法受到保护，免受此类干涉或攻击。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall protect the privacy of personal , health and rehabilitation information of persons with disabilities on an equal basis with others .
Translation: 缔约国应在与其他人平等的基础上，保护残疾人的个人、健康及康复信息的隐私。

Query_Text_en: Persons with disabilities , including children , retain their fertility on an equal basis with others .
Translation: 包括儿童在内的残障人士与其他人一样，享有平等的生育权。

Query_Text_en: in all cases the best interests of the child shall be paramount .
Translation: 在所有情况下，儿童的最佳利益应被置于首位。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall render appropriate assistance to persons with disabilities in the performance of their child-rearing responsibilities .
Translation: 缔约国应为残疾人在履行抚养子女责任方面提供适当的协助。

Query_Text_en: 3 . States Parties shall ensure that children with disabilities have equal rights with respect to family life .
Translation: 缔约国应确保残疾儿童在家庭生活方面享有平等权利。

Query_Text_en: With a view to realizing these rights , and to prevent concealment , abandonment , neglect and segregation of children with disabilities , States Parties shall undertake to provide early and comprehensive information , services and support to children with disabilities and their families .
Translation: 为实现这些权利，并防止对残疾儿童的隐瞒、遗弃、忽视和隔离，各缔约国应承诺为残疾儿童及其家庭提供及时、全面的信息、服务和支持。

Query_Text_en: 4 . States Parties shall ensure that a child shall not be separated from his or her parents against their will , except when competent authorities subject to judicial review determine , in accordance with applicable law and procedures , that such separation is necessary for the best interests of the child .
Translation: 4. 缔约国应确保，除非有权机关根据适用法律和程序，并经司法审查，认定为保障儿童最佳利益所必需，不得在未经儿童父母同意的情况下将其与父母分离。

Query_Text_en: In no case shall a child be separated from parents on the basis of a disability of either the child or one or both of the parents .
Translation: 任何情况下，不得仅因儿童或其父母一方或双方的残疾而将儿童与父母分离。

Query_Text_en: 5 . States Parties shall , where the immediate family is unable to care for a child with disabilities , undertake every effort to provide alternative care within the wider family , and failing that , within the community in a family setting .
Translation: 5. 缔约国应在残疾儿童的直系家庭无法照料其生活时，尽一切努力在更广泛的家庭范围内提供替代照护；如无法实现，则应在社区内以家庭式环境提供照护。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties recognize the right of persons with disabilities to education .
Translation: 缔约国承认残疾人享有受教育的权利。

Query_Text_en: Enabling persons with disabilities to participate effectively in a free society .
Translation: 让残疾人能够在自由社会中有效参与。

Query_Text_en: Effective individualized support measures are provided in environments that maximize academic and social development , consistent with the goal of full inclusion .
Translation: 有效的个性化支持措施应在最大限度促进学业和社会发展的环境中提供，这与全面融合的目标保持一致。

Query_Text_en: 3 . States Parties shall enable persons with disabilities to learn life and social development skills to facilitate their full and equal participation in education and as members of the community .
Translation: 3. 缔约国应当使残疾人能够学习生活技能和社会发展技能，以促进他们在教育领域以及作为社区成员的充分和平等参与。

Query_Text_en: Ensuring that the education of persons , and in particular children , who are blind , deaf or deafblind , is delivered in the most appropriate languages and modes and means of communication for the individual , and in environments which maximize academic and social development .
Translation: 确保对盲人、聋人及聋盲人士，尤其是儿童的教育，以最适合其个人的语言、交流方式和手段进行，并在能够最大程度促进其学业和社会发展的环境中开展。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In order to help ensure the realization of this right , States Parties shall take appropriate measures to employ teachers , including teachers with disabilities , who are qualified in sign language and\/or Braille , and to train professionals and staff who work at all levels of education .
Translation: 4. 为了帮助确保实现这一权利，缔约国应采取适当措施，聘用包括有残疾的教师在内的、具备手语和/或盲文资格的教师，并对在各级教育工作中的专业人员和工作人员进行培训。

Query_Text_en: Such training shall incorporate disability awareness and the use of appropriate augmentative and alternative modes , means and formats of communication , educational techniques and materials to support persons with disabilities .
Translation: 此类培训应包括残疾意识教育，以及适当的辅助和替代沟通方式、手段与形式，采用相应的教育方法和材料，以支持残疾人士。

Query_Text_en: 5 . States Parties shall ensure that persons with disabilities are able to access general tertiary education , vocational training , adult education and lifelong learning without discrimination and on an equal basis with others .
Translation: 5. 缔约国应确保残疾人能够无歧视、与他人平等地进入普通高等教育、职业培训、成人教育和终身学习。

Query_Text_en: To this end , States Parties shall ensure that reasonable accommodation is provided to persons with disabilities .
Translation: 为此，缔约国应确保为残疾人提供合理便利。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 25 HealthStates Parties recognize that persons with disabilities have the right to the enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health without discrimination on the basis of disability .
Translation:
第25条 健康

缔约国承认，残疾人有权在不因残疾而受到歧视的情况下，享有可达到的最高标准的健康。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall take all appropriate measures to ensure access for persons with disabilities to health services that are gender-sensitive , including health-related rehabilitation .
Translation: 缔约国应采取一切适当措施，确保残疾人能够获得性别敏感的卫生服务，包括与健康相关的康复服务。

Query_Text_en: Prevent discriminatory denial of health care or health services or food and fluids on the basis of disability .
Translation: 防止因残疾而歧视性地拒绝提供医疗保健、健康服务或食物和水。

Query_Text_en: 1 . States Parties shall take effective and appropriate measures , including through peer support , to enable persons with disabilities to attain and maintain maximum independence , full physical , mental , social and vocational ability , and full inclusion and participation in all aspects of life .
Translation: 缔约国应采取有效和适当的措施，包括通过同伴支持，帮助残疾人实现和保持最大程度的独立性、充分的身体、心理、社会和职业能力，以及在生活各个方面的全面融入和参与。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Support participation and inclusion in the community and all aspects of society , are voluntary , and are available to persons with disabilities as close as possible to their own communities , including in rural areas .
Translation: [2] 支持残疾人参与和融入社区及社会各领域，确保这些活动是自愿的，并尽可能在他们所在社区，包括农村地区，为残疾人提供相关服务和机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall promote the development of initial and continuing training for professionals and staff working in habilitation and rehabilitation services .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应促进为从事康复和复健服务的专业人员及工作人员开展初始和持续培训的发展。

Query_Text_en: 3 . States Parties shall promote the availability , knowledge and use of assistive devices and technologies , designed for persons with disabilities , as they relate to habilitation and rehabilitation .
Translation: 3. 缔约国应促进为残疾人设计的辅助器具和技术在康复和适应过程中得到广泛提供、普及和使用。

Query_Text_en: 1 .
