S. dollars for the period January 1 , 1981 to June 30 , 1985 , i. e. $ 1 . 082 , the former date being the date of the introduction of the current basket of currencies of the SDR [ Article 5 [ a ] ] . Once the initially authorized amount is fully subscribed , the authorized capital will be increased automatically to the extent necessary to provide for subscriptions by acceding members [ Article 5 [ b ] ] . The authorized capital may also be increased at any time by the Council of Governors [ referred to in this Commentary as the Council ] by the special majority of at least two-thirds of the voting power representing at least 55 percent of capital subscriptions [ Article 5 [ c ] and Article 3 [ d ] ] .
Translation: 4. 公约规定，授权资本为十亿特别提款权，分为十万股，每股面值一万特别提款权。然而，成员国就股本的缴付义务，将以1981年1月1日至1985年6月30日期间特别提款权兑美元的平均价值为基础结算，即1.082美元。1981年1月1日为现行特别提款权货币篮子引入之日（见第5条[a]）。一旦最初授权的资本全部被认购，授权资本将自动增加，以满足新加入成员的认购需求（见第5条[b]）。此外，授权资本也可由理事会（本评注中称为“理事会”）以至少三分之二表决权且代表至少55%资本认购额的特别多数随时增加（见第5条[c]及第3条[d]）。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The amout of subscribed capital will determine the Agency 's underwriting capacity [ see Article 22 ] . It is anticipated that the authorized capital will be subscribed within a reasonable time after the Agency commences operations and that it will be able to operate successfully on that basis .
Translation: 5. 认缴资本的数额将决定本机构的承保能力（见第22条）。预计在本机构开始运营后，授权资本将在合理期限内被认缴，并且本机构能够在此基础上顺利开展业务。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Every member shall subscribe to the capital stock of the Agency . Article 6 provides for a minimum subscription of 50 shares [ SDR 500 , 000 ] . This will give all members a stake in the Agency . Initial subscriptions of original members are set out in Schedule A to the Convention . The Subscriptions of acceding members will be determined by the Agency 's Council . While shares will be issued at par to original members , the Council is authorized to determine the terms and conditions of acceding members ' subscriptions provided that the issue price shall not be less than par . Issue prices above par might be appropriate if the Agency has accumulated reserves at the time of the accession [ Article 6 ] .
Translation: 6. 每一成员均须认购本机构的股本。第六条规定，最低认购额为50股（特别提款权500,000）。这一规定确保所有成员都在本机构中拥有权益。原始成员的初始认购份额载于《公约》附件A。新加入成员的认购份额将由本机构理事会确定。原始成员的股份将按面值发行，理事会有权决定新加入成员认购股份的具体条款和条件，但发行价格不得低于面值。如果本机构在新成员加入时已积累储备，则发行价格高于面值可能是适当的（第六条）。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The Convention provides that ten percent of the price of the subscribed shares is to be paid in cash and that an additional ten percent is to be paid in the form of non-negotiable , non-interest-bearing promissory notes or similar obligations to be encashed pursuant to a decision of the Board . The cash payment is designed to cover start-up costs , administrative expenditures and possible claims arising out of the Agency 's guarantees . The arrangement for additional payment in the form of non-negotiable instruments allows the funds to remain within the members ' central banking systems and provides a cushion in the event that a large claim occurs during the Agency 's formative years . The purpose of this provision is to strengthen the Agency 's standing as a financially sound insurer from the outset . The remaining 80 percent of the subscribed shares is subject to call by the Agency to meet its obligations [ Article 7 ] . It should be emphasized that actual recourse to the non-negotiable instruments and the callable capital is not anticipated because the Agency is expected to conduct its activities on a sound business basis and maintain under all circumstances its ability to meet its financial obligations [ see Article 25 ] . Article 8 [ c ] provides that in case of default by a member on a call , the Agency is authorized to make successive calls on unpaid subscriptions .
Translation: 《公约》规定，已认购股份价格的10%须以现金支付，另有10%须以不可流通、无息的本票或类似债务形式支付，并根据理事会的决定兑现。现金支付旨在覆盖启动成本、管理支出及因本机构担保可能产生的索赔。以不可流通票据形式支付的安排，使资金得以保留在成员国的中央银行体系内，并在本机构初创阶段如发生大额索赔时提供缓冲。此项规定的目的是自一开始就增强本机构作为财务稳健保险人的地位。其余80%的认购股份则由本机构根据需要进行催缴，以履行其义务（见第七条）。需要强调的是，实际上并不预期会动用不可流通票据和可催缴资本，因为本机构将以稳健的商业原则开展业务，并在任何情况下都保持履行财务义务的能力（见第二十五条）。第八条(c)规定，如成员在催缴时违约，本机构有权对未缴认购份额进行连续催缴。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Subject to the limited exception discussed below , payments on the paid-in and callable portions of subscriptions must be made in a freely usable currency as defined in the Convention [ Articles 3 [ e ] and 8 ] . This is essential to ensure the Agency 's financial viability and its recognition as a credible insurer . The Board of Directors [ referred to in this Commentary as the Board ] has the discretion , after consultation with the International Monetary Fund , to designate as `` freely usable '' currencies other than those so designated by the International Monetary Fund . The Board can make this decision if it is satisfied that the currency concerned can be readily used for the purposes of the Agency and if the country whose currency is involved agrees [ Article 3 [ e ] ] . In order to reduce the financial burden of developing member countries , the Convention allows developing countries to pay up to 25 percent of the paid-in cash portion of their subscription in their local currencies . In view of the small amounts likely to be involved , this is not expected to have adverse effects on the Agency 's finances .
Translation: 8. 除下文所述的有限例外情况外，认缴出资和可随时缴纳部分的付款必须以《公约》所定义的自由使用货币进行 [第3条[e]和第8条]。这是确保机构财务可行性及其作为可信保险人获得认可的关键。董事会（在本评注中称为“董事会”）有权在与国际货币基金组织协商后，将国际货币基金组织指定以外的其他货币指定为“自由使用”货币。如果董事会确信相关货币能够被机构方便地用于其目的，并且该货币所属国家同意 [第3条[e]]，则可作出此决定。为减轻发展中国家成员的财务负担，《公约》允许发展中国家用本国货币支付其认缴现金部分最多25%。鉴于涉及的金额可能较小，这预计不会对机构的财务状况产生不利影响。

Query_Text_en: 9 . To reduce the financial burden on all members , the Convention provides that under certain circumstances the Agency will refund to members amounts paid on a call on subscribed capital . These refunds would be made in a freely usable currency in proportion to the payments made by members under calls made prior to such refund [ Article 10 [ b ] ] .
Translation: 9. 为减轻所有成员的财务负担，《公约》规定，在特定情况下，机构将向成员退还其已缴纳的认缴资本款项。这些退款将以可自由使用的货币按成员在退款前各次缴款的比例发放。[第10条第(b)款]

Query_Text_en: In the case of recovery of payments from a host country in a currency which is not freely usable , it is envisaged that the Agency would make the refund once it succeeds in converting such payments into usable currencies . To the extent amounts are refunded , members ' callable capital obligations would be re-established so that the situation existing before the respective call is restored [ Article 10 [ C ] ] .
Translation: 如果从东道国收回的款项是以非自由使用货币支付，机构将在成功将该款项兑换为可用货币后予以退款。退款金额相当于成员的可追加资本义务将重新建立，以恢复各成员在相关资本追加前的原有状态［第10条［C］］。

Query_Text_en: 10 . The Convention establishes the general framework for the Agency 's guarantee operations and enables the Board to define more precisely the scope of these operations by issuing policies , rules and regulations which can be amended from time to time .
Translation: 10. 公约为本机构的担保业务确立了总体框架，并授权理事会通过制定政策、规则和规章，对这些业务的范围作出更为具体的规定，并可根据需要进行修订。

Query_Text_en: This provides the Agency with the necessary flexibility to adapt , within this general framework , to changing circumstances and maintain its financial viability . For example , the Agency could limit the scope of its coverage on commencing operations and expand it as it gained experience and built up financial reserves .
Translation: 这为机构提供了必要的灵活性，使其能够在这一总体框架下适应不断变化的环境，并保持财务可持续性。例如，机构在开始运营时可以限制其保障范围，随着经验积累和财务储备的增加，再逐步扩大保障范围。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the details of each guarantee operation and the specific arrangements reached between the Agency and the investor would be incorporated into the contract of guarantee entered into between the agency and the investor . Article 16 provides that the Agency can not cover under a contract of guarantee the total loss sustained by an investor . This provision is designed to discourage possible irresponsible conduct by investors relying on total loss cover [ commonly referred to as `` moral hazard '' ] . In determining the appropriate percentage of possible indemnification , the Agency may find some guidance in the rules of national investment guarantee schemes which typically indemnify between 70 and 95 percent of a loss .
Translation: 此外，每一项担保操作的具体细节以及机构与投资者之间达成的具体安排，都将被纳入机构与投资者签订的担保合同中。第16条规定，机构不得在担保合同项下对投资者遭受的全部损失提供赔付。该规定旨在防止投资者依赖全额损失赔付而可能产生的不负责任行为（通常被称为“道德风险”）。在确定适当的赔付比例时，机构可以参考各国投资担保计划的相关规定，这些计划通常对损失的70%至95%进行赔付。

Query_Text_en: 11 . As stated above , the policies , rules and regulations applicable to guarantee operations will be determined by the Board . Contracts of guarantee , concluded on the basis of these principles , will be approved by the President of the Agency under the direction of the Board .
Translation: 11. 如上所述，适用于担保业务的政策、规则和规章将由董事会决定。根据上述原则签订的担保合同，将由机构总裁在董事会的指导下批准。

Query_Text_en: the currency transfer risk resulting from host government restrictions and delays in converting and transferring local currency earned by an investor , expropriation , and the risk of war and civil disturbance . The Convention adds to these traditionally covered risks the risk of breach or repudiation of a contractual commitment by the host government towards an investor under the limited conditions mentioned in paragraph 15 below [ Article 11 [ a ] ] .
Translation: 由于东道国政府对投资者所赚取的本地货币进行兑换和转移的限制与延迟所产生的货币转移风险、征收风险，以及战争和内乱风险。公约在传统风险基础上，进一步将东道国政府在下述第15段所述有限条件下对投资者的合同承诺违约或否认风险纳入保障范围（第11条[a]）。

Query_Text_en: 13 . The currency transfer risk is broadly defined in Article 11 [ a ] [ i ] . It is intended to encompass all forms of new direct restrictions , including additions to existing restrictions , as well as indirect or disguised restrictions , whether such restrictions are imposed by law or in fact . The restriction must be `` attributable to the host government '' , restrictions imposed by public agencies and other public organs of the host country are intended to be covered by this language . The provision is also intended to include the failure of the host government to act within `` a reasonable period of time '' on a transfer application . The provision does not define the specific period but it is expected that this will be accomplished in the rules and regulations to be issued by the Board and specifically in the contracts of guarantee . In determining what constitutes a `` reasonable period '' , the Agency will need to reconcile the investors ' interest in a speedy transfer with the fact that certain delays in the processing of applications by governments may be justified .
Translation: 13. 货币转移风险在第11条[a][i]中有广义定义。其旨在涵盖所有形式的新直接限制，包括对现有限制的补充，以及间接或隐性的限制，无论这些限制是通过法律还是事实上施加的。该限制必须“可归因于东道国政府”，东道国的公共机构和其他公共机关施加的限制也包含在此表述之内。本条款还包括东道国政府未能在“合理期限内”对转移申请作出处理的情形。条款并未具体界定该期限，但预计将在董事会颁布的规章制度中，特别是在担保合同中予以明确。在确定何为“合理期限”时，机构需要在投资者对快速转移的利益与政府在处理申请过程中某些延误可能合理之间进行权衡。

Query_Text_en: 14 . Article 11 [ a ] [ ii ] defines the expropriation risk .
Translation: 14. 第11条[a][ii]款对征收风险作出了界定。

Query_Text_en: It would encompass measures attributable to the host government such as nationalization , confiscation , sequestration , seizure , attachment and freezing of assets . The phrase `` any legislative or administrative action '' in the provision includes measures by the executive , but not measures taken by judicial bodies in the exercise of their functions . Measures normally taken by governments to regulate their economic activities such as taxation , environmental and labor legislation as well as normal measures for the maintenance of public safety , are not intended to be covered by this provision unless they discriminate against the holder of the guarantee .
Translation: 它将包括可归因于东道国政府的措施，如国有化、没收、扣押、查封和冻结资产。条款中的“任何立法或行政行为”一语包括行政机关采取的措施，但不包括司法机关在履行其职能时采取的措施。政府为规范其经济活动而通常采取的措施，如税收、环境和劳动立法，以及为维护公共安全而采取的正常措施，除非对担保持有人存在歧视，否则本条款并不打算涵盖这些措施。

Query_Text_en: In defining these measures , the Agency 's practice would not be meant to prejudice the rights of a member country or of investors under bilateral investment treaties , other treaties and international law .
Translation: 在界定这些措施时，机构的做法不应损害成员国或投资者根据双边投资协定、其他条约及国际法所享有的权利。

Query_Text_en: 15 . The breach of contract risk is contained in Article 11 [ a ] [ iii ] . Indemnification is available only when an investor has no forum to pursue the contractual claim against the government or when recourse to such a forum is hampered by an unreasonable delay as defined in the guarantee contract or when , after obtaining a final decision in his favor , the investor is unable to enforce it .
Translation: 15. 合同违约风险包含在第11条[a][iii]中。只有在投资者无法通过任何途径对政府提出合同索赔，或依据担保合同的规定，诉诸该途径受到不合理拖延，或在获得有利的最终裁决后无法执行时，才可获得赔偿。

Query_Text_en: 16 . Article 11 [ a ] [ iv ] encompasses the risk of war and civil disturbance . It is intended to include revolutions , insurrections , coups d'etat and similar political events which are typically outside the control of the host government . Acts of terrorists and similar activities which are specifically directed against the holder of the guarantee are , however , not intended to be covered by this provision but may be covered under Article 11 [ b ] , which is discussed below .
Translation: 第16条第11款[a][iv]涵盖战争和内乱风险，旨在包括革命、叛乱、政变及类似的政治事件，这些通常超出东道国政府的控制范围。然而，针对担保持有人专门实施的恐怖主义行为及类似活动，并不在本条款的保障范围之内，但可能会根据下文讨论的第11条[b]予以保障。

Query_Text_en: 17 . The Convention Provides additional flexibility by allowing the coverage of other specific non-commercial risks , but only at the joint request of the investor and the host country and with approval of the Board by special majority [ Article 11 [ b ] ] . Such approval may be issued on a case by case basis or in the form of regulations specifying the cases to be covered under this provision .
Translation: 17. 公约通过允许涵盖其他特定的非商业风险，提供了额外的灵活性，但仅限于投资者与东道国共同提出请求，并经理事会特别多数通过批准［第11条（b）］。此类批准可以逐案发放，也可以以规章形式，明确规定根据本条款所涵盖的具体情形。

Query_Text_en: 18 . Events occurring before the conclusion of the contract of guarantee , governmental action to which the holder of the guarantee has agreed or for which he is responsible , and losses resulting from currency devaluation and depreciation are specifically excluded by Article 11 [ b ] and [ c ] .
Translation: 18. 根据第11条[b]和[c]的规定，担保合同签订前发生的事件、担保持有人同意或应承担责任的政府行为，以及因货币贬值和折旧造成的损失，均被明确排除在外。

Query_Text_en: 19 . Article 12 defines the type of investments eligible for cover by the Agency .
Translation: 第19条：第12条规定了可由该机构承保的投资类型。

Query_Text_en: This provision endeavors to strike a balance between the need to preserve the Agency 's scarce capital to promote flows of direct investment and the need to assure future flexibility by allowing the Board to extend coverage to other types of investment . It is envisaged that the Agency will focus on guaranteeing investments eligible under Article 12 [ a ] , i. e. equity investment , different forms of direct investment , and medium-or long-term loans made or guaranteed by owners of equity in the enterprise concerned [ so-called equity-type or sponsored loans ] . The term `` direct investment '' is a generic term whose precise scope will have to be determined by the Board . The Board is expected to be guided by the International Monetary Fund 's definition of foreign direct investment as an `` investment that is made to acquire a lasting interest in an enterprise operating in an economy other than that of the investor , the investor 's purpose being to have an effective voice in the management of the enterprise . The Board may consider as direct investment such new forms of investment as service and management contracts as well as franchising , licensing , leasing , and production-sharing agreements where the investor 's return depends on the performance of the enterprise . In any case , it is immaterial whether the investment is made in monetary form or in kind such as the contribution of machinery , services , technical processes and technology .
Translation: 本条款旨在在保护机构有限资本以促进直接投资流动的需要与通过允许理事会将保障范围扩展至其他类型投资以确保未来灵活性的需要之间取得平衡。预计机构将重点为根据第12条[a]规定符合条件的投资提供担保，即股权投资、各种形式的直接投资，以及由企业相关股权所有者发放或担保的中长期贷款（即所谓的股权型或赞助贷款）。“直接投资”一词是一个通用术语，其具体范围需由理事会确定。理事会预计将以国际货币基金组织对外国直接投资的定义为指导，即“为在投资者本国以外经济体经营的企业获取持久利益而进行的投资，投资者的目的是在企业管理中拥有有效发言权。”理事会可将服务和管理合同，以及特许经营、许可、租赁和生产分成协议等新型投资形式视为直接投资，只要投资者的回报取决于企业的经营业绩。在任何情况下，投资是以货币形式还是以实物形式（如提供机械、服务、技术工艺和技术）进行，均无关紧要。

Query_Text_en: 20 . Article 12 [ b ] gives the Board flexibility , in the future , to extend the Agency 's coverage to other forms of investment . It authorizes the Board , by special majority , to extend coverage to any medium - or long-term form of investment except loans which are not related to a specific investment covered or to be covered by the Agency . To conserve the Agency 's scarce resources , the Agency would not guarantee or reinsure any export credit , regardless of its form , which is provided , guaranteed or reinsured by a government or an official export credit agency . Because the coverage of the Agency is restricted to investments , exports will be covered [ within the limits of the preceding sentence ] only to the extent that they represent a contribution to a specific investment . An agency or distributorship arrangement , which is designed primarily to promote exports , and in which an investor has an inconsequential equity interest , would not be covered by the Agency . The Agency would function as an investment guarantee agency , and would not function as an export credit agency which could compete with offcial export credit agencies .
Translation: 第12条[b]赋予理事会灵活性，以便将来将本机构的保障范围扩展至其他形式的投资。该条授权理事会以特别多数决定，将保障范围扩展至除与本机构已保障或拟保障的特定投资无关的贷款之外的任何中长期投资形式。为节约本机构有限的资源，本机构不对任何由政府或官方出口信贷机构提供、担保或再保险的出口信贷，无论其形式如何，提供担保或再保险。由于本机构的保障范围仅限于投资，出口仅在其构成对特定投资的贡献时，且在前述规定范围内，方可获得保障。主要目的是促进出口、且投资者仅拥有微不足道股权的代理或经销安排，不在本机构保障范围之内。本机构将作为投资担保机构运作，而非作为可能与官方出口信贷机构竞争的出口信贷机构。

Query_Text_en: 21 . To serve its objective without undermining its financial viability , the Agency will limit its guarantees to sound investments . It should satisfy itself that the investment concerned will contribute to the economic and social development of the host country , comply with the laws and regulations of that country , and be consistent with the country 's declared development objectives . It should also be satisfied that appropriate investment conditions , including the availability of fair and equitable treatment and legal protection , will apply to the investment concerned [ Article 12 [ d ] ] . In case no such protection is assured under the laws of the host country or under bilateral investment treaties , the Agency will issue the guarantee only after it reaches agreement with the host country pursuant to Article23 [ b ] [ ii ] or otherwise on the treatment to be extended to the investments covered by the Agency . Investments guaranteed by the Agency should also be new , that is implemented subsequent to the registration of the application for the guarantee by the Agency [ Article 12 [ c ] ] . The exclusion of pre-existing investments would not bar the Agency from covering investments made to develop an existing investment or from covering the reinvestment earnings which could otherwise be transferred outside the host country . The term `` earnings '' in Article 12 [ c ] [ ii ] is intended to include royalties and license fees .
Translation: 为了实现其目标且不损害其财务可行性，机构将仅对健全的投资提供担保。机构应确保相关投资有助于东道国的经济和社会发展，遵守该国的法律法规，并与该国公布的发展目标保持一致。机构还应确信，相关投资将适用适当的投资条件，包括公平和公正待遇以及法律保护的可获得性[第12条[d]]。如果东道国法律或双边投资协定未能确保此类保护，机构只有在根据第23条[b][ii]或以其他方式与东道国就机构所涵盖投资的待遇达成协议后，才会发放担保。机构担保的投资还应为新增投资，即在机构登记担保申请之后实施的投资[第12条[c]]。对既有投资的排除，并不妨碍机构为用于开发现有投资的投资或为本可转移出东道国的再投资收益提供担保。第12条[c][ii]中的“收益”一词旨在包括特许权使用费和许可费。

Query_Text_en: 22 . To qualify for a guarantee , investors who are natural persons must be nationals of members other than the host country . If investors are juridical persons , they must be incorporated and have their principal place of business in a member country other than the host country or have the majority of their capital owned by a member country or its nationals , other than the host country or its nationals . Privately and publicly owned investments are eligible as long as they are operated on a commercial basis [ Article 13 [ a ] [ iii ] ] . It is expected , however , that the bulk of guaranteed investments will be privately owned .
Translation: 22. 为符合担保资格，作为自然人的投资者必须是东道国外的成员国国民。若投资者为法人，则必须在东道国外的成员国注册成立并将主要营业地设于该成员国，或其大部分资本由东道国外的成员国或其国民拥有。无论私人还是公有投资，只要以商业方式运营，均有资格获得担保 [第13条[a][iii]]。但预计大部分获得担保的投资将以私人所有为主。

Query_Text_en: 23 . Article 13 [ c ] provides an exception to the requirement that investors may not be linked to the host country in the case of assets transferred from abroad by nationals of the host country or juridical persons incorporated in the host country or owned by host country nationals , provided that the investor and the host country jointly apply for a guarantee and the Board approves it by special majority . This exception is consistent with the Agency 's central objective of channelling the flow if investments to developing countries , some of which now have nationals living abroad with considerable off-shore funds . It would also help in the repatriation of capital to developing countries .
Translation: 第23条第13款[c]规定了一个例外情况，即对于由东道国国民或在东道国注册成立的法人，或由东道国国民所有的法人从境外转移的资产，如果投资者与东道国共同申请担保并经理事会特别多数通过，则投资者可以与东道国产生关联。这一例外规定与本机构引导投资流向发展中国家的核心目标是一致的，因为目前一些发展中国家的国民在海外拥有大量离岸资金。该规定也有助于资本回流发展中国家。

Query_Text_en: 24 . Article 14 limits the Agency 's own guarantee operations to investments made in the territory of a developing member country . A developing member country is defined in Article 3 [ c ] as a member listed as such in Schedule A to the Convention . During discussions by the Executive Directors , it was understood that the Agency would develop policies on eligibility whereby priority in its operations would be given to lesser developed countries . It was also agreed that , for purposes of Article 14 , dependent territories for whose international relations a non-developing country is responsible , should be treated as developing members , if the non-developing member country so requests . However , investments of that member in its dependent territories would be excluded from cover .
Translation: 第14条将本机构自身的担保业务限定于在发展中成员国境内进行的投资。第3条[c]款将发展中成员国定义为《公约》附表A中列明的成员。在执行董事会讨论期间，大家一致认为，本机构将制定有关资格的政策，在业务开展中优先考虑较不发达国家。同时也达成共识，对于第14条而言，由非发展中成员国负责其国际关系的附属领地，如非发展中成员国提出请求，应视为发展中成员国。然而，该成员国在其附属领地的投资将不予担保。

Query_Text_en: 25 . Article 15 provides that the Agency will not conclude any contract of guarantee before `` the host government has approved the issuance of the guarantee by the Agency against the risks designated for cover . Any host government may withhold its approval . This enables the host country to evaluate a proposed investment before giving its consent . The Agency is expected to establish procedures for obtaining consents under this provision . These may include requesting approvals on a no objection basis [ Article 38 [ b ] ] . Although the approval of the home country of the investor is not required , it would not be appropriate for the Agency to cover an investment if informed by the investor 's home country that it would be financed with funds transferred outside such country in violation of its laws .
Translation: 第25条。第15条规定，机构在“东道国政府批准机构针对指定风险提供担保”之前，不得签订任何担保合同。任何东道国政府都可以拒绝批准。这使东道国能够在同意前评估拟议的投资。机构预计将制定在本条款下获得同意的程序。这些程序可能包括以无异议方式请求批准[第38条[b]]。虽然不要求投资者本国的批准，但如果投资者本国告知该投资将以违反其法律的方式，用从该国转出的资金进行融资，则机构不应为该投资提供担保。

Query_Text_en: 26 . Article 18 [ a ] provides that where the Agency compensates or agrees to compensate an investor under a contract of guarantee , it assumes the rights that the investor acquired against the host country as a result of the event giving rise to the claim against the Agency . Subrogation is an accepted principle of insurance law . It provides for the assignment of an existing claim from the guaranteed investor to the Agency and the Agency as subrogee acquires the same rights as the investor had . The contracts of guarantee will define the terms and conditions of subrogation . These terms and conditions are of special significance for the investor in view of the fact that the Agency will compensate investors only for part of their losses [ Article 16 ] . Article 18 [ b ] provides for the recognition of the Agency 's right of subrogation by all members .
Translation: 第26条第18(a)款规定，当多边投资担保机构根据担保合同对投资者进行赔偿或同意赔偿时，因引发对机构索赔事件而投资者对东道国享有的权利即由机构承继。代位权是保险法中公认的原则，它规定将受保投资者现有的索赔权转让给机构，机构作为代位权人获得与投资者相同的权利。担保合同将对代位权的条款和条件作出规定。鉴于机构仅对投资者的部分损失进行赔偿（第16条），这些条款和条件对投资者尤为重要。第18(b)款规定，所有成员国均应承认机构的代位权。

Query_Text_en: 27 . Under Article 18 [ c ] , the Agency has the right to treatment as favorable as would be given the holder of the guarantee with respect to the use and transfer of local currencies of host countries received by the Agency as subrogee . In addition , the Agency is authorized to use these currencies for the payment of its administrative expenditures or other costs and is directed to seek to enter into agreements with host countries on other uses of these currencies if they are not freely usable . Such other uses could include the sale of the currencies to other institutions [ such as international lending agencies ] , foreign investors in these countries or to importers of goods from these countries . The Agency 's ability to use effectively , or otherwise dispose of , local currencies may be of significance in its operations in the unlikely case it should acquire substantial amounts of such currencies .
Translation: 根据第18条[c]，本机构有权在使用和转让其作为代位权人从东道国获得的本币时，享有与担保持有人同等的优惠待遇。此外，本机构有权将这些货币用于支付其行政开支或其他费用，并被要求在这些货币无法自由使用时，争取与东道国就其他用途达成协议。这些其他用途可以包括将货币出售给其他机构（如国际贷款机构）、在这些国家的外国投资者，或从这些国家进口商品的进口商。本机构能否有效使用或以其他方式处置本币，在极少数情况下若本机构获得大量此类货币时，可能对其业务具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: 28 . In order to ensure prompt payment of claims , decisions will be taken by the President in accordance with the contracts of guarantee and such policies as the Board may adopt [ Article 17 ] and , in cases of dispute , final determination may depend on the outcome of arbitration between the Agency and the investor concerned [ Article 58 ] . It is envisaged that these policies will require the holder to seek such administrative remedies as may be appropriate under the circumstances , if they are readily available under the laws of the host country , and may provide for reasonable periods of time to elapse so as to maximize the prospects for amicable settlement of claims between investors and host countries [ Article 17 ] .
Translation: 28. 为确保索赔款项及时支付，主席将根据担保合同及董事会可能采纳的相关政策作出决定［第17条］。如发生争议，最终裁决可能取决于机构与相关投资者之间的仲裁结果［第58条］。预计这些政策将要求持有人在东道国法律允许且易于获得的情况下，寻求适当的行政救济，并可能规定合理的时间期限，以最大限度地促进投资者与东道国之间索赔的友好解决［第17条］。

Query_Text_en: It is expected that the specific time limits , to be included in the guarantee contracts , would be consistent with the practice of other political risk insurers . This provision reflects established practices of national investment guarantee schemes and should not impose an undue burden on investors since they are not required to exhaust all local remedies before obtaining compensation from the Agency . The time limits would depend on the type of risk involved and the complexity of the particular case . The above time limits must be distinguished from the maximum periods allowed between the filing of a claim and the Agency 's decision on the claim . These time limits are not specified in the Convention because of the difficulty in determining specific periods which would be appropriate in all situations . However , the Agency may establish such time limits in its rules and regulations and may incorporate them into the contracts of guarantee in order to increase the attractiveness of its services .
Translation: 预计将纳入担保合同的具体时限，将与其他政治风险保险机构的惯例保持一致。该规定反映了各国投资担保计划的既定做法，不会对投资者构成不合理负担，因为投资者无需在获得本机构赔偿前穷尽所有本地救济措施。具体时限将取决于所涉风险类型及案件的复杂程度。上述时限应与投资者提出索赔与本机构作出决定之间允许的最长期限加以区分。由于难以确定适用于所有情形的具体期限，公约中并未规定这些时限。然而，本机构可在其规章中设定此类时限，并可将其纳入担保合同，以提升本机构服务的吸引力。

Query_Text_en: 29 . The Agency will complement national and regional programs rather than compete with them [ Article 19 ] . It is therefore expected to focus on guaranteeing investments from members without a national program [ chiefly capital-exporting developing member countries ] , coguaranteeing investments with national and regional agencies , providing reinsurance for national and regional agencies , guaranteeing investments which fail eligibility tests of the national and regional program concerned despite their soundness and developmental character , and guaranteeing investments financed by investors from different member countries . To contain its overhead and enhance its efficiency , the Agency may avail itself of the administrative support of national or regional entities and may enter into appropriate cooperative agreements with them [ Article 19 ] . For example , national administrative agencies might assist in processing applications of local investors for multilateral guarantees and any resulting claims . This would reduce the possible need for the Agency to establish offices away from its headquarters . It is clear , however , that the Agency would have to rely on its own risk assessments and reserve to itself decisions on issuance of guarantees and on payment of claims .
Translation: 29. 本机构将以补充国家和地区项目为主，而非与其竞争（第19条）。因此，预计其主要工作包括：为没有国家项目的成员国（主要是资本输出的发展中国家）提供投资担保，与国家和地区机构共同担保投资，为国家和地区机构提供再保险，对虽具备良好投资和发展特性但未通过相关国家和地区项目资格审查的投资进行担保，以及为来自不同成员国的投资者所融资的投资提供担保。为控制管理成本并提升效率，本机构可利用国家或地区实体的行政支持，并可与其签订适当的合作协议（第19条）。例如，国家行政机构可协助处理本地投资者申请多边担保及相关索赔事宜，这将减少本机构在总部以外设立办事处的需求。然而，显然本机构必须依靠自身的风险评估，并保留对担保发放及索赔支付的最终决策权。

Query_Text_en: 30 . Article 19 defines the institutions the Agency may cooperate with in this respect as `` national entities of members and regional entities the majority of whose capital is owned by members , which carry out activities similar to those of the Agency . This includes any agency that issues investment guarantees against non-commercial risks or that promotes private investment to developing countries . As a result , the Agency might cooperate with more than one institution in the same country . It should be noted that cooperation between a national entity and the Agency does not result in the entity automatically becoming the channel of communication between the member country and the Agency under Article 38 . This provision requires each member to designate an appropriate authority for communication on all matters arising under the Convention .
Translation: 第30条。第19条规定了本机构在这方面可以合作的机构为“成员国的国家实体以及资本多数由成员国拥有的区域实体，这些实体从事与本机构类似的活动。”这包括任何为非商业风险提供投资担保或促进对发展中国家私人投资的机构。因此，本机构可能会在同一国家与多个机构合作。需要注意的是，国家实体与本机构的合作，并不意味着该实体会根据第38条自动成为成员国与本机构之间的沟通渠道。该条款要求每个成员国指定一个适当的主管机构，负责就《公约》项下产生的所有事项进行沟通。

Query_Text_en: 31 . The Agency may cooperate with private political risk insurers to enhance its own operations and to encourage those insurers to provide political risk insurance in developing members of the Agency on conditions similar to those of the Agency [ Article 21 [ a ] ] . For example , with respect to the former objective , private insurance companies might assist the Agency in marketing its program . With respect to the latter objective , the Agency is expected to play a catalytic role in mobilizing private underwriting capacity , for example , by entering with private underwriters into coinsurance arrangements . The Agency will in particular seek to guarantee investments for which comparable coverage on reasonable terms is not available from private insurers .
Translation: 31. 该机构可与私人政治风险保险公司合作，以提升自身运营能力，并鼓励这些保险公司在本机构成员的发展中国家以与本机构类似的条件提供政治风险保险（第21条[a]）。例如，就前一目标而言，私人保险公司可以协助本机构推广其项目。就后一目标而言，本机构有望在调动私人承保能力方面发挥催化作用，例如通过与私人承保人签订共同保险安排。特别是，本机构将重点为那些私人保险公司无法以合理条件提供类似保障的投资项目提供担保。

Query_Text_en: In some countries governments play a role in coordinating public and private insurance activities , and Article 38 [ a ] requires the Agency to consult with member governments , at their request , on the matters set out in Articles 19 to 21 . These include the Agency 's complementary role in the design of its own guarantee operations , coinsurance , reinsurance , sponsorship operations and administrative cooperation . Where appropriate , the Agency may enter into an `` umbrella agreement '' with a government providing the framework for the Agency 's cooperation with the public and private insurers of that member .
Translation: 在一些国家，政府在协调公共和私人保险活动中发挥作用，而第38条[a]要求本机构在成员国政府提出请求时，就第19至21条所列事项与其协商。这些事项包括本机构在自身担保业务设计、共同保险、再保险、担保业务和行政合作中的补充作用。在适当情况下，本机构可以与某一政府签订“总体协议”，为本机构与该成员国的公共和私人保险机构的合作提供框架。

Query_Text_en: 33 . The Agency is authorized under Articles 20 and 21 [ a ] to provide reinsurance to institutions of members issuing investment guarantees , to regional investment guarantee agencies [ of which the sole example at present is the Inter-Arab Investment Guarantee Corporation ] , and to private insurers in member countries . As stated in paragraph 31 of this Commentary , the Agency 's arrangements with private insurers , including arrangments for reinsurance , are intended to encourage them to offer investors guarantees on conditions similar to those offered by the Agency . Reinsurance is intended to diversify the Agency 's own risk portfolio as well as that of the reinsured entity . It should also allow the reinsured entity to expand its operations .
Translation: 33. 根据第20和第21条[a]，本机构有权为成员国发行投资担保的机构、区域性投资担保机构（目前唯一的例子是阿拉伯国家间投资担保公司）以及成员国的私人保险公司提供再保险。如本评述第31段所述，本机构与私人保险公司之间的安排，包括再保险安排，旨在鼓励他们以与本机构类似的条件向投资者提供担保。再保险旨在分散本机构自身的风险组合，同时也分散被再保险实体的风险组合。此外，再保险还应有助于被再保险实体扩大其业务规模。

Query_Text_en: 34 . It should be noted that reinsurance provided by the Agency must always relate to `` a specific investment . The intention here is to exclude the reinsurance of portions of primary underwriters ' risk portfolios [ commonly referred to as treaty reinsurance ] . It should also be noted that reinsurance operations are intended to comprise only a predetermined part of the Agency 's overall operations . Article 20 [ a ] therefore provides that maximum amounts shall be set from time to time by the Board by special majority . In the case of investments completed more than one year prior to receipt of the application for reinsurance by the Agency , the Convention establishes an initial limit of ten percent of the total coverage which the Agency may provide on its own account , i. e. without resort to sponsorship . These limits apply to the reinsurance of both public entities and private insurers . They may be changed by the Board by special majority whenever deemed appropriate .
Translation: 34. 应当注意，机构提供的再保险必须始终与“特定投资”相关。这里的意图是排除对初级承保人风险组合部分的再保险（通常称为合约再保险）。还应注意，再保险业务仅应构成机构整体业务的预定部分。因此，第20条[a]规定，最高额度应由理事会以特别多数不时设定。对于在机构收到再保险申请前已完成一年以上的投资，《公约》规定了一个初始上限，即机构可自行承担的总保险额度的10%，也就是说，不依赖于担保。这些限制适用于对公共实体和私人保险公司的再保险。理事会可在认为适当时，以特别多数对这些限制进行更改。

Query_Text_en: 35 . The conditions determining eligibility with respect to risks , investment , investor and host country applicable to Agency guarantees will apply to reinsured investments ; for technical reasons , reinsured investments need not be implemented subsequent to the application for reinsurance [ Article 20 [ a ] ] .
Translation: 35. 适用于机构担保的风险、投资、投资者及东道国等资格条件，同样适用于再保险投资；出于技术原因，再保险投资不要求在提出再保险申请后实施［第20条［a］］。

Query_Text_en: 36 . Article 20 [ c ] provides that , to the extent possible , reinsurance arrangements will be structured so that the Agency or the reinsured entity will have equivalent rights of subrogation and arbitration to those the Agency would have if it were the Primary guarantor . However , the Agency 's rights as subrogee will not be effective without the host country 's prior approval of the reinsurance by the Agency [ Article 20 [ c ] ] . In some cases , it might be impracticable for the Agency to be subrogated to the rights of the reinsured entity . In other cases , it might be expedient for the Agency to let the reinsured entity enforce the subrogated rights acquired by the Agency as its agent . Article 20 [ c ] requires contracts of reinsurance to provide that the reinsured entity will pursue recovery remedies with due diligence .
Translation: 第36条。第20条[c]规定，在可能的范围内，分保安排应当使本机构或被保险实体享有与本机构作为主保险人时等同的代位权和仲裁权。然而，未经东道国事先批准本机构的再保险安排，本机构作为代位权人的权利将不生效（第20条[c]）。在某些情况下，本机构取得被保险实体权利的代位可能不可行。在其他情况下，本机构可视情况授权被保险实体以其代理人身份行使本机构取得的代位权。第20条[c]要求再保险合同规定，被保险实体应当勤勉行使追偿权利。

Query_Text_en: 37 . Under Article 21 [ b ] , the Agency may reinsure any guarantees issued by it with public or private insurers . Such reinsurance would allow it further to diversify its risk portfolio . It is expected to use this authority only where it can obtain reinsurance cover at appropriate terms and reasonable cost .
Translation: 根据第21条[b]款，机构可以将其所签发的任何担保向公共或私人保险公司进行再保险。此类再保险将有助于进一步分散其风险组合。预计机构仅在能够以适当条件和合理成本获得再保险保障时才会行使该权利。

Query_Text_en: 38 . Under accepted principles of insurance and banking , the incurring of aggregate liabilities in excess of the insurer 's or bank 's equity is permitted . The basis for this principle is that it can not reasonably be expected that all guaranteed or insured risks will become losses . Under the Convention , this principle is applied to the Agency . Article 22 [ a ] provides that the maximum aggregate amount of contingent liability which may be assumed by the Agency may not exceed one hundred and 50 percent of its subscribed capital and reserves as well as , possibly , a portion of reinsurance cover , unless the Council determines otherwise by special majority . Since the Agency is expected to build up its portfolio over time , the Board is called upon to review from time to time the actual spread of risks and the loss potential with a view to determining whether a higher risk-asset ratio should be recommended to the Council . However , any decision to increase the ratio is , as stated above , subject to a special majority vote and the maximum risk-asset ratio may not exceed one-to-five .
Translation: 38. 根据公认的保险和银行业原则，允许保险公司或银行承担超过其自有资本总额的负债。其依据在于，不能合理预期所有担保或承保的风险都会转化为损失。根据《公约》，该原则同样适用于本机构。第22条[a]规定，除非理事会以特别多数作出另行决定，本机构可承担的或有负债总额不得超过其认缴资本和储备金的150%，以及可能包括的部分再保险保障。鉴于本机构预计将逐步建立其投资组合，董事会需定期审查实际风险分布及损失潜力，以决定是否应向理事会建议提高风险资产比率。然而，如上所述，任何提高该比率的决定均须经特别多数通过，且最高风险资产比率不得超过五分之一。

Query_Text_en: 39 . Article 22 [ b ] [ i ] provides that the Board may prescribe the maximum amount of contingent liability for all guarantees issued to investors of individual members . The objective of this provision is to maintain an equilibrium between the relative contributions of a member to the Agency and the benefits from the Agency accruing to its investors . In setting limits , the Board is required to give `` due consideration '' to a member 's capital subscription ; however , `` due consideration '' is also to be given to the need of applying these limits more liberally to developing member countries when they or their nationals invest in other developing members .
Translation: 第39条第22款[b][i]规定，理事会可以规定对各成员国投资者所签发的所有担保的或有责任的最高限额。该条款的目的是在成员对本机构的相对出资与其投资者从本机构获得的利益之间保持平衡。在设定限额时，理事会须对成员的资本认购给予“适当考虑”；然而，对于发展中成员国及其国民在其他发展中成员国投资的情况，也应“适当考虑”更为宽松地适用这些限额的需要。

Query_Text_en: 40 . A third category of limits may be established by the Board in order to achieve a viable overall spread of risk and to avoid undue concentrations of risk . Thus limits may be placed on the Agency 's exposure with respect to the size of individual projects , total investments in individual host countries , types of investment or risk or other factors [ Article 22 [ b ] [ ii ] ] . Since these limits serve solely to diversify risk , any limit on investments in individual host countries is not to be affected by such countries ' relative capital subscriptions .
Translation: 40. 董事会还可设立第三类限额，以实现整体风险的合理分散，避免风险过度集中。因此，可以对机构在单个项目规模、对某一东道国的总投资、投资类型或风险类型，以及其他因素方面的风险敞口设定限额［第22条［b］［ii］］。由于这些限额仅用于分散风险，对单一东道国投资的限额不应受该国相对资本认缴额的影响。

Query_Text_en: 41 . One of the features that distinguishes the Agency from earlier proposals is its obligation to carry out activities complementary to issuing guarantees to promote the flow of investments to and among member countries [ Article 2 [ b ] ] . The Agency has a responsibility under Article 23 [ a ] to conduct research and disseminate information on investment opportunities in developing member countries , as well as to undertake other activities to promote foreign investment .
Translation: 41. 本机构区别于以往提案的一个特点，是其有义务开展与提供担保相辅相成的活动，以促进投资流向成员国及成员国之间（第2条[b]）。根据第23条[a]，本机构有责任开展研究并传播有关发展中成员国投资机会的信息，同时还要开展其他促进外国投资的活动。

Query_Text_en: In addition , the Agency , at the request of a member , may provide technical assistance and advice with the objective of improving investment conditions . This could include advice on such matters as the drafting of investment codes and reviewing investment incentive programs . Such complementary services may be provided against appropriate fees or may be extended at no cost to the beneficiary countries when warranted .
Translation: 此外，机构可应成员请求，提供旨在改善投资环境的技术援助和咨询服务。这些服务可能包括投资法规的起草建议以及投资激励计划的评审等内容。此类补充服务可根据情况收取相应费用，或在必要时免费向受益国提供。

Query_Text_en: 42 . In carrying out its promotional activities , the Agency will be guided by the relevant investment agreements among its members and will seek to remove impediments among its members to investment flows . In addition , the Agency has a duty to coordinate with other agencies concerned with the promotion of foreign investment , particularly the International Finance Corporation [ Article 23 [ a ] ] . This would help to avoid duplication in the Agency 's activities .
Translation: 42. 在开展促进活动时，机构将以成员间相关投资协议为指导，并致力于消除成员间影响投资流动的障碍。此外，机构有责任与其他负责促进外国投资的机构，特别是国际金融公司进行协调（第23条[a]）。这将有助于避免机构活动的重复。

Query_Text_en: 43 . Article 23 [ b ] [ i ] places a duty on the Agency to encourage the amicable settlement of disputes between investors and host countries . It may also provide information on available dispute settlement and conciliation mechanisms . The Agency is also directed to promote and facilitate the conclusion of investment protection treaties among its members . For example , it could undertake studies on existing agreements and assist member governments in the analysis of the implications of and benefits from such agreements .
Translation: 第43条第23款[b][i]规定，机构有责任鼓励投资者与东道国之间的友好争端解决。机构还可以提供有关现有争端解决和调解机制的信息。同时，机构被要求推动并促进成员之间投资保护条约的签署。例如，机构可以对现有协议进行研究，并协助成员国政府分析此类协议的影响和收益。

Query_Text_en: 44 . Under Article 23 [ b ] [ ii ] , the Agency will endeavor to enter into bilateral and multilateral agreements with its members in order to assure that the investments guaranteed by it will receive treatment at least as favorable as that accorded by the member concerned to the most favored investment guarantee agency or State . In determining the most favored agency or State , the Agency will consider agreements as a whole , and not their individual provisions . Agreements under Article 23 [ b ] [ ii ] require the Board 's approval by special majority . It is anticipated that these agreements would be concluded when the investments covered by the Agency would not otherwise benefit from existing bilateral treaties or when the standards provided in such treaties are deemed by the Agency to be inadequate .
Translation: 根据第23条[b][ii]，本机构将努力与其成员国签订双边和多边协议，以确保由本机构担保的投资能够获得至少与相关成员国给予最惠投资担保机构或国家同等的待遇。在确定最惠机构或国家时，本机构将整体考虑相关协议，而非单独条款。根据第23条[b][ii]签订的协议须经董事会特别多数通过。预计这些协议将在本机构所担保的投资无法从现有双边条约中受益，或本机构认为相关条约所提供的标准不充分时签订。

Query_Text_en: 45 . Earlier Bank proposals to establish an international investment insurance agency contemplated that the Agency would have conducted its operations solely on behalf of sponsoring member countries . Under the Convention , guarantees of sponsored investments play a supplemental but important role to operations conducted by the Agency on its own behalf . In addition to the latter operations , the Agency may , under Article 24 , guarantee other investments , and provide additional reinsurance , if a member or members agree to sponsor these investments . The specific provisions relating to sponsorship operations are set out in Annex I , which is an integral part of the Convention . It must be emphasized that the assets held and administered by the Agency in the Sponsorship Trust Fund mentioned below are required under Article 2 [ c ] of Annex I to be kept separate and apart from the assets of the Agency and that the Agency can not incur any liability with respect to its own assets under the sponsorship operations [ Article 6 of Annex I ] .
Translation: 45. 早期世界银行提出建立国际投资保险机构的建议中，曾设想该机构仅代表发起成员国开展业务。根据公约，受发起投资担保的业务在机构自身开展的业务之外，起到了补充但重要的作用。除了机构自身的业务外，根据第24条，若有成员同意发起这些投资，机构还可担保其他投资并提供额外再保险。与发起业务相关的具体规定载于附件一，该附件为公约不可分割的一部分。必须强调，机构持有并管理的发起信托基金资产（如下文所述），根据附件一第2[c]条，须与机构自身资产分开管理，且机构不得因发起业务而以自身资产承担任何责任（附件一第6条）。

Query_Text_en: A member proposing to the Agency the guarantee of an investment will incur a loss-sharing contingent obligation in the amount of the guarantee sponsored by it . Premiums and other revenues attributable to sponsored guarantees will be accumulated in a separate trust fund called the Sponsorship Trust Fund . The administrative expenses and payments on claims related to sponsored investments would be paid out of this Fund . After depletion of the Fund , any loss incurred on a sponsored guarantee would be shared by all sponsoring members , each in the proportion which the total amount of guarantees sponsored by it bears to the total amount of guarantees sponsored by all members . Each sponsor 's maximum liability is , however , limited to the total maximum contingent liability under all guarantees sponsored from time to time by that member . Articles 1 and 3 of Annex I provide limitations on a member 's obligations to share in losses under the sponsorship arrangement .
Translation: 向机构提议为某项投资提供担保的成员，将承担与其所担保金额等额的损失分担或或有责任。与担保相关的保费及其他收入将被累积到一个名为“担保信托基金”的独立信托基金中。与担保投资相关的管理费用和理赔支出将由该基金支付。在基金耗尽后，任何因担保产生的损失将由所有担保成员按其所担保总额占所有成员担保总额的比例共同分担。然而，每个担保成员的最大责任限于其不时担保的所有担保项下的最大或有责任总额。附件一第1条和第3条对成员在担保安排下分担损失的义务作出了限制。

Query_Text_en: 47 . Sponsorship enables members to provide investment insurance protection in several instances . Members which do not have a national scheme may use this system to provide coverage to their investors . For other members , sponsorship might be used as a risk diversification device since it would allow them to substitute the pro rata share in all contingent liabilities of the Sponsorship Trust Fund for the entire contingent liability for the investments if insured by their national scheme .
Translation: 47. 赞助机制使成员能够在多种情况下为投资提供保险保障。没有国家保险计划的成员可以通过该机制为其投资者提供保障。对于其他成员，赞助机制还可作为风险分散工具，因为通过该机制，他们可以用赞助信托基金中按比例分担的或有负债，替代由本国保险计划承担的全部投资或有负债。

Query_Text_en: 48 . In general , the provisions of the Convention relating to guarantee operations and financial management which are applicable to the Agency 's own operations will also apply to sponsored guarantees [ Article 6 of Annex I ] . In particular , the eligibility requirements under Articles 11 and 12 of the Convention also govern sponsored investments . However , guarantees relating to sponsored investments are not limited to nationals of member countries . Article 1 [ a ] of Annex I provides that such investments may be made `` by an investor of any nationality or by investors of any or several nationalities .
Translation: 48. 一般而言，《公约》中与担保业务和财务管理相关的规定，凡适用于机构自身业务的，也同样适用于受托担保[附件一第六条]。尤其是，《公约》第十一条和第十二条规定的资格要求，同样适用于受托投资。然而，涉及受托投资的担保并不限于成员国国民。附件一第一条[a]规定，此类投资可以由“任何国籍的投资者或由一个或数个国籍的投资者进行”。

Query_Text_en: '' The host country may co-sponsor an investment . Co-sponsorship indicates a strong developmental interest by the host country in the investment , and an intention to improve its risk profile . Article 1 [ c ] of Annex I places a duty on the Agency to give priority treatment to the coverage of investments cosponsored by the host country .
Translation: 东道国可以共同发起一项投资。共同发起表明东道国对该投资具有强烈的发展兴趣，并意在改善其风险状况。附件一第1条[c]规定，机构有义务优先为东道国共同发起的投资提供保障。

Query_Text_en: 49 . The limitation provided in Article 14 of the Convention restricting coverage to investments in developing countries applies to operations on the Agency 's own account and does not extend to sponsorship operations . Members may sponsor investments in any member country , but a special emphasis is placed on operations in developing member countries . The rationale for allowing sponsorship operations in developed countries is that guarantees for sponsored investments in developed countries , which are of particular interest to some capital-exporting developing countries , do not absorb scarce underwriting capacity and would not therefore reduce the Agency 's capacity to guarantee investments in developing countries . In some circumstances , an investment in a developed country corporation may facilitate joint ventures with that corporation or its subsidiary in developing countries . Investments in developed countries also have the advantage of improving the risk profile of the Sponsorship Trust Fund 's portfolio and enabling it to achieve a greater measure of diversification .
Translation: 《公约》第14条规定的仅限于对发展中国家投资提供担保的限制，适用于机构自营业务，但不适用于担保业务。成员可以为任何成员国的投资提供担保，但特别强调对发展中成员国的业务。允许在发达国家开展担保业务的理由在于，为发达国家的被担保投资提供担保，尤其是对一些资本输出型发展中国家而言，并不会占用有限的承保能力，因此不会减少机构为发展中国家投资提供担保的能力。在某些情况下，对发达国家企业的投资可能有助于与该企业或其子公司在发展中国家开展合资企业。此外，对发达国家的投资还有助于改善担保信托基金投资组合的风险状况，并实现更高程度的多元化。

Query_Text_en: 50 . Article 5 [ a ] of Annex I authorizes the Agency to issue reinsurance to members and their agencies , regional agencies of members and private insurers in member countries on the basis of sponsorship . These reinsurance operations are subject to the same conditions as reinsurance operations on the Agency 's own account .
Translation: 附件一第5条[a]授权本机构根据担保原则，向成员及其机构、成员国的区域机构以及成员国的私人保险公司提供再保险。此类再保险业务须遵循与本机构自营再保险业务相同的条件。

Query_Text_en: 51 . Article 6 of Annex I provides that sponsorship operations will be carried out in accordance with the same sound business and financial practices governing the Agency 's guarantee operations based on its own capital and reserves . As in the case of underwriting for its own account , the Agency would not be expected to cover sponsored investment involving unacceptably high risks or that would unbalance its risk portfolio . Sponsorship operations would also benefit from the credit of the sponsoring members which , it is assumed , would be among the most creditworthy members . Article 1 [ c ] of Annex I specifically directs the Agency to `` pay due regard to the prospects that the sponsoring member will be in a position to meet its sponsorship obligations . Moreover , sponsorship operations are expected to be financially as sound as the Agency 's own guarantee operations .
Translation: 附件一第六条规定，担保业务应按照管理局以自有资本和储备金进行担保业务时所遵循的同样健全的商业和财务惯例进行。与自有账户承保的情况一样，管理局不应为涉及不可接受高风险或会导致其风险组合失衡的担保投资提供担保。担保业务还将受益于担保成员的信用，假定这些成员应是信用最好的成员之一。附件一第一条[c]项明确指示管理局“应充分考虑担保成员履行其担保义务的能力前景”。此外，担保业务在财务上应与管理局自身的担保业务同样健全。

Query_Text_en: 52 . Article 1 [ d ] of Annex I requires the Agency to consult periodically with sponsoring member countries on matters related to sponsorship operations . Moreover , voting allocations will be modified for the purpose of decisions on sponsored investment in that each sponsoring member and each member hosting a sponsored investment will be allocated one additional vote for each SDR 10 , 000 of any investment sponsored or hosted by it [ Article 7 of Annex I ] . Theoretically , therefore , there is a possibility that the terms and conditions adopted by the Board for sponsorship operations may not be identical to those concerning operations on the Agency 's own account .
Translation: 附件一第1条[d]要求机构定期与发起成员国就与发起业务相关的事项进行协商。此外，为了对发起投资的决策进行投票分配，每个发起成员国以及每个承办发起投资的成员国，将根据其所发起或承办的每一笔SDR 10,000的投资，获得一个额外投票权（见附件一第7条）。因此，从理论上讲，董事会针对发起业务所制定的条款和条件，可能与机构自营业务的相关条款和条件并不完全一致。

Query_Text_en: The Government of the People 's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Senegal have decided , in accordance with the interests of the two countries , to establish diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level and send its respective ambassador to the other country .
Translation: 中华人民共和国政府和塞内加尔共和国政府根据两国利益，决定建立大使级外交关系，并互派大使。

Query_Text_en: The Government of the People 's Republic of China respects the non-alignment policy pursued by the Government of the Republic of Senegal .
Translation: 中华人民共和国政府尊重塞内加尔共和国政府奉行的不结盟政策。

Query_Text_en: The Government of the Republic of Senegal acknowledges that the Government of the People 's Republic of China is the sole legitimate government representing the entire Chinese people .
Translation: 塞内加尔共和国政府承认中华人民共和国政府是代表全体中国人民的唯一合法政府。

Query_Text_en: The two governments agree to develop diplomatic relations , friendship and cooperation between China and Senegal on the basis of the following principles mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity , non-aggression against the other country , non-interference into internal affairs of the other country , equality and mutual benefit and peaceful coexistence . The communiqu is issued on December 7th 1971 , in Dakar .
Translation: 两国政府同意在以下原则基础上发展中国与塞内加尔之间的外交关系、友谊与合作：相互尊重主权和领土完整、互不侵犯、互不干涉内政、平等互利、和平共处。该公报于1971年12月7日在达喀尔发布。

Query_Text_en: There are two texts to the communiqu , and each text is written in Chinese and French . Both texts are equally valid .
Translation: 公告共有两份文本，每份文本均以中文和法文撰写，两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 EstablishmentThe `` Asia-Pacific Telecommunity '' [ hereinafter referred to as the `` Telecommunity '' ] is hereby established as a regional telecommunication organization in conformity with Article 32 of the International Telecommunication Convention [ Malaga-Torremolinos , 1973 ] .
Translation:
第一条 成立  
现根据《国际电信公约》（马拉加-托雷莫利诺斯，1973年）第三十二条，成立“亚太电信共同体”（以下简称“共同体”），作为区域性电信组织。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] promote and assist in the formulation and implementation of bilateral or multilateral telecommunication programs within the region in co-operation with appropriate international or regional organizations .
Translation: [g] 促进并协助与相关国际或区域组织合作，在本地区制定和实施双边或多边电信项目。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Composition of the Telecommunity1 . The Telecommunity shall comprise Members , Associate Members and Affiliate Members .
Translation:
第三条 电信共同体的组成

1. 电信共同体由正式成员、准成员和附属成员组成。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Membership in the Telecommunity shall be open to any State within the region which is a member of the United Nations or a member of ESCAP .
Translation: 2. 电信共同体的成员资格对本地区任何联合国成员国或亚太经社会成员国开放。

Query_Text_en: Any such State on becoming a party to this Constitution in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 or Article 19 shall become a Member of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 任何此类国家根据第十七条或第十九条的规定加入本《章程》后，即成为电信共同体的成员。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any State within the region which does not qualify for membership under paragraph 2 of this Article , shall become a Member after having secured the affirmative vote of two-thirds of all Members , and upon becoming a party to this Constitution in accordance with the provision of Article 19 .
Translation: 3. 本区域内任何未符合本条第2款规定的成员资格的国家，须经全体成员三分之二的赞成票，并依照第十九条的规定成为本宪章的缔约方后，方可成为成员。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Associate membership in the Telecommunity shall be open to any associate member of ESCAP .
Translation: 4. 电信共同体的准会员资格对任何联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会的准会员开放。

Query_Text_en: An associate member of ESCAP on becoming a party to this Constitution in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 or Article 19 and the provisions of Article 20 , shall become an Associate Member of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 亚太经社会的准成员根据第十七条或第十九条以及第二十条的规定成为本宪章缔约方后，即成为电信共同体的准成员。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Affiliate membership in the Telecommunity shall be open to any entity which operates , as a common carrier , national and\/or international telecommunications services within the region and which is nominated for affiliate membership by a Member or an Associate Member of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 5. 电信共同体的附属会员资格对在本地区作为公共运营商运营国内和/或国际电信服务的任何实体开放，并且该实体须由电信共同体的成员或准成员提名为附属会员。

Query_Text_en: Any such entity , upon informing the Telecommunity , through the nominating Member or Associate Member , in a communication addressed to the Executive Director or , prior to the appointment of the Executive Director , to the Executive Secretary of ESCAP , of its willingness to uphold this Constitution shall become an Affiliate Member of the Telecommunity with effect from the date of the receipt of such communication .
Translation: 任何此类实体，通过提名成员或准成员，向电信共同体发出致执行主任（或在执行主任任命之前，致亚太经社会执行秘书）的书面通知，表达其愿意遵守本章程的意愿后，自该通知收到之日起，成为电信共同体的附属成员。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Recognition of rightsThe Telecommunity shall recognize fully the rights of a Member and an Associate Member to regulate their telecommunications .
Translation:
第四条 权利认可

电信共同体应充分承认成员和准成员对其电信进行监管的权利。

Query_Text_en: It shall also take into consideration the obligations of a Member , an Associate Member and an Affiliate Member to the existing international and regional telecommunication organizations .
Translation: 还应考虑成员、准成员和附属成员对现有国际和区域电信组织所承担的义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 HeadquartersThe headquarters of the Telecommunity shall be at Bangkok .
Translation:
第五条 总部  
电信共同体总部设在曼谷。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Official languageThe official language of the Telecommunity shall be English .
Translation:
第六条 官方语言  
本电信共同体的官方语言为英语。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the General Assembly ; [ b ] the Management Committee ; [ c ] the Secretariat . 2 . The General Assembly or the Management Committee shall establish such subsidiary bodies and expert groups as they deem necessary for fulfilling the objectives of the Telecommunity .
Translation:
[a] 全体大会；[b] 管理委员会；[c] 秘书处。

2. 全体大会或管理委员会应根据电信共同体的目标需要，设立其认为必要的附属机构和专家组。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Whenever such bodies or groups are established , their terms of reference , period of tenure , other rules for the conduct of their activities , and budgetary provisions shall be simultaneously laid down .
Translation: 3. 每当此类机构或团体成立时，应同时制定其职责范围、任期、活动规则及预算安排。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The meetings of the General Assembly and the Management Committee shall be held at the headquarters of the Telecommunity unless the respective organs decide otherwise .
Translation: 4. 除非相关机构另有决定，会员大会和管理委员会的会议应在电信共同体总部举行。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 The General Assembly1 . The General Assembly shall be the supreme organ of the Telecommunity and shall be composed of all the Members and Associate Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation:
第八条 大会

1. 大会是电信共同体的最高机构，由所有成员和准成员组成。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member shall have one vote in the General Assembly .
Translation: 2. 每个成员在大会中均有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: 3 . An Associate Member shall not have the right to vote in the General Assembly .
Translation: 3. 准会员无权在大会上投票。

Query_Text_en: 4 . An Affiliate Member may participate in the deliberations of the General Assembly as an observer .
Translation: 4. 附属会员可以以观察员身份参与大会的讨论。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The General Assembly shall meet in ordinary session every three years and in extraordinary session when circumstances require .
Translation: 5. 大会每三年召开一次常规会议，遇特殊情况时可召开临时会议。

Query_Text_en: Extraordinary sessions shall be convened by the President of the General Assembly at the request of two-thirds of the Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 大会主席应在电信共同体三分之二成员的请求下召集特别会议。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] adopt its own rules of procedure .
Translation: [e] 制定其自身的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The General Assembly shall elect a President and two Vice-Presidents at each ordinary session from among the representatives of the Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 7. 大会应在每届常会期间，从电信共同体成员的代表中选举产生一名主席和两名副主席。

Query_Text_en: The President and the two Vice-Presidents shall each hold office until the next ordinary session of the General Assembly . They shall be eligible for election for a further term to any of these offices , but no person shall be eligible for election to the same office for more than two consecutive terms .
Translation: 主席和两位副主席的任期将持续至下一次常规大会召开。他们可以再次被选为上述任何职位，但同一职位连续任职不得超过两届。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The President elected by the General Assembly shall have the title of `` President of the Asia-Pacific Telecommunity '' .
Translation: 8. 由大会选举产生的主席将被授予“亚太电信共同体主席”称号。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The sessions of the General Assembly shall be presided over by the President .
Translation: 9. 大会会议由主席主持。

Query_Text_en: During each session , the date and place of meeting of the next session shall be determined .
Translation: 每次会议期间，应确定下一次会议的日期和地点。

Query_Text_en: 10 . When the President of the General Assembly is for any reason unable to perform his functions under this Article , one of the Vice-Presidents shall perform the functions of the President .
Translation: 10. 当大会主席因任何原因无法履行本条规定的职能时，由一位副主席代行主席职能。

Query_Text_en: 11 . Subject to the provisions of this Constitution , the decisions of the General Assembly shall be made by a simple majority of the Members present and voting , with the exception that decisions on financial matters shall require a two-thirds majority of the Members present and voting .
Translation: 11. 根据本宪章的规定，大会的决议应由出席并投票的成员以简单多数通过，但涉及财务事项的决议须经出席并投票的成员三分之二多数通过。

Query_Text_en: 12 . A quorum for a meeting of the General Assembly shall consist of the representatives of two-thirds of the Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 12. 电信共同体大会会议的法定人数应为三分之二成员的代表。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 The Management Committee1 . The Management Committee shall be composed of all the Members and Associate Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation:
第九条 管理委员会

1. 管理委员会由电信共同体的所有成员和准成员组成。

Query_Text_en: Each Member and Associate Member shall be represented by one representative who may be accompanied by advisers .
Translation: 每个成员和准成员应由一名代表出席，代表可由顾问陪同。

Query_Text_en: Wherever possible representatives shall be qualified in the field of telecommunications and be officials serving in , or directly responsible to or for , the telecommunication administration of the Member or the Associate Member .
Translation: 各成员或准成员的代表应尽可能具备电信领域的专业资格，并应是在其电信主管部门任职的官员，或直接隶属于该部门、对该部门负责或负责该部门工作的官员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member shall have one vote in the Management Committee .
Translation: 每个成员在管理委员会中均拥有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: 3 . An Associate Member shall not have the right to vote in the Management Committee .
Translation: 3. 准会员无权在管理委员会中投票。

Query_Text_en: 4 . An Affiliate Member may participate in the deliberations of the Management Committee as an observer .
Translation: 4．附属会员可作为观察员参加管理委员会的讨论。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] conclude , on behalf of the Telecommunity , provisional agreements between the Telecommunity and Governments , organizations or administrations . Seek approval of the General Assembly and in the intervals between sessions of the General Assembly seek approval , by a simple majority of the Members , by correspondence for agreements thus concluded .
Translation: [h] 代表电信共同体与各国政府、组织或管理机构签署临时协议。此类协议须提交大会批准，在大会闭会期间，应通过通信方式征求全体成员的简单多数同意。

Query_Text_en: Associate Members and Affiliate Members could also be consulted , by correspondence , if necessary ;
Translation: 如有必要，也可通过函件征求准会员和附属会员的意见。

Query_Text_en: [ m ] adopt its own rules of procedure .
Translation: [ m ] 制定本组织的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The Management Committee shall elect a Chairman and two Vice-Chairmen every two years from among the representatives of the Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 6. 管理委员会应每两年从电信共同体成员代表中选举产生一名主席和两名副主席。

Query_Text_en: The Chairman and the two Vice-Chairmen shall each hold office until the holding of the next election .
Translation: 主席和两位副主席的任期将持续至下一次选举举行。

Query_Text_en: They shall be eligible for election for a further term to any of these offices , but no person shall be eligible for election to the same office for more than two consecutive terms .
Translation: 他们可以再次被选举担任上述任何职务，但任何人连续担任同一职务不得超过两届。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] the Chairman considers the holding of such a meeting necessary and two-thirds of the Members agree to be present .
Translation: 或 [b] 主席认为有必要召开此类会议，并且有三分之二的成员同意出席。

Query_Text_en: The Chairman of the Management Committee shall inform the President of the General Assembly if he considers that a matter might be of particular concern to the General Assembly .
Translation: 如管理委员会主席认为某一事项可能特别关系到大会，他应当通知大会主席。

Query_Text_en: 8 . A quorum for a meeting of the Management Committee shall consist of the representatives of two-thirds of the Members of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 8. 管理委员会会议的法定人数应为电信共同体三分之二成员的代表出席。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The decisions of the Management Committee shall be arrived at by consensus .
Translation: 9. 管理委员会的决策应通过协商一致作出。

Query_Text_en: 10 . The Executive Director shall be appointed by the Management Committee on the basis of a selection made from a list of candidates proposed by the Members in a meeting of the representatives of the Members specially convened for this purpose .
Translation: 10. 执行董事应由管理委员会任命，任命依据是在为此专门召开的成员代表会议上，由成员提出的候选人名单中进行遴选。

Query_Text_en: The Deputy-Executive Directors shall be similarly appointed by the Management Committee except that in the meeting held for the selection of Deputy-Executive Directors , the Executive Director may be present and consulted .
Translation: 副执行董事的任命方式与执行董事相同，由管理委员会负责，但在选任副执行董事的会议上，执行董事可以出席并参与咨询。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 The Secretariat1 . The Secretariat of the Telecommunity shall be composed of the Executive Director of the Telecommunity , who shall be the chief administrative officer of the Telecommunity , such number of Deputy-Executive Directors and such other officials as may be deemed necessary by the Management Committee .
Translation:
第十条 秘书处

电信共同体的秘书处由电信共同体执行主任组成，执行主任为电信共同体的首席行政官员，另有若干副执行主任及管理委员会认为必要的其他工作人员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Executive Director and the Deputy-Executive Directors shall hold office for a term of three years . They shall be eligible for re-appointment but shall not hold office for more than two consecutive terms .
Translation: 执行主任和副执行主任的任期为三年。任期届满后可以连任，但不得连续任职超过两届。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Such other officials as may be deemed necessary by the Management Committee shall be appointed by the Executive Director on such terms of service as the Management Committee may determine .
Translation: 3．管理委员会认为必要的其他官员，由执行主任按照管理委员会确定的服务条款予以任命。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] prepare the draft program of work , budget estimates , accounts , annual reports and periodic reports of the Telecommunity for submission to the Management Committee for its consideration and approval .
Translation: [一] 编制电信共同体的工作计划草案、预算估算、账目、年度报告和定期报告，提交管理委员会审议和批准。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] any specific activity as the General Assembly or the Management Committee may approve .
Translation: [ g ] 经大会或管理委员会批准的任何具体活动。

Query_Text_en: 60 , 50 , 40 , 30 , 20 , 10 , 4 , 2 , 1 , 1\/2 . No reduction in a unit classification established in accordance with this Constitution shall take effect between sessions of the General Assembly .
Translation: 60，50，40，30，20，10，4，2，1，1/2。根据本宪法规定设立的单位分类，在州议会休会期间不得进行任何削减。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Extra-budgetary contributions either in cash or in some other form which may be voluntarily made by Members , Associate Members , Affiliate Members and other sources .
Translation: [ b ] 会员、准会员、附属会员及其他来源可自愿以现金或其他形式提供的预算外捐助。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The expenses of the Telecommunity specified in paragraph 1 [ g ] of this Article shall be met from extra-budgetary contributions .
Translation: 3. 本条第1款[g]项所述电信共同体的相关费用，应通过预算外资金予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Members , Associate Members and Affiliate Members shall pay in advance their annual contributory shares , calculated on the basis of the annual budget approved by the Management Committee .
Translation: 会员、准会员和附属会员应根据管理委员会批准的年度预算，提前缴纳其年度分摊费用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . A Member which is in arrears in its payments to the Telecommunity shall lose its right to vote in the General Assembly , the Management Committee and in the subsidiary bodies for so long as the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of contribution due from it for the preceding two years .
Translation: 5. 会员国如拖欠对电信共同体的缴款，且拖欠金额等于或超过其前两年应缴的会费，将在拖欠期间失去在大会、管理委员会及下属机构中的投票权。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Each Member , Associate Member and Affiliate Member shall bear the expenses of its delegations to the General Assembly , to the Management Committee and to any other bodies on which it may be represented .
Translation: 6. 各成员、准成员及附属成员应自行承担其代表团参加大会、管理委员会及其所参与的其他机构的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] institute legal proceedings .
Translation: [ c ] 提起法律诉讼。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Telecommunity shall conclude a headquarters agreement with the Government of Thailand .
Translation: 2. 电信共同体应与泰国政府签订总部协议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Telecommunity and the officials thereof may enjoy , in the territory of each of the Members and Associate Members of the Telecommunity , such privileges and immunities as may be necessary for the exercise of its functions and fulfilment of its objectives as are accorded to the United Nations and the officials thereof under the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations , 1946 , or , at the option of any Member or Associate Member such privileges and immunities as may be defined by agreements concluded between it and the Telecommunity .
Translation: 3. 电信共同体及其官员在各成员国和准成员国境内，可享有为履行其职能和实现其目标所必需的特权与豁免权，这些特权与豁免权应与《联合国特权与豁免公约》（1946年）授予联合国及其官员的相同，或由任何成员国或准成员国选择，通过与电信共同体签订的协议另行规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Relationship with the United Nations and with international and regional organizationsThe Telecommunity shall establish and maintain close relations with the appropriate United Nation bodies and specialized agencies and other appropriate international and regional organizations .
Translation:
第十三条 与联合国及国际和区域组织的关系

电信共同体应与联合国有关机构及专门机构，以及其他相关的国际和区域组织建立并保持密切关系。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 Withdrawal from the Telecommunity1 . Any member or Associate Member of the Telecommunity may withdraw from the Telecommunity by a notification of withdrawal , addressed to the Executive Director .
Translation:
第十四条 退出电信共同体

任何成员或准成员均可通过向执行主任提交退出通知，退出电信共同体。

Query_Text_en: In such a case , any Affiliate Member which has been nominated by the withdrawing Member or Associate Member shall withdraw from the Telecommunity by the above notification .
Translation: 在此情况下，由退出的成员或准成员提名的任何附属成员，应根据上述通知退出该电信共同体。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any Affiliate Member may withdraw from the Telecommunity by a notification addressed to the Executive Director through the Member of Associate Member which has nominated it .
Translation: 2. 任何附属成员可通过提名其为附属成员的成员或准成员，向执行主任提交通知，退出该电信共同体。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Executive Director shall inform all other Members , Associate Members and Affiliate Members of his receipt of the notification , and transmit the notification to the Depositary under Article 16 of this Constitution .
Translation: 3. 执行董事应将收到通知的情况告知所有其他成员、准成员和附属成员，并根据本章程第16条将该通知转交给保管人。

Query_Text_en: 4 . A notification of withdrawal shall take effect on the last day of the same fiscal year if it is received by the Executive Director within the first six months of the fiscal year and one year after the receipt of notification if it is received later .
Translation: 4. 如果撤回通知在财政年度的前六个月内被执行主任收到，则该通知将在同一财政年度的最后一天生效；如果在此之后收到，则将在收到通知一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any Member , Associate Member or Affiliate Member withdrawing from the Telecommunity shall continue to be responsible for the obligations incurred for the period of its membership .
Translation: 任何退出电信共同体的成员、准成员或附属成员，仍须对其在成员期间所产生的义务负责。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Dissolution of the Telecommunity1 . The General Assembly of the Telecommunity may , by a two-thirds majority of the Members present and voting , resolve that the Telecommunity be dissolved .
Translation:
第十五条 电信共同体的解散

电信共同体大会可由出席并投票的成员以三分之二多数通过决议，决定解散电信共同体。

Query_Text_en: 2 . On the approval of such a resolution by two-thirds of the Members of the Telecommunity , in notifications addressed to the Executive Director , the necessary steps shall be taken by the General Assembly for dissolution of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 2. 经电信共同体三分之二成员批准该决议，并向执行主任发出通知后，大会应采取必要措施，解散电信共同体。

Query_Text_en: These steps shall include establishment by the General Assembly of a committee to liquidate the assets of the Telecommunity .
Translation: 这些步骤应包括由大会设立一个委员会，负责清算电信共同体的资产。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The General Assembly shall , at the appropriate stage , adopt a final declaration stating that the Telecommunity is dissolved .
Translation: 3. 大会应在适当阶段通过最终声明，宣布电信共同体解散。

Query_Text_en: The declaration shall be communicated by the Executive Director to the Depositary under Article 16 of this Constitution .
Translation: 该声明应由执行主任根据本宪章第十六条通知保管人。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Depositary of the ConstitutionThis Constitution shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations [ referred to as the `` Depositary '' ] .
Translation:
第十六条 宪章的保存  
本宪章应由联合国秘书长（以下简称“保存人”）保存。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Signature , ratification or acceptance1 . This Constitution shall until its entry into force be open for signature by all those eligible for membership or associate membership of the Telecommunity under paragraph 2 or 4 respectively of Article 3 .
Translation:
第十七条 签署、批准或接受

本章程在生效前，凡根据第三条第二款或第四款有资格成为电信共同体成员或准成员的所有国家，均可签署本章程。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Constitution shall remain open for signature at the secretariat of ESCAP at Bangkok from the first day of April , 1976 , until the thirty-first day of October , 1976 .
Translation: 2. 本宪章自1976年4月1日至1976年10月31日期间，始终在曼谷联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会秘书处开放签署。

Query_Text_en: This Constitution shall thereafter be transmitted to the Secretary-General of the United Nations , and shall until its entry into force be open for signature at the Headquarters of the United Nations , New York [ 2 ] , where it will remain in deposit .
Translation: 本宪章随后将提交联合国秘书长，并在其生效前，于联合国纽约总部开放签署，并在该处保存。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Depositary shall send certified copies of this Constitution to all States and all associate members of ESCAP eligible for membership in the Telecommunity under paragraph 2 or 4 of Article 3 .
Translation: 3. 保管机构应将本宪章的经认证副本发送给所有国家以及根据第三条第2款或第4款有资格加入电信共同体的所有亚太经社会准成员。

Query_Text_en: 4 . This Constitution shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatories .
Translation: 4. 本宪章须经签署方批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification or acceptance shall be deposited with the Depositary who shall notify the other signatories of each deposit and the date thereof .
Translation: 批准书或接受书应交存于保管人，由保管人通知其他签署方每一份交存及其日期。

Query_Text_en: Any other signatory who complies with the provisions of the preceding paragraph , shall become a Member or Associate Member of the Telecommunity on the thirtieth day after the date on which its instrument of ratification or acceptance is deposited .
Translation: 任何其他签署方，凡遵守前款规定者，自其交存批准书或接受书之日起第三十天，成为该电信共同体的成员或准成员。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Entry into forceThis Constitution shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the deposit of instruments of ratification or acceptance with the Depositary , by seven signatory States that are eligible for membership in the Telecommunity under paragraph 2 of Article 3 , including Thailand , the country in which the headquarters of the Telecommunity shall be .
Translation:
第十八条 生效  
本宪章自七个符合第三条第二款规定、具备加入电信共同体资格的签署国（包括电信共同体总部所在地泰国）向保管人交存批准或接受文书之日起第三十天生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Accession1 . Any State eligible for membership in the Telecommunity under paragraph 2 or 3 of Article 3 and any associate member of ESCAP may , after the entry into force of this Constitution , accede to this Constitution by deposit of an instrument of accession with the Depositary .
Translation:
第十九条 加入

凡符合本宪章第三条第二款或第三款规定的电信共同体成员资格的国家，以及联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会的准成员，在本宪章生效后，均可通过向保管人提交加入书的方式加入本宪章。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The instrument of accession shall become effective on the thirtieth day after the date of its deposit .
Translation: 2. 加入书应自交存之日起第三十天生效。

Query_Text_en: The Depositary shall notify the Members , Associate Members and Affiliate Members of each accession when it is received .
Translation: 保存人应在收到加入文件时，通知所有成员、准成员和附属成员。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Associate Members of ESCAPIf an associate member of ESCAP is not fully responsible for the conduct of its international relations and if the Government of the State responsible for the conduct of the international relations of that associate member , does not accede to or is not eligible to accede to this Constitution on the associate member 's behalf , the associate member shall at the time of acceding to this Constitution present an instrument issued by the Government of the State responsible for the conduct of the international relations of the associate member confirming that the associate member has authority to be a party to , and to assume rights and obligations under , this Constitution .
Translation:
第二十条 亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会准成员

如亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会的准成员未能完全负责其国际关系事务，且负责该准成员国际关系的国家政府未代表该准成员加入或无资格代表其加入本宪章，则该准成员在加入本宪章时，须提交由负责其国际关系的国家政府出具的文件，确认该准成员有权成为本宪章的缔约方，并承担本宪章项下的权利与义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Inaugural meetings of the General Assembly and the Management Committee of the TelecommunityWithin three months of entry into force of this Constitution , the Executive Secretary of ESCAP shall convene , in consultation with the Government of Thailand , inaugural meetings of the General Assembly and the Management Committee of the Telecommunity provided that such meetings shall not be held before the first day of August , 1977 .
Translation:
第二十一条 电信共同体大会和管理委员会的首次会议

本章程生效后三个月内，联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会执行秘书应与泰国政府协商，召集电信共同体大会和管理委员会的首次会议，但该等会议不得早于1977年8月1日召开。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Amendment of the Constitution1 . Any Member may propose amendments to this Constitution .
Translation:
第二十二条 宪章修正  
任何成员均可提出对本宪章的修正建议。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Adoption of an amendment to this Constitution shall require a two-thirds majority of the Members present and voting in the General Assembly .
Translation: 2. 本宪章的任何修正案须经大会出席并投票的成员三分之二多数通过方可采纳。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The amendments shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the deposit with the Depositary of instruments of ratification or acceptance of such amendments by two-thirds of the Members .
Translation: 3. 修正案应在三分之二成员向保存人交存批准书或接受书后三十日生效。

Query_Text_en: IN FAITH WHEREOF the undersigned , having been duly authorized to this effect by their respective Governments , have signed this Constitution on the dates appearing opposite their signatures .
Translation: 为此，以下签署人经各自政府正式授权，已于其签名所示日期签署本宪章。

Query_Text_en: The General Conference of the International Labor Organisation , Having been convened at Geneva by the Governing Body of the International Labor Office , and having met in its Ninth Session on 7 June 1926 , andHaving decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to seamen 's articles of agreement , which is included in the first item of the agenda of the Session , andHaving determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention , adopts this twenty-fourth day of June of the year one thousand nine hundred and twenty-six the following Convention , which may be cited as the Seamen 's Articles of Agreement Convention , 1926 , for ratification by the Members of the International Labor Organisation in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation :
Translation: 国际劳工组织大会经国际劳工局理事会召集，于1926年6月7日在日内瓦举行第九届会议，并决定就本届会议议程第一项所列的海员雇佣合同问题，采纳若干建议，并认定这些建议应采取国际公约的形式，特于一九二六年六月二十四日通过下列公约，定名为《1926年海员雇佣合同公约》，提交国际劳工组织各会员国依照国际劳工组织宪章的规定予以批准：

Query_Text_en: Article 11 . This Convention shall apply to all sea-going vessels registered in the country of any Member ratifying this Convention and to the owners , masters and seamen of such vessels .
Translation: 第十一条 本公约适用于所有在任何批准本公约成员国注册的海船，以及该类船舶的船东、船长和船员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . It shall not apply to [ a ] ships of war , [ b ] Government vessels not engaged in trade , [ c ] vessels engaged in the coasting trade , [ d ] pleasure yachts , [ e ] Indian country craft , [ f ] fishing vessels , [ g ] vessels of less than 100 tons gross registered tonnage or 300 cubic metres , nor to vessels engaged in the home trade below the tonnage limit prescribed by national law for the special regulation of this trade at the date of the passing of this Convention .
Translation: 2. 本公约不适用于以下船舶：[a] 军舰，[b] 未从事贸易的政府船舶，[c] 从事沿海贸易的船舶，[d] 游艇，[e] 印度本地船只，[f] 渔船，[g] 总登记吨位不足100吨或容积不足300立方米的船舶，以及在本公约通过之日，按国家法律规定的吨位限制以下、受特殊规定的本地贸易船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the term vessel includes any ship or boat of any nature whatsoever , whether publicly or privately owned , ordinarily engaged in maritime navigation ;
