Translation: 第二十三条 世界遗产委员会还可以向国家或区域培训中心提供国际援助，用于各级人员和专家在文化和自然遗产的识别、保护、保存、展示和修复等领域的培训。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 International assistance on a large scale shall be preceded by detailed scientific , economic and technical studies .
Translation: 第二十四条 大规模国际援助应以详尽的科学、经济和技术研究为前提。

Query_Text_en: These studies shall draw upon the most advanced techniques for the protection , conservation , presentation and rehabilitation of the natural and cultural heritage and shall be consistent with the objectives of this Convention .
Translation: 这些研究应采用最先进的自然和文化遗产保护、保存、展示与修复技术，并应符合本公约的宗旨。

Query_Text_en: The studies shall also seek means of making rational use of the resources available in the State concerned .
Translation: 这些研究还应探索合理利用相关国家现有资源的途径。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 As a general rule , only part of the cost of work necessary shall be borne by the international community .
Translation: 第二十五条 一般情况下，国际社会只承担必要工作费用的一部分。

Query_Text_en: The contribution of the State benefiting from international assistance shall constitute a substantial share of the resources devoted to each program or project , unless its resources do not permit this .
Translation: 接受国际援助的国家应为每项计划或项目投入大量资源，除非其自身资源无法满足这一要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 The World Heritage Committee and the recipient State shall define in the agreement they conclude the conditions in which a program or project for which international assistance under the terms of this Convention is provided , shall be carried out .
Translation: 第二十六条 世界遗产委员会与受援国应在所签订的协议中明确规定，根据本公约提供国际援助的项目或计划的实施条件。

Query_Text_en: It shall be the responsibility of the State receiving such international assistance to continue to protect , conserve and present the property so safeguarded , in observance of the conditions laid down by the agreement .
Translation: 接受此类国际援助的国家有责任根据协议规定的条件，继续保护、保存并展示所受保护的遗产。

Query_Text_en: Article 27The States Parties to this Convention shall endeavor by all appropriate means , and in particular by educational and information programs , to strengthen appreciation and respect by their peoples of the cultural and natural heritage defined in Articles 1 and 2 of the Convention .
Translation: 第二十七条 缔约国应通过一切适当方式，特别是通过教育和宣传项目，努力增强本国人民对本公约第一条和第二条所界定的文化和自然遗产的认同与尊重。

Query_Text_en: They shall undertake to keep the public broadly informed of the dangers threatening this heritage and of the activities carried on in pursuance of this Convention .
Translation: 他们应承诺广泛向公众通报威胁这一遗产的各种危险，以及根据本公约开展的相关活动。

Query_Text_en: Article 28States Parties to this Convention which receive international assistance under the Convention shall take appropriate measures to make known the importance of the property for which assistance has been received and the role played by such assistance .
Translation:
第二十八条  
接受本公约项下国际援助的缔约国，应采取适当措施，宣传所获援助财产的重要性及该援助所发挥的作用。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 The States Parties to this Convention shall , in the reports which they submit to the General Conference of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization on dates and in a manner to be determined by it , give information on the legislative and administrative provisions which they have adopted and other action which they have taken for the application of this Convention , together with details of the experience acquired in this field .
Translation: 第二十九条 缔约国应按照联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会所确定的时间和方式，在其提交的报告中，提供其为实施本公约所采取的立法和行政措施及其他行动的信息，并详细说明在该领域所获得的经验。

Query_Text_en: These reports shall be brought to the attention of the World Heritage Committee .
Translation: 这些报告应提交世界遗产委员会审议。

Query_Text_en: The Committee shall submit a report on its activities at each of the ordinary sessions of the General Conference of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 委员会应在联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会的每一届常会期间提交其活动报告。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 This Convention is drawn up in Arabic , English , French , Russian and Spanish , the five texts being equally authoritative .
Translation: 第三十条 本公约以阿拉伯文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文制定，五种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by States members of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures .
Translation: 第三十一条 本公约须经联合国教育、科学及文化组织成员国按照各自的宪法程序予以批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification or acceptance shall be deposited with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 批准书或接受书应交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 This Convention shall be open to accession by all States not members of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization which are invited by the General Conference of the Organization to accede to it .
Translation: 第三十二条 本公约对所有并非法国联合国教育、科学及文化组织成员国、但经该组织大会邀请加入本公约的国家开放加入。

Query_Text_en: Accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument of accession with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 加入应通过向联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事交存加入书的方式完成。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 This Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of the deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession , but only with respect to those States which have deposited their respective instruments of ratification , acceptance or accession on or before that date .
Translation: 第三十三条 本公约应自第二十份批准书、接受书或加入书交存之日起三个月后生效，但仅对在该日期前已交存各自批准书、接受书或加入书的国家生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall enter into force with respect to any other State three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession .
Translation: 本协定对任何其他国家自其交存批准书、接受书或加入书后三个月生效。

Query_Text_en: with regard to the provisions of this Convention , the implementation of which comes under the legal jurisdiction of individual constituent States , countries , provinces or cantons that are not obliged by the constitutional system of the federation to take legislative measures , the federal government shall inform the competent authorities of such States , countries , provinces or cantons of the said provisions , with its recommendation for their adoption .
Translation: 对于本公约中属于各成员州、国家、省或州（canton）法律管辖范围的条款，若联邦宪法体系未要求其采取立法措施，联邦政府应将相关条款及其采纳建议通知上述州、国家、省或州的主管部门。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Each State Party to this Convention may denounce the Convention .
Translation: 第三十五条 每一缔约国均可宣布退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall be notified by an instrument in writing , deposited with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 废止声明应以书面形式提交，并交由联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事保存。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall take effect twelve months after the receipt of the instrument of denunciation . It shall not affect the financial obligations of the denouncing State until the date on which the withdrawal takes effect .
Translation: 退出声明自收到退出文件之日起十二个月后生效。在退出生效之前，退出国的财务义务不受影响。

Query_Text_en: Article 36The Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization shall inform the States members of the Organization , the States not members of the Organization which are referred to in Article 32 , as well as the United Nations , of the deposit of all the instruments of ratification , acceptance , or accession provided for in Articles 31 and 32 , and of the denunciations provided for in Article 35 .
Translation: 第三十六条 联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事应将根据第三十一条和第三十二条规定提交的所有批准书、接受书或加入书的存放情况，以及根据第三十五条规定的退出通知，告知该组织成员国、第三十二条所述的非成员国以及联合国。

Query_Text_en: Article 37This Convention may be revised by the General Conference of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 第三十七条 本公约可由联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会修订。

Query_Text_en: Any such revision shall , however , bind only the States which shall become Parties to the revising convention .
Translation: 但任何此类修订仅对成为修订公约缔约方的国家具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: If the General Conference should adopt a new convention revising this Convention in whole or in part , then , unless the new convention otherwise provides , this Convention shall cease to be open to ratification , acceptance or accession , as from the date on which the new revising convention enters into force .
Translation: 如果大会通过一项对本公约进行全部或部分修订的新公约，则除非新公约另有规定，自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约将不再开放供批准、接受或加入。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 In conformity with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations , this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization .
Translation: 第三十八条 根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条的规定，本公约应由联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事请求，在联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: Done in Paris , this twenty-third day of November 1972 , in two authentic copies bearing the signature of the President of the seventeenth session of the General Conference and of the Director-General of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization , which shall be deposited in the archives of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization , and certified true copies of which shall be delivered to all the States referred to in Articles 31 and 32 as well as to the United Nations .
Translation: 本文件于1972年11月23日在巴黎签署，共两份正本，由第十七届大会主席和联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事签署，存放于联合国教育、科学及文化组织档案中，并将向第三十一条和第三十二条所述各国及联合国颁发经认证的副本。

Query_Text_en: This convention shall go into force on 16 March 1923 .
Translation: 本公约自1923年3月16日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Having decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to the supervision of articles of agreement ; provision of facilities for finding employment for seamen ; application to seamen of the Convention and Recommendations adopted at Washington in November last in regard to unemployment and unemployment insurance , which is the second item in the agenda for the Genoa meeting of the Conference , and Having determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention , adopts the following Convention , which may be cited as the Unemployment Indemnity [ Shipwreck ] Convention , 1920 , for ratification by the Members of the International Labor Organization in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the International Labor Organization :
Translation: 鉴于已决定采纳关于监督协议条款、为海员提供就业便利、以及将去年十一月在华盛顿通过的有关失业及失业保险的公约和建议适用于海员的若干提案（该事项为国际劳工大会热那亚会议议程的第二项），并已确定上述提案应以国际公约的形式制定，特此通过以下公约，简称《1920年失业补偿（船舶遇难）公约》，以供国际劳工组织成员根据国际劳工组织宪章的规定予以批准：

Query_Text_en: Article 1 1 . For the purpose of this Convention , the term `` seamen '' includes all persons employed on any vessel engaged in maritime navigation .
Translation: 第一条1款：本公约所称“海员”，是指在任何从事海上航行的船舶上受雇的所有人员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purpose of this Convention , the term `` vessel '' includes all ships and boats , of any nature whatsoever , engaged in maritime navigation , whether publicly or privately owned ; it excludes ships of war .
Translation: 2. 本公约所称“船舶”，包括一切从事海上航行的各类船只和艇只，无论其性质如何，无论公有或私有；但不包括军舰。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . In every case of loss or foundering of any vessel , the owner or person with whom the seaman has contracted for service on board the vessel shall pay to each seaman employed thereon an indemnity against unemployment resulting from such loss or foundering .
Translation:
第二条  
1. 在任何船舶发生损失或沉没的情况下，船东或与船员签订船上服务合同的相关人员，应向每一位受雇于该船的船员支付因该损失或沉没导致失业的补偿金。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This indemnity shall be paid for the days during which the seaman remains in fact unemployed at the same rate as the wages payable under the contract , but the total indemnity payable under this Convention to any one seaman may be limited to two months '' wages .
Translation: 2. 该赔偿金应按合同规定的工资标准，支付给实际处于失业状态的海员，支付天数以海员实际失业天数为准。但根据本公约，任何一名海员所获赔偿金总额可限定为两个月工资。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Seamen shall have the same remedies for recovering such indemnities as they have for recovering arrears of wages earned during the service .
Translation:
第三条  
海员在追索此类赔偿时，享有与追索服务期间所获工资欠款相同的救济途径。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] subject to such modifications as may be necessary to adapt its provisions to local conditions .
Translation: 或 [ b ] 根据当地情况作出必要调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member shall notify to the International Labor Office the action taken in respect of each of its colonies , protectorates and possessions which are not fully self-governing .
Translation: 每一成员国应将其对尚未完全自治的殖民地、保护地和属地所采取的措施，通知国际劳工局。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 The formal ratifications of this Convention , under the conditions set forth in the Constitution of the International Labor Organization , shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第五条 本公约的正式批准，应按照国际劳工组织章程规定的条件，通知国际劳工局局长登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 As soon as the ratifications of two Members of the International Labor Organization have been registered with the International Labor Office , the Director-General of the International Labor Office shall so notify all the Members of the International Labor Organization .
Translation:
第六条  
一旦有两个国际劳工组织成员国的批准书在国际劳工局登记，国际劳工局局长应将此情况通知所有国际劳工组织成员国。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 This Convention shall come into force at the date on which such notification is issued by the Director-General of the International Labor Office , and it shall then be binding only upon those Members which have registered their ratifications with the International Labor Office .
Translation: 第七条 本公约自国际劳工局局长发布相关通知之日起生效，并且仅对已向国际劳工局登记批准书的成员国具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter this Convention will come into force for any other Member at the date on which its ratification is registered with the International Labor Office .
Translation: 此后，本公约对任何其他成员国自其批准书在国际劳工局登记之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Subject to the provisions of Article 7 , each Member which ratifies this Convention agrees to bring its provisions into operation not later than 1 July 1922 , and to take such action as may be necessary to make these provisions effective .
Translation:
第八条  
在遵守第七条规定的前提下，每一批准本公约的成员同意最迟于1922年7月1日使本公约的各项规定生效，并采取一切必要措施确保这些规定得到切实执行。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 A Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of five years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force , by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation:
第九条  
任何已批准本公约的成员国，可在本公约首次生效之日起五年期满后，通过向国际劳工局局长提交声明予以登记的方式，宣布退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Governments signatory to the present Convention , Considering it advisable to secure the highest degree of harmony and uniformity in their Customs systems and especially to study the problems inherent in the development and improvement of Customs technique and Customs legislation in connection therewith , Convinced that it will be in the interest of international trade to promote co - operation between Governments in these matters , bearing in mind the economic and technical factors involved therein , Have agreed as follows :
Translation: 本公约签署国，鉴于有必要在各自海关制度中实现最高程度的协调与统一，特别是研究与海关技术和相关立法发展与完善有关的问题，深信促进各国政府在上述领域的合作符合国际贸易的利益，并充分考虑其中涉及的经济和技术因素，兹协议如下：

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the Government of any separate Customs territory which is proposed by a Contracting Party having responsibility for the formal conduct of its diplomatic relations , which is autonomous in the conduct of its external commercial relations and whose admission as a separate Member is approved by the Council .
Translation: [ ii ] 由缔约方提议、负责其外交事务的任何独立关税区政府，该关税区在对外贸易关系方面具有自主权，并经理事会批准作为独立成员加入。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Government of any separate Customs territory , which is a Member of the Council under paragraph [ a ] [ ii ] above , shall cease to be a Member on notification to the Council of the withdrawal of its membership by the Contracting Party having responsibility for the formal conduct of its diplomatic relations .
Translation: 任何根据上述[a][ii]条款成为理事会成员的单独关税区政府，在负责其外交事务的缔约方通知理事会撤回其成员资格时，将不再是理事会成员。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Each Member shall nominate one delegate and one or more alternates to be its representatives on the Council . These representatives may be assisted by advisers . [ d ] The Council may admit representatives of non - Member Governments or of international organizations in the capacity of observers .
Translation:
[ c ] 每一成员应指定一名代表及一名或多名候补代表，作为其在理事会的代表。这些代表可由顾问协助。

[ d ] 理事会可接纳非成员国政府或国际组织的代表以观察员身份列席。

Query_Text_en: the parties in dispute may agree in advance to accept the recommendations of the Council as binding ; [ f ] to ensure the circulation of information regarding Customs regulations and procedures ; [ g ] on its own initiative or on request , to furnish to interested Governments information or advice on Customs matters within the general purposes of the present Convention and to make recommendations thereon ; [ h ] to co - operate with other inter - governmental organizations as regards matters within its competence . Article IV The Members of the Council shall supply to the Council any information and documentation requested by it which is necessary for the execution of its functions provided that no Member shall be required to divulge confidential information , the disclosure of which would impede the enforcement of its laws , or which would otherwise be contrary to the public interest or prejudice the legitimate commercial interests of any enterprise , public or private .
Translation:
争议各方可事先同意将理事会的建议视为具有约束力；  
[f] 确保有关海关法规和程序的信息流通；  
[g] 主动或应请求，向有关政府提供与本公约宗旨相关的海关事务信息或建议，并就此提出建议；  
[h] 就其职权范围内的事项与其他政府间组织进行合作。

第四条  
理事会成员应向理事会提供其为履行职能所要求的任何信息和文件，但任何成员均无义务披露属于机密的信息，若披露该信息将妨碍其法律的执行，或有悖于公共利益，或损害任何公私企业的合法商业利益。

Query_Text_en: Article V The Council shall be assisted by a Permanent Technical Committee and a General Secretariat .
Translation: 第五条 理事会应由常设技术委员会和秘书处协助其工作。

Query_Text_en: Article VI [ a ] The Council shall elect annually , from among the delegates of Members , a Chairman and not less than two Vice - Chairmen .
Translation: 第六条 [a] 理事会应每年从成员国代表中选举一名主席和不少于两名副主席。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] It shall establish its own Rules of Procedure by a majority of not less than two - thirds of its Members .
Translation: [ b ] 它应由不少于三分之二多数的成员制定自己的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] It shall establish a Nomenclature Committee as provided in the Convention on Nomenclature for the Classification of Goods in Customs Tariffs and a Valuation Committee as provided in the Convention on the Valuation of Goods for Customs Purposes .
Translation: [ c ] 它应根据《关税商品分类命名公约》设立命名委员会，并根据《海关估价公约》设立估价委员会。

Query_Text_en: It shall also establish such other committees as may be desirable for the purposes of the Conventions referred to in Article III [ d ] or for any other purposes within its competence .
Translation: 它还应根据第三条[d]所述公约的需要，或为其职权范围内的其他目的，设立其他委员会。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] It shall determine the tasks to be assigned to the Permanent Technical Committee and the powers to be delegated to it .
Translation: 它应决定交由常设技术委员会的任务以及授予其的权限。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] It shall approve its annual budget , control its expenditure and give such directions as it may consider desirable regarding its finances to the General Secretariat .
Translation: [e] 它应批准其年度预算，控制其支出，并就其财务向秘书处提出其认为适当的指示。

Query_Text_en: Article VII [ a ] The Headquarters of the Council shall be in Brussels .
Translation: 第七条 [a] 理事会总部设在布鲁塞尔。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Council , the Permanent Technical Committee and any committees established by the Council may meet elsewhere than at the Headquarters of the Council , if the Council so decides .
Translation: [ b ] 经理事会决定，理事会、常设技术委员会及理事会设立的任何委员会可在理事会总部以外的地点召开会议。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The Council shall meet at least twice a year .
Translation: [ c ] 理事会每年至少召开两次会议。

Query_Text_en: Its first meeting shall take place not later than three months after the entry into force of the present Convention .
Translation: 其首次会议应在本公约生效之日起三个月内召开。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII [ a ] Each Member of the Council shall have one vote except that a Member shall not have a vote on any question relating to the interpretation , application or amendment of any of the Conventions referred to in Article III [ d ] which is in force and which does not apply to that Member .
Translation: 第八条 [a] 理事会每个成员均有一票表决权，但对于第三条 [d] 所提及、已生效且不适用于该成员的任何公约的解释、适用或修订相关问题，该成员无表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Except as provided in Article VI [ b ] the decisions of the Council shall be taken by a majority of two - thirds of the Members present and entitled to vote .
Translation: 除第六条[b]另有规定外，理事会的决议须经出席并有表决权的成员三分之二多数通过。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall not take a decision on any matter unless more than half of the Members entitled to vote on that matter are present .
Translation: 理事会在任何事项上作出决定时，须有超过半数有权就该事项投票的成员出席，方可进行表决。

Query_Text_en: Article IX [ a ] The Council shall establish such relations with the United Nations , its principal organs , subsidiary bodies and specialized agencies , and any other inter - governmental organizations , as may best assure collaboration in the achievement of their respective tasks .
Translation: 第九条 [a] 理事会应与联合国及其主要机构、附属机构、专门机构，以及其他任何政府间组织建立适当关系，以促进各自任务的协作与实现。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Council may make arrangements necessary to facilitate consultation and cooperation with non - governmental organizations interested in matters within its competence .
Translation: [ b ] 理事会可作出必要安排，以便就其职权范围内相关事务与有关的非政府组织进行协商与合作。

Query_Text_en: Article X [ a ] The Permanent Technical Committee shall be composed of representatives of the Members of the Council .
Translation: 第X条 [a] 常设技术委员会由理事会成员的代表组成。

Query_Text_en: Each Member of the Council may nominate one delegate and one or more alternates to be its representatives on the Committee .
Translation: 理事会每一成员均可提名一名代表及一名或多名候补代表，作为其在委员会中的代表。

Query_Text_en: Representatives shall be officials specialized in technical Customs matters . They may be assisted by experts .
Translation: 代表应为专门从事海关技术事务的官员，并可由专家协助。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Permanent Technical Committee shall meet not less than four times a year .
Translation: 常设技术委员会每年召开会议不少于四次。

Query_Text_en: Article XI [ a ] The Council shall appoint a Secretary General and a Deputy Secretary General whose functions , duties , conditions of service and terms of office shall be determined by the Council .
Translation: 第十一条 [a] 理事会应任命秘书长和副秘书长，其职能、职责、服务条件及任期由理事会决定。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Secretary General shall appoint the staff of the General Secretariat .
Translation: [ b ] 秘书长应任命秘书处工作人员。

Query_Text_en: The establishment and staff regulations shall be approved by the Council .
Translation: 编制和人员规定须经理事会批准。

Query_Text_en: Article XII [ a ] Each Member shall bear the expenses of its own delegation to the Council , to the Permanent Technical Committee and to any committees of the Council .
Translation: 第十二条 [a] 各成员应自行承担其代表团参加理事会、常设技术委员会及理事会任何委员会的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The expenses of the Council shall be borne by its Members in accordance with a scale to be determined by the Council .
Translation: [ b ] 理事会的费用应由其成员按照理事会确定的比例分担。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The Council may deprive of its voting rights any Member which does not pay its contribution within three months of being notified of the amount thereof .
Translation: [ c ] 理事会可剥夺任何在被通知缴纳会费金额后三个月内未支付会费的成员的投票权。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Each Member shall pay its full annual contribution for the financial year during which it becomes a Member of the Council and for the financial year during which its notice of withdrawal becomes effective .
Translation: 每一成员应全额缴纳其成为理事会成员当年及其退出通知生效当年的全年会费。

Query_Text_en: Article XIII [ a ] The Council shall enjoy , in the territory of each of its Members , such legal capacity , as defined in the Annex to the present Convention , as may be necessary for the exercise of its functions .
Translation: 第十三条 [a] 理事会在每一成员国境内，应享有本公约附件所规定的、为履行其职能所必需的法律地位。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Council , the representatives of Members , the advisers and experts appointed to assist them , and the officials of the Council shall enjoy the privileges and immunities specified in the Annex to the present Convention .
Translation: [ b ] 理事会、成员代表、协助他们的顾问和专家，以及理事会官员，应享有本公约附件中规定的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The Annex to the present Convention shall form an integral part thereof , and any reference to the Convention shall be deemed to include a reference to the Annex .
Translation: 本公约的附件为其不可分割的组成部分，对本公约的任何提及均应视为包括对该附件的提及。

Query_Text_en: Article XIV The Contracting Parties accept the provisions of the Protocol concerning the European Customs Union Study Group opened for signature at Brussels on the same date as the present Convention .
Translation: 第十四条 缔约方接受与本公约同日于布鲁塞尔开放签署的《关于欧洲关税同盟研究小组的议定书》中的各项规定。

Query_Text_en: In determining the scale of contributions provided for in Article XII [ b ] , the Council shall take into consideration membership of the Study Group .
Translation: 在确定第十二条[b]所规定的缴费规模时，理事会应考虑研究小组的成员情况。

Query_Text_en: Article XV The present Convention shall be open for signature until 31 March , 1951 .
Translation: 第十五条 本公约自签署之日起至1951年3月31日止对各方开放签署。

Query_Text_en: Article XVI [ a ] The present Convention shall be subject to ratification . [ b ] Instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs , which shall notify all signatory and acceding Governments and the Secretary General of each such deposit .
Translation:
第十六条  
[a] 本公约须经批准。  
[b] 批准书应交存比利时外交部，由其通知所有签署和加入的政府以及秘书长每一次交存情况。

Query_Text_en: Article XVII [ a ] When instruments of ratification have been deposited by seven of the signatory Governments , the present Convention shall come into force between them .
Translation: 第十七条 [a] 当七个签署国交存了批准书后，本公约即在这些国家之间生效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] For each signatory Government ratifying thereafter the present Convention shall come into force upon deposit of its instrument of ratification .
Translation: 对于此后批准本公约的每一签署国，本公约自其交存批准书之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIII [ a ] The Government of any State which is not a signatory to the present Convention may accede thereto as from 1 April , 1951 .
Translation: 第十八条 [a] 任何尚未签署本公约的国家政府，自1951年4月1日起均可加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs , which shall notify all signatory and acceding Governments and the Secretary General of each such deposit .
Translation: 加入书的交存应提交比利时外交部，由其通知所有签署和加入本协定的政府以及秘书长每一次交存情况。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The present Convention shall come into force for any acceding Government on the deposit of its instrument of accession , but not before it comes into force in accordance with paragraph [ a ] of Article XVII .
Translation: 本公约对任何加入政府自其交存加入书之日起生效，但不得早于根据第十七条第[a]款规定生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: Article XIX The present Convention is of unlimited duration , but at any time after the expiry of five years from its entry into force under paragraph [ a ] of Article XVII , any Contracting Party may withdraw therefrom .
Translation: 第十九条 本公约为无限期有效，但自根据第十七条[a]款生效满五年后，任何缔约方均可随时退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: Withdrawal shall take effect one year after the date of receipt by the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the notification of withdrawal .
Translation: 退出将在比利时外交部收到退出通知之日起一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: The Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall notify each withdrawal to all signatory and acceding Governments and to the Secretary General .
Translation: 比利时外交部应将每一次退出的情况通知所有签署国、加入国以及秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article XX [ a ] The Council may recommend amendments to the present Convention to the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第二十条 [a] 理事会可向缔约方建议修改本公约。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Contracting Party accepting an amendment shall notify the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs in writing of its acceptance and the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall notify all signatory and acceding Governments and the Secretary General of the receipt of the notice of acceptance .
Translation: [ b ] 任何缔约方接受修正案时，应以书面形式通知比利时外交部，比利时外交部应将收到接受通知的情况通报所有签署国、加入国及秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] An amendment shall come into force three months after receipt by the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs of notice of acceptance by all the Contracting Parties .
Translation: [ c ] 修正案应在比利时外交部收到所有缔约方接受通知后三个月生效。

Query_Text_en: When any amendment has been accepted by all the Contracting Parties the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall notify all signatory and acceding Governments and the Secretary General of such acceptance and of the date on which the amendment will come into force .
Translation: 一旦所有缔约方接受任何修正案，比利时外交部应将该修正案的接受情况及其生效日期通知所有签署和加入的政府以及秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] After an amendment has come into force , no Government may ratify or accede to the present Convention unless it also accepts the amendment .
Translation: [ d ] 修正案生效后，任何政府在批准或加入本公约时，必须同时接受该修正案。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof the undersigned , having been duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 为此， 下列签署人经各自政府正式授权，已签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: Done at Brussels on the fifteenth day of December , nineteen hundred and fifty [ December 15 , 1950 ] in the English and French languages , both texts being equally authentic , in a single original , which shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of Belgium which shall transmit certified copies thereof to each signatory and acceding Government .
Translation: 本文件于一九五零年十二月十五日在布鲁塞尔以英文和法文签署，两种文本具有同等效力，原件一份，存放于比利时政府档案馆，由比利时政府向各签署国及加入国发送经认证的副本。

Query_Text_en: The General Conference of the International Labor Organisation , Having been convened at Geneva by the Governing Body of the International Labor Office , and having met in its Third Session on 25 October 1921 , and Having decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to the prohibition of the employment of any person under the age of eighteen years as trimmer or stoker , which is included in the eighth item of the agenda of the Session , and Having determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention , adopts the following Convention , which may be cited as the Minimum Age [ Trimmers and Stokers ] Convention , 1921 , for ratification by the Members of the International Labor Organisation in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation :
Translation: 国际劳工组织大会由国际劳工局理事会召集，于1921年10月25日在日内瓦举行第三届会议。大会决定就禁止雇用未满十八岁人员担任加煤工或司炉工的问题，采纳若干建议，该议题列为本届会议议程第八项。大会并决定将上述建议以国际公约形式通过，特此通过以下公约，定名为《最低年龄（加煤工及司炉工）公约，1921年》，供国际劳工组织成员根据国际劳工组织章程的规定批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 For the purpose of this Convention , the term [ vessel ] includes all ships and boats , of any nature whatsoever , engaged in maritime navigation , whether publicly or privately owned ; it excludes ships of war .
Translation: 第一条 本公约所称“船舶”，包括所有从事海上航行的船只和艇，不论其性质如何，无论公有或私有；但不包括军舰。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Young persons under the age of eighteen years shall not be employed or work on vessels as trimmers or stokers .
Translation: 第二条 未满十八周岁的青少年不得在船舶上担任煤工或司炉工，也不得从事相关工作。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] to young persons of not less than sixteen years of age , who , if found physically fit after medical examination , may be employed as trimmers or stokers on vessels exclusively engaged in the coastal trade of India and of Japan , subject to regulations made after consultation with the most representative organizations of employers and workers in those countries .
Translation: [ c ] 年满十六岁的青年，经体检确认身体健康后，可在印度和日本专门从事沿海贸易的船舶上担任加煤工或司炉工，但须遵守经与两国最具代表性的雇主和工人组织协商制定的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 When a trimmer or stoker is required in a port where young persons of less than eighteen years of age only are available , such young persons may be employed and in that case it shall be necessary to engage two young persons in place of the trimmer or stoker required . Such young persons shall be at least sixteen years of age .
Translation: 第四条 如果在某港口仅有未满十八岁的青年可供雇用，而需要配备煤工或司炉工时，可以雇用这些青年，但必须以两名青年替代所需的煤工或司炉工。所雇用的青年须年满十六岁。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 In order to facilitate the enforcement of the provisions of this Convention , every shipmaster shall be required to keep a register of all persons under the age of eighteen years employed on board his vessel , or a list of them in the articles of agreement , and of the dates of their births .
Translation: 第五条 为便于本公约条款的执行，每一船长均须保存一份本船雇用的所有未满十八周岁人员的登记册，或在雇佣协议中列明其名单及出生日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Articles of agreement shall contain a brief summary of the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第六条  
协议条款应简要概述本公约的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 The formal ratifications of this Convention , under the conditions set forth in the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation , shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第七条 本公约的正式批准，应按照国际劳工组织章程规定的条件，通知国际劳工局局长登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 1 . This Convention shall come into force at the date on which the ratifications of two Members of the International Labor Organisation have been registered by the Director-General .
Translation: 第八条 第一款：本公约自国际劳工组织两名成员的批准书由总干事登记之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Thereafter , the Convention shall come into force for any member at the date on which its ratification has been registered with the International Labor Office .
Translation: 3. 此后，本公约对任何成员自其批准书在国际劳工局登记之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 As soon as the ratifications of two Members of the International Labor Organisation have been registered with the International Labor Office , the Director-General of the International Labor Office shall so notify all the Members of the International Labor Organisation . He shall likewise notify them of the registration of the ratifications which may be communicated subsequently by other Members of the Organisation .
Translation: 第九条 一旦国际劳工组织两个成员国的批准书在国际劳工局登记，国际劳工局局长应将此情况通知所有国际劳工组织成员国。对于其他成员国随后提交的批准书登记情况，局长也应同样予以通知。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Subject to the provisions of Article 8 , each Member which ratifies this Convention agrees to bring the provisions of Articles 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 and 6 into operation not later than 1 January 1924 and to take such action as may be necessary to make these provisions effective .
Translation: 第十条 在遵守第八条规定的前提下，每一批准本公约的成员同意最迟于1924年1月1日使本公约第一、二、三、四、五和六条的规定生效，并采取一切必要措施确保这些规定得到有效实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 Each Member of the International Labor Organisation which ratifies this Convention engages to apply it to its colonies , possessions and protectorates , in accordance with the provisions of Article 35 of the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation .
Translation: 第十一条 凡批准本公约的国际劳工组织成员，应根据《国际劳工组织章程》第三十五条的规定，将本公约适用于其殖民地、属地和保护地。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 A Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force , by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第十二条 已批准本公约的成员，可在本公约首次生效之日起满十年后，通过向国际劳工局局长提交声明予以登记的方式，宣布退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 At least once in ten years , the Governing Body of the International Labor Office shall present to the General Conference a report on the working of this Convention and shall consider the desirability of placing on the agenda of the Conference the question of its revision or modification .
Translation: 第十三条 国际劳工局理事会应至少每十年向全体大会提交一份关于本公约实施情况的报告，并应考虑是否将修订或修改本公约的问题列入大会议程。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 The French and English texts of this Convention shall both be authentic .
Translation: 第十四条　本公约的法文文本和英文文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 The High Contracting Parties undertake to respect and to ensure respect for the present Convention in all circumstances .
Translation: 第一条 高缔约方承诺在任何情况下都尊重并确保本公约得到尊重。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 In addition to the provisions which shall be implemented in peacetime , the present Convention shall apply to all cases of declared war or of any other armed conflict which may arise between two or more of the High Contracting Parties , even if the state of war is not recognized by one of them .
Translation: 第二条 除和平时期应执行的规定外，本公约还适用于两国或多国缔约方之间发生的所有已宣战或其他武装冲突的情形，即使其中一方并未承认战争状态。

Query_Text_en: The Convention shall also apply to all cases of partial or total occupation of the territory of a High Contracting Party , even if the said occupation meets with no armed resistance .
Translation: 本公约同样适用于对缔约一方法律领土的全部或部分占领，即使该占领未遭遇武装抵抗。

Query_Text_en: Although one of the Powers in conflict may not be a party to the present Convention , the Powers who are parties thereto shall remain bound by it in their mutual relations .
Translation: 尽管交战国之一可能并非本公约的缔约方，但作为缔约方的各国在相互关系中仍须遵守本公约。

Query_Text_en: They shall furthermore be bound by the Convention in relation to the said Power , if the latter accepts and applies the provisions thereof .
Translation: 此外，如果该国接受并适用本公约的各项规定，他们也应当对该国承担本公约项下的义务。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Persons taking no active part in the hostilities , including members of armed forces who have laid down their arms and those placed hors de combat by sickness , wounds , detention , or any other cause , shall in all circumstances be treated humanely , without any adverse distinction founded on race , color , religion or faith , sex , birth or wealth , or any other similar criteria .
Translation: [1] 在敌对行动中未积极参战的人员，包括已放下武器的武装部队成员，以及因疾病、伤病、拘留或其他原因丧失战斗能力者，在任何情况下都应受到人道对待，不得因种族、肤色、宗教或信仰、性别、出生或财富，或任何类似标准而产生任何不利区别。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the passing of sentences and the carrying out of executions without previous judgement pronounced by a regularly constituted court , affording all the judicial guarantees which are recognized as indispensable by civilized peoples .
Translation: [d] 未经由正式设立的法庭作出判决，且未提供文明社会公认的所有必要司法保障，即进行宣判和执行死刑。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The wounded and sick shall be collected and cared for .
Translation: 伤员和病人应予以收集并妥善照料。

Query_Text_en: An impartial humanitarian body , such as the International Committee of the Red Cross , may offer its services to the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 一个公正的人道主义机构，如红十字国际委员会，可以向冲突各方提供服务。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict should further endeavor to bring into force , by means of special agreements , all or part of the other provisions of the present Convention .
Translation: 冲突各方还应通过特别协议，努力使本公约的其他条款全部或部分生效。

Query_Text_en: The application of the preceding provisions shall not affect the legal status of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 前述条款的适用不影响冲突各方的法律地位。

Query_Text_en: Article4 Neutral Powers shall apply by analogy the provisions of the present Convention to the wounded and sick , and to members of the medical personnel and to chaplains of the armed forces of the Parties to the conflict , received or interned in their territory , as well as to dead persons found .
Translation: 第四条 中立国应比照本公约的规定，适用于在其领土上接收或收容的交战各方武装部队的伤病员、医务人员和随军牧师，以及发现的死者。

Query_Text_en: Article5 For the protected persons who have fallen into the hands of the enemy , the present Convention shall apply until their final repatriation .
Translation: 第五条 对于落入敌方之手的受保护人员，本公约应适用，直至其最终遣返。

Query_Text_en: Article6 In addition to the agreements expressly provided for in Articles 10 , 15 , 23 , 28 , 31 , 36 , 37 and 52 , the High Contracting Parties may conclude other special agreements for all matters concerning which they may deem it suitable to make separate provision .
Translation: 第六条 除第10条、第15条、第23条、第28条、第31条、第36条、第37条和第52条明文规定的协议外，缔约高阶各方还可就其认为适宜作出单独规定的所有事项，缔结其他特别协议。

Query_Text_en: No special agreement shall adversely affect the situation of the wounded and sick , of members of the medical personnel or of chaplains , as defined by the present Convention , nor restrict the rights which it confers upon them .
Translation: 任何特别协议均不得对本公约所界定的伤病员、医务人员或随军牧师的处境产生不利影响，也不得限制本公约赋予他们的权利。

Query_Text_en: Wounded and sick , as well as medical personnel and chaplains , shall continue to have the benefit of such agreements as long as the Convention is applicable to them , except where express provisions to the contrary are contained in the aforesaid or in subsequent agreements , or where more favourable measures have been taken j with regard to them by one or other of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 只要本公约适用于伤病人员、医务人员和牧师，他们应继续享有上述协议的利益，除非上述协议或后续协议中有明确相反规定，或冲突一方对他们采取了更为有利的措施。

Query_Text_en: Article7 Wounded and sick , as well as members of the medical personnel and chaplains , may in no circumstances renounce in part or in entirety the rights secured to them by the present Convention , and by the special agreements referred to in the foregoing Article , if such there be .
Translation: 第七条 伤员和病人，以及医务人员和牧师，无论在任何情况下，均不得部分或全部放弃本公约及前述条款所提及的特别协议所赋予他们的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article8 The present Convention shall be applied with the cooperation and under the scrutiny of the Protecting Powers whose duty it is to safeguard the interests of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 第八条 本公约的实施应在保护国的协助和监督下进行，保护国有责任维护冲突各方的利益。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the Protecting Powers may appoint , apart from their diplomatic or consular staff , delegates from amongst their own nationals or the nationals of other neutral Powers . The said delegates shall be subject to the approval of the Power with which they are to carry out their duties . The Parties to the conflict shall facilitate to the greatest extent possible , the task of the representatives or delegates of the Protecting Powers .
Translation: 为此，保护国除可指派其外交或领事人员外，还可从本国公民或其他中立国公民中任命代表。上述代表的任命须经其履行职责所在国的同意。冲突各方应尽最大可能为保护国代表或代表团的工作提供便利。

Query_Text_en: The representatives or delegates of the Protecting Powers shall not in any case exceed their mission under the present Convention .
Translation: 保护国的代表或代表团在任何情况下不得超越本公约规定的职责范围。

Query_Text_en: They shall , in particular , take account of the imperative necessities of security of the State wherein they carry out their duties .
Translation: 他们在履行职责时，尤其应考虑所在国家安全的迫切需要。

Query_Text_en: Their activities shall only be restricted as an exceptional and temporary measure when this is rendered necessary by imperative military necessities .
Translation: 只有在迫切的军事需要使之成为必要时，方可将其活动作为例外性和临时性措施予以限制。

Query_Text_en: Article9 The provisions of the present Convention constitute no obstacle to the humanitarian activities which the International Committee of the Red Cross or any other impartial humanitarian organization may , subject to the consent of the Parties to the conflict concerned , undertake for the protection of wounded and sick , medical personnel and chaplains , and for their relief .
Translation: 第九条 本公约的规定不应妨碍国际红十字委员会或任何其他公正的人道主义组织，在有关冲突方同意的前提下，为保护伤病人员、医务人员和牧师及为其提供救助而开展的人道主义活动。

Query_Text_en: Article10 The High Contracting Parties may at any time agree to entrust to an organization which offers all guarantees of impartiality and efficacy the duties incumbent on the Protecting Powers by virtue of the present Convention .
Translation: 第十条 高缔约方可随时同意，将本公约赋予保护国的职责委托给一个能够提供完全公正和有效保障的组织。

Query_Text_en: When wounded and sick , or medical personnel and chaplains do not benefit or cease to benefit , no matter for what reason , by the activities of a Protecting Power or of an organization provided for in the first paragraph above , the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State , or such an organization , to undertake the functions performed under the present Convention by a Protecting Power designated by the Parties to a conflict .
Translation: 当伤病人员、医务人员或随军牧师，无论出于何种原因，未能或不再能受益于保护国或上述第一段所规定组织的活动时，关押国应请求一个中立国或此类组织，承担本公约项下由冲突各方指定的保护国所履行的职能。

Query_Text_en: If protection can not be arranged accordingly , the Detaining Power shall request or shall accept , subject to the provisions of this Article , the offer of the services of a humanitarian organization , such as the International Committee of the Red Cross , to assume the humanitarian functions performed by Protecting Powers under the present Convention .
Translation: 如果无法按规定安排保护措施，拘留国应根据本条规定，主动请求或接受人道主义组织（如红十字国际委员会）提供服务，由其承担本公约下保护国所履行的人道主义职能。

Query_Text_en: Any neutral Power , or any organization invited by the Power concerned or offering itself for these purposes , shall be required to act with a sense of responsibility towards the Party to the conflict on which persons protected by the present Convention depend , and shall be required to furnish sufficient assurances that it is in a position to undertake the appropriate functions and to discharge them impartially .
Translation: 任何中立国，或经有关国家邀请或主动提出承担相关职责的任何组织，均须对依赖本公约保护的冲突方负有责任感，并须提供充分保证，证明其有能力承担相应职能并公正履行职责。

Query_Text_en: No derogation from the preceding provisions shall be made by special agreements between Powers one of which is restricted , even temporarily , in its freedom to negotiate with the other Power or its allies by reason of military events , more particularly where the whole , or a substantial part , of the territory of the said Power is occupied .
Translation: 在任何一方因军事事件而被限制与另一方或其盟友进行谈判的自由，尤其是当该方全部或大部分领土被占领时，双方不得通过特别协议对前述条款作出任何减损。

Query_Text_en: Whenever , in the present Convention , mention is made of a Protecting Power , such mention also applies to substitute organizations in the sense of the present Article .
Translation: 凡在本公约中提及保护国时，该提及同样适用于本条所指的替代组织。

Query_Text_en: Article11 In cases where they deem it advisable in the interest of protected persons , particularly in cases of disagreement between the Parties to the conflict as to the application or interpretation of the provisions of the present Convention , the Protecting Powers shall lend their good offices with a view to settling the disagreement .
Translation: 第十一条 在认为有利于受保护人员的情况下，特别是在冲突各方对本公约条款的适用或解释存在分歧时，保护国应提供善意协助，以促成分歧的解决。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , each of the Protecting Powers may , either at the invitation of one Party or on its own initiative , propose to the Parties to the conflict a meeting of their representatives , in particular of the authorities responsible for the wounded and sick , members of medical personnel and chaplains , possibly on neutral territory suitably chosen .
Translation: 为此，每一保护国均可应一方当事国的邀请，或自行主动，向冲突各方提议召开其代表的会议，特别是由负责伤病员、医务人员和随军牧师事务的主管当局代表参加的会议，会议地点可选择适当的中立地区。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict shall be bound to give effect to the proposals made to them for this purpose .
Translation: 冲突各方有义务落实为此目的向其提出的建议。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Powers may , if necessary , propose for approval by the Parties to the conflict , a person belonging to a neutral Power or delegated by the International Committee of the Red Cross , who shall be invited to take part in such a meeting
Translation: 保护国如有必要，可以向冲突各方提议由中立国人员或国际红十字委员会委派人员参加此类会议，并征得各方同意。

Query_Text_en: Article12 Members of the armed forces and other persons mentioned in the following Article , who are wounded or sick , shall be respected and protected in all circumstances .
Translation: 第十二条 武装部队成员及下文所述其他人员，无论在任何情况下，凡受伤或患病者，均应受到尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: They shall be treated humanely and cared for by the Party to the conflict in whose power they may be , without any adverse distinction founded on sex , race , nationality , religion , political opinions , or any other similar criteria .
Translation: 他们应受到人道对待，并由掌握其控制权的冲突一方负责照料，不得因性别、种族、国籍、宗教、政治见解或任何其他类似标准而有任何不利区别对待。

Query_Text_en: they shall not wilfully be left without medical assistance and care , nor shall conditions exposing them to contagion or infection be created .
Translation: 不得故意使其得不到医疗救助和护理，也不得人为制造使其暴露于传染或感染风险的环境。

Query_Text_en: Only urgent medical reasons will authorize priority in the order of treatment to be administered .
Translation: 只有紧急医疗原因才会被授权在治疗顺序上给予优先。

Query_Text_en: Women shall be treated with all consideration due to their sex .
Translation: 女性应受到与其性别相应的充分尊重和关怀。

Query_Text_en: The Party to the conflict which is compelled to abandon wounded or sick to the enemy shall , as far as military considerations permit , leave with them a part of its medical personnel and material to assist in their care .
Translation: 交战一方在被迫将伤员或病员遗留给敌方时，应在军事情况允许的范围内，留下一部分医务人员和医疗物资，以协助照料这些伤病员。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Members of other militias and members of other volunteer corps , including those of organized resistance movements , belonging to a Party to the conflict and operating in or outside their own territory , even if this territory is occupied , provided that such militias or volunteer corps , including such organized resistance movements , fulfil the following conditions :
Translation: [2] 其他民兵组织成员及其他志愿队成员，包括有组织的抵抗运动成员，只要他们属于冲突一方，并在本国或境外（即使该领土被占领）活动，且这些民兵或志愿队，包括有组织的抵抗运动，满足以下条件：

Query_Text_en: [ d ] that of conducting their operations in accordance with the laws and customs of war .
Translation: [ d ] 按照战争法律和惯例开展其行动。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Inhabitants of a non-occupied territory , who on the approach of the enemy , spontaneously take up arms to resist the invading forces , without having had time to form themselves into regular armed units , provided they carry arms openly and respect the laws and customs of war .
Translation: [6] 非被占领地区的居民，在敌军逼近时，未经组织成正规武装部队，便自发拿起武器抵抗入侵部队，只要他们公开携带武器并遵守战争法规和习惯，即可适用相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article14 Subject to the provisions of Article 12 , the wounded and sick of a belligerent who fall into enemy hands shall be prisoners of war , and the provisions of international law concerning prisoners of war shall apply to them .
Translation: 第十四条 根据第十二条的规定，交战方中受伤或患病人员如落入敌方之手，应被视为战俘，并适用有关战俘的国际法规定。

Query_Text_en: Article15 At all times , and particularly after an engagement , Parties to the conflict shall , without delay , take all possible measures to search for and collect the wounded and sick , to protect them against pillage and ill-treatment , to ensure their adequate care , and to search for the dead and prevent their being despoiled . Whenever circumstances permit , an armistice or a suspension of fire shall be arranged , or local arrangements made , to permit the removal , exchange and transport of the wounded left on the battlefield . Likewise , local arrangements may be concluded between Parties to the conflict for the removal or exchange of wounded and sick from a besieged or encircled area , and for the passage of medical and religious personnel and equipment on their way to that area .
Translation: 第十五条 各缔约方在任何时候，尤其是在战斗结束后，应当毫不迟延地采取一切可能措施，搜寻和收集伤员和病人，防止其遭受掠夺和虐待，确保其得到充分救护，并搜寻死者，防止其遗体被亵渎。只要条件允许，应当达成停战或停火协议，或作出局部安排，以便转移、交换和运送遗留在战场上的伤员。同样，冲突各方之间也可以就从被围困或包围地区转移或交换伤员和病人，以及医疗和宗教人员及设备通行该地区，达成局部安排。

Query_Text_en: Article16 Parties to the conflict shall record as soon as possible , in respect of each wounded , sick or dead person of the adverse Party falling into their hands , any particulars which may assist in his identification .
Translation: 第16条 冲突各方应尽快记录落入其手中的敌方伤员、病人或死者的有关信息，以协助其身份识别。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] particulars concerning wounds or illness , or cause of death .
Translation: [h] 关于伤情、疾病或死亡原因的具体情况。

Query_Text_en: As soon as possible the above mentioned information shall be forwarded to the Information Bureau described in Article 122 of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949 , which shall transmit this information to the Power on which these persons depend through the intermediary of the Protecting Power and of the Central Prisoners of War Agency .
Translation: 上述信息应尽快转交给1949年8月12日《日内瓦公约》关于战俘待遇的第122条所述的信息局，由该信息局通过保护国和中央战俘事务局，将该信息转交给相关人员所属的国家。

Query_Text_en: They shall likewise collect and forward through the same bureau one half of a double identity disc , last wills or other documents of importance to the next of kin , money and in general all articles of an intrinsic or sentimental value , which are found on the dead .
Translation: 他们还应通过同一机构收集并转交双份身份识别牌中的一份、遗嘱或其他重要文件给死者的近亲，以及金钱和一般具有内在价值或纪念意义的所有物品。

Query_Text_en: These articles , together with unidentified articles , shall be sent in sealed packets , accompanied by statements giving all particulars necessary for the identification of the deceased owners , as well as by a complete list of the contents of the parcel .
Translation: 这些物品连同无法识别的物品，应装入密封包裹，并附上能够确认死者身份的所有必要信息说明，以及包裹内物品的完整清单。

Query_Text_en: Article17 Parties to the conflict shall ensure that burial or cremation of the dead , carried out individually as far as circumstances permit , is preceded by a careful examination , if possible by a medical examination , of the bodies , with a view to confirming death , establishing identity and enabling a report to be made .
Translation: 第十七条 冲突各方应确保对死者进行安葬或火化时，在条件允许的情况下尽可能采取个别方式，并在此之前对遗体进行仔细检查，如有可能由医学人员进行检查，以确认死亡、确定身份并便于制作报告。

Query_Text_en: One half of the double identity disc , or the identity disc itself if it is a single disc , should remain on the body .
Translation: 双重身份牌的一半，或如果是单一身份牌，则整个身份牌，应始终佩戴在身上。

Query_Text_en: Bodies shall not be cremated except for imperative reasons of hygiene or for motives based on the religion of the deceased .
Translation: 除非出于卫生方面的必要原因，或因逝者宗教信仰的需要，不得进行遗体火化。

Query_Text_en: In case of cremation , the circumstances and reasons for cremation shall be stated in detail in the death certificate or on the authenticated list of the dead .
Translation: 如进行火化，死亡证明或经认证的死亡人员名单中应详细说明火化的具体情况和原因。

Query_Text_en: They shall further ensure that the dead are honourably interred , if possible according to the rites of the religion to which they belonged , that their graves are respected , grouped if possible according to the nationality of the deceased , properly maintained and marked so that they may always be found .
Translation: 他们还应确保对死者予以体面安葬，如有可能，应按照其所属宗教的仪式进行，并应尊重其墓地，尽可能按死者国籍分组，妥善维护和标记墓地，以便随时能够找到。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , they shall organize at the commencement of hostilities an Official Graves Registration Service , to allow subsequent exhumations and to ensure the identification of bodies , whatever the site of the graves , and the possible transportation to the home country .
Translation: 为此，他们应在敌对行动开始时设立官方阵亡者登记服务，以便日后能够进行遗体发掘，确保无论墓地所在地如何，均能辨认遗体，并在可能的情况下将遗体运回本国。

Query_Text_en: These provisions shall likewise apply to the ashes , which shall be kept by the Graves Registration Service until proper disposal thereof in accordance with the wishes of the home country .
Translation: 这些规定同样适用于骨灰，骨灰将由墓地登记服务机构保管，直至按照原籍国的意愿妥善处理。

Query_Text_en: As soon as circumstances permit , and at latest at the end of hostilities , these Services shall exchange , through the Information Bureau mentioned in the second paragraph of Article 16 , lists showing the exact location and markings of the graves , together with particulars of the dead interred therein .
Translation: 一旦条件允许，且最迟应在敌对行动结束时，各方服务机构应通过第十六条第二款所述的信息局，互相交换列有墓地确切位置和标志的清单，并附上埋葬者的详细信息。

Query_Text_en: Article18 The military authorities may appeal to the charity of the inhabitants voluntarily to collect and care for , under their direction , the wounded and sick , granting persons who have responded to this appeal the necessary protection and facilities .
Translation: 第十八条 军事当局可以呼吁居民自愿伸出援手，在其指导下收集和照料伤病人员，并为响应这一呼吁的人员提供必要的保护和便利。

Query_Text_en: Should the adverse Party take or retake control of the area , he shall likewise grant these persons the same protection and the same facilities .
Translation: 如果对方重新控制该地区，他也应为这些人员提供同等的保护和便利。

Query_Text_en: The military authorities shall permit the inhabitants and relief societies , even in invaded or occupied areas , spontaneously to collect and care for wounded or sick of whatever nationality .
Translation: 军事当局应允许居民和救济组织，即使在被侵略或占领地区，也可以自发收集和照料任何国籍的伤病人员。

Query_Text_en: The civilian population shall respect these wounded and sick , and in particular abstain from offering them violence .
Translation: 平民应尊重这些伤病人员，尤其不得对他们施加暴力。

Query_Text_en: No one may ever be molested or convicted for having nursed the wounded or sick .
Translation: 任何人不得因救护伤病人员而受到骚扰或定罪。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of the present Article do not relieve the occupying Power of its obligation to give both physical and moral care to the wounded and sick .
Translation: 本条款的规定并不免除占领国对伤病人员承担的物质和精神照料义务。

Query_Text_en: Article19 Fixed establishments and mobile medical units of the Medical Service may in no circumstances be attacked , but shall at all times be respected and protected by the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 第十九条 医疗服务的固定机构和流动医疗单位在任何情况下均不得受到攻击，冲突各方应始终予以尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: Should they fall into the hands of the adverse Party , their personnel shall be free to pursue their duties , as long as the capturing Power has not itself ensured the necessary care of the wounded and sick found in such establishments and units .
Translation: 如果这些人员落入对方手中，只要俘获方尚未自行确保对这些机构和单位中发现的伤员和病人的必要照料，他们应被允许继续履行其职责。

Query_Text_en: The responsible authorities shall ensure that the said medical establishments and units are , as far as possible , situated in such a manner that attacks against military objectives can not imperil their safety .
Translation: 主管当局应确保上述医疗机构和单位尽可能设立在不会因对军事目标的攻击而危及其安全的位置。

Query_Text_en: Article20 Hospital ships entitled to the protection of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded , Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea of 12 August 1949 , shall not be attacked from the land .
Translation: 第二十条 受1949年8月12日《日内瓦公约》保护的医院船，即旨在改善武装部队中伤员、病员和遇难者状况的医院船，不得遭受来自陆地的攻击。

Query_Text_en: Article21 The protection to which fixed establishments and mobile medical units of the Medical Service are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit , outside their humanitarian duties , acts harmful to the enemy .
Translation: 第二十一条 医疗服务机构的固定设施和流动医疗单位所享有的保护，除非其被用于执行超出人道主义职责、对敌方有害的行为，否则不得终止。

Query_Text_en: Protection may , however , cease only after a due warning has been given , naming , in all appropriate cases , a reasonable time limit , and after such warning has remained unheeded .
Translation: 然而，只有在事先发出正式警告，并在所有适当情况下明确规定合理的期限，且该警告在期限届满后仍未被遵守的情况下，保护措施方可终止。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] That the humanitarian activities of medical units and establishments or of their personnel extend to the care of civilian wounded or sick .
Translation: [5] 医疗单位及机构或其人员的人道主义活动应包括对受伤或患病平民的照护。

Query_Text_en: Article23 In time of peace , the High Contracting Parties and , after the outbreak of hostilities , the Parties thereto , may establish in their own territory and , if the need arises , in occupied areas , hospital zones and localities so organized as to protect the wounded and sick from the effects of war , as well as the personnel entrusted with the organization and administration of these zones and localities and with the care of the persons therein assembled .
Translation: 第二十三条 在和平时期，高缔约方以及在敌对行动爆发后，相关缔约方可在本国领土内，必要时亦可在被占领地区设立医院区和特定场所，以保护伤病人员免受战争影响，并保障负责组织、管理这些区域及照料聚集人员的工作人员的安全。

Query_Text_en: Upon the outbreak and during the course of hostilities , the Parties concerned may conclude agreements on mutual recognition of the hospital zones and localities they have created .
Translation: 在敌对行动爆发及其进行期间，有关各方可以就相互承认其设立的医院区和医院地点达成协议。

Query_Text_en: They may for this purpose implement the provisions of the Draft Agreement annexed to the present Convention , with such amendments as they may consider necessary .
Translation: 为此，他们可以实施本公约所附《协议草案》的相关条款，并可根据需要作出适当修改。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross are invited to lend their good offices in order to facilitate the institution and recognition of these hospital zones and localities .
Translation: 邀请保护国和国际红十字委员会提供协助，以促进这些医院区域和地点的设立与认可。

Query_Text_en: Article24 Medical personnel exclusively engaged in the search for , or the collection , transport or treatment of the wounded or sick , or in the prevention of disease , staff exclusively engaged in the administration of medical units and establishments , as well as chaplains attached to the armed forces , shall be respected and protected in all circumstances .
Translation: 第二十四条 专门从事搜寻、收集、运送或救治伤病员，或从事防疫工作的医务人员，专门负责医疗单位和机构管理的工作人员，以及隶属于武装部队的随军牧师，在任何情况下均应受到尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: Article25 Members of the armed forces specially trained for employment , should the need arise , as hospital orderlies , nurses or auxiliary stretcher-bearers , in the search for or the collection , transport or treatment of the wounded and sick shall likewise be respected and protected if they are carrying out these duties at the time when they come into contact with the enemy or fall into his hands .
Translation: 第二十五条 经专门训练用于担任医院勤务员、护士或辅助担架员的武装部队成员，在搜寻、收集、运送或救治伤病员时，如遇敌方或落入敌手，只要正在执行上述职责，应同样受到尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: Article26 The staff of National Red Cross Societies and that of other Voluntary Aid Societies , duly recognized and authorized by their Governments , who may be employed on the same duties as the personnel named in Article 24 , are placed on the same footing as the personnel named in the said Article , provided that the staff of such societies are subject to military laws and regulations .
Translation: 第二十六条 经政府正式认可和授权的国家红十字会及其他志愿救援组织的工作人员，如从事第二十四条所述人员的同类工作，在符合该组织工作人员受军事法律和规章约束的前提下，享有与第二十四条所述人员同等的待遇。

Query_Text_en: Each High Contracting Party shall notify to the other , either in time of peace or at the commencement of or during hostilities , but in any case before actually employing them , the names of the societies which it has authorized , under its responsibility , to render assistance to the regular medical service of its armed forces .
Translation: 每一高缔约方应在和平时期，或在敌对行动开始时或进行期间，但无论如何须在实际使用之前，将其授权、并由其负责协助其武装部队正规医疗服务的团体名称通知对方。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 A recognized Society of a neutral country can only lend the assistance of its medical personnel and units to a Party to the conflict with the previous consent of its own Government and the authorization of the Party to the conflict concerned .
Translation:
第二十七条  
中立国经认可的救济会，只有在本国政府事先同意并经有关冲突方授权的情况下，方可向冲突方提供其医务人员和医疗单位的协助。

Query_Text_en: That personnel and those units shall be placed under the control of that Party to the conflict .
Translation: 该人员和相关单位应置于该冲突方的指挥之下。

Query_Text_en: The neutral Government shall notify this consent to the adversary of the State which accepts such assistance .
Translation: 中立国政府应将其同意提供援助的决定通知接受该援助的国家的对方当事国。

Query_Text_en: The Party to the conflict who accepts such assistance is bound to notify the adverse Party thereof before making any use of it .
Translation: 接受此类援助的冲突方在使用该援助前，必须通知对方当事方。

Query_Text_en: In no circumstances shall this assistance be considered as interference in the conflict .
Translation: 在任何情况下，此项援助均不得被视为对冲突的干涉。

Query_Text_en: The members of the personnel named in the first paragraph shall be duly furnished with the identity cards provided for in Article 40 before leaving the neutral country to which they belong .
Translation: 第一款所述人员成员，在离开其所属中立国之前，应当按照第四十条的规定，领取相应的身份证件。

Query_Text_en: Article28 Personnel designated in Articles 24 and 26 who fall into the hands of the adverse Party , shall be retained only in so far as the state of health , the spiritual needs and the number of prisoners of war require .
Translation: 第二十八条 根据第二十四条和第二十六条指定的人员，如落入敌方之手，仅在战俘的健康状况、精神需求及人数需要的情况下，方可予以留用。

Query_Text_en: Personnel thus retained shall not be deemed prisoners of war .
Translation: 因此被留用的人员不得被视为战俘。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless they shall at least benefit by all the provisions of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 然而，他们至少应享有1949年8月12日《日内瓦战俘待遇公约》中的所有相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Within the framework of the military laws and regulations of the Detaining Power , and under the authority of its competent service , they shall continue to carry out , in accordance with their professional ethics , their medical and spiritual duties on behalf of prisoners of war , preferably those of the armed forces to which they themselves belong .
Translation: 在拘留国军事法律法规框架内，并在其主管部门授权下，他们应根据职业道德，继续为战俘履行医疗和精神职责，优先服务于与其自身隶属武装部队相同的战俘。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] They shall be authorized to visit periodically the prisoners of war in labor units or hospitals outside the camp .
Translation: 他们应被授权定期探访在营地外劳工分队或医院中的战俘。

Query_Text_en: The Detaining Power shall put at their disposal the means of transport required .
Translation: 拘留方应为其提供所需的交通工具。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] In each camp the senior medical officer of the highest rank shall be responsible to the military authorities of the camp for the professional activity of the retained medical personnel .
Translation: 在每个营地中，级别最高的高级医疗官员应对营地军事当局负责所留用医疗人员的专业活动。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , from the outbreak of hostilities , the Parties to the conflict shall agree regarding the corresponding seniority of the ranks of their medical personnel , including those of the societies designated in Article 26 .
Translation: 为此，自敌对行动爆发之时起，冲突各方应就其医务人员的相应军衔达成一致，包括第26条所指定的团体的医务人员。

Query_Text_en: In all questions arising out of their duties , this medical officer , and the chaplains , shall have direct access to the military and medical authorities of the camp who shall grant them the facilities they may require for correspondence relating to these questions .
Translation: 在履行职责过程中所产生的所有问题中，医疗官和牧师应可以直接联系营地的军事和医疗当局，营地当局应为他们就相关问题进行通信提供必要的便利。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Although retained personnel in a camp shall be subject to its internal discipline , they shall not , however , be required to perform any work outside their medical or religious duties .
Translation: 虽然被留用人员在营地内须遵守其内部纪律，但不得被要求从事医疗或宗教职责以外的任何工作。

Query_Text_en: During hostilities the Parties to the conflict shall make arrangements for relieving where possible retained personnel , and shall settle the procedure of such relief .
Translation: 在敌对行动期间，冲突各方应尽可能安排对被扣留人员的救助，并应协商确定救助的具体程序。

Query_Text_en: None of the preceding provisions shall relieve the Detaining Power of the obligations imposed upon it with regard to the medical and spiritual welfare of the prisoners of war .
Translation: 上述各项规定均不得免除拘留国对战俘医疗和精神福利所承担的义务。

Query_Text_en: Article29 Members of the personnel designated in Article 25 who have fallen into the hands of the enemy , shall be prisoners of war , but shall be employed on their medical duties in so far as the need arises .
Translation:
第二十九条  
根据第二十五条规定指派的人员，如落入敌方之手，应被视为战俘，但在有需要时，应继续从事医疗工作。

Query_Text_en: Article30 Personnel whose retention is not indispensable by virtue of the provisions of Article 28 shall be returned to the Party to the conflict to whom they belong , as soon as a road is open for their return and military requirements permit .
Translation: 第三十条 根据第二十八条规定，凡不属于必须留用人员，应在通路开放且军事需要允许的情况下，尽快遣返至其所属冲突方。

Query_Text_en: Pending their return , they shall not be deemed prisoners of war . Nevertheless they shall at least benefit by all the provisions of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 在他们返回之前，不应被视为战俘。然而，他们至少应享有1949年8月12日《关于战俘待遇的日内瓦公约》中的所有规定。

Query_Text_en: They shall continue to fulfil their duties under the orders of the adverse Party and shall preferably be engaged in the care of the wounded and sick of the Party to the conflict to which they themselves belong .
Translation: 他们应继续按照对方的指令履行职责，并优先负责照料属于自己一方的伤员和病人。

Query_Text_en: On their departure , they shall take with them the effects , personal belongings , valuables and instruments belonging to them .
Translation: 在离境时，他们可以携带属于自己的物品、个人财产、贵重物品及器具。

Query_Text_en: Article31 The selection of personnel for return under Article 30 shall be made irrespective of any consideration of race , religion or political opinion , but preferably according to the chronological order of their capture and their state of health .
Translation: 第三十一条 根据第三十条遣返人员的选择，不得考虑种族、宗教或政治观点因素，而应优先按照被俘时间的先后顺序及其健康状况进行。

Query_Text_en: As from the outbreak of hostilities , Parties to the conflict may determine by special agreement the percentage of personnel to be retained , in proportion to the number of prisoners and the distribution of the said personnel in the camps .
Translation: 自敌对行动爆发之日起，冲突各方可通过特别协议，按照被俘人员数量确定需保留人员的比例，并决定上述人员在各营地的分配。

Query_Text_en: Article32 Persons designated in Article 27 who have fallen into the hands of the adverse Party may not be detained .
Translation: 第三十二条 被第二十七条所指明人员，如落入对方手中，不得被拘留。

Query_Text_en: Unless otherwise agreed , they shall have permission to return to their country , or if this is not possible , to the territory of the Party to the conflict in whose service they were , as soon as a route for their return is open and military considerations permit .
Translation: 除非另有协议，一旦返程路线开放且军事条件允许，他们应被允许返回本国；如无法返回，则应被允许前往为其服务的冲突方领土。

Query_Text_en: Pending their release , they shall continue their work under the direction of the adverse Party ; they shall preferably be engaged in the care of the wounded and sick of the Party to the conflict in whose service they were .
Translation: 在被释放之前，他们应继续在对方的指挥下工作；优先从事照护他们所服务的冲突方的伤员和病人的工作。

Query_Text_en: On their departure , they shall take with them their effects personal articles and valuables and the instruments , arms and if possible the means of transport belonging to them .
Translation: 在离开时，他们应携带个人物品、贵重物品、工具、武器，以及如有可能属于他们的交通工具。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict shall secure to this personnel , while in their power , the same food , lodging , allowances and pay as are granted to the corresponding personnel of their armed forces .
Translation: 冲突各方应确保在其控制下的此类人员，获得与其武装部队相应人员同等的食物、住宿、津贴和薪酬。

Query_Text_en: The food shall in any case be sufficient as regards quantity , quality and variety to keep the said personnel in a normal state of health .
Translation: 无论如何，所提供的食物在数量、质量和种类方面都应足以保证相关人员的正常健康状态。

Query_Text_en: Article33 The material of mobile medical units of the armed forces which fall into the hands of the enemy , shall be reserved for the care of wounded and sick .
Translation: 第三十三条 落入敌方之手的武装部队流动医疗单位的物资，应保留用于救治伤病人员。

Query_Text_en: The buildings , material and stores of fixed medical establishments of the armed forces shall remain subject to the laws of war , but may not be diverted from their purpose as long as they are required for the care of wounded and sick .
Translation: 武装部队固定医疗机构的建筑、物资和储备仍受战争法的约束，但只要这些设施仍用于照顾伤病人员，就不得改变其用途。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the commanders of forces in the field may make use of them , in case of urgent military necessity , provided that they make previous arrangements for the welfare of the wounded and sick who are nursed in them .
Translation: 然而，前线部队指挥官在紧急军事需要的情况下，可以使用这些场所，但前提是他们已事先妥善安排好在其中接受护理的伤病人员的福利。

Query_Text_en: The material and stores defined in the present Article shall not be intentionally destroyed .
Translation: 本条所规定的物资和储备不得故意销毁。

Query_Text_en: Article34 The real and personal property of aid societies which are admitted to the privileges of the Convention shall be regarded as private property .
Translation: 第三十四条 获准享有本公约权利的救济会的动产和不动产，应视为私人财产。

Query_Text_en: The right of requisition recognized for belligerents by the laws and customs of war shall not be exercised except in case of urgent necessity , and only after the welfare of the wounded and sick has been ensured .
Translation: 交战方依据战争法律和惯例所享有的征用权，除非在紧急情况下，并且在确保伤病员福利的前提下，不得行使。

Query_Text_en: Article35 Transports of wounded and sick or of medical equipment shall be respected and protected in the same way as mobile medical units .
Translation: 第三十五条 伤病员运输和医疗器材运输应当与流动医疗单位一样，受到尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: Should such transports or vehicles fall into the hands of the adverse Party , they shall be subject to the laws of war , on condition that the Party to the conflict who captures them shall in all cases ensure the care of the wounded and sick they contain .
Translation: 如果此类运输工具或车辆落入对方手中，应遵守战争法，但无论何种情况，俘获方必须确保对其中伤员和病人的妥善照料。

Query_Text_en: The civilian personnel and all means of transport obtained by requisition shall be subject to the general rules of international law .
Translation: 通过征用获得的民用人员及所有运输工具，均应遵守国际法的一般规定。

Query_Text_en: Article36 Medical aircraft , that is to say , aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of wounded and sick and for the transport of medical personnel and equipment , shall not be attacked , but shall be respected by the belligerents , while flying at heights , times and on routes specifically agreed upon between the belligerents concerned .
Translation: 第三十六条 医疗飞机，即专门用于转运伤病人员以及医疗人员和设备的飞机，不得遭受攻击，应受到交战各方的尊重，但须在交战各方特别协商确定的高度、时间和航线飞行。

Query_Text_en: They shall bear , clearly marked , the distinctive emblem prescribed in Article 38 , together with their national colors on their lower , upper and lateral surfaces .
Translation: 他们应在其下部、上部及侧面清晰标示第38条规定的专用徽章，并配以本国颜色。

Query_Text_en: They shall be provided with any other markings or means of identification that may be agreed upon between the belligerents upon the outbreak or during the course of hostilities .
Translation: 在敌对行动爆发时或进行期间，经交战双方协商同意，还应为其提供任何其他标志或识别方式。

Query_Text_en: Unless agreed otherwise , flights over enemy or enemy-occupied territory are prohibited .
Translation: 除非另有约定，禁止飞越敌方或敌占区领土。

Query_Text_en: Medical aircraft shall obey every summons to land .
Translation: 医疗飞机必须服从一切降落指令。

Query_Text_en: In the event of a landing thus imposed , the aircraft with its occupants may continue its flight after examination , if any .
Translation: 在这种被迫降落的情况下，经过必要的检查后，飞机及其人员可以继续飞行。

Query_Text_en: In the event of an involuntary landing in enemy or enemy-occupied territory , the wounded and sick , as well as the crew of the aircraft shall be prisoners of war .
Translation: 如在敌方或敌占区被迫着陆，伤员、病员以及机组人员应被视为战俘。

Query_Text_en: The medical personnel shall be treated according to Article 24 and the Articles following .
Translation: 医务人员应按照第二十四条及其后续条款进行处理。

Query_Text_en: Article37 Subject to the provisions of the second paragraph , medical aircraft of Parties to the conflict may fly over the territory of neutral Powers , land on it in case of necessity , or use it as a port of call .
Translation: 第三十七条 在符合第二款规定的前提下，冲突各方的医疗飞机可以飞越中立国领土，在必要情况下降落，或将其作为中途停靠港。

Query_Text_en: They shall give the neutral Powers previous notice of their passage over the said territory and obey all summons to alight , on land or water .
Translation: 他们应事先通知中立国其将经过上述领土，并服从一切要求其在陆地或水面降落的指令。

Query_Text_en: They will be immune from attack only when flying on routes , at heights and at times specifically agreed upon between the Parties to the conflict and the neutral Power concerned .
Translation: 只有在交战各方与有关中立国之间就航线、高度和时间达成明确协议的情况下，他们才享有不受攻击的豁免权。

Query_Text_en: The neutral Powers may , however , place conditions or restrictions on the passage or landing of medical aircraft on their territory .
Translation: 中立国可以对医疗飞机在其领土上的通行或着陆设定条件或限制。

Query_Text_en: Such possible conditions or restrictions shall be applied equally to all Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 此类可能的条件或限制应同等适用于冲突各方。

Query_Text_en: Unless agreed otherwise between the neutral Power and the Parties to the conflict , the wounded and sick who are disembarked , with the consent of the local authorities , on neutral territory by medical aircraft , shall be detained by the neutral Power , where so required by international law , in such a manner that they can not again take part in operations of war .
Translation: 除非中立国与冲突各方另有协议，经当地当局同意，由医疗飞机在中立领土卸下的伤员和病人，应由中立国按照国际法的要求予以拘留，以确保他们无法再次参与战争行动。

Query_Text_en: The cost of their accommodation and internment shall be borne by the Power on which they depend .
Translation: 他们的住宿和拘留费用应由其所属国家承担。

Query_Text_en: Article38 As a compliment to Switzerland , the heraldic emblem of the red cross on a white ground , formed by reversing the Federal colors , is retained as the emblem and distinctive sign of the Medical Service of armed forces .
Translation: 第三十八条 为表彰瑞士，保留红底白十字的徽章作为武装部队医疗服务的标志和识别符号，该徽章由联邦颜色反转而成。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , in the case of countries which already use as emblem , in place of the red cross , the red crescent or the red lion and sun on a white ground , those emblems are also recognized by the terms of the present Convention .
Translation: 然而，对于那些已经使用红新月或白底红狮与太阳作为标志，而非红十字的国家，根据本公约的规定，这些标志同样受到承认。

Query_Text_en: Article39 Under the direction of the competent military authority , the emblem shall be displayed on the flags , armlets and on all equipment employed in the Medical Service .
Translation: 第三十九条 在主管军事机关的指挥下，徽章应当悬挂于旗帜、臂章以及医疗部门使用的所有装备上。

Query_Text_en: Article40 The personnel designated in Article 24 and in Articles 26 and 27 shall wear , affixed to the left arm , a water-resistant armlet bearing the distinctive emblem , issued and stamped by the military authority .
Translation: 第四十条 第二十四条、第二十六条和第二十七条所规定的人员，应佩戴由军事当局签发并盖章的防水臂章，臂章上印有专用标志，佩戴于左臂。

Query_Text_en: Such personnel , in addition to wearing the identity disc mentioned in Article 16 , shall also carry a special identity card bearing the distinctive emblem .
Translation: 此类人员，除佩戴第十六条所述的身份识别牌外，还应随身携带印有专用标志的特别身份证件。

Query_Text_en: This card shall be water-resistant and of such size that it can be carried in the pocket .
Translation: 该卡片应具备防水性能，并且尺寸适宜，便于随身携带。

Query_Text_en: It shall be worded in the national language , shall mention at least the surname and first names , the date of birth , the rank and the service number of the bearer , and shall state in what capacity he is entitled to the protection of the present Convention .
Translation: 该证件应使用本国语言书写，至少注明持有人的姓氏、名字、出生日期、军衔和军人编号，并应说明其有权享受本公约保护的身份。

Query_Text_en: The card shall bear the photograph of the owner and also either his signature or his finger-prints or both .
Translation: 该卡应附有持卡人照片，并应包含其签名或指纹，或两者兼有。

Query_Text_en: It shall be embossed with the stamp of the military authority .
Translation: 应加盖军事当局的印章。

Query_Text_en: The identity card shall be uniform throughout the same armed forces and , as far as possible , of a similar type in the armed forces of the High Contracting Parties .
Translation: 身份证在同一军队中应统一格式，并且在缔约国的各军队中应尽可能采用类似类型。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict may be guided by the model which is annexed , by way of example , to the present Convention .
Translation: 冲突各方可参照本公约所附示范文本作为范例。

Query_Text_en: They shall inform each other , at the outbreak of hostilities , of the model they are using .
Translation: 在敌对行动爆发时，双方应相互通报所使用的型号。

Query_Text_en: Identity cards should be made out , if possible , at least in duplicate , one copy being kept by the home country .
Translation: 身份证应尽可能至少制作两份，其中一份由本国保存。

Query_Text_en: In no circumstances may the said personnel be deprived of their insignia or identity cards nor of the right to wear the armlet .
Translation: 在任何情况下，上述人员不得被剥夺其徽章或身份证件，也不得被剥夺佩戴臂章的权利。

Query_Text_en: In case of loss , they shall be entitled to receive duplicates of the cards and to have the insignia replaced .
Translation: 如若遗失，他们有权获得卡片的副本，并更换徽章。

Query_Text_en: the armlet shall be issued and stamped by the military authority .
Translation: 臂章应由军事当局发放并加盖印章。

Query_Text_en: Military identity documents to be carried by this type of personnel shall specify what special training they have received , the temporary character of the duties they are engaged upon , and their authority for wearing the armlet .
Translation: 此类人员所携带的军人身份证明文件应注明其所接受的特殊训练、所从事任务的临时性质，以及佩戴臂章的授权依据。

Query_Text_en: Article42 The distinctive flag of the Convention shall be hoisted only over such medical units and establishments as are entitled to be respected under the Convention , and only with the consent of the military authorities .
Translation: 第四十二条 只有根据本公约应受尊重的医疗单位和机构，且经军事当局同意，方可悬挂本公约的专用旗帜。

Query_Text_en: In mobile units , as in fixed establishments , it may be accompanied by the national flag of the Party to the conflict to which the unit or establishment belongs .
Translation: 在流动单位中，与固定机构一样，可以悬挂该单位或机构所属冲突方的国家旗帜。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , medical units which have fallen into the hands of the enemy shall not fly any flag other than that of the Convention .
Translation: 然而，落入敌方之手的医疗单位不得悬挂除公约旗帜之外的任何旗帜。

Query_Text_en: Parties to the conflict shall take the necessary steps , in so far as military considerations permit , to make the distinctive emblems indicating medical units and establishments clearly visible to the enemy land , air or naval forces , in order to obviate the possibility of any hostile action .
Translation: 冲突各方应采取必要措施，在军事条件允许的情况下，使表明医疗单位和机构的专用标志对敌方陆、空或海军部队清晰可见，以避免任何敌对行为的发生。

Query_Text_en: Article43 The medical units belonging to neutral countries , which may have been authorized to lend their services to a belligerent under the conditions laid down in Article 27 , shall fly , along with the flag of the Convention , the national flag of that belligerent , wherever the latter makes use of the faculty conferred on him by Article 42 .
Translation: 第四十三条 根据第二十七条规定获准向交战方提供服务的中立国医疗单位，在该交战方依照第四十二条行使其权利时，应与公约旗帜一同悬挂该交战方的国旗。
