Query_Text_en: Subject to orders to the contrary by the responsible military authorities , they may on all occasions fly their national flag , even if they fall into the hands of the adverse Party .
Translation: 除非负责的军事当局另有命令，他们在任何情况下都可以悬挂本国国旗，即使落入对方手中亦可。

Query_Text_en: Article44 With the exception of the cases mentioned in the following paragraphs of the present Article , the emblem of the red cross on a white ground and the words '' Red Cross '' or '' Geneva Cross '' may not be employed , either in time of peace or in time of war , except to indicate or to protect the medical units and establishments , the personnel and material protected by the present Convention and other Conventions dealing with similar matters .
Translation: 第四十四条 除本条下列各款所述情形外，无论在和平时期或战争时期，红底白十字的标志及“红十字”或“日内瓦十字”字样，均不得使用，除非用于标示或保护本公约及其他处理类似事项的公约所保护的医疗单位和机构、人员及物资。

Query_Text_en: The same shall apply to the emblems mentioned in Article 38 , second paragraph , in respect of the countries which use them .
Translation: 对于使用第二段第38条所述徽章的国家，同样适用上述规定。

Query_Text_en: The National Red Cross Societies and other societies designated in Article 26 shall have the right to use the distinctive emblem conferring the protection of the Convention only within the framework of the present paragraph .
Translation: 国家红十字会及第二十六条所指定的其他团体，仅可在本款规定的范围内使用赋予本公约保护的专有标志。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , National Red Cross [ Red Crescent , Red Lion and Sun ] Societies may , in time of peace , in accordance with their rational legislation , make use of the name and emblem of the Red Cross for their other activities which are in conformity with the principles laid down by the International Red Cross Conferences .
Translation: 此外，各国红十字会（红新月会、红狮与太阳会）在和平时期，可以根据本国法律规定，将红十字名称和标志用于其他符合国际红十字大会所制定原则的活动。

Query_Text_en: the emblem shall be comparatively small in size and may not be placed on armlets or on the roofs of buildings .
Translation: 该标志应相对较小，不得用于臂章或建筑物屋顶。

Query_Text_en: The international Red Cross organizations and their duly authorized personnel shall be permitted to make use , at all times , of the emblem of the red cross on a white ground .
Translation: 国际红十字组织及其正式授权人员应被允许在任何时候使用白底红十字标志。

Query_Text_en: As an exceptional measure , in conformity with national legislation and with the express permission of one of the National Red Cross [ Red Crescent , Red Lion and Sun ] Societies , the emblem of the Convention may be employed in time of peace to identify vehicles used as ambulances and to mark the position of aid stations exclusively assigned to the purpose of giving free treatment to the wounded or sick .
Translation: 作为一项特殊措施，根据国家立法并经国家红十字会（红新月会、红狮与太阳会）之一的明确许可，公约所规定的标志可在和平时期用于识别用作救护车的车辆，并用于标示专门用于为伤病人员免费治疗的救护站位置。

Query_Text_en: Article45 Each Party to the conflict , acting through its Commanders-in-Chief , shall ensure the detailed execution of the preceding Articles , and provide for unforeseen cases , in conformity with the general principles of the present Convention .
Translation: 第四十五条 各冲突方应通过其总司令确保前述条款得到详细执行，并根据本公约的一般原则，对未预见的情况作出安排。

Query_Text_en: Article46 Reprisals against the wounded , sick , personnel , buildings or equipment protected by the Convention are prohibited .
Translation: 第四十六条 禁止对受本公约保护的伤员、病人、人员、建筑物或设备进行报复。

Query_Text_en: Article47 The High Contracting Parties undertake , in time of peace as in time of war , to disseminate the text of the present Convention as widely as possible in their respective countries , and , in particular , to include the study thereof in their programs of military and , if possible , civil instruction , so that the principles thereof may become known to the entire population , in particular to the armed fighting forces , the medical personnel and the chaplains .
Translation: 第四十七条　缔约各方承诺，无论在和平时期还是战争时期，均应在各自国家尽可能广泛传播本公约的文本，特别是将其内容纳入军事教育课程，并在可能情况下纳入民事教育课程，以使本公约的原则为全国人民，尤其是武装部队、医务人员和随军牧师所熟知。

Query_Text_en: Article48 The High Contracting Parties shall communicate to one another through the Swiss Federal Council and , during hostilities , through the Protecting Powers , the official translations of the present Convention , as well as the laws and regulations which they may adopt to ensure the application thereof .
Translation: 第四十八条　缔约各方应通过瑞士联邦委员会相互通报本公约的正式译本，以及为确保本公约实施而制定的法律和法规；在敌对行动期间，则应通过保护国进行通报。

Query_Text_en: Article49 The High Contracting Parties undertake to enact any legislation necessary to provide effective penal sanctions for persons committing , or ordering to be committed , any of the grave breaches of the present Convention defined in the following Article .
Translation: 第四十九条　缔约各方承诺制定必要的立法，对实施或指使实施本公约下文所界定的严重违反行为的人员，予以有效的刑事制裁。

Query_Text_en: Each High Contracting Party shall be under the obligation to search for persons alleged to have committed , or to have ordered to be committed , such grave breaches , and shall bring such persons , regardless of their nationality , before its own courts .
Translation: 各缔约方有义务追查涉嫌实施或指示实施此类严重违反行为的人员，并无论其国籍如何，将其提交本国法院审理。

Query_Text_en: It may also , if it prefers , and in accordance with the provisions of its own legislation , hand such persons over for trial to another High Contracting Party concerned , provided such High Contracting Party has made out a prima facie case .
Translation: 如有需要，并根据本国法律规定，缔约一方也可以将此类人员移交给有关的另一缔约方进行审判，前提是该缔约方已提出初步证据。

Query_Text_en: Each High Contracting Party shall take measures necessary for the suppression of all acts contrary to the provisions of the present Convention other than the grave breaches defined in the following Article .
Translation: 除下一条所定义的严重违反行为外，每一缔约方应采取必要措施，制止所有与本公约条款相抵触的行为。

Query_Text_en: In all circumstances , the accused persons shall benefit by safeguards of proper trial and defense , which shall not be less favourable than those provided by Article 105 and those following , of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 在任何情况下，被指控人员均应享有正当审判和辩护的保障，其待遇不得低于1949年8月12日《日内瓦公约》关于战俘待遇的第105条及其后续条款所规定的标准。

Query_Text_en: wilful killing , torture or inhuman treatment , including biological experiments , wilfully causing great suffering or serious injury to body or health , and extensive destruction and appropriation of property , not justified by military necessity and carried out unlawfully and wantonly .
Translation: 蓄意杀害、酷刑或非人道待遇，包括生物实验，故意造成严重痛苦或对身体健康造成严重伤害，以及在无军事必要情况下，非法且肆意进行的大规模毁坏和侵占财产。

Query_Text_en: Article51 No High Contracting Party shall be allowed to absolve itself or any other High Contracting Party of any liability incurred by itself or by another High Contracting Party in respect of breaches referred to in the preceding Article .
Translation: 第五十一条 任何缔约国不得免除自身或其他缔约国因前一条所述违反行为而产生的任何责任。

Query_Text_en: Article52 At the request of a Party to the conflict , an enquiry shall be instituted , in a manner to be decided between the interested Parties , concerning any alleged violation of the Convention .
Translation: 第五十二条 应冲突一方当事方的请求，对于任何所指称的违反本公约的行为，应以有关当事方商定的方式进行调查。

Query_Text_en: If agreement has not been reached concerning the procedure for the enquiry , the Parties should agree on the choice of an umpire who will decide upon the procedure to be followed .
Translation: 如双方未能就调查程序达成一致，应协商选定一名裁决员，由其决定应采取的程序。

Query_Text_en: Once the violation has been established , the Parties to the conflict shall put an end to it and shall repress it with the least possible delay .
Translation: 一旦违规行为被确认，冲突各方应立即予以制止，并尽快加以惩处。

Query_Text_en: Article53 The use by individuals , societies , firms or companies either public or private , other than those entitled thereto under the present Convention , of the emblem or the designation '' Red Cross '' or '' Geneva Cross '' or any sign or designation constituting an imitation thereof , whatever the object of such use , and irrespective of the date of its adoption , shall be prohibited at all times .
Translation: 第五十三条 除本公约规定有权使用者外，任何个人、团体、公司或企业，无论公私性质，均禁止在任何时候使用“红十字”或“日内瓦十字”徽章或名称，或任何构成其仿制的标志或名称，无论其用途为何，也不论其采用日期为何。

Query_Text_en: By reason of the tribute paid to Switzerland by the adoption of the reversed Federal colors , and of the confusion which may arise between the arms of Switzerland and the distinctive emblem of the Convention , the use by private individuals , societies or firms , of the arms of the Swiss Confederation , or of marks constituting an imitation thereof , whether as trademarks or commercial marks , or as parts of such marks , or for a purpose contrary to commercial honesty , or in circumstances capable of wounding Swiss national sentiment , shall be prohibited at all times .
Translation: 鉴于采用反转联邦颜色向瑞士致敬，以及瑞士国徽与公约专有标志可能引发混淆，私人、团体或企业不得以任何形式使用瑞士联邦国徽或其仿制标志，无论作为商标、商业标记、标记的一部分，或用于违背商业诚信的目的，或在可能伤害瑞士民族感情的情况下，均应始终禁止。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , such High Contracting Parties as were not party to the Geneva Convention of 27 July 1929 , may grant to prior users of the emblems , designations , signs or marks designated in the first paragraph , a time limit not to exceed three years from the coming into force of the present Convention to discontinue such use provided that the said use shall not be such as would appear , in time of war , to confer the protection of the Convention .
Translation: 然而，对于未参加1929年7月27日《日内瓦公约》的缔约国，可以允许在本条第一款所述徽章、名称、标志或记号的原有使用者，自本公约生效之日起，在不超过三年的期限内停止使用，但前提是该等使用在战争时期不得被视为赋予本公约所规定的保护。

Query_Text_en: The prohibition laid down in the first paragraph of the present Article shall also apply , without effect on any rights acquired through prior use , to the emblems and marks mentioned in the second paragraph of Article 38 .
Translation: 本条第一款所规定的禁止事项，同样适用于第38条第二款所提及的徽章和标志，但不影响因先前使用而取得的任何权利。

Query_Text_en: Article54 The High Contracting Parties shall , if their legislation is not already adequate , take measures necessary for the prevention and repression , at all times , of the abuses referred to under Article 53
Translation: 第五十四条　如缔约国现行法律尚不完善，应随时采取必要措施，防止和惩治第五十三条所述的滥用行为。

Query_Text_en: Article55 The present Convention is established in English and in French .
Translation: 第五十五条 本公约以英文和法文制定。

Query_Text_en: Both texts are equally authentic .
Translation: 两种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: The Swiss Federal Council shall arrange for official translations of the Convention to be made in the Russian and Spanish languages .
Translation: 瑞士联邦委员会应负责将本公约正式译为俄文和西班牙文。

Query_Text_en: Article56 The present Convention , which bears the date of this day , is open to signature until 12 February 1950 , in the name of the Powers represented at the Conference which opened at Geneva on 21 April 1949 ; furthermore , by Powers not represented at that Conference but which are Parties to the Geneva Conventions of 1864 , 1906 or 1929 for the Relief of the Wounded and Sick in Armies in the Field .
Translation: 第五十六条 本公约自今日起开放签署，签署期限至1950年2月12日，签署方包括参加1949年4月21日在日内瓦召开的会议的各国，以及未参加该会议但为1864年、1906年或1929年《陆军伤病救护日内瓦公约》缔约方的国家。

Query_Text_en: Article57 The present Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible and the ratifications shall be deposited at Berne .
Translation: 第五十七条 本公约应尽快予以批准，批准书应在伯尔尼交存。

Query_Text_en: A record shall be drawn up of the deposit of each instrument of ratification and certified copies of this record shall be transmitted by the Swiss Federal Council to all the Powers in whose name the Convention has been signed , or whose accession has been notified .
Translation: 每一份批准书的交存都应制作记录，并由瑞士联邦委员会向所有以其名义签署本公约或已通知加入的国家发送经认证的记录副本。

Query_Text_en: Article58 The present Convention shall come into force six months after not less than two instruments of ratification have been deposited .
Translation: 第五十八条 本公约自至少两份批准书交存之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , it shall come into force for each High Contracting Party six months after the deposit of the instrument of ratification .
Translation: 此后，对于每一缔约高等缔约方，本公约应自其交存批准书之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article59 The present Convention replaces the Conventions of 22 August 1864 , 6 July 1906 , and 27 July 1929 , in relations between the High Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第五十九条 本公约在缔约国之间取代1864年8月22日、1906年7月6日和1929年7月27日签订的各项公约。

Query_Text_en: Article60 From the date of its coming into force , it shall be open to any Power in whose name the present Convention has not been signed , to accede to this Convention .
Translation: 第六十条 本公约自生效之日起，任何尚未以其名义签署本公约的国家均可加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article61Accessions shall be notified in writing to the Swiss Federal Council , and shall take effect six months after the date on which they are received .
Translation: 第61条 加入须以书面形式通知瑞士联邦委员会，并自收到通知之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate the accessions to all the Powers in whose name the Convention has been signed , or whose accession has been notified .
Translation: 瑞士联邦委员会应将所有加入本公约的情况，通报给以其名义签署本公约或已通知加入本公约的所有国家。

Query_Text_en: Article62 The situations provided for in Articles 2 and 3 shall give immediate effect to ratifications deposited and accessions notified by the Parties to the conflict before or after the beginning of hostilities or occupation .
Translation: 第六十二条 在第二条和第三条所规定的情形下，冲突各方在敌对行动或占领开始前后所交存的批准书和所通知的加入，均应立即生效。

Query_Text_en: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate by the quickest method any ratifications or accessions received from Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 瑞士联邦委员会应以最快方式通报收到的冲突当事方的任何批准或加入。

Query_Text_en: Article63 Each of the High Contracting Parties shall be at liberty to denounce the present Convention .
Translation: 第六十三条 每一缔约方均有权宣布退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall be notified in writing to the Swiss Federal Council , which shall transmit it to the Governments of all the High Contracting Parties .
Translation: 废约声明应以书面形式通知瑞士联邦委员会，由其转达给所有缔约国政府。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall take effect one year after the notification thereof has been made to the Swiss Federal Council .
Translation: 该退约通知在提交给瑞士联邦委员会一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: However , a denunciation of which notification has been made at a time when the denouncing Power is involved in a conflict shall not take effect until peace has been concluded , and until after operations connected with release and repatriation of the persons protected by the present Convention have been terminated .
Translation: 然而，在宣布退出时，若通知是在退出国卷入冲突期间发出的，则该退出声明在和平达成之前，以及在根据本公约进行的被保护人员的释放与遣返行动结束之前，不得生效。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall have effect only in respect of the denouncing Power . It shall in no way impair the obligations which the Parties to the conflict shall remain bound to fulfil by virtue of the principles of the law of nations , as they result from the usages established among civilized peoples , from the laws of humanity and the dictates of the public conscience .
Translation: 该退约声明仅对提出退约的缔约国生效，并不影响冲突各方根据国际法原则、文明国家间既定惯例、人道法则及公共良知要求所应履行的义务。

Query_Text_en: Article64 The Swiss Federal Council shall register the present Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations . The Swiss Federal Council shall also inform the Secretariat of the United Nations of all ratifications , accessions and denunciations received by it with respect to the present Convention .
Translation: 第六十四条 瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约登记在联合国秘书处。瑞士联邦委员会还应将其收到的关于本公约的所有批准、加入和退出通知告知联合国秘书处。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof the undersigned , having deposited their respective full powers , have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 为此，以下签署人经出具各自的全权证书，已在本公约上签字为证。

Query_Text_en: Done at Geneva this twelfth day of August 1949 , in the English and French languages .
Translation: 本文件于一九四九年八月十二日在日内瓦以英文和法文签署。

Query_Text_en: The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Swiss Confederation .
Translation: 正本应存放于瑞士联邦档案馆。

Query_Text_en: The Swiss Federal Council shall transmit certified copies thereof to each of the Signatory and Acceding States .
Translation: 瑞士联邦委员会应将经认证的副本分送给所有签署国和加入国。

Query_Text_en: HAVE DEEMED it necessary to revise in certain particulars and to complete the work of the First Peace Conference for the pacific settlement of international disputes ;
Translation: 认为有必要在若干方面进行修订，并完善第一次和平会议关于和平解决国际争端的工作；

Query_Text_en: [ Names of Plenipotentiaries not reproduced here . Who , after deposited their full powers , found in good and due form , have agreed upon the following :
Translation: [全权代表名单在此不予列出。各全权代表在提交了经核查符合规定的全权证书后，达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Article 1With a view to obviating as far as possible recourse to force in the relations between States , the Contracting Powers agree to use their best efforts to ensure the pacific settlement of international differences .
Translation: 第一条 为尽可能避免国家间诉诸武力，缔约国同意尽最大努力，确保以和平方式解决国际争端。

Query_Text_en: Article 2In case of serious disagreement or dispute , before an appeal to arms , the Contracting Powers agree to have recourse , as far as circumstances allow , to the good offices or mediation of one or more friendly Powers .
Translation: 第二条 在发生严重分歧或争端时，缔约国同意在诉诸武力之前，尽可能根据实际情况，寻求一个或多个友好国家的善意协助或调解。

Query_Text_en: Article 3Independently of this recourse , the Contracting Powers deem it expedient and desirable that one or more Powers , strangers to the dispute , should , on their own initiative and as far as circumstances may allow , offer their good offices or mediation to the States at variance .
Translation:
第三条  
除上述途径外，缔约国认为，一项或多项与争端无关的国家主动并在条件允许的情况下，向争执双方提供善意协助或调解，是切实可行且值得提倡的。

Query_Text_en: Powers strangers to the dispute have the right to offer good offices or mediation even during the course of hostilities .
Translation: 与争端无关的第三方有权在敌对行动期间提供斡旋或调解。

Query_Text_en: The exercise of this right can never be regarded by either of the parties in dispute as an unfriendly act .
Translation: 任何一方在争议中行使这一权利，均不得被视为不友好行为。

Query_Text_en: Article 4The part of the mediator consists in reconciling the opposing claims and appeasing the feelings of resentment which may have arisen between the States at variance .
Translation: 第四条 调解人的职责在于协调双方的对立诉求，缓和因争议而产生的敌对情绪。

Query_Text_en: Article 5The functions of the mediator are at an end when once it is declared , either by one of the parties to the dispute or by the mediator himself , that the means of reconciliation proposed by him are not accepted .
Translation:
第五条  
调解员的职能在任何一方当事人或调解员本人声明其所提出的和解方案未被接受时即告终止。

Query_Text_en: Article 6Good offices and mediation undertaken either at the request of the parties in dispute or on the initiative of Powers strangers to the dispute have exclusively the character of advice , and never have binding force .
Translation:
第六条  
无论是应争端当事方的请求，还是由与争端无关的国家主动提出，所进行的善意斡旋与调解仅具建议性质，绝不具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Article 7The acceptance of mediation can not , unless there be an agreement to the contrary , have the effect of interrupting , delaying , or hindering mobilization or other measures of preparation for war .
Translation: 第七条 除非另有协议，接受调解不得导致中断、延误或妨碍动员或其他战争准备措施。

Query_Text_en: If it takes place after the commencement of hostilities , the military operations in progress are not interrupted in the absence of an agreement to the contrary .
Translation: 如果在敌对行动开始后发生，除非另有协议，正在进行的军事行动不会中断。

Query_Text_en: In case of a serious difference endangering peace , the States at variance choose respectively a Power , to which they entrust the mission of entering into direct communication with the Power chosen on the other side , with the object of preventing the rupture of pacific relations .
Translation: 在出现严重分歧危及和平时，争议各方分别选择一个国家，委托其与对方所选国家直接沟通，以防止和平关系破裂。

Query_Text_en: For the period of this mandate , the term of which , unless otherwise stipulated , can not exceed thirty days , the States in dispute cease from all direct communication on the subject of the dispute , which is regarded as referred exclusively to the mediating Powers , which must use their best efforts to settle it .
Translation: 在本授权期限内，除非另有规定，期限不得超过三十天，争端各方应停止就争端事项进行任何直接沟通，争端事项视为专门提交给调解国处理，调解国必须尽最大努力予以解决。

Query_Text_en: In case of a definite rupture of pacific relations , these Powers are charged with the joint task of taking advantage of any opportunity to restore peace .
Translation: 如和平关系确实破裂，这些国家将共同承担利用任何机会恢复和平的任务。

Query_Text_en: Article 9In disputes of an international nature involving neither honor nor vital interests , and arising from a difference of opinion on points of facts , the Contracting Powers deem it expedient and desirable that the parties who have not been able to come to an agreement by means of diplomacy , should , as far as circumstances allow , institute an International Commission of Inquiry , to facilitate a solution of these disputes by elucidating the facts by means of an impartial and conscientious investigation .
Translation: 第九条 对于不涉及国家荣誉或重大利益、且因事实观点分歧而产生的国际性争端，缔约国认为，在外交途径未能达成协议的情况下，双方应根据实际情况设立国际调查委员会，通过公正、认真地调查事实，促进争端的解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 10International Commissions of Inquiry are constituted by special agreement between the parties in dispute .
Translation:
第十条  
国际调查委员会由争议双方通过特别协议成立。

Query_Text_en: The Inquiry convention defines the facts to be examined ;
Translation: 调查惯例界定了需审查的事实；

Query_Text_en: it determines the mode and time in which the Commission is to be formed and the extent of the powers of the Commissioners . It also determines , if there is need , where the Commission is to sit , and whether it may remove to another place , the language the Commission shall use and the languages the use of which shall be authorized before it , as well as the date on which each party must deposit its statement of facts , and , generally speaking , all the conditions upon which the parties have agreed .
Translation: 它决定了委员会的组建方式和时间，以及委员的权限范围。如有必要，还规定了委员会的开会地点及是否可以迁移至其他地点、委员会使用的语言及允许在委员会前使用的语言，以及各方提交事实陈述的日期，并且一般来说，所有双方达成一致的条件也由其确定。

Query_Text_en: If the parties consider it necessary to appoint Assessors , the Convention of Inquiry shall determine the mode of their selection and the extent of their powers .
Translation: 如双方认为有必要任命评审员，调查公约应确定其选任方式及权限范围。

Query_Text_en: Article 11If the Inquiry Convention has not determined where the Commission is to sit , it will sit at The Hague .
Translation: 第十一条 如果调查公约未确定委员会的开会地点，则委员会应在海牙召开。

Query_Text_en: The place of meeting , once fixed , can not be altered by the Commission except with the assent of the parties .
Translation: 会议地点一经确定，除非经各方同意，委员会不得变更。

Query_Text_en: If the Inquiry Convention has not determined what languages are to be employed , the question shall be decided by the Commission .
Translation: 如调查公约未规定应使用何种语言，则由委员会决定所用语言。

Query_Text_en: Article 12Unless an undertaking is made to the contrary , Commissions of Inquiry shall be formed in the manner determined by Articles 45 and 57 of the present Convention .
Translation: 除非另有承诺，调查委员会应按照本公约第45条和第57条的规定组建。

Query_Text_en: Article 13Should one of the Commissioners or one of the Assessors , should there be any , either die , or resign , or be unable for any reason whatever to discharge his functions , the same procedure is followed for filling the vacancy as was followed for appointing him .
Translation: 第十三条 如果一名委员或评审（如有）因故去世、辞职或因任何原因无法履行其职责，填补空缺应按照其原先的任命程序进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 14The parties are entitled to appoint special agents to attend the Commission of Inquiry , whose duty it is to represent them and to act as intermediaries between them and the Commission .
Translation: 第十四条 当事方有权委派专门代表出席调查委员会，代表的职责是代表当事方，并作为当事方与委员会之间的联络人。

Query_Text_en: They are further authorized to engage counsel or advocates , appointed by themselves , to state their case and uphold their interests before the Commission .
Translation: 他们还被授权聘请由其自行指定的律师或代理人，在委员会面前陈述其案件并维护其利益。

Query_Text_en: Article 15The International Bureau of the Permanent Court of Arbitration acts as registry for the Commissions which sit at The Hague , and shall place its offices and staff at the disposal of the Contracting Powers for the use of the Commission of Inquiry .
Translation: 第十五条 常设仲裁法院国际局作为在海牙举行的委员会的登记机构，并应将其办公场所和工作人员提供给缔约国，以供调查委员会使用。

Query_Text_en: Article 16If the Commission meets elsewhere than at The Hague , it appoints a Secretary-General , whose office serves as registry .
Translation: 第十六条 如果委员会在海牙以外的地点召开会议，则应任命一名秘书长，其办公室作为登记处。

Query_Text_en: It is the function of the registry , under the control of the President , to make the necessary arrangements for the sittings of the Commission , the preparation of the Minutes , and , while the inquiry lasts , for the charge of the archives , which shall subsequently be transferred to the International Bureau at The Hague .
Translation: 在总统的领导下，登记处负责为委员会的会议安排必要的事务，准备会议记录，并在调查期间管理档案，调查结束后将档案移交位于海牙的国际局。

Query_Text_en: Article 17In order to facilitate the constitution and working of Commissions of Inquiry , the Contracting Powers recommend the following rules , which shall be applicable to the inquiry procedure in so far as the parties do not adopt other rules .
Translation: 第十七条 为促进调查委员会的组建和运作，缔约国建议以下规则，除非当事方另行制定规则，这些规则应适用于调查程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 18The Commission shall settle the details of the procedure not covered by the special Inquiry Convention or the present Convention , and shall arrange all the formalities required for dealing with the evidence .
Translation: 第十八条 委员会应负责处理未被特别调查公约或本公约涵盖的程序细节，并安排处理证据所需的全部手续。

Query_Text_en: Article 19On the inquiry both sides must be heard .
Translation: 第十九条 调查过程中，必须听取双方意见。

Query_Text_en: At the dates fixed , each party communicates to the Commission and to the other party the statements of facts , if any , and , in all cases , the instruments , papers , and documents which it considers useful for ascertaining the truth , as well as the list of witnesses and experts whose evidence it wishes to be heard .
Translation: 在指定日期，每一方应向委员会及对方提交事实陈述（如有），并在所有情况下，提交其认为有助于查明事实的相关文件、资料和证件，以及希望听取证词的证人和专家名单。

Query_Text_en: Article 20The Commission is entitled , with the assent of the Powers , to move temporarily to any place where it considers it may be useful to have recourse to this means of inquiry or to send one or more of its members .
Translation: 第二十条 委员会有权在有关国家同意的情况下，临时迁移至其认为有必要进行调查的任何地点，或派遣一名或多名成员前往。

Query_Text_en: Permission must be obtained from the State on whose territory it is proposed to hold the inquiry .
Translation: 必须获得拟在其领土上进行调查的国家的许可。

Query_Text_en: Article 21Every investigation , and every examination of a locality , must be made in the presence of the agents and counsel of the parties or after they have been duly summoned .
Translation: 第二十一条：所有调查以及对现场的检查，必须在当事人代理人和律师在场的情况下进行，或在他们被正式传唤之后进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 22The Commission is entitled to ask from either party for such explanations and information as it considers necessary .
Translation: 第二十二条 委员会有权向任何一方要求其提供其认为必要的解释和信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 23The parties undertake to supply the Commission of Inquiry , as fully as they may think possible , with all means and facilities necessary to enable it to become completely acquainted with , and to accurately understand , the facts in question .
Translation: 第二十三条 各方承诺将尽其所能，向调查委员会提供所有必要的手段和便利，以使其能够全面了解并准确掌握相关事实。

Query_Text_en: They undertake to make use of the means at their disposal , under their municipal law , to insure the appearance of the witnesses or experts who are in their territory and have been summoned before the Commission .
Translation: 他们承诺依据本国法律，利用其可用手段，确保在其境内并被委员会传唤的证人或专家出庭作证。

Query_Text_en: If the witnesses or experts are unable to appear before the Commission , the parties will arrange for their evidence to be taken before the qualified officials of their own country .
Translation: 如证人或专家无法出席委员会，相关当事方应安排在本国具备资格的官员面前进行证据陈述。

Query_Text_en: Article 24For all notices to be served by the Commission in the territory of a third Contracting Power , the Commission shall apply direct to the Government of the said Power .
Translation: 第二十四条 委员会在第三缔约国境内送达所有通知时，应直接向该国政府提出申请。

Query_Text_en: The same rule applies in the case of steps being taken on the spot to procure evidence .
Translation: 同样的规则适用于现场采取措施收集证据的情况。

Query_Text_en: The requests for this purpose are to be executed so far as the means at the disposal of the Power applied to under its municipal law allow .
Translation: 对此目的的请求应在被请求国根据其国内法所能提供的手段范围内予以执行。

Query_Text_en: They can not be rejected unless the Power in question considers they are calculated to impair its sovereign rights or its safety .
Translation: 除非有关国家认为这些建议可能损害其主权权利或安全，否则不得拒绝。

Query_Text_en: The Commission will equally be always entitled to act through the Power on whose territory it sits .
Translation: 委员会同样始终有权通过其所在国行使职权。

Query_Text_en: Article 25The witnesses and experts are summoned on the request of the parties or by the Commission of its own motion , and , in every case , through the Government of the State in whose territory they are .
Translation: 第二十五条 证人和专家由当事方请求或委员会自行决定传唤，并且在任何情况下，均通过其所在国政府进行传唤。

Query_Text_en: The witnesses are heard in succession and separately in the presence of the agents and counsel , and in the order fixed by the Commission .
Translation: 证人依照委员会确定的顺序，分别且依次在执法人员和律师在场的情况下接受讯问。

Query_Text_en: Article 26The examination of witnesses is conducted by the President .
Translation: 第二十六条 证人由庭长负责讯问。

Query_Text_en: The members of the Commission may however put to each witness questions which they consider likely to throw light on and complete his evidence , or get information on any point concerning the witness within the limits of what is necessary in order to get at the truth .
Translation: 然而，委员会成员可以向每位证人提出他们认为有助于澄清和补充其证词的问题，或就与该证人有关的任何事项获取信息，但须以查明事实所必需的范围为限。

Query_Text_en: The agents and counsel of the parties may not interrupt the witness when he is making his statement , nor put any direct question to him , but they may ask the President to put such additional questions to the witness as they think expedient .
Translation: 各方代理人及律师在证人陈述时不得打断，也不得直接向证人提问，但他们可以请求主席向证人提出他们认为适当的补充问题。

Query_Text_en: Article 27The witness must give his evidence without being allowed to read any written draft .
Translation: 第二十七条 证人作证时不得宣读任何书面稿件。

Query_Text_en: He may , however , be permitted by the President to consult notes or documents if the nature of the facts referred to necessitates their employment .
Translation: 但是，如果所涉及事实的性质需要使用相关资料，总统可以允许他查阅笔记或文件。

Query_Text_en: Article 28A Minute of the evidence of the witness is drawn up forthwith and read to the witness .
Translation: 第二十八条A 证人证言记录应当立即制作，并向证人宣读。

Query_Text_en: The latter may make such alterations and additions as he thinks necessary , which will be recorded at the end of his statement .
Translation: 后者可根据其认为必要的情况作出修改和补充，并将在其陈述结尾处予以记录。

Query_Text_en: When the whole of his statement has been read to the witness , he is asked to sign it .
Translation: 当证人听完整份陈述后，会被要求在上面签字。

Query_Text_en: Article 29The agents are authorized , in the course of or at the close of the inquiry , to present in writing to the Commission and to the other party such statements , requisitions , or summaries of the facts as they consider useful for ascertaining the truth .
Translation: 第二十九条 调查过程中或调查结束时，代理人有权向委员会及对方提交书面陈述、请求或事实摘要，认为有助于查明真相的材料。

Query_Text_en: Article 30The Commission considers its decisions in private and the proceedings are secret .
Translation: 第三十条 委员会以非公开方式审议其决定，审理过程保密。

Query_Text_en: All questions are decided by a majority of the members of the Commission .
Translation: 委员会的所有事项均由多数成员表决决定。

Query_Text_en: If a member declines to vote , the fact must be recorded in the Minutes .
Translation: 如有成员弃权，须在会议记录中予以注明。

Query_Text_en: Article 31The sittings of the Commission are not public , nor the Minutes and documents connected with the inquiry published except in virtue of a decision of the Commission taken with the consent of the parties .
Translation: 第三十一条 委员会的会议不对外公开，会议记录及与调查有关的文件，除非经委员会作出决定并征得当事方同意，不予公布。

Query_Text_en: Article 32After the parties have presented all the explanations and evidence , and the witnesses have all been heard , the President declares the inquiry terminated , and the Commission adjourns to deliberate and to draw up its Report .
Translation: 第三十二条 当各方均已陈述完毕并提交所有证据，所有证人也已作证后，主席宣布调查结束，委员会随即休会进行评议并起草报告。

Query_Text_en: Article 33The Report is signed by all the members of the Commission .
Translation: 第三十三条 报告须由委员会全体成员签署。

Query_Text_en: If one of the members refuses to sign , the fact is mentioned ; but the validity of the Report is not affected .
Translation: 如果有成员拒绝签署，将会予以注明；但报告的有效性不受影响。

Query_Text_en: Article 34The Report of the Commission is read at a public sitting , the agents and counsel of the parties being present or duly summoned .
Translation: 第三十四条 委员会报告在公开会议上宣读，双方当事人的代理人和律师须到场或经正式传唤。

Query_Text_en: A copy of the Report is given to each party .
Translation: 报告副本将提供给各方。

Query_Text_en: Article 35The Report of the Commission is limited to a statement of facts , and has in no way the character of an Award .
Translation: 第三十五条 委员会报告仅限于事实陈述，不具有裁决性质。

Query_Text_en: It leaves to the parties entire freedom as to the effect to be given to the statement .
Translation: 它完全赋予各方对该声明效力的自主决定权。

Query_Text_en: Article 36Each party pays its own expenses and an equal share of the expenses incurred by the Commission .
Translation: 第三十六条：各方自行承担自身费用，并平等分担委员会所产生的费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 37International arbitration has for its object the settlement of disputes between States by Judges of their own choice and on the basis of respect for law .
Translation:
第三十七条  
国际仲裁的宗旨是由各国自行选择的仲裁员，依据法律原则，解决国家间的争端。

Query_Text_en: Recourse to arbitration implies an engagement to submit in good faith to the Award .
Translation: 诉诸仲裁意味着承诺将以诚信态度接受裁决。

Query_Text_en: Article 38In questions of a legal nature , and especially in the interpretation or application of International Conventions , arbitration is recognized by the Contracting Powers as the most effective , and , at the same time , the most equitable means of settling disputes which diplomacy has failed to settle .
Translation: 第三十八条 在法律性质的问题上，特别是在国际公约的解释或适用方面，缔约国承认仲裁是解决外交未能解决的争端最有效且最公正的方式。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , it would be desirable that , in disputes about the abovementioned questions , the Contracting Powers should , if the case arose , have recourse to arbitration , in so far as circumstances permit .
Translation: 因此，在上述问题发生争议时，缔约国在条件允许的情况下，应尽可能通过仲裁方式解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 39The Arbitration Convention is concluded for questions already existing or for questions which may arise eventually .
Translation: 第三十九条 仲裁公约适用于已经存在的问题以及可能出现的问题。

Query_Text_en: It may embrace any dispute or only disputes of a certain category .
Translation: 它可以涵盖任何争议，也可以仅限于某一类争议。

Query_Text_en: Article 40Independently of general or private Treaties expressly stipulating recourse to arbitration as obligatory on the Contracting Powers , the said Powers reserve to themselves the right of concluding new Agreements , general or particular , with a view to extending compulsory arbitration to all cases which they may consider it possible to submit to it .
Translation:
第四十条  
除一般或私人条约明确规定缔约国必须诉诸仲裁外，缔约国保留自行缔结新的协议（无论是一般性还是特殊性）的权利，以便将强制仲裁适用于其认为可以提交仲裁的所有案件。

Query_Text_en: Article 41With the object of facilitating an immediate recourse to arbitration for international differences , which it has not been possible to settle by diplomacy , the Contracting Powers undertake to maintain the Permanent Court of Arbitration , as established by the First Peace Conference , accessible at all times , and operating , unless otherwise stipulated by the parties , in accordance with the rules of procedure inserted in the present Convention .
Translation: 第四十一条 为了便于对通过外交无法解决的国际争端立即诉诸仲裁，缔约国承诺维持由第一次和平会议设立的常设仲裁法院，使其随时可供使用，并除非当事方另有规定，按照本公约所载程序规则运作。

Query_Text_en: Article 42The Permanent Court is competent for all arbitration cases , unless the parties agree to institute a special Tribunal .
Translation: 第四十二条 常设法院有权受理所有仲裁案件，除非当事方同意设立特别法庭。

Query_Text_en: Article 43The Permanent Court sits at The Hague .
Translation: 第四十三条 常设法院设于海牙。

Query_Text_en: it has charge of the archives and conducts all the administrative business .
Translation: 它负责管理档案并处理所有行政事务。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Powers undertake to communicate to the Bureau , as soon as possible , a certified copy of any conditions of arbitration arrived at between them and of any Award concerning them delivered by a special Tribunal .
Translation: 缔约国承诺尽快向该局提交一份经认证的仲裁条件副本，以及由特别法庭作出的涉及它们的任何裁决副本。

Query_Text_en: They likewise undertake to communicate to the Bureau the laws , regulations , and documents eventually showing the execution of the Awards given by the Court .
Translation: 他们同样承诺向局方通报有关法律、法规及文件，以证明法院裁决的执行情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 44Each Contracting Power selects four persons at the most , of known competency in questions of international law , of the highest moral reputation , and disposed to accept the duties of Arbitrator .
Translation: 第四十四条 每一缔约国可最多选派四名在国际法问题上具有公认能力、品行高尚并愿意接受仲裁员职责的人士。

Query_Text_en: The persons thus elected are inscribed , as Members of the Court , in a list which shall be notified to all the Contracting Powers by the Bureau .
Translation: 经如此选举产生的人士，将作为法院成员登记在册，该名单由书记处通知所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Any alteration in the list of Arbitrators is brought by the Bureau to the knowledge of the Contracting Powers .
Translation: 仲裁员名单的任何变动均由局通知缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Two or more Powers may agree on the selection in common of one or more Members .
Translation: 两个或多个大国可以共同协商选定一名或多名成员。

Query_Text_en: The same person can be selected by different Powers .
Translation: 同一个人可以被不同的权力机构选中。

Query_Text_en: The Members of the Court are appointed for a term of six years .
Translation: 法院成员的任期为六年。

Query_Text_en: These appointments are renewable . Should a Member of the Court die or resign , the same procedure is followed for filling the vacancy as was followed for appointing him . In this case the appointment is made for a fresh period of six years .
Translation: 这些任命可以续期。如果法院成员去世或辞职，填补空缺的程序与其原先的任命程序相同。在这种情况下，新任命的任期为六年。

Query_Text_en: Article 45When the Contracting Powers wish to have recourse to the Permanent Court for the settlement of a difference which has arisen between them , the Arbitrators called upon to form the Tribunal with jurisdiction to decide this difference must be chosen from the general list of Members of the Court .
Translation: 第四十五条 当缔约国希望通过常设法院解决彼此之间产生的争议时，负责组成具备裁决该争议管辖权法庭的仲裁员，必须从法院成员的总名单中选出。

Query_Text_en: Each party appoints two Arbitrators , of whom one only can be its national or chosen from among the persons selected by it as Members of the Permanent Court . These Arbitrators together choose an Umpire .
Translation: 每一方各指定两名仲裁员，其中仅一名可以是本国国民或从其所选的常设法院成员中选出。这些仲裁员共同选定一名裁决员。

Query_Text_en: If the votes are equally divided , the choice of the Umpire is entrusted to a third Power , selected by the parties by common accord .
Translation: 如表决结果出现平分，裁决权将交由双方共同协商选定的第三国行使。

Query_Text_en: If an agreement is not arrived at on this subject each party selects a different Power , and the choice of the Umpire is made in concert by the Powers thus selected .
Translation: 如双方未能就此议题达成协议，则各方各自选定一个国家，由所选国家协商共同决定仲裁国。

Query_Text_en: If , within two months ' time , these two Powers can not come to an agreement , each of them presents two candidates taken from the list of Members of the Permanent Court , exclusive of the members selected by the parties and not being nationals of either of them .
Translation: 如果在两个月内，这两个大国仍无法达成协议，则每一方应各自从常设法院成员名单中提出两名候选人，但不得包括由当事方选定的成员，且不得为任何一方的本国国民。

Query_Text_en: Drawing lots determines which of the candidates thus presented shall be Umpire .
Translation: 抽签决定由上述候选人中谁担任裁判。

Query_Text_en: Article 46The Tribunal being thus composed , the parties notify to the Bureau their determination to have recourse to the Court , the text of their `` Compromis '' [ 1 ] , and the names of the Arbitrators .
Translation: 第四十六条 仲裁庭组成后，当事各方应将其提交法院的决定、《仲裁协议》文本以及仲裁员名单通知秘书局。

Query_Text_en: The Bureau communicates without delay to each Arbitrator the `` Compromis '' , and the names of the other members of the Tribunal .
Translation: 秘书局应立即将“仲裁协议”及其他仲裁庭成员的姓名通知每位仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal assembles at the date fixed by the parties .
Translation: 仲裁庭在双方约定的日期召开。

Query_Text_en: The Bureau makes the necessary arrangements for the meeting .
Translation: 该局负责为会议作出必要的安排。

Query_Text_en: The members of the Tribunal , in the exercise of their duties and out of their own country , enjoy diplomatic privileges and immunities .
Translation: 法庭成员在履行职责并身处国外时，享有外交特权和豁免权。

Query_Text_en: Article 47The Bureau is authorized to place its offices and staff at the disposal of the Contracting Powers for the use of any special Board of Arbitration .
Translation: 第四十七条 局有权将其办事机构及工作人员提供给缔约国，以供任何特别仲裁委员会使用。

Query_Text_en: The jurisdiction of the Permanent Court may , within the conditions laid down in the regulations , be extended to disputes between non-Contracting Powers or between Contracting Powers and non-Contracting Powers , if the parties are agreed on recourse to this Tribunal .
Translation: 在规章规定的条件下，常设法院的管辖权可以扩展至非缔约国之间的争端，或缔约国与非缔约国之间的争端，前提是双方同意提交该法庭裁决。

Query_Text_en: Article 48The Contracting Powers consider it their duty , if a serious dispute threatens to break out between two or more of them , to remind these latter that the Permanent Court is open to them .
Translation: 第四十八条 缔约国认为，如果两国或多国之间有严重争端即将爆发，有责任提醒有关国家常设法院对其开放。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , they declare that the fact of reminding the parties at variance of the provisions of the present Convention , and the advice given to them , in the highest interests of peace , to have recourse to the Permanent Court , can only be regarded as friendly actions .
Translation: 因此，他们声明，提醒争议各方注意本公约的相关规定，并本着维护和平的最高利益，建议其诉诸常设法院的行为，只能被视为友好举措。

Query_Text_en: In case of dispute between two Powers , one of them can always address to the International Bureau a note containing a declaration that it would be ready to submit the dispute to arbitration .
Translation: 在两国发生争议时，其中一方可随时向国际局递交一份声明，表示其愿意将争议提交仲裁解决。

Query_Text_en: The Bureau must at once inform the other Power of the declaration .
Translation: 该局必须立即将该声明通知另一缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Article 49The Permanent Administrative Council , composed of the Diplomatic Representatives of the Contracting Powers accredited to The Hague and of the Netherland Minister for Foreign Affairs , who will act as President , is charged with the direction and control of the International Bureau .
Translation: 第四十九条 常设行政委员会由驻海牙的缔约国外交代表和荷兰外交部长组成，荷兰外交部长担任主席。该委员会负责指导和监督国际局的工作。

Query_Text_en: The Council settles its rules of procedure and all other necessary regulations .
Translation: 理事会制定其议事规则及所有其他必要规章。

Query_Text_en: It decides all questions of administration which may arise with regard to the operations of the Court .
Translation: 它负责裁决与法院运作相关的所有行政事务。

Query_Text_en: It has entire control over the appointment , suspension , or dismissal of the officials and employees of the Bureau .
Translation: 它对本局官员和雇员的任命、停职或解雇拥有完全的控制权。

Query_Text_en: It fixes the payments and salaries , and controls the general expenditure .
Translation: 它规定了支付和薪酬，并控制总体支出。

Query_Text_en: At meetings duly summoned the presence of nine members is sufficient to render valid the discussions of the Council .
Translation: 在依法召集的会议上，九名成员的出席即可使理事会的讨论有效。

Query_Text_en: The decisions are taken by a majority of votes .
Translation: 决策由多数票通过。

Query_Text_en: The Council communicates to the Contracting Powers without delay the regulations adopted by it .
Translation: 理事会会将其通过的规章及时通知缔约国。

Query_Text_en: It furnishes them with an annual Report on the labors of the Court , the working of the administration , and the expenditure .
Translation: 它向他们提交一份年度报告，内容包括法院的工作、行政运作以及经费支出情况。

Query_Text_en: The Report likewise contains a resume of what is important in the documents communicated to the Bureau by the Powers in virtue of Article 43 , paragraphs 3 and 4 .
Translation: 报告同样对各国根据第43条第3款和第4款提交给局的文件中重要内容作了摘要。

Query_Text_en: Article 50The expenses of the Bureau shall be borne by the Contracting Powers in the proportion fixed for the International Bureau of the Universal Postal Union . The expenses to be charged to the adhering Powers shall be reckoned from the date on which their adhesion comes into force
Translation: 第五十条 局的经费应由缔约国按照万国邮政联盟国际局所规定的比例分担。对加入国应分担的经费，自其加入生效之日起计算。

Query_Text_en: Article 51With a view to encouraging the development of arbitration , the Contracting Powers have agreed on the following rules , which are applicable to arbitration procedure , unless other rules have been agreed on by the parties .
Translation: 第五十一条 为促进仲裁的发展，缔约国同意以下规则，除非当事方另有约定，这些规则适用于仲裁程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 52The Powers which have recourse to arbitration sign a `` Compromis '' , in which the subject of the dispute is clearly defined , the time allowed for appointing Arbitrators , the form , order , and time in which the communication referred to in Article 63 must be made , and the amount of the sum which each party must deposit in advance to defray the expenses .
Translation: 第五十二条 诉诸仲裁的各缔约国应签署“仲裁协议”，明确界定争端事项，规定指定仲裁员的期限、根据第六十三条所述进行沟通的方式、顺序及时间，以及各方为支付费用需预先缴纳的金额。

Query_Text_en: The `` Compromis '' likewise defines , if there is occasion , the manner of appointing Arbitrators , any special powers which may eventually belong to the Tribunal , where it shall meet , the language it shall use , and the languages the employment of which shall be authorized before it , and , generally speaking , all the conditions on which the parties are agreed .
Translation: “妥协书”同样规定了在必要时仲裁员的指定方式、仲裁庭可能享有的特别权力、仲裁庭的开庭地点、所使用的语言及允许在庭审中使用的语言，并且一般而言，还规定了双方当事人达成一致的所有条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 53The Permanent Court is competent to settle the `` Compromis '' , if the parties are agreed to have recourse to it for the purpose .
Translation: 第五十三条 常设法院有权解决“协议书”事项，前提是双方同意为此目的提请法院裁决。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A dispute covered by a general Treaty of Arbitration concluded or renewed after the present Convention has come into force , and providing for a `` Compromis '' in all disputes and not either explicitly or implicitly excluding the settlement of the `` Compromis '' from the competence of the Court . Recourse can not , however , be had to the Court if the other party declares that in its opinion the dispute does not belong to the category of disputes which can be submitted to compulsory arbitration , unless the Treaty of Arbitration confers upon the Arbitration Tribunal the power of deciding this preliminary question .
Translation: 1. 在本公约生效后签订或续签的一般仲裁条约所涵盖的争端，并且该条约规定所有争端均须通过“争端协议”解决，且未明确或暗示排除法院对“争端协议”事项的管辖权。惟若另一方声明其认为该争端不属于可提交强制仲裁的争端类别，则不得向法院申请，除非仲裁条约赋予仲裁庭决定此项初步问题的权力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A dispute arising from contract debts claimed from one Power by another Power as due to its nationals , and for the settlement of which the offer of arbitration has been accepted .
Translation: 2. 因一国向另一国主张合同债务，认为该债务应支付给其本国国民而引发的争议，并且为解决该争议，仲裁建议已被接受。

Query_Text_en: This arrangement is not applicable if acceptance is subject to the condition that the `` Compromis '' should be settled in some other way .
Translation: 如果接受以“争端协议”须通过其他方式解决为条件，则此安排不适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 54In the cases contemplated in the preceding Article , the `` Compromis '' shall be settled by a Commission consisting of five members selected in the manner arranged for in Article 45 , paragraphs 3 to 6 .
Translation: 第五十四条 在前条所述情形下，“仲裁协议”应由一个由五名成员组成的委员会进行裁决，该委员会成员的选任方式按照第四十五条第三至第六款的规定进行。

Query_Text_en: The fifth member is President of the Commission ex officio .
Translation: 第五位成员为委员会主席，依职权担任该职。

Query_Text_en: Article 55The duties of Arbitrator may be conferred on one Arbitrator alone or on several Arbitrators selected by the parties as they please , or chosen by them from the Members of the Permanent Court of Arbitration established by the present Convention .
Translation: 第五十五条 仲裁员的职责可以由一名仲裁员单独承担，也可以由当事方自由选定的多名仲裁员共同承担，或者由当事方从本公约设立的常设仲裁法院成员中选任。

Query_Text_en: Failing the constitution of the Tribunal by direct agreement between the parties , the course referred to in Article 45 , paragraphs 3 to 6 , is followed .
Translation: 如双方未能通过直接协商组成仲裁庭，则应按照第45条第3至第6款规定的程序进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 56When a Sovereign or the Chief of a State is chosen as Arbitrator , the arbitration procedure is settled by him .
Translation: 第五十六条 当一国元首或国家首脑被选为仲裁人时，仲裁程序由其自行决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 57The Umpire is President of the Tribunal ex officio .
Translation: 第五十七条 仲裁员当然担任仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: When the Tribunal does not include an Umpire , it appoints its own President .
Translation: 如仲裁庭未设仲裁长，则由仲裁庭自行指定主席。

Query_Text_en: Article 58When the `` Compromis '' is settled by a Commission , as contemplated in Article 54 , and in the absence of an agreement to the contrary , the Commission itself shall form the Arbitration Tribunal .
Translation: 第五十八条 当“争端协议”由委员会根据第五十四条的规定达成，且未另有协议时，该委员会本身即构成仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: Article 59Should one of the Arbitrators either die , retire , or be unable for any reason whatever to discharge his functions , the same procedure is followed for filling the vacancy as was followed for appointing him .
Translation: 第五十九条 如果仲裁员因故去世、退休或因任何原因无法履行其职责，应按照任命该仲裁员时所采用的相同程序进行补缺。

Query_Text_en: Article 60The Tribunal sits at The Hague , unless some other place is selected by the parties .
Translation: 第六十条 仲裁庭通常在海牙开庭，除非当事人另有选择。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal can only sit in the territory of a third Power with the latter 's consent .
Translation: 法庭只能在第三方国家的领土上举行，且须经该国同意。

Query_Text_en: The place of meeting once fixed can not be altered by the Tribunal , except with the consent of the parties .
Translation: 会议地点一经确定，除非经双方同意，仲裁庭不得更改。

Query_Text_en: Article 61If the question as to what languages are to be used has not been settled by the `` Compromis '' , it shall be decided by the Tribunal .
Translation: 第六十一条 如果关于使用何种语言的问题未在“协议”中解决，则由法庭决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 62The parties are entitled to appoint special agents to attend the Tribunal to act as intermediaries between themselves and the Tribunal .
Translation: 第六十二条 当事方有权指定特别代理人出席仲裁庭，作为其与仲裁庭之间的联络人。

Query_Text_en: They are further authorized to retain for the defense of their rights and interests before the Tribunal counsel or advocates appointed by themselves for this purpose .
Translation: 他们还被授权为在法庭上维护自身权利和利益而聘请由其自行指定的律师或代理人。

Query_Text_en: The Members of the permanent Court may not act as agents , counsel , or advocates except on behalf of the Power which appointed them Members of the Court .
Translation: 常设法院的成员不得担任代理人、法律顾问或辩护人，除非是代表任命其为法院成员的国家。

Query_Text_en: pleadings and oral discussions .
Translation: 诉状与口头辩论。

Query_Text_en: the parties annex thereto all papers and documents called for in the case .
Translation: 双方随案附上所有要求提交的文件和资料。

Query_Text_en: This communication shall be made either directly or through the intermediary of the International Bureau , in the order and within the time fixed by the `` Compromis '' .
Translation: 该通知应按照“仲裁协议”规定的顺序和期限，直接或通过国际局转达。

Query_Text_en: The time fixed by the `` Compromis '' may be extended by mutual agreement by the parties , or by the Tribunal when the latter considers it necessary for the purpose of reaching a just decision .
Translation: “协议书”所规定的期限，可以经双方当事人协商一致予以延长，或者在仲裁庭认为为作出公正裁决有必要时，由仲裁庭决定延长。

Query_Text_en: The discussions consist in the oral development before the Tribunal of the arguments of the parties .
Translation: 讨论包括在法庭上由各方进行口头辩论。

Query_Text_en: Article 64A certified copy of every document produced by one party must be communicated to the other party .
Translation: 第64A条 由一方提交的每份文件的经认证副本，必须送交对方。

Query_Text_en: Article 65Unless special circumstances arise , the Tribunal does not meet until the pleadings are closed .
Translation: 第六十五条 除非出现特殊情况，法庭在诉状交换完毕前不予开庭。

Query_Text_en: Article 66The discussions are under the control of the President .
Translation: 第六十六条 会议讨论由主席主持。

Query_Text_en: They are only public if it be so decided by the Tribunal , with the assent of the parties .
Translation: 只有在法庭决定并经各方同意的情况下，庭审才会公开。

Query_Text_en: They are recorded in minutes drawn up by the Secretaries appointed by the President .
Translation: 他们的记录由总统任命的秘书整理成会议纪要。

Query_Text_en: These minutes are signed by the President and by one of the Secretaries and alone have an authentic character .
Translation: 本会议记录由主席和一名秘书签署，具有唯一的正式效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 67After the close of the pleadings , the Tribunal is entitled to refuse discussion of all new papers or documents which one of the parties may wish to submit to it without the consent of the other party .
Translation: 第六十七条 答辩结束后，未经对方当事人同意，任何一方如欲提交新的文件或材料，仲裁庭有权拒绝其讨论。

Query_Text_en: Article 68The Tribunal is free to take into consideration new papers or documents to which its attention may be drawn by the agents or counsel of the parties .
Translation: 第六十八条 仲裁庭可以自由考虑由当事方代理人或律师提交的新文件或资料。

Query_Text_en: In this case , the Tribunal has the right to require the production of these papers or documents , but is obliged to make them known to the opposite party .
Translation: 在此情况下，仲裁庭有权要求提交这些文件或资料，但有义务将其告知对方当事人。

Query_Text_en: Article 69The Tribunal can , besides , require from the agents of the parties the production of all papers , and can demand all necessary explanations .
Translation: 第六十九条 仲裁庭还可以要求双方代理人提交所有文件，并可要求提供一切必要的说明。

Query_Text_en: In case of refusal the Tribunal takes note of it .
Translation: 如有拒绝，法庭将予以记录。

Query_Text_en: Article 70The agents and the counsel of the parties are authorized to present orally to the Tribunal all the arguments they may consider expedient in defense of their case .
Translation: 第七十条 当事方的代理人和律师有权向法庭口头陈述他们认为有利于维护本方立场的所有论点。

Query_Text_en: Article 71They are entitled to raise objections and points .
Translation: 第七十一条 他们有权提出异议和意见。

Query_Text_en: The decisions of the Tribunal on these points are final and can not form the subject of any subsequent discussion .
Translation: 仲裁庭在这些问题上的裁决为最终裁决，不得作为任何后续讨论的议题。

Query_Text_en: Article 72The members of the Tribunal are entitled to put questions to the agents and counsel of the parties , and to ask them for explanations on doubtful points .
Translation: 第七十二条 法庭成员有权向当事方的代理人和律师提问，并就有疑问之处要求其作出解释。

Query_Text_en: Neither the questions put , nor the remarks made by members of the Tribunal in the course of the discussions , can be regarded as an expression of opinion by the Tribunal in general or by its members in particular .
Translation: 法庭成员在讨论过程中提出的问题或发表的意见，均不能被视为法庭整体或其成员个人的观点表达。

Query_Text_en: Article 73The Tribunal is authorized to declare its competence in interpreting the `` Compromis '' , as well as the other Treaties which may be invoked , and in applying the principles of law .
Translation: 第七十三条 仲裁法庭有权宣布其在解释“仲裁协议”以及可能被援引的其他条约、并适用法律原则方面的管辖权。

Query_Text_en: Article 74The Tribunal is entitled to issue rules of procedure for the conduct of the case , to decide the forms , order , and time in which each party must conclude its arguments , and to arrange all the formalities required for dealing with the evidence .
Translation: 第七十四条 仲裁庭有权制定案件审理程序规则，决定各方陈述意见的形式、顺序和时间，并安排处理证据所需的全部手续。

Query_Text_en: Article 75The parties undertake to supply the Tribunal , as fully as they consider possible , with all the information required for deciding the case .
Translation: 第七十五条 当事各方承诺，尽其所能向法庭提供裁决案件所需的一切信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 76For all notices which the Tribunal has to serve in the territory of a third Contracting Power , the Tribunal shall apply direct to the Government of that Power .
Translation: 第七十六条 仲裁法庭需在第三缔约国境内送达的所有通知，应由仲裁法庭直接向该国政府提出。

Query_Text_en: The same rule applies in the case of steps being taken to procure evidence on the spot .
Translation: 同样的规则适用于现场取证的情形。

Query_Text_en: The requests for this purpose are to be executed as far as the means at the disposal of the Power applied to under its municipal law allow .
Translation: 此类请求的执行，应在被请求国根据其本国法律所能提供的手段范围内进行。

Query_Text_en: They can not be rejected unless the Power in question considers them calculated to impair its own sovereign rights or its safety .
Translation: 除非有关国家认为这些建议可能损害其自身的主权权利或安全，否则不得拒绝。

Query_Text_en: The Court will equally be always entitled to act through the Power on whose territory it sits .
Translation: 法院同样始终有权通过其所在地的国家行使职权。

Query_Text_en: Article 77When the agents and counsel of the parties have submitted all the explanations and evidence in support of their case the President shall declare the discussion closed .
Translation: 第七十七条 当当事方的代理人和律师提交了所有支持其案件的说明和证据后，庭长应宣布辩论结束。

Query_Text_en: Article 78The Tribunal considers its decisions in private and the proceedings remain secret .
Translation: 第七十八条 法庭在非公开情况下审议其裁决，审理过程亦予以保密。

Query_Text_en: All questions are decided by a majority of the members of the Tribunal
Translation: 所有问题均由法庭成员多数决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 79The Award must give the reasons on which it is based .
Translation: 第七十九条 裁决书必须说明其所依据的理由。

Query_Text_en: it is signed by the President and Registrar or by the Secretary acting as Registrar .
Translation: 由校长和注册主任签署，或由秘书以注册主任身份签署。

Query_Text_en: Article 80The Award is read out in public sitting , the agents and counsel of the parties being present or duly summoned to attend .
Translation: 第八十条 裁决应在公开会议上宣读，双方当事人的代理人和律师须在场或经正式通知出席。

Query_Text_en: Article 81The Award , duly pronounced and notified to the agents of the parties , settles the dispute definitively and without appeal .
Translation: 第八十一条 裁决一经正式作出并通知双方代理人，即最终解决争议，不得上诉。

Query_Text_en: Article 82Any dispute arising between the parties as to the interpretation and execution of the Award shall , in the absence of an Agreement to the contrary , be submitted to the Tribunal which pronounced it .
Translation: 第八十二条 凡因裁决的解释或执行而引发的争议，除非双方另有协议，应提交作出该裁决的仲裁庭处理。

Query_Text_en: Article 83The parties can reserve in the `` Compromis '' the right to demand the revision of the Award .
Translation: 第83条 当事人可以在“仲裁协议”中保留要求裁决修订的权利。

Query_Text_en: In this case and unless there be an Agreement to the contrary , the demand must be addressed to the Tribunal which pronounced the Award .
Translation: 在本案中，除非另有协议，申请应提交作出裁决的仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: It can only be made on the ground of the discovery of some new fact calculated to exercise a decisive influence upon the Award and which was unknown to the Tribunal and to the party which demanded the revision at the time the discussion was closed .
Translation: 只有在发现某些可能对裁决产生决定性影响的新事实，并且该事实在讨论结束时对仲裁庭和要求复审的一方均属未知的情况下，才能提出复审请求。

Query_Text_en: Proceedings for revision can only be instituted by a decision of the Tribunal expressly recording the existence of the new fact , recognizing in it the character described in the preceding paragraph , and declaring the demand admissible on this ground .
Translation: 只有在法庭作出明确记录新事实存在、确认其具有前述条款所述性质，并据此宣布申请理由成立的裁决后，方可启动复审程序。

Query_Text_en: The `` Compromis '' fixes the period within which the demand for revision must be made .
Translation: “协议”规定了提出复议请求的时限。

Query_Text_en: Article 84The Award is not binding except on the parties in dispute .
Translation: 第八十四条 裁决仅对争议当事方具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: When it concerns the interpretation of a Convention to which Powers other than those in dispute are parties , they shall inform all the Signatory Powers in good time .
Translation: 当涉及对一项有争议国以外的缔约国也为当事方的公约进行解释时，应及时通知所有签约国。

Query_Text_en: Each of these Powers is entitled to intervene in the case .
Translation: 每个大国都有权在此案中进行干预。

Query_Text_en: If one or more avail themselves of this right , the interpretation contained in the Award is equally binding on them .
Translation: 如果有一方或多方行使了该权利，裁决中所包含的解释对他们同样具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Article 85Each party pays its own expenses and an equal share of the expenses of the Tribunal .
Translation: 第八十五条 各方自行承担各自的费用，并平摊仲裁庭的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 86With a view to facilitating the working of the system of arbitration in disputes admitting of a summary procedure , the Contracting Powers adopt the following rules , which shall be observed in the absence of other arrangements and subject to the reservation that the provisions of Chapter III apply so far as may be .
Translation: 第八十六条 为了促进适用简易程序解决争端的仲裁制度的运作，缔约国采纳以下规则。在没有其他安排的情况下，应遵守这些规则，并以第三章的相关规定在适用范围内为前提。

Query_Text_en: Article 87Each of the parties in dispute appoints an Arbitrator .
Translation: 第八十七条 争议各方各自指定一名仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: The two Arbitrators thus selected choose an Umpire .
Translation: 由两名仲裁员选定后，再共同选出一名裁决员。

Query_Text_en: which of the candidates thus proposed shall be the Umpire is determined by lot .
Translation: 由抽签决定所提候选人中哪一位担任裁决人。

Query_Text_en: The Umpire presides over the Tribunal , which gives its decisions by a majority of votes .
Translation: 仲裁长主持法庭，法庭的裁决由多数票通过。

Query_Text_en: Article 88In the absence of any previous agreement the Tribunal , as soon as it is formed , settles the time within which the two parties must submit their respective cases to it .
Translation: 第八十八条 在未有任何先前协议的情况下，仲裁庭一经组成，即确定双方当事人向其提交各自案件的期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 89Each party is represented before the Tribunal by an agent , who serves as intermediary between the Tribunal and the Government who appointed him .
Translation: 第八十九条 每一方在法庭上由代理人代表，其作为法庭与任命他的政府之间的中介。

Query_Text_en: Article 90The proceedings are conducted exclusively in writing .
Translation: 第九十条 程序仅以书面形式进行。

Query_Text_en: Each party , however , is entitled to ask that witnesses and experts should be called .
Translation: 然而，每一方均有权要求传唤证人和专家。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal has , for its part , the right to demand oral explanations from the agents of the two parties , as well as from the experts and witnesses whose appearance in Court it may consider useful .
Translation: 法庭有权要求双方代理人，以及其认为有必要出庭的专家和证人，进行口头说明。

Query_Text_en: Article 91The present Convention , duly ratified , shall replace , as between the Contracting Powers , the Convention for the Pacific Settlement of International Disputes of 29 July 1899 .
Translation: 第九十一条 本公约经正式批准后，在缔约国之间，将取代1899年7月29日签署的《和平解决国际争端公约》。

Query_Text_en: Article 92The present Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible .
Translation: 第九十二条 本公约应尽快予以批准。

Query_Text_en: The ratifications shall be deposited at The Hague .
Translation: 批准书应交存于海牙。

Query_Text_en: The first deposit of ratifications shall be recorded in a proc s-verbal signed by the Representatives of the Powers which take part therein and by the Netherland Minister for Foreign Affairs .
Translation: 首批批准文件的递交应由参与递交的各国代表及荷兰外交部长共同签署备忘录予以记录。

Query_Text_en: The subsequent deposits of ratifications shall be made by means of a written notification , addressed to the Netherland Government and accompanied by the instrument of ratification .
Translation: 此后各项批准书的交存，应通过书面通知方式进行，通知应提交给荷兰政府，并附上批准书。

Query_Text_en: A duly certified copy of the proc s-verbal relative to the first deposit of ratifications , of the notifications mentioned in the preceding paragraph , and of the instruments of ratification , shall be immediately sent by the Netherland Government , through the diplomatic channel , to the Powers invited to the Second Peace Conference , as well as to those Powers which have adhered to the Convention .
Translation: 荷兰政府应通过外交途径，立即将关于首次交存批准书的会议记录、前款所述的通知以及批准书的正式副本，送交受邀参加第二次和平会议的各缔约国以及已加入本公约的国家。

Query_Text_en: In the cases contemplated in the preceding paragraph , the said Government shall at the same time inform the Powers of the date on which it received the notification .
Translation: 在前款所述情形下，该政府应同时将其收到通知的日期告知各国。

Query_Text_en: Article 93Non-Signatory Powers which have been invited to the Second Peace Conference may adhere to the present Convention .
Translation: 第93条 已被邀请参加第二次和平会议的非签约国可以加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Power which desires to adhere notifies its intention in writing to the Netherland Government , forwarding to it the act of adhesion , which shall be deposited in the archives of the said Government .
Translation: 希望加入的国家应以书面形式通知荷兰政府其意愿，并向其提交加入文件，该文件将存放于荷兰政府档案中。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] This Government shall immediately forward to all the other Powers invited to the Second Peace Conference a duly certified copy of the notification as well as of the act of adhesion , mentioning the date on which it received the notification .
Translation: 本政府应立即将经正式认证的通知副本及加入文件，连同收到通知的日期，转发给所有受邀参加第二次和平会议的其他国家。

Query_Text_en: Article 94The conditions on which the Powers which have not been invited to the Second Peace Conference may adhere to the present Convention shall form the subject of a subsequent Agreement between the Contracting Powers .
Translation: 第九十四条 未受邀参加第二次和平会议的列强，如欲加入本公约，其加入条件应由缔约国另行协议确定。

Query_Text_en: Article 95The present Convention shall take effect , in the case of the Powers which were not a party to the first deposit of ratifications , sixty days after the date of the proc s-verbal of this deposit , and , in the case of the Powers which ratify subsequently or which adhere , sixty days after the notification of their ratification or of their adhesion has been received by the Netherland Government .
Translation: 第九十五条 本公约对未参与首次批准书交存的缔约国，自该批准书交存备忘录之日起六十天后生效；对随后批准或加入的缔约国，自荷兰政府收到其批准或加入通知之日起六十天后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 96In the event of one of the Contracting Parties wishing to denounce the present Convention , the denunciation shall be notified in writing to the Netherland Government , which shall immediately communicate a duly certified copy of the notification to all the other Powers informing them of the date on which it was received .
Translation:
第96条  
如缔约一方希望退出本公约，应以书面形式通知荷兰政府。荷兰政府应立即将该通知的正式认证副本发送给所有其他国家，并告知其收到通知的日期。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall only have effect in regard to the notifying Power , and one year after the notification has reached the Netherland Government .
Translation: 该退约声明仅对提出声明的缔约方有效，并自荷兰政府收到该通知之日起一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 97A register kept by the Netherland Minister for Foreign Affairs shall give the date of the deposit of ratifications effected in virtue of Article 92 , paragraphs 3 and 4 , as well as the date on which the notifications of adhesion [ Article 93 , paragraph 2 ] or of denunciation [ Article 96 , paragraph 1 ] have been received .
Translation: 第97条 由荷兰外交大臣保存的登记册应记录根据第92条第3款和第4款进行的批准书交存日期，以及根据第93条第2款的加入通知或根据第96条第1款的退出通知的收到日期。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Power is entitled to have access to this register and to be supplied with duly certified extracts from it .
Translation: 每一缔约国都有权查阅该登记册，并获得经正式认证的摘录。

Query_Text_en: IN FAITH WHEREOF the Plenipotentiaries have appended their signatures to the present Convention .
Translation: 为此，双方全权代表在本公约上签字，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: DONE at The Hague on the 18th October 1907 , in a single copy , which shall remain deposited in the archives of the Netherland Government , and duly certified copies of which shall be sent , through the diplomatic channel , to the Contracting Powers .
Translation: 本文件于1907年10月18日在海牙签署，仅制一份正本，存放于荷兰政府档案馆，并将通过外交渠道向缔约国发送经正式认证的副本。

Query_Text_en: Article IThe present Convention applies outside territorial waters to all legally established submarine cables landed on the territories , colonies or possessions of one or more of the High Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第一条 本公约适用于在缔约国之一或多个的领土、殖民地或属地登陆的、依法设立的所有领海以外的海底电缆。

Query_Text_en: Article IIIt is a punishable offence to break or injure a submarine cable , wilfully or by culpable negligence , in such manner as might interrupt or obstruct telegraphic communication , either wholly or partially , such punishment being without prejudice to any civil action for damages .
Translation: 第三条 蓄意或因重大过失破坏或损坏海底电缆，致使电报通信全部或部分中断或受阻的，均属可处罚的犯罪行为。该处罚不影响因损害而提起的任何民事诉讼。

Query_Text_en: This provision does not apply to cases where those who break or injure a cable do so with the lawful object of saving their lives or their ship , after they have taken every necessary precaution to avoid so breaking or injuring the cable .
Translation: 本条款不适用于在采取一切必要预防措施以避免损坏电缆后，因合法目的为拯救生命或船舶而损坏或破坏电缆的情形。

Query_Text_en: Article IIIThe High Contracting Parties undertake that , on granting a concession for landing a submarine cable , they will insist , so far as possible , upon proper measures of safety being taken , both as regards the track of the cable and its dimensions .
Translation:
第三条
缔约各方承诺，在授予铺设海底电缆的特许权时，将尽可能要求采取适当的安全措施，无论是针对电缆的铺设路线还是其规格尺寸。

Query_Text_en: Article IVThe owner of a cable who , on laying or repairing his own cable , breaks or injures another cable , must bear the cost of repairing the breakage or injury , without prejudice to the application , if need by , of Article II of the present Convention .
Translation:
第四条  
电缆所有人在铺设或修理自身电缆时，如造成其他电缆的断裂或损坏，必须承担修复该断裂或损坏的费用，但本公约第二条如有需要，仍可适用。

Query_Text_en: Article VVessels engaged in laying or repairing submarine cables shall conform to the regulations as to signals which have been , or may be , adopted by mutual agreement among the High Contracting Parties , with the view of preventing collisions at sea .
Translation: 从事铺设或修理海底电缆的船舶，应遵守缔约各高等缔约方为防止海上碰撞而已经或将来可能通过协商一致所制定的有关信号规定。

Query_Text_en: When a ship engaged in repairing a cable exhibits the said signals , other vessels which see them , or are able to see them , shall withdraw to or keep beyond a distance of one nautical mile at least from the ship in question , so as not to interfere with her operations .
Translation: 当一艘船舶正在进行电缆修理作业并展示上述信号时，其他能够看到或可能看到该信号的船舶，应当撤离或保持至少一海里以上的距离，以免干扰其作业。

Query_Text_en: Fishing gear and nets shall be kept at the same distance .
Translation: 渔具和渔网应保持相同的间距。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , fishing vessels which see , or are able to see , a telegraph-ship exhibiting the said signals , shall be allowed a period of 24 hours at most within which to obey the notice so given , during which time they shall not be interfered with in any way .
Translation: 然而，渔船在看到或能够看到正在展示上述信号的电报船时，最多可有24小时的时间来遵守所发出的通知，在此期间不得以任何方式干扰其活动。

Query_Text_en: The operations of the telegraph-ships shall be completed as quickly as possible .
Translation: 电报船的作业应尽快完成。

Query_Text_en: Article VIVessels which see , or are able to see , the buoys showing the position of a cable when the latter is being laid , is out of order , or is broken , shall keep beyond a distance of one-quarter of a nautical mile at least from the said buoys .
Translation:
第六条  
船舶在铺设、维修或断裂电缆时，如能看到或能够看到标示电缆位置的浮标，须至少保持距离该浮标四分之一海里以上。

Query_Text_en: Fishing nets and gear shall be kept at the same distance .
Translation: 渔网及渔具应保持相同的间距。

Query_Text_en: Article VIIOwners of ships or vessels who can prove that they have sacrificed an anchor , a net , or other fishing gear in order to avoid injuring a submarine cable , shall receive compensation from the owner of the cable .
Translation:
第七条  
船舶或船只的所有者如能证明其为避免损坏海底电缆而牺牲了锚、渔网或其他渔具，应由电缆所有者给予赔偿。

Query_Text_en: In order to establish a claim to such compensation , a statement , supported by the evidence of the crew , should , whenever possible , be drawn up immediately after the occurrence ;
Translation: 为确立此类赔偿请求，应在事件发生后尽可能立即制作一份声明，并由船员证据予以支持。

Query_Text_en: and the master must , within 24 hours after his return to or next putting into port , make a declaration to the proper authorities .
Translation: 船长必须在返回或下一次靠港后的24小时内，向有关当局作出申报。

Query_Text_en: The latter shall communicate the information to the consular authorities of the country to which the owner of the cable belongs .
Translation: 后者应将该信息通报给电缆所有者所属国家的领事当局。

Query_Text_en: Article VIIIThe tribunals competent to take cognizance of infractions of the present Convention are those of the country to which the vessel on board of which the offence was committed belongs .
Translation: 第八条 有权审理本公约所涉违规行为的法庭，应为违规行为发生时船舶所属国家的法庭。

Query_Text_en: It is , moreover , understood that , in cases where the provisions in the previous paragraph can not apply , offences against the present Convention will be dealt with in each of the Contracting States in accordance , so far as the subjects and citizens of those States respectively are concerned , with the general rules of criminal jurisdiction prescribed by the laws of that particular State , or by international treaties .
Translation: 此外，还应理解，在前款规定无法适用的情况下，各缔约国对于本公约所涉犯罪，将根据各自国家法律或国际条约所规定的刑事管辖权一般规则，分别对本国国民或公民进行处理。

Query_Text_en: Article IXProsecutions for infractions provided against by Articles II , V and VI of the present Convention shall be instituted by the State , or in its name .
Translation:
第九条  
对本公约第二条、第五条和第六条所规定的违法行为的起诉，应由国家或以国家名义提起。

Query_Text_en: Article XOffences against the present Convention may be verified by all means of proof allowed by the legislation of the country of the court .
Translation:
第十条  
违反本公约的行为可通过该法院所在国法律允许的所有证据方式予以查证。

Query_Text_en: When the officers commanding the ships of war , or ships specially commissioned for the purpose by one of the High Contracting Parties , have reason to believe that an infraction of the measures provided for in the present Convention has been committed by a vessel other than a vessel of war , they may demand from the captain or master the production of the official documents proving the nationality of the said vessel .
Translation: 当一方缔约国指挥的军舰或为此特别委派的船只指挥官有理由认为，除军舰以外的某船只违反了本公约所规定的措施时，他们可以要求该船船长或负责人出示证明该船国籍的官方文件。

Query_Text_en: The fact of such document having been exhibited shall then be endorsed upon it immediately .
Translation: 应立即在该文件上注明其已被出示的事实。

Query_Text_en: Further , formal statements of the facts may be prepared by the said officers , whatever may be the nationality of the vessel incriminated .
Translation: 此外，无论被指控船舶的国籍如何，上述官员均可准备正式的事实陈述。

Query_Text_en: These formal statements shall be drawn up in the form and in the language used in the country to which the officer making them belongs ;
Translation: 这些正式声明应按照作出声明的官员所属国家所使用的形式和语言拟定。

Query_Text_en: they may be considered , in the country where they are adduced , as evidence in accordance with the laws ofthat country .
Translation: 在提交这些证据的国家，可以根据该国法律将其视为证据。

Query_Text_en: The accused and the witnesses shall have the right to add , or to have added thereto , in their own language , any explanations they may consider useful .
Translation: 被告人和证人有权以自己的语言补充或要求补充他们认为有用的任何说明。

Query_Text_en: These declarations shall be duly signed .
Translation: 这些声明应予以正式签署。

Query_Text_en: Article XIThe proceedings and trial in cases of infraction of the provisions of the present Convention shall always take place as summarily as the laws and regulations in force will permit .
Translation: 第十一条 违反本公约规定的案件，其诉讼程序和审判应始终在现行法律法规允许的范围内，尽可能简捷地进行。

Query_Text_en: Article XIIThe High Contracting Parties engage to take or to propose to their respective legislatures the necessary measures for insuring the execution of the present Convention , and especially for punishing , by either fine or imprisonment , or both , those who contravene the provisions of Articles II , V and VI .
Translation:
第十二条  
缔约各方承诺采取必要措施，或向各自立法机关提出必要建议，以确保本公约的执行，特别是对违反第二条、第五条和第六条规定者，予以罚款、监禁或两者并处的处罚。

Query_Text_en: Article XIIIThe High Contracting Parties will communicate to each other laws already made , or which may hereafter be made , in their respective countries , relating to the object of the present Convention .
Translation:
第十三条
缔约各方将相互通报各自国家已制定或今后可能制定的与本公约宗旨相关的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article XIVStates which have not signed the present Convention may adhere to it on making a request to that effect .
Translation:
第十四条  
尚未签署本公约的国家，可以提出请求，加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: This adhesion shall be notified through the diplomatic channel to the Government of the French Republic , and by the latter to the other Signatory Powers .
Translation: 该加入应通过外交渠道通知法兰西共和国政府，由其再通知其他签约国。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIt is understood that the stipulations of the present Convention do not in any way restrict the freedom of action of belligerents .
Translation: 第十六条 本公约的规定不以任何方式限制交战方的行动自由。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIThe present Convention shall be brought into force on a day to be agreed upon by the High Contracting Powers .
Translation: 第十六条 本公约应由缔约各高级当事国商定日期后生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall remain in force for five years from that day , and unless any of the High Contracting Parties have announced , 12 months before the expiration of the said period of five years , its intention to terminate its operation , it shall continue in force for a period of one year , and so on from year to year .
Translation: 本协议自该日起生效，有效期为五年。如在五年期满前十二个月，任何缔约方未宣布终止本协议的意向，则本协议自动延续一年，并依此类推，每年顺延一年。

Query_Text_en: If one of the Signatory Powers denounce the Convention , such denunciation shall have effect only as regards that Power .
Translation: 如果缔约国之一宣布退出本公约，该退出仅对该国有效。

Query_Text_en: Article XVIIThe present Convention shall be ratified , and the ratifications exchanged at Paris with as little delay as possible , and , at the latest , at the expiration of a year .
Translation: 第十七条 本公约应予以批准，并应尽快在巴黎交换批准书，最迟不得超过一年。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] IN WITNESS WHEREOF the respective Plenipotentiaries have signed the same , and have affixed thereto their seals .
Translation: 为此，双方全权代表已签署本协议，并加盖印章。

Query_Text_en: DONE in 26 copies , at Paris , the 14th day of March 1884 .
Translation: 本文件一式二十六份，于1884年3月14日签署于巴黎。

Query_Text_en: [ British Colonies and Possessions ] The stipulations of the Convention concluded under today 's date for the protection of submarine cables shall be applicable , in conformity with Article I , to the colonies and possessions of Her Britannic Majesty , with the exception of those hereinafter mentioned , namely :
Translation: 【英属殖民地及属地】根据今日签署的关于保护海底电缆的公约及其第一条的规定，该公约的条款适用于大英女王陛下的殖民地及属地，但下列所述者除外：

Query_Text_en: CanadaNewfoundlandThe CapeNatalNew South WalesVictoriaQueenslandTasmaniaSouth AustraliaWestern AustraliaNew ZealandProvided always that the stipulations of the said Convention shall be applicable to any of the abovenamed colonies or possession on whose behalf notice to that effect shall have been given by Her Britannic Majesty 's representative at Paris to the French Minister for Foreign Affairs .
Translation: 加拿大、纽芬兰、开普、纳塔尔、新南威尔士、维多利亚、昆士兰、塔斯马尼亚、南澳大利亚、西澳大利亚、新西兰。惟须始终以如下条件为准：上述任何殖民地或属地，须由大英女王驻巴黎代表向法国外交部长发出相关通知后，本公约的各项规定方可适用于其。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Each of the abovenamed colonies or possessions which may have acceded to the said Convention shall be at liberty to withdraw from it in the same manner as the Powers parties to it .
Translation: 上述各已加入该公约的殖民地或属地，可按照缔约国相同的方式退出该公约。

Query_Text_en: In the event of any of the said colonies or possessions desiring to withdraw from the Convention , a notification to that effect shall be made by Her Britannic Majesty 's representative at Paris to the French Minister for Foreign Affairs . DONE in 26 copies , at Paris , the 14th day of March , 1884 .
Translation: 如上述任何殖民地或属地希望退出本公约，应由英国女王驻巴黎代表向法国外交部长发出相关通知。本文件于1884年3月14日在巴黎制成26份。

Query_Text_en: Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts Against the Safety of Civil Aviation
Translation: 《关于打击危害民用航空安全非法行为的公约》

Query_Text_en: e communicates information which he knows to be false , thereby endangering the safety of an aircraft in flight
Translation: 他明知所传递的信息为虚假，却仍予以传播，从而危及飞行中航空器的安全。

Query_Text_en: b is an accomplice of a person who commits or attempts to commit any such offence
Translation: b 是实施或企图实施上述任何犯罪行为者的同伙。

Query_Text_en: in the case of a forced landing the flight shall be deemed to continue until the competent authorities take over the responsibility for the aircraft and for persons and property on board ;
Translation: 在发生迫降的情况下，飞行应视为持续进行，直至主管当局接管对航空器及机上人员和财产的责任。

Query_Text_en: the period of service shall in any event , extend for the entire period during which the aircraft is in flight as defined in paragraph a of this Article
Translation: 无论任何情况下，服务期限应覆盖本条第a款所定义的整个飞行期间。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Each Contracting State undertakes to make the offences mentioned in Article 1 punishable by severe penalties
Translation: 第三条 各缔约国承诺对第一条所述犯罪行为予以严厉惩处。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall not apply to aircraft used in military , customs or police services
Translation: 本公约不适用于用于军事、海关或警务的航空器。

Query_Text_en: b the offence is committed in the territory of a State other than the State of registration of the aircraft
Translation: b. 该犯罪行为发生在飞机注册国以外的国家境内。

Query_Text_en: 3 Notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article , in the cases contemplated in subparagraphs a , b , c and e of paragraph 1 of Article 1 this Convention shall also apply if the offender or the alleged offender is found in the territory of a State other than the State of registration of the aircraft
Translation: 尽管本条第2款有规定，但在第1条第1款a、b、c和e项所述情形下，如果犯罪者或被指控犯罪者在飞机注册国以外的其他国家境内被发现，本公约亦适用。
