Query_Text_en: Article 91 . A Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force , by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第91条 已经批准本公约的成员国，可在本公约首次生效之日起满十年后，通过向国际劳工局局长提交注销声明予以注销，并由局长予以登记。

Query_Text_en: Such denunciation shall not take effect until one year after the date on which it is registered .
Translation: 该退约声明自登记之日起一年后方可生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member which has ratified this Convention and which does not , within the year following the expiration of the period of ten years mentioned in the preceding paragraph , exercise the right of denunciation provided for in this article , will be bound for another period of ten years and , thereafter , may denounce this Convention at the expiration of each period of ten years under the terms provided for in this article .
Translation: 2. 每一批准本公约的成员，如在前款所述十年期限届满后的一年内未行使本条规定的退出权利，将自动再受本公约约束十年。此后，该成员可在每一十年期限届满时，按照本条规定的条件退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 101 . The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall notify all Members of the International Labor Organisation of the registration of all ratifications , declarations and denunciations communicated to him by the Members of the Organisation .
Translation: 第一百零一条 国际劳工局局长应将所有成员国提交的批准书、声明和废止通知的登记情况，通知国际劳工组织的所有成员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When notifying the Members of the Organisation of the registration of the second ratification communicated to him , the Director-General shall draw the attention of the Members of the Organisation to the date upon which the Convention will come into force .
Translation: 2. 总干事在通知本组织成员第二份批准书登记事宜时，应提醒本组织成员注意本公约生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 11The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall communicate to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations full particulars of all ratifications , declarations and acts of denunciation registered by him in accordance with the provisions of the preceding articles .
Translation: 第十一条 国际劳工局局长应将根据前述条款登记的所有批准、声明和废止行为的详细情况，按照《联合国宪章》第102条的规定，通报联合国秘书长进行登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 12At such times as it may consider necessary , the Governing Body of the International Labor Office shall present to the General Conference a report on the working of this Convention and shall examine the desirability of placing on the agenda of the Conference the question of its revision in whole or in part .
Translation: 第十二条 国际劳工局管理机构在其认为必要时，应向大会提交关于本公约实施情况的报告，并审议是否有必要将本公约全部或部分修订的问题列入大会议程。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] As from the date when the new revising Convention comes into force this Convention shall cease to be open to ratification by the Members .
Translation: 自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约将不再对成员开放批准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall in any case remain in force in its actual form and content for those Members which have ratified it but have not ratified the revising Convention .
Translation: 2. 本公约对于已批准但尚未批准修订公约的成员，应继续以现行形式和内容保持有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 14The English and French versions of the text of this Convention are equally authoritative .
Translation: 第十四条 本公约的英文和法文文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: k the private staff are persons employed exclusively in the private service of the members of the special mission
Translation: 私人工作人员是指专门受雇于特别使团成员私人事务的人员。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 SENDING OF A SPECIAL MISSIONA State may send a special mission to another State with the consent of the latter previously obtained through the diplomatic or another agreed or mutually acceptable channel
Translation:
第二条 派遣特别使团  
一国可通过外交渠道或其他双方协商认可的渠道，事先获得对方国家同意后，向该国派遣特别使团。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3 FUNCTIoNS OF A SPECIAL MISSIONThe functions of a special mission shall be determined by the mutual consent of the sending and the receiving State
Translation:
第三条 特别使团的职能

特别使团的职能应由派遣国和接受国双方协商一致确定。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 4 SENDING OF THE SAME SPECAL MISSIoN TO TWO OR MORE STATESA State which wishes to send the same special mission to two or more States shall so inform each receiving State when seeking the consent of that State
Translation:
第四条 向两个或多个国家派遣同一特使团  
一国如欲向两个或多个国家派遣同一特使团，应在请求各接受国同意时，告知每一接受国。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5 SENDING OF A JOINT SPECIAL MISSION BY TWO OR MORE STATESTwo or more States which wish to send a joint special mission to another State shall so inform the receiving State when seeking the consent of that State
Translation:
第五条 两个或两个以上国家派遣联合特别使团

两个或两个以上国家希望向另一国派遣联合特别使团时，应在请求该国同意时将此意向通知接受国。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 SENDING OF SPECIAL MISSIONS BY TWO OR MORE STATES IN ORDER TO DEAL WITH A QUESTION OF COMMON INTERESTTwo or more States may each send a special mission at the same time to another State with the consent of that State obtained if accordance with article 2 in order to deal together with the agreement of all of these States with a question of common interest to all of them
Translation:
第六条 两个或两个以上国家为处理共同关心的问题派遣特别使团

两个或两个以上国家，经根据第二条取得接受国同意后，可以同时各自向该国派遣特别使团，以在各有关国家一致同意的情况下，共同处理对它们具有共同利益的问题。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 NON EXISTENCE OF DIPLOMATIC OR CONSULAR RELATIONSThe existence of diplomatic or consular relations is not necessary for the sending or reception of a special mission
Translation:
第七条 外交或领事关系的不存在

派遣或接收特别使团并不以存在外交或领事关系为必要条件。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 APPOINTMENT OF THE MEMBERS OF THE SPECIAL MISSIONSubject to the provisions of articles 10 11 and 12 the sending State may freely appoint the members of the special mission after having given to the receiving State all necessary information concerning the size and composition of the special mission and in particular the names and designations of the persons it intends to appoint The receiving State may decline to accept a special mission of a size that is not considered by it to be reasonable having regard to circumstances and conditions in the receiving State and to the needs of the particular mission It may also without giving reasons decline to accept any person as a member of the special mission
Translation:
第八条 特别使团成员的任命

在遵守第十、十一和十二条规定的前提下，派遣国可在向接受国提供有关特别使团规模和组成的所有必要信息，特别是拟任命人员的姓名和职务后，自由任命特别使团成员。接受国可根据本国情况和条件以及该特别使团的实际需要，拒绝接受其认为规模不合理的特别使团。接受国亦可在不说明理由的情况下，拒绝接受任何人作为特别使团成员。

Query_Text_en: 1 A special mission shall consist of one or more representatives of the sending State from among whom the sending State may appoint a head It may also include diplomatic staff administrative and technical staff and service staff
Translation: 1. 特别任务团应由派遣国的一名或多名代表组成，派遣国可从中指定团长。特别任务团还可包括外交人员、行政和技术人员以及服务人员。

Query_Text_en: 2 When members of a permanent diplomatic mission or of a consular post in the receiving State are included in a special mission they shall retain their privileges and immunities as members of their permanent diplomatic mission or consular post in addition to the privileges and immunities accorded by the present Convention
Translation: 2 当驻在国常设外交代表团或领事机构的成员被纳入特别使团时，除享有本公约赋予的特权与豁免外，仍保留其作为常设外交代表团或领事机构成员的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: 1 The representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff should in principle be of the nationality of the sending State
Translation: 1 派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员原则上应为派遣国国籍。

Query_Text_en: 2 Nationals of the receiving State may not be appointed to a special mission except with the consent of that State which may be withdrawn at any time
Translation: 接受国的国民不得被任命为特别使团成员，除非获得该国同意，并且该同意可随时撤回。

Query_Text_en: 3 The receiving State may reserve the right provided for in paragraph 2 of this article with regard to nationals of a third State who ale not also nationals of the sending State
Translation: 3. 接受国可以对本条第2款所规定的权利作出保留，适用于那些并非派遣国国民的第三国国民。

Query_Text_en: F the location of the premises occupied by the special mission and of the private acccommodation enjoyinginviolability under articles 30 36 and 39 as well as any other information that may be necessary to identify such premises and accommodation
Translation: F. 特殊使团所使用场所的位置，以及根据第30、36和39条享有不可侵犯权的私人住所的位置，以及识别上述场所和住所所需的任何其他信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 Unless it is impossible notification of arrival and final departure must be given in advance
Translation: 除非确有困难，否则须提前通知到达和最终离境时间。

Query_Text_en: 1 The receiving State may at any time and without having to explain its decision notify the sending State that any representative of the sending State in the special mission or any member of its diplomatic staff is persona non grata or that any other member of the staff of the mission is not acceptable In any such case the sending State shall as appropriate either recall the person concerned or terminate his functions with the mission A person may be declared non grata or not acceptable before arriving in the territory of the receiving State
Translation: 1. 接受国可在任何时候，无需说明理由，通知派遣国，派遣国特别使团中的任何代表或其外交人员中的任何成员为“不受欢迎的人”，或使团其他工作人员中的任何成员为“不被接受的人”。在此情况下，派遣国应视情形召回有关人员或终止其在使团中的职务。某人可在抵达接受国领土之前被宣布为“不受欢迎的人”或“不被接受的人”。

Query_Text_en: 2 If the sending State refuses or fails within a reasonable period to carry out its obligations under paragraph 1 of this article the receiving State may refuse to recognize the person concerned as a member of the special mission
Translation: 如果派遣国拒绝或在合理期限内未履行本条第1款规定的义务，接受国可以拒绝承认有关人员为特别使团成员。

Query_Text_en: 1 The functions of a special mission shall commence as soon as the mission enters into official contact with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or with such other organ of the receiving State as may be agreed
Translation: 1. 特别使团的职能自与接受国外交部或经双方同意的其他机构正式接触之时开始。

Query_Text_en: 2 The commencement of the functions of a special mission shall not depend upon presentation of the mission by the permanent diplomatic mission of the sending State or upon the submission of letters of credence or full powers
Translation: 2 特别使团职能的启动不以派遣国常驻外交使团的介绍或递交国书或全权证书为前提。

Query_Text_en: 1 The head of the special mission or if the sending State has not appointed a head one of the representatives of the sending State designated by the latter is authorized to act on behalf of the special mission and to address communications to the receiving State The receiving State shall address communications concerning the special mission to the head of the mission or if there is none to the representative referred to above either direct or through the permanent diplomatic mission
Translation: 1. 特别使团的团长，或者如派遣国未指定团长时，由派遣国指定的一名代表，有权代表特别使团行事并向接受国发出通报。接受国应将涉及特别使团的通报直接或通过常驻外交使团，发给团长；如无团长，则发给上述代表。

Query_Text_en: 2 However a member of the special mission may be authorized by the sending State by the head of the special mission or if there is none by the representative referred to in paragraph 1 of this article either to substitute for the head of the special mission or for the aforesaid representative or to perform particular acts on behalf of the mission
Translation: 然而，派遣国可授权特别使命团成员，由特别使命团团长或在无团长时由本条第1款所述代表，代替特别使命团团长或上述代表，或代表使命团执行特定事务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15 ORGAN OF THE RECEIVNG STATE WITH WHICH OFFICIAL BUSINESS IS CONDUCTEDAll official business with the receiving State entrusted to the special mission by the sending State shall be conducted with or through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or with such other organ of the receiving State as may be agreed
Translation:
第十五条 与接受国进行官方事务的机构  
派遣国委托特使团与接受国进行的所有官方事务，应通过接受国外交部或经双方同意的其他机构进行。

Query_Text_en: 1 Where two or more special missions meet in the territory of the receiving State or of a third State precedence among the missions shall be determined in the absence of a special agreement according to the alphabetical order of the names of the States used by the protocol of the State in whose territory the missions are meeting
Translation: 1. 当两个或两个以上特别使团在接受国或第三国境内会晤时，除非另有特别协议，否则使团之间的排列顺序应按照使团会晤所在国礼宾惯例所使用的国家名称的字母顺序确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 Precedence among two or more special missions which meet on a ceremonial or formal occasion shall be governed by the protocol in force in the receiving State
Translation: 两支或多支特别使团在接待国举行礼仪或正式场合时，其优先顺序应按照接待国现行的礼宾规定执行。

Query_Text_en: 3 Precedence among the members of the same special mission shall be mat which is notified to the receiving State or to the third State in whose territory two or more special missions are meeting
Translation: 3 同一特别代表团成员之间的排序，应以通知接受国或两项以上特别代表团会晤所在第三国的顺序为准。

Query_Text_en: 1 A special mission shall have its seat in the locality agreed bv the States concerned
Translation: 1 特别使团应设在有关国家商定的地点。

Query_Text_en: 2 In the absence of agreement the special mission shall have its seat in the locality where the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the receiving State is situated
Translation: 2. 如未达成协议，特别使团应设于接受国外交部所在地。

Query_Text_en: 3 If the special mission performs its functions in different localities the States concerned may agree that it shall have more than one seat from among which they may choose one as the principal seat
Translation: 3 如果特别使命在不同地点履行职能，有关国家可以同意为其设立一个以上的驻地，并可从中选定一个作为主要驻地。

Query_Text_en: 1 Special missions from two or more States may meet in the territory of a third State only after obtaining the express consent of that State which retains the right to with draw it
Translation: 两国或多国的特别使团只有在获得第三国明确同意后，方可在该国境内会面，而该国保留撤回该同意的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 In giving its consent the third State may lay down conditions which shall be observed by the sending States 3 The third State shall assume in respect of the sending States the rights and obligations of a receiving State to the extent that it indicates in giving its consent
Translation:
2. 在给予同意时，第三国可以规定须由派遣国遵守的条件。  
3. 第三国在给予同意时所明确的范围内，对派遣国承担接受国的权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: 1 A special mission shall have the right to use the flag and emblem of the sending State on the premises occupied by the mission and on its means of transport when used on on official business
Translation: 1 特派使团有权在其所占用的馆舍以及执行公务时所使用的交通工具上悬挂派遣国的国旗和国徽。

Query_Text_en: 2 In the exercise of the right accorded by this article regard shall be had to the laws regulations and usages of the receiving State
Translation: 在行使本条所赋予的权利时，应遵守接受国的法律、法规和惯例。

Query_Text_en: e notification by the receiving State that it considers the special mission terminated
Translation: 接受国通知其认为特别使团任务已经终止

Query_Text_en: 2 The severance of diplomatic or consular relations between the sending State and the receiving State shall not of itself have the effect of terminating special missions existing at the time of such severance
Translation: 2 派遣国与接受国断绝外交或领事关系，并不自动导致在断绝关系时已存在的特别使团终止。

Query_Text_en: 1 The Head of the sending State when he leads a special mission shall enjoy in the receiving State or in a third State the facilities privileges and immunities accorded by international law to Heads of State on an official visit
Translation: 1 派遣国元首在率领特别使团时，应在接受国或第三国享有国际法赋予正式访问国家元首的便利、特权和豁免权。

Query_Text_en: 2 The Head of the Government the Minister for Foreign Affairs and other persons of high rank when they take part in a special mission of the sending State shall enjoy in the receiving State or in a third State in addition to what is granted by the present Convention the facilities privileges and immunities accorded by international law
Translation: 2. 当派遣国政府首脑、外交部长及其他高级官员作为特使参与特别任务时，除本公约所规定的便利、特权和豁免外，还应在接受国或第三国享有国际法所赋予的便利、特权和豁免。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 22 GENERAL FACILITIESThe reeiving State shall accord to the special mission the facilities required for the performance of its functions having regard to the nature and task of the special mission
Translation:
第二十二条 一般便利

接受国应根据特别使团的性质和任务，给予其履行职能所需的便利。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 23 PREMISES AND ACCOMMODATIONThe receiving State shall assist the special mission if it so requests in procuring the necessary premises and obtaining suitable accommodation for its members
Translation:
第二十三条 场所与住宿

如有请求，接受国应协助特别使团获取必要的场所，并为其成员安排适当的住宿。

Query_Text_en: 1 To the extent compatible with the nature and duration of the functions performed by the special mission the sending State and the members of the special mission acting on behalf of the mission shall be exempt from all national regional or municipal dues and taxes in respect of the premises occupied by the special mission other than such as represent payment for specific services rendered
Translation: 在与特别使团所履行职能的性质和期限相适应的范围内，派遣国及代表使团行事的特别使团成员，应免除因特别使团所占用场所而产生的一切国家、地区或市政赋税，但为特定服务所支付的费用除外。

Query_Text_en: 2 The exemption from taxation referred to in this article shall not apply to such dues and taxes payable under the law of the receiving State by persons contracting with the sending State or with a member of the special mission
Translation: 本条所指的免税待遇，不适用于根据接受国法律，由与派遣国或特别使团成员订立合同的人员应缴纳的各项税费。

Query_Text_en: 1 The premises where the special mission is established in accordance with the present Convention shall be inviolable The agents of the receiving State may not enter the said premises except with the consent of the head of the special mission or if appropriate of the head of the permanent diplomatic mission of the sending State accredited to the receiving State Such consent may be assumed in case of fire or other disaster that seriously endangers Public safety and only in the event that it has not been possible to obtain the express consent of the head of the special mission or where appropriate of the head of the permanent mission
Translation: 根据本公约设立特别使团的场所应享有不可侵犯性。接受国的工作人员未经特别使团团长或（如适用）派遣国驻接受国常驻外交使团团长的同意，不得进入上述场所。在发生火灾或其他严重危及公共安全的灾害，并且无法获得特别使团团长或（如适用）常驻使团团长的明确同意时，可以视为已获得同意。

Query_Text_en: 2 The receiving State is under a special duty to take all appropriate steps to protect the premises of the special mission against any intrusion or damage and to prevent any disturbance of the peace of the mission or impairment of its dignity
Translation: 接受国负有特别义务，采取一切适当措施，保护特别使团馆舍不受侵入或损害，并防止对使团安宁的任何干扰或对其尊严的损害。

Query_Text_en: 3 The premises of the special mission their furnishings other property used in the operation of the special mission and its means of transport shall be immune from search requisition attachment or execution
Translation: 三、特别使命的馆舍、其陈设及为执行特别使命所使用的其他财产，以及其交通工具，均享有不受搜查、征用、扣押或强制执行的豁免权。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 26 INVIOLABILITY OF ARCHIVES AND DOCUMENTSThe archives and documents of the special mission shall be inviolable at all times and wherever they may be They should when necessary bear visible external marks of identification
Translation:
第二十六条 档案和文件不可侵犯

特别使命的档案和文件在任何时候、任何地点均不可侵犯。必要时，应在其外部明显标识身份。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 27 FREEDOM OF MOVEMENTSubject to its laws and regulations concerning zones entry into which is prohibited or regulated for reasons of national security the receiving State shall ensure to all members of the special mission such freedom of movement and travel in its territory as is necessary for the performance of the functions of the special mission
Translation:
第二十七条 行动自由

在遵守接受国为国家安全原因而对某些区域的进入所制定的法律法规的前提下，接受国应确保特别使团全体成员在其境内享有为履行特别使团职能所必需的行动和旅行自由。

Query_Text_en: 1 The receiving State shall permit and protect free communication on the part of the special mission for all official purposes In communicating with the Government of the sending State its diplomatic missions its consular posts and its other special missions or with sections of the same mission wherever situated the special mission may employ all appropriate means including couriers and messages in code or cipher However the special mission may install and use a wireless transmitter only with the consent of the receiving State
Translation: 1. 接受国应允许并保护特使团为所有官方目的进行自由通信。特使团在与派遣国政府、其外交使团、领事机构及其他特使团，或与同一特使团的各部门（无论其所在地）进行通信时，可以采用所有适当方式，包括使用信使及密码或加密信息。然而，特使团仅可在接受国同意的情况下安装和使用无线发射设备。

Query_Text_en: 2 The official correspondence of the special mission shall be inviolable Official correspondence means all correspondence relating to the special mission and its functions
Translation: 2. 特别使命的官方通信应受不可侵犯的保护。官方通信是指与特别使命及其职能相关的所有通信。

Query_Text_en: 3 Where practicable the special mission shall use the means of communication including the bag and the courier of the permanent diplomatic mission of the sending State
Translation: 3. 在可行的情况下，特别使团应使用派遣国常驻外交使团的通讯方式，包括外交邮袋和信使。

Query_Text_en: 4 The bag of the special mission shall not be opened or detained
Translation: 4 特殊任务的包不得被打开或扣押。

Query_Text_en: 5 The packages constituting the bag of the special mission must bear visible external marks of their character and may contain only documents or articles intended for the official use of the special mission
Translation: 5 特别任务包裹必须在外部显著标明其性质，并且仅可包含用于特别任务官方用途的文件或物品。

Query_Text_en: 6 The courtier of the special mission who shall be provided with an official document indicating his status and the number of packages constituting the bag shall be protected by the receiving State in the performance of his functions He shall enjoy personal inviolability and shall not be liable to any form of arrest or detention
Translation: 执行特别任务的使节信使应持有表明其身份及外交邮袋件数的官方文件。接受国应在其履行职责时予以保护。该信使享有人身不可侵犯权利，不受任何形式的逮捕或拘留。

Query_Text_en: 7 The sending State or the special mission may designate couriers ad hoc of the special mission In such cases the provisions of paragraph 6 of this article shall also apply except that the immunities therein mentioned shall cease to apply when the courtier ad hoc has delivered to the consignee the special mission 's bag in his charge
Translation: 7 派遣国或特别使团可以指定特别使团的临时信使。在此情况下，本条第6款的规定同样适用，但所述豁免权在临时信使将其所负责的特别使团邮袋交付收件人后即不再适用。

Query_Text_en: 8 The bag of the special mission may be entrusted to the captain of a shiP or of a commercial aircraft scheduled to land at an authorized port of entry The captain shall be provided with an official document indicating the number of packages constituting the bag but he shall not be considered to be a courtier of the special mission By arrangement with the appropriate authorities the special mission may send one of its members to take possession of the bag directly and freely from the capitain of the ship or of the aircraft
Translation: 8. 特别使团的邮袋可以委托即将抵达经授权入境口岸的船长或民用航空器机长携带。船长或机长应获发一份注明邮袋件数的正式文件，但其本人不被视为特别使团的信使。经与有关当局协商，特别使团可派遣一名成员直接并自由地从船长或机长处领取该邮袋。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 29 PERSONAL INVIOLABILITYThe persons of the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and of the members of its diplomatic staff shall be inviolable They shall not be liable to any form of arrest or detention The receiving State shall treat them with due respect and shall take all appropriate steps to prevent any attack on their persons freedom or dignity
Translation:
第二十九条 人身不可侵犯

派遣国特别使团代表及其外交人员的人身不可侵犯。他们不受任何形式的逮捕或拘留。接受国应予以应有尊重，并采取一切适当措施防止对其人身、自由或尊严的任何侵犯。

Query_Text_en: 1 The private accommodation of the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and of the members of its diplomatic staff shall enjoy the same inviolability and protection as the premises of the special mission
Translation: 派遣国特别使团代表及其外交人员的私人住所，享有与特别使团馆舍同等的不可侵犯性和保护。

Query_Text_en: 2 Their papers their correspondence and except as provided in paragraph 4 of article 31 their property shall likewise enjoy inviolability
Translation: 他们的文件、通信，以及除第31条第4款另有规定外的财产，同样享有不可侵犯的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 The representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff shall enjoy immunity from the criminal jurisdiction of the receiving State
Translation: 派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员成员应享有接受国刑事司法管辖豁免权。

Query_Text_en: A a real action relating to private immovable property situated in the territory of the receiving State unless the person concerned holds it on behalf of the sending State for the purposes of the mission ;
Translation: 除非有关人员是代表派遣国为使馆事务而持有该不动产，否则与位于接受国境内的私人不动产有关的诉讼不得提起。

Query_Text_en: D an action for damages arising out of an accident caused by a vehicle used outside the official functions of me person concerned
Translation: D 因相关人员在非公务活动中使用车辆而引发事故所产生的损害赔偿诉讼

Query_Text_en: 3 The representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff are not obliged to give evidence as witnesses
Translation: 派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员成员无义务以证人身份作证。

Query_Text_en: 4 No measures of execution may be taken in respect of a representative of the sending State in the special mission or a member of its diplomatic staff except in the cases coming under subparagraphs a b c and d of paragraph 2 of this article and provided that the measures concerned can be taken without infringing the inviolability of his person or his accommodation
Translation: 除本条第2款a、b、c和d项所述情形外，不得对派遣国特别使团的代表或其外交人员采取任何强制执行措施，并且在上述情形下，所采取的措施不得侵犯其人身或住所的不可侵犯性。

Query_Text_en: 5 The immunity from jurisdiction of the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and of the members of its diplomatic staff does not exempt them from the jurisdiction of the sending State
Translation: 5 派遣国特别使团代表及其外交人员享有司法豁免权，并不意味着他们免于接受派遣国的司法管辖。

Query_Text_en: 1 Subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 of this article representatives of the sending State in the special mission and members of its diplomatic staff shall in respect of services rendered for the sending State be exempt from social security provisions which may be in force in the receiving State
Translation: 1 根据本条第3款的规定，派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员，就为派遣国提供的服务，在接受国现行的社会保障规定方面应予以豁免。

Query_Text_en: B that they are covered by the social security provisions which may be in force in the sending State or a third State
Translation: B 他们受派遣国或第三国可能正在实施的社会保障规定的保障。

Query_Text_en: 3 Representatives of the sending State in the special mission and members of its diplomatic staff who employ persons to whom the exemption provided for in paragrah 2 of this article does not apply shall observe the obligations which the social security provisions of the receiving State impose under employers
Translation: 派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员，如雇用本条第2款所不适用的人员，应遵守接受国社会保障规定对雇主所规定的义务。

Query_Text_en: 4 The exemption provided for in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article shall not preclude voluntary participation in the social security system of the receiving State where such participation is permitted by that State
Translation: 本条第1款和第2款所规定的豁免，不应妨碍受雇国允许的情况下，自愿参加受雇国社会保障体系的行为。

Query_Text_en: 5 The provisions of this article shall not affect bilateral or multilateral agreements concerning social security concluded previously and shall not prevent the conclusion of such agreements in the future
Translation: 本条款的规定不影响此前已签订的有关社会保障的双边或多边协议，也不妨碍今后此类协议的缔结。

Query_Text_en: F registration course or record fees mortgage dues and stamp duty subject to the provisions of article 24
Translation: F项：登记课程或记录费用、抵押贷款费用及印花税，须遵守第24条的规定。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 34 EXEMPTION FRoM PERSONAL SERVICESThe receiving State shall exempt the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff from all personal services from all public service of any kind whatsoever and from military obligations such as those connected with requisitioning military contributions and billeting
Translation:
第三十四条 免除个人服务  
接受国应免除派遣国特别使团代表及其外交工作人员的所有个人服务、任何形式的公共服务，以及与征用、军事捐助和驻军有关的军事义务。

Query_Text_en: B articles for the personal use of the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff
Translation: B. 供派遣国特别使团代表及其外交工作人员个人使用的物品

Query_Text_en: 2 The personal baggage of the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and of the members of its diplomatic staff shall be exempt from inspection unless there are serious grounds for presuming that it contains articles not covered by the exemptions mentioned in paragraph 1 of this article or articles the import or export of which is prohibited by the law or controlled by the quarantine regulations of the receiving State In such cases inspection shall be conducted only in the presence of the person concerned or of his authorized representative
Translation: 2. 派遣国特别使团代表及其外交人员的个人行李，应免于检查，除非有充分理由认为其中包含本条第1款所述豁免范围以外的物品，或包含接收国法律禁止进出口或受检疫规定管控的物品。在此情况下，检查须在当事人或其授权代表在场时进行。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 36 ADMINISTRATIVE AND TECHNICAL STAFFMembers of the administrative and technical staff of the special mission shall enjoy the privileges and immunities specified in articles 29 to 34 except that the immunity from civil and administrative jurisdiction of the receiving State specified in paragraph 2 of article 31 shall not extend to acts performed outside the course of their duties They shall also enjoy the privileges mentioned in paragraph l of article 35 in respect of articles imported at the time of their first entry into the territory of the receiving State
Translation:
第三十六条 行政和技术人员  
特别使命的行政和技术人员应享有第二十九至三十四条规定的特权与豁免，但第三十一条第二款规定的接受国对民事和行政管辖权的豁免，不适用于其在履行职责之外所为的行为。此外，他们还应享有第三十五条第一款所述的特权，即在首次进入接受国领土时进口物品的相关特权。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 37 SERVICE STAFFMembers of the service staff of the special mission shall enjoy immunity from the jurisdiction of the receiving State in respect of acts performed in the course of their duties exemption from dues and taxes on the emoluments they receive by reason of their employment and exemption from social security legislation as provided in article 32
Translation:
第三十七条 服务人员

特别使团的服务人员在履行职责期间所从事的行为，享有接受国司法管辖权豁免；其因受雇所得的报酬，免缴一切赋税和税费；并按照第三十二条的规定，免于适用社会保障法规。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 38 PRIVATE STAFFPrivate staff of the members of the special mission shall be exempt from dues and taxes on the emoluments they receive by reason of their employment In all other respects they may enjoy privileges and immunities only to the extent permitted by the receiving State However the receiving State must exercise its jurisdiction over these persons in such a manner as to interfere unduly with the performance of the functions of the special mission
Translation:
第三十八条 私人工作人员  
特别使命成员的私人工作人员因受雇而获得的薪酬，应免除缴纳任何会费和税款。除此之外，他们仅可在接受国允许的范围内享有特权与豁免权。然而，接受国在对这些人员行使司法管辖权时，必须以不妨碍特别使命履行职能的方式进行。

Query_Text_en: 1 Members of the families of representatives of the sending State in the special mission and of members of its diplomatic staff shall if they accompany such members of the special mission enjoy the privileges and immunities specified in articles 29 to 35 provided that they are not nationals of or permanently resident in the receiving State
Translation: 1. 派遣国特别使团代表及其外交人员的家庭成员，如随同特别使团成员前往，且非接受国国民或永久居民的，应享有第29至35条所规定的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: 2 Members of the families of members of the administrative and technical staff of the special mission shall if they accompany such members of the special mission enjoy the privileges and immunities specified in article 36 provided that they are not nationals of or permanently resident in the receiving State
Translation: 行政和技术人员特别使团成员的家庭成员，如随同该特别使团成员前往，将享有第36条规定的特权与豁免，前提是他们不是接受国的国民或永久居民。

Query_Text_en: 1 Except in so far as additional privileges and immunities may be granted by the receiving State the representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff who are nationals of or permanently resident in the receiving State shall enjoy only immunity from jurisdiction and inviolability in respect of official acts performed in the exercise of their functions
Translation: 除非接受国另行授予额外特权与豁免权，派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员中属于接受国国籍或在接受国永久居住者，仅在履行职务所进行的官方行为方面享有司法豁免权和不可侵犯权。

Query_Text_en: 2 Other members of the special mission and private staff who are nations of or permanently resident in the receiving State shall enjoy privileges and immunities only to the extent granted to them by that State However the receiving State must exercise its jurisdiction over those persons in such a manner as not to interfere unduly with the performance of the functions of the special mission
Translation: 2. 特别使团的其他成员及私人工作人员，如为接受国公民或永久居民，仅在接受国授予的范围内享有特权与豁免。然而，接受国在对上述人员行使司法管辖权时，必须以不不当妨碍特别使团履行职能的方式进行。

Query_Text_en: 1 The sending State may waive the immunity from jurisdiction of its representatives in the special mission of the members of its diplomatic staff and of other persons enjoying immunity under articles 36 to 40
Translation: 派遣国可以放弃其特别使团代表、外交人员成员以及根据第36至第40条享有豁免权的其他人员的司法管辖豁免权。

Query_Text_en: 2 Waiver must always be express
Translation: 豁免必须始终以明确方式作出。

Query_Text_en: 3 The initiation of proceedings by any of the persons referred to in paragraph 1 of this article shall preclude him from invoking immunity from jurisdiction in respect of any counter claim directly connected with the principal claim
Translation: 本条第一款所述任何人一旦提起诉讼，即不得以与主诉直接相关的反诉为由主张司法豁免权。

Query_Text_en: 4 Waiver of immunity from jurisdiction in respect of civil or administrative proceedings shall not be held to imply waiver of immunity in respect of the execution of the judgement for which a separate waiver shall be necessary
Translation: 4 在民事或行政诉讼中放弃司法豁免权，并不意味着放弃对判决执行的豁免权；对判决执行的豁免需另行单独放弃。

Query_Text_en: 1 If a representative of the sending State in the special mission or a member of its diplomatic staff passes through or is in the territory of a third State while proceeding to take up his functions or returning to the sending State the third State shall accord him inviolability and such other immunities as may be required to ensure his transit or return The same shall apply in the case of any members of his family enjoying privileges or immunities who are accompanying the person referred to in this paragraph whether traveling with him or traveling separately to join him or to return to their country
Translation: 1. 如果派遣国特别使团的代表或其外交人员在前往履职或返回派遣国途中经过或停留在第三国领土，第三国应给予其人身不可侵犯权以及为确保其过境或返回所需的其他豁免。同样，凡享有特权与豁免的家庭成员，无论是与上述人员同行，还是单独前往与其会合或返回本国，均应适用本款规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 In circumstances similar to those specified in paragraph 1 of this article third States shall not hinder the transit of members of the administrative and technical or service staff of the special mission or of members of their families through their territories
Translation: 在与本条第1款所述情形类似的情况下，第三国不得阻碍特别使团行政和技术人员或服务人员及其家庭成员经其领土过境。

Query_Text_en: 3 Third States shall accord to official correspondence and other official communications in transit including messages in code or cipher the same freedom and protection as the receiving State is bound to accord under the present Convention Subject to the provisions of paragraph 4 of this article they shall accord to the couriers and bags of the special mission in transit the same inviolability and protection as the receiving State is bound to accord under the present Convention
Translation: 第三国应给予在途中的官方信函及其他官方通信（包括密码或加密信息）与接受国根据本公约所应给予的同等自由和保护。根据本条第4款的规定，第三国应给予在途中的特别使命使者及其邮袋与接受国根据本公约所应给予的同等不可侵犯性和保护。

Query_Text_en: 4 The third State shall be bound to comply with its obligations in respect of the persons mentioned in paragraphs 1 2 and 3 of this article only if it has been informed in advance either in the visa application or by notification of the tran sit of those persons as members of the special mission members of their families or couriers and has raised no objection to it
Translation: 第三国只有在事先通过签证申请或收到关于上述人员作为特别使团成员、其家庭成员或信使的过境通知，并且未提出异议的情况下，才有义务履行本条第1、2、3款所述人员相关的义务。

Query_Text_en: 5 The obligations of third States under paragraphs 1 2 and 3 of this article shall also apply to the persons mentioned respectively in those paragraphs and to the official communications and the bags of the special mission when the use of the territory of the third State is due to force majeure
Translation: 当因不可抗力而使用第三国领土时，本条第1、2、3款规定的第三国义务，同样适用于上述各款所提及人员，以及特别使团的官方通信和邮袋。

Query_Text_en: 1 Every member of the special mission shall enjoy the privileges and immunities to which he is entitled from the moment he enters the territory of the receiving State for the purpose of performing his functions in the special mission or it he is already in its territory from the moment when his appointment is notified to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or such other organ of the receiving State as may be agreed
Translation: 1. 特别使团的每一成员，自为履行其在特别使团中的职能进入接受国领土之时起，或如其已在该领土之内，自其被任命的通知送达接受国外交部或双方同意的其他机关之时起，即享有其应享有的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: 2 When the functions of a member of the special mission have come to an end his privileges and immunities shall normally cease at the moment when he leaves the territory of the receiving State or on the expiry of a reasonable period in which to do so but shah subsist until that time even in case of armed conflict However in respect of acts performed by such a member in the exercise of his functions immunity shall continue to subsist
Translation: 2 当特别使命成员的职务终止时，其特权与豁免权通常自其离开接受国领土之时，或在合理期限届满时终止，但即使在武装冲突情况下，该等特权与豁免权在此之前仍然有效。然而，对于该成员在履行职务过程中所实施的行为，其豁免权应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: 3 In the event of the death of a member of the special mission the members of his family shall continue to enjoy the privileges and immunities to which they are entitled until the expiry of a reasonable period in which to leave the territory of the receiving State
Translation: 3. 如特别使团成员去世，其家属在离开接受国领土的合理期限届满前，仍可继续享有其应有的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: 1 In the event of the death of a member of the special mission or of a member of his family accompanying him if the deceased was not a national of or permanently resident in the receiving State the receiving State shall permit the withdrawal of the movable property of the deceased with the exception of any property acquired in the country the export of which was prohibited at the time of his death
Translation: 如特别使命成员或其随行家庭成员去世，且死者并非接受国国民或永久居民，接受国应允许其动产撤离，但在该国境内取得且在其去世时被禁止出口的财产除外。

Query_Text_en: 2 Estate succession and inheritance duties shall not be levied on movable property which is in the receiving State solely because of the presence there of the deceased as a member of the special mission or of the family of a member of the mission
Translation: 2. 对于因死者作为特别使团成员或其家庭成员而在接受国境内的动产，不应征收遗产继承税或遗产税。

Query_Text_en: 1 The receiving State must even in case of armed conflict grant facilities to enable persons enjoying privileges and immunities other than nationals of the receiving State and members of the families of such persons irrespective of their nationality to leave at the earliest possible moment In particular it must in case of need place at their disposal the necessary means of transport for themselves and their property
Translation: 即使在武装冲突情况下，接受国也必须为享有特权与豁免权的人员（除接受国国民外）及其家庭成员（无论其国籍如何）提供便利，使其能够尽早离境。特别是在必要时，接受国必须为他们及其财产提供所需的交通工具。

Query_Text_en: 2 The receiving State must grant the sending State facilities for removing the archives of the special mission from the territory of the receiving State
Translation: 2 接受国必须为派遣国提供便利，以便其将特别使团的档案从接受国境内移出。

Query_Text_en: 1 When the functions of a special mission come to an end the receiving State must respect and protect the premises of the special mission so long as they are assigned to it as well as the property and archives of the special mission The sending State must withdraw the property and archives within a reasonable period of time
Translation: 当特别任务的职能结束后，接受国必须尊重并保护特别任务所使用的场所，以及其财产和档案，只要这些场所仍被分配给该特别任务。派遣国必须在合理期限内撤回其财产和档案。

Query_Text_en: 2 In case of the absence or severance of diplomatic or consular relations between the sending State and the receiving State and if the functions of the special mission have come to an end the sending State may even if there is an armed conflict entrust the custody of the property and archives of the special mission to a third State acceptable to the receiving State
Translation: 2. 在派遣国与接受国之间断绝或中止外交或领事关系，并且特别使团的职能已经终止的情况下，即使发生武装冲突，派遣国仍可将特别使团的财产和档案的保管委托给接受国同意的第三国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Without prejudice to their privileges and immunities it is the duty of all persons enjoying these privileges and immunities under the present Convention to respect the laws and regulations of the receiving State They also have a duty not to interfere in the internal affairs op that State
Translation: 在不影响其特权与豁免的前提下，所有根据本公约享有这些特权与豁免的人士都有义务遵守接受国的法律和法规，同时也有义务不干涉该国内政。

Query_Text_en: 2 The premises of the special mission must not be used in any manner incompatible with the functions of the special mission as envisaged in the present Convention in other rules of general international law or in any special agreements in force between the sending and the receiving State
Translation: 2 特别使命的场所不得以任何与本公约所设想的特别使命职能、其他一般国际法规则或派遣国与接受国之间现行特别协议不相符的方式使用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 48 PROFESSIONAL OR COMMERCIAL ACTIVITYThe representatives of the sending State in the special mission and the members of its diplomatic staff shall not practice for personal profit any professional or commercial activity in the receiving State
Translation:
第四十八条 专业或商业活动

派遣国特别使团的代表及其外交人员不得在接受国从事任何以个人利益为目的的专业或商业活动。

Query_Text_en: 1 In the application of the provisions of the present Convention no discrimination shall be made as between States
Translation: 在适用本公约条款时，各国之间不得有任何歧视。

Query_Text_en: A Where the receiving State applies any of the provisions of the present Convention restrictively because of a restrictive application of that provision to its special mission in the sending State ;
Translation: A 如果接受国因其在派遣国的特别使团对本公约某项条款采取限制性适用，而对本公约的相关条款也采取限制性适用；

Query_Text_en: B Where States modify among themselves by custom or agreement the extent of facilities privileges and immunities for their special missions although such a modification has not been agreed with other States provided that it is not incompatible with the object and purpose of the present Convention and does not affect the enjoyment of the rights or the performance of the obligations of third States
Translation: B 如果各国通过习惯或协议在其特殊使团之间调整便利、特权和豁免的范围，尽管此类调整未与其他国家达成一致，但只要该调整不与本公约的宗旨和目的相抵触，且不影响第三国权利的享有或义务的履行，即可予以认可。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 50 SIGNATUREThe present Convention shall be open for signature by all States Members of the United Nations or of any of the specialized agencies or of the International Atomic Energy Agency or Parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice and by any other State invited by the General Assembly of the United Nations to become a Party to the Convention until 31 December 1970 at United Nations Headquarters in New York
Translation:
第五十条 签署  
本公约自公布之日起，联合国会员国、任何专门机构或国际原子能机构的成员国、国际法院规约的缔约国，以及经联合国大会邀请成为本公约缔约方的其他国家，均可在纽约联合国总部签署本公约，签署期限至1970年12月31日止。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 51 RATIFICATIONThe present Convention is subject to ratification The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations
Translation:
第五十一条 批准

本公约须经批准。批准书应交存联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 52 ACCESSIONThe present Convention shall remain open for accession by any State belonging to any of the categories mentioned in article 50 The instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations
Translation:
第五十二条 加入

本公约将继续向第五十条所述类别的任何国家开放加入。加入文书应交存联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: 1 The present Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of deposit of the twenty second instrument of ratification or accession with the Secretary General of the United Nations
Translation: 本公约将在第二十二份批准书或加入书向联合国秘书长交存之日起第三十天生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 For each State ratifying or acceding to the Convention after the deposit of the twenty second instrument of ratification or accession the Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification or accession
Translation: 对于在第二十二份批准书或加入书交存之后批准或加入本公约的每一缔约国，本公约应于该国交存批准书或加入书后三十日生效。

Query_Text_en: B of the date on which the present Convention will enter into force in accordance with article 53
Translation: 自本公约根据第五十三条生效之日起

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 55 AUTHENTIC TEXTSThe original of the present Convention of which the Chinese English French Russian and Spanish texts are equally authentic shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations who shall send certified copies thereof to all States belonging to any of the categories mentioned in article 50 IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments have signed the present Convention opened for signature at New YOrk on 16 December 1969
Translation:
第五十五条 正本文本

本公约正本以中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各种文本具有同等效力，由联合国秘书长保存，并向第五十条所述任何类别的所有国家发送经认证的副本。

为此，签署人经各自政府正式授权，于1969年12月16日在纽约开放签署的本公约上签字，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: Article 1The World Meteorological Organization [ hereinafter called the Organization ] is hereby established .
Translation: 第一条 兹成立世界气象组织（以下简称“本组织”）。

Query_Text_en: PART III MEMBERSHIP
Translation: 第三部分 会员资格

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Any trust territory or group of trust territories maintaining its own meteorological service and administered by the United Nations to which the United Nations applies the present Convention in accordance with Article 34 .
Translation: 任何由联合国管理、拥有自身气象服务的托管领土或托管领土集团，且联合国根据第34条将本公约适用于该领土或集团。

Query_Text_en: Any request for membership in the Organization shall state in accordance with which paragraph of this Article membership is sought .
Translation: 任何申请加入本组织的请求，应说明依据本条哪一款提出入会申请。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The Secretariat .
Translation: [5] 秘书处。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] There shall be a President and two Vice-Presidents of the Organization who shall also be President and Vice-Presidents of the Congress and of the Executive Committee .
Translation: [ b ] 组织应设主席一名、副主席两名，且该主席和副主席同时担任大会及执行委员会的主席和副主席。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 [ a ] Eligibility for election to the offices of President and Vice-President of the Organization , of President and Vice-President of the Regional Associations , and for membership , subject to the provisions of Article 13 [ c ] of the present Convention , on the Executive Committee should be confined to the Directors of Meteorological Services of Members of the Organization .
Translation: 第5条[a] 本组织主席和副主席、区域协会主席和副主席的选举资格，以及根据本公约第13条[c]规定的执行委员会成员资格，仅限于本组织成员的气象服务主管。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] In the performance of their duties , the officers of the Organization and the members of the Executive Committee should regard themselves as representatives of the Organization rather than as representatives of particular Members thereof .
Translation: 在履行职责时，组织的工作人员和执行委员会成员应视自己为组织的代表，而非某一成员的代表。

Query_Text_en: PART V ELIGIBILITY
Translation: 第五部分 资格条件

Query_Text_en: Article 6 [ a ] The Congress is the supreme body of the Organization and shall be composed of delegates representing Members .
Translation: 第六条 [a] 大会是本组织的最高权力机构，由代表成员的代表组成。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] With a view to securing the widest possible technical representation , any director of a meteorological service or any other individual may be invited by the President to be present at and participate in the discussions of the Congress .
Translation: [ b ] 为确保尽可能广泛的技术代表性，任何气象服务机构负责人或其他个人，均可由主席邀请出席大会并参与讨论。

Query_Text_en: PART VI THE WORLD METEOROLOGICAL CONGRESS
Translation: 第六部分 世界气象大会

Query_Text_en: Each Member shall designate one of its delegates , who should be the director of its meteorological service , as its principal delegate .
Translation: 每个成员应指定一名代表，原则上应由其气象部门负责人担任，作为其主要代表。

Query_Text_en: Article 8FunctionsThe functions of the Congress shall be :
Translation:
第八条 职能

大会的职能如下：

Query_Text_en: [ a ] To determine general regulations , subject to the provisions of the present Convention , prescribing the constitution and the functions of the various bodies of the Organization ;
Translation: [ a ] 在不违反本公约规定的前提下，制定有关本组织各机构的组成及其职能的一般规章；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] To determine its own rules of procedure ;
Translation: [ b ] 制定自身议事规则。

Query_Text_en: to define their terms of reference , coordinate their activities , and consider their recommendations ;
Translation: 明确其职权范围，协调各自活动，并审议相关建议；

Query_Text_en: [ k ] To determine the location of the Secretariat of the Organization ;
Translation: [ k ] 决定本组织秘书处的设立地点；

Query_Text_en: [ l ] To take any other appropriate action to further the purposes of the Organization .
Translation: [l] 采取任何其他适当行动以进一步实现本组织的宗旨。

Query_Text_en: Article 9Execution of Congress decisions [ a ] All Members shall do their utmost to implement the decisions of the Congress .
Translation:
第九条  代表大会决议的执行

[a] 全体成员应尽最大努力贯彻执行代表大会的各项决议。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] If , however , any Member finds it impracticable to give effect to some requirement in a technical resolution adopted by Congress , such Member shall inform the Secretary General of the Organization whether its inability to give effect to it is provisional or final , and state its reasons therefor .
Translation: [ b ] 然而，如果任何成员发现无法切实执行大会通过的某项技术决议中的某项要求，该成员应通知本组织秘书长其无法执行该要求是暂时性的还是最终性的，并说明其原因。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Meetings [ a ] The Executive Committee shall meet at least once a year .
Translation:
第十条 会议

[一] 执行委员会每年至少召开一次会议。

Query_Text_en: The time and place of the meeting shall be determined by the President of the Organization , taking account of the views of the other members of the Committee .
Translation: 会议的时间和地点由本组织主席确定，并征求委员会其他成员的意见。

Query_Text_en: Each Member shall have one vote in decisions of the Congress , except that only Members of the Organization which are States , as specified in paragraphs [ a ] , [ b ] and [ c ] of Article 3 of the present Convention , [ hereinafter referred to as `` Members which are States '' ] , shall be entitled to vote on any of the following subjects :
Translation: 每个成员在大会决策中均享有一票表决权，但只有本组织作为国家的成员（即本公约第三条第[a]、[b]和[c]款所述的成员，以下简称“国家成员”）才有权就以下事项进行投票：

Query_Text_en: Article 11Voting [ a ] Each Member shall have one vote in decisions of the Congress , except that only Members of the Organization which are States , as specified in paragraphs [ a ] , [ b ] and [ c ] of Article 3 of the present Convention , [ hereinafter referred to as `` Members which are States '' ] , shall be entitled to vote on any of the following subjects :
Translation:
第十一条 投票  
[a] 每一会员在大会的决策中均有一票表决权，但仅有本公约第三条[a]、[b]和[c]款所指的国家会员（以下简称“国家会员”）有权就下列事项进行表决：

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Decisions of the Congress shall be by two-thirds majority of the votes cast for and against , except that elections of individuals to serve in any capacity in the Organization shall be by simple majority of the votes cast .
Translation: [ b ] 大会的决议须经投票赞成与反对票的三分之二多数通过，但组织内任何职位的个人选举则以投票的简单多数决定。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this paragraph , however , shall not apply to decisions taken in accordance with Articles 3 , 25 , 26 , and 28 of the present Convention .
Translation: 然而，本款规定不适用于根据本公约第3条、第25条、第26条和第28条作出的决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 12QuorumA majority of the Members shall be required to constitute a quorum for meetings of the Congress .
Translation:
第十二条 会议法定人数

大会召开会议时，须有多数成员出席方可构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: For those meetings of the Congress at which decisions are taken on the subjects enumerated in paragraph [ a ] of Article 10 , a majority of the Members which are States shall be required to constitute a quorum .
Translation: 在大会就第十条第[a]款所列事项作出决定的会议上，须有多数成员国出席方可构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: PART VII THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE
Translation: 第七部分 执行委员会

Query_Text_en: [ b ] To adopt resolutions arising out of recommendations of the Technical Commissions on matters of urgency affecting the technical regulations , provided that all Regional Associations concerned are given an opportunity to express their approval or disapproval before adoption by the Executive Committee ;
Translation: [ b ] 就技术委员会提出的、涉及技术规章的紧急事项，通过相关决议，但须在执行委员会通过前，给予所有相关区域协会表达同意或不同意意见的机会；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] To provide technical information , counsel , and assistance in the field of meteorology ;
Translation: [ c ] 提供气象领域的技术信息、咨询和协助；

Query_Text_en: Each member of the Executive Committee shall have only one vote , notwithstanding that he may be a member in more than one capacity .
Translation: 无论执行委员会成员以何种身份担任委员，每人仅有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 QuorumThe quorum shall consist of a majority of the members of the Executive Committee .
Translation:
第十七条 会议法定人数

执行委员会会议的法定人数为委员会成员的过半数。

Query_Text_en: PART VIII REGIONAL ASSOCIATIONS
Translation: 第八部分 地区协会

Query_Text_en: Article 18 [ a ] Regional Associations shall be composed of the Members of the Organization , the networks of which lie in or extend into the Region .
Translation: 第十八条 [a] 区域协会应由本组织成员组成，这些成员的网络位于或延伸至该区域。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Members of the Organization shall be entitled to attend the meetings of Regional Associations to which they do not belong , take part in the discussions , present their views upon questions affecting their own Meteorological Service , but shall not have the right to vote .
Translation: [ b ] 本组织成员有权参加其未隶属的区域协会会议，参与讨论，并就涉及本国气象服务的问题发表意见，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Regional Associations shall meet as often as necessary .
Translation: 区域协会应根据需要随时召开会议。

Query_Text_en: The time and place of the meeting shall be determined by the Presidents of the Regional Associations in agreement with the President of the Organization .
Translation: 会议的时间和地点由各区域协会主席与本组织主席协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The functions of the Regional Associations shall be :
Translation: 区域协会的职能如下：

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] To consider matters brought to their attention by the Executive Committee ;
Translation: [二] 审议执行委员会提交的相关事项；

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] To discuss matters of general meteorological interest and to coordinate meteorological and associated activities in their respective regions ;
Translation: [ iii ] 讨论一般气象相关事项，并协调各自区域内的气象及相关活动。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] To perform such other functions as may be conferred on them by the Congress .
Translation: 履行国会赋予他们的其他职能。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Each Regional Association shall elect its President and Vice-President .
Translation: 每个区域协会应选举其主席和副主席。

Query_Text_en: PART IX TECHNICAL COMMISSIONS
Translation: 第九部分 技术委员会

Query_Text_en: Article 19 [ a ] Commissions consisting of technical experts may be established by the Congress to study and make recommendations to the Congress and the Executive Committee on any subject within the purposes of the Organization .
Translation: 第十九条 [a] 国会可以设立由技术专家组成的委员会，负责研究并就本组织宗旨范围内的任何议题向国会和执行委员会提出建议。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 [ a ] The Secretary General shall be appointed by the Congress on such terms as the Congress may approve .
Translation: 第二十一条 [a] 秘书长由大会任命，任职条件由大会批准。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The staff of the Secretariat shall be appointed by the Secretary General with the approval of the Executive Committee in accordance with regulations established by the Congress .
Translation: 秘书处工作人员由秘书长按照大会制定的规章，并经执行委员会批准后任命。

Query_Text_en: They shall refrain from any action which might reflect on their position as international officers .
Translation: 他们应避免采取任何可能影响其作为国际官员身份的行为。

Query_Text_en: Each Member of the Organization on its part shall respect the exclusively international character of the responsibilities of the Secretary General and the staff and not seek to influence them in the discharge of their responsibilities to the Organization .
Translation: 本组织各成员应尊重秘书长及其工作人员职责的纯粹国际性质，不得在其履行对本组织职责时试图加以影响。

Query_Text_en: PART XI FINANCES
Translation: 第十一部分 财务

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Congress shall delegate to the Executive Committee such authority as may be required to approve the annual expenditures of the Organization within the limitations determined by the Congress .
Translation: [ b ] 代表大会应授权执行委员会在大会规定的限额内批准本组织年度支出的相关权限。

Query_Text_en: Article 24The expenditures of the Organization shall be apportioned among the Members of the Organization in the proportions determined by the Congress .
Translation: 第二十四条 组织的支出应按照大会确定的比例由各成员分担。

Query_Text_en: PART XII RELATIONS WITH THE UNITED NATIONS
Translation: 第十二部分 与联合国的关系

Query_Text_en: Article 25The Organization shall be brought into relationship with the United Nations pursuant to Article 57 of the Charter of the United Nations , subject to the approval of the terms of the agreement by two-thirds of the Members which are States .
Translation: 第二十五条 本组织应根据《联合国宪章》第五十七条，与联合国建立关系，但须经三分之二成员国批准协议条款。

Query_Text_en: PART XIII RELATIONS WITH OTHER ORGANIZATIONS
Translation: 第十三部分 与其他组织的关系

Query_Text_en: Article 26 [ a ] The Organization shall establish effective relations and cooperate closely with such other inter-governmental organizations as may be desirable .
Translation: 第二十六条 [a] 本组织应与其他适当的政府间组织建立有效关系并密切合作。

Query_Text_en: Any formal agreement entered into with such organizations shall be made by the Executive Committee , subject to approval by two-thirds of the Members which are States .
Translation: 与此类组织签订的任何正式协议，须由执行委员会负责，并经三分之二成员国批准。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Subject to approval by two-thirds of the Members which are States , the Organization may take over from any other international organization or agency , the purpose and activities of which lie within the purposes of the Organization , such functions , resources , and obligations as may be transferred to the Organization by international agreement or by mutually acceptable arrangements entered into between the competent authorities of the respective organizations .
Translation: 经三分之二成员国批准，组织可从其他国际组织或机构接管其宗旨和活动与本组织宗旨相符的职能、资源和义务，前提是这些职能、资源和义务可通过国际协议或由相关组织主管部门达成的双方认可安排转移至本组织。

Query_Text_en: PART XIV LEGAL STATUS , PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES
Translation: 第十四部分 法律地位、特权与豁免

Query_Text_en: Article 27 [ a ] the Organization shall enjoy in the territory of each Member such legal capacity as may be necessary for the fulfilment of its purposes and for the exercise of its functions .
Translation: 第二十七条 [a] 本组织在每个成员国境内应享有为实现其宗旨和履行其职能所必需的法律资格。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] [ ii ] Representatives of Members and officials of the Organization shall similarly enjoy such privileges and immunities as are necessary for the independent exercise of their functions in connection with the Organization .
Translation: [ b ] [ ii ] 会员国代表及本组织官员亦应享有为独立履行其与本组织相关职能所必需的特权与豁免。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Such legal capacity , privileges , and immunities shall be defined in a separate agreement to be prepared by the Organization in consultation with the Secretary General of the United Nations and concluded between the Members which are States .
Translation: 此类法律能力、特权和豁免应在本组织与联合国秘书长协商后，由本组织拟定，并由作为成员国的国家之间通过单独协议加以规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 [ a ] The text of any proposed amendment to the present Convention shall be communicated by the Secretary General to Members of the Organization at least six months in advance of its consideration by the Congress .
Translation: 第二十八条 [a] 任何对本公约拟议修正案的文本，秘书长应至少在大会审议前六个月通知本组织成员。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Amendments to the present Convention involving new obligations for Members shall require approval by the Congress , in accordance with the provisions of Article 10 of the present Convention , by a two-thirds majority vote , and shall come into force on acceptance by two-thirds of the Members which are States for each such Member accepting the amendment and thereafter for each remaining such Member on acceptance by it .
Translation: 对本公约新增成员义务的修正案，须按照本公约第10条的规定，经大会以三分之二多数票通过，并在获得三分之二为国家的成员接受后，对每一接受修正案的成员生效，随后对其余每一此类成员在其接受后生效。

Query_Text_en: Such amendments shall come into force for any Member not responsible for its own international relations upon the acceptance on behalf of such a Member by the Member responsible for the conduct of its international relations .
Translation: 对于任何不负责自身国际关系的成员，此类修正案在负责其国际关系的成员代表其接受后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Other amendments shall come into force upon approval by two-thirds of the Members which are States .
Translation: 其他修正案须经三分之二的成员国批准后方可生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 29Any question or dispute concerning the interpretation or application of the present Convention which is not settled by negotiation or by the Congress shall be referred to an independent arbitrator appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice , unless the parties concerned agree on another mode of settlement .
Translation: 第二十九条 凡因本公约的解释或适用所引发的问题或争议，若未能通过协商或大会解决，应提交由国际法院院长指定的独立仲裁员进行裁决，除非有关各方同意采用其他解决方式。

Query_Text_en: PART XVII WITHDRAWAL
Translation: 第十七部分 退出

Query_Text_en: Article 30 [ a ] Any Member may withdraw from the Organization on twelve months ' notice in writing given by it to the Secretary General of the Organization , who shall at once inform all the Members of the Organization of such notice of withdrawal .
Translation: 第30条 [a] 任何成员均可通过向本组织秘书长提交书面通知，在提前十二个月通知的情况下退出本组织。秘书长应立即将该退出通知告知本组织所有成员。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Member of the organization not responsible for its own international relations may be withdrawn from the Organization on twelve months ' notice in writing given by the Member or other authority responsible for its international relations to the Secretary General of the Organization , who shall at once inform all the Members of the Organization of such notice of withdrawal .
Translation: [ b ] 任何不负责自身国际关系的组织成员，可以由该成员或负责其国际关系的其他机构向组织秘书长提交书面通知，提前十二个月申请退出组织。秘书长应立即将该退出通知告知所有组织成员。

Query_Text_en: Article 31If any Member fails to meet its financial obligations to the Organization or otherwise fails in its obligations under the present Convention , the Congress may by resolution suspend it from exercising its rights and enjoying privileges as a Member of the Organization until it has met such financial or other obligations .
Translation: 第三十一条 如果任何成员未能履行其对本组织的财务义务，或未能履行本公约规定的其他义务，大会可通过决议暂停其作为本组织成员的权利和特权，直至其履行相关财务或其他义务为止。

Query_Text_en: PART XIX RATIFICATION AND ACCESSION
Translation: 第十九部分 批准与加入

Query_Text_en: Article 32The present Convention shall be ratified by the signatory States and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Government of the United States of America , which will notify each signatory and acceding State of the date of deposit thereof .
Translation: 第三十二条 本公约须经签署国批准，批准书应交存于美利坚合众国政府。美利坚合众国政府将通知每一个签署国和加入国批准书交存的日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 33Subject to the provisions of Article 3 of the present Convention , accession shall be effected by the deposit with the Government of the United States of America of an instrument of accession , which shall take effect on the date of its receipt by the Government of the United States of America , which will notify each signatory and acceding State thereof .
Translation:
第三十三条  
在本公约第三条规定的前提下，加入本公约须向美利坚合众国政府提交加入书。加入书自美利坚合众国政府收到之日起生效，美利坚合众国政府将通知每一个签署国和加入国。

Query_Text_en: Article 34Subject to the provisions of Article 3 of the present Convention , [ a ] Any contracting State may declare that its ratification of , or accession to , the present Convention includes any territory or group of territories for the international relations of which it is responsible .
Translation:
第三十四条  
在本公约第三条规定的前提下，任何缔约国均可声明，其对本公约的批准或加入包括其负责处理国际关系的任何领土或领土集团。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The United Nations may apply the present Convention to any trust territory or group of trust territories for which it is the administering authority .
Translation: 联合国可将本公约适用于其作为管理当局的任何托管领土或托管领土集团。

Query_Text_en: PART XX ENTRY INTO FORCE
Translation: 第二十部分 生效

Query_Text_en: Article 35The present Convention shall come into force on the thirtieth day after the date of the deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification or accession .
Translation: 第三十五条 本公约自第三十份批准书或加入书交存之日起第三十天开始生效。

Query_Text_en: The present Convention shall come into force for each State ratifying or acceding after that date on the thirtieth day after the deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession .
Translation: 本公约对于在该日期之后批准或加入的每一缔约国，自其交存批准书或加入书之日起第三十天开始生效。

Query_Text_en: The present Convention shall bear the date on which it is opened for signature and shall remain open for signature for a period of 120 days thereafter .
Translation: 本公约应注明其开放签署之日期，并自该日期起开放签署120天。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Washington this eleventh day of October 1947 , in the English and French languages , each equally authentic , the original of which shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of the United States of America .
Translation: 本文件于1947年10月11日在华盛顿以英文和法文签署，两种文本具有同等效力，正本将存放于美利坚合众国政府档案馆。

Query_Text_en: [ Signatures not reproduced here .
Translation: [签名未在此处展示。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the principle that conferences should make available to interested parties pertinent information about their activities which are relevant to those parties and should publish meaningful information on their activities , HAVE AGREED as follows :
Translation: [ f ] 会议应向相关方提供与其利益相关的活动信息，并应公布有关其活动的有意义信息的原则，现达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Liner conference or conference : A group of two or more vessel-operating carriers which provides international liner services for the carriage of cargo on a particular route or routes within specified geographical limits and which has an agreement or arrangement , whatever its nature , within the framework of which they operate under uniform or common freight rates and any other agreed conditions with respect to the provision of liner services .
Translation: 班轮公会或公会：指由两家或以上经营船舶的承运人组成的团体，在特定地理范围内的某一条或多条航线上提供国际班轮货运服务，并根据协议或安排（无论其性质如何），在统一或共同的运价及其他有关班轮服务的约定条件下开展运营。

Query_Text_en: National shipping line : A national shipping line of any given country is a vessel-operating carrier which has its head office of management and its effective control in that country and is recognized as such by an appropriate authority of that country or under the law of that country .
Translation: 国家航运公司：某一国家的国家航运公司是指在该国设有管理总部并受该国实际控制的船舶经营承运人，并且经该国相关主管部门或依据该国法律认可为国家航运公司的企业。

Query_Text_en: Lines belonging to and operated by a joint venture involving two or more countries and in whose equity the national interests , public and\/or private , of those countries have a substantial share and whose head office of management and whose effective control is in one of those countries can be recognized as a national line by the appropriate authorities of those countries .
Translation: 由两个或两个以上国家参与的合资企业拥有和运营的航线，并且这些国家的国家利益（无论是公共的还是私人的）在其股权中占有重要份额，其管理总部和实际控制权位于其中一个国家的，可以由这些国家的相关主管部门认定为国家航线。

Query_Text_en: Third-country shipping line : A vessel-operating carrier in its operations between two countries of which it is not a national shipping line .
Translation: 第三国航运公司：指在两个国家之间运营的船舶经营承运人，但其并非这两个国家的本国航运公司。

Query_Text_en: Shipper : A person or entity who has entered into , or who demonstrates an intention to enter into , a contractual or other arrangement with a conference or shipping line for the shipment of goods in which he has a beneficial interest .
Translation: 托运人：指与班轮公会或航运公司签订合同或其他协议，或有意签订此类合同或协议，以运输其拥有权益的货物的个人或实体。

Query_Text_en: Shippers ' organization : An association or equivalent body which promotes , represents and protects the interests of shippers and , if those authorities so desire , is recognized in that capacity by the appropriate authority or authorities of the country whose shippers it represents .
Translation: 托运人组织：指促进、代表并维护托运人利益的协会或同类机构，并在有关当局有此意愿时，被其所代表国家的主管当局正式认可为该身份的组织。

Query_Text_en: Goods carried by the conference : Cargo transported by shipping lines members of a conference in accordance with the conference agreement .
Translation: 班轮公会运输的货物：指由班轮公会成员航运公司根据公会协议运输的货物。

Query_Text_en: Appropriate authority : Either a government or a body designated by a government or by national legislation to perform any of the functions ascribed to such authority by the provisions of this Code .
Translation: 主管机关：指政府或由政府或国家立法指定的机构，负责履行本规范规定的任何相关职能。

Query_Text_en: Promotional freight rate : A rate instituted for promoting the carriage of non-traditional exports of the country concerned .
Translation: 优惠运价：为促进本国非传统出口货物运输而设立的运价。

Query_Text_en: Special freight rate : A preferential freight rate , other than a promotional freight rate , which may be negotiated between the parties concerned .
Translation: 特惠运价：指除促销运价之外，由相关各方协商确定的优惠运价。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Membership [ 1 ] Any national shipping line shall have the right to be a full member of a conference which serves the foreign trade of its country , subject to the criteria set out in Article 1 [ 2 ] .
Translation:
第一条 会员资格

[1] 任何国家的航运公司，只要符合第一条第[2]款规定的标准，均有权作为正式会员加入服务于本国对外贸易的航运公会。

Query_Text_en: Shipping lines which are not national lines in any trade of a conference shall have the right to become full members of that conference , subject to the criteria set out in Article 1 [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] and to the provisions regarding the share of trade as set out in Article 2 as regards third-country shipping lines .
Translation: 在任何公会贸易中，非国家航运公司的航运公司有权成为该公会的正式成员，但须符合第1条第[2]款和第[3]款规定的标准，并遵守第2条关于第三国航运公司运量份额的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] A shipping line applying for membership of a conference shall furnish evidence of its ability and intention , which may include the use of chartered tonnage , provided the criteria of this paragraph are met , to operate a regular , adequate and efficient service on a long-term basis as defined in the conference agreement within the framework of the conference , shall undertake to abide by all the terms and conditions of the conference agreement , and shall deposit a financial guarantee to cover any outstanding financial obligation in the event of subsequent withdrawal , suspension or expulsion from membership , if so required under the conference agreement .
Translation: 申请加入班轮公会的航运公司，应提供其具备并有意在公会框架内，根据公会协议的规定，长期运营定期、充足且高效服务的相关证明（包括使用租赁船舶在内，前提是符合本款规定的标准）。该公司还应承诺遵守公会协议的所有条款和条件，并在公会协议要求的情况下，提交一份财务担保，以覆盖其因后续退出、暂停或被开除会员资格时可能产生的任何未清偿财务义务。

Query_Text_en: and [ e ] the current participation of the shipping line on the same route or routes within the framework of another conference .
Translation: 以及 [e] 该航运公司在同一路线或相关路线的其他班轮公会框架下的现有参与情况。

Query_Text_en: The above criteria shall not be applied so as to subvert the implementation of the provisions relating to participation in trade set out in Article 2 .
Translation: 上述标准不得用于破坏第二条中关于参与贸易的相关规定的实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] An application for admission or readmission to membership shall be promptly decided upon and the decision communicated by a conference to an applicant promptly , and in no case later than six months from the date of application .
Translation: 对加入或重新加入成员资格的申请，应由大会及时作出决定，并将决定及时通知申请方，且无论如何不得迟于申请之日起六个月。

Query_Text_en: When a shipping line is refused admission or readmission the conference shall , at the same time , give in writing the grounds for such refusal .
Translation: 当航运公司被拒绝加入或重新加入时，会议应同时以书面形式说明拒绝的理由。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] When considering applications for admission , a conference shall take into account the views put forward by shippers and shippers ' organizations of the countries whose trade is carried by the conference , as well as the views of appropriate authorities if they so request .
Translation: 在审议入会申请时，班轮公会应充分考虑承运贸易国家的货主及货主组织所提出的意见，并在相关主管部门提出要求时，听取其意见。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] In addition to the criteria for admission set out in Article 1 [ 2 ] , a shipping line applying for readmission shall also give evidence of having fulfilled its obligations in accordance with Article 4 [ 1 ] and [ 4 ] .
Translation: 除第一条第二款规定的准入标准外，申请重新准入的航运公司还须提供其已按照第四条第一款和第四款履行义务的相关证明。

Query_Text_en: The conference may give special scrutiny to the circumstances under which the line left the conference .
Translation: 会议可能会特别审查该线路离开会议的具体情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Participation in trade [ 1 ] Any shipping line admitted to membership of a conference shall have sailing and loading rights in the trades covered by that conference .
Translation:
第二条 参与贸易

[1] 任何被接纳为班轮公会成员的航运公司，均有权在该公会所涵盖的贸易航线上进行航行和装载业务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] When a conference operates a pool , all shipping lines members of the conference serving the trade covered by the pool shall have the right to participate in the pool for that trade .
Translation: 当一个航运联盟运营运力池时，联盟内所有服务该贸易航线的船公司成员均有权参与该航线的运力池。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] For the purpose of determining the share of trade which member lines shall have the right to acquire , the national shipping lines of each country , irrespective of the number of lines , shall be regarded as a single group of shipping lines for that country .
Translation: 为确定各成员航运公司有权获得的贸易份额时，每一国家的国家航运公司，无论其数量多少，均应视为该国的一个航运公司集团。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Third-country shipping lines , if any , shall have the right to acquire a significant part , such as twenty per cent , in the freight and volume of traffic generated by that trade .
Translation: 如有第三国航运公司，应有权获得该贸易所产生货运量和运输量的重要份额，例如20%。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] If , for any one of the countries whose trade is carried by a conference , there are no national shipping lines participating in the carriage of that trade , the share of the trade to which national shipping lines of that country would be entitled under Article 2 [ 4 ] shall be distributed among the individual member lines participating in the trade in proportion to their respective shares .
Translation: 如果某一由班轮公会承运贸易的国家没有本国的航运公司参与该贸易运输，则该国航运公司根据第2条[4]本应享有的贸易份额，应按各成员公司在该贸易中所占份额，分配给参与该贸易的各成员公司。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] If the national shipping lines of one country decide not to carry their full share of the trade , that portion of their share of the trade which they do not carry shall be distributed among the individual member lines participating in the trade in proportion to their respective shares .
Translation: 如果一国的国家航运公司决定不承运其应承担的全部贸易份额，则其未承运的那部分份额应按各成员航运公司在该贸易中所占的比例，分配给参与该贸易的其他成员航运公司。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] If the national shipping lines of the countries concerned do not participate in the trade between those countries covered by a conference , the shares of trade carried by the conference between those countries shall be allocated between the participating member lines of third countries by commercial negotiations between those lines .
Translation: 如果有关国家的国家航运公司未参与由班轮公会涵盖的这些国家之间的贸易，则这些国家之间由班轮公会承运的贸易份额应通过参与的第三国成员航运公司之间的商业谈判进行分配。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] The national shipping lines of a region , members of a conference , at one end of the trade covered by the conference , may redistribute among themselves by mutual agreement the shares in trades allocated to them , in accordance with Article 2 [ 4 ] to [ 7 ] inclusive .
Translation: 该地区的国家航运公司作为会议成员，在会议所涵盖贸易的一端，可以根据第2条第[4]至第[7]款的规定，通过相互协商，将分配给它们的贸易份额重新分配。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] Subject to the provisions of Article 2 [ 4 ] to [ 8 ] inclusive regarding shares of trade among individual shipping lines or groups of shipping lines , pooling or trade-sharing agreements shall be reviewed by the conference periodically , at intervals to be stipulated in those agreements and in accordance with criteria to be specified in the conference agreement .
Translation: 在遵守第2条第[4]至[8]款关于各航运公司或航运公司集团之间市场份额的规定前提下，联合经营或市场份额分配协议应由会议定期审查，审查间隔由相关协议规定，并按照会议协议中明确的标准进行。

Query_Text_en: [ 10 ] The application of the present Article shall commence as soon as possible after entry into force of the present Convention and shall be completed within a transition period which in no case shall be longer than two years , taking into account the specific situation in each of the trades concerned .
Translation: 本条的适用应在本公约生效后尽快开始，并应在不超过两年的过渡期内完成，同时应考虑各相关行业的具体情况。

Query_Text_en: [ 11 ] Shipping lines members of a conference shall be entitled to operate chartered ships to fulfil their conference obligations .
Translation: 班轮公会成员航运公司有权运营租赁船舶以履行其公会义务。

Query_Text_en: [ 12 ] The criteria for sharing and the revision of shares as set out in Article 2 [ 1 ] to [ 11 ] inclusive shall apply when , in the absence of a pool , there exists berthing , sailing and\/or any other form of cargo allocation agreement .
Translation: 第2条第[1]至第[11]款所规定的分配标准和份额调整，应适用于在没有联合经营的情况下，存在泊位、航行和/或任何其他形式的货物分配协议的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ 13 ] Where no pooling , berthing , sailing or other trade participation agreements exist in a conference , either group of national shipping lines , members of the conference , may require that pooling arrangements be introduced , in respect of the trade between their countries carried by the conference , in conformity with the provisions of Article 2 [ 4 ] ; or alternatively they may require that the sailings be so adjusted as to provide an opportunity to these lines to enjoy substantially the same rights to participate in the trade between those two countries carried by the conference as they would have enjoyed under the provisions of Article 2 [ 4 ] .
Translation: 在班轮公会中，如不存在运力共用、泊位安排、航班调整或其他贸易参与协议，任何一方国家的班轮公司成员均可要求在两国间由公会承运的贸易中，依据第2条第4款的规定，引入运力共用安排；或者，亦可要求调整航班，以使该方班轮公司能够在两国间由公会承运的贸易中，享有与依据第2条第4款规定应享有的实质上相同的参与权利。

Query_Text_en: Any such request shall be considered and decided by the conference .
Translation: 任何此类请求应由大会审议并作出决定。

Query_Text_en: If there is no agreement to institute such a pool or adjustment of sailings among the members of the conference , the groups of national shipping lines of the countries at both ends of the trade shall have a majority vote in deciding to establish such a pool or adjustment of sailings .
Translation: 如果会议成员之间未就设立此类运力共用机制或调整航班达成一致，则由贸易双方国家的国家航运公司集团以多数票决定是否设立该运力共用机制或调整航班。

Query_Text_en: The matter shall be decided upon within a period not exceeding six months from the receipt of the request .
Translation: 该事项应在收到请求之日起六个月内作出决定。

Query_Text_en: [ 14 ] In the event of a disagreement between the national shipping lines of the countries at either end whose trade is served by the conference with regard to whether or not pooling shall be introduced , they may require that within the conference , sailings be so adjusted as to provide an opportunity to these lines to enjoy substantially the same rights to participate in the trade between those two countries carried by the conference as they would have enjoyed under the provisions of Article 2 [ 4 ] .
Translation: [14] 如果会议所服务的两国国家航运公司在是否引入运力联合方面存在分歧，他们可以要求会议内部调整航次安排，使这些航运公司能够在会议所承运的两国贸易中，享有与《第2条[4]》规定下基本相同的参与权利。

Query_Text_en: In the event that there are no national shipping lines in one of the countries whose trade is served by the conference , the national shipping line or lines of the other country may make the same request .
Translation: 如果某一贸易涉及的国家没有国家航运公司，则另一国家的国家航运公司可以提出同样的请求。

Query_Text_en: The conference shall use its best endeavors to meet this request .
Translation: 大会应尽最大努力满足该项请求。

Query_Text_en: If , however , this request is not met , the appropriate authorities of the countries at both ends of the trade may take up the matter if they so wish and make their views known to the parties concerned for their consideration .
Translation: 然而，如果该请求未得到满足，贸易双方国家的相关主管部门可根据需要介入此事，并向有关各方表达意见，以供其参考。

Query_Text_en: If no agreement is reached , the dispute shall be dealt with in accordance with the procedures established in this Code .
Translation: 如未达成协议，争议应按照本规范所规定的程序处理。

Query_Text_en: [ 15 ] Other shipping lines , members of a conference , may also request that pooling or sailing agreements be introduced , and the request shall be considered by the conference in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Code .
Translation: [15] 其他作为班轮公会成员的航运公司也可以提出引入运力共享或航次安排协议的请求，该请求应由班轮公会根据本规则的相关规定进行审议。

Query_Text_en: [ 16 ] A conference shall provide for appropriate measures in any conference pooling agreement to cover cases where the cargo has been shut out by a member line for any reason excepting late presentation by the shipper .
Translation: [16] 任何班轮公会协议中，会议应规定适当措施，以应对除托运人迟交货物外，由成员航线因其他原因拒载货物的情况。

Query_Text_en: Such agreement shall provide that a vessel with unbooked space , capable of being used , be allowed to lift the cargo , even in excess of the pool share of the line in the trade , if otherwise the cargo would be shut out and delayed beyond a period set by the conference .
Translation: 该协议应规定，凡有可用未预订舱位的船舶，均可承运货物，即使超过该航线在该贸易中的配额份额，只要否则货物将被拒载并延误超过会议规定的期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 17 ] The provisions of Article 2 [ 1 ] to [ 16 ] inclusive concern all goods regardless of their origin , their destination or the use for which they are intended , with the exception of military equipment for national defense purposes .
Translation: 第2条第[1]至第[16]款的规定适用于所有货物，无论其来源、目的地或用途，唯用于国家防御的军事装备除外。

Query_Text_en: these procedures shall ensure that the voting rules do not hinder the proper work of the conference and the service of the trade and shall define the matters on which decisions will be made by unanimity .
Translation: 这些程序应确保表决规则不会妨碍会议的正常运作和贸易服务，并应明确规定哪些事项需以全体一致通过的方式作出决定。

Query_Text_en: However , a decision can not be taken in respect of matters defined in a conference agreement relating to the trade between two countries without the consent of the national shipping lines of those two countries .
Translation: 然而，涉及两国间贸易的会议协议中所规定事项，未经两国国家航运公司的同意，不能作出决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Sanctions [ 1 ] A shipping lines member of a conference shall be entitled , subject to the provisions regarding withdrawal which are embodied in pool schemes and\/or cargo-sharing arrangements , to secure its release , without penalty , from the terms of the conference agreement after giving three months ' notice , unless the conference agreement provides for a different time period , although it shall be required to fulfil its obligations as a member of the conference up to the date of its release .
Translation:
第四条 制裁
