Query_Text_en: ? 1 For the purposes of identifying the law applicable under this Convention where a State comprises two or more territorial units each of which has its own system of law or its own rules of law in respect of succession the provisions of this Article apply
Translation: 为根据本公约确定适用法律之目的，如果一国包括两个或两个以上各自拥有自己继承法律体系或继承法律规则的领土单位，则本条的规定适用。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 If there are rules in force in such a State identifying which law among the laws of the two or more units is to apply in any circumstance for which this Article provides the law of that unit applies In the absence of such rules the following paragraphs of this Article apply
Translation: 如果该国家现行的法律中有规定，能够确定在本条所述情形下应适用两个或多个单位中的哪一个单位的法律，则适用该规定。在没有此类规定的情况下，应适用本条下列各款的规定。

Query_Text_en: ? a the law of the State of the habitual residence of the deceased at the time of designation or of his death means the law of that unit of the State in which at the relevant time the deceased had his habitual residence ;
Translation: “某一国法律”是指在指定时或死亡时，死者惯常居住地所在国家的法律，即指在相关时间点，死者惯常居住地所在国家的该行政单位的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? b the law of the State of the nationality of the deceased at the time of designation or of his death means the law of that unit of the State in which at the relevant time the deceased had his habitual residence and in the absence of such an habitual residence the law of the unit with which he had his closest connection
Translation: “该国籍国法律”是指在指定时或死亡时，已故者经常居住地所在的该国单位的法律；如无经常居住地，则指与其有最密切联系的该国单位的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 For the purposes of any reference in this Convention the law of the State of closest connection means the law of that unit of the State with which the deceased was most closely connected
Translation: 在本公约中，凡提及“最密切联系国的法律”，均指与被继承人有最密切联系的该国某一单位的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 Subject to Article 6 for the purposes of any designation pursuant to this Convention whereby the deceased designates the law of a unit of the State of which at the time of designation or of his death
Translation: 受第6条的约束，为本公约项下的任何指定之目的，如果被继承人在指定时或死亡时指定其所属国家的某一单位的法律……

Query_Text_en: ? b he was not a national the designation is valid only if he then had his habitual residence in that unit or if he was not then habitually resident in that unit but was so resident in that State he had had an habitual residence in that unit at some time
Translation: ？b 如果他当时不是该国国民，则该指定仅在他当时在该地区有惯常居所，或者他当时虽未在该地区有惯常居所但在该国有惯常居所，并且他曾在该地区有过惯常居所的情况下有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 For the purposes of any designation under Article 6 with regard to particular assets whereby the deceased designates the law of a State it is presumed that subject to evidence of contrary intent the designation means the law of each unit in which the assets are situated
Translation: ? 6 就根据第6条对特定资产进行指定而言，如果被继承人指定某一国家的法律，则在没有相反意图的证据情况下，推定该指定是指该资产所在地每一个单元的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 7 For the purposes of Article 3 paragraph 2 the required period of residence is attained when the deceased for the five years immediately preceding his death had his residence in that State notwithstanding that during that period he resided in more than one of the units of that State When the period has been attained and the deceased had an habitual residence in that State at that time but no habitual residence in any particular unit of that State the applicable law is the law of that unit in which the deceased last resided unless at that time he had a closer connection with another unit of the State in which case the law of the latter unit applies
Translation: 就第3条第2款而言，所需的居住期限在被继承人在其去世前的五年内一直居住在该国时即视为已满足，即使在此期间他曾居住于该国的多个地区。当该期限已满足且被继承人在去世时在该国有惯常居所，但在该国的任何特定地区没有惯常居所时，适用的法律为被继承人最后居住的地区的法律，除非当时他与该国的另一个地区有更密切的联系，在这种情况下，适用后者地区的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 For purposes of identifying the law applicable under this Convention where a State has two or more legal systems applicable to the succession of deceased persons for different categories of persons any reference to the law of such State shall be construed as referring to the legal system determined by the rules in force in that State In the absence of such rules the reference shall be construed as referring to the legal system with which the deceased had the closest connection
Translation: 第二十条 为了根据本公约确定适用法律，如果一国对不同类别的人员在继承事务中适用两个或以上法律体系，则对该国法律的任何引用应解释为指该国现行规则所确定的法律体系。若无此类规则，则该引用应解释为指与被继承人关系最密切的法律体系。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 A Contracting State in which different systems of law or sets of rules of law apply to succession shall not be bound to apply the rules of the Convention to conflicts solely between the laws of such different systems or sets of rules of law
Translation:
第二十一条  
在缔约国境内，如适用于继承的法律体系或法律规则存在差异，该缔约国无须将本公约的规定适用于仅涉及这些不同法律体系或法律规则之间的法律冲突。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention applies in a Contracting State to the succession of any person whose death occurs after the Convention has entered into force for that State
Translation: 本公约适用于缔约国中在本公约对该国生效后死亡的任何人的继承问题。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Where at a time prior to the entry into force of the Convention in that State the deceased has designated the law applicable to his succession that designation is to be considered valid there if it Complies with Article 5
Translation: 在该国《公约》生效之前，若被继承人已指定其继承适用的法律，只要该指定符合第5条的规定，则该指定应被视为有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Where at a time prior to the entry into force of the Convention in that State the parties to an agreement as to succession have designated the law applicable to that agreement that designation is to be considered valid there if it complies with Article 11
Translation: 3 在某一国家《公约》生效之前，如果继承协议的当事方已经指定了适用于该协议的法律，只要该指定符合第11条的规定，该指定应被视为在该国有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention does not affect any other international instrument to which Contracting States are or become Parties and which contains provisions on matters governed by this Convention unless a contrary declaration is made by the States Parties to such instrument
Translation: 本公约不影响缔约国已经或将来成为其缔约方的任何其他国际文书中所载有关本公约所规范事项的条款，除非该文书的缔约国作出相反声明。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Paragraph 1 of this Article also applies to uniform laws based on special ties of a regional or other nature between the States concerned
Translation: 本条第1款也适用于基于有关国家之间区域性或其他特殊联系的统一法律。

Query_Text_en: ? a that it will not apply the Convention to agreements as to succession as defined in Article 8 and therefore that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 if the designation is not expressed in a statement made in accordance with the requirements for a testamentary disposition ;
Translation: 它声明不会将本公约适用于第八条所定义的继承协议，因此，如果根据第五条作出的指定并非以符合遗嘱处分要求的声明形式表达，则不会予以承认。

Query_Text_en: ? b that it will not apply Article 4 ;
Translation: 它不会适用第4条；

Query_Text_en: ? c that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 by a person who at the time of his death was not or was no longer either a national of or habitually resident in the State whose law he had designated but at that time was a national of and habitually resident in the reserving State ;
Translation: 它声明，对于根据第5条所作的指定，如果该人在死亡时既不是、也不再是其所指定法律所属国家的国民或惯常居住者，而在该时是作出保留声明国家的国民并惯常居住于该国，则该国不承认该指定。

Query_Text_en: ? d that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 if all of the following conditions are met ? the law of the State making the reservation would have been the applicable law under Article 3 if there had been no valid designation made under Article 5 ? the application of the law designated under Article 5 would totally or very substantially deprive the spouse or a child of the deceased of an inheritance or family provision to which the spouse or child would have been entitled under the mandatory rules of the law of the State making this reservation ? that spouse or child is habitually resident in or a national of that State
Translation: 如果同时满足以下所有条件，该国声明其不承认根据第5条所作的指定：——如果没有根据第5条作出有效指定，根据第3条，该国的法律本应为适用法律；——适用第5条所指定的法律将完全或大幅度剥夺已故者的配偶或子女根据该国强制性法律本应享有的继承权或家庭供养权；——该配偶或子女通常居住在该国，或为该国国民。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 No other reservation shall be permitted
Translation: ? 2 不允许有其他保留意见。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Any Contracting State may at any time withdraw a reservation which it has made ;
Translation: 任何缔约国可随时撤回其所作的保留；

Query_Text_en: the reservation shall cease to have effect on the fast day of the month following the expiration of three months after notification of the withdrawal
Translation: 该保留将在撤回通知后三个月期满的下一个月的首日失效。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention shall be open for signature by the States which were Members of the Hague Conference on Private International Law at the time of its Sixteenth Session
Translation: 本公约应向在其第十六届会议时为海牙国际私法会议成员国的国家开放签署。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 It shall be ratified accepted or approved and the instruments of ratification acceptance or approval shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands depositary of the Convention
Translation: 2 它应当被批准、接受或认可，并且批准书、接受书或认可书应交存于荷兰王国外交部，作为本公约的保存机关。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Any other State may accede to the Convention after it has entered into force in accordance with Article 28 paragraph 1
Translation: 在本公约根据第28条第1款生效后，任何其他国家均可加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the depositary
Translation: 加入书的文书应交存于保存人

Query_Text_en: ? 1 If a State has two or more territorial units in which different systems of law are applicable in relation to matters dealt with in this Convention it may at the time of signature ratification acceptance approval or accession declare that this Convention shall extend to all of its territorial units or only to one or more of them and may alter this declaration by submitting another declaration at any time
Translation: 如果一国拥有两个或两个以上在本公约所涉事项上适用不同法律制度的领土单位，该国可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入时声明本公约适用于其所有领土单位，或仅适用于其中一个或多个领土单位，并可随时通过提交另一声明更改该声明。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Any such declaration shall be notified to the depositary and shall state expressly the territorial units to which the Convention applies
Translation: 任何此类声明应通知保存人，并应明确说明本公约适用的领土单位。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 If a State makes no declaration under this Article the Convention is to extend to all territorial units of that State
Translation: 如果一国未根据本条作出声明，本公约应适用于该国的所有领土单位。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the deposit of the third instrument of ratification acceptance or approval referred to in Article 25
Translation: 本公约应于根据第25条所述的第三份批准书、接受书或核准书交存后三个月期满后的第一个月的第一天生效。

Query_Text_en: ? a for each State ratifying accepting or approving it subsequently or acceding to it on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification acceptance approval or accession ;
Translation: 对于每一个随后批准、接受、认可或加入本公约的国家，自其交存批准书、接受书、认可书或加入书后三个月期满后的第一个月的第一天起对该国生效；

Query_Text_en: ? b for a territorial unit to which the Convention has been extended in conformity with Article 27 on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the notification referred to in that Article
Translation: 对于根据第27条的规定已将本公约适用于某一领土单位的情况，自该条所述通知后满三个月的下一个月的第一天起生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 After the entry into force of an instrument revising this Convention a State may only become Party to the Convention as revised
Translation: 第二十九条 修订本公约的文书生效后，任何国家只能作为修订后的公约缔约方加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 A State Party to this Convention may denounce it or only Chapter of the Convention by a notification in writing addressed to the depositary
Translation: 本公约的缔约国可以通过向保存人提交书面通知，声明退出本公约或仅退出本公约的某一章。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The denunciation takes effect on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the notification is received by the depositary Where a longer period for the denunciation to take effect is specified in the notification the denunciation takes effect upon the expiration of such longer period after the notification is received by the depositary
Translation: 2. 退约自保存人收到通知后三个月期满后的第一个月的第一天起生效。如果通知中规定了更长的退约生效期，则退约自保存人收到通知后该更长期限届满时生效。

Query_Text_en: ? e the denunciations referred to in Article 30 ? In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized thereto have signed this Convention ? Done at The Hague on the 1st day of August 1989 in the English and French languages both texts being equally authentic in a single copy which shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and of which a certified copy shall be sent through diplomatic channels to each of the States Members of the Hague Conference on Private International Law at the date of its Sixteenth Session
Translation: 第30条所提及的退约声明？为此，签署人经正式授权，已在本公约上签字。本公约于1989年8月1日在海牙以英文和法文两种文本签订，两种文本具有同等效力，正本一份，将存放于荷兰王国政府档案中，并通过外交途径向海牙国际私法会议第十六届会议时的所有成员国发送经认证的副本。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] To assist in the reconstruction and development of territories of members by facilitating the investment of capital for productive purposes , including the restoration of economies destroyed or disrupted by war , the reconversion of productive facilities to peacetime needs and the encouragement of the development of productive facilities and resources in less developed countries .
Translation: 协助成员国领土的重建与发展，通过促进资本投资于生产性用途，包括恢复因战争而被破坏或扰乱的经济、将生产设施转为和平时期需求，以及鼓励欠发达国家生产设施和资源的发展。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] To promote private foreign investment by means of guarantees or participations in loans and other investments made by private investors ;
Translation: [二] 通过为私人投资者的贷款及其他投资提供担保或参与，促进私人外资投资。

Query_Text_en: and when private capital is not available on reasonable terms , to supplement private investment by providing , on suitable conditions , finance for productive purposes out of its own capital , funds raised by it and its other resources .
Translation: 当私人资本无法以合理条件获得时，基金可在适当条件下，利用自身资本、筹集的资金及其他资源，为生产性用途提供融资，以补充私人投资。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] To promote the long-range balanced growth of international trade and the maintenance of equilibrium in balances of payments by encouraging international investment for the development of the productive resources of members , thereby assisting in raising productivity , the standard of living and conditions of labor in their territories .
Translation: [三] 通过鼓励国际投资以开发成员国的生产资源，促进国际贸易的长期均衡增长和国际收支的平衡，从而有助于提高生产力、生活水平和劳动条件。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] To arrange the loans made or guaranteed by it in relation to international loans through other channels so that the more useful and urgent projects , large and small alike , will be dealt with first .
Translation: [ iv ] 协调其发放或担保的贷款与其他渠道的国际贷款，使无论项目大小，能够优先处理那些更有益且更紧迫的项目。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] To conduct its operations with due regard to the effect of international investment on business conditions in the territories of members and , in the immediate postwar years , to assist in bringing about a smooth transition from a wartime to a peacetime economy .
Translation: [五] 在开展业务时，充分考虑国际投资对成员国地区商业环境的影响，并在战后初期协助实现从战时经济向和平时期经济的平稳过渡。

Query_Text_en: The Bank shall be guided in all its decisions by the purposes set forth above .
Translation: 银行在所有决策中应以上述宗旨为指导。

Query_Text_en: Article II Membership in and Capital of the BankSection 1 . Membership [ a ] The original members of the Bank shall be those members of the International Monetary Fund which accept membership in the Bank before the date specified in Article XI , Section 2 [ e ] .
Translation:
第二条 银行的成员资格与资本

第一节 成员资格

[a] 银行的创始成员应为在第十一条第二节[e]所规定日期之前，接受加入银行的国际货币基金组织成员。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 . Authorized Capital [ a ] The authorized capital stock of the Bank shall be $ 10,000,000,000 , in terms of United States dollars of the weight and fineness in effect on July 1 , 1944 .
Translation:
第二条 授权资本

[一] 本行的授权资本为100亿美元，按1944年7月1日时美国法定货币的重量和成色计算。

Query_Text_en: The capital stock shall be divided into 100,000 shares [ 1 ] having a par value of $ 100,000 each , which shall be available for subscription only by members .
Translation: 股本应分为100,000股，每股面值为100,000美元，仅限成员认购。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The capital stock may be increased when the Bank deems it advisable by a three-fourths majority of the total voting power .
Translation: [ b ] 银行认为有必要时，可通过总表决权四分之三多数决定增加资本金。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 . Subscription of Shares [ a ] Each member shall subscribe shares of the capital stock of the Bank .
Translation:
第3条 股份认购

[a] 各成员应认购本行的股本股份。

Query_Text_en: The minimum number of shares to be subscribed by the original members shall be those set forth in Schedule A.
Translation: 原始成员需认购的最低股份数应为附表A中所列数量。

Query_Text_en: The minimum number of shares to be subscribed by other members shall be determined by the Bank , which shall reserve a sufficient portion of its capital stock for subscription by such members .
Translation: 其他成员需认购的最低股份数由银行确定，银行将预留足够的资本股份供这些成员认购。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank shall prescribe rules laying down the conditions under which members may subscribe shares of the authorized capital stock of the Bank in addition to their minimum subscriptions .
Translation: 银行应制定规则，规定成员在最低认购额之外认购银行授权股本股份的条件。

Query_Text_en: 1 . As of April 27 , 1988 , the authorized capital stock of the Bank had been increased to 1,420,500 shares . [ c ] If the authorized capital stock of the Bank is increased , each member shall have a reasonable opportunity to subscribe , under such conditions as the Bank shall decide , a proportion of the increase of stock equivalent to the proportion which its stock theretofore subscribed bears to the total capital stock of the Bank , but no member shall be obligated to subscribe any part of the increased capital .
Translation: 截至1988年4月27日，银行的授权股本已增至1,420,500股。[c] 如银行增加授权股本，每一成员均应有合理机会，按照银行决定的条件，认购与其先前所认购股份占银行总股本比例相当的新增股份，但任何成员均无义务认购新增资本的任何部分。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 . Issue Price of SharesShares included in the minimum subscriptions of original members shall be issued at par .
Translation:
第四条 股份发行价格  
原始成员最低认购份额内的股份应按面值发行。

Query_Text_en: Other shares shall be issued at par unless the Bank by a majority of the total voting power decides in special circumstances to issue them on other terms .
Translation: 除非银行凭借总表决权的多数决定在特殊情况下以其他条件发行，否则其他股份应按面值发行。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the remaining eighty percent shall be subject to call by the Bank only when required to meet obligations of the Bank created under Article IV , Sections 1 [ a ] [ ii ] and [ iii ] .
Translation: [ ii ] 剩余的百分之八十仅在银行根据第四条第一节第[ a ]项第[ii]和第[iii]款所产生的义务需要时，方可由银行要求缴纳。

Query_Text_en: Calls on unpaid subscriptions shall be uniform on all shares .
Translation: 对未缴股款的催缴应适用于所有股份，且方式一致。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 . Limitation on LiabilityLiability on shares shall be limited to the unpaid portion of the issue price of the shares .
Translation:
第六条 责任限制  
股东对股份的责任仅限于尚未缴付的发行价款部分。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] when a member makes payments in any currency under [ i ] and [ ii ] above , such payments shall be made in amounts equal in value to the member 's liability under the call .
Translation: [ iii ] 当成员根据上述 [ i ] 和 [ ii ] 以任何货币进行支付时，支付金额应与该成员根据缴款要求所承担的责任等值。

Query_Text_en: This liability shall be a proportionate part of the subscribed capital stock of the Bank as authorized and defined in Section 2 of this Article .
Translation: 该项责任应按本条第2款授权并界定的本行认缴股本的比例承担。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] an original member who can not make such a payment because it has not recovered possession of its gold reserves which are still seized or immobilized as a result of the war may postpone an payment until such date as the Bank shall decide .
Translation: [ ii ] 原始成员国因其黄金储备因战争原因仍被扣押或冻结，无法进行此项支付的，可以将支付延期至银行决定的日期。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] not more than five percent of the price of the share shall be called in any period of three months .
Translation: [ ii ] 在任何连续三个月期间，所收取的股份价格不得超过该股份价格的百分之五。

Query_Text_en: Section 9 . Maintenance of Value of Certain Currency Holdings of the Bank [ a ] Whenever [ i ] the par value of a member 's currency is reduced , or [ ii ] the foreign exchange value of a member 's currency has , in the opinion of the Bank , depreciated to a significant extent within that member 's territories , the member shall pay to the Bank within a reasonable time an additional amount of its own currency sufficient to maintain the value , as of the time of initial subscription , of the amount of the currency of such member which is held by the Bank and derived from currency originally paid in to the Bank by the member under Article II , Section 7 [ i ] , from currency referred to in Article IV , Section 2 [ b ] , or from any additional currency furnished under the provisions of the present paragraph , and which has not been repurchased by the member for gold or for the currency of any member which is acceptable to the Bank .
Translation:
第九条 银行持有特定货币的价值维护

[a] 每当出现以下情况之一：[i] 成员国货币的平价被降低，或[ii] 银行认为成员国货币在该成员国境内的外汇价值已显著贬值时，该成员国应在合理期限内向银行支付其本国货币的额外金额，以维持银行持有的该成员国货币价值（以初始认购时为准）。这些货币包括根据第二条第七款[i]由成员国最初缴纳给银行的货币、根据第四条第二款[b]提及的货币、或根据本段规定提供的任何额外货币，并且尚未被成员国以黄金或银行可接受的任何成员国货币回购。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Whenever the par value of a member 's currency is increased , the Bank shall return to such member within a reasonable time an amount of that member 's currency equal to the increase in the value of the amount of such currency described in [ a ] above .
Translation: [ b ] 每当成员国货币的平价上调时，银行应在合理期限内向该成员国返还相当于上述[a]所述货币金额增值部分的该成员国货币。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The provisions of the preceding paragraphs may be waived by the Bank when a uniform proportionate change in the par values of the currencies of all its members is made by the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 当国际货币基金组织对所有成员国货币的平价进行统一比例调整时，银行可豁免前述各款规定。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 . Restriction on Disposal of SharesShares shall not be pledged or encumbered in any manner whatever and they shall be transferable only to the Bank .
Translation:
第十条 股份处置限制  
股份不得以任何方式进行质押或设立任何权利负担，且仅可转让给银行。

Query_Text_en: ArticleIII General Provisions Relating to Loans and GuaranteesSection 1 . Use of Resources [ a ] The resources and the facilities of the Bank shall be used exclusively for the benefit of members with equitable consideration to projects for development and projects for reconstruction alike .
Translation:
第三条 贷款与担保的一般规定  
第一节 资源的使用  
[一] 银行的资源和设施应专用于成员国，并公平考虑发展项目和重建项目。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] For the purpose of facilitating the restoration and reconstruction of the economy of members whose metropolitan territories have suffered great devastation from enemy occupation or hostilities , the Bank , in determining the conditions and terms of loans made to such members , shall pay special regard to lightening the financial burden and expediting the completion of such restoration and reconstruction .
Translation: 为促进那些因敌军占领或战争而导致本土遭受严重破坏的成员国经济的恢复与重建，银行在确定向这些成员国提供贷款的条件和条款时，应特别关注减轻其财政负担，并加快恢复与重建工作的完成。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 . Dealings between Members and the BankEach member shall deal with the Bank only through its Treasury , central bank , stabilization fund or other similar fiscal agency , and the Bank shall deal with members only by or through the same agencies .
Translation:
第二条 会员与银行之间的往来  
每一会员国只能通过其财政部、中央银行、稳定基金或其他类似的财政机构与银行进行往来，银行也只能通过上述机构与会员国进行往来。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 . Limitations on Guarantees and Borrowings of the BankThe total amount outstanding of guarantees , participations in loans and direct loans made by the Bank shall not be increased at any time , if by such increase the total would exceed one hundred percent of the unimpaired subscribed capital , reserves and surplus of the Bank .
Translation:
第三条 银行担保与借款的限制

银行所提供的担保、参与贷款及直接贷款的未偿还总额，在任何时候均不得因新增而使总额超过银行未受损的实缴资本、储备及盈余的总和的百分之一百。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] When the member in whose territories the project is located is not itself the borrower , the member or the central bank or some comparable agency of the member which is acceptable to the Bank , fully guarantees the repayment of the principal and the payment of interest and other charges on the loan .
Translation: 当项目所在成员国本身并非借款方时，该成员国或其中央银行，或经银行认可的其他类似机构，须对贷款本金的偿还以及利息和其他费用的支付提供全额担保。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The Bank is satisfied that in the prevailing market conditions the borrower would be unable otherwise to obtain the loan under conditions which in the opinion of the Bank are reasonable for the borrower .
Translation: [ ii ] 银行确信，在当前市场条件下，借款人无法以银行认为对其合理的条件获得该贷款。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] A competent committee , as provided for in Article V , Section 7 , has submitted a written report recommending the project after a careful study of the merits of the proposal .
Translation: 根据第五条第七款的规定，相关委员会经过对该提案的优点进行认真研究后，提交了书面报告，建议批准该项目。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] In the opinion of the Bank the rate of interest and other charges are reasonable and such rate , charges and the schedule for repayment of principal are appropriate to the project .
Translation: [ iv ] 银行认为，利率及其他费用是合理的，且该利率、费用以及本金偿还计划均适用于该项目。

Query_Text_en: and the Bank shall act prudently in the interests both of the particular member in whose territories the project is located and of the members as a whole .
Translation: 银行应以审慎态度行事，既要维护项目所在成员国的利益，也要兼顾全体成员的共同利益。

Query_Text_en: [ vi ] In guaranteeing a loan made by other investors , the Bank receives suitable compensation for its risk .
Translation: 在为其他投资者提供贷款担保时，银行会因承担风险获得相应的补偿。

Query_Text_en: [ vii ] Loans made or guaranteed by the Bank shall , except in special circumstances , be for the purpose of specific projects of reconstruction or development .
Translation: [七] 除特殊情况外，银行发放或担保的贷款应专门用于特定的重建或发展项目。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 . Use of Loans Guaranteed , Participated in or Made by the Bank [ a ] The Bank shall impose no conditions that the proceeds of a loan shall be spent in the territories of any particular member or members .
Translation:
第五节 银行担保、参与或发放贷款的使用  
[一] 银行不得附加任何条件，要求贷款所得必须在任何特定成员或成员国境内使用。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank shall make arrangements to ensure that the proceeds of any loan are used only for the purposes for which the loan was granted , with due attention to considerations of economy and efficiency and without regard to political or other non-economic influences or considerations .
Translation: 银行应作出安排，确保任何贷款的资金仅用于贷款批准时所规定的用途，并充分考虑经济性和效率，不受政治或其他非经济因素的影响。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] In the case of loans made by the Bank , it shall open an account in the name of the borrower and the amount of the loan shall be credited to this account in the currency or currencies in which the loan is made .
Translation: [ c ] 对于银行发放的贷款，银行应以借款人的名义开立账户，并将贷款金额以贷款所用货币记入该账户。

Query_Text_en: The borrower shall be permitted by the Bank to draw on this account only to meet expenses in connection with the project as they are actually incurred .
Translation: 借款人仅可在银行的许可下，从该账户提取资金用于支付与项目实际发生的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 . Loans to the International Finance Corporation [ 1 ] [ a ] The Bank may make , participate in , or guarantee loans to the International Finance Corporation , an affiliate of the Bank , for use in its lending operations .
Translation:
第六节 国际金融公司贷款

[1][a] 银行可以向国际金融公司——银行的关联机构——提供贷款、参与贷款或为其贷款提供担保，用于其贷款业务。

Query_Text_en: The total amount outstanding of such loans , participations and guarantees shall not be increased if , at the time or as a result thereof , the aggregate amount of debt [ including the guarantee of any debt ] incurred by the said Corporation from any source and then outstanding shall exceed an amount equal to four times its unimpaired subscribed capital and surplus .
Translation: 在任何情况下，如因该等贷款、参股及担保的总未偿还金额增加，导致或在增加时，该公司从任何来源所负的全部债务（包括对任何债务的担保）总额超过其未受损的实缴资本及盈余总额的四倍，则不得增加上述贷款、参股及担保的总未偿还金额。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The provisions of Article III , Sections 4 and 5 [ c ] and of Article IV , Section 3 shall not apply to loans , participations and guarantees authorized by this Section .
Translation: 本条授权的贷款、参股和担保，不适用第三条第4款和第5款以及第四条第3款的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] By making or participating in direct loans out of its own funds corresponding to its unimpaired paid-up capital and surplus and , subject to Section 6 of this Article , to its reserves . 2 . Section added by amendment effective December 17 , 1965 .
Translation:
[一] 通过以自有资金发放或参与直接贷款，金额不超过其未受损的实缴资本和盈余，并在本条第六款规定的前提下，不超过其储备金。  
2. 本条款由1965年12月17日生效的修正案新增。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] By making or participating in direct loans out of funds raised in the market of a member , or otherwise borrowed by the Bank .
Translation: [ ii ] 通过利用在成员国市场筹集的资金，或银行以其他方式借入的资金，进行直接贷款或参与直接贷款。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] By guaranteeing in whole or in part loans made by private investors through the usual investment channels .
Translation: （三）通过常规投资渠道，对私人投资者发放的贷款提供全部或部分担保。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may borrow funds under [ a ] [ ii ] above or guarantee loans under [ a ] [ iii ] above only with the approval of the member in whose markets the funds are raised and the member in whose currency the loan is denominated , and only if those members agree that the proceeds may be exchanged for the currency of any other member without restriction .
Translation: 银行仅可在获得相关成员国同意的情况下，按照上述 [a][ii] 条款借入资金或按照上述 [a][iii] 条款为贷款提供担保。具体而言，须经资金筹集市场所在成员国及贷款计价货币所属成员国的批准，并且仅在上述成员国同意贷款所得可不受限制地兑换为任何其他成员国货币的前提下，方可进行相关操作。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 . Availability and Transferability of Currencies [ a ] Currencies paid into the Bank under Article II , Section 7 [ i ] , shall be loaned only with the approval in each case of the member whose currency is involved ;
Translation:
第二节 货币的可用性与可转让性

[一] 根据第二条第七款（一）项支付给银行的货币，只有在相关成员国同意的情况下，方可贷出。

Query_Text_en: provided , however , that if necessary , after the Bank 's subscribed capital has been entirely called , such currencies shall , without restriction by the members whose currencies are offered , be used or exchanged for the currencies required to meet contractual payments of interest , other charges or amortization on the Bank 's own borrowings , or to meet the Bank 's liabilities with respect to such contractual payments on loans guaranteed by the Bank .
Translation: 但前提是，如有必要，在银行认缴资本全部被要求缴纳后，这些货币应在不受提供货币成员限制的情况下，用于或兑换为银行履行自身借款合同项下利息、其他费用或偿还款项所需的货币，或用于银行履行对其担保贷款合同项下相关付款责任所需的货币。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Currencies received by the Bank from borrowers or guarantors in payment on account of principal of direct loans made with currencies referred to in [ a ] above shall be exchanged for the currencies of other members or reloaned only with the approval in each case of the members whose currencies are involved ;
Translation: [ b ] 银行从借款人或担保人处收到的、用于偿还上述[a]项所指货币直接贷款本金的货币，只有在相关成员国分别同意的情况下，方可兑换为其他成员国货币或再次发放贷款。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Currencies received by the Bank from borrowers or guarantors in payment on account of principal of direct loans made by the Bank under Section 1 [ a ] [ ii ] of this Article , shall be held and used , without restriction by the members , to make amortization payments , or to anticipate payment of or repurchase part or all of the Bank 's own obligations .
Translation: 银行从借款人或担保人处收到的、用于偿还根据本条第1[a][ii]项直接贷款本金的货币，应由银行持有和使用，成员国不得对其加以限制，可用于偿还贷款、提前支付或回购银行自身部分或全部债务。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] All other currencies available to the Bank , including those raised in the market or otherwise borrowed under Section 1 [ a ] [ ii ] of this Article , those obtained by the sale of gold , those received as payments of interest and other charges for direct loans made under Sections 1 [ a ] [ i ] and [ ii ] , and those received as payments of commissions and other charges under Section 1 [ a ] [ iii ] , shall be used or exchanged for other currencies or gold required in the operations of the Bank without restriction by the members whose currencies are offered .
Translation: [ d ] 银行可支配的所有其他货币，包括根据本条第1[a][ii]项通过市场筹集或以其他方式借入的货币、通过出售黄金获得的货币、根据第1[a][i]和[ii]项直接贷款所收到的利息及其他费用，以及根据第1[a][iii]项收到的佣金及其他费用，均应在银行业务所需时用于或兑换为其他货币或黄金，且不受提供货币成员的任何限制。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Currencies raised in the markets of members by borrowers on loans guaranteed by the Bank under Section1 [ a ] [ iii ] of this Article , shall also be used or exchanged for other currencies without restriction by such members .
Translation: 由银行根据本条第1[a][iii]项提供担保，借款人在成员国市场筹集的货币，也应由该成员国自由用于或兑换其他货币，不受任何限制。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The Bank shall furnish the borrower with such currencies of members , other than the member in whose territories the project is located , as are needed by the borrower for expenditures to be made in the territories of such other members to carry out the purposes of the loan .
Translation: [ a ] 银行应向借款方提供除项目所在成员国以外的其他成员国货币，以满足借款方在这些成员国境内为实现贷款目的所需的支出。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may , in exceptional circumstances when local currency required for the purposes of the loan can not be raised by the borrower on reasonable terms , provide the borrower as part of the loan with an appropriate amount of that currency .
Translation: [ b ] 在借款人无法以合理条件筹集到用于贷款目的的本地货币的特殊情况下，银行可作为贷款的一部分，向借款人提供适当数量的该种货币。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The Bank , if the project gives rise indirectly to an increased need for foreign exchange by the member in whose territories the project is located , may in exceptional circumstances provide the borrower as part of the loan with an appropriate amount of gold or foreign exchange not in excess of the borrower 's local expenditure in connection with the purposes of the loan .
Translation: [ c ] 如果项目间接导致该项目所在成员国对外汇需求的增加，银行可在特殊情况下向借款人提供适当数量的黄金或外汇，作为贷款的一部分，但不得超过借款人因贷款用途所产生的本地支出。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The Bank may , in exceptional circumstances , at the request of a member in whose territories a portion of the loan is spent , repurchase with gold or foreign exchange a part of that member 's currency thus spent but in no case shall the part so repurchased exceed the amount by which the expenditure of the loan in those territories gives rise to an increased need for foreign exchange .
Translation: [ d ] 银行可在特殊情况下，应贷款部分资金支出所在成员国的请求，用黄金或外汇回购该成员国因贷款支出而流通的部分本币，但回购金额不得超过该贷款在该成员国境内支出所引致的外汇需求增加额。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The terms and conditions of interest and amortization payments , maturity and dates of payment of each loan shall be determined by the Bank .
Translation: 每笔贷款的利息及摊销支付条款、到期日和付款日期均由银行确定。

Query_Text_en: The Bank shall also determine the rate and any other terms and conditions of commission to be charged in connection with such loan . In the case of loans made under Section 1 [ a ] [ ii ] of this Article during the first ten years of the Bank 's operations , this rate of commission shall be not less than one percent per annum and not greater than one and one-half percent per annum , and shall be charged on the outstanding portion of any such loan .
Translation: 银行还应确定与该贷款相关的佣金费率及其他任何条款和条件。对于根据本条第1(a)[ii]款在银行运营的最初十年内发放的贷款，该佣金费率不得低于年利率1%，且不得高于年利率1.5%，并应按该贷款未偿还部分计收。

Query_Text_en: At the end of this period of ten years , the rate of commission may be reduced by the Bank with respect both to the outstanding portions of loans already made and to future loans , if the reserves accumulated by the Bank under Section 6 of this Article and out of other earnings are considered by it sufficient to justify a reduction .
Translation: 在本条第六款规定的储备金及其他收益所积累的储备被银行认为足以支持降低费率时，十年期满后，银行可对已发放贷款的未偿部分及未来贷款的佣金率予以下调。

Query_Text_en: In the case of future loans the Bank shall also have discretion to increase the rate of commission beyond the above limit , if experience indicates that an increase is advisable .
Translation: 对于今后的贷款，如经实际情况表明有必要提高，银行亦有权酌情将佣金率提高至上述限额之上。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] All loan contracts shall stipulate the currency or currencies in which payments under the contract shall be made to the Bank .
Translation: 所有贷款合同应规定根据合同向银行支付款项所使用的货币。

Query_Text_en: At the option of the borrowers however , such payments may be made in gold , or subject to the agreement of the Bank , in the currency of a member other than that prescribed in the contract .
Translation: 不过，借款方可以选择以黄金支付，或者在银行同意的情况下，以合同规定之外的其他成员国货币支付。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] In the case of loans made under Section 1 [ a ] [ i ] of this Article , the loan contracts shall provide that payments to the Bank of interest , other charges and amortization shall be made in the currency loaned , unless the member whose currency is loaned agrees that such payments shall be made in some other specified currency or currencies .
Translation: 在根据本条第1款[a][i]项发放的贷款中，贷款合同应规定，向银行支付的利息、其他费用及还本应以所贷款币种支付，除非被贷款成员同意以其他指定货币支付。

Query_Text_en: These payments , subject to the provisions of Article II , Section 9 [ c ] , shall be equivalent to the value of such contractual payments at the time the loans were made , in terms of a currency specified for the purpose by the Bank by a three-fourths majority of the total voting power .
Translation: 这些付款，须遵守第二条第九节 [c] 的规定，应当等同于贷款发放时此类合同付款的价值，并以银行通过总投票权四分之三多数指定的货币计价。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] In the case of loans made under Section 1 [ a ] [ ii ] of this Article , the total amount outstanding and payable to the Bank in any one currency shall at no time exceed the total amount of the outstanding borrowings made by the Bank under Section 1 [ a ] [ ii ] and payable in the same currency .
Translation: 在根据本条第1款[a][ii]项发放的贷款中，银行在任何时候以任何一种货币应收的未偿还贷款总额，不得超过银行根据本条第1款[a][ii]项以同一货币所借入的未偿还借款总额。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] If a member suffers from an acute exchange stringency , so that the service of any loan contracted by that member or guaranteed by it or by one of its agencies can not be provided in the stipulated manner , the member concerned may apply to the Bank for a relaxation of the conditions of payment .
Translation: 如果某一成员国遭遇严重的外汇紧张，导致其无法按规定方式履行由该成员国或其机构所承担或担保的任何贷款的偿付义务，该成员国可向银行申请放宽付款条件。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] The Bank may , in its discretion , make arrangements with the member concerned to accept service payments on the loan in the member 's currency for periods not to exceed three years upon appropriate terms regarding the use of such currency and the maintenance of its foreign exchange value ; and for the repurchase of such currency on appropriate terms .
Translation: 银行可自行决定与相关成员达成协议，在适当条件下接受该成员以其本国货币支付贷款服务款项，期限不超过三年，并就该货币的使用及其外汇价值的维持作出相应安排；同时就该货币的回购达成适当条款。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The Bank may modify the terms of amortization or extend the life of the loan , or both .
Translation: [ ii ] 银行可以修改还款条件，延长贷款期限，或同时采取这两项措施。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 . Guarantees [ a ] In guaranteeing a loan placed through the usual investment channels , the Bank shall charge a guarantee commission payable periodically on the amount of the loan outstanding at a rate determined by the Bank .
Translation:
第五条 担保

[一] 在通过常规投资渠道提供贷款担保时，银行应就未偿还贷款金额，按照银行确定的利率，定期收取担保手续费。

Query_Text_en: During the first ten years of the Bank 's operations , this rate shall be not less than one percent per annum and not greater than one and one-half percent per annum .
Translation: 在银行运营的最初十年内，该利率不得低于每年百分之一，也不得高于每年百分之一点五。

Query_Text_en: At the end of this period of ten years , the rate of commission may be reduced by the Bank with respect both to the outstanding portions of loans already guaranteed and to future loans if the reserves accumulated by the Bank under Section 6 of this Article and out of other earnings are considered by it sufficient to justify a reduction .
Translation: 在十年期满后，如果银行根据本条第六款及其他收益所积累的储备被认为足以支持降低佣金率，则银行可对已担保贷款的未偿部分及未来贷款的佣金率予以下调。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Guarantee commissions shall be paid directly to the Bank by the borrower .
Translation: [ b ] 保证佣金应由借款人直接支付给银行。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Guarantees by the Bank shall provide that the Bank may terminate its liability with respect to interest if , upon default by the borrower and by the guarantor , if any , the Bank offers to purchase , at par and interest accrued to a date designated in the offer , the bonds or other obligations guaranteed - [ d ] The Bank shall have power to determine any other terms and conditions of the guarantee .
Translation:
[ c ] 银行的担保应规定，若借款人及（如有）担保人违约，银行可通过提出以面值及至指定日期所累计利息购买所担保的债券或其他债务，从而终止其对利息的责任。

[ d ] 银行有权决定担保的其他任何条款和条件。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 . Special ReserveThe amount of commissions received by the Bank under Sections 4 and 5 of this Article shall be set aside as a special reserve , which shall be kept available for meeting liabilities of the Bank in accordance with Section 7 of this Article .
Translation:
第六条 特别准备金  
本行根据本条第四条和第五条所收取的佣金，应作为特别准备金提取，并应根据本条第七条的规定，随时用于清偿本行的相关负债。

Query_Text_en: The special reserve shall be held in such liquid form , permitted under this Agreement , as the Executive Directors may decide .
Translation: 特别储备应以本协定允许的、执行董事会决定的流动形式持有。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The Bank shall make such arrangements as may be feasible to adjust the obligations under the loans , including arrangements under or analogous to those provided in Section 4 [ c ] of this Article .
Translation: [ a ] 银行应在可行的情况下作出相应安排，以调整贷款项下的义务，包括根据本条第4[c]款规定的安排或类似安排。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] first , against the special reserve provided in Section 6 of this Article ;
Translation: 首先，从本条第六款规定的特别准备金中扣除；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] then , to the extent necessary and at the discretion of the Bank , against the other reserves , surplus and capital available to the Bank .
Translation: [ ii ] 然后，在必要范围内并由银行自行决定，从银行可用的其他储备、盈余和资本中予以抵扣。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Whenever necessary to meet contractual payments of interest , other charges or amortization on the Bank 's own borrowings , or to meet the Bank 's liabilities with respect to similar payments on loans guaranteed by it , the Bank may call an appropriate amount of the unpaid subscriptions of members in accordance with Article II , Sections 5 and 7 .
Translation: [ c ] 银行在需要支付自身借款的合同利息、其他费用或偿还本金，或履行对其担保贷款的类似付款义务时，可根据《第二条》第五和第七节的规定，向成员国征收适当金额的未缴认购款。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] To redeem prior to maturity , or otherwise discharge its liability on , all or part of the outstanding principal of any loan guaranteed by it in respect of which the debtor is in default .
Translation: 在债务人违约的情况下，提前赎回或以其他方式解除其对所担保贷款全部或部分未偿本金的责任。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] To repurchase , or otherwise discharge its liability on , all or part of its own outstanding borrowings .
Translation: [ ii ] 回购或以其他方式解除其对全部或部分自身未偿借款的责任。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] To buy and sell securities it has issued and to buy and sell securities which it has guaranteed or in which it has invested , provided that the Bank shall obtain the approval of the member in whose territories the securities are to be bought or sold .
Translation: [一] 购买和出售其所发行的证券，以及购买和出售其所担保或投资的证券，但前提是银行应获得相关成员国对在其境内买卖该等证券的批准。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] To guarantee securities in which it has invested for the purpose of facilitating their sale .
Translation: [ ii ] 为促进所投资证券的销售提供担保。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] To borrow the currency of any member with the approval of that member .
Translation: [三] 经成员批准，借用该成员的货币。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] To buy and sell such other securities as the Directors by a three-fourths majority of the total voting power may deem proper for the investment-of all or part of the special reserve under Section 6 of this Article .
Translation: [四] 经董事会总表决权四分之三多数同意，购买和出售董事认为适合用于本条第六节下专项储备全部或部分投资的其他证券。

Query_Text_en: In exercising the powers conferred by this Section , the Bank may deal with any person , partnership , association , corporation or other legal entity in the territories of any member .
Translation: 在行使本条赋予的权力时，银行可以与任何成员国境内的个人、合伙企业、协会、公司或其他法律实体进行交易。

Query_Text_en: Section 9 . Warning to be Placed on SecuritiesEvery security guaranteed or issued by the Bank shall bear on its face a conspicuous statement to the effect that it is not an obligation of any government unless expressly stated on the security .
Translation:
第九条  证券须载明警示

由本行担保或发行的每一项证券，其正面均须以醒目方式载明如下声明：除非证券上明确说明，否则该证券并非任何政府的债务。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 . Political Activity ProhibitedThe Bank and its officers shall not interfere in the political affairs of any member ; nor shall they be influenced in their decisions by the political character of the member or members concerned .
Translation:
第十条 禁止政治活动

银行及其工作人员不得干涉任何成员的政治事务；在决策过程中，也不得受有关成员的政治属性影响。

Query_Text_en: Only economic considerations shall be relevant to their decisions , and these considerations shall be weighed impartially in order to achieve the purposes stated in Article I.
Translation: 他们的决策只应考虑经济因素，并应公正权衡这些因素，以实现第一条所述的目标。

Query_Text_en: Article V Organization and ManagementSection 1 . Structure of the BankThe Bank shall have a Board of Governors , Executive Directors , a President and such other officers and staff to perform such duties as the Bank may determine .
Translation:
第五条 组织与管理

第一节 银行的组织结构

银行应设理事会、执行董事会、行长及其他必要的高级管理人员和工作人员，履行银行规定的各项职责。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 . Board of Governors [ a ] All the powers of the Bank shall be vested in the Board of Governors consisting of one governor and one alternate appointed by each member in such manner as it may determine .
Translation:
第二条 董事会

[a] 银行的所有权力均归董事会所有，董事会由每个成员按照其自行决定的方式各自任命的一名董事和一名副董事组成。

Query_Text_en: Each governor and each alternate shall serve for five years , subject to the pleasure of the member appointing him , and may be reappointed .
Translation: 每位理事及其候补理事的任期为五年，任命成员可随时撤换，并可连任。

Query_Text_en: The Board shall select one of the Governor-s as chairman .
Translation: 理事会应从理事中选举一人为主席。

Query_Text_en: [ vii ] Determine the distribution of the net income of the Bank .
Translation: [七] 决定银行净收入的分配。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The Board of Governors shall hold an annual meeting and such other meetings as may be provided for by the Board or called by the Executive Directors .
Translation: [ c ] 理事会应每年召开一次年会，并可根据理事会的规定或执行董事的召集召开其他会议。

Query_Text_en: Meetings of the Board shall be called by the Directors whenever requested by five members or by members having one quarter of the total voting power .
Translation: 董事会会议应由董事召集，在有五名成员或拥有四分之一总表决权的成员提出要求时召开。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Governors shall be a majority of the Governors , exercising not less than two-thirds of the total voting power .
Translation: [d] 董事会任何会议的法定人数为多数董事，并且其行使的表决权不得低于总表决权的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] The Board of Governors may by regulation establish a procedure whereby the Executive Directors , when they deem such action to be in the best interests of the Bank , may obtain a vote of the Governors on a specific question without calling a meeting of the Board .
Translation: [ e ] 董事会可通过规章制定程序，使执行董事在认为有利于银行最佳利益时，无需召开董事会会议，即可就特定事项征求理事的投票意见。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The Board of Governors , and the Executive Directors to the extent authorized , may adopt such rules and regulations as may be necessary or appropriate to conduct the business of the Bank .
Translation: 董事会及经授权的执行董事可制定为银行业务开展所必需或适当的规章制度。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] Governors and alternates shall serve as such without compensation from the Bank , but the Bank shall pay them reasonable expenses incurred in attending meetings .
Translation: [ g ] 行长及其副手在银行任职期间不从银行领取报酬，但银行应支付其因出席会议所产生的合理费用。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] The Board of Governors shall determine the remuneration to be paid to the Executive Directors and the salary and terms of the contract of service of the President .
Translation: [h] 董事会应决定执行董事的报酬，以及行长的薪资和服务合同条款。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 . Voting [ a ] Each member shall have two hundred fifty votes plus one additional vote for each share of stock held .
Translation:
第三条 投票权

[a] 每一成员应拥有250票，并且每持有一股股票，额外获得一票。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Except as otherwise specifically provided , all matters before the Bank shall be decided by a majority of the votes cast .
Translation: 除非另有明确规定，银行的一切事项均应以所投票数的多数决定。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 . Executive Directors [ a ] The Executive Directors shall be responsible for the conduct of the general operations of the Bank , and for this purpose , shall exercise all the powers delegated to them by the Board of Governors .
Translation:
第四条 执行董事

[一] 执行董事负责银行一般业务的管理，并为此行使理事会授予的一切权力。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] seven shall be elected according to Schedule B by all the Governors other than those appointed by the five members referred to in [ i ] above .
Translation: [ ii ] 七名成员应按照附表B，由除上述五名成员所任命的其他所有理事选举产生。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this paragraph , `` members '' means governments of countries whose names are set forth in Schedule A , whether they are original members or become members in accordance with Article 11 , Section I [ b ] .
Translation: 本段中，“成员”指的是附表A中列明的国家政府，无论其是创始成员，还是根据第11条第I节[b]项成为成员的国家。

Query_Text_en: When governments of other countries become members , the Board of Governors may , by a four-fifths majority of the total voting power , increase the total number of directors by increasing the number of directors to be elected .
Translation: 当其他国家的政府成为成员时，理事会可通过总表决权四分之三多数的同意，增加可选举董事的名额，从而增加董事总数。

Query_Text_en: Executive Directors shall be appointed or elected every two years .
Translation: 执行董事应每两年任命或选举一次。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Each executive director shall appoint an alternate with full power to act for him when he is not present .
Translation: 每位执行董事应指定一名全权代理其行使职权的替代人选，以便其不在场时代理其工作。

Query_Text_en: When the executive directors appointing them are present , alternates may participate in meetings but shall not vote .
Translation: 在任命他们的执行董事出席会议时，替补董事可以参与会议，但不得投票。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Directors shall continue in office until their successors are appointed or elected .
Translation: 董事在其继任者被任命或选举产生之前，将继续履行职务。

Query_Text_en: If the office of an elected director becomes vacant more than ninety days before the end of his term , another director shall be elected for the remainder of the term by the governors who elected the former director .
Translation: 如果某位民选董事的职位在其任期结束前九十天以上出现空缺，由选举该董事的理事在剩余任期内重新选举一名董事。

Query_Text_en: A majority of the votes cast shall be required for election .
Translation: 当选需获得投票总数的过半数。

Query_Text_en: While the office remains vacant , the alternate of the former director shall exercise his powers , except that of appointing an alternate .
Translation: 在该职位空缺期间，前任主任的替补人员应行使其职权，但不得行使任命替补人员的权力。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] The Executive Directors shall function in continuous session at the principal office of the Bank and shall meet as often as the business ofthe Bank may require .
Translation: 执行董事应在银行总部常设会议，并根据银行业务需要随时召开会议。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] A quorum for any meeting of the Executive Directors shall be a majority of the Directors , exercising not less than one-half of the total voting power .
Translation: [ f ] 执行董事会任何会议的法定人数为多数董事出席，且其所行使的表决权不少于全部表决权的二分之一。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] Each appointed director shall be entitled to cast the number of votes allotted under Section 3 of this Article to the member appointing him .
Translation: 每位被任命的董事均有权按照本条第3节规定，代表任命其的成员行使相应数量的投票权。

Query_Text_en: Each elected director shall be entitled to cast the number of votes which counted toward his election .
Translation: 每位当选董事有权投出其当选时所获得的票数。

Query_Text_en: All the votes which a director is entitled to cast shall be cast as a unit .
Translation: 董事有权投出的所有选票应作为一个整体投出。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] The Board of Governors shall adopt regulations under which a member not entitled to appoint a director under [ b ] above may send a representative to attend any meeting of the Executive Directors when a request made by , or a matter particularly affecting , that member is under consideration . [ i ] The Executive Directors may appoint such committees as they deem advisable .
Translation:
[h] 理事会应制定相关规定，允许未按上述[b]条款有权任命董事的成员，在其提出请求或涉及该成员的相关事项被审议时，派代表参加执行董事会议。

[i] 执行董事可根据需要设立他们认为合适的委员会。

Query_Text_en: Membership of such committees need not be limited to governors or directors or their alternates .
Translation: 此类委员会的成员不必仅限于理事、董事或其替代人员。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 . President and Staff [ a ] The Executive Directors shall select a President who shall not be a governor or an executive director or an alternate for either .
Translation:
第五条 总裁及工作人员

[a] 执行董事会应选举一名总裁，该总裁不得兼任理事、执行董事或其任何一方的候补人员。

Query_Text_en: The President shall be Chairman of the Executive Directors , but shall have no vote except a deciding vote in case of an equal division .
Translation: 行长应担任执行董事会主席，但除在表决结果出现平票时拥有决定票外，无表决权。

Query_Text_en: He may participate in meetings of the Board of Governors , but shall not vote at such meetings .
Translation: 他可以参加理事会的会议，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: The President shall cease to hold office when the Executive Directors so decide .
Translation: 当执行董事作出决定时，总裁即停止履行职务。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The President shall be chief of the operating staff of the Bank and shall conduct , under the direction of the Executive Directors , the ordinary business of the Bank . Subject to the general control of the Executive Directors , he shall be responsible for the organization , appointment and dismissal of the officers and staff .
Translation: [ b ] 行长是银行运营团队的负责人，在执行董事的指导下负责银行的日常业务。行长在执行董事的总体管控下，负责组织、任命和解聘银行的管理人员及员工。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The President , officers and staff of the Bank , in the discharge of their offices , owe their duty entirely to the Bank and to no other authority .
Translation: 银行的行长、管理人员及员工在履行职务时，完全以银行利益为依归，不受其他任何权威的指使。

Query_Text_en: Each member of the Bank shall respect the international character of this duty and shall refrain from all attempts to influence any of them in the discharge of their duties .
Translation: 银行的每一位成员都应尊重这一职责的国际性质，并避免以任何方式试图影响其他成员履行其职责。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] In appointing the officers and staff the President shall , subject to the paramount importance of securing the highest standards of efficiency and of technical competence , pay due regard to the importance of recruiting personnel on as wide a geographical basis as possible .
Translation: 在任命官员和工作人员时，主席应在确保最高效率和专业能力标准的前提下，充分重视尽可能广泛的地域招聘。

Query_Text_en: Section 6 . Advisory Council [ a ] There shall be an Advisory Council of not less than seven persons selected by the Board of Governors including representatives of banking , commercial , industrial , labor , and agricultural interests , and with as wide a national representation as possible .
Translation:
第六条 顾问委员会

[a] 顾问委员会由理事会选任不少于七人组成，其中应包括银行、商业、工业、劳工和农业等领域的代表，并尽可能广泛地体现全国各方面的代表性。

Query_Text_en: In those fields where specialized international organizations exist , the members of the Council representative of those fields shall be selected in agreement with such organizations .
Translation: 在设有专门国际组织的领域，理事会中代表该领域的成员应与相关组织协商后选定。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall advise the Bank on matters of general policy .
Translation: 理事会应就银行的总体政策问题提供咨询意见。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall meet annually and on such other occasions as the Bank may request .
Translation: 理事会应每年召开一次会议，并根据银行的要求在其他时间召开会议。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Councillors shall serve for two years and may be reappointed .
Translation: [ b ] 委员任期两年，可以连任。

Query_Text_en: They shall be paid their reasonable expenses incurred on behalf of the Bank .
Translation: 他们因代表银行所产生的合理费用应予以支付。

Query_Text_en: Section 7 . Loan CommitteesThe committees required to report on loans under Article III , Section 4 , shall be appointed by the Bank .
Translation:
第七节 贷款委员会  
根据第三条第四节规定需就贷款进行报告的委员会，应由银行任命。

Query_Text_en: Each such committee shall include an expert selected by the governor representing the member in whose territories the project is located and one or more members of the technical staff of the Bank .
Translation: 每个此类委员会应包括由行长选定、代表项目所在成员国的专家，以及一名或多名银行技术人员。

Query_Text_en: Section 8 . Relationship to Other International Organizations [ a ] The Bank , within the terms of this Agreement , shall cooperate with any general international organization and with public international organizations having specialized responsibilities in related fields .
Translation:
第八条 与其他国际组织的关系

[一] 本行应在本协定规定的范围内，与任何综合性国际组织以及在相关领域具有专门职责的公共国际组织开展合作。

Query_Text_en: Any arrangements for such cooperation which would involve a modification of any provision of this Agreement may be effected only after amendment to this Agreement under Article VIII .
Translation: 任何涉及修改本协议任何条款的此类合作安排，须根据第八条通过修订本协议后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] In making decisions on applications for loans or guarantees relating to matters directly within the competence of any international organization of the types specified in the preceding paragraph and participated in primarily by members of the Bank , the Bank shall give consideration to the views and recommendations of such organization .
Translation: 在对与前款所述类型的任何国际组织直接职权相关的贷款或担保申请作出决定时，银行应当考虑该组织的意见和建议，而该类国际组织主要由本行成员参与。

Query_Text_en: Section 9 . Location of Offices [ a ] The principal office of the Bank shall be located in the territory of the member holding the greatest number of shares .
Translation:
第九条 办公地点

[a] 银行的主要办事处应设在持有股份最多的成员国境内。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may establish agencies or branch offices in the territories of any member of the Bank .
Translation: 银行可以在任何成员国境内设立代理机构或分支机构。

Query_Text_en: Section 10 . Regional Offices and Councils [ a ] The Bank may establish regional offices and determine the location of , and the areas to be covered by , each regional office .
Translation:
第十条 地区办事处及理事会

[一] 银行可设立地区办事处，并决定每个办事处的设立地点及其所覆盖的区域。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each regional office shall be advised by a regional council representative of the entire area and selected in such manner as the Bank may decide .
Translation: 每个地区办事处应由一名代表整个地区的地区理事会成员提供咨询，该成员的选拔方式由银行自行决定。

Query_Text_en: Section 11 . Depositories [ a ] Each member shall designate its central bank as a depository for all the Bank 's holdings of its currency or , if it has no central bank , it shall designate such other institution as may be acceptable to the Bank .
Translation:
第十一条 存款机构  
[a] 每个成员应指定其中央银行作为本行持有其货币的存款机构；如无中央银行，则应指定其他经本行认可的机构。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may hold other assets , including gold , in depositories designated by the five members having the largest number of shares and in such other designated depositories as the Bank may select .
Translation: [ b ] 银行可在由持股数量最多的五个成员指定的保管机构，以及银行可能选择的其他指定保管机构中持有包括黄金在内的其他资产。

Query_Text_en: Initially , at least one-half of the gold holdings of the Bank shall be held in the depository designated by the member in whose territory the Bank has its principal office , and at least forty percent shall be held in the depositories designated by the remaining four members referred to above , each of such depositories to hold , initially , not less than the amount of gold paid on the shares of the member designating it .
Translation: 最初，银行至少一半的黄金储备应存放在由银行总部所在成员国指定的保管机构中，至少40%的黄金储备应存放在上述其他四个成员国指定的保管机构中，每个保管机构初始存放的黄金数量不得少于其指定成员国所缴纳股份的黄金金额。

Query_Text_en: However , all transfers of gold by the Bank shall be made with due regard to the costs of transport and anticipated requirements of the Bank .
Translation: 但是，银行进行黄金转移时，应充分考虑运输成本及银行的预期需求。

Query_Text_en: In an emergency the Executive Directors may transfer all or any part of the Bank 's gold holdings to any place where they can be adequately protected .
Translation: 在紧急情况下，执行董事可以将银行的全部或部分黄金储备转移到能够得到充分保护的地点。

Query_Text_en: Section 12 . Form of Holdings of CurrencyThe Bank shall accept from any member , in place of any part of the member 's currency , paid in to the Bank under Article 11 , Section 7 [ i ] , or to meet amortization payments on loans made with such currency , and not needed by the Bank in its operations , notes or similar obligations issued by the Government of the member or the depository designated by such member , which shall be non-negotiable , non-interest-bearing and payable at their par value on demand by credit to the account of the Bank in the designated depository .
Translation:
第十二节 货币持有形式

银行应接受任何成员以其政府或其指定存款机构发行的票据或类似债务，替代根据第十一条第七节[i]向银行缴纳的部分成员货币，或用于偿还以该货币发放贷款的分期付款，且该部分货币银行在业务中并不需要。上述票据或类似债务须为不可转让、无息，并应按面值随时支付，支付方式为将款项记入银行在指定存款机构的账户。

Query_Text_en: Section 13 . Publication of Reports and Provision of Information [ a ] The Bank shall publish an annual report containing an audited statement of its accounts and shall circulate to members at intervals of three months or less a summary statement of its financial position and a profit and loss statement showing the results of its operations .
Translation:
第十三条 报告的公布与信息的提供

[一] 银行应公布年度报告，其中包括经审计的财务报表，并应每三个月或更短时间向成员分发一份财务状况摘要及损益表，反映其经营成果。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may publish such other reports as it deems desirable to carry out its purposes .
Translation: [ b ] 银行可根据实现其宗旨的需要，发布其认为适当的其他报告。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Copies of all reports , statements and publications made under this section shall be distributed to members .
Translation: 根据本条款制作的所有报告、声明和出版物的副本应分发给各成员。

Query_Text_en: Section 14 . Allocation of Net Income [ a ] The Board of Governors shall determine annually what part of the Bank 's net income , after making provision for reserves , shall be allocated to surplus and what part , if any , shall be distributed .
Translation:
第十四条 净收入的分配

[一] 董事会应每年决定，在提取准备金后，银行净收入中应划入盈余的部分，以及（如有）应予分配的部分。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] If any part is distributed , up to two percent non-cumulative shall be paid , as a first charge against the distribution for any year , to each member on the basis of the average amount of the loans outstanding during the year made under Article IV , Section 1 [ a ] [ i ] , out of currency corresponding to its subscription .
Translation: [ b ] 如有分配，每位成员可按其在本年度根据第四条第一款[a][i]项发放贷款的平均未偿还金额，优先从与其认缴份额相对应的货币中获得不超过2%的非累计分配，该分配作为当年分配的首要扣除项。

Query_Text_en: If two percent is paid as a first charge , any balance remaining to be distributed shall be paid to all members in proportion to their shares .
Translation: 如果首先支付2%的费用，剩余待分配的余额应按各成员的股份比例进行分配。

Query_Text_en: Payments to each member shall be made in its own currency , or if that currency is not available in other currency acceptable to the member .
Translation: 对每个成员的付款应以其本国货币进行；如该货币无法提供，则可使用该成员接受的其他货币支付。

Query_Text_en: if such payments are made in currencies other than the member 's own currency , the transfer of the currency and its use by the receiving member after payment shall be without restriction by the members .
Translation: 如果此类付款是以成员本国货币以外的货币进行的，付款后该货币的转移及接收成员对其使用，不得受到成员的任何限制。

Query_Text_en: Article VI Withdrawal and Suspension of Membership : Suspension of OperationsSection 1 . Right of Members to WithdrawAny member may withdraw from the Bank at any time by transmitting a notice in writing to the Bank at its principal office .
Translation:
第六条 会员的退出与暂停：业务暂停

第一节 会员的退出权利

任何成员均可随时通过向银行总部提交书面通知的方式退出本行。

Query_Text_en: Withdrawal shall become effective on the date such notice is received .
Translation: 退出自收到该通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 . Suspension of MembershipIf a member fails to fulfill any of its obligations to the Bank , the Bank may suspend its membership by decision of a majority of the Governors , exercising a majority of the total voting power .
Translation:
第二条 会员资格的暂停

如有成员未能履行其对银行的任何义务，银行可由总裁多数决定，并行使多数总投票权，暂停该成员的资格。

Query_Text_en: The member so suspended shall automatically cease to be a member one year from the date of its suspension unless a decision is taken by the same majority to restore the member to good standing .
Translation: 被暂停的成员自暂停之日起一年后将自动失去成员资格，除非以相同多数决定恢复其良好身份。

Query_Text_en: While under suspension , a member shall not be entitled to exercise any rights under this Agreement , except the right of withdrawal , but shall remain subject to all obligations .
Translation: 在暂停期间，成员无权行使本协议项下的任何权利，除退出权外，但仍须履行所有义务。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 . Cessation of Membership in International Monetary FundAny member which ceases to be a member of the International Monetary Fund shall automatically cease after three months to be a member of the Bank unless the Bank by three-fourths of the total voting power has agreed to allow it to remain a member .
Translation:
第三条 终止国际货币基金组织成员资格  
任何成员如不再是国际货币基金组织的成员，除非经本行总表决权四分之三同意其继续为本行成员，否则在三个月后将自动丧失本行成员资格。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 . Settlement of Accounts with Governments Ceasing to be Members [ a ] When a government ceases to be a member , it shall remain liable for its direct obligations to the Bank and for its contingent liabilities to the Bank so long as any part of the loans or guarantees contracted before it ceased to be a member are outstanding ;
Translation:
第四节 与不再为成员的政府的结算

[一] 当一个政府不再是成员时，只要其在退出成员资格前所签订的贷款或担保尚未全部履行完毕，该政府仍须对其对银行的直接义务及或有负债承担责任。

Query_Text_en: but it shall cease to incur liabilities with respect to loans and guarantees entered into thereafter by the Bank and to share either in the income or the expenses of the Bank .
Translation: 但其将不再承担银行此后所签订的贷款和担保相关的任何责任，也不再参与银行的收入或支出。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] At the time a government ceases to be a member , the Bank shall arrange for the repurchase of its shares as a part of the settlement of accounts with such government in accordance with the provisions of [ c ] and [ d ] below .
Translation: 当一国政府不再是成员时，银行应根据下文 [c] 和 [d] 的规定，将其股份回购，作为与该政府结算账户的一部分。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose the repurchase price of the shares shall be the value shown by the books of the Bank on the day the government ceases to be a member .
Translation: 为此，股份的回购价格应为政府终止成员资格当日银行账面所示的价值。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Any amount due to the government for its shares shall be withheld so long as the government , its central bank or any of its agencies remains liable , as borrower or guarantor , to the Bank and such amount may , at the option of the Bank , be applied on any such liability as it matures .
Translation: [ i ] 只要政府、其中央银行或任何机构作为借款人或担保人对本行仍负有责任，政府应得的任何股份款项均应予以扣留，并可由本行选择，在相关责任到期时用于清偿该等责任。

Query_Text_en: No amount shall be withheld on account of the liability of the government resulting from its subscription for shares under Article H , Section 5 [ ii ] .
Translation: 政府因根据第H条第5节（ii）项认购股份所产生的任何责任，不得因此扣留任何款项。

Query_Text_en: In any event , no amount due to a member for its shares shall be paid until six months after the date upon which the government ceases to be a member .
Translation: 无论如何，任何应支付给成员的股份款项，均不得在政府不再是成员之日起六个月内支付。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Payments for shares may be made from time to time , upon their surrender by the government , to the extent by which the amount due as the repurchase price in [ b ] above exceeds the aggregate of liabilities on loans and guarantees in [ c ] [ i ] above until the former member has received the full repurchase price .
Translation: [ ii ] 股份的支付可由政府不时交回股份时进行，支付金额为上述 [ b ] 项回购价格应付金额超过上述 [ c ][ i ] 项贷款和担保总负债的部分，直至前成员收到全部回购价格为止。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Payments shall be made in the currency of the country receiving payment or at the option of the Bank in gold .
Translation: [三] 付款应以收款国的货币进行，或由银行选择以黄金支付。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] If losses are sustained by the Bank on any guarantees , participations in loans , or loans which were outstanding on the date when the government ceased to be a member , and the amount of such losses exceeds the amount of the reserve provided against losses on the date when the government ceased to be a member , such government shall be obligated to repay upon demand the amount by which the repurchase price of its shares would have been reduced , if the losses had been taken into account when the repurchase price was determined .
Translation: [ iv ] 如果银行在政府停止成为成员国之日尚未到期的任何担保、贷款参与或贷款上遭受损失，且该损失金额超过政府停止成为成员国之日为损失准备的储备金额，则该政府有义务在银行要求时偿还一笔款项，该款项相当于在确定其股份回购价格时若将上述损失计入，股份回购价格本应减少的金额。

Query_Text_en: In addition , the former member government shall remain liable on any call for unpaid subscriptions under Article IL Section 5 [ ii ] , to the extent that it would have been required to respond if the impairment of capital had occurred and the call had been made at the time the repurchase price of its shares was determined .
Translation: 此外，前成员国政府仍应对根据第九条第五款（二）项所作的未缴股本认缴要求承担责任，责任范围为：如果资本减损发生并在其股份回购价格确定时提出认缴要求，该成员国本应承担的责任。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] if the Bank suspends permanently its operations under Section 5 [ b ] of this Article , within six months of the date upon which any government ceases to be a member , all rights of such government shall be determined by the provisions of Section 5 of this Article .
Translation: [ d ] 如果银行根据本条第5款[ b ]永久中止其业务，在任何政府终止成员资格之日起六个月内，该政府的所有权利应按照本条第5款的规定予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 . Suspension of Operations and Settlement of Obligations [ a ] In an emergency the Executive Directors may suspend temporarily operations in respect of new loans and guarantees pending an opportunity for further consideration and action by the Board of Governors .
Translation:
第五节 业务暂停与债务结算

[一] 在紧急情况下，执行董事可暂时暂停有关新贷款和担保的业务，待理事会进一步审议和采取措施。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Bank may suspend permanently its operations in respect of new loans and guarantees by a vote of a majority of the Governors , exercising a majority of the total voting power .
Translation: [ b ] 银行可经多数理事行使多数总表决权投票决定，永久中止其关于新贷款和担保的业务。

Query_Text_en: After such suspension of operations the Bank shall forthwith cease all activities , except those incident to the orderly realization , conservation , and preservation of its assets and settlement of its obligations .
Translation: 在暂停运营后，银行应立即停止所有活动，除与资产有序变现、保全和维护以及债务清偿相关的事项外。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The liability of all members for uncalled subscriptions to the capital stock of the Bank and in respect of the depreciation of their own currencies shall continue until all claims of creditors , including all contingent claims , shall have been discharged .
Translation: 所有成员对尚未缴纳的银行资本股本认缴款项以及因本国货币贬值所产生的责任，将持续有效，直至所有债权人的索赔，包括所有或有索赔，均已清偿为止。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Application of UCPThe Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits , 2007 Revision , ICC Publication no. 600 [ `` UCP '' ] are rules that apply to any documentary credit [ `` credit '' ] [ including , to the extent to which they may be applicable , any standby letter of credit ] when the text of the credit expressly indicates that it is subject to these rules .
Translation:
第一条 UCP的适用范围

《跟单信用证统一惯例》（2007年修订本，国际商会第600号出版物，以下简称“UCP”）为适用于任何明示受其约束的跟单信用证（以下简称“信用证”）（包括在适用范围内的备用信用证）的规则。

Query_Text_en: They are binding on all parties thereto unless expressly modified or excluded by the credit .
Translation: 除非信用证明确修改或排除，否则这些条款对所有相关方均具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Advising bank means the bank that advises the credit at the request of the issuing bank .
Translation: 通知行是指根据开证行的请求，对信用证进行通知的银行。

Query_Text_en: Applicant means the party on whose request the credit is issued .
Translation: 申请人是指根据其请求开立信用证的一方。

Query_Text_en: Banking day means a day on which a bank is regularly open at the place at which an act subject to these rules is to be performed .
Translation: 银行营业日是指银行在需履行本规则所涉行为的地点正常营业的日子。

Query_Text_en: Beneficiary means the party in whose favor a credit is issued .
Translation: 受益人是指以其为受益方开立信用证的一方。

Query_Text_en: Complying presentation means a presentation that is in accordance with the terms and conditions of the credit , the applicable provisions of these rules and international standard banking practice .
Translation: 合规交单是指符合信用证条款与条件、相关规则规定以及国际标准银行惯例的交单。

Query_Text_en: Confirmation means a definite undertaking of the confirming bank , in addition to that of the issuing bank , to honor or negotiate a complying presentation .
Translation: 保兑是指保兑银行在开证银行承诺的基础上，明确承诺对符合规定的交单进行付款或议付。

Query_Text_en: Confirming bank means the bank that adds its confirmation to a credit upon the issuing bank 's authorization or request .
Translation: 保兑银行是指应开证行的授权或请求，在信用证上加具保兑的银行。

Query_Text_en: Credit means any arrangement , however named or described , that is irrevocable and thereby constitutes a definite undertaking of the issuing bank to honor a complying presentation .
Translation: 信用证是指无论其名称或描述如何，只要其为不可撤销的安排，即构成开证行对符合规定的交单承担付款责任的明确承诺。

Query_Text_en: a. to pay at sight if the credit is available by sight payment .
Translation: a. 如信用证为即期付款，则应即期付款。

Query_Text_en: b. to incur a deferred payment undertaking and pay at maturity if the credit is available by deferred payment .
Translation: b. 如信用证以延期付款方式可用，则承担延期付款承诺并于到期时付款。

Query_Text_en: c. to accept a bill of exchange [ `` draft '' ] drawn by the beneficiary and pay at maturity if the credit is available by acceptance .
Translation: c. 若信用证以承兑方式提供，则接受受益人开立的汇票，并在到期时付款。

Query_Text_en: Issuing bank means the bank that issues a credit at the request of an applicant or on its own behalf .
Translation: 开证行是指根据申请人的请求或以自身名义开立信用证的银行。

Query_Text_en: Negotiation means the purchase by the nominated bank of drafts [ drawn on a bank other than the nominated bank ] and\/or documents under a complying presentation , by advancing or agreeing to advance funds to the beneficiary on or before the banking day on which reimbursement is due to [ to be paid the nominated bank .
Translation: “议付”是指指定银行在合格交单的情况下，通过向受益人预付或同意预付资金，在应向指定银行偿付的银行营业日或之前，购买以其他银行为付款行开立的汇票和/或单据。

Query_Text_en: Nominated bank means the bank with which the credit is available or any bank in the case of a credit available with any bank .
Translation: 指定银行是指可使用信用证的银行，或在信用证可由任何银行使用的情况下，指任何银行。

Query_Text_en: Presentation means either the delivery of documents under a credit to the issuing bank or nominated bank or the documents so delivered .
Translation: “交单”是指根据信用证向开证行或指定银行提交单据，或指所提交的这些单据。

Query_Text_en: Presenter means a beneficiary , bank or other party that makes a presentation .
Translation: 提交人是指提出交单的受益人、银行或其他方。

Query_Text_en: Where applicable , words in the singular include the plural and in the plural include the singular .
Translation: 在适用情况下，单数词语包括复数，复数词语亦包括单数。

Query_Text_en: A credit is irrevocable even if there is no indication to that effect .
Translation: 即使未作相关说明，信用证也是不可撤销的。

Query_Text_en: A document may be signed by handwriting , facsimile signature , perforated signature , stamp , symbol or any other mechanical or electronic method of authentication .
Translation: 文件可以通过手写签名、签名印刷、穿孔签名、盖章、符号或任何其他机械或电子认证方式进行签署。

Query_Text_en: A requirement for a document to be legalized , visaed , certified or similar will be satisfied by any signature , mark , stamp or label on the document which appears to satisfy that requirement .
Translation: 如文件上有任何签名、标记、印章或标签，表面上符合文件需经认证、签证、证明或类似要求的，即视为已满足该要求。

Query_Text_en: Branches of a bank in different countries are considered to be separate banks .
Translation: 一家银行在不同国家的分支机构被视为独立的银行。

Query_Text_en: Terms such as `` first class '' , `` well known '' , `` qualified '' , `` independent '' , `` official '' , `` competent '' or `` local '' used to describe the issuer of a document allow any issuer except the beneficiary to issue that document .
Translation: 用于描述单证签发人的术语，如“一级”、“知名”、“合格”、“独立”、“官方”、“有资质”或“本地”，均允许除受益人以外的任何签发人签发该单证。

Query_Text_en: Unless required to be used in a document , words such as `` prompt '' , `` immediately '' or `` as soon as possible '' will be disregarded .
Translation: 除非文件要求使用，否则“prompt”、“immediately”或“as soon as possible”等词语将不予考虑。

Query_Text_en: The expression `` on or about '' or similar will be interpreted as a stipulation that an event is to occur during a period of five calendar days before until five calendar days after the specified date , both start and end dates included .
Translation: “于某日或前后”或类似表述将被解释为规定某事件应在指定日期前后各五个日历日内发生，起止日期均包括在内。

Query_Text_en: The words `` to '' , `` until '' , `` till '' , `` from '' and `` between '' when used to determine a period of shipment include the date or dates mentioned , and the words `` before '' and `` after '' exclude the date mentioned .
Translation: 在用于确定装运期限时，单词“至”、“直到”、“至……为止”、“从”和“介于……之间”包括所提及的日期，而“在……之前”和“在……之后”则不包括所提及的日期。

Query_Text_en: The words `` from '' and `` after '' when used to determine a maturity date exclude the date mentioned .
Translation: 在用于确定到期日时，“from”和“after”这两个词所指的日期不包括在内。

Query_Text_en: The terms `` first half '' and `` second half '' of a month shall be construed respectively as the 1st to the 15th and the 16th to the last day of the month , all dates inclusive .
Translation: “上半月”和“下半月”分别指每月的1日至15日和16日至当月最后一日，首尾日期均包括在内。

Query_Text_en: The terms `` beginning '' , `` middle '' and `` end '' of a month shall be construed respectively as the 1st to the 10th , the 11th to the 20th and the 21st to the last day of the month , all dates inclusive .
Translation: “月初”、“月中”和“月末”分别指每月的1日至10日、11日至20日以及21日至月末，所有日期均包含在内。

Query_Text_en: a. A credit by its nature is a separate transaction from the sale or other contract on which it may be based . Banks are in no way concerned with or bound by such contract , even if any reference whatsoever to it is included in the credit .
Translation: 信用证本质上是独立于其所依据的销售或其他合同的单独交易。银行对该合同不承担任何责任，也不受其约束，即使信用证中包含任何与该合同有关的内容。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , the undertaking of a bank to honor , to negotiate or to fulfil any other obligation under the credit is not subject to claims or defences by the applicant resulting from its relationships with the issuing bank or the beneficiary .
Translation: 因此，银行承诺根据信用证履行付款、议付或其他义务，不受申请人与开证行或受益人之间关系所产生的任何索赔或抗辩影响。

Query_Text_en: A beneficiary can in no case avail itself of the contractual relationships existing between banks or between the applicant and the issuing bank .
Translation: 受益人在任何情况下均不得援引银行之间或申请人与开证行之间存在的合同关系。

Query_Text_en: b. An issuing bank should discourage any attempt by the applicant to include , as an integral part of the credit , copies of the underlying contract , proforma invoice and the like .
Translation: b. 开证行应当劝阻申请人将基础合同、形式发票等文件作为信用证不可分割的组成部分纳入其中。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 5 Documents v. Goods , Services or PerformanceBanks deal with documents and not with goods , services or performance to which the documents may relate .
Translation:
第5条 文件与货物、服务或履约

银行只处理文件，而不处理这些文件所涉及的货物、服务或履约。

Query_Text_en: a. A credit must state the bank with which it is available or whether it is available with any bank .
Translation: a. 信用证必须注明可用银行，或注明是否可在任何银行使用。

Query_Text_en: A credit available with a nominated bank is also available with the issuing bank .
Translation: 在指定银行可用的信用证，同样也可在开证行使用。

Query_Text_en: b. A credit must state whether it is available by sight payment , deferred payment , acceptance or negotiation .
Translation: b. 信用证必须明确其可用于即期付款、延期付款、承兑或议付。

Query_Text_en: c. A credit must not be issued available by a draft drawn on the applicant .
Translation: c. 信用证不得以申请人为出票对象开立。

Query_Text_en: d. i. A credit must state an expiry date for presentation .
Translation: d. i. 信用证必须注明交单截止日期。

Query_Text_en: An expiry date stated for honor or negotiation will be deemed to be an expiry date for presentation .
Translation: 注明用于承兑或议付的到期日，将被视为提交单据的到期日。

Query_Text_en: ii . The place of the bank with which the credit is available is the place for presentation .
Translation: ii. 信用证可用银行所在地即为提交单据的地点。

Query_Text_en: The place for presentation under a credit available with any bank is that of any bank .
Translation: 在任何银行可用的信用证项下，交单地点为任何银行所在地。

Query_Text_en: A place for presentation other than that of the issuing bank is in addition to the place of the issuing bank .
Translation: 除开证行所在地之外的提交地点，属于开证行所在地之外的额外提交地点。

Query_Text_en: e. Except as provided in sub-article 29 [ a ] , a presentation by or on behalf of the beneficiary must be made on or before the expiry date .
Translation: 除非第29[a]款另有规定，受益人或其代理必须在到期日前提交相关材料。

Query_Text_en: v. negotiation with a nominated bank and that nominated bank does not negotiate .
Translation: 与指定银行进行议付，但该指定银行未予议付。

Query_Text_en: b. An issuing bank is irrevocably bound to honor as of the time it issues the credit .
Translation: b. 开证行自信用证签发之时起即不可撤销地承担付款责任。

Query_Text_en: c. An issuing bank undertakes to reimburse a nominated bank that has honored or negotiated a complying presentation and forwarded the documents to the issuing bank .
Translation: c. 开证行承诺向已对合规交单进行付款或议付并将单据转交给开证行的指定银行进行偿付。

Query_Text_en: Reimbursement for the amount of a complying presentation under a credit available by acceptance or deferred payment is due at maturity , whether or not the nominated bank prepaid or purchased before maturity .
Translation: 对于符合信用证要求的交单，若信用证以承兑或延期付款方式可用，则应在到期时支付款项，无论指定银行是否在到期前进行了预付款或买断。

Query_Text_en: An issuing bank '' s undertaking to reimburse a nominated bank is independent of the issuing bank 's undertaking to the beneficiary .
Translation: 开证行对指定银行的偿付承诺与其对受益人的承诺是相互独立的。

Query_Text_en: e. negotiation with another nominated bank and that nominated bank does not negotiate .
Translation: e. 与另一家指定银行进行议付，但该指定银行未予议付。

Query_Text_en: ii . negotiate , without recourse , if the credit is available by negotiation with the confirming bank .
Translation: ii. 如信用证由保兑银行议付，则无追索权议付。

Query_Text_en: b. A confirming bank is irrevocably bound to honor or negotiate as of the time it adds its confirmation to the credit .
Translation: b. 一旦保兑银行对信用证加注保兑，其即不可撤销地承担履行或议付的义务。

Query_Text_en: c. A confirming bank undertakes to reimburse another nominated bank that has honored or negotiated a complying presentation and forwarded the documents to the confirming bank .
Translation: c. 保兑银行承诺向另一家指定银行偿付，该指定银行已对符合要求的交单进行付款或议付，并将相关单据转交给保兑银行。
