Query_Text_en: Reimbursement for the amount of a complying presentation under a credit available by acceptance or deferred payment is due at maturity , whether or not another nominated bank prepaid or purchased before maturity .
Translation: 对于符合信用证要求的交单，若信用证以承兑或延期付款方式可用，则应在到期时支付款项，无论其他指定银行是否在到期前进行了预付款或买断。

Query_Text_en: A confirming bank '' s undertaking to reimburse another nominated bank is independent of the confirming bank 's undertaking to the beneficiary .
Translation: 保兑行对另一指定银行的偿付承诺与其对受益人的承诺是相互独立的。

Query_Text_en: d. If a bank is authorized or requested by the issuing bank to confirm a credit but is not prepared to do so , it must inform the issuing bank without delay and may advise the credit without confirmation .
Translation: d. 如果开证行授权或要求某银行对信用证进行保兑，但该银行不愿意保兑，则必须立即通知开证行，并可在未加保兑的情况下通知信用证。

Query_Text_en: a. A credit and any amendment may be advised to a beneficiary through an advising bank .
Translation: a. 信用证及其任何修改可通过通知银行通知受益人。

Query_Text_en: An advising bank that is not a confirming bank advises the credit and any amendment without any undertaking to honor or negotiate .
Translation: 未作为保兑行的通知行在通知信用证及其修改时，不承担任何付款或议付的承诺。

Query_Text_en: b. By advising the credit or amendment , the advising bank signifies that it has satisfied itself as to the apparent authenticity of the credit or amendment and that the advice accurately reflects the terms and conditions of the credit or amendment received .
Translation: b. 通知信用证或修改时，通知行表示其已核实信用证或修改的表面真实性，并确认所通知的内容准确反映其收到的信用证或修改的条款和条件。

Query_Text_en: c. An advising bank may utilize the services of another bank [ `` second advising bank '' ] to advise the credit and any amendment to the beneficiary .
Translation: c. 通知行可以委托另一家银行（“第二通知行”）向受益人通知信用证及其任何修改。

Query_Text_en: By advising the credit or amendment , the second advising bank signifies that it has satisfied itself as to the apparent authenticity of the advice it has received and that the advice accurately reflects the terms and conditions of the credit or amendment received .
Translation: 通过对信用证或修改通知进行通知，第二通知行表明其已确认所收到通知的表面真实性，并且该通知准确反映了所收到信用证或修改的条款和条件。

Query_Text_en: d. A bank utilizing the services of an advising bank or second advising bank to advise a credit must use the same bank to advise any amendment thereto .
Translation: d. 开证行如委托通知行或第二通知行对信用证进行通知，则对该信用证的任何修改也必须通过同一家银行进行通知。

Query_Text_en: e. If a bank is requested to advise a credit or amendment but elects not to do so , it must so inform , without delay , the bank from which the credit , amendment or advice has been received .
Translation: e. 如果一家银行被要求通知信用证或修改，但选择不予通知，则必须立即将此决定告知向其发送信用证、修改或通知的银行。

Query_Text_en: f. If a bank is requested to advise a credit or amendment but can not satisfy itself as to the apparent authenticity of the credit , the amendment or the advice , it must so inform , without delay , the bank from which the instructions appear to have been received .
Translation: 如果一家银行被要求通知信用证或修改，但无法确认信用证、修改或通知的真实性，则必须立即通知其收到指示的银行。

Query_Text_en: If the advising bank or second advising bank elects nonetheless to advise the credit or amendment , it must inform the beneficiary or second advising bank that it has not been able to satisfy itself as to the apparent authenticity of the credit , the amendment or the advice .
Translation: 如果通知行或第二通知行仍决定通知信用证或修改，则必须告知受益人或第二通知行，其未能确认信用证、修改或通知的表面真实性。

Query_Text_en: a. Except as otherwise provided by article 38 , a credit can neither be amended nor canceled without the agreement of the issuing bank , the confirming bank , if any , and the beneficiary .
Translation: 除非第38条另有规定，信用证的修改或撤销须经开证行、保兑行（如有）及受益人三方同意。

Query_Text_en: b. An issuing bank is irrevocably bound by an amendment as of the time it issues the amendment .
Translation: b. 开证行自发布修改通知之时起，即不可撤销地受该修改约束。

Query_Text_en: A confirming bank may extend its confirmation to an amendment and will be irrevocably bound as of the time it advises the amendment .
Translation: 保兑银行可以对修改进行保兑，并将在通知修改之时不可撤销地承担相关责任。

Query_Text_en: A confirming bank may , however , choose to advise an amendment without extending its confirmation and , if so , it must inform the issuing bank without delay and inform the beneficiary in its advice .
Translation: 然而，保兑行可以选择仅通知修改而不延伸其保兑责任，如若如此，必须立即通知开证行，并在通知中告知受益人。

Query_Text_en: c. The terms and conditions of the original credit [ or a credit incorporating previously accepted amendments ] will remain in force for the beneficiary until the beneficiary communicates its acceptance of the amendment to the bank that advised such amendment .
Translation: c. 原信用证的条款和条件（或包含已被接受修改的信用证）在受益人向通知该修改的银行表示接受之前，将继续对受益人有效。

Query_Text_en: The beneficiary should give notification of acceptance or rejection of an amendment .
Translation: 受益人应就修改通知其接受或拒绝的意见。

Query_Text_en: If the beneficiary fails to give such notification , a presentation that complies with the credit and to any not yet accepted amendment will be deemed to be notification of acceptance by the beneficiary of such amendment . As of that moment the credit will be amended .
Translation: 如果受益人未能发出上述通知，符合信用证及任何尚未被接受的修改条款的交单，将被视为受益人已接受该修改。从该时起，信用证将被修改。

Query_Text_en: d. A bank that advises an amendment should inform the bank from which it received the amendment of any notification of acceptance or rejection .
Translation: d. 建议修改的银行应将收到的任何接受或拒绝通知，告知其收到该修改通知的银行。

Query_Text_en: e. Partial acceptance of an amendment is not allowed and will be deemed to be notification of rejection of the amendment .
Translation: e. 不允许对修订案进行部分接受，部分接受将被视为对修订案的拒绝通知。

Query_Text_en: f. A provision in an amendment to the effect that the amendment shall enter into force unless rejected by the beneficiary within a certain time shall be disregarded .
Translation: f. 修正案中关于“除非受益人在规定时间内予以拒绝，否则该修正案即行生效”的条款应予以忽略。

Query_Text_en: a. An authenticated teletransmission of a credit or amendment will be deemed to be the operative credit or amendment , and any subsequent mail confirmation shall be disregarded .
Translation: 经认证的信用证或修改通知的电传将被视为正式的信用证或修改通知，任何后续的邮件确认均不予考虑。

Query_Text_en: If a teletransmission states `` full details to follow '' [ or words of similar effect ] , or states that the mail confirmation is to be the operative credit or amendment , then the teletransmission will not be deemed to be the operative credit or amendment .
Translation: 如果电传内容表述“详细信息随后提供”（或类似措辞），或表明邮寄确认函将作为正式信用证或修改文件，则该电传不应被视为正式的信用证或修改文件。

Query_Text_en: The issuing bank must then issue the operative credit or amendment without delay in terms not inconsistent with the teletransmission .
Translation: 开证行必须立即按照电传内容，及时开立正式信用证或修改通知，且条款不得与电传内容相抵触。

Query_Text_en: b. A preliminary advice of the issuance of a credit or amendment [ `` pre-advice '' ] shall only be sent if the issuing bank is prepared to issue the operative credit or amendment .
Translation: b. 只有在开证行已准备好正式开立信用证或进行修改时，才可发送有关信用证或修改的预先通知（“预通知”）。

Query_Text_en: An issuing bank that sends a pre-advice is irrevocably committed to issue the operative credit or amendment , without delay , in terms not inconsistent with the pre-advice .
Translation: 开证行一旦发出预先通知，即不可撤销地承诺将及时按照与预先通知内容一致的条款开立正式信用证或进行修改，不得有任何与预先通知不符之处。

Query_Text_en: a. Unless a nominated bank is the confirming bank , an authorization to honor or negotiate does not impose any obligation on that nominated bank to honor or negotiate , except when expressly agreed to by that nominated bank and so communicated to the beneficiary .
Translation: 除非指定银行为保兑银行，授权其承兑或议付并不对该指定银行构成任何承兑或议付的义务，除非该指定银行已明确同意并将此意向告知受益人。

Query_Text_en: b. By nominating a bank to accept a draft or incur a deferred payment undertaking , an issuing bank authorizes that nominated bank to prepay or purchase a draft accepted or a deferred payment undertaking incurred by that nominated bank .
Translation: b. 当开证行指定某银行承兑汇票或承担延期付款承诺时，即授权该被指定银行对其所承兑的汇票或所承担的延期付款承诺进行预付款或购买。

Query_Text_en: c. Receipt or examination and forwarding of documents by a nominated bank that is not a confirming bank does not make that nominated bank liable to honor or negotiate , nor does it constitute honor or negotiation .
Translation: c. 被指定银行但非保兑银行接收或审核并转交文件，并不使该指定银行承担付款或议付的责任，也不构成付款或议付。

Query_Text_en: a. If a credit states that reimbursement is to be obtained by a nominated bank [ `` claiming bank '' ] claiming on another party [ `` reimbursing bank '' ] , the credit must state if the reimbursement is subject to the ICC rules for bank-to-bank reimbursements in effect on the date of issuance of the credit .
Translation: a. 如果信用证规定由被指定银行（“索偿银行”）向另一方（“偿付银行”）索取偿付，则信用证必须注明该偿付是否适用信用证开立日有效的国际商会银行间偿付规则。

Query_Text_en: i. An issuing bank must provide a reimbursing bank with a reimbursement authorization that conforms with the availability stated in the credit . The reimbursement authorization should not be subject to an expiry date .
Translation: i. 开证行必须向偿付行提供与信用证规定的可用性相一致的偿付授权。该偿付授权不应设有到期日。

Query_Text_en: ii . A claiming bank shall not be required to supply a reimbursing bank with a certificate of compliance with the terms and conditions of the credit .
Translation: ii. 索赔银行无需向偿付银行提供符合信用证条款和条件的合规证明。

Query_Text_en: iii . An issuing bank will be responsible for any loss of interest , together with any expenses incurred , if reimbursement is not provided on first demand by a reimbursing bank in accordance with the terms and conditions of the credit .
Translation: iii. 如偿付行未按照信用证条款和条件在首次要求时提供偿付，开证行将承担由此产生的任何利息损失及相关费用。

Query_Text_en: iv . A reimbursing bank '' s charges are for the account of the issuing bank .
Translation: iv. 偿付行的费用由开证行承担。

Query_Text_en: However , if the charges are for the account of the beneficiary , it is the responsibility of an issuing bank to so indicate in the credit and in the reimbursement authorization .
Translation: 然而，如果费用由受益人承担，开证行有责任在信用证及偿付授权中予以明确说明。

Query_Text_en: If a reimbursing bank '' s charges are for the account of the beneficiary , they shall be deducted from the amount due to a claiming bank when reimbursement is made .
Translation: 如补偿银行的费用由受益人承担，则在进行补偿时，该费用应从应支付给索赔银行的金额中扣除。

Query_Text_en: If no reimbursement is made , the reimbursing bank '' s charges remain the obligation of the issuing bank .
Translation: 如未进行偿付，偿付行的费用仍由开证行承担。

Query_Text_en: c. An issuing bank is not relieved of any of its obligations to provide reimbursement if reimbursement is not made by a reimbursing bank on first demand .
Translation: c. 如偿付行未能在首次请求时进行偿付，开证行的任何偿付义务并不因此而免除。

Query_Text_en: a. A nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , and the issuing bank must examine a presentation to determine , on the basis of the documents alone , whether or not the documents appear on their face to constitute a complying presentation .
Translation: a. 被指定银行在履行其指定职责时、如有的话，保兑银行以及开证行，必须仅根据所提交的单据，对其进行审核，以判断这些单据表面上是否构成合规的提交。

Query_Text_en: b. A nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , and the issuing bank shall each have a maximum of five banking days following the day of presentation to determine if a presentation is complying .
Translation: b. 被指定银行在履行其指定职责时、如有保兑银行以及开证行，各方在收到交单之日起最多有五个银行工作日用于确定该交单是否符合信用证规定。

Query_Text_en: This period is not curtailed or otherwise affected by the occurrence on or after the date of presentation of any expiry date or last day for presentation .
Translation: 该期限不会因在提交之日或之后发生的任何到期日或最后提交日而被缩短或以其他方式受到影响。

Query_Text_en: c. A presentation including one or more original transport documents subject to articles 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 or 25 must be made by or on behalf of the beneficiary not later than 21 calendar days after the date of shipment as described in these rules , but in any event not later than the expiry date of the credit .
Translation: c. 受益人或其代理人须在本规则所述装运日期后不超过21个日历日内，提交一份或多份受第19、20、21、22、23、24或25条约束的正本运输单据，但无论如何，提交时间不得晚于信用证的到期日。

Query_Text_en: d. Data in a document , when read in context with the credit , the document itself and international standard banking practice , need not be identical to , but must not conflict with , data in that document , any other stipulated document or the credit .
Translation: d. 文件中的数据，在结合信用证、文件本身及国际标准银行惯例进行解读时，无需与该文件、其他规定文件或信用证中的数据完全一致，但不得相互矛盾。

Query_Text_en: e. In documents other than the commercial invoice , the description of the goods , services or performance , if stated , may be in general terms not conflicting with their description in the credit .
Translation: 在商业发票以外的文件中，如需注明货物、服务或履行的描述，可以采用与信用证中描述不冲突的概括性表述。

Query_Text_en: f. If a credit requires presentation of a document other than a transport document , insurance document or commercial invoice , without stipulating by whom the document is to be issued or its data content , banks will accept the document as presented if its content appears to fulfil the function of the required document and otherwise complies with sub-article 14 [ d ] .
Translation: f. 如果信用证要求提交除运输单据、保险单据或商业发票之外的其他单据，但未规定由谁出具或未规定单据的具体内容，银行将在所提交单据内容看似能够履行所要求单据功能，并且符合第14条[d]款其他规定的情况下予以接受。

Query_Text_en: g. A document presented but not required by the credit will be disregarded and may be returned to the presenter .
Translation: g. 提交但信用证未要求的单据将被忽略，并可能退还给提交人。

Query_Text_en: h. If a credit contains a condition without stipulating the document to indicate compliance with the condition , banks will deem such condition as not stated and will disregard it .
Translation: h. 如果信用证中包含某项条件，但未规定需提交证明符合该条件的单据，银行将视该条件为未列明，并予以忽略。

Query_Text_en: i. A document may be dated prior to the issuance date of the credit , but must not be dated later than its date of presentation .
Translation: i. 单据的日期可以早于信用证的开证日期，但不得晚于其提交日期。

Query_Text_en: j. When the addresses of the beneficiary and the applicant appear in any stipulated document , they need not be the same as those stated in the credit or in any other stipulated document , but must be within the same country as the respective addresses mentioned in the credit .
Translation: j. 当受益人和申请人的地址出现在任何规定单据中时，无需与信用证或其他规定单据中所载地址完全一致，但必须与信用证中所述各自地址位于同一国家。

Query_Text_en: Contact details [ telefax , telephone , email and the like ] stated as part of the beneficiary 's and the applicant 's address will be disregarded .
Translation: 受益人和申请人地址中所包含的联系方式（如传真、电话、电子邮件等）将不予考虑。

Query_Text_en: However , when the address and contact details of the applicant appear as part of the consignee or notify party details on a transport document subject to articles 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 or 25 , they must be as stated in the credit .
Translation: 然而，当申请人的地址和联系方式作为收货人或通知方信息的一部分，出现在受第19、20、21、22、23、24或25条约束的运输单据上时，必须与信用证中所述一致。

Query_Text_en: k. The shipper or consignor of the goods indicated on any document need not be the beneficiary of the credit .
Translation: k. 任何单据上所列明的货物托运人或发货人，无需为信用证的受益人。

Query_Text_en: l. A transport document may be issued by any party other than a carrier , owner , master or charterer provided that the transport document meets the requirements of articles 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 or 24 of these rules .
Translation: 1. 除承运人、所有人、船长或租船人外，任何其他方均可签发运输单证，前提是该运输单证符合本规则第19、20、21、22、23或24条的要求。

Query_Text_en: a. When an issuing bank determines that a presentation is complying , it must honor .
Translation: a. 开证行在确定提交的单据相符时，必须履行付款义务。

Query_Text_en: b. When a confirming bank determines that a presentation is complying , it must honor or negotiate and forward the documents to the issuing bank .
Translation: b. 当保兑银行认定提交的单据符合要求时，必须履行付款或议付，并将单据转交给开证行。

Query_Text_en: c. When a nominated bank determines that a presentation is complying and honors or negotiates , it must forward the documents to the confirming bank or issuing bank .
Translation: c. 当被指定银行认定提交的单据符合要求并予以承兑或议付时，必须将相关单据转交给保兑银行或开证行。

Query_Text_en: a. When a nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , or the issuing bank determines that a presentation does not comply , it may refuse to honor or negotiate .
Translation: a. 当被指定银行依据其指定行身份、保兑行（如有）或开证行认定提交的单据不符合规定时，可以拒绝承兑或议付。

Query_Text_en: b. When an issuing bank determines that a presentation does not comply , it may in its sole judgement approach the applicant for a waiver of the discrepancies .
Translation: b. 当开证行认定提交的单据不符规定时，可自行决定是否联系申请人，寻求对不符点的免责处理。

Query_Text_en: This does not , however , extend the period mentioned in sub-article 14 [ b ] .
Translation: 然而，这并不延长第14条款[b]中所述的期限。

Query_Text_en: c. When a nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , or the issuing bank decides to refuse to honor or negotiate , it must give a single notice to that effect to the presenter .
Translation: c. 当被指定银行根据其指定行事时，若有保兑银行或开证银行决定拒绝承兑或议付，必须向提交人发出一次性通知，说明其决定。

Query_Text_en: d ] that the bank is acting in accordance with instructions previously received from the presenter .
Translation: d] 银行正根据此前从提交人处收到的指示行事。

Query_Text_en: d. The notice required in sub-article 16 [ c ] must be given by telecommunication or , if that is not possible , by other expeditious means no later than the close of the fifth banking day following the day of presentation .
Translation: d. 第16条[c]款所要求的通知，必须通过电信方式发出；如无法通过电信方式，则应以其他快捷方式发出，并且不得迟于提交之日后的第五个银行营业日结束前发出。

Query_Text_en: e. A nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , or the issuing bank may , after providing notice required by sub-article 16 [ c ] [ iii ] [ a ] or [ b ] , return the documents to the presenter at any time .
Translation: e. 被指定银行在履行其指定职责时，确认银行（如有），或开证行，可在按照第16[c][iii][a]或[b]项要求发出通知后，随时将单据退还给提交人。

Query_Text_en: f. If an issuing bank or a confirming bank fails to act in accordance with the provisions of this article , it shall be precluded from claiming that the documents do not constitute a complying presentation .
Translation: f. 如果开证行或保兑行未按照本条款的规定行事，则不得主张单据不构成相符交单。

Query_Text_en: g. When an issuing bank refuses to honor or a confirming bank refuses to honor or negotiate and has given notice to that effect in accordance with this article , it shall then be entitled to claim a refund , with interest , of any reimbursement made .
Translation: g. 当开证行拒绝付款，或保兑行拒绝付款或议付，并已按照本条规定发出相关通知后，其有权要求退还已支付的任何偿付款项，并可要求支付利息。

Query_Text_en: a. At least one original of each document stipulated in the credit must be presented .
Translation: a. 信用证规定的每份文件至少须提交一份正本。

Query_Text_en: b. A bank shall treat as an original any document bearing an apparently original signature , mark , stamp , or label of the issuer of the document , unless the document itself indicates that it is not an original .
Translation: b. 除非文件本身表明其并非原件，银行应将任何带有发行人明显原始签名、标记、印章或标签的文件视为原件。

Query_Text_en: oriii . states that it is original , unless the statement appears not to apply to the document presented .
Translation: oriii. 声明其为原件，除非该声明明显不适用于所提交的文件。

Query_Text_en: d. If a credit requires presentation of copies of documents , presentation of either originals or copies is permitted .
Translation: d. 如果信用证要求提交文件副本，则提交正本或副本均可。

Query_Text_en: e. If a credit requires presentation of multiple documents by using terms such as `` in duplicate '' , `` in two fold '' or `` in two copies '' , this will be satisfied by the presentation of at least one original and the remaining number in copies , except when the document itself indicates otherwise .
Translation: e. 如果信用证要求提交多份文件，并使用“副本”、“两份”或“两份副本”等表述，则只需提交至少一份正本，其余为副本即可，除非文件本身另有规定。

Query_Text_en: andiv . need not be signed .
Translation: 无需签署。

Query_Text_en: b. A nominated bank acting on its nomination , a confirming bank , if any , or the issuing bank may accept a commercial invoice issued for an amount in excess of the amount permitted by the credit , and its decision will be binding upon all parties , provided the bank in question has not honored or negotiated for an amount in excess of that permitted by the credit .
Translation: b. 被指定银行在履行其指定职责时、任何确认银行或开证行，可以接受金额超过信用证允许金额的商业发票，并且其决定对所有相关方具有约束力，前提是该银行未对超过信用证允许金额的款项进行承兑或议付。

Query_Text_en: c. The description of the goods , services or performance in a commercial invoice must correspond with that appearing in the credit .
Translation: c. 商业发票中对货物、服务或履约的描述必须与信用证中的描述一致。

Query_Text_en: the carrier or a named agent for or on behalf of the carrier , or the master or a named agent for or on behalf of the master .
Translation: 承运人或其指定代理人，或代表承运人的代理人，亦或船长或其指定代理人，或代表船长的代理人。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by the carrier , master or agent must be identified as that of the carrier , master or agent .
Translation: 承运人、船长或代理人的任何签字，必须明确标明其身份。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by an agent must indicate whether the agent has signed for or on behalf of the carrier or for or on behalf of the master .
Translation: 代理人签署的任何签名必须明确表明其是代表承运人还是代表船长签署。

Query_Text_en: ii . indicate that the goods have been dispatched , taken in charge or shipped on board at the place stated in the credit , by :
Translation: ii. 表明货物已按照信用证规定的地点发运、接管或装船，由：

Query_Text_en: pre-printed wording , or a stamp or notation indicating the date on which the goods have been dispatched , taken in charge or shipped on board .
Translation: 预先印制的文字，或表明货物已发运、接收或装船日期的印章或批注。

Query_Text_en: The date of issuance of the transport document will be deemed to be the date of dispatch , taking in charge or shipped on board , and the date of shipment .
Translation: 运输单据的签发日期将被视为发运、接管或装船日期，以及装运日期。

Query_Text_en: However , if the transport document indicates , by stamp or notation , a date of dispatch , taking in charge or shipped on board , this date will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 然而，如果运输单据上通过盖章或批注的方式注明了发运日期、接收日期或装船日期，则该日期将被视为装运日期。

Query_Text_en: b. the transport document contains the indication `` intended '' or similar qualification in relation to the vessel , port of loading or port of discharge .
Translation: b. 运输单据中关于船舶、装货港或卸货港含有“预定”或类似表述。

Query_Text_en: iv . be the sole original transport document or , if issued in more than one original , be the full set as indicated on the transport document .
Translation: iv. 应为唯一正本运输单据，或如签发多份正本，则应为运输单据上所注明的全套正本。

Query_Text_en: v. contain terms and conditions of carriage or make reference to another source containing the terms and conditions of carriage [ short form or blank back transport document ] .
Translation: 五、载明运输条款和条件，或引用载有运输条款和条件的其他来源（简式或空白背面运输单证）。

Query_Text_en: Contents of terms and conditions of carriage will not be examined .
Translation: 运输条款内容将不予审查。

Query_Text_en: vi . contain no indication that it is subject to a charter party .
Translation: 六、不得包含其受租船合同约束的任何表述。

Query_Text_en: b. For the purpose of this article , transhipment means unloading from one means of conveyance and reloading to another means of conveyance [ whether or not in different modes of transport ] during the carriage from the place of dispatch , taking in charge or shipment to the place of final destination stated in the credit .
Translation: b. 本条所称“转运”，是指在从发货地、接收地或装运地运往信用证所规定的最终目的地的运输过程中，将货物从一种运输工具卸下，再装载到另一种运输工具上（无论是否涉及不同运输方式）。

Query_Text_en: c. i. A transport document may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same transport document .
Translation: c. i. 运输单据可以注明货物将会或可能进行转运，但前提是整个运输过程均由同一份运输单据涵盖。

Query_Text_en: ii . A transport document indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable , even if the credit prohibits transhipment .
Translation: ii. 即使信用证禁止转运，注明将进行或可能进行转运的运输单据也是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: pre-printed wording , or an on board notation indicating the date on which the goods have been shipped on board .
Translation: 预先印制的文字，或在提单上注明货物装船日期的标记。

Query_Text_en: The date of issuance of the bill of lading will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the bill of lading contains an on board notation indicating the date of shipment , in which case the date stated in the on board notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 提单的签发日期将被视为装运日期，除非提单上有注明装船日期的“已装船批注”，在此情况下，批注中注明的日期将被视为装运日期。

Query_Text_en: If the bill of lading contains the indication `` intended vessel '' or similar qualification in relation to the name of the vessel , an on board notation indicating the date of shipment and the name of the actual vessel is required .
Translation: 如果提单中关于船名含有“预定船舶”或类似限定词，则须加注已装船批注，注明装运日期及实际船名。

Query_Text_en: iii . indicate shipment from the port of loading to the port of discharge stated in the credit .
Translation: 三、注明从信用证规定的装运港至卸货港的运输。

Query_Text_en: If the bill of lading does not indicate the port of loading stated in the credit as the port of loading , or if it contains the indication `` intended '' or similar qualification in relation to the port of loading , an on board notation indicating the port of loading as stated in the credit , the date of shipment and the name of the vessel is required .
Translation: 如果提单未将信用证中规定的装货港标明为装货港，或在装货港栏中出现“预定”或类似限定性表述，则必须加注装货港（与信用证一致）、装船日期及船名的已装船批注。

Query_Text_en: This provision applies even when loading on board or shipment on a named vessel is indicated by pre-printed wording on the bill of lading .
Translation: 即使提单上通过预印文字注明已装船或已装载至指定船舶，本条款仍然适用。

Query_Text_en: iv . be the sole original bill of lading or , if issued in more than one original , be the full set as indicated on the bill of lading .
Translation: 四、须为唯一的正本提单，或如有多份正本，则须提交提单上所注明的全部正本。

Query_Text_en: iv . contain terms and conditions of carriage or make reference to another source containing the terms and conditions of carriage [ short form or blank back bill of lading ] .
Translation: 四、载明运输条款和条件，或引用包含运输条款和条件的其他来源（简式或背面空白提单）。

Query_Text_en: b. For the purpose of this article , transhipment means unloading from one vessel and reloading to another vessel during the carriage from the port of loading to the port of discharge stated in the credit .
Translation: b. 本条所称“转运”是指在信用证规定的装运港至卸货港运输过程中，将货物从一艘船卸下并重新装载到另一艘船上的行为。

Query_Text_en: c. i. A bill of lading may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same bill of lading .
Translation: c. i. 提单可以注明货物将进行或可能进行转运，前提是整个运输过程由同一份提单覆盖。

Query_Text_en: ii . A bill of lading indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable , even if the credit prohibits transhipment , if the goods have been shipped in a container , trailer or LASH barge as evidenced by the bill of lading .
Translation: ii. 即使信用证禁止转运，只要提单显示货物已以集装箱、拖车或LASH驳船方式装运，并由提单予以证明，注明将进行或可能进行转运的提单也是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: d. Clauses in a bill of lading stating that the carrier reserves the right to tranship will be disregarded .
Translation: d. 提单中载明承运人保留转运权利的条款将不予考虑。

Query_Text_en: The date of issuance of the non-negotiable sea waybill will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the non-negotiable sea waybill contains an on board notation indicating the date of shipment , in which case the date stated in the on board notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 不可转让海运提单的签发日期将被视为装运日期，除非该提单上载有注明装运日期的已装船批注，在此情况下，批注中所载日期将被视为装运日期。

Query_Text_en: If the non-negotiable sea waybill contains the indication `` intended vessel '' or similar qualification in relation to the name of the vessel , an on board notation indicating the date of shipment and the name of the actual vessel is required .
Translation: 如果不可转让的海运单上关于船名含有“预定船舶”或类似限定词，则须加注已装船批注，注明装运日期及实际船名。

Query_Text_en: If the non-negotiable sea waybill does not indicate the port of loading stated in the credit as the port of loading , or if it contains the indication `` intended '' or similar qualification in relation to the port of loading , an on board notation indicating the port of loading as stated in the credit , the date of shipment and the name of the vessel is required .
Translation: 如果不可转让海运单未将信用证中规定的装货港作为装货港予以注明，或在装货港相关信息中出现“预定”或类似限定词，则必须加注一则装船批注，注明信用证规定的装货港、装船日期及船名。

Query_Text_en: This provision applies even when loading on board or shipment on a named vessel is indicated by pre-printed wording on the non-negotiable sea waybill .
Translation: 即使不可转让海运提单上有预先印刷的装船或指定船舶的字样，本条款仍然适用。

Query_Text_en: iv . be the sole original non-negotiable sea waybill or , if issued in more than one original , be the full set as indicated on the non-negotiable sea waybill .
Translation: iv. 应为唯一正本不可转让的海运单，或如签发多份正本，则应提交不可转让海运单上所注明的全套正本。

Query_Text_en: v. contain terms and conditions of carriage or make reference to another source containing the terms and conditions of carriage [ short form or blank back non-negotiable sea waybill ] .
Translation: 五、包含运输条款和条件，或引用其他载有运输条款和条件的来源（适用于简式或背面空白的不可转让海运单）。

Query_Text_en: c. i. A non-negotiable sea waybill may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same non-negotiable sea waybill .
Translation: c. i. 不可转让海运单可以注明货物将会或可能会转运，但前提是整个运输过程均由同一份不可转让海运单覆盖。

Query_Text_en: ii . A non-negotiable sea waybill indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable , even if the credit prohibits transhipment , if the goods have been shipped in a container , trailer or LASH barge as evidenced by the non-negotiable sea waybill .
Translation: ii. 即使信用证禁止转运，只要不可转让的海运单据表明货物已以集装箱、拖车或LASH驳船方式装运，并且该单据显示将进行或可能进行转运，则该不可转让海运单据也是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: d. Clauses in a non-negotiable sea waybill stating that the carrier reserves the right to tranship will be disregarded .
Translation: d. 不可转让海运提单中载明承运人保留转船权利的条款将被视为无效。

Query_Text_en: the master or a named agent for or on behalf of the master , or the owner or a named agent for or on behalf of the owner , or the charterer or a named agent for or on behalf of the charterer .
Translation: 船长或其指定代理人，代表船长行事；或船东或其指定代理人，代表船东行事；或租船人或其指定代理人，代表租船人行事。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by the master , owner , charterer or agent must be identified as that of the master , owner , charterer or agent .
Translation: 船长、船东、租船人或代理人签署的任何文件，必须明确标明其身份为船长、船东、租船人或代理人。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by an agent must indicate whether the agent has signed for or on behalf of the master , owner or charterer .
Translation: 代理人签署时必须明确其是代表船东、所有人还是租船人签署。

Query_Text_en: An agent signing for or on behalf of the owner or charterer must indicate the name of the owner or charterer .
Translation: 代理人以所有人或租船人名义签署文件时，必须注明所有人或租船人的名称。

Query_Text_en: The date of issuance of the charter party bill of lading will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the charter party bill of lading contains an on board notation indicating the date of shipment , in which case the date stated in the on board notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 租船提单的签发日期将被视为装运日期，除非租船提单上有注明装船日期的批注，在此情况下，批注中所注明的日期将被视为装运日期。

Query_Text_en: The port of discharge may also be shown as a range of ports or a geographical area , as stated in the credit .
Translation: 卸货港也可以按照信用证的规定，显示为一系列港口或某一地理区域。

Query_Text_en: iv . be the sole original charter party bill of lading or , if issued in more than one original , be the full set as indicated on the charter party bill of lading .
Translation: iv. 为唯一的正本租船提单，或如签发多份正本，则应提交租船提单上所注明的全套正本。

Query_Text_en: b. A bank will not examine charter party contracts , even if they are required to be presented by the terms of the credit .
Translation: b. 即使信用证条款要求提交租船合同，银行也不会对租船合同进行审查。

Query_Text_en: the carrier , or a named agent for or on behalf of the carrier .
Translation: 承运人或承运人指定的代理人。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by the carrier or agent must be identified as that of the carrier or agent .
Translation: 承运人或其代理人的任何签字，必须明确标明其为承运人或代理人所签。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by an agent must indicate that the agent has signed for or on behalf of the carrier .
Translation: 代理人签署时必须明确表示其是代表承运人或以承运人名义进行签署。

Query_Text_en: ii . indicate that the goods have been accepted for carriage .
Translation: ii. 表明货物已被接受运输。

Query_Text_en: iii . indicate the date of issuance .
Translation: 三、注明签发日期。

Query_Text_en: This date will be deemed to be the date of shipment unless the air transport document contains a specific notation of the actual date of shipment , in which case the date stated in the notation will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 除非航空运输单据上注明了实际装运日期，否则该日期将被视为装运日期；如有注明，则以注明的日期为装运日期。

Query_Text_en: Any other information appearing on the air transport document relative to the flight number and date will not be considered in determining the date of shipment .
Translation: 航空运输单据上除航班号和日期以外的其他信息，不应作为确定发运日期的依据。

Query_Text_en: iv . indicate the airport of departure and the airport of destination stated in the credit .
Translation: iv. 标明信用证中规定的出发机场和目的机场。

Query_Text_en: v. be the original for consignor or shipper , even if the credit stipulates a full set of originals .
Translation: v. 即使信用证要求提供全套正本，发货人或托运人也应为正本签发人。

Query_Text_en: vi . contain terms and conditions of carriage or make reference to another source containing the terms and conditions of carriage .
Translation: 六、应包含运输条款和条件，或提及载有运输条款和条件的其他来源。

Query_Text_en: b. For the purpose of this article , transhipment means unloading from one aircraft and reloading to another aircraft during the carriage from the airport of departure to the airport of destination stated in the credit .
Translation: b. 本条所称转运，是指在信用证规定的始发机场至目的机场运输过程中，将货物从一架飞机卸下并重新装载到另一架飞机上的行为。

Query_Text_en: c. i. An air transport document may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped , provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same air transport document .
Translation: c. i. 航空运输单据可以注明货物将进行或可能进行转运，但前提是整个运输过程均由同一份航空运输单据涵盖。

Query_Text_en: ii . An air transport document indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable , even if the credit prohibits transhipment .
Translation: ii. 即使信用证禁止转运，注明将进行或可能进行转运的航空运输单证也是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: i. indicate the name of the carrier and : be signed by the carrier or a named agent for or on behalf of the carrier , or indicate receipt of the goods by signature , stamp or notation by the carrier or a named agent for or on behalf of the carrier .
Translation: i. 应注明承运人名称，并由承运人或其指定代理人代表承运人签字，或由承运人或其指定代理人代表承运人以签字、盖章或批注的方式确认已收到货物。

Query_Text_en: Any signature , stamp or notation of receipt of the goods by the carrier or agent must be identified as that of the carrier or agent .
Translation: 承运人或代理人对货物的任何签字、盖章或收货标记，必须明确标识为承运人或代理人的签署。

Query_Text_en: Any signature , stamp or notation of receipt of the goods by the agent must indicate that the agent has signed or acted for or on behalf of the carrier .
Translation: 代理人对货物的任何签字、盖章或收货标记，必须表明代理人是代表承运人签署或操作的。

Query_Text_en: If a rail transport document does not identify the carrier , any signature or stamp of the railway company will be accepted as evidence of the document being signed by the carrier .
Translation: 如果铁路运输单证未注明承运人，铁路公司的任何签字或盖章均可作为该单证由承运人签署的有效凭证。

Query_Text_en: ii . indicate the date of shipment or the date the goods have been received for shipment , dispatch or carriage at the place stated in the credit .
Translation: 二、注明装运日期或货物在信用证规定地点已接受装运、发运或运输的日期。

Query_Text_en: Unless the transport document contains a dated reception , stamp , an indication of the date of receipt or a date of shipment , the date of issuance of the transport document will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 除非运输单据上包含有注明收货日期的印章、收货日期或发运日期，否则运输单据的签发日期将被视为发运日期。

Query_Text_en: iii . indicate the place of shipment and the place of destination stated in the credit .
Translation: 三、注明信用证中规定的装运地点和目的地。

Query_Text_en: b. i. A road transport document must appear to be the original for consignor or shipper or bear no marking indicating for whom the document has been prepared .
Translation: b. i. 道路运输单据必须为托运人或发货人的正本，或未标明为谁制备该单据的任何标记。

Query_Text_en: ii . A rail transport document marked `` duplicate '' will be accepted as an original .
Translation: ii. 标有“副本”字样的铁路运输单证将被视为正本接受。

Query_Text_en: iii . A rail or inland waterway transport document will be accepted as an original whether marked as an original or not .
Translation: iii. 铁路或内河运输单据，无论是否标注为正本，均可作为正本接受。

Query_Text_en: c. In the absence of an indication on the transport document as to the number of originals issued , the number presented will be deemed to constitute a full set .
Translation: c. 如果运输单据上未注明正本的份数，则提交的数量将被视为一套完整的正本。

Query_Text_en: d. For the purpose of this article , transhipment means unloading from one means of conveyance and reloading to another means of conveyance , within the same mode of transport , during the carriage from the place of shipment , dispatch or carriage to the place of destination stated in the credit .
Translation: d. 本条所称“转运”，是指在同一运输方式下，将货物从一种运输工具卸下，再装载到另一种运输工具，且该过程发生在从信用证所载发货地、起运地或运输地到目的地的运输途中。

Query_Text_en: e. i. A road , rail or inland waterway transport document may indicate that the goods will or may be transhipped provided that the entire carriage is covered by one and the same transport document .
Translation: e. i. 公路、铁路或内河运输单据可以注明货物将进行或可能进行转运，但前提是整个运输过程由同一份运输单据涵盖。

Query_Text_en: ii . A road , rail or inland waterway transport document indicating that transhipment will or may take place is acceptable , even if the credit prohibits transhipment .
Translation: ii. 即使信用证禁止转运，注明将进行或可能进行转运的公路、铁路或内陆水路运输单据也是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: andii . indicate a date of pick-up or of receipt or wording to this effect .
Translation: 并注明提货日期、收货日期或类似表述。

Query_Text_en: This date will be deemed to be the date of shipment .
Translation: 该日期将被视为发货日期。

Query_Text_en: b. A requirement that courier charges are to be paid or prepaid may be satisfied by a transport document issued by a courier service evidencing that courier charges are for the account of a party other than the consignee .
Translation: b. 关于快递费用需由某方支付或预付的要求，可以通过快递公司出具的运输单据予以满足，只要该单据显示快递费用由收货人以外的其他方承担。

Query_Text_en: c. A post receipt or certificate of posting , however named , evidencing receipt of goods for transport , must appear to be stamped or signed and dated at the place from which the credit states the goods are to be shipped .
Translation: c. 无论名称为何，能够证明货物已收运的邮寄收据或寄件证明，必须在信用证规定的发货地点加盖印章或签字，并注明日期。

Query_Text_en: a. A transport document must not indicate that the goods are or will be loaded on deck .
Translation: a. 运输单据不得显示货物已在甲板上装载或将被装载于甲板上。

Query_Text_en: A clause on a transport document stating that the goods may be loaded on deck is acceptable .
Translation: 运输单据中注明货物可以装载于甲板的条款是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: b. A transport document bearing a clause such as `` shipper '' s load and count '' and `` said by shipper to contain '' is acceptable .
Translation: b. 承运单证上带有“由托运人装载和计数”或“据托运人称所载货物”等类似条款是可以接受的。

Query_Text_en: c. A transport document may bear a reference , by stamp or otherwise , to charges additional to the freight .
Translation: c. 运输单证可以通过盖章或其他方式注明除运费之外的其他费用。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 27 Clean Transport DocumentA bank will only accept a clean transport document .
Translation:
第27条 清洁运输单据  
银行只会接受清洁运输单据。

Query_Text_en: A clean transport document is one bearing no clause or notation expressly declaring a defective condition of the goods or their packaging .
Translation: 清洁运输单据是指未载明货物或其包装存在缺陷的条款或注明的单据。

Query_Text_en: The word `` clean '' need not appear on a transport document , even if a credit has a requirement for that transport document to be `` clean on board '' .
Translation: 即使信用证要求运输单据注明“清洁已装船”，运输单据上也不必出现“clean”一词。

Query_Text_en: a. An insurance document , such as an insurance policy , an insurance certificate or a declaration under an open cover , must appear to be issued and signed by an insurance company , an underwriter or their agents or their proxies .
Translation: a. 保险单证，如保险单、保险凭证或预约保险声明，必须由保险公司、承保人或其代理人、代表出具并签署。

Query_Text_en: Any signature by an agent or proxy must indicate whether the agent or proxy has signed for or on behalf of the insurance company or underwriter .
Translation: 代理人或代表签署的任何签名，必须明确注明该代理人或代表是以保险公司或承保人的名义，还是代表其进行签署。

Query_Text_en: b. When the insurance document indicates that it has been issued in more than one original , all originals must be presented .
Translation: b. 当保险单据注明为多份正本时，须提交所有正本。

Query_Text_en: c. Cover notes will not be accepted .
Translation: c. 不接受附加说明。

Query_Text_en: d. An insurance policy is acceptable in lieu of an insurance certificate or a declaration under an open cover .
Translation: d. 保险单可作为保险凭证或开放保单项下声明的替代文件予以接受。

Query_Text_en: e. The date of the insurance document must be no later than the date of shipment , unless it appears from the insurance document that the cover is effective from a date not later than the date of shipment .
Translation: e. 保险单日期不得晚于发货日期，除非保险单上显示保险责任自不晚于发货日期起生效。

Query_Text_en: f. i. The insurance document must indicate the amount of insurance coverage and be in the same currency as the credit .
Translation: f. i. 保险单必须注明保险金额，并且币种应与信用证一致。

Query_Text_en: ii . A requirement in the credit for insurance coverage to be for a percentage of the value of the goods , of the invoice value or similar is deemed to be the minimum amount of coverage required .
Translation: ii. 信用证中关于保险金额需为货物价值、发票金额或类似金额一定百分比的要求，应视为保险最低承保金额的要求。

Query_Text_en: If there is no indication in the credit of the insurance coverage required , the amount of insurance coverage must be at least 110 % of the CIF or CIP value of the goods .
Translation: 如信用证中未注明所需的保险金额，保险金额必须至少为货物CIF或CIP价值的110%。

Query_Text_en: When the CIF or CIP value can not be determined from the documents , the amount of insurance coverage must be calculated on the basis of the amount for which honor or negotiation is requested or the gross value of the goods as shown on the invoice , whichever is greater .
Translation: 当无法从单据中确定CIF或CIP价值时，保险金额必须按照申请承兑或议付的金额，或发票上所示货物的总价值（以较高者为准）计算。

Query_Text_en: iii . The insurance document must indicate that risks are covered at least between the place of taking in charge or shipment and the place of discharge or final destination as stated in the credit .
Translation: iii. 保险单据必须表明，保险责任至少覆盖从提货地或装运地至信用证所规定的卸货地或最终目的地的区间。

Query_Text_en: g. A credit should state the type of insurance required and , if any , the additional risks to be covered .
Translation: g. 信用证应注明所需保险类型，并说明需额外承保的风险（如有）。

Query_Text_en: An insurance document will be accepted without regard to any risks that are not covered if the credit uses imprecise terms such as `` usual risks '' or `` customary risks '' .
Translation: 如果信用证使用“通常风险”或“习惯风险”等不明确术语，保险单将被接受，而不考虑未承保的任何风险。

Query_Text_en: h. When a credit requires insurance against `` all risks '' and an insurance document is presented containing any `` all risks '' notation or clause , whether or not bearing the heading `` all risks '' , the insurance document will be accepted without regard to any risks stated to be excluded .
Translation: h. 当信用证要求投保“全险”，且提交的保险单包含任何“全险”字样或条款，无论是否以“全险”为标题，保险单将被接受，而不考虑其中声明排除的任何风险。

Query_Text_en: i. An insurance document may contain reference to any exclusion clause .
Translation: 保险文件中可能包含对任何除外条款的引用。

Query_Text_en: j. An insurance document may indicate that the cover is subject to a franchise or excess [ deductible ] .
Translation: j. 保险文件可能会注明保险责任以免赔额或自负额为条件。

Query_Text_en: a. If the expiry date of a credit or the last day for presentation falls on a day when the bank to which presentation is to be made is closed for reasons other than those referred to in article 36 , the expiry date or the last day for presentation , as the case may be , will be extended to the first following banking day .
Translation: 如果信用证的到期日或提交文件的最后期限恰逢受理银行因第36条未提及的原因关闭，则到期日或提交文件的最后期限将顺延至其后第一个营业日。

Query_Text_en: b. If presentation is made on the first following banking day , a nominated bank must provide the issuing bank or confirming bank with a statement on its covering schedule that the presentation was made within the time limits extended in accordance with sub-article 29 [ a ] .
Translation: b. 如在下一个营业日进行交单，指定银行必须在其附带的文件中向开证行或保兑行说明，交单是在根据第29[a]款延长的时限内完成的。

Query_Text_en: c. The latest date for shipment will not be extended as a result of sub-article 29 [ a ] .
Translation: c. 根据第29[a]款，最迟装运日期不得延长。

Query_Text_en: a The Uniform Rules for Collections ,1995 Revision , ICC Publication No 522 , shall apply to all collections as defined in Article 2 where such rules are incorporated into the text of the `` collection instruction '' referred to in Article 4 and are binding on all parties thereto unless otherwise expressly agreed or contrary to the provisions of a national , state or local law and or regulation which can not be departed from
Translation: 1995年修订的《托收统一规则》（ICC出版物第522号）应适用于所有第二条所定义的托收，只要这些规则被纳入第四条所述的“托收指示”文本中，并对所有相关方具有约束力，除非另有明确约定，或存在不可违背的国家、州或地方法律和/或法规的规定。

Query_Text_en: b Banks shall have no obligation to handle either a collection or any collection instruction or subsequent related instructions
Translation: b 银行没有义务处理任何托收、任何托收指令或后续相关指令。

Query_Text_en: c If a bank elects , for any reason , not to handle a collection or any related instructions received by it , it must advise the party from whom it received the collection or the instructions by telecommunication or if that is not possible , by other expeditious means , without delay
Translation: 如果银行因任何原因选择不办理其收到的托收或相关指示，必须立即通过电讯方式，或如无法通过电讯，则以其他快捷方式，通知向其提交托收或指示的一方。

Query_Text_en: iii deliver documents on other terms and conditions
Translation: 三、在其他条款和条件下交付文件

Query_Text_en: b `` Documents '' means financial documents and or commercial documents :
Translation: b “单据”是指财务单据和/或商业单据：

Query_Text_en: ii `` Commercial documents '' means invoices , transport documents , documents of title or other similar documents , or any other documents whatsoever , not being financial documents
Translation: ii “商业文件”是指发票、运输文件、所有权文件或其他类似文件，或任何其他文件，但不包括金融文件。

Query_Text_en: c `` Clean collection '' means collection of financial documents not accompanied by commercial documents
Translation: “光票托收”是指仅附有金融单据而不附带商业单据的托收。

Query_Text_en: ii Commercial documents not accompanied by financial documents
Translation: ii 未附带金融文件的商业文件

Query_Text_en: iv the `` presenting bank '' which is the collecting bank making presentation to the drawee
Translation: iv “提示银行”，即向付款人进行提示的代收银行

Query_Text_en: b The `` drawee '' is the one to whom presentation is to be made in accordance with the collection instruction B Form and structure of collections
Translation:
b “付款人”是根据托收指示进行提示的对象  
B 托收的形式和结构

Query_Text_en: a i All documents sent for collection must be accompanied by a collection instruction indicating that the collection is subject to URC 522 and giving complete and precise instructions Banks are only permitted to act upon the instructions given in such collection instruction , and in accordance with these Rules
Translation: 所有提交托收的单据必须附有托收指示书，明确说明本次托收受《托收统一规则》（URC 522）约束，并提供完整、明确的指示。银行仅可根据该托收指示书中的指示及本规则行事。

Query_Text_en: iii Unless otherwise authorised in the collection instruction , banks will disregard any instructions from any party bank , other than the party bank from whom they received the collection
Translation: 除非托收指示另有授权，银行将忽略除其收到托收的相关方银行之外任何其他相关方银行的指示。

Query_Text_en: xi Instructions in case of nonpayment , non acceptance and or non compliance with other instructions
Translation: xi 如遇拒付、拒收及/或未遵守其他指示时的处理指示

Query_Text_en: c i Collection instructions should bear the complete address of the drawee or of the domicile at which the presentation is to be made If the address is incomplete or incorrect , the collecting bank may , without any liability and responsibility on its part , endeavor to ascertain the proper address
Translation: 托收指示应注明付款人或应进行提示的付款地点的完整地址。如地址不完整或不正确，代收银行可在不承担任何责任和义务的情况下，设法查明正确地址。

Query_Text_en: ii The collecting bank will not be liable or responsible for any ensuing delay as a result of an incomplete incorrect address being provided
Translation: ii. 如因所提供地址不完整或不正确而导致后续延误，代收银行不承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: a For the purposes of these Articles , presentation is the procedure whereby the presenting bank makes the documents available to the drawee as instructed
Translation: 在本章程中，提交是指提交银行按照指示向付款人提供相关单据的程序。

Query_Text_en: b The collection instruction should state the exact period of time within which any action is to be taken by the drawee Expressions such as `` first '' , `` prompt '' , `` immediate '' , and the like should not be used in connection with presentation or with reference to any period of time within which documents have to be taken up or for any other action that is to be taken by the drawee If such terms are used banks will disregard them
Translation: b. 托收指示应明确说明付款人需采取任何行动的具体时间期限。不得在提交单据或提及付款人需提取单据或采取任何其他行动的时间期限时，使用“第一时间”、“迅速”、“立即”等类似表述。如果使用了此类术语，银行将予以忽略。

Query_Text_en: c Documents are to be presented to the drawee in the form in which they are received , except that banks are authorised to affix any necessary stamps , at the expense of the party from whom they received the collection unless otherwise instructed , and to make any necessary endorsements or place any rubber stamps or other identifying marks or symbols customary to or required for the collection operation
Translation: 文件应以收到时的形式提交给付款人，但银行有权在未另行指示的情况下，在收到托收文件的一方承担费用的前提下，盖上任何必要的印章，并进行必要的背书或加盖橡皮印章或其他用于托收操作的惯常或所需的标识符号。

Query_Text_en: d For the purpose of giving effect to the instructions of the principal , the remitting bank will utilise the bank nominated by the principal as the collecting bank In the absence of such nomination , the remitting bank will utilise any bank of its own , or another bank 's choice in the country of payment or acceptance or in the country where other terms and conditions have to be complied with
Translation: 为执行委托人的指示，汇款银行将使用委托人指定的银行作为托收银行。如未指定，汇款银行可在付款或承兑所在国，或需履行其他条款和条件的国家，选择本行或其他银行作为托收银行。

Query_Text_en: e The documents and collection instruction may be sent directly by the remitting bank to the collecting bank or through another bank as intermediary
Translation: 文件和托收指示可由托收行直接发送至代收行，或通过其他银行作为中介转递。

Query_Text_en: f If the remitting bank does not nominate a specific presenting bank , the collecting bank may utilise a presenting bank 6f its choice
Translation: 如果汇款银行未指定具体的提示银行，代收银行可以自行选择提示银行。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 SIGHT ACCEPTANCE
Translation: 第六条 现场验收

Query_Text_en: In the case of documents payable at sight the presenting bank must make presentation for payment without delay In the case of documents payable at a tenor other than sight the presenting bank must , where acceptance is called for , make presentation for acceptance without delay , and where payment is called for , make presentation for payment not later than the appropriate maturity date
Translation: 对于见票即付的单据，提示行必须毫不延误地进行付款提示。对于远期付款的单据，如需承兑，提示行必须毫不延误地进行承兑提示；如需付款，提示行必须不迟于相应到期日进行付款提示。

Query_Text_en: a Collections should not contain bills of exchange payable at a future date with instructions that commercial documents are to be delivered against payment
Translation: a. 托收项下不得包含远期付款的汇票，并附有凭付款交付商业单据的指示。

Query_Text_en: b If a collection contains a bill of exchange payable at a future date , the collection instruction should state whether the commercial documents are to be released to the drawee against acceptance D A or against payment D P In the absence of such statement commercial documents will be released only against payment and the collecting bank will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of documents
Translation: 如果托收项下包含一张远期付款的汇票，托收指示应明确说明商业单据应在承兑交单（D/A）还是付款交单（D/P）的条件下交付给付款人。如未作此说明，商业单据将仅在付款后交付，收款银行对因单据交付延误所产生的任何后果不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: c If a collection contains a bill of exchange payable at a future date and the collection instruction indicates that commercial documents are to be released against payment , documents will be released only against such payment and the collecting bank will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of documents
Translation: 如果托收项下包含一张远期汇票，且托收指示要求凭付款交付商业单据，则单据仅在收到付款后交付，代收行对于因单据交付延迟而产生的任何后果不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 CREATION OF DOCUMENTSWhere the remitting bank instructs that either the collecting bank or the drawee is to create documents hills of exchange , promissory notes , trust receipts , letters of undertaking or other documents that were not included in the collection , the form and wording of such documents shall be provided by the remitting bank otherwise the collecting bank shall not be liable or responsible for the form and wording of any such document provided by the collecting bank and or the drawee
Translation:
第八条 文件的制作

如托收行指示，由代收行或付款人制作文件（如汇票、本票、信托收据、承诺书或其他未包含在托收项下的文件），则此类文件的格式和内容应由托收行提供，否则，代收行对其自行或由付款人提供的任何此类文件的格式和内容不承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9 GOOD FAITH AND REASONABLE CAREBanks will act in good faith and exercise reasonable care
Translation:
第九条 诚信与合理注意  
银行应本着诚信原则行事，并采取合理的注意措施。

Query_Text_en: a Goods should not be despatched directly to the address of a bank or consigned to or to the order of a bank without prior agreement on the part of that bank Nevertheless , in the event that goods are despatched directly to the address of a bank or consigned to or to the order of a bank for release to a drawee against payment or acceptance or upon other terms and conditions without prior agreement on the part of that bank , such bank shall have no obligation to take delivery of the goods , which remain at the risk and responsibility of the party despatching the goods
Translation: 货物不得在未经银行事先同意的情况下，直接发运至银行地址或以银行为收货人或按银行指示发运。然而，如货物在未经银行事先同意的情况下，直接发运至银行地址或以银行为收货人或按银行指示发运，并要求银行在付款、承兑或其他条件下向付款人放货，则该银行没有义务接收货物，货物的风险和责任仍由发货方承担。

Query_Text_en: b Banks have no obligation to take any action in respect of the goods to which a documentary collection relates , including storage and insurance of the goods even when specific instructions are given to do so Banks will only take such action if , when , and to the extent that they agree to do so in each case Notwithstanding the provisions of sub Article c this rule applies even in the absence of any specific advice to this effect by the collecting bank
Translation: b 银行没有义务对与跟单托收相关的货物采取任何行动，包括货物的储存和保险，即使已收到具体指示。银行仅在每一情况下同意时，才会采取相应行动，且仅在其同意的时间和范围内。尽管有c款的规定，本规则即使在代收银行未就此提出任何具体建议的情况下，亦适用。

Query_Text_en: c Nevertheless , in the case that banks take action for the protection of the goods , whether instructed or not , they assume no liability or responsibility with regard to the fate and or condition of the goods and or for any acts and or omissions on the part of any third parties entrusted with the custody and or protection of the goods However , the collecting bank must advise without delay the bank from which the collection instruction was received of any such action taken
Translation: 然而，无论银行是否受指示采取措施保护货物，银行对于货物的命运和状况，以及任何受托保管或保护货物的第三方的行为或疏忽，均不承担任何责任或义务。但收款银行必须立即将所采取的相关措施通知发出托收指示的银行。

Query_Text_en: d Any charges and or expenses incurred by banks in connection with any action taken to protect the goods will be for the account of the party from whom they received the collection
Translation: 因银行为保护货物所采取的任何措施而产生的所有费用和支出，均由向其提交托收的当事方承担。

Query_Text_en: e i Notwithstanding the provisions of sub Article 10 a , where the goods are consigned to or to the order of the collecting bank and the drawee has honored the collection by payment , acceptance or other terms and conditions , and the collecting bank arranges for the release of the goods , the remitting bank shall be deemed to have authorised the collecting bank to do so
Translation: 尽管第10(a)款有相关规定，但如果货物是发运给代收行或按其指示发运，并且付款人已通过付款、承兑或其他条款履行了托收，且代收行安排放货，则视为委托行已授权代收行作出上述安排。

Query_Text_en: ii Where a collecting bank on the instructions of the remitting bank or in terms of sub Article 10 e i , arranges for the release of the goods , the remitting bank shall indemnify such collecting bank for all damages and expenses incurred
Translation: ii 若代收行根据托收行的指示或根据第10条e款第i项的规定安排放货，托收行应赔偿该代收行因此产生的所有损失和费用。

Query_Text_en: c A party instructing another party to perform services shall be bound by and liable to indemnify the instructed party against all obligations and responsibilities imposed by foreign laws and usages
Translation: 委托一方指示另一方提供服务时，应承担并负责赔偿受指示方因外国法律及惯例所产生的全部义务和责任。

Query_Text_en: a Banks must determine that the documents received appear to be as listed in the collection instruction and must advise by telecommunication or , if that is not possible , by other expeditious means , without delay , the party from whom the collection instruction was received of any documents missing , of found to be other than listed Banks have no further obligation in this respect
Translation: 银行必须确认所收到的单据与托收指示中所列内容相符，并应通过电讯方式，或在无法电讯时以其他快捷方式，立即通知发出托收指示的一方有关单据的缺失或与所列不符的情况。对此，银行不再承担进一步义务。

Query_Text_en: c Subject to sub Article 5 c and sub Articles 12 a and 12 b above , banks will present documents as received without further examination
Translation: 在遵守上述第5条c款及第12条a款和第12条b款的前提下，银行将按收到的文件进行提交，无需进一步审查。

Query_Text_en: nor do they assume any liability or responsibility for the description , quantity , weight , quality , condition , packing , delivery , value or existence of the goods represented by any document s , or for the good faith or acts and or omissions , solvency , performance or standing of the consignors , the carriers , the forwarders , the consignees or the insurers of the goods , or any other person whomsoever
Translation: 他们亦不对任何单据所代表货物的描述、数量、重量、质量、状况、包装、交付、价值或实际存在承担任何责任，也不对货物的发货人、承运人、货运代理人、收货人或保险人，或任何其他相关人员的诚信、行为及/或疏忽、偿付能力、履约情况或信誉承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: b Banks will not be liable or responsible for any delays resulting from the need to obtain clarification of any instructions received
Translation: 银行对于因需对所接收指令进行澄清而导致的任何延误，不承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15FORCE MAJEUREBanks assume no liability or responsibility for consequences arising out of the interruption of their business by Acts of GOd , riots , civil commotions , insurrections , wars , or any other causes beyond their control or by strikes or lockout
Translation:
第十五条 不可抗力  
银行因天灾、骚乱、民事动乱、叛乱、战争或其他不可控原因，或因罢工或停工导致业务中断所产生的后果，概不承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: b Notwithstanding the provisions of sub Article 1 c , and unless otherwise agreed , the collecting bank will effect payment of the amount collected in favor of the remitting bank only
Translation: b 尽管有第1(c)款的规定，除非另有约定，代收行仅会将所收款项支付给托收行。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 17 PAYMENT IN LCK ` AL CURRENCYIn the case of documents payable in the currency of the country of payment local currency , the presenting bank must , unless otherwise instructed in the collection instruction , release the documents to the drawee against payment in local currency only if such currency is immediately available for disposal in the manner specified in the collection instruction
Translation:
第十七条 本地货币支付  
对于以支付国货币支付的单据，除非托收指示另有规定，提交银行必须仅在该货币能够按照托收指示中规定的方式立即用于处置时，才可在收到本地货币付款后将单据交付给付款人。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18 PAYMENT IN FOREIGN CURRENCYIn the case of documents payable in a currency other than that of the country of payment foreign currency , the presenting bank must , unless otherwise instructed in the collection instruction , re lease the documents to the drawee against payment in the designated foreign currency only if such foreign currency can immediately be remitted in accordance with the instructions given in the collection instruction
Translation:
第十八条 外币付款

如单据需以付款国家货币以外的其他货币支付，除非托收指示另有规定，提交银行仅在被指定的外币能够按照托收指示的要求即时汇出的情况下，方可在收到该指定外币付款后将单据交付给付款人。

Query_Text_en: a In respect of clean collections , partial payments may be accepted if and to the extent to which and on the conditions on which partial payments are authorised by the law in force in the place of payment The financial document s will be released to the drawee only when full payment thereof has been received
Translation: 关于光票托收，部分付款可予接受，但须符合付款地现行法律所允许的范围和条件。财务单据仅在收到全部款项后方可交付给付款人。

Query_Text_en: b in respect of documentary collections , partial payments will only be accepted if specifically authorised in the collection instruction However , unless otherwise instructed , the presenting bank will release the documents to the drawee only after full payment has been received , and the presenting bank will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of documents
Translation: 在托收业务中，只有在托收指示中明确授权的情况下，才可接受部分付款。然而，除非另有指示，提交银行将在收到全额付款后才向付款人交付单据，并且提交银行对于因单据交付延迟所产生的任何后果不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: c In all cases partial payments will be accepted only subject to compliance with the provisions of either Article 17 or Article 18 as appropriate Partial payment , if accepted , will be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of Article 16
Translation: 在所有情况下，只有在符合第17条或第18条相关规定的前提下，才会接受部分付款。如部分付款被接受，将按照第16条的规定处理。

Query_Text_en: a If the collection instruction specifies that interest is to be collected and the drawee refuses to pay such interest , the presenting bank may deliver the document s against payment or acceptance or on other terms and conditions as the case may be , without collecting such interest , unless sub Article 20 c applies
Translation: 如果托收指示中规定需收取利息，而付款人拒绝支付该利息，除非适用第20条c款，提示行可以在未收取该利息的情况下，按照具体情况凭付款、承兑或其他条款和条件交付单据。

Query_Text_en: b Where such interest is to be collected , the collection instruction must specify the rate of interest , interest period and basis of calculation
Translation: 如需收取该项利息，收款指令必须明确利率、计息期间及计算依据。

Query_Text_en: c Where the collection instruction expressly states that interest may not be waived and the drawee refuses to pay such interest the presenting bank will not deliver documents and will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of document s When payment of interest has been refused , the presenting bank must inform by telecommunication or , if that is not possible , by other expeditious means without delay the bank from which the collection instruction was received
Translation: c. 如果托收指示中明确规定利息不得减免，而付款人拒绝支付该利息，代收行将不会交付单据，并且对因单据交付延误所产生的任何后果不承担责任。当利息被拒付时，代收行必须立即通过电讯方式，或如无法通过电讯，则应以其他快捷方式，及时通知发出托收指示的银行。

Query_Text_en: a If the collection instruction specifies that collection charges and or expenses are to tie for account of the drawee and the drawee refuses to pay them the presenting bank may deliver the document s against payment or acceptance or on other terms and conditions as the case may be , without collecting charges and or expenses , unless sub Article 21 b applies Whenever collection charges and or expenses are so waived they will be for the account of the party from whom the collection was received and may be deducted from the proceeds
Translation: a 如果托收指示规定托收费用和/或开支由付款人承担，而付款人拒绝支付该等费用，除非适用第21条b款，提示行可以在未收取费用和/或开支的情况下，按照具体情况凭付款、承兑或其他条款交付单据。凡因此而免收的托收费用和/或开支，应由委托托收方承担，并可从托收所得款项中扣除。

Query_Text_en: b Where the collection instruction expressly states that charges and or expenses may not be waived and the drawee refuses to pay such charges and or expenses , the presenting bank will not deliver documents and will not be responsible for any consequences arising out of any delay in the delivery of the document s When payment of collection charges and or expenses has been refused the presenting bank must inform by telecommunication or , if that is not possible , by other expeditious means without delay the bank from which the collection instruction was received
Translation: b 如果托收指示明确规定不得免除相关费用，且付款人拒绝支付这些费用，代收行将不会交付单据，并且对于因单据交付延迟所产生的任何后果不承担责任。当托收费用被拒绝支付时，代收行必须通过电讯方式，或在无法电讯时以其他快捷方式，立即通知发出托收指示的银行。

Query_Text_en: c In all cases where in the express terms of a collection instruction or under these Rules , disbursements and or expenses and or collection charges are to be borne by the principal , the collecting bank s shall be entitled to recover promptly outlays in respect of disbursements , expenses and charges from the bank from which the collection instruction was received , and the remitting bank shall be entitled to recover promptly from the principal any amount so paid out by it , together with its own disbursements , expenses and charges , regardless of the fate of the collection
Translation: 在所有明确规定由委托人承担垫付款项、费用和/或托收费用的托收指示或本规则项下的情形中，代收行有权及时向发出托收指示的银行收回其已垫付的款项、费用和费用，而托收行有权及时向委托人收回其已支付的任何款项，以及其自身的垫付款项、费用和费用，无论托收结果如何。

Query_Text_en: d Banks reserve the right to demand payment of charges and or expenses in advance from the party from whom the collection instruction was received , to cover costs in attempting to carry out any instructions , and pending receipt of such payment , also reserve the right not to carry out such instructions
Translation: 银行有权要求向其提交托收指令的一方预先支付相关费用和支出，以弥补在执行任何指令过程中产生的成本。在收到上述预付款项之前，银行亦有权不予执行相关指令。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 22 ACCEPTANCEThe presenting bank is responsible for seeing that the form of the acceptance of a bill of exchange appears to be complete and correct , but is not responsible for the genuineness of any signature or for the authority of any signatory to sign the acceptance
Translation:
第二十二条 承兑  
提示银行有责任确保汇票的承兑形式完整且正确，但不对任何签名的真实性或签署人签署承兑的授权负责。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 23 PROMISSORY NOTES AND OTHER INSTRUMENTSThe presenting bank is not responsible for the genuineness of any signature or for the authority of any signatory to sign a promissory note , receipt , or other instruments
Translation:
第二十三条 本票及其他票据  
提示银行对本票、收据或其他票据上任何签名的真实性，或签署人具备签署该等票据的授权，不承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 24 PROTESTThe collection instruction should give specific instructions regarding protest or other legal process in lieu thereof , in the event of non payment or non acceptance In the absence of such specific instructions , the banks concerned with the collection have no obligation to have the document s protested or subjected to other legal process in lieu thereof for non payment or non acceptance Any charges and or expenses incurred by banks in connection with such protest , or other legal process , will be for the account of the party from whom the collection instruction was received
Translation:
第二十四条 抗议

托收指示应就拒付或拒收情况下的抗议或其他替代法律程序作出具体指示。如无具体指示，办理托收的银行无义务因拒付或拒收而对单据进行抗议或采取其他替代法律程序。银行因办理此类抗议或其他法律程序所产生的任何费用和支出，均由发出托收指示的一方承担。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 25 CASE OF NEEDIf the principal nominates a representative to act as case of need in the event of non payment and or non acceptance the collection instruction should clearly and fully indicate the powers of such case of need In the absence of such indication banks will not accept any instructions from the case of need
Translation:
第二十五条 需要时代理人

如委托人指定代理人在遇到未付款及/或未承兑时作为需要时代理人，托收指示应明确、完整地说明该代理人的权限。如未作此说明，银行将不接受需要时代理人的任何指示。

Query_Text_en: a FORM OF ADVICEAll advices or information from the collecting bank to the bank from which the collection instruction was received must bear appropriated details including , in all cases , the latter bank 's reference as stated in the collection instruction
Translation:
一种通知形式  
收款行向发出托收指示的银行提供的所有建议或信息，必须包含适当的详细信息，并在任何情况下都应包括该银行在托收指示中注明的参考编号。

Query_Text_en: b METHOD OF ADVICEIt shall be the responsibility of the remitting bank to instruct the collecting bank regarding the method by which the advices de tailed in sub Articles c i , c ii and c iii are to be given In the absence of such instructions , the collecting bank will send the relative advices by the method of its choice at the expense of the bank from which the collection instruction was received
Translation:
b 通知方式  
汇款银行有责任指示代收银行有关子条款 c i、c ii 和 c iii 中所述通知的具体方式。如未作出相关指示，代收银行将按照其自行选择的方式发送相关通知，所产生的费用由发出托收指令的银行承担。

Query_Text_en: c i ADVICE OF PAYMENTThe collecting bank must send without delay advice of payment to the bank from which the collection instruction was received , de tailing the amount or amounts collected , charges and or disbursements and or expenses deducted , where appropriate , and method of disposal of the funds
Translation:
c i 付款通知  
代收行必须立即向发出托收指示的银行发送付款通知，详细说明所收款项金额、扣除的费用和/或支出（如适用），以及资金的处置方式。

Query_Text_en: ii ADVICE OF ACCEPTANCEThe collecting bank must send without delay advice of acceptance to the bank from which the collection instruction was received
Translation:
ii 接受通知  
代收行必须立即向发出托收指示的银行发送承兑通知。

Query_Text_en: iii ADVICE OF NON PAYMENT AND OR NON ACCEPTANCEThe presenting bank should endeavor to ascertain the reasons for non payment and or non acceptance and advise accordingly , without delay , the bank from which it received the collection instruction The presenting bank must send without delay advice of nonpayment and or advice of non acceptance to the bank from which it received the collection instruction On receipt of such advice the remitting bank must give appropriate instructions as to the further handling of the documents If such instructions are not received by the presenting bank within 60 days after its advice of non payment and or non acceptance , the documents may be returned to the bank from which the collection instruction was received without any further responsibility on the part of the presenting bank
Translation:
iii 未付款及/或未承兑通知  
代收行应尽力查明未付款及/或未承兑的原因，并及时将相关情况通知其收到托收指令的银行。代收行必须及时向其收到托收指令的银行发送未付款通知及/或未承兑通知。收到该通知后，汇出行应就文件的后续处理给予适当指示。如代收行在发出未付款及/或未承兑通知后60天内未收到相关指示，则可将文件退还给其收到托收指令的银行，代收行对此不再承担任何责任。

Query_Text_en: Rule 1 General Obligations [ 1 ] Upon notification of the registration of the request for arbitration , the parties shall , with all possible dispatch , proceed to constitute a Tribunal , with due regard to Section 2 of Chapter IV of the Convention .
Translation:
规则一 总体义务

[1] 在收到仲裁请求登记通知后，双方应尽快组建仲裁庭，并充分遵循《公约》第四章第二节的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Unless such information is provided in the request , the parties shall communicate to the Secretary-General as soon as possible any provisions agreed by them regarding the number of arbitrators and the method of their appointment .
Translation: [2] 除非请求中已提供相关信息，否则各方应尽快将其就仲裁员人数及其指定方式所达成的任何协议条款通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Except if each member of the Tribunal is appointed by agreement of the parties , nationals of the State party to the dispute or of the State whose national is a party to the dispute may be appointed by a party only if appointment by the other party to the dispute of the same number of arbitrators of either of these nationalities would not result in a majority of arbitrators of these nationalities .
Translation: [3] 除非仲裁庭的每一名成员均由双方当事人协商一致任命，否则，争端一方国家的国民或争端当事人所属国家的国民，只有在对方当事人任命相同数量的该等国籍仲裁员不会导致该国籍仲裁员占多数的情况下，方可由一方当事人任命。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] No person who had previously acted as a conciliator or arbitrator in any proceeding for the settlement of the dispute may be appointed as a member of the Tribunal .
Translation: 曾在任何争议解决程序中担任过调解员或仲裁员的人不得被任命为仲裁庭成员。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the requesting party shall , within 10 days after the registration of the request , propose to the other party the appointment of a sole arbitrator or of a specified uneven number of arbitrators and specify the method proposed for their appointment ;
Translation: [ a ] 请求方应在请求登记后10日内，向对方提出指定一名独任仲裁员或指定为单数的若干仲裁员，并明确提出其任命方式。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] within 20 days after receipt of the reply containing any such other proposals , the requesting party shall notify the other party whether it accepts or rejects such proposals .
Translation: 在收到包含任何其他提议的回复后20天内，申请方应通知对方其是否接受或拒绝该等提议。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The communications provided for in paragraph [ 1 ] shall be made or promptly confirmed in writing and shall either be transmitted through the Secretary-General or directly between the parties with a copy to the Secretary-General .
Translation: [2] 前款所规定的通信应以书面形式进行或及时以书面形式确认，并应通过秘书长转交，或由当事方直接相互发送，同时抄送秘书长。

Query_Text_en: The parties shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of the contents of any agreement reached .
Translation: 各方应及时将所达成协议的内容通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] At any time 60 days after the registration of the request , if no agreement on another procedure is reached , either party may inform the Secretary-General that it chooses the formula provided for in Article 37 [ 2 ] [ b ] of the Convention .
Translation: 在请求登记后满60天的任何时间，如果双方未就其他程序达成协议，任何一方均可通知秘书长，选择《公约》第37条第2款(b)项规定的方式。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General shall thereupon promptly inform the other party that the Tribunal is to be constituted in accordance with that Article .
Translation: 秘书长应立即通知另一方，仲裁庭将根据该条款予以组建。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] promptly upon receipt of the reply containing such a proposal , the initiating party shall notify the other party whether it concurs in the appointment of the arbitrator proposed by that party to be the President of the Tribunal .
Translation: 在收到包含该提议的回复后，发起方应立即通知另一方其是否同意由该方提议的仲裁员担任仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The communications provided for in this Rule shall be made or promptly confirmed in writing and shall either be transmitted through the Secretary-General or directly between the parties with a copy to the Secretary-General .
Translation: [2] 本规则所规定的所有通信应以书面形式进行或及时以书面形式确认，并应通过秘书长转交，或由当事方之间直接发送，同时抄送秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Rule 4 Appointment of Arbitrators by the Chairman of the Administrative Council [ 1 ] If the Tribunal is not constituted within 90 days after the dispatch by the Secretary-General of the notice of registration , or such other period as the parties may agree , either party may , through the Secretary-General , address to the Chairman of the Administrative Council a request in writing to appoint the arbitrator or arbitrators not yet appointed and to designate an arbitrator to be the President of the Tribunal .
Translation:
规则4 行政理事会主席任命仲裁员

[1] 如秘书长发出登记通知后90天内，或双方同意的其他期限内，仲裁庭尚未组成，任何一方均可通过秘书长向行政理事会主席提交书面请求，要求任命尚未被任命的仲裁员，并指定其中一名仲裁员担任仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The provision of paragraph [ 1 ] shall apply mutatis mutandis in the event that the parties have agreed that the arbitrators shall elect the President of the Tribunal and they fail to do so .
Translation: 第[1]款的规定在双方约定由仲裁员选举仲裁庭主席但未能选举时，亦适用。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Secretary-General shall forthwith send a copy of the request to the other party .
Translation: [3] 秘书长应立即将该请求的副本送交另一方。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Chairman shall , with due regard to Articles 38 and 40 [ 1 ] of the Convention , and after consulting both parties as far as possible , comply with that request within 30 days after its receipt .
Translation: 主席应在充分考虑《公约》第38条和第40条[1]的规定，并尽可能与双方协商后，于收到该请求之日起30日内予以办理。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The Secretary-General shall promptly notify the parties of any appointment or designation made by the Chairman .
Translation: 秘书长应及时将主席所作的任何任命或指定通知各方。

Query_Text_en: Rule 5 Acceptance of Appointments [ 1 ] The party or parties concerned shall notify the Secretary-General of the appointment of each arbitrator and indicate the method of his appointment .
Translation:
规则五 任命的接受

[1] 有关当事方应将每位仲裁员的任命情况及其任命方式通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] As soon as the Secretary-General has been informed by a party or the Chairman of the Administrative Council of the appointment of an arbitrator , he shall seek an acceptance from the appointee .
Translation: 一旦秘书长接到一方当事人或管理委员会主席关于指定仲裁员的通知，即应向被指定人征求其接受任命的意见。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If an arbitrator fails to accept his appointment within 15 days , the Secretary-General shall promptly notify the parties , and if appropriate the Chairman , and invite them to proceed to the appointment of another arbitrator in accordance with the method followed for the previous appointment .
Translation: [3] 如果仲裁员在15天内未接受其任命，秘书长应立即通知各方，并在适当情况下通知主席，并邀请他们按照之前的任命方式重新任命另一名仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: Rule 6 Constitution of the Tribunal [ 1 ] The Tribunal shall be deemed to be constituted and the proceeding to have begun on the date the Secretary-General notifies the parties that all the arbitrators have accepted their appointment .
Translation:
规则六 仲裁庭的组成

[1] 仲裁庭应视为在秘书长通知各方所有仲裁员均已接受任命之日正式组成，程序亦自该日起开始。

Query_Text_en: `` To the best of my knowledge there is no reason why I should not serve on the Arbitral Tribunal constituted by the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes with respect to a dispute between .
Translation: 据我所知，没有任何理由阻碍我在国际投资争端解决中心就一项争端担任仲裁庭成员。

Query_Text_en: and `` I shall keep confidential all information coming to my knowledge as a result of my participation in this proceeding , as well as the contents of any award made by the Tribunal .
Translation: 我将对因参与本程序而获悉的所有信息以及仲裁庭作出的任何裁决内容予以保密。

Query_Text_en: `` I shall judge fairly as between the parties , according to the applicable law , and shall not accept any instruction or compensation with regard to the proceeding from any source except as provided in the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes and in the Regulations and Rules made pursuant thereto .
Translation: 我将根据适用法律，在各方之间公正裁决，并且除《解决投资争端公约》及其相关规章规定外，不接受任何来源就该程序发出的指示或报酬。

Query_Text_en: `` A statement of my past and present professional , business and other relationships [ if any ] with the parties is attached hereto .
Translation: 随附一份关于我与相关各方过去及目前的职业、商业及其他关系（如有）的说明。

Query_Text_en: `` Any arbitrator failing to sign a declaration by the end of the first session of the Tribunal shall be deemed to have resigned .
Translation: 任何仲裁员如未在仲裁庭首次会议结束前签署声明，视为已辞职。

Query_Text_en: Rule 7 Replacement of ArbitratorsAt any time before the Tribunal is constituted , each party may replace any arbitrator appointed by it and the parties may by common consent agree to replace any arbitrator . The procedure of such replacement shall be in accordance with Rules l , 5 and 6 .
Translation:
规则7 仲裁员的更换

在仲裁庭组成之前，任何一方均可更换其所指定的仲裁员，双方亦可经共同同意更换任何仲裁员。更换仲裁员的程序应按照规则1、5和6进行。

Query_Text_en: Rule 8 Incapacity or Resignation of Arbitrators [ 1 ] If an arbitrator becomes incapacitated or unable to perform the duties of his office , the procedure in respect of the disqualification of arbitrators set forth in Rule 9 shall apply .
Translation:
规则8 仲裁员丧失能力或辞职

[1] 如果仲裁员丧失能力或无法履行其职务，则应适用规则9中关于仲裁员资格取消的相关程序。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] An arbitrator may resign by submitting his resignation to the other members of the Tribunal and the Secretary-General .
Translation: [2] 仲裁员可以通过向仲裁庭其他成员和秘书长提交辞呈的方式辞职。

Query_Text_en: If the arbitrator was appointed by one of the parties , the Tribunal shall promptly consider the reasons for his resignation and decide whether it consents thereto .
Translation: 如果仲裁员是由一方当事人指定的，仲裁庭应及时审议其辞职原因，并决定是否同意其辞职。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of its decision .
Translation: 仲裁庭应立即将其裁决通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Rule 9 Disqualification of Arbitrators [ 1 ] A party proposing the disqualification of an arbitrator pursuant to Article 57 of the Convention shall promptly , and in any event before the proceeding is declared closed , file its proposal with the Secretary-General , stating its reasons therefor .
Translation:
规则9 仲裁员的资格取消

[1] 根据《公约》第57条提出仲裁员资格取消的当事方，应当及时，并且无论如何在程序宣布结束之前，将其申请提交给秘书长，并说明理由。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] notify the other party of the proposal .
Translation: 并[b]将该提议通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The arbitrator to whom the proposal relates may , without delay , furnish explanations to the Tribunal or the Chairman , as the case may be .
Translation: 与该提案相关的仲裁员可立即向仲裁庭或主席（视情况而定）作出说明。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Unless the proposal relates to a majority of the members of the Tribunal , the other members shall promptly consider and vote on the proposal in the absence of the arbitrator concerned .
Translation: 除非该提案涉及仲裁庭的大多数成员，否则其他成员应在相关仲裁员缺席的情况下，迅速审议并表决该提案。

Query_Text_en: If those members are equally divided , they shall , through the Secretary-General , promptly notify the Chairman of the proposal , of any explanation furnished by the arbitrator concerned and of their failure to reach a decision .
Translation: 如果这些成员意见相等分歧，他们应通过秘书长，立即将该提案、有关仲裁员所作的任何说明以及未能作出决定的情况通知主席。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Whenever the Chairman has to decide on a proposal to disqualify an arbitrator , he shall take that decision within 30 days after he has received the proposal .
Translation: 每当主席需要对取消仲裁员资格的提案作出决定时，应在收到该提案后30天内作出决定。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] The proceeding shall be suspended until a decision has been taken on the proposal .
Translation: 在对该提案作出决定之前，程序将暂停。

Query_Text_en: Rule 10 Procedure during a Vacancy on the Tribunal [ 1 ] The Secretary-General shall forthwith notify the parties and , if necessary , the Chairman of the Administrative Council of the disqualification , death , incapacity or resignation of an arbitrator and of the consent , if any , of the Tribunal to a resignation .
Translation:
规则10 仲裁庭出现空缺时的程序

[1] 秘书长应立即将仲裁员被取消资格、死亡、丧失能力或辞职，以及仲裁庭对辞职是否同意（如有），通知各方当事人，并在必要时通知行政理事会主席。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Upon the notification by the Secretary-General of a vacancy on the Tribunal , the proceeding shall be or remain suspended until the vacancy has been filled .
Translation: [2] 一旦秘书长通知法庭出现空缺，相关程序应中止或继续中止，直至该空缺被填补为止。

Query_Text_en: Rule 11 Filling Vacancies on the Tribunal [ 1 ] Except as provided in paragraph [ 2 ] , a vacancy resulting from the disqualification , death , incapacity or resignation of an arbitrator shall be promptly filled by the same method by which his appointment had been made .
Translation:
规则11 仲裁庭空缺的填补
