Query_Text_en: Article VII Special rules drawn up by AgreementWhen in accordance with the present Convention special rules are drawn up by agreement between all or some of the Contracting Governments , such rules shall be communicated to the Secretary-General of the Organization for circulation to all Contracting Governments .
Translation:
第七条 协议制定的特别规则

根据本公约，由所有或部分缔约国协商制定的特别规则，应当通知本组织秘书长，由其转发给所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Article VIII Amendments [ a ] The present Convention may be amended by either of the procedures specified in the following paragraphs .
Translation:
第八条 修正案  
[a] 本公约可按照下列各款规定的任一程序进行修订。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Any amendment proposed by a Contracting Government shall be submitted to the Secretary-General of the Organization , who shall then circulate it to all Members of the Organization and all Contracting Governments at least six months prior to its consideration .
Translation: [一] 缔约国提出的任何修正案，应提交给本组织秘书长，由秘书长至少在审议前六个月将其分发给本组织所有成员和所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Any amendment proposed and circulated as above shall be referred to the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization for consideration .
Translation: [ ii ] 按上述方式提出并分发的任何修正案，均应提交本组织的海上安全委员会审议。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Contracting Governments of States , whether or not Members of the Organization , shall be entitled to participate in the proceedings of the Maritime Safety Committee for the consideration and adoption of amendments .
Translation: 无论是否为本组织成员国，缔约国均有权参与海上安全委员会关于修订案审议和通过的相关程序。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] Amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the Maritime Safety Committee expanded as provided for in sub-paragraph [ iii ] of this paragraph [ hereinafter referred to as `` the expanded Maritime Safety Committee '' ] on condition that at least one-third of the Contracting Governments shall be present at the time of voting .
Translation: [iv] 修正案须经出席并投票的缔约国三分之二多数通过，由按照本款第[iii]项规定扩大的海上安全委员会（以下简称“扩大的海上安全委员会”）审议，但投票时须有至少三分之一的缔约国在场。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] Amendments adopted in accordance with sub-paragraph [ iv ] of this paragraph shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Governments for acceptance .
Translation: 根据本款第[iv]项通过的修正案，应由本组织秘书长通知所有缔约国，以供其接受。

Query_Text_en: or [ bb ] at the end of a different period , which shall not be less than one year , if so determined at the time of its adoption by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the expanded Maritime Safety Committee .
Translation: 或者在另一个不低于一年的期间结束时，如果在通过时由出席并投票的缔约国三分之二多数决定，则适用该期间。

Query_Text_en: However , if within the specified period either more than one-third of Contracting Governments , or Contracting Governments the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant fleet , notify the Secretary-General of the Organization that they object to the amendment , it shall be deemed not to have been accepted .
Translation: 然而，如果在规定期限内，有超过三分之一的缔约国，或其商船队总吨位合计占世界商船队总吨位不少于百分之五十的缔约国，通知本组织秘书长表示反对该修正案，则该修正案应视为未被接受。

Query_Text_en: [ vii ] [ 1 ] An amendment to an Article of the Convention or to Chapter I of the Annex shall enter into force with respect to those Contracting Governments which have accepted it , six months after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted , and with respect to each Contracting Government which accepts it after that date , six months after the date of that Contracting Government 's acceptance .
Translation: [七][一] 对公约条款或附件第一章的修正案，自被认为已被接受之日起六个月后，对已接受该修正案的缔约国生效；对在该日期之后接受修正案的每一缔约国，则自其接受之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] An amendment to the Annex other than Chapter I shall enter into force with respect to all Contracting Governments , except those which have objected to the amendment under sub-paragraph [ vi ] [ 2 ] of this paragraph and which have not withdrawn such objections , six months after the date on which it is deemed to have been accepted . However , before the date set for entry into force , any Contracting Government may give notice to the Secretary-General of the Organization that it exempts itself from giving effect to that amendment for a period not longer than one year from the date of its entry into force , or for such longer period as may be determined by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting in the expanded Maritime Safety Committee at the time of the adoption of the amendment .
Translation: 除第一章以外的附件修正案，自被视为已被接受之日起六个月后，对所有缔约国生效，但根据本款第[vi][2]项对该修正案提出异议且未撤回异议的缔约国除外。然而，在生效日期之前，任何缔约国均可通知本组织秘书长，声明其在该修正案生效之日起最长一年内，或经扩大的海上安全委员会出席并投票的缔约国三分之二多数决定的更长期限内，免于适用该修正案。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Amendment by a Conference : [ i ] Upon the request of a Contracting Government concurred in by at least one-third of the Contracting Governments , the Organization shall convene a Conference of Contracting Governments to consider amendments to the present Convention .
Translation: [ c ] 通过缔约国会议修订： [ i ] 经任一缔约国提出请求，并得到至少三分之一缔约国的同意，组织应召集缔约国会议，审议对本公约的修订。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Every amendment adopted by such a Conference by a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Governments for acceptance .
Translation: [ ii ] 由此类会议以出席并投票的缔约国三分之二多数通过的任何修正案，均应由组织秘书长通知所有缔约国，以征求其接受。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Unless the Conference decides otherwise , the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted and shall enter into force in accordance with the procedures specified in sub-paragraphs [ b ] [ vi ] and [ b ] [ vii ] respectively of this Article , provided that references in these paragraphs to the expanded Maritime Safety Committee shall be taken to mean references to the Conference .
Translation: [三] 除非大会另有决定，修正案应视为已被接受，并应按照本条第[b][vi]和[b][vii]项规定的程序分别生效，但上述各项中提及的扩大的海上安全委员会应视为指大会。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] [ i ] A Contracting Government which has accepted an amendment to the Annex which has entered into force shall not be obliged to extend the benefit of the present Convention in respect of the certificates issued to a ship entitled to fly the flag of a State the Government of which , pursuant to the provisions of sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vi ] [ 2 ] of this Article , has objected to the amendment and has not withdrawn such an objection , but only to the extent that such certificates relate to matters covered by the amendment in question .
Translation: 已经接受并生效的附件修正案的缔约国政府，无需对根据本条第 [ b ] [ vi ] [ 2 ] 项规定提出异议且未撤回异议的国家政府所发给有权悬挂其旗帜船舶的证书，延伸本公约的利益，但仅限于该证书涉及相关修正案所涵盖事项的部分。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] A Contracting Government which has accepted an amendment to the Annex which has entered into force shall extend the benefit of the present Convention in respect of the certificates issued to a ship entitled to fly the flag of a State the Government of which , pursuant to the provisions of sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vii ] [ 2 ] of this Article , has notified the Secretary-General of the Organization that it exempts itself from giving effect to the amendment .
Translation: 已接受并生效的附件修正案的缔约国，应当将本公约的利益，延伸适用于根据本条第 [b][vii][2] 项规定，已通知本组织秘书长其自行免除执行该修正案义务的国家政府所签发、并有权悬挂该国国旗的船舶所持有的证书。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Unless expressly provided otherwise , any amendment to the present Convention made under this Article , which relates to the structure of a ship , shall apply only to ships the keels of which are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction , on or after the date on which the amendment enters into force .
Translation: 除非本公约另有明确规定，根据本条作出的任何涉及船舶结构的修正案，仅适用于在该修正案生效之日或之后铺设龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Any declaration of acceptance of , or objection to , an amendment or any notice given under sub-paragraph [ b ] [ vii ] [ 2 ] of this Article shall be submitted in writing to the Secretary-General of the Organization , who shall inform all Contracting Governments of any such submission and the date of its receipt .
Translation: [ f ] 任何关于接受或反对修正案的声明，或根据本条第 [ b ] [ vii ] [ 2 ] 项作出的任何通知，均应以书面形式提交给本组织秘书长。秘书长应将所有此类提交及其收到日期通知所有缔约国政府。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] The Secretary-General of the Organization shall inform all Contracting Governments of any amendments which enter into force under this Article , together with the date on which each such amendment enters into force .
Translation: [ g ] 组织秘书长应将根据本条生效的任何修正案及其生效日期通知所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Article IX Signature , ratification , acceptance , approval and accession [ a ] The present Convention shall remain open for signature at the Headquarters of the Organization from 1 November 1974 until I July 1975 and shall thereafter remain open for accession .
Translation:
第九条 签署、批准、接受、核准与加入

本公约自1974年11月1日至1975年7月1日期间在本组织总部开放供签署，期满后仍可供加入。

Query_Text_en: or [ iii ] accession .
Translation: 或 [三] 加入。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument to that effect with the Secretary-General of the Organization .
Translation: [b] 批准、接受、认可或加入应通过向本组织秘书长提交相关文书来完成。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ c ] The Secretary-General of the Organization shall inform the Governments of all States which have signed the present Convention or acceded to it of any signature or of the deposit of any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession and the date of its deposit .
Translation: [2][c]本组织秘书长应将任何签署本公约或交存批准、接受、认可或加入文件及其交存日期的情况，通知所有已签署或加入本公约的国家政府。

Query_Text_en: Article X Entry into force [ a ] The present Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date on which not less than twenty-five States , the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant shipping , have become parties to it in accordance with Article IX .
Translation:
第十条 生效  
[a] 本公约将在不少于二十五个国家根据第九条成为缔约方，并且这些国家的商船队总吨位占全球商船总吨位不少于百分之五十之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ b ] Any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession deposited after the date on which the present Convention enters into force shall take effect three months after the date of deposit .
Translation: [3][b] 在本公约生效日期之后交存的任何批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，应自交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ c ] After the date on which an amendment to the present Convention is deemed to have been accepted under Article VIII , any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession deposited shall apply to the Convention as amended .
Translation: [4][c] 自本公约的修正案根据第八条被视为已被接受之日起，任何此后交存的批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，均适用于经修正的本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article XI Denunciation [ a ] The present Convention may be denounced by any Contracting Government at any time after the expiry of five years from the date on which the Convention enters into force for that Government .
Translation:
第十一条 退出  
[a] 本公约在对某一缔约国生效满五年后，该缔约国可随时宣布退出公约。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Denunciation shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument of denunciation with the Secretary-General of the Organization who shall notify all the other Contracting Governments of any instrument of denunciation received and of the date of its receipt as well as the date on which such denunciation takes effect .
Translation: [ b ] 退出应通过向本组织秘书长提交退出书进行，秘书长应将收到的任何退出书及其收到日期以及退出生效日期通知所有其他缔约国。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] A denunciation shall take effect one year , or such longer period as may be specified in the instrument of denunciation , after its receipt by the Secretary-General of the Organization .
Translation: [ c ] 退约将在组织秘书长收到退约书后一年，或退约书中指定的更长期限后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article XII Deposit and registration [ a ] The present Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Organization who shall transmit certified true copies thereof to the Governments of all States which have signed the present Convention or acceded to it .
Translation:
第十二条 存放与登记

本公约应交存于本组织秘书长，由秘书长向所有签署或加入本公约的国家政府发送经认证的正式副本。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] As soon as the present Convention enters into force , the text shall be transmitted by the Secretary-General of the Organization to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication , in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations .
Translation: 一旦本公约生效，组织秘书长应将文本提交联合国秘书长，按照《联合国宪章》第102条进行登记和公布。

Query_Text_en: Article XIII LanguagesThe present Convention is established in a single copy in the Chinese , English , French , Russian and Spanish languages , each text being equally authentic .
Translation:
第十三条 语言

本公约以中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文制定一份正本，各文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Official translations in the Arabic , German and Italian languages shall be prepared and deposited with the signed original .
Translation: 阿拉伯语、德语和意大利语的正式译本应予以编制，并与签署的原件一同存放。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , being duly authorized by their respective Governments for that purpose , have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 为此，双方经各自政府正式授权，已签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: DONE at London this first day of November one thousand nine hundred and seventy-four .
Translation: 本协议于一九七四年十一月一日在伦敦签署。

Query_Text_en: [ xi ] `` member of the Union '' means a State party to the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 , or a Contracting Party .
Translation: “成员国”是指1961/1972年法案或1978年法案的缔约国，或指一项缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Basic Obligation of the Contracting PartiesEach Contracting Party shall grant and protect breeders ' rights .
Translation:
第二条 缔约方的基本义务  
每一缔约方应当授予并保护育种者权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Genera and Species to be Protected [ 1 ] [ States already members of the Union ] Each Contracting Party which is bound by the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 shall apply the provisions of this Convention , [ i ] at the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention , to all plant genera and species to which it applies , on the said date , the provisions of the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 and , [ ii ] at the latest by the expiration of a period of five years after the said date , to all plant genera and species .
Translation:
第3条 受保护的属和种

[1] [已是联盟成员的国家] 每一受1961/1972年法案或1978年法案约束的缔约方，应当自其受本公约约束之日起，按照下列规定适用本公约的条款：

[i] 自其受本公约约束之日起，适用于在该日期适用1961/1972年法案或1978年法案条款的所有植物属和种；

[ii] 最迟在该日期后五年期满时，适用于所有植物属和种。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ New members of the Union ] Each Contracting Party which is not bound by the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 shall apply the provisions of this Convention , [ i ] at the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention , to at least 15 plant genera or species and , [ ii ] at the latest by the expiration of a period of 10 years from the said date , to all plant genera and species .
Translation: [2] [联盟的新成员] 任何未受1961/1972年法案或1978年法案约束的缔约方，应自其受本公约约束之日起，至少对15个植物属或物种适用本公约的规定，并且最迟在该日起10年期满时，对所有植物属和物种适用本公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 National Treatment [ 1 ] [ Treatment ] Without prejudice to the rights specified in this Convention , nationals of a Contracting Party as well as natural persons resident and legal entities having their registered offices within the territory of a Contracting Party shall , insofar as the grant and protection of breeders ' rights are concerned , enjoy within the territory of each other Contracting Party the same treatment as is accorded or may hereafter be accorded by the laws of each such other Contracting Party to its own nationals , provided that the said nationals , natural persons or legal entities comply with the conditions and formalities imposed on the nationals of the said other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第四条 国民待遇

在不影响本公约规定权利的前提下，缔约一方的国民，以及在缔约一方领土内有住所的自然人和注册办事处的法人，就育种者权利的授予和保护而言，应在其他缔约方领土内享有与该缔约方法律给予或将来可能给予其本国国民同等的待遇，前提是上述国民、自然人或法人遵守该缔约方对其本国国民规定的条件和手续。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ `` Nationals '' ] For the purposes of the preceding paragraph , `` nationals '' means , where the Contracting Party is a State , the nationals of that State and , where the Contracting Party is an intergovernmental organization , the nationals of the States which are members of that organization .
Translation: [2] [“国民”] 就前款而言，“国民”是指：如果缔约方为一国，则指该国的国民；如果缔约方为政府间组织，则指该组织成员国的国民。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Conditions of Protection [ 1 ] [ Criteria to be satisfied ] The breeder 's right shall be granted where the variety is [ i ] new , [ ii ] distinct , ? [ iii ] uniform and [ iv ] stable .
Translation:
第5条 保护条件

[1] [需满足的标准] 育种者权利的授予应以该品种具备 [i] 新颖性、[ii] 特异性、[iii] 一致性和 [iv] 稳定性为条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Other conditions ] The grant of the breeder 's right shall not be subject to any further or different conditions , provided that the variety is designated by a denomination in accordance with the provisions of Article 20 , that the applicant complies with the formalities provided for by the law of the Contracting Party with whose authority the application has been filed and that he pays the required fees .
Translation: [2] [其他条件] 品种权的授予不得附加任何其他或不同的条件，前提是该品种按照第20条的规定被命名，申请人遵守提交申请的缔约方法律规定的手续，并支付所需费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Novelty [ 1 ] [ Criteria ] The variety shall be deemed to be new if , at the date of filing of the application for a breeder 's right , propagating or harvested material of the variety has not been sold or otherwise disposed of to others , by or with the consent of the breeder , for purposes of exploitation of the variety [ i ] in the territory of the Contracting Party in which the application has been filed earlier than one year before that date and [ ii ] in a territory other than that of the Contracting Party in which the application has been filed earlier than four years or , in the case of trees or of vines , earlier than six years before the said date .
Translation: 第六条 新颖性 [1] [标准] 若在育种者权利申请提交之日，品种的繁殖材料或收获材料未曾由育种者本人或经其同意，以开发利用该品种为目的，出售或以其他方式处置给他人，则该品种被视为新颖。具体而言，若在申请提交的缔约方境内，该等出售或处置行为发生在申请日前一年之前，或在申请提交的缔约方以外的地区，发生在申请日前四年之前（如为树木或葡萄藤，则为六年之前），则不符合新颖性要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Varieties of recent creation ] Where a Contracting Party applies this Convention to a plant genus or species to which it did not previously apply this Convention or an earlier Act , it may consider a variety of recent creation existing at the date of such extension of protection to satisfy the condition of novelty defined in paragraph [ 1 ] even where the sale or disposal to others described in that paragraph took place earlier than the time limits defined in that paragraph .
Translation: [2] [新近培育品种] 当一缔约方将本公约适用于此前未适用本公约或早期条款的某一植物属或种时，可以认为在延伸保护之日已存在的新近培育品种符合第[1]款所定义的新颖性条件，即使该款所述的销售或转让行为早于该款规定的时间限制。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ `` Territory '' in certain cases ] For the purposes of paragraph [ 1 ] , all the Contracting Parties which are member States of one and the same intergovernmental organization may act jointly , where the regulations of that organization so require , to assimilate acts done on the territories of the States members of that organization to acts done on their own territories and , should they do so , shall notify the Secretary-General accordingly .
Translation: [3]【在某些情况下的“领土”】就第[1]款而言，凡是同一政府间组织成员国的所有缔约方，在该组织的规章要求时，可以共同采取行动，将在该组织成员国领土上实施的行为视同在其本国领土上实施的行为，并应将此类做法通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 DistinctnessThe variety shall be deemed to be distinct if it is clearly distinguishable from any other variety whose existence is a matter of common knowledge at the time of the filing of the application .
Translation:
第七条 区别性  
品种应当具有明显区别，即在申请时能够清楚地区别于任何已为公众所知的其他品种。

Query_Text_en: In particular , the filing of an application for the granting of a breeder 's right or for the entering of another variety in an official register of varieties , in any country , shall be deemed to render that other variety a matter of common knowledge from the date of the application , provided that the application leads to the granting of a breeder 's right or to the entering of the said other variety in the official register of varieties , as the case may be .
Translation: 特别是，在任何国家提交授予育种者权利或将其他品种登记入官方品种名录的申请，均应视为自申请之日起，该其他品种已成为众所周知的事项，前提是该申请最终导致育种者权利的授予或该其他品种被登记入官方品种名录。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 UniformityThe variety shall be deemed to be uniform if , subject to the variation that may be expected from the particular features of its propagation , it is sufficiently uniform in its relevant characteristics .
Translation:
第八条 一致性  
品种如在其相关特性上具有足够一致性，并且除因其繁殖特性所预期的变异外，被视为一致。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 StabilityThe variety shall be deemed to be stable if its relevant characteristics remain unchanged after repeated propagation or , in the case of a particular cycle of propagation , at the end of each such cycle .
Translation:
第九条 稳定性  
如果某一品种在反复繁殖后，其相关特性保持不变，或者在特定繁殖周期的情况下，在每个周期结束时其相关特性保持不变，则该品种应被视为稳定。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Filing of Applications [ 1 ] [ Place of first application ] The breeder may choose the Contracting Party with whose authority he wishes to file his first application for a breeder 's right .
Translation:
第十条 申请的提交

[1] [首次申请地] 育种者可以自主选择希望向其主管机关首次提交植物品种权申请的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Time of subsequent applications ] The breeder may apply to the authorities of other Contracting Parties for the grant of breeders ' rights without waiting for the grant to him of a breeder 's right by the authority of the Contracting Party with which the first application was filed .
Translation: [2] [后续申请时间] 育种者可以向其他缔约方主管部门申请授予育种者权利，无需等待其首次申请所在缔约方主管部门授予育种者权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Independence of protection ] No Contracting Party shall refuse to grant a breeder 's right or limit its duration on the ground that protection for the same variety has not been applied for , has been refused or has expired in any other State or intergovernmental organization .
Translation: [3] [保护的独立性] 任何缔约方不得以同一品种在其他国家或政府间组织未申请保护、已被拒绝保护或保护期已届满为由，拒绝授予育种者权利或限制其期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 Right of Priority [ 1 ] [ The right ; its period ] Any breeder who has duly filed an application for the protection of a variety in one of the Contracting Parties [ the `` first application '' ] shall , for the purpose of filing an application for the grant of a breeder 's right for the same variety with the authority of any other Contracting Party [ the `` subsequent application '' ] , enjoy a right of priority for a period of 12 months .
Translation:
第11条 优先权

[1] [优先权及其期限] 任何育种者在一缔约方正式提交了品种保护申请（“首次申请”）后，在向任何其他缔约方主管机关就同一品种提出授予育种者权利的申请（“后续申请”）时，享有为期12个月的优先权。

Query_Text_en: This period shall be computed from the date of filing of the first application . The day of filing shall not be included in the latter period .
Translation: 该期限自首次申请提交之日起计算，提交当日不计入该期限内。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Claiming the right ] In order to benefit from the right of priority , the breeder shall , in the subsequent application , claim the priority of the first application .
Translation: 为享有优先权，育种者应在后续申请中主张首次申请的优先权。

Query_Text_en: The authority with which the subsequent application has been filed may require the breeder to furnish , within a period of not less than three months from the filing date of the subsequent application , a copy of the documents which constitute the first application , certified to be a true copy by the authority with which that application was filed , and samples or other evidence that the variety which is the subject matter of both applications is the same .
Translation: 后续申请提交的主管机关可以要求育种者在后续申请提交之日起不少于三个月的期限内，提供构成首次申请的文件副本，并由首次申请提交的主管机关认证其为真实副本，同时提供样品或其他证据，以证明两项申请所涉及的品种为同一品种。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Documents and material ] The breeder shall be allowed a period of two years after the expiration of the period of priority or , where the first application is rejected or withdrawn , an appropriate time after such rejection or withdrawal , in which to furnish , to the authority of the Contracting Party with which he has filed the subsequent application , any necessary information , document or material required for the purpose of the examination under Article 12 , as required by the laws of that Contracting Party .
Translation: [3] [文件和材料]育种者应被允许在优先权期限届满后两年内，或者在首次申请被驳回或撤回的情况下，于该驳回或撤回后适当时间内，向其提交后续申请的缔约方主管机关提供根据该缔约方法律要求、为第12条规定的审查目的所需的任何必要信息、文件或材料。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Events occurring during the period ] Events occurring within the period provided for in paragraph [ 1 ] , such as the filing of another application or the publication or use of the variety that is the subject of the first application , shall not constitute a ground for rejecting the subsequent application .
Translation: 在第[1]款规定的期间内发生的事件，如提交另一项申请或首次申请所涉及品种的公开或使用，不得作为驳回后续申请的理由。

Query_Text_en: Such events shall also not give rise to any thirdparty right .
Translation: 此类事件亦不得产生任何第三方权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Examination of the ApplicationAny decision to grant a breeder 's right shall require an examination for compliance with the conditions under Articles 5 to 9 .
Translation:
第十二条 申请审查

授予育种者权利的任何决定，须经过对是否符合第五至第九条规定条件的审查。

Query_Text_en: In the course of the examination , the authority may grow the variety or carry out other necessary tests , cause the growing of the variety or the carrying out of other necessary tests , or take into account the results of growing tests or other trials which have already been carried out .
Translation: 在审查过程中，主管部门可以自行种植该品种或进行其他必要的测试，也可以委托种植该品种或进行其他必要的测试，或参考已进行的种植测试或其他试验的结果。

Query_Text_en: For the purposes of examination , the authority may require the breeder to furnish all the necessary information , documents or material .
Translation: 为便于审查，主管机关可要求育种者提供所有必要的信息、文件或材料。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Provisional ProtectionEach Contracting Party shall provide measures designed to safeguard the interests of the breeder during the period between the filing or the publication of the application for the grant of a breeder 's right and the grant of that right .
Translation:
第十三条 临时保护  
各缔约方应采取措施，在育种权申请提交或公布至该权利授予期间，保障育种者的利益。

Query_Text_en: Such measures shall have the effect that the holder of a breeder 's right shall at least be entitled to equitable remuneration from any person who , during the said period , has carried out acts which , once the right is granted , require the breeder 's authorization as provided in Article 14 .
Translation: 此类措施应确保，育种权持有人至少有权从在上述期间内实施了根据第14条规定在权利授予后需经育种者授权的行为的任何人处获得合理报酬。

Query_Text_en: A Contracting Party may provide that the said measures shall only take effect in relation to persons whom the breeder has notified of the filing of the application .
Translation: 缔约方可以规定，前述措施仅对育种者已通知其申请提交的人员生效。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] production or reproduction [ multiplication ] , [ ii ] conditioning for the purpose of propagation , [ iii ] offering for sale , [ iv ] selling or other marketing , [ v ] exporting , [ vi ] importing , [ vii ] stocking for any of the purposes mentioned in [ i ] to [ vi ] , above .
Translation: [i] 生产或繁殖（增殖），[ii] 为繁育目的进行的处理，[iii] 提供销售，[iv] 销售或其他营销活动，[v] 出口，[vi] 进口，[vii] 为上述第[i]至第[vi]项所述任何目的而储存。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The breeder may make his authorization subject to conditions and limitations .
Translation: [ b ] 育种者可以对其授权设定条件和限制。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Acts in respect of the harvested material ] Subject to Articles 15 and 16 , the acts referred to in items [ i ] to [ vii ] of paragraph [ 1 ] [ a ] in respect of harvested material , including entire plants and parts of plants , obtained through the unauthorized use of propagating material of the protected variety shall require the authorization of the breeder , unless the breeder has had reasonable opportunity to exercise his right in relation to the said propagating material .
Translation: [2] [关于收获物的行为] 根据第15条和第16条的规定，凡涉及通过未经授权使用受保护品种繁殖材料获得的收获物（包括整株植物及其部分）的第[1][a]款第[i]至第[vii]项所述行为，除非育种者已有合理机会就上述繁殖材料行使其权利，否则须经育种者授权。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Acts in respect of certain products ] Each Contracting Party may provide that , subject to Articles 15 and 16 , the acts referred to in items [ i ] to [ vii ] of paragraph [ 1 ] [ a ] in respect of products made directly from harvested material of the protected variety falling within the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] through the unauthorized use of the said harvested material shall require the authorization of the breeder , unless the breeder has had reasonable opportunity to exercise his right in relation to the said harvested material .
Translation: [3] [关于特定产品的行为] 每一缔约方可规定，依据第15和16条的规定，对于未经授权使用受保护品种收获材料直接生产的、属于第2款规定范围的产品，凡涉及第1款[a]项[i]至[vii]所述行为，均须经育种者授权，除非育种者已获得合理机会行使其对该收获材料的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Possible additional acts ] Each Contracting Party may provide that , subject to Articles 15 and 16 , acts other than those referred to in items [ i ] to [ vii ] of paragraph [ 1 ] [ a ] shall also require the authorization of the breeder .
Translation: [4] [可能的附加行为] 各缔约方可规定，除第15条和第16条另有规定外，除第[1][a]款第[i]至第[vii]项所述行为外的其他行为，也须经育种者授权。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Essentially derived and certain other varieties ] [ a ] The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 4 ] shall also apply in relation to [ i ] varieties which are essentially derived from the protected variety , where the protected variety is not itself an essentially derived variety , [ ii ] varieties which are not clearly distinguishable in accordance with Article 7 from the protected variety and [ iii ] varieties whose production requires the repeated use of the protected variety .
Translation:
[5] [实质性衍生品种及其他相关品种]  
[a] 第[1]至[4]款的规定同样适用于以下品种：[i] 从受保护品种实质性衍生的品种，前提是受保护品种本身并非实质性衍生品种；[ii] 根据第7条，与受保护品种不具有明显可区分性的品种；以及[iii] 其生产需反复使用受保护品种的品种。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] For the purposes of subparagraph [ a ] [ i ] , a variety shall be deemed to be essentially derived from another variety [ `` the initial variety '' ] when [ i ] it is predominantly derived from the initial variety , or from a variety that is itself predominantly derived from the initial variety , while retaining the expression of the essential characteristics that result from the genotype or combination of genotypes of the initial variety , [ ii ] it is clearly distinguishable from the initial variety and [ iii ] except for the differences which result from the act of derivation , it conforms to the initial variety in the expression of the essential characteristics that result from the genotype or combination of genotypes of the initial variety .
Translation: [b] 就[a][i]款的目的而言，当一个品种（“初始品种”）具有以下特征时，应视为基本上源自另一个品种：[i] 它主要源自初始品种，或源自本身主要源自初始品种的品种，同时保留了由初始品种的基因型或基因型组合所决定的基本特征的表现；[ii] 它与初始品种有明显区别；并且[iii] 除因派生行为导致的差异外，在由初始品种的基因型或基因型组合所决定的基本特征的表现方面，与初始品种一致。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Essentially derived varieties may be obtained for example by the selection of a natural or induced mutant , or of a somaclonal variant , the selection of a variant individual from plants of the initial variety , backcrossing , or transformation by genetic engineering .
Translation: 本质上，实质性衍生品种可以通过以下方式获得：例如，通过选择自然或诱发的突变体、体细胞变异体，从初始品种的植物中选出变异个体、回交，或通过基因工程转化。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Exceptions to the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Compulsory exceptions ] The breeder 's right shall not extend to [ i ] acts done privately and for non-commercial purposes , [ ii ] acts done for experimental purposes and [ iii ] acts done for the purpose of breeding other varieties , and , except where the provisions of Article 14 [ 5 ] apply , acts referred to in Article 14 [ 1 ] to [ 4 ] in respect of such other varieties .
Translation:
第十五条 育种者权利的例外

【一】【强制性例外】育种者权利不适用于以下行为：[一]为私人且非商业目的而实施的行为；[二]为实验目的而实施的行为；[三]为培育其他品种而实施的行为；以及，除非第十四条第（五）款另有规定，对该等其他品种实施第十四条第（一）至（四）款所述的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Optional exception ] Notwithstanding Article 14 , each Contracting Party may , within reasonable limits and subject to the safeguarding of the legitimate interests of the breeder , restrict the breeder 's right in relation to any variety in order to permit farmers to use for propagating purposes , on their own holdings , the product of the harvest which they have obtained by planting , on their own holdings , the protected variety or a variety covered by Article 14 [ 5 ] [ a ] [ i ] or [ ii ] .
Translation: [2] [可选例外] 尽管有第14条的规定，每一缔约方可在合理范围内，并在保护育种者合法权益的前提下，限制育种者对任何品种的权利，以允许农民在其自有土地上，将通过种植受保护品种或第14条第5款[a][i]或[ii]所涵盖品种所获得的收获产品，用于繁殖目的。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Exhaustion of the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Exhaustion of right ] The breeder 's right shall not extend to acts concerning any material of the protected variety , or of a variety covered by the provisions of Article 1 [ 5 ] , which has been sold or otherwise marketed by the breeder or with his consent in the territory of the Contracting Party concerned , or any material derived from the said material , unless such acts [ i ] involve further propagation of the variety in question or [ ii ] involve an export of material of the variety , which enables the propagation of the variety , into a country which does not protect varieties of the plant genus or species to which the variety belongs , except where the exported material is for final consumption purposes .
Translation:
第十六条 育种者权利的耗竭

[权利的耗竭] 育种者权利不适用于与受保护品种或本条第一款所述品种相关的任何材料的行为，前提是该材料已由育种者或经其同意在相关缔约方境内销售或以其他方式投放市场，或为由上述材料衍生的任何材料，除非该等行为 [一] 涉及对相关品种的进一步繁殖，或 [二] 涉及将能够繁殖该品种的材料出口至不对该品种所属植物属或种进行保护的国家，但出口材料用于最终消费目的的除外。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Meaning of `` material '' ] For the purposes of paragraph [ 1 ] , `` material '' means , in relation to a variety , [ i ] propagating material of any kind , [ ii ] harvested material , including entire plants and parts of plants , and [ iii ] any product made directly from the harvested material .
Translation: [2] [“材料”的含义] 就第[1]段而言，“材料”指与某一品种相关的，[i] 任何类型的繁殖材料，[ii] 收获材料，包括整株植物及其部分，以及[iii] 任何直接由收获材料制成的产品。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Restrictions on the Exercise of the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Public interest ] Except where expressly provided in this Convention , no Contracting Party may restrict the free exercise of a breeder 's right for reasons other than of public interest .
Translation: 第十七条 对育种者权利行使的限制 [1] [公共利益] 除本公约另有明确规定外，任何缔约方不得以公共利益以外的理由限制育种者权利的自由行使。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Equitable remuneration ] When any such restriction has the effect of authorizing a third party to perform any act for which the breeder 's authorization is required , the Contracting Party concerned shall take all measures necessary to ensure that the breeder receives equitable remuneration .
Translation: [2] [公平报酬] 当任何此类限制导致授权第三方实施需要育种者许可的行为时，有关缔约方应采取一切必要措施，确保育种者获得公平报酬。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Measures Regulating CommerceThe breeder 's right shall be independent of any measure taken by a Contracting Party to regulate within its territory the production , certification and marketing of material of varieties or the importing or exporting of such material .
Translation:
第十八条 商业管理措施

育种者权利应独立于缔约方在其领土内针对品种材料的生产、认证和营销，以及该材料的进出口所采取的任何管理措施。

Query_Text_en: In any case , such measures shall not affect the application of the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 无论如何，此类措施不得影响本公约条款的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Duration of the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Period of protection ] The breeder 's right shall be granted for a fixed period .
Translation:
第十九条 育种者权利的期限

[1] [保护期限] 育种者权利应在规定期限内授予。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Minimum period ] The said period shall not be shorter than 20 years from the date of the grant of the breeder 's right . For trees and vines , the said period shall not be shorter than 25 years from the said date .
Translation: [2] [最短期限] 自授予育种者权利之日起，该期限不得少于20年。对于树木和藤本植物，该期限不得少于25年。

Query_Text_en: use of the denomination ] [ a ] The variety shall be designated by a denomination which will be its generic designation .
Translation: 品种应以一个名称进行指定，该名称将作为其通用名称。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each Contracting Party shall ensure that , subject to paragraph [ 4 ] , no rights in the designation registered as the denomination of the variety shall hamper the free use of the denomination in connection with the variety , even after the expiration of the breeder 's right .
Translation: [ b ] 每一缔约方应确保，除第[4]款另有规定外，任何以品种名称注册的权利不得妨碍该名称在与该品种相关的自由使用，即使育种者权利已到期亦是如此。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Characteristics of the denomination ] The denomination must enable the variety to be identified .
Translation: [2] [品种名称的特性] 品种名称必须能够识别该品种。

Query_Text_en: It may not consist solely of figures except where this is an established practice for designating varieties .
Translation: 除非以数字命名品种已成惯例，否则名称不得仅由数字组成。

Query_Text_en: It must not be liable to mislead or to cause confusion concerning the characteristics , value or identity of the variety or the identity of the breeder .
Translation: 其不得具有误导性，也不得引起对品种特性、价值或身份，或育种者身份的混淆。

Query_Text_en: In particular , it must be different from every denomination which designates , in the territory of any Contracting Party , an existing variety of the same plant species or of a closely related species .
Translation: 特别是，它必须与任何缔约方领土内用于指称同一植物种或与之密切相关种的现有品种的任何名称不同。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Registration of the denomination ] The denomination of the variety shall be submitted by the breeder to the authority . If it is found that the denomination does not satisfy the requirements of paragraph [ 2 ] , the authority shall refuse to register it and shall require the breeder to propose another denomination within a prescribed period .
Translation: [3] [品种名称的登记] 品种名称由育种者提交给主管机构。若主管机构发现该名称不符合第[2]款的要求，将拒绝登记，并要求育种者在规定期限内另行提出名称。

Query_Text_en: The denomination shall be registered by the authority at the same time as the breeder 's right is granted .
Translation: 品种名称应在授予育种者权利的同时由主管部门进行登记。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Prior rights of third persons ] Prior rights of third persons shall not be affected .
Translation: [4] [第三方的优先权利] 第三方的优先权利不受影响。

Query_Text_en: If , by reason of a prior right , the use of the denomination of a variety is forbidden to a person who , in accordance with the provisions of paragraph [ 7 ] , is obliged to use it , the authority shall require the breeder to submit another denomination for the variety .
Translation: 如果由于先前权利的原因，某人在根据第[7]款规定必须使用某品种名称时被禁止使用该名称，主管机构应要求育种者为该品种提交另一个名称。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Same denomination in all Contracting Parties ] A variety must be submitted to all Contracting Parties under the same denomination .
Translation: [5] [所有缔约方采用相同品种名称] 一个品种在所有缔约方都必须以相同的名称提交。

Query_Text_en: The authority of each Contracting Party shall register the denomination so submitted , unless it considers the denomination unsuitable within its territory .
Translation: 缔约方主管机关应对所提交的品种名称予以登记，除非其认为该名称在本国（本地区）不适用。

Query_Text_en: In the latter case , it shall require the breeder to submit another denomination .
Translation: 在后一种情况下，育种者需提交另一个名称。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Information among the authorities of Contracting Parties ] The authority of a Contracting Party shall ensure that the authorities of all the other Contracting Parties are informed of matters concerning variety denominations , in particular the submission , registration and cancellation of denominations .
Translation: [6] [缔约方主管机关之间的信息通报] 缔约方主管机关应确保将有关品种命名的事项，特别是命名的提交、注册和注销情况，通报所有其他缔约方主管机关。

Query_Text_en: Any authority may address its observations , if any , on the registration of a denomination to the authority which communicated that denomination .
Translation: 任何主管机关如对某一名称的注册有任何意见，可以向通报该名称的主管机关提出。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Obligation to use the denomination ] Any person who , within the territory of one of the Contracting Parties , offers for sale or markets propagating material of a variety protected within the said territory shall be obliged to use the denomination of that variety , even after the expiration of the breeder 's right in that variety , except where , in accordance with the provisions of paragraph [ 4 ] , prior rights prevent such use .
Translation: [7] [品种名称使用义务] 任何人在缔约方领土内销售或推广受保护品种的繁殖材料时，均有义务使用该品种的名称，即使该品种的育种者权利已到期，除非根据第[4]款的规定，因先前权利而无法使用该名称。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] [ Indications used in association with denominations ] When a variety is offered for sale or marketed , it shall be permitted to associate a trademark , trade name or other similar indication with a registered variety denomination . If such an indication is so associated , the denomination must nevertheless be easily recognizable .
Translation: [8] [与品种名称一同使用的标识] 当某一品种被提供销售或上市时，可以允许将商标、商号或其他类似标识与已注册的品种名称一同使用。但即使使用了此类标识，品种名称仍须易于识别。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Nullity of the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Reasons of nullity ] Each Contracting Party shall declare a breeder 's right granted by it null and void when it is established [ i ] that the conditions laid down in Articles 6 or 7 were not complied with at the time of the grant of the breeder 's right , [ ii ] that , where the grant of the breeder 's right has been essentially based upon information and documents furnished by the breeder , the conditions laid down in Articles 8 or 9 were not complied with at the time of the grant of the breeder 's right , or [ iii ] that the breeder 's right has been granted to a person who is not entitled to it , unless it is transferred to the person who is so entitled .
Translation:
第二十一条 育种者权利的无效

[1] [无效事由] 各缔约方应当在确立以下情形时，宣布其授予的育种者权利无效：[i] 在授予育种者权利时未遵守第六条或第七条规定的条件；[ii] 在育种者权利的授予主要基于育种者提供的信息和文件的情况下，未遵守第八条或第九条规定的条件；或[iii] 育种者权利授予了无权获得该权利的人，除非该权利已转让给有权获得该权利的人。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Exclusion of other reasons ] No breeder 's right shall be declared null and void for reasons other than those referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] .
Translation: [2] [排除其他理由] 除第[1]款所述理由外，育种者权利不得因其他原因被宣布无效。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Cancellation of the Breeder 's Right [ 1 ] [ Reasons for cancellation ] [ a ] Each Contracting Party may cancel a breeder 's right granted by it if it is established that the conditions laid down in Articles 8 or 9 are no longer fulfilled .
Translation:
第二十二条 植物育种者权利的撤销

[1] [撤销的理由] [a] 各缔约方如确认第八条或第九条规定的条件不再符合，可以撤销其授予的育种者权利。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Furthermore , each Contracting Party may cancel a breeder 's right granted by it if , after being requested to do so and within a prescribed period , [ i ] the breeder does not provide the authority with the information , documents or material deemed necessary for verifying the maintenance of the variety , [ ii ] the breeder fails to pay such fees as may be payable to keep his right in force , or [ iii ] the breeder does not propose , where the denomination of the variety is canceled after the grant of the right , another suitable denomination .
Translation: 此外，每一缔约方均可在下列情况下取消其授予的育种者权利：在被要求并于规定期限内，育种者未向主管机构提供核查品种维持所需的信息、文件或材料；育种者未支付维持其权利有效所需的相关费用；或在品种名称于权利授予后被取消时，育种者未提出其他适当的名称。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Exclusion of other reasons ] No breeder 's right shall be canceled for reasons other than those referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] .
Translation: [2] [排除其他理由] 除第[1]款所述原因外，育种者权利不得因其他理由被撤销。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 MembersThe Contracting Parties shall be members of the Union .
Translation:
第二十三条  成员

缔约方为本联盟成员。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Legal Status and Seat [ 1 ] [ Legal personality ] The Union has legal personality .
Translation:
第二十四条 法律地位与总部

[1] [法律人格] 联盟具有法人资格。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Legal capacity ] The Union enjoys on the territory of each Contracting Party , in conformity with the lawsapplicable in the said territory , such legal capacity as may be necessary for the fulfillment of the objectives of the Unionand for the exercise of its functions .
Translation: [2] [法律能力] 联盟在每一缔约方领土内，根据该领土适用的法律，享有为实现联盟目标和履行其职能所必需的法律能力。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Seat ] The seat of the Union and its permanent organs are at Geneva .
Translation: [ 3 ] [ 设址 ] 联盟及其常设机构的所在地为日内瓦。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Headquarters agreement ] The Union has a headquarters agreement with the Swiss Confederation .
Translation: [4] [总部协议] 联盟与瑞士联邦签订了总部协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 OrgansThe permanent organs of the Union are the Council and the Office of the Union .
Translation:
第二十五条 机构  
联盟的常设机构为联盟理事会和联盟办公室。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 The Council [ 1 ] [ Composition ] The Council shall consist of the representatives of the members of the Union . Each member of the Union shall appoint one representative to the Council and one alternate .
Translation: 第二十六条 理事会 [1] [组成] 理事会由联盟成员的代表组成。每个联盟成员应任命一名代表和一名候补代表参加理事会。

Query_Text_en: Representatives or alternates may be accompanied by assistants or advisers .
Translation: 代表或其替补人员可以由助理或顾问陪同。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Officers ] The Council shall elect a President and a first Vice-President from among its members . It may elect other Vice-Presidents .
Translation: [2] [职员] 理事会应从其成员中选举主席和第一副主席，并可选举其他副主席。

Query_Text_en: The first Vice-President shall take the place of the President if the latter is unable to officiate .
Translation: 如主席因故无法履行职务时，由第一副主席代理其职。

Query_Text_en: The President shall hold office for three years .
Translation: 总统任期为三年。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Sessions ] The Council shall meet upon convocation by its President . An ordinary session of the Council shall be held annually .
Translation: [ 3 ] [会议] 理事会应由主席召集召开。理事会每年举行一次例行会议。

Query_Text_en: he shall convene it , within a period of three months , if one-third of the members of the Union so request .
Translation: 如有三分之一联盟成员提出请求，他应在三个月内召集会议。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Observers ] States not members of the Union may be invited as observers to meetings of the Council . Other observers , as well as experts , may also be invited to such meetings .
Translation: [4] [观察员] 非联盟成员国可被邀请作为观察员参加理事会会议。其他观察员以及专家也可被邀请参加此类会议。

Query_Text_en: and [ x ] in general , take all necessary decisions to ensure the efficient functioning of the Union .
Translation: 并且[x]通常情况下，采取一切必要决策，以确保联盟的高效运作。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Votes ] [ a ] Each member of the Union that is a State shall have one vote in the Council .
Translation: [6] [表决] [a] 联盟中作为国家的每一成员在理事会中拥有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Contracting Party that is an intergovernmental organization may , in matters within its competence , exercise the rights to vote of its member States that are members of the Union .
Translation: [ b ] 任何作为政府间组织的缔约方，在其权限范围内，可以行使其成员国作为联盟成员所享有的投票权。

Query_Text_en: Such an intergovernmental organization shall not exercise the rights to vote of its member States if its member States exercise their right to vote , and vice versa .
Translation: 如果该政府间组织的成员国行使投票权，则该政府间组织不得行使其成员国的投票权；反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Majorities ] Any decision of the Council shall require a simple majority of the votes cast , provided that any decision of the Council under paragraphs [ 5 ] [ ii ] , [ vi ] and [ vii ] , and under Articles 28 [ 3 ] , 29 [ 5 ] [ b ] and 38 [ 1 ] shall require three-fourths of the votes cast .
Translation: [ 7 ] [ 多数原则 ] 理事会的任何决定须经投票的简单多数通过，但根据第[5][ii]、[vi]和[vii]款，以及第28[3]、29[5][b]和38[1]条作出的决定，须经投票的四分之三多数通过。

Query_Text_en: Abstentions shall not be considered as votes .
Translation: 弃权票不计入表决结果。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 The Office of the Union [ 1 ] [ Tasks and direction of the Office ] The Office of the Union shall carry out all the duties and tasks entrusted to it by the Council . It shall be under the direction of the Secretary-General .
Translation: 第二十七条 联盟办公室 [1] [办公室的职责与管理] 联盟办公室应履行理事会赋予的所有职责和任务，并由秘书长领导。

Query_Text_en: he shall be responsible for carrying out the decisions of the Council .
Translation: 他将负责执行理事会的决议。

Query_Text_en: He shall submit the budget of the Union for the approval of the Council and shall be responsible for its implementation .
Translation: 他应向理事会提交联盟预算以供批准，并负责预算的执行。

Query_Text_en: He shall make reports to the Council on his administration and the activities and financial position of the Union .
Translation: 他应就其管理工作以及联盟的活动和财务状况向理事会提交报告。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Staff ] Subject to the provisions of Article 26 [ 5 ] [ iii ] , the conditions of appointment and employment of the staff necessary for the efficient performance of the tasks of the Office of the Union shall be fixed in the administrative and financial regulations .
Translation: [ 3 ] [工作人员] 根据第26条[5][iii]的规定，为确保联盟办公室高效履行职责所需工作人员的聘用和雇佣条件，应在行政和财务条例中予以规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Languages [ 1 ] [ Languages of the Office ] The English , French , German and Spanish languages shall be used by the Office of the Union in carrying out its duties .
Translation:
第二十八条 语言

[一] [办公室用语] 联盟办公室在履行职责时，应使用英语、法语、德语和西班牙语。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Languages in certain meetings ] Meetings of the Council and of revision conferences shall be held in the four languages .
Translation: [2] [特定会议的语言] 理事会会议及修订会议应使用四种语言进行。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Further languages ] The Council may decide that further languages shall be used .
Translation: [ 3 ] [其他语言] 理事会可决定使用其他语言。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 Finances [ 1 ] [ Income ] The expenses of the Union shall be met from [ i ] the annual contributions of the States members of the Union , [ ii ] payments received for services rendered , [ iii ] miscellaneous receipts .
Translation:
第二十九条 财务

[一] [收入] 联盟的经费来源包括：[一]成员国的年度会费；[二]因提供服务所获得的收入；[三]其他杂项收入。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Contributions : units ] [ a ] The share of each State member of the Union in the total amount of the annual contributions shall be determined by reference to the total expenditure to be met from the contributions of the States members of the Union and to the number of contribution units applicable to it under paragraph [ 3 ] .
Translation: [2] [ 会费份额：单位 ] [a] 各成员国在联盟年度会费总额中的份额，应根据需由成员国会费承担的总支出，以及根据第[3]款适用于该国的会费单位数确定。

Query_Text_en: The said share shall be computed according to paragraph [ 4 ] .
Translation: 上述股份应按照第[4]款计算。

Query_Text_en: share of each member ] [ a ] The number of contribution units applicable to any member of the Union which is party to the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 on the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention shall be the same as the number applicable to it immediately before the said date .
Translation: 每个成员的份额 [a] 任何在成为本公约约束方之日已参加1961/1972年或1978年议定书的联盟成员，其适用的分摊单位数应与该日前对其适用的分摊单位数相同。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any other State member of the Union shall , on joining the Union , indicate , in a declaration addressed to the Secretary-General , the number of contribution units applicable to it .
Translation: [ b ] 任何其他加入联盟的成员国，应在加入时向秘书长提交声明，说明其适用的缴费单位数。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Any State member of the Union may , at any time , indicate , in a declaration addressed to the Secretary-General , a number of contribution units different from the number applicable to it under subparagraph [ a ] or [ b ] .
Translation: [ c ] 联盟的任何成员国可随时通过向秘书长提交声明，表明其愿意承担与[a]或[b]项下适用于其的份额不同的会费单位数。

Query_Text_en: Such declaration , if made during the first six months of a calendar year , shall take effect from the beginning of the subsequent calendar year ; otherwise , it shall take effect from the beginning of the second calendar year which follows the year in which the declaration was made .
Translation: 如该声明在日历年度的前六个月内作出，则自下一个日历年度开始生效；否则，自作出声明之年后的第二个日历年度开始生效。

Query_Text_en: computation of shares ] [ a ] For each budgetary period , the amount corresponding to one contribution unit shall be obtained by dividing the total amount of the expenditure to be met in that period from the contributions of the States members of the Union by the total number of units applicable to those States members of the Union .
Translation: 份额计算 ] [ a ] 在每个预算期内，通过将该期需要由联盟成员国缴纳的总支出金额，除以这些成员国适用的总份额单位数，得出每个缴费单位对应的金额。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The amount of the contribution of each State member of the Union shall be obtained by multiplying the amount corresponding to one contribution unit by the number of contribution units applicable to that State member of the Union .
Translation: 每个联盟成员国的会费金额，应通过将一个会费单位对应的金额乘以该成员国适用的会费单位数得出。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Arrears in contributions ] [ a ] A State member of the Union which is in arrears in the payment of its contributions may not , subject to subparagraph [ b ] , exercise its right to vote in the Council if the amount of its arrears equals or exceeds the amount of the contribution due from it for the preceding full year .
Translation:
[5] [拖欠会费]
[a] 联盟成员国如拖欠会费，且其拖欠金额等于或超过上一完整年度应缴会费，除非符合[b]项规定，不得在理事会行使投票权。

Query_Text_en: The suspension of the right to vote shall not relieve such State member of the Union of its obligations under this Convention and shall not deprive it of any other rights thereunder .
Translation: 暂停该成员国的表决权，并不免除其在本公约项下的义务，也不剥夺其在本公约项下享有的其他权利。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Council may allow the said State member of the Union to continue to exercise its right to vote if , and as long as , the Council is satisfied that the delay in payment is due to exceptional and unavoidable circumstances .
Translation: [ b ] 如果理事会确信该联邦成员国的拖欠缴款是由于特殊且不可避免的情况造成的，理事会可以允许其继续行使表决权，直至相关情况消除为止。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Auditing of the accounts ] The auditing of the accounts of the Union shall be effected by a State member of the Union as provided in the administrative and financial regulations . Such State member of the Union shall be designated , with its agreement , by the Council .
Translation: [6] [账目审计] 联盟账目的审计应由联盟的一个成员国按照行政和财务条例进行。该成员国经其同意，由理事会指定。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Contributions of intergovernmental organizations ] Any Contracting Party which is an intergovernmental organization shall not be obliged to pay contributions .
Translation: [ 7 ] [ 政府间组织的缴费义务 ] 作为缔约方的任何政府间组织均无须缴纳会费。

Query_Text_en: If , nevertheless , it chooses to pay contributions , the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 4 ] shall be applied accordingly .
Translation: 如果该方仍然选择缴纳会费，则应相应适用第[1]至第[4]款的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] ensure that the public is informed through the regular publication of information concerning - applications for and grants of breeders ' rights , and - proposed and approved denominations .
Translation: [ iii ] 通过定期发布以下信息，确保公众知情：——育种者权利的申请与授予情况，以及——拟定和批准的品种名称。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Conformity of laws ] It shall be understood that , on depositing its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , as the case may be , each State or intergovernmental organization must be in a position , under its laws , to give effect to the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: [2] [法律一致性] 应理解为，在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时（视情况而定），每一缔约国或政府间组织必须依据其本国法律，有能力使本公约的各项规定生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Relations Between Contracting Parties and States Bound by Earlier Acts [ 1 ] [ Relations between States bound by this Convention ] Between States members of the Union which are bound both by this Convention and any earlier Act of the Convention , only this Convention shall apply .
Translation:
第三十一条 缔约方与受早期文件约束的国家之间的关系

[缔约本公约的国家之间的关系]

对于既受本公约又受本公约任何早期文件约束的联盟成员国之间，只适用本公约。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Possible relations with States not bound by this Convention ] Any State member of the Union not bound by this Convention may declare , in a notification addressed to the Secretary-General , that , in its relations with each member of the Union bound only by this Convention , it will apply the latest Act by which it is bound .
Translation: [2] [与未受本公约约束的国家的可能关系] 任何未受本公约约束的联盟成员国，均可通过向秘书长发出通知声明，在其与仅受本公约约束的联盟其他成员国的关系中，将适用对其具有约束力的最新文本。

Query_Text_en: As from the expiration of one month after the date of such notification and until the State member of the Union making the declaration becomes bound by this Convention , the said member of the Union shall apply the latest Act by which it is bound in its relations with each of the members of the Union bound only by this Convention , whereas the latter shall apply this Convention in respect of the former .
Translation: 自该通知日期满一个月后起，直至作出声明的联盟成员国受本公约约束期间，该成员国在与仅受本公约约束的其他联盟成员国的关系中，应适用其所受约束的最新文本，而后者则应对前者适用本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Special AgreementsMembers of the Union reserve the right to conclude among themselves special agreements for the protection of varieties , insofar as such agreements do not contravene the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第三十二条 特别协议  
联盟成员保留在不违反本公约规定的前提下，彼此之间签订有关品种保护的特别协议的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 SignatureThis Convention shall be open for signature by any State which is a member of the Union at the date of its adoption .
Translation:
第三十三条 签署  
本公约应向在其通过之日为联盟成员的任何国家开放签署。

Query_Text_en: It shall remain open for signature until March 31 , 1992 .
Translation: 本文件将开放签署至1992年3月31日。

Query_Text_en: Accession [ 1 ] [ States and certain intergovernmental organizations ] [ a ] Any State may , as provided in this Article , become party to this Convention .
Translation: 加入 [1] [国家和某些政府间组织] [a] 任何国家均可按照本条规定，成为本公约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any intergovernmental organization may , as provided in this Article , become party to this Convention if it [ i ] has competence in respect of matters governed by this Convention , [ ii ] has its own legislation providing for the grant and protection of breeders ' rights binding on all its member States and [ iii ] has been duly authorized , in accordance with its internal procedures , to accede to this Convention .
Translation: 任何政府间组织，符合本条规定的情况下，可以成为本公约的缔约方，前提是：（一）该组织在本公约所涉事项上具有相关权限；（二）该组织拥有适用于所有成员国、关于授予和保护育种者权利的自身立法；（三）该组织已按照其内部程序正式获得加入本公约的授权。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Instrument of adherence ] Any State which has signed this Convention shall become party to this Convention by depositing an instrument of ratification , acceptance or approval of this Convention .
Translation: [2] [加入文件] 已签署本公约的任何国家，须通过提交本公约的批准、接受或认可文件，成为本公约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Any State which has not signed this Convention and any intergovernmental organization shall become party to this Convention by depositing an instrument of accession to this Convention .
Translation: 任何尚未签署本公约的国家以及任何政府间组织，均可通过提交加入本公约的文书成为本公约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General .
Translation: 批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书应交存秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Advice of the Council ] Any State which is not a member of the Union and any intergovernmental organization shall , before depositing its instrument of accession , ask the Council to advise it in respect of the conformity of its laws with the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: [3] [理事会建议] 任何非本联盟成员国及任何政府间组织，在递交加入文书前，应请求理事会就其法律是否符合本公约规定提供建议。

Query_Text_en: If the decision embodying the advice is positive , the instrument of accession may be deposited .
Translation: 如果采纳该建议的决定为肯定，则可交存加入书。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Reservations [ 1 ] [ Principle ] Subject to paragraph [ 2 ] , no reservations to this Convention are permitted .
Translation:
第三十五条 保留

[1] [原则] 除第二款另有规定外，本公约不允许作出任何保留。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Possible exception ] [ a ] Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 [ 1 ] , any State which , at the time of becoming party to this Convention , is a party to the Act of 1978 and which , as far as varieties reproduced asexually are concerned , provides for protection by an industrial property title other than a breeder 's right shall have the right to continue to do so without applying this Convention to those varieties .
Translation: [2] [可能的例外] [a] 尽管有第3条[1]的规定，任何在加入本公约时已为1978年文本缔约方的国家，并且对于无性繁殖品种通过除育种者权利以外的其他工业产权方式予以保护的，该国有权继续以该方式进行保护，无需将本公约适用于这些品种。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any State making use of the said right shall , at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , as the case may be , notify the Secretary-General accordingly .
Translation: 任何行使上述权利的国家，应在交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: The same State may , at any time , withdraw the said notification .
Translation: 同一国家可随时撤回上述通知。

Query_Text_en: Information to be Published [ 1 ] [ Initial notification ] When depositing its instrument of ratification , acceptance or approval of or accession to this Convention , as the case may be , any State or intergovernmental organization shall notify the Secretary - General of [ i ] its legislation governing breeder 's rights and [ ii ] the list of plant genera and species to which , on the date on which it will become bound by this Convention , it will apply the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 须予公布的信息 [1] [首次通知] 任何国家或政府间组织在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入本公约的文书时，应当将以下事项通知秘书长：[i] 其关于育种者权利的立法情况；[ii] 在其受本公约约束之日适用本公约规定的植物属和种的清单。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Notification of changes ] Each Contracting Party shall promptly notify the Secretary-General of [ i ] any changes in its legislation governing breeders ' rights and [ ii ] any extension of the application of this Convention to additional plant genera and species .
Translation: [ 2 ] [ 变更通知 ] 各缔约方应及时将其有关育种者权利的法律法规的任何变更，以及本公约适用范围扩展至其他植物属和物种的情况，通知秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Publication of the information ] The Secretary-General shall , on the basis of communications received from each Contracting Party concerned , publish information on [ i ] the legislation governing breeders ' rights and any changes in that legislation , and [ ii ] the list of plant genera and species referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] [ ii ] and any extension referred to in paragraph [ 2 ] [ ii ] .
Translation: [3] [信息公布] 秘书长应根据各相关缔约方提交的通报，公布以下信息：[i] 关于育种者权利的法律及其任何变更，以及 [ii] 第[1][ii]段所述的植物属和种类名单及第[2][ii]段所述的任何扩展。

Query_Text_en: Closing of Earlier Acts [ 1 ] [ Initial entry into force ] This Convention shall enter into force one month after five States have deposited their instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , as the case may be , provided that at least three of the said instruments have been deposited by States party to the Act of 1961\/1972 or the Act of 1978 .
Translation:
先前条款的终止

[1] [最初生效] 本公约应在五个国家交存其批准、接受、核准或加入文书（视情况而定）后一个月生效，且上述文书中至少有三个应由1961/1972年或1978年议定书的缔约国交存。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Subsequent entry into force ] Any State not covered by paragraph [ 1 ] or any intergovernmental organization shall become bound by this Convention one month after the date on which it has deposited its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , as the case may be .
Translation: [2] [后续生效] 未被第[1]段涵盖的任何国家或任何政府间组织，应在其提交批准、接受、核准或加入文书（视情况而定）之日起一个月后，受本公约约束。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Closing of the 1978 Act ] No instrument of accession to the Act of 1978 may be deposited after the entry into force of this Convention according to paragraph [ 1 ] , except that any State that , in conformity with the established practice of the General Assembly of the United Nations , is regarded as a developing country may deposit such an instrument until December 31 , 1995 , and that any other State may deposit such an instrument until December 31 , 1993 , even if this Convention enters into force before that date .
Translation: [3] [1978年公约的终止] 除非根据第[1]款本公约尚未生效，否则不得在本公约生效后提交1978年公约的加入文书。但根据联合国大会既定惯例被视为发展中国家的任何国家，可在1995年12月31日前提交该文书；其他国家则可在1993年12月31日前提交该文书，即使本公约在该日期之前已生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 Revision of the Convention [ 1 ] [ Conference ] This Convention may be revised by a conference of the members of the Union .
Translation: 第三十八条 公约的修订 [1] [会议] 本公约可由联盟成员召开会议予以修订。

Query_Text_en: The convocation of such conference shall be decided by the Council .
Translation: 此类会议的召开应由理事会决定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Quorum and majority ] The proceedings of a conference shall be effective only if at least half of the States members of the Union are represented at it .
Translation: [ 2 ] [ 法定人数与多数原则 ] 会议的议事程序仅在有至少一半的联盟成员国出席的情况下方为有效。

Query_Text_en: A majority of three-quarters of the States members of the Union present and voting at the conference shall be required for the adoption of any revision .
Translation: 任何修订须经出席会议并参与表决的联盟成员国四分之三多数通过方可采纳。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Denunciation [ 1 ] [ Notifications ] Any Contracting Party may denounce this Convention by notification addressed to the Secretary-General .
Translation: 第三十九条 退出 [1] [通知] 任何缔约方均可通过向秘书长发出通知的方式退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General shall promptly notify all members of the Union of the receipt of that notification .
Translation: 秘书长应立即将收到该通知的情况通报联盟全体成员。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Earlier Acts ] Notification of the denunciation of this Convention shall be deemed also to constitute notification of the denunciation of any earlier Act by which the Contracting Party denouncing this Convention is bound .
Translation: [2] [先前条约] 通知退出本公约的行为，亦视为通知退出缔约方所受约束的任何先前条约。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Effective date ] The denunciation shall take effect at the end of the calendar year following the year in which the notification was received by the Secretary-General .
Translation: [3] [生效日期] 退出将在秘书长收到通知的次年年底生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Acquired rights ] The denunciation shall not affect any rights acquired in a variety by reason of this Convention or any earlier Act prior to the date on which the denunciation becomes effective .
Translation: [4] [既得权利] 退约不影响在退约生效日期之前，依据本公约或任何早期文本已在某一品种上取得的任何权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Preservation of Existing RightsThis Convention shall not limit existing breeders ' rights under the laws of Contracting Parties or by reason of any earlier Act or any agreement other than this Convention concluded between members of the Union .
Translation:
第四十条 现有权利的保留

本公约不应限制缔约方法律下已有的育种者权利，或因本联盟成员之间根据本公约以外的任何早期法案或协议所享有的育种者权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 Original and Official Texts of the Convention [ 1 ] [ Original ] This Convention shall be signed in a single original in the English , French and German languages , the French text prevailing in case of any discrepancy among the various texts .
Translation:
第四十一条 公约的正本与正式文本

本公约应以英文、法文和德文三种文字签署一份正本。如各文本之间有任何不一致，以法文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: The original shall be deposited with the Secretary-General .
Translation: 正本应交存秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Official texts ] The Secretary-General shall , after consultation with the interested Governments , establish official texts of this Convention in the Arabic , Dutch , Italian , Japanese and Spanish languages and such other languages as the Council may designate .
Translation: 秘书长应在与有关政府协商后，制定本公约的阿拉伯文、荷兰文、意大利文、日文和西班牙文正式文本，以及理事会指定的其他语种正式文本。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Depositary Functions [ 1 ] [ Transmittal of copies ] The Secretary-General shall transmit certified copies of this Convention to all States and intergovernmental organizations which were represented in the Diplomatic Conference that adopted this Convention and , on request , to any other State or intergovernmental organization .
Translation:
第四十二条 存放职能

[一] [文本分发] 秘书长应将本公约的经认证副本分送给出席通过本公约的外交会议的所有国家和政府间组织，并应根据请求，向任何其他国家或政府间组织分送。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Registration ] The Secretary-General shall register this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations .
Translation: [ 2 ] [ 登记 ] 秘书长应将本公约在联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: While fully recognizing the sovereign right of each country to regulate its telecommunication and having regard to the growing importance of telecommunication for the preservation of peace and the social and economic development of all countries , the plenipotentiaries of the Contracting Governments , with the object of facilitating peaceful relations , international cooperation and economic and social development among peoples by means of efficient telecommunication services , have agreed to establish this Convention which is the basic instrument of the International Telecommunication Union .
Translation: 在充分尊重各国对其电信进行监管的主权权利，并考虑到电信在维护和平以及各国社会和经济发展中的日益重要作用的前提下，缔约国全权代表为促进通过高效电信服务实现各国人民之间的和平关系、国际合作以及经济和社会发展，达成一致，制定本公约，作为国际电信联盟的基本文件。

Query_Text_en: 5 [ c ] any sovereign country , not listed in Annex 1 and not a Member of the United Nations , which applies for Membership of the Union and which , after having secured approval of such application by two-thirds of the Members of the Union , accedes to the Convention in accordance with Article 46 .
Translation: 5 [c] 任何未被列入附件一且非联合国成员的主权国家，若申请加入本联盟，并在获得联盟三分之二成员批准后，按照第46条的规定加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 6 2 . For the purpose of 5 , if an application for Membership is made , by diplomatic channel and through the intermediary of the country of the seat of the Union , during the interval between two Plenipotentiary Conferences , the Secretary-General shall consult the Members of the Union ;
Translation: 6 2. 为了执行第5条，如果在两次全权代表大会之间，通过外交渠道并经联盟总部所在国转递，提交了加入联盟的申请，秘书长应当征询联盟成员的意见；

Query_Text_en: a Member shall be deemed to have abstained if it has not replied within four months after its opinion has been requested .
Translation: 如成员在被请求发表意见后四个月内未作答复，则视为弃权。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Rights and obligations of Members7 1 . Members of the Union shall have the rights and shall be subject to the obligations provided for in the Convention .
Translation:
第二条 成员的权利与义务

1. 联盟成员应享有本公约规定的权利，并承担本公约规定的义务。

Query_Text_en: 11 [ c ] subject to the provisions of Nos. 117 and 179 , each Member shall also have one vote in all consultations carried out by correspondence .
Translation: 11 [c] 在遵守第117号和第179号规定的前提下，每个成员在通过通信进行的所有协商中也拥有一票表决权。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Seat of the Union12 The seat of the Union shall be at Geneva .
Translation:
第三条 联盟总部

联盟总部设在日内瓦。

Query_Text_en: 14 [ a ] to maintain and extend international cooperation between all Members of the Union for the improvement and rational use of telecommunications of all kinds , as well as to promote and to offer technical assistance to developing countries in the field of telecommunications ;
Translation: 14 [a] 维护并拓展联盟所有成员之间在各类电信领域的国际合作，促进电信的改进与合理利用，同时在电信领域推动并向发展中国家提供技术援助；

Query_Text_en: 16 [ c ] to harmonize the actions of nations in the attainment of those ends .
Translation: 协调各国的行动，以实现上述目标。

Query_Text_en: 24 [ g ] undertake studies , make regulations , adopt resolutions , formulate recommendations and opinions , and collect and publish information concerning telecommunication matters .
Translation: 24 [g] 开展研究，制定规章，采纳决议，提出建议和意见，并收集和发布有关电信事务的信息。

Query_Text_en: 33 [ d ] the International Telegraph and Telephone Consultative Committee [ CCITT ] .
Translation: 33 [d] 国际电报电话咨询委员会（CCITT）。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Plenipotentiary Conference34 1 . The Plenipotentiary Conference shall be composed of delegations representing Members .
Translation:
第六条 全权代表大会  
1. 全权代表大会由成员代表团组成。

Query_Text_en: It shall normally be convened every five years and , in any case , the interval between successive Plenipotentiary Conferences shall not exceed six years .
Translation: 通常应每五年召开一次全权代表大会，且两届全权代表大会之间的间隔不得超过六年。

Query_Text_en: 47 [ l ] deal with such other telecommunication questions as may be necessary .
Translation: 47 [ l ] 处理其他必要的电信相关问题。

Query_Text_en: 51 2 . Administrative conferences shall normally be convened to consider specific telecommunication matters . Only items included in their agenda may be discussed by such conferences . The decisions of such conferences must in all circumstances be in conformity with the provisions of the Convention .
Translation: 行政会议通常应就特定电信事项召开。此类会议只能讨论议程中列入的事项。会议的所有决定在任何情况下都必须符合《公约》的规定。

Query_Text_en: When adopting resolutions and decisions , administrative conferences should take into account the foreseeable financial implications and shall try to avoid adopting resolutions and decisions which might give rise to expenditure in excess of the upper limits on credits laid down by the Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation: 在通过决议和决定时，行政会议应充分考虑可预见的财务影响，并应尽量避免通过可能导致支出超出全权代表大会所规定信贷上限的决议和决定。

Query_Text_en: 55 [ c ] any other question of a worldwide character within the competence of the conference .
Translation: 55 [c] 任何其他属于大会职权范围的全球性问题。

Query_Text_en: 56 [ 2 ] The agenda of a regional administrative conference may provide only for specific telecommunication questions of a regional nature , including instructions to the International Frequency Registration Board regarding its activities in respect of the region concerned , provided such instructions do not conflict with the interests of other regions .
Translation: 56 [2] 区域行政会议的议程只能包括具有区域性质的特定电信问题，包括就其相关区域的活动向国际频率登记委员会提出指示，但前提是此类指示不得损害其他区域的利益。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , the decisions of such a conference must in all circumstances be in conformity with the provisions of the Administrative Regulations .
Translation: 此外，此类会议所作出的决定在任何情况下都必须符合《管理规章》的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Administrative Council57 1 . [ 1 ] The Administrative Council shall be composed of forty-one Members of the Union elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference with due regard to the need for equitable distribution of the seats of the Council among all regions of the world .
Translation:
第八条 行政理事会

1. [1] 行政理事会由全权代表大会选举产生的41个联盟成员组成，选举时应充分考虑理事会席位在全球各地区的公平分配。

Query_Text_en: Except in the case of vacancies arising as provided for in the General Regulations , the Members of the Union elected to the Administrative Council shall hold office until the date on which a new Administrative Council is elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference . They shall be eligible for re-election .
Translation: 除非因《总则》规定的情形出现空缺外，联盟成员当选为行政理事会成员后，其任期应持续至全权代表大会选举产生新一届行政理事会之日。其成员可连选连任。

Query_Text_en: 58 [ 2 ] Each Member of the Council shall appoint a person to serve on the Council who may be assisted by one or more advisers .
Translation: 58 [2] 理事会每一成员应任命一名人员在理事会任职，并可由一名或多名顾问协助。

Query_Text_en: 59 2 . The Administrative Council shall adopt its own Rules of Procedure .
Translation: 行政理事会应制定其议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 60 3 . In the interval between Plenipotentiary Conferences the Administrative Council shall act on behalf of the Plenipotentiary Conference within the limits of the powers delegated to it by the latter .
Translation: 在全权代表大会闭会期间，管理委员会应在全权代表大会授予的权限范围内，代表全权代表大会行使职权。

Query_Text_en: 61 4 . [ 1 ] The Administrative Council shall take all steps to facilitate the implementation by the Members of the provisions of the Convention , of the Administrative Regulations , of the decisions of the Plenipotentiary Conference , and , where appropriate , of the decisions of other conferences and meetings of the Union , and perform any duties assigned to it by the Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation: 61 4. [1] 行政理事会应采取一切措施，促进成员实施《公约》、行政规章、全权代表大会的决定，以及在适当情况下，联盟其他会议和大会的决定，并履行全权代表大会赋予其的各项职责。

Query_Text_en: 62 [ 2 ] It shall determine each year the policy of technical assistance , in accordance with the objectives of the Union .
Translation: 每年，联盟应根据其目标确定技术援助政策。

Query_Text_en: 63 [ 3 ] It shall ensure the efficient coordination of the work of the Union and exercise effective financial control over its permanent organs .
Translation: [3] 它应确保联盟各项工作的高效协调，并对其常设机构实施有效的财务监管。

Query_Text_en: 64 [ 4 ] It shall promote international cooperation for the provision of technical cooperation to the developing countries by every means at its disposal , especially through the participation of the Union in the appropriate programs of the United Nations , in accordance with the purposes of the Union , one of which is to promote by all possible means the development of telecommunications .
Translation: 它应通过一切可用手段，特别是通过联盟参与联合国相关项目，促进向发展中国家提供技术合作的国际合作，符合联盟宗旨，其中之一就是通过各种可能的方式推动电信事业的发展。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 General Secretariat65 1 . [ 1 ] The General Secretariat shall be directed by a Secretary-General , assisted by one Deputy Secretary-General .
Translation:
第九条 秘书处  
1. 秘书处由秘书长领导，并由一名副秘书长协助工作。

Query_Text_en: 66 [ 2 ] The Secretary-General and the Deputy Secretary-General shall take up their duties on the dates determined at the time of their election .
Translation: 秘书长和副秘书长应于其当选时确定的日期就职。

Query_Text_en: They shall normally remain in office until dates determined by the following Plenipotentiary Conference , and they shall be eligible for re-election once only .
Translation: 他们通常将任职至下一届全权代表大会确定的日期，并且仅可连任一次。

Query_Text_en: 67 [ 3 ] The Secretary-General shall take all the action required to ensure economic use of the Union 's resources and he shall be responsible to the Administrative Council for all the administrative and financial aspects of the Union 's activities .
Translation: 67 [3] 秘书长应采取一切必要措施，确保联盟资源的经济使用，并就联盟活动的所有行政和财务方面向管理委员会负责。

Query_Text_en: The Deputy Secretary-General shall be responsible to the Secretary-General .
Translation: 副秘书长对秘书长负责。

Query_Text_en: 68 2 . [ 1 ] If the post of Secretary-General falls vacant , the Deputy Secretary-General shall succeed to it and shall remain in office until a date determined by the following Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation: 68 2. [1] 如秘书长职位出现空缺，由副秘书长继任，并任职至下届全权代表大会确定的日期为止。

Query_Text_en: He shall be eligible for election to that office subject to the provisions of No. 66 .
Translation: 他有资格被选为该职位，但须遵守第66条的规定。

Query_Text_en: When under these conditions the Deputy Secretary-General succeeds to the office of the Secretary-General , the post of Deputy Secretary-General shall be considered to fall vacant on that same date and the provisions of No. 69 will be applied .
Translation: 在上述情况下，如副秘书长继任秘书长职务，则副秘书长职位自同日视为出现空缺，并应适用第69条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 69 [ 2 ] If the post of Deputy Secretary-General falls vacant more than 180 days prior to the date set for the convening of the next Plenipotentiary Conference , the Administrative Council shall appoint a successor for the balance of the term .
Translation: 69 [2] 如果副秘书长职位在下届全权代表大会召开日期前180天以上出现空缺，行政理事会应任命继任者，完成剩余任期。

Query_Text_en: The Administrative Council shall appoint a Secretary-General and , if the vacancies occur more than 180 days prior to the date set for the convening of the next Plenipotentiary Conference , a Deputy Secretary-General .
Translation: 行政理事会应任命秘书长，并在下一次全权代表大会召开日期前180天以上出现空缺时，任命副秘书长。

Query_Text_en: An official thus appointed by the Administrative Council shall serve for the balance of the term for which his predecessor was elected .
Translation: 由管理委员会任命的该官员应履行其前任所当选剩余任期的职责。

Query_Text_en: Such officials shall be eligible for election as Secretary-General and\/or Deputy Secretary-General at the Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation: 这些官员有资格在全权代表大会上被选举为秘书长和/或副秘书长。

Query_Text_en: 71 3 . The Secretary-General shall act as the legal representative of the Union .
Translation: 秘书长应作为联盟的法律代表。

Query_Text_en: 72 4 . The Deputy Secretary-General shall assist the Secretary-General in the performance of his duties and undertake such specific tasks as may be entrusted to him by the Secretary-General .
Translation: 副秘书长应协助秘书长履行其职责，并承担秘书长委托的具体任务。

Query_Text_en: He shall perform the duties of the Secretary-General in the absence of the latter .
Translation: 在秘书长缺席时，他将履行秘书长的职责。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 International Frequency Registration Board73 1 . The International Frequency Registration Board [ IFRB ] shall consist of five independent members , elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation:
第十条 国际频率登记委员会

1. 国际频率登记委员会（IFRB）由五名独立成员组成，由全权代表大会选举产生。

Query_Text_en: These members shall be elected from the candidates sponsored by countries , Members of the Union , in such a way as to ensure equitable distribution amongst the regions of the world .
Translation: 这些成员应由联盟成员国提名的候选人中选举产生，以确保在世界各地区之间实现公平分配。

Query_Text_en: Each Member of the Union may propose only one candidate who shall be a national of its country .
Translation: 联盟各成员国只能提名一名候选人，且该候选人须为本国公民。

Query_Text_en: 74 2 . The members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall take up their duties on the dates determined at the time of their election and shall remain in office until dates determined by the following Plenipotentiary Conference .
Translation: 国际频率登记委员会成员应在选举时确定的日期就职，并任职至下一次全权代表大会确定的日期。

Query_Text_en: 75 3 . The members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall serve , not as representing their respective countries , or of a region , but as custodians of an international public trust .
Translation: 国际频率登记委员会的成员并非代表各自国家或地区，而是作为国际公共信托的维护者履行职责。

Query_Text_en: the Board shall also provide assistance to the developing countries in their preparations for these conferences ;
Translation: 董事会还应协助发展中国家为这些会议的筹备工作提供支持。

Query_Text_en: 82 [ f ] to maintain such essential records as may be related to the performance of its duties .
Translation: 82 [f] 维护与履行其职责相关的必要记录。

Query_Text_en: these studies shall not generally address economic questions but where they involve comparing technical alternatives economic factors may be taken into consideration .
Translation: 这些研究一般不涉及经济问题，但在比较技术方案时，可以考虑经济因素。

Query_Text_en: 83 , come within the purview of the CCIR .
Translation: 83，属于国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）的职权范围。

Query_Text_en: 85 [ 3 ] In the performance of its studies , each Consultative Committee shall pay due attention to the study of questions and to the formulation of recommendations directly connected with the establishment , development and improvement of telecommunications in developing countries in both the regional and international fields .
Translation: 在开展研究工作时，每个咨询委员会应高度重视与发展中国家在区域和国际领域建立、发展和完善电信直接相关的问题研究及建议制定。

Query_Text_en: 88 [ b ] any recognized private operating agency which , with the approval of the Member which has recognized it , expresses a desire to participate in the work of these Committees .
Translation: 88 [ b ] 经其认可的成员批准，任何被认可的私人运营机构表达希望参与这些委员会工作的意愿。

Query_Text_en: 92 [ c ] a Director elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference and appointed in accordance with No. 323 .
