Translation: 前提是，在该雇员或代理人的行为或疏忽情况下，还需证明该雇员或代理人是在其职务范围内行事。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The limits prescribed in Article 21 and in this Article shall not prevent the court from awarding , in accordance with its own law , in addition , the whole or part of the court costs and of the other expenses of the litigation incurred by the plaintiff , including interest .
Translation: 第21条及本条所规定的限制，不应妨碍法院根据本国法律，另外判给原告全部或部分诉讼费用及其他诉讼支出，包括利息。

Query_Text_en: The foregoing provision shall not apply if the amount of the damages awarded , excluding court costs and other expenses of the litigation , does not exceed the sum which the carrier has offered in writing to the plaintiff within a period of six months from the date of the occurrence causing the damage , or before the commencement of the action , if that is later .
Translation: 上述条款不适用于以下情形：若判决赔偿金额（不包括诉讼费用及其他诉讼开支）不超过承运人在造成损害事件发生之日起六个月内，或在诉讼开始之前（以较晚者为准）以书面形式向原告提出的赔偿金额。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The sums mentioned in terms of Special Drawing Right in this Convention shall be deemed to refer to the Special Drawing Right as defined by the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 本公约中提及的特别提款权金额，应视为指国际货币基金组织所定义的特别提款权。

Query_Text_en: Conversion of the sums into national currencies shall , in case of judicial proceedings , be made according to the value of such currencies in terms of the Special Drawing Right at the date of the judgement .
Translation: 在司法程序中，各项金额应按照判决日各国货币对特别提款权的价值进行折算。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the Special Drawing Right , of a State Party which is a Member of the International Monetary Fund , shall be calculated in accordance with the method of valuation applied by the International Monetary Fund , in effect at the date of the judgement , for its operations and transactions .
Translation: 缔约国中属于国际货币基金组织成员的国家，其本国货币相对于特别提款权的价值，应按照国际货币基金组织在判决日期时适用于其业务和交易的估值方法进行计算。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the Special Drawing Right , of a State Party which is not a Member of the International Monetary Fund , shall be calculated in a manner determined by that State .
Translation: 对于不是国际货币基金组织成员的缔约国，其本国货币以特别提款权计价的价值，应按照该国自行确定的方式计算。

Query_Text_en: and 250 monetary units per kilogram with respect to paragraph 3 of Article 22 .
Translation: 并且根据第22条第3款，每公斤为250货币单位。

Query_Text_en: This monetary unit corresponds to sixty-five and a half milligrams of gold of millesimal fineness nine hundred .
Translation: 该货币单位相当于含有九百千分纯度的黄金六十五点五毫克。

Query_Text_en: These sums may be converted into the national currency concerned in round figures .
Translation: 这些金额可以按整数折算为相关国家的本币。

Query_Text_en: The conversion of these sums into national currency shall be made according to the law of the State concerned .
Translation: 这些款项的兑换应按照相关国家的法律进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The calculation mentioned in the last sentence of paragraph I of this Article and the conversion method mentioned in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be made in such manner as to express in the national currency of the State Party as far as possible the same real value for the amounts in Articles 21 and 22 as would result from the application of the first three sentences of paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 3. 本条第一款最后一句所述的计算，以及本条第二款所述的换算方法，应以尽可能在缔约国的本国货币中表达《第21条》和《第22条》金额的实际价值，使其与本条第一款前三句所适用的结果相一致。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall communicate to the depositary the manner of calculation pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article , or the result of the conversion in paragraph 2 of this Article as the case may be , when depositing an instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval of or accession to this Convention and whenever there is a change in either .
Translation: 缔约国在交存本公约的批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，以及在上述计算方式或换算结果发生变化时，应将根据本条第1款的计算方式或第2款的换算结果（视情况而定）通知保存人。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Without prejudice to the provisions of Article 25 of this Convention and subject to paragraph 2 below , the limits of liability prescribed in Articles 21 , 22 and 23 shall be reviewed by the Depositary at five-year intervals , the first such review to take place at the end of the fifth year following the date of entry into force of this Convention , or if the Convention does not enter into force within five years of the date it is first open for signature , within the first year of its entry into force , by reference to an inflation factor which corresponds to the accumulated rate of inflation since the previous revision or in the first instance since the date of entry into force of the Convention .
Translation: 在不影响本公约第25条规定的前提下，并依照下述第2款的规定，保管人应每五年对第21、22和23条规定的责任限额进行审查。首次审查应在本公约生效之日起第五年期满时进行；如本公约自首次开放签字之日起五年内尚未生效，则应在其生效之日起一年内进行首次审查。审查时应参考通货膨胀系数，该系数应反映自上次修订以来或首次修订时自本公约生效之日起累计的通货膨胀率。

Query_Text_en: The measure of the rate of inflation to be used in determining the inflation factor shall be the weighted average of the annual rates of increase or decrease in the Consumer Price Indices of the States whose currencies comprise the Special Drawing Right mentioned in paragraph 1 of Article 23 .
Translation: 用于确定通胀系数的通胀率衡量标准，应为构成第23条第1款所述特别提款权的各国货币对应的消费者价格指数年度涨跌幅的加权平均值。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the review referred to in the preceding paragraph concludes that the inflation factor has exceeded 10 percent , the Depositary shall notify States Parties of a revision of the limits of liability .
Translation: 2. 如果前款所述的审查结果表明通胀系数已超过10%，保存人应通知缔约国责任限额的修订情况。

Query_Text_en: Any such revision shall become effective six months after its notification to the States Parties .
Translation: 任何此类修订将在通知缔约国六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: If within three months after its notification to the States Parties a majority of the States Parties register their disapproval , the revision shall not become effective and the Depositary shall refer the matter to a meeting of the States Parties .
Translation: 如果在通知缔约国后三个月内，超过半数的缔约国表示反对，该修订将不生效，保存人应将此事提交缔约国会议审议。

Query_Text_en: The Depositary shall immediately notify all States Parties of the coming into force of any revision .
Translation: 保管机构应立即通知所有缔约国任何修订的生效情况。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this Article , the procedure referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be applied at any time provided that one-third of the States Parties express a desire to that effect and upon condition that the inflation factor referred to in paragraph 1 has exceeded 30 percent since the previous revision or since the date of entry into force of this Convention if there has been no previous revision .
Translation: 3. 尽管本条第1款另有规定，但只要有三分之一的缔约国提出要求，并且第1款所述的通胀因素自上一次修订以来或自本公约生效之日起（如未曾修订）已超过30%，即可随时适用本条第2款所述程序。

Query_Text_en: Subsequent reviews using the procedure described in paragraph 1 of this Article will take place at five-year intervals starting at the end of the fifth year following the date of the reviews under the present paragraph .
Translation: 后续审查将按照本条第一款所述程序进行，自本款规定的审查日期结束后，每五年进行一次。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Stipulation on LimitsA carrier may stipulate that the contract of carriage shall be subject to higher limits of liability than those provided for in this Convention or to no limits of liability whatsoever .
Translation:
第二十五条 限额规定  
承运人可以规定，运输合同适用的责任限额高于本公约所规定的限额，或者不设任何责任限额。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Invalidity of Contractual ProvisionsAny provision tending to relieve the carrier of liability or to fix a lower limit than that which is laid down in this Convention shall be null and void , but the nullity of any such provision does not involve the nullity of the whole contract , which shall remain subject to the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第二十六条 合同条款的无效

任何旨在免除承运人责任或规定低于本公约所设限额的条款，均为无效。但该等条款的无效并不导致整个合同的无效，合同其余部分仍应受本公约规定的约束。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 Freedom to ContractNothing contained in this Convention shall prevent the carrier from refusing to enter into any contract of carriage , from waiving any defences available under the Convention , or from laying down conditions which do not conflict with the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第二十七条 合同自由  
本公约的任何规定均不妨碍承运人拒绝订立运输合同、放弃本公约项下可享有的抗辩权，或制定与本公约条款不冲突的条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Advance PaymentsIn the case of aircraft accidents resulting in death or injury of passengers , the carrier shall , if required by its national law , make advance payments without delay to a natural person or persons who are entitled to claim compensation in order to meet the immediate economic needs of such persons .
Translation:
第二十八条 预付款项

在发生航空器事故导致旅客死亡或受伤的情况下，承运人应根据其本国法律的要求，向有权要求赔偿的自然人及时支付预付款项，以满足其紧迫的经济需求。

Query_Text_en: Such advance payments shall not constitute a recognition of liability and may be offset against any amounts subsequently paid as damages by the carrier .
Translation: 此类预付款项不构成对责任的承认，并可在承运人随后支付的任何赔偿金额中予以抵扣。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 Basis of ClaimsIn the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo , any action for damages , however founded , whether under this Convention or in contract or in tort or otherwise , can only be brought subject to the conditions and such limits of liability as are set out in this Convention without prejudice to the question as to who are the persons who have the right to bring suit and what are their respective rights .
Translation:
第二十九条 请求依据  
在运输旅客、行李和货物过程中，无论损害赔偿请求基于本公约、合同、侵权或其他原因，任何诉讼只能在本公约规定的条件和责任限额下提起，但不影响有权提起诉讼的人员及其各自权利的问题。

Query_Text_en: In any such action , punitive , exemplary or any other non-compensatory damages shall not be recoverable .
Translation: 在任何此类诉讼中，惩罚性、示范性或其他非补偿性损害赔偿均不得获得。

Query_Text_en: 1 . If an action is brought against a servant or agent of the carrier arising out of damage to which the Convention relates , such servant or agent , if they prove that they acted within the scope of their employment , shall be entitled to avail themselves of the conditions and limits of liability which the carrier itself is entitled to invoke under this Convention .
Translation: 如果因本公约所涉及的损害而对承运人的雇员或代理提起诉讼，且该雇员或代理能够证明其行为是在其职务范围内，则其有权适用承运人根据本公约所享有的责任条件和责任限制。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The aggregate of the amounts recoverable from the carrier , its servants and agents , in that case , shall not exceed the said limits .
Translation: 在此情况下，可向承运人及其雇员和代理人追偿的总金额不得超过上述限额。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Save in respect of the carriage of cargo , the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply if it is proved that the damage resulted from an act or omission of the servant or agent done with intent to cause damage or recklessly and with knowledge that damage would probably result .
Translation: 3. 除货物运输外，本条第1款和第2款的规定不适用，若能证明损害是由于受雇人或代理人故意造成损害，或明知可能造成损害而鲁莽行为或不作为所致。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Receipt by the person entitled to delivery of checked baggage or cargo without complaint is prima facie evidence that the same has been delivered in good condition and in accordance with the document of carriage or with the record preserved by the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 3 and paragraph 2 of Article 4 .
Translation: 1. 权利人无异议地接收托运行李或货物，即为其已按运输凭证或根据第三条第二款及第四条第二款所述其他方式保存的记录，完好交付的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the case of damage , the person entitled to delivery must complain to the carrier forthwith after the discovery of the damage , and , at the latest , within seven days from the date of receipt in the case of checked baggage and fourteen days from the date of receipt in the case of cargo .
Translation: 2. 如发生损坏，收货权利人应在发现损坏后立即向承运人提出申诉，并且最迟应在领取托运行李之日起七天内，或在领取货物之日起十四天内提出。

Query_Text_en: In the case of delay , the complaint must be made at the latest within twenty-one days from the date on which the baggage or cargo have been placed at his or her disposal .
Translation: 如发生延误，旅客或货主必须最迟在行李或货物被交付其处置之日起二十一天内提出申诉。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Every complaint must be made in writing and given or dispatched within the times aforesaid .
Translation: 3. 每项投诉必须以书面形式提出，并在上述规定的时间内提交或寄出。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If no complaint is made within the times aforesaid , no action shall lie against the carrier , save in the case of fraud on its part .
Translation: 4. 如在上述期限内未提出任何索赔，除承运人存在欺诈行为外，不得对其提起诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Death of Person LiableIn the case of the death of the person liable , an action for damages lies in accordance with the terms of this Convention against those legally representing his or her estate .
Translation:
第三十二条 责任人死亡

如责任人死亡，依据本公约的规定，可以向其遗产的合法代表提起损害赔偿诉讼。

Query_Text_en: 1 . An action for damages must be brought , at the option of the plaintiff , in the territory of one of the States Parties , either before the court of the domicile of the carrier or of its principal place of business , or where it has a place of business through which the contract has been made or before the court at the place of destination .
Translation: 1. 损害赔偿诉讼应由原告选择，在缔约任一国家的法院提起，可以是在承运人住所地或主要营业地的法院，或是在承运人订立合同的营业机构所在地的法院，亦可是在目的地的法院提起。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In respect of damage resulting from the death or injury of a passenger , an action may be brought before one of the courts mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article , or in the territory of a State Party in which at the time of the accident the passenger has his or her principal and permanent residence and to or from which the carrier operates services for the carriage of passengers by air , either on its own aircraft or on another carrier 's aircraft pursuant to a commercial agreement , and in which that carrier conducts its business of carriage of passengers by air from premises leased or owned by the carrier itself or by another carrier with which it has a commercial agreement .
Translation: 2. 关于因旅客死亡或受伤所造成的损害，诉讼可以在本条第1款所述的任一法院提起，或者在事故发生时旅客具有主要和永久居所的缔约国领土内提起，且承运人以自有航空器或根据商业协议使用其他承运人的航空器，经营进出该地的航空旅客运输业务，并且该承运人是在其自身或与其有商业协议的其他承运人租赁或拥有的场所内开展航空旅客运输业务。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] `` principal and permanent residence '' means the one fixed and permanent abode of the passenger at the time of the accident .
Translation: [ b ] “主要且永久居所”指的是乘客在事故发生时的唯一固定且永久的住所。

Query_Text_en: The nationality of the passenger shall not be the determining factor in this regard .
Translation: 在此方面，乘客的国籍不应作为决定性因素。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Questions of procedure shall be governed by the law of the court seized of the case .
Translation: 4. 程序事项应由受理案件法院的法律管辖。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of this Article , the parties to the contract of carriage for cargo may stipulate that any dispute relating to the liability of the carrier under this Convention shall be settled by arbitration .
Translation: 在遵守本条规定的前提下，货物运输合同的当事人可以约定，凡与本公约项下承运人责任有关的任何争议，均应通过仲裁方式解决。

Query_Text_en: Such agreement shall be in writing .
Translation: 该协议应以书面形式订立。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitration proceedings shall , at the option of the claimant , take place within one of the jurisdictions referred to in Article 33 .
Translation: 2. 仲裁程序应由申请人选择，在第33条所述的任一司法管辖区内进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitrator or arbitration tribunal shall apply the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 仲裁员或仲裁庭应适用本公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article shall be deemed to be part of every arbitration clause or agreement , and any term of such clause or agreement which is inconsistent therewith shall be null and void .
Translation: 本条第2款和第3款的规定应视为每一仲裁条款或协议的组成部分，任何与之不一致的条款均属无效。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The right to damages shall be extinguished if an action is not brought within a period of two years , reckoned from the date of arrival at the destination , or from the date on which the aircraft ought to have arrived , or from the date on which the carriage stopped .
Translation: 损害赔偿请求权如未在两年内提起诉讼，即自到达目的地之日、或飞机应到达之日、或运输终止之日起算，将予以消灭。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The method of calculating that period shall be determined by the law of the court seized of the case .
Translation: 2. 该期间的计算方法应由受理案件法院所属法定规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In the case of carriage to be performed by various successive carriers and falling within the definition set out in paragraph 3 of Article 1 , each carrier which accepts passengers , baggage or cargo is subject to the rules set out in this Convention and is deemed to be one of the parties to the contract of carriage in so far as the contract deals with that part of the carriage which is performed under its supervision .
Translation: 1. 在由多个连续承运人进行运输且符合第一条第三款定义的情况下，每一位接受旅客、行李或货物的承运人，均须遵守本公约所规定的规则，并被视为运输合同的当事方，合同中涉及其所监督的运输部分时亦是如此。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the case of carriage of this nature , the passenger or any person entitled to compensation in respect of him or her can take action only against the carrier which performed the carriage during which the accident or the delay occurred , save in the case where , by express agreement , the first carrier has assumed liability for the whole journey .
Translation: 2. 在此类运输情况下，旅客或有权就其获得赔偿的任何人，仅可对发生事故或延误时实际承运该段运输的承运人提起诉讼，除非首家承运人通过明确协议对整个旅程承担责任。

Query_Text_en: 3 . As regards baggage or cargo , the passenger or consignor will have a right of action against the first carrier , and the passenger or consignee who is entitled to delivery will have a right of action against the last carrier , and further , each may take action against the carrier which performed the carriage during which the destruction , loss , damage or delay took place .
Translation: 3. 关于行李或货物，旅客或托运人有权向第一承运人提起诉讼，旅客或有权接受交付的收货人有权向最后承运人提起诉讼。此外，任何一方均可向发生毁损、丢失、损坏或延误的运输段的承运人提起诉讼。

Query_Text_en: These carriers will be jointly and severally liable to the passenger or to the consignor or consignee .
Translation: 这些承运人将对旅客或托运人、收货人承担连带责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 Right of Recourse against Third PartiesNothing in this Convention shall prejudice the question whether a person liable for damage in accordance with its provisions has a right of recourse against any other person .
Translation:
第三十七条 对第三方的追偿权

本公约的任何规定均不影响根据本公约承担损害赔偿责任的人是否有权向其他人追偿的问题。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In the case of combined carriage performed partly by air and partly by any other mode of carriage , the provisions of this Convention shall , subject to paragraph 4 of Article 18 , apply only to the carriage by air , provided that the carriage by air falls within the terms of Article 1 .
Translation: 1. 在部分由航空运输、部分由其他运输方式共同完成的联运情况下，本公约的规定仅适用于航空运输，但须遵守第18条第4款的规定，且航空运输须符合第1条的相关条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Nothing in this Convention shall prevent the parties in the case of combined carriage from inserting in the document of air carriage conditions relating to other modes of carriage , provided that the provisions of this Convention are observed as regards the carriage by air .
Translation: 2. 本公约的任何规定均不妨碍在联运情况下，相关方在航空运输单证中加入涉及其他运输方式的条款，前提是关于航空运输的部分须遵守本公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Contracting Carrier - Actual CarrierThe provisions of this Chapter apply when a person [ hereinafter referred to as `` the contracting carrier '' ] as a principal makes a contract of carriage governed by this Convention with a passenger or consignor or with a person acting on behalf of the passenger or consignor , and another person [ hereinafter referred to as `` the actual carrier '' ] performs , by virtue of authority from the contracting carrier , the whole or part of the carriage , but is not with respect to such part a successive carrier within the meaning of this Convention .
Translation:
第三十九条 合同承运人与实际承运人

本章规定适用于以下情形：一方（以下简称“合同承运人”）作为主事方，与旅客或托运人，或代表旅客或托运人的人员，订立受本公约约束的运输合同；另一方（以下简称“实际承运人”）根据合同承运人的授权，履行全部或部分运输，但就该部分而言，并非本公约所指的连续承运人。

Query_Text_en: Such authority shall be presumed in the absence of proof to the contrary .
Translation: 除非有相反证据，否则应推定具有该权力。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Respective Liability of Contracting and Actual CarriersIf an actual carrier performs the whole or part of carriage which , according to the contract referred to in Article 39 , is governed by this Convention , both the contracting carrier and the actual carrier shall , except as otherwise provided in this Chapter , be subject to the rules of this Convention , the former for the whole of the carriage contemplated in the contract , the latter solely for the carriage which it performs .
Translation:
第四十条 缔约承运人和实际承运人的各自责任

如果实际承运人根据第三十九条所述合同，履行了全部或部分受本公约管辖的运输，则除本章另有规定外，缔约承运人和实际承运人均应遵守本公约的规定。缔约承运人对合同所约定的全部运输承担责任，实际承运人仅对其实际履行的运输部分承担责任。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The acts and omissions of the actual carrier and of its servants and agents acting within the scope of their employment shall , in relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , be deemed to be also those of the contracting carrier .
Translation: 1. 实际承运人及其在职权范围内行事的雇员和代理人的作为与不作为，在实际承运人所履行的运输中，应视为合同承运人的作为与不作为。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The acts and omissions of the contracting carrier and of its servants and agents acting within the scope of their employment shall , in relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , be deemed to be also those of the actual carrier .
Translation: 2. 在实际承运人所进行的运输过程中，合同承运人及其在职权范围内行事的雇员和代理人的行为和疏忽，也应视为实际承运人的行为和疏忽。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , no such act or omission shall subject the actual carrier to liability exceeding the amounts referred to in Articles 21 , 22 , 23 and 24 .
Translation: 然而，任何此类作为或不作为均不得使实际承运人承担超过第21、22、23和24条所规定金额的责任。

Query_Text_en: Any special agreement under which the contracting carrier assumes obligations not imposed by this Convention or any waiver of rights or defences conferred by this Convention or any special declaration of interest in delivery at destination contemplated in Article 22 shall not affect the actual carrier unless agreed to by it .
Translation: 任何承运合同中，承运人承担本公约未规定的义务，或放弃本公约赋予的权利或抗辩，或根据第22条作出的关于目的地交付的特别声明，除非实际承运人同意，否则对实际承运人不产生影响。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Addressee of Complaints and InstructionsAny complaint to be made or instruction to be given under this Convention to the carrier shall have the same effect whether addressed to the contracting carrier or to the actual carrier .
Translation:
第四十二条 投诉和指示的受理方  
根据本公约向承运人提出的任何投诉或指示，无论是向缔约承运人还是实际承运人提出，均具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , instructions referred to in Article 12 shall only be effective if addressed to the contracting carrier .
Translation: 然而，依据第12条所提及的指示，只有在发给合同承运人的情况下才具有法律效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 Servants and AgentsIn relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , any servant or agent of that carrier or of the contracting carrier shall , if they prove that they acted within the scope of their employment , be entitled to avail themselves of the conditions and limits of liability which are applicable under this Convention to the carrier whose servant or agent they are , unless it is proved that they acted in a manner that prevents the limits of liability from being invoked in accordance with this Convention .
Translation:
第四十三条 仆人和代理人  
对于实际承运人所进行的运输，实际承运人或合同承运人的任何仆人或代理人，如能证明其行为属于职务范围内，有权适用本公约规定的承运人所享有的责任条件和责任限额，除非能够证明其行为导致根据本公约不能援用责任限额。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 Aggregation of DamagesIn relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , the aggregate of the amounts recoverable from that carrier and the contracting carrier , and from their servants and agents acting within the scope of their employment , shall not exceed the highest amount which could be awarded against either the contracting carrier or the actual carrier under this Convention , but none of the persons mentioned shall be liable for a sum in excess of the limit applicable to that person .
Translation:
第四十四条 损害赔偿的合并  
就实际承运人履行的运输而言，从实际承运人和合同承运人及其在履行职务范围内行事的雇员和代理人处可获得的赔偿总额，不得超过本公约项下可对合同承运人或实际承运人判决的最高赔偿金额。但上述任何人员的赔偿责任均不得超过适用于其本人的责任限额。

Query_Text_en: Article 45 Addressee of ClaimsIn relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , an action for damages may be brought , at the option of the plaintiff , against that carrier or the contracting carrier , or against both together or separately .
Translation:
第四十五条 索赔对象

对于由实际承运人履行的运输，原告可以选择向实际承运人、合同承运人，或同时或分别向二者提起损害赔偿诉讼。

Query_Text_en: If the action is brought against only one of those carriers , that carrier shall have the right to require the other carrier to be joined in the proceedings , the procedure and effects being governed by the law of the court seized of the case .
Translation: 如果诉讼仅针对其中一家承运人提起，该承运人有权要求将另一家承运人一并列为诉讼当事人，相关程序及其法律后果应由受理案件法院的法律予以规范。

Query_Text_en: Article 46 Additional JurisdictionAny action for damages contemplated in Article 45 must be brought , at the option of the plaintiff , in the territory of one of the States Parties , either before a court in which an action may be brought against the contracting carrier , as provided in Article 33 , or before the court having jurisdiction at the place where the actual carrier has its domicile or its principal place of business .
Translation:
第四十六条 附加管辖权  
根据第四十五条提起的损害赔偿诉讼，原告可选择在任一缔约国境内提起，既可以按照第三十三条的规定，在可对合同承运人提起诉讼的法院进行，也可以在实际承运人住所或主要营业地所在的有管辖权的法院进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 47 Invalidity of Contractual ProvisionsAny contractual provision tending to relieve the contracting carrier or the actual carrier of liability under this Chapter or to fix a lower limit than that which is applicable according to this Chapter shall be null and void , but the nullity of any such provision does not involve the nullity of the whole contract , which shall remain subject to the provisions of this Chapter .
Translation:
第四十七条 合同条款无效  
任何旨在减免合同承运人或实际承运人根据本章规定应承担责任，或设定低于本章适用限额的合同条款，均属无效。但该类条款的无效并不影响整个合同的效力，合同其他部分仍应遵守本章规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 48 Mutual relations of Contracting and Actual CarriersExcept as provided in Article 45 , nothing in this Chapter shall affect the rights and obligations of the carriers between themselves , including any right of recourse or indemnification .
Translation:
第四十八条 缔约承运人和实际承运人之间的相互关系

除本公约第四十五条另有规定外，本章任何内容均不影响承运人之间的权利和义务，包括任何追索权或赔偿权。

Query_Text_en: Article 49 Mandatory ApplicationAny clause contained in the contract of carriage and all special agreements entered into before the damage occurred by which the parties purport to infringe the rules laid down by this Convention , whether by deciding the law to be applied , or by altering the rules as to jurisdiction , shall be null and void .
Translation:
第四十九条 强制适用  
承运合同中包含的任何条款，以及在损害发生前双方达成的所有特别协议，如意图通过选择适用法律或变更管辖规则等方式违反本公约规定的规则，均属无效。

Query_Text_en: Article 50 InsuranceStates Parties shall require their carriers to maintain adequate insurance covering their liability under this Convention .
Translation:
第五十条 保险  
缔约国应要求其承运人保持足够的保险，以覆盖其根据本公约所承担的责任。

Query_Text_en: A carrier may be required by the State Party into which it operates to furnish evidence that it maintains adequate insurance covering its liability under this Convention .
Translation: 承运人可能会被其运营所在的缔约国要求，提供其根据本公约规定所承担责任已投保足额保险的证明。

Query_Text_en: Article 51 Carriage Performed in Extraordinary CircumstancesThe provisions of Articles 3 to 5 , 7 and 8 relating to the documentation of carriage shall not apply in the case of carriage performed in extraordinary circumstances outside the normal scope of a carrier 's business .
Translation:
第五十一条 非正常情况下的运输

在承运人业务正常范围之外因特殊情况进行的运输，不适用本公约第三至第五条、第七条和第八条关于运输单证的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 52 Definition of DaysThe expression `` days '' when used in this Convention means calendar days , not working days .
Translation:
第五十二条 天数的定义  
本公约中所使用的“天数”一词，指的是日历天，而非工作日。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention shall be open for signature in Montreal on 28 May 1999 by States participating in the International Conference on Air Law held at Montreal from 10 to 28 May 1999 .
Translation: 1. 本公约将于1999年5月28日在蒙特利尔向参加1999年5月10日至28日在蒙特利尔举行的国际航空法会议的各国开放签署。

Query_Text_en: After 28 May 1999 , the Convention shall be open to all States for signature at the headquarters of the International Civil Aviation Organization in Montreal until it enters into force in accordance with paragraph 6 of this Article .
Translation: 自1999年5月28日之后，本公约将在国际民用航空组织蒙特利尔总部向所有国家开放签署，直至根据本条第六款的规定生效为止。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall similarly be open for signature by Regional Economic Integration Organisations .
Translation: 2. 本公约同样向区域经济一体化组织开放签署。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this Convention , a `` Regional Economic Integration Organisation '' means any organization which is constituted by sovereign States of a given region which has competence in respect of certain matters governed by this Convention and has been duly authorized to sign and to ratify , accept , approve or accede to this Convention .
Translation: 本公约所称“区域经济一体化组织”，是指由某一地区主权国家组成、在本公约所涉若干事项上具有管辖权，并已被正式授权签署、批准、接受、认可或加入本公约的组织。

Query_Text_en: A reference to a `` State Party '' or `` States Parties '' in this Convention , otherwise than in paragraph 2 of Article 1 , paragraph 1 [ b ] of Article 3 , paragraph [ b ] of Article 5 , Articles 23 , 33 , 46 and paragraph [ b ] of Article 57 , applies equally to a Regional Economic Integration Organisation .
Translation: 除本公约第1条第2款、第3条第1款[b]项、第5条[b]项、第23条、第33条、第46条及第57条[b]项外，凡本公约中提及“缔约国”或“缔约国方”，均同等适用于区域经济一体化组织。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of Article 24 , the references to `` a majority of the States Parties '' and `` one-third of the States Parties '' shall not apply to a Regional Economic Integration Organisation .
Translation: 就第24条而言，文中提及的“缔约国多数”及“缔约国三分之一”不适用于区域经济一体化组织。

Query_Text_en: 3 . This Convention shall be subject to ratification by States and by Regional Economic Integration Organisations which have signed it .
Translation: 3. 本公约须经已签署本公约的国家和区域经济一体化组织批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any State or Regional Economic Integration Organisation which does not sign this Convention may accept , approve or accede to it at any time .
Translation: 4. 未签署本公约的任何国家或区域经济一体化组织，均可在任何时间接受、批准或加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall be deposited with the International Civil Aviation Organization , which is hereby designated the Depositary .
Translation: 5. 批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书应交存于国际民用航空组织，该组织特此被指定为保存机关。

Query_Text_en: 6 . This Convention shall enter into force on the sixtieth day following the date of deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession with the Depositary between the States which have deposited such instrument .
Translation: 6. 本公约将在第三十份批准、接受、核准或加入文书向保存人交存之日后第六十天，对已交存该文书的国家之间生效。

Query_Text_en: An instrument deposited by a Regional Economic Integration Organisation shall not be counted for the purpose of this paragraph .
Translation: 区域经济一体化组织提交的文书，不应计入本款所指的数量。

Query_Text_en: 7 . For other States and for other Regional Economic Integration Organisations , this Convention shall take effect sixty days following the date of deposit of the instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 7. 对于其他国家和其他区域经济一体化组织，本公约自其交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起六十天后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] any denunciation under Article 54 .
Translation: [ e ] 依据第54条作出的任何声明。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any State Party may denounce this Convention by written notification to the Depositary .
Translation: 任何缔约国均可通过书面通知保存人宣布退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Denunciation shall take effect one hundred and eighty days following the date on which notification is received by the Depositary .
Translation: 2. 退约应自缔约方将通知送达保存人之日起一百八十天后生效。

Query_Text_en: The Convention was adopted by the 58th session of the United Nations General Assembly on October 31, 2003. It was opened for signature by all countries in Merida, Mexico on December 9, 2003. China signed the Convention on December 10, 2003, ratified it on October 27, 2005, and submitted its instrument of ratification on January 13, 2006. The convention came into effect for China on February 12, 2006.
Translation: 该公约于2003年10月31日在联合国大会第58届会议上通过，并于同年12月9日在墨西哥梅里达向所有国家开放签署。中国于2003年12月10日签署该公约，2005年10月27日批准，并于2006年1月13日提交批准书。该公约自2006年2月12日起对中国生效。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] To promote integrity , accountability and proper management of public affairs and public property
Translation: 促进廉洁、问责以及对公共事务和公共财产的妥善管理

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] any other person defined as a `` public official '' in the domestic law of a State Party ?
Translation: [ iii ] 任何在缔约国国内法中被定义为“公职人员”的其他人。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] `` Controlled delivery '' shall mean the technique of allowing illicit or suspect consignments to pass out of , through or into the territory of one or more States , with the knowledge and under the supervision of their competent authorities with a view to the investigation of an offence and the identification of persons involved in the commission of the offence
Translation: “控制交付”是指在一个或多个国家的主管当局知情并监督下，为调查犯罪和识别涉案人员而允许非法或可疑货物离开、通过或进入该国领土的技术。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall apply , in accordance with its terms , to the prevention , investigation and prosecution of corruption and to the freezing , seizure , confiscation and return of the proceeds of offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 本公约应根据其条款，适用于腐败的预防、调查和起诉，以及根据本公约确立的犯罪所得的冻结、扣押、没收和返还。

Query_Text_en: 2 For the purposes of implementing this Convention , it shall not be necessary , except as otherwise stated herein , for the offences set forth in it to result in damage or harm to state property
Translation: 为实施本公约之目的，除非本公约另有规定，本公约所列举的犯罪行为，无需造成对国家财产的损害或危害。

Query_Text_en: 1 States Parties shall carry out their obligations under this Convention in a manner consistent with the principles of sovereign equality and territorial integrity of States and that of non intervention in the domestic affairs of other States
Translation: 缔约国应以符合国家主权平等、领土完整以及不干涉他国内政原则的方式履行本公约项下的义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 Nothing in this Convention shall entitle a State Party to undertake in the territory of another State the exercise of jurisdiction and performance of functions that are reserved exclusively for the authorities of that other State by its domestic law
Translation: 本公约的任何规定均不赋予一缔约国在另一缔约国领土内行使该国法律专属其主管机关的管辖权或履行相关职能的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system , develop and implement or maintain effective , coordinated anti corruption policies that promote the participation of society and reflect the principles of the rule of law , proper management of public affairs and public property , integrity , transparency and accountability
Translation: 各缔约国应根据其法律体系的基本原则，制定并实施或保持有效且协调的反腐败政策，促进社会参与，并体现法治原则、公共事务和公共财产的妥善管理、廉洁、透明和问责。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall endeavor to establish and promote effective practices aimed at the prevention of corruption
Translation: 2 各缔约国应努力建立并推广旨在预防腐败的有效做法。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall endeavor to periodically evaluate relevant legal instruments and administrative measures with a view to determining their adequacy to prevent and fight corruption
Translation: 3. 各缔约国应努力定期评估相关法律文件和行政措施，以确定其在预防和打击腐败方面的适当性。

Query_Text_en: 4 States Parties shall , as appropriate and in accordance with the fundamental principles of their legal system , collaborate with each other and with relevant international and regional organizations in promoting and developing the measures referred to in this article
Translation: 缔约国应根据其法律体系的基本原则，酌情与其他缔约国及相关国际和区域组织合作，推动和制定本条所述的相关措施。

Query_Text_en: That collaboration may include participation in international programs and projects aimed at the prevention of corruption
Translation: 该合作可能包括参与旨在防止腐败的国际项目和计划。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Increasing and disseminating knowledge about the prevention of corruption
Translation: [ b ] 加强和普及有关预防腐败的知识

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall grant the body or bodies referred to in paragraph 1 of this article the necessary independence , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system , to enable the body or bodies to carry out its or their functions effectively and free from any undue influence
Translation: 2. 各缔约国应根据其法律体系的基本原则，赋予本条第1款所述机构必要的独立性，以确保其能够有效履行职责，并不受任何不当影响。

Query_Text_en: The necessary material resources and specialized staff , as well as the training that such staff may require to Carry out their functions , should be provided
Translation: 应当提供必要的物资资源和专业人员，并为这些人员开展职能所需的培训。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall inform the Secretary General of the United Nations of the name and address of the authority or authorities that may assist other States Parties in developing and implementing specific measures for the prevention of corruption
Translation: 3. 各缔约国应将可协助其他缔约国制定和实施防止腐败具体措施的主管机关名称和地址，通知联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] That promote education and training programs to enable them to meet the requirements for the correct , honorable and proper performance of public functions and that provide them with specialized and appropriate training to enhance their awareness of the risks of corruption inherent in the performance of their functions
Translation: [ d ] 推动开展教育和培训项目，使其能够满足正确、光荣和恰当履行公共职能的要求，并为其提供专业且适当的培训，以增强其对履行职能过程中固有腐败风险的认识。

Query_Text_en: Such programs may make reference to codes or standards of conduct in applicable areas
Translation: 此类项目可能会参照相关领域的行为准则或标准。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall also consider adopting appropriate legislative and administrative measures , consistent with the objectives of this Convention and in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to prescribe criteria concerning candidature for and election to public office
Translation: 2. 各缔约国还应考虑采取适当的立法和行政措施，依据本公约的宗旨并遵循本国法律的基本原则，规定有关公共职务候选资格及选举的标准。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall also consider taking appropriate legislative and administrative measures , consistent with the objectives of this Convention and in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to enhance transparency in the funding of candidatures for elected public office and , where applicable , the funding of political parties
Translation: 3. 各缔约国还应考虑根据本公约的宗旨，并依其本国法律的基本原则，采取适当的立法和行政措施，以提高对公职选举候选人资金以及（如适用）政党资金的透明度。

Query_Text_en: 4 Each State Party shall in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , endeavor to adopt , maintain and strengthen systems that promote transparency and prevent conflicts of interest
Translation: 4. 各缔约国应根据其本国法律的基本原则，努力采取、维护并强化促进透明度和防止利益冲突的制度。

Query_Text_en: 1 In order to fight corruption each State Party shall promote , inter alia , integrity , honesty and responsibility among its public officials in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system
Translation: 1 为了打击腐败，每一缔约国应根据其法律体系的基本原则，在其公务员中促进包括廉洁、诚实和责任在内的价值观。

Query_Text_en: 2 In particular each State Party shall endeavor to apply , within its own institutional and legal systems , codes or standards of conduct for the correct , honorable and proper performance of public functions
Translation: 特别是，每一缔约国应努力在其本国的体制和法律体系内，实施有关公职人员正确、廉洁和适当履行职责的行为准则或标准。

Query_Text_en: 3 For the purposes of implementing the provisions of this article , each State Party shall , where appropriate and in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system take note of the relevant initiatives of regional , interregional and multilateral organizations , such as the International Code of Conduct for Public Officials contained in the annex to General Assembly resolution 51/59 of 12 December 1996
Translation: 为实施本条规定，每一缔约国应在适当情况下并根据其法律体系的基本原则，参考区域、跨区域及多边组织的相关倡议，例如联合国大会1996年12月12日第51/59号决议附件中所载的《公职人员国际行为准则》。

Query_Text_en: 4 Each State Party shall also consider , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , establishing measures and systems to facilitate the reporting by public officials of acts of corruption to appropriate authorities when such acts come to their notice in the performance of their functions
Translation: 4 各缔约国还应根据其国内法的基本原则，考虑建立相关措施和制度，便利公职人员在履行职务过程中发现腐败行为时，向有关当局报告该等行为。

Query_Text_en: 5 Each State Party shall endeavor , where appropriate and in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to establish measures and systems requiring public officials to make declarations to appropriate authorities regarding , inter alia , their outside activities , employment , investments , assets and substantial gifts or benefits from which a conflict of interest may result with respect to their functions as public officials
Translation: 5. 各缔约国应根据其本国法律的基本原则，在适当情况下，努力建立相关措施和制度，要求公职人员向有关当局申报其外部活动、就业、投资、资产以及可能导致其公职职责产生利益冲突的重大礼品或利益等事项。

Query_Text_en: 6 Each State Party shall consider taking , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , disciplinary or other measures against public officials who violate the codes or standards established in accordance with this article
Translation: 6. 各缔约国应根据本国法律的基本原则，考虑对违反本条规定的行为准则或标准的公职人员采取纪律处分或其他措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system , take the necessary steps to establish appropriate systems of procurement , based on transparency , competition and objective criteria in decision making , that are effective , inter alia , in preventing corruption
Translation: 1. 各缔约国应根据本国法律体系的基本原则，采取必要措施，建立以透明、竞争和决策客观为基础的适当采购制度，有效预防腐败等行为。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Where appropriate measures to regulate matters regarding personnel responsible for procurement , such as declaration of interest in particular public procurements , screening procedures and training requirements
Translation: [ e ] 在适当情况下，采取相关措施规范采购负责人事项，例如在特定公共采购中申报利益关系、筛查程序以及培训要求。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system , take appropriate measures to promote transparency and accountability in the management of public finances
Translation: 2. 各缔约国应根据其法律体系的基本原则，采取适当措施，促进公共财政管理的透明度和问责制。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Where appropriate measures action in the case of failure to comply with the requirements established in this paragraph
Translation: 在未能遵守本款规定要求时，应采取适当措施。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall take such civil and administrative measures as may be necessary , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to preserve the integrity of accounting books , records , financial statements or other documents related to public expenditure and revenue and to prevent the falsification of such documents
Translation: 3. 各缔约国应根据本国法律的基本原则，采取必要的民事和行政措施，以维护会计账簿、记录、财务报表或其他与公共支出和收入相关文件的完整性，并防止此类文件被伪造。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Public reportingTaking into account the need to combat corruption , each State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , take such measures as may be necessary to enhance transparency in its public administration , including with regard to its organization , functioning and decision making processes , where appropriate ?
Translation:
第十条 公开报告

鉴于打击腐败的需要，每一缔约国应根据其本国法律的基本原则，采取必要措施，加强其公共行政的透明度，包括在适当情况下，涉及其组织、运作和决策程序的透明度。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Publishing information , which may include periodic reports on the risks of corruption in its public administration
Translation: [ c ] 发布信息，包括可能定期公布其公共管理中存在的腐败风险报告

Query_Text_en: 1 Bearing in mind the independence of the judiciary and its crucial role in combating corruption , each State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system and without prejudice to judicial independence , take measures to strengthen integrity and to prevent opportunities for corruption among members of the judiciary
Translation: 鉴于司法独立及其在打击腐败中的关键作用，每一缔约国应根据本国法律体系的基本原则，并在不影响司法独立的前提下，采取措施，加强司法人员的廉洁性，防止其腐败行为的发生。

Query_Text_en: Such measures may include rules with respect to the conduct of members of the judiciary
Translation: 此类措施可能包括关于司法成员行为的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 Measures to the same effect as those taken pursuant to paragraph 1 of this article may be introduced and applied within the prosecution service in those States Parties where it does not form part of the judiciary but enjoys independence similar to that of the judicial service
Translation: 在缔约国中，检察机关虽不属于司法机关但享有与司法机关类似独立性的，可以在检察机关内部采取与本条第1款规定具有同等效果的措施并予以实施。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall take measures in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to prevent corruption involving the private sector , enhance accounting and auditing standards in the private sector and , where appropriate , provide effective , proportionate and dissuasive civil , administrative or criminal penalties for failure to comply with such measures
Translation: 1. 各缔约国应根据本国法律的基本原则，采取措施防止涉及私营部门的腐败行为，提升私营部门的会计和审计标准，并在适当情况下，对未遵守上述措施的行为，依法给予有效、相称且具有威慑力的民事、行政或刑事处罚。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Ensuring that private enterprises , taking into account their structure and size , have sufficient internal auditing controls to assist in preventing and detecting acts of corruption and that the accounts and required financial statements of such private enterprises are subject to appropriate auditing and certification procedures
Translation: 确保私营企业根据其结构和规模，具备足够的内部审计控制，以协助防止和发现腐败行为，并确保这些企业的账目及所需财务报表接受适当的审计和认证程序。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The intentional destruction of bookkeeping documents earlier than foreseen by the law
Translation: [f] 依法规定期限之前故意销毁会计凭证

Query_Text_en: 4 Each State Party shall disallow the tax deductibility of expenses that constitute bribes , the latter being one of the constituent elements of the offences established in accordance with articles 15 and 16 of this Convention and , where appropriate , other expenses incurred in furtherance of corrupt conduct
Translation: 4. 各缔约国应禁止将构成贿赂的支出作为可抵扣税项，贿赂行为是根据本公约第十五条和第十六条所规定犯罪的构成要素，并在适当情况下，禁止将为实施腐败行为而发生的其他支出作为可抵扣税项。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall take appropriate measures within its means and in accordance with fundamental principles of its domestic law , to promote the active participation of individuals and groups outside the public sector , such as civil society , non governmental organizations and community based organizations , in the prevention of and the fight against corruption and to raise public awareness regarding the existence , causes and gravity of and the threat posed by corruption
Translation: 各缔约国应在其能力范围内，并根据本国法律的基本原则，采取适当措施，促进公共部门以外的个人和团体——如公民社会、非政府组织和社区组织——积极参与预防和打击腐败的工作，并提高公众对腐败存在、原因、严重性及其所构成威胁的认识。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Respecting , promoting and protecting the freedom to seek , receive , publish and disseminate information concerning corruption
Translation: [ d ] 尊重、促进和保护寻求、接收、发布和传播有关腐败信息的自由

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] For the protection of national security or ordre public or of public health or morals
Translation: [ ii ] 为保护国家安全、公共秩序、公共健康或道德

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall take appropriate measures to ensure that the relevant anti corruption bodies referred to in this Convention are known to the public and shall provide access to such bodies , where appropriate , for the reporting , including anonymously , of any incidents that may be considered to constitute an offence established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 2. 各缔约国应采取适当措施，确保本公约所指的相关反腐败机构为公众所知，并在适当情况下，为公众提供向这些机构报告可能构成本公约所规定犯罪行为的渠道，包括匿名举报。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Without prejudice to article 46 of this Convention , ensure that administrative , regulatory , law enforcement and other authorities dedicated to combating money laundering [ including , where appropriate under domestic law , judicial authorities ] have the ability to cooperate and exchange information at the national and international levels within the conditions prescribed by its domestic law and , to that end , shall consider the establishment of a financial intelligence unit to serve as a national center for the collection , analysis and dissemination of information regarding potential money laundering
Translation: 在不影响本公约第46条规定的前提下，确保专门打击洗钱的行政、监管、执法及其他相关机构（包括在本国法律允许的情况下的司法机关）能够在本国法律规定的条件下，在国内和国际层面开展合作与信息交流，并为此考虑设立金融情报机构，作为收集、分析和传播有关潜在洗钱信息的国家中心。

Query_Text_en: 2 States Parties shall consider implementing feasible measures to detect and monitor the movement of cash and appropriate negotiable instruments across their borders , subject to safeguards to ensure proper use of information and without impeding in any way the movement of legitimate capital
Translation: 缔约国应考虑采取可行措施，检测和监控现金及相关可流通票据跨境流动，但须采取保障措施，确保信息的合理使用，并不得以任何方式阻碍合法资本的流动。

Query_Text_en: Such measures may include a requirement that individuals and businesses report the cross border transfer of substantial quantities of cash and appropriate negotiable instruments
Translation: 此类措施可能包括要求个人和企业报告大量现金及相关可转让票据的跨境转移情况。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] To apply enhanced scrutiny to transfers of funds that do not contain complete information on the originator
Translation: [ c ] 对于未包含完整付款人信息的资金转移，实施更严格的审查。

Query_Text_en: 4 In establishing a domestic regulatory and supervisory regime under the terms of this article , and without prejudice to any other article of this Convention , States Parties are called upon to use as a guideline the relevant initiatives of regional , interregional and multilateral organizations against money laundering
Translation: 在根据本条规定建立本国监管和监督制度时，并且在不影响本公约其他条款的前提下，缔约国应以区域性、跨区域性及多边组织打击洗钱的相关倡议为指导。

Query_Text_en: 5 States Parties shall endeavor to develop and promote global , regional , subregional and bilateral cooperation among judicial , law enforcement and financial regulatory authorities in order to combat moneylaundering
Translation: 5 各缔约国应努力在司法、执法和金融监管机构之间，发展和促进全球、区域、次区域及双边合作，以打击洗钱活动。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The solicitation or acceptance by a public official , directly or indirectly , of an undue advantage , for the official himself or herself or another person or entity , in order that the official act or refrain from acting in the exercise of his or her official duties
Translation: [ b ] 公职人员为其本人或他人、实体，直接或间接索取或接受不正当利益，以作为其在履行职务过程中采取或不采取某项行为的条件。

Query_Text_en: when committed intentionally , the promise , offering or giving to a foreign public official or an official of a public international organization , directly or indirectly , of an undue advantage , for the official himself or herself or another person or entity , in order that the official act or refrain from acting in the exercise of his or her official duties , inorder to obtain or retain business or other undue advantage in relation to the conduct of international business
Translation: 故意实施时，向外国公职人员或国际公共组织官员直接或间接承诺、提供或给予不正当利益，无论是为该官员本人还是为其他个人或实体，目的是使该官员在履行其职务时采取或不采取某种行为，以获取或维持业务或在国际商务活动中获得其他不正当利益。

Query_Text_en: the solicitation or acceptance by a foreign public official or an official of a public international organization , directly or indirectly , of an undue advantage , for the official himself or herself or another person or entity , in order that the official act or refrain from acting in the exercise of his or her official duties
Translation: 外国公职人员或国际公共组织官员直接或间接索取或接受不正当利益，无论该利益归其本人还是他人或实体，目的是为了在履行其职务过程中采取或不采取某项行为。

Query_Text_en: when committed intentionally , the embezzlement , misappropriation or other diversion by a public official for his or her benefit or for the benefit of another person or entity , of any property , public or private funds or securities or any other thing of value entrusted to the public official by virtue of this or her position
Translation: 公职人员利用职务之便，故意侵吞、挪用或以其他方式转移其本人或他人、实体利益的任何财产、公共或私人资金、证券或其他有价值物品的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The solicitation or acceptance by a public official or any other person , directly or indirectly , of all undue advantage for himself or herself or for another person in order that the public official or the person abuse his or her real or supposed influence with a view to obtaining from an administration or public authority of the State Party an undue advantage
Translation: [ b ] 公职人员或其他人直接或间接地为自己或他人索取或接受任何不正当利益，以便该公职人员或该人滥用其实际或假定的影响力，从缔约国的行政机关或公共权力机构获取不正当利益。

Query_Text_en: when committed intentionally , the abuse of functions or position , that is , the performance of or failure to perform an act , in violation of laws , by a public official in the discharge of his or her functions , for the purpose of obtaining an undue advantage for himself or herself or for another person or entity
Translation: 公职人员在履行职责过程中，若故意滥用职权或职能，即为谋取本人或他人、实体的不正当利益，违反法律规定实施或不实施某项行为。

Query_Text_en: when committed intentionally , illicit enrichment , that is , a significant increase in the assets of a public official that he or she can not reasonably explain in relation to his or her lawful income
Translation: 如果是故意为之，非法致富指的是公职人员的资产出现显著增长，而该增长无法以其合法收入作出合理解释。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The solicitation or acceptance , directly or indirectly , of an undue advantage by any person who directs or works , in any capacity , for a private sector entity , for the person himself or herself or for another person , in order that he or she , in breach of his or her duties , act or refrain from acting
Translation: [ b ] 任何为私人部门实体担任管理或以任何身份工作的人员，直接或间接索取或接受不正当利益，无论是为其本人还是为他人，以致其违反职责，采取或不采取某种行为。

Query_Text_en: when committed intentionally in the course of economic , financial or commercial activities , embezzlement by a person who directs or works , in any capacity , in a private sector entity of any property , private funds or securities or any other thing of value entrusted to him or her by virtue of his or her position
Translation: 在经济、金融或商业活动中，任何在私营部门实体中以任何身份担任管理或工作人员的人员，若利用职务之便，故意侵吞其受托管理的财产、私人资金、证券或其他有价值物品的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] For the purposes of subparagraph [ b ] above , predicate offences shall include offences committed both within and outside the jurisdiction of the State Party in question
Translation: [ c ] 就上述 [ b ] 项而言，先行犯罪应包括在该缔约国管辖范围内和管辖范围外所犯的犯罪。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] If required by fundamental principles of the domestic law of a State Party , it may be provided that the offences set forth in paragraph 1 of this article do not apply to the persons who committed the predicate offence
Translation: 如缔约国国内法的基本原则要求，可以规定本条第1款所列罪行不适用于实施先行犯罪的人员。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 ConcealmentWithout prejudice to the provisions of article 23 of this Convention , each State Party shall consider adopting such legislative and other measures as may be necessary to establish as a criminal offence , when committed intentionally after the commission of any of the offences established in accordance with this Convention without having participated in such offences , the concealment or continued retention of property when the person involved knows that such property is the result of any of the offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation:
第二十四条 隐匿  
在不影响本公约第二十三条规定的前提下，每一缔约国应考虑采取必要的立法及其他措施，将在未参与根据本公约所设立的任何犯罪行为之后，故意隐匿或持续保有财产，且相关人员明知该财产系根据本公约所设立的犯罪所得，定为刑事犯罪。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The use of physical force , threats or intimidation to interfere with the exercise of official duties by a justice or law enforcement official in relation to the commission of offences established in accordance with this Convention Nothing in this subparagraph shall prejudice the right of States Parties to have legislation that protects other categories of public official
Translation: [ b ] 使用暴力、威胁或恐吓手段，干扰司法人员或执法人员在与本公约所规定犯罪相关的履行公务。 本款内容不影响缔约国制定保护其他类别公职人员的立法权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall adopt such measures as may be necessary , consistent with its legal principles , to establish the liability of legal persons for participation in the offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 每一缔约国应根据其法律原则，采取必要措施，确立法人因参与根据本公约所规定犯罪的法律责任。

Query_Text_en: 2 Subject to the legal principles of the State Party , the liability of legal persons may be criminal , civil or administrative
Translation: 2 根据缔约国的法律原则，法人可以承担刑事、民事或行政责任。

Query_Text_en: 3 Such liability shall be without prejudice to the criminal liability of the natural persons who have committed the offences
Translation: 此类责任不影响实施犯罪行为的自然人的刑事责任。

Query_Text_en: 4 Each State Party shall , in particular , ensure that legal persons held liable in accordance with this article are subject to effective , proportionate and dissuasive criminal or non criminal sanctions , including monetary sanctions
Translation: 4 各缔约国应特别确保，根据本条规定被追究责任的法人，受到有效、适当且具有威慑力的刑事或非刑事制裁，包括罚款等经济处罚。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall adopt such legislative and other measures as may be necessary to establish as a criminal offence in accordance with its domestic law , participation in any capacity such as an accomplice , assistant or instigator in an offence established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 1 各缔约国应根据本国法律，采取必要的立法及其他措施，将以任何身份参与本公约所规定犯罪（如作为共犯、协助者或教唆者）定为刑事犯罪。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party may adopt such legislative and other measures as may be necessary to establish as a criminal offence , in accordance with its domestic law , any attempt to commit an offence established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 2 每一缔约国可根据本国法律，采取必要的立法及其他措施，将根据本公约所确立的犯罪行为的未遂，定为刑事犯罪。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party may adopt such legislative and other measures as may be necessary to establish as a criminal offence in accordance with its domestic law , the preparation for an offence established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 3 各缔约国可根据本国法律，采取必要的立法及其他措施，将根据本公约规定的犯罪的预备行为定为刑事犯罪。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Knowledge , intent and purpose as elements of an offenceKnowledge , intent or purpose required as an element of an offence established in accordance with this Convention may be inferred from objective factual circumstances
Translation:
第二十八条 作为犯罪要素的知识、意图和目的

根据本公约设立的犯罪所要求的知识、意图或目的，可以根据客观事实情况推断。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 Statute of limitationsEach State Party shall , where appropriate , establish under its domestic law a long statute of limitations period in which to commence proceedings for any offence established in accordance with this Convention and establish a longer statute of limitations period or provide for the suspension of the statute of limitations where the alleged offender has evaded the administration of justice
Translation:
第二十九条 诉讼时效

缔约国应根据本公约的规定，在其国内法律中设立较长的诉讼时效期限，以便对任何根据本公约设立的犯罪行为提起诉讼，并在被指控的犯罪嫌疑人逃避司法时，设立更长的诉讼时效期限或规定诉讼时效的中止。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall make the commission of an offence established in accordance with this Convention liable to sanctions that take into account the gravity of that offence
Translation: 每一缔约国应对根据本公约所确立的犯罪行为施加相应制裁，并充分考虑该犯罪行为的严重性。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall take such measures as may be necessary to establish or maintain , in accordance with its legal system and constitutional principles , an appropriate balance between any immunities or jurisdictional privileges accorded to its public officials for the performance of their functions and the possibility , when necessary , of effectively investigating , prosecuting and adjudicating offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 2. 各缔约国应根据本国法律制度和宪法原则，采取必要措施，在为本国公职人员履行职务所赋予的任何豁免权或司法特权与在必要时有效调查、起诉和审判根据本公约所确立犯罪的可能性之间，建立或保持适当的平衡。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall endeavor to ensure that any discretionary legal powers under its domestic law relating to the prosecution of persons for offences established in accordance with this Convention are exercised to maximize the effectiveness of law enforcement measures in respect of those offences and with due regard to the need to deter the commission of such offences
Translation: 3. 各缔约国应努力确保其国内法律中关于根据本公约所设立犯罪行为的起诉所涉及的自由裁量权，能够最大限度地提升针对该类犯罪的执法效果，并充分考虑防止此类犯罪发生的需要。

Query_Text_en: 4 In the case of offences established in accordance with this Convention , each State Party shall take appropriate measures in accordance with its domestic law and with due regard to the rights of the defense , to seek to ensure that conditions imposed in connection with decisions on release pending trial or appeal take into consideration the need to ensure the presence of the defendant at subsequent criminal proceedings
Translation: 对于根据本公约设立的犯罪，各缔约国应根据本国法律并充分尊重辩方权利，采取适当措施，力求确保在审判或上诉期间有关释放决定所施加的条件，能够充分考虑确保被告人在后续刑事诉讼中出庭的需要。

Query_Text_en: 5 Each State Party shall take into account the gravity of the offences concerned when considering the eventuality of early release or parole of persons convicted of such offences
Translation: 5. 各缔约国在考虑对因相关罪行被判刑人员提前释放或假释的可能性时，应充分考虑该罪行的严重性。

Query_Text_en: 6 Each State Party , to the extent consistent with the fundamental principles of its legal system , shall consider establishing procedures through which a public official accused of an offence established in accordance with this Convention may , where appropriate , be removed , suspended or reassigned by the appropriate authority , bearing in mind respect for the principle of the presumption of innocence
Translation: 6. 各缔约国应在其法律体系基本原则允许的范围内，考虑建立相关程序，使被指控犯有本公约所规定罪行的公职人员在适当情况下，由相关主管部门予以免职、停职或调任，同时应尊重无罪推定原则。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Holding office in an enterprise owned in whole or in part by the State
Translation: 在国有或部分国有企业中担任职务

Query_Text_en: 8 Paragraph 1 of this article shall be without prejudice to the exercise of disciplinary powers by the competent authorities against civilservants
Translation: 本条第1款的规定不影响主管机关对公务员行使纪律处分权。

Query_Text_en: 9 Nothing contained in this Convention shall affect the principle that the description of the offences established in accordance with this Convention and of the applicable legal defences or other legal principles controlling the lawfulness of conduct is reserved to the domestic law of a State Party and that such offences shall be prosecuted and punished in accordance with that law
Translation: 本公约的任何内容均不影响以下原则：根据本公约确立的犯罪行为的定性，以及适用的法律抗辩或其他决定行为合法性的法律原则，均由缔约国本国法律规定，并且此类犯罪应依照该国法律予以起诉和惩处。

Query_Text_en: 10 States Parties shall endeavor to promote the reintegration into society of persons convicted of offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 缔约国应努力促进根据本公约所确立罪行被判刑人员的社会再融入。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Property equipment or other instrumentalities used in or destined for use in offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation: [ b ] 用于实施或拟用于实施根据本公约确立的犯罪的财产、设备或其他工具

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State Party shall take such measures as may be necessary to enable the identification , tracing , freezing or seizure of any item referred to in paragraph 1 of this article for the purpose of eventual confiscation
Translation: 2. 各缔约国应采取必要措施，以便能够识别、追踪、冻结或扣押本条第1款所述任何物品，以实现最终没收的目的。

Query_Text_en: 3 Each State Party shall adopt , in accordance with its domestic law , such legislative and other measures as may be necessary to regulate the administration by the competent authorities of frozen , seized or confiscated property covered in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article
Translation: 3. 各缔约国应根据本国法律，采取必要的立法及其他措施，以规范主管机关对本条第1和第2款所涉及的冻结、扣押或没收财产的管理。

Query_Text_en: 4 If such proceeds of crime have been transformed or converted , in part or in full , into other property , such property shall be liable to the measures referred to in this article instead of the proceeds
Translation: 4 如果这些犯罪所得已被部分或全部转化或转换为其他财产，则该财产应适用本条所述措施，而非犯罪所得。

Query_Text_en: 5 If such proceeds of crime have been intermingled with property acquired from legitimate sources , such property shall , without prejudice to any powers relating to freezing or seizure , be liable to confiscation up to the assessed value of the intermingled proceeds
Translation: 如果犯罪所得与合法来源取得的财产混合在一起，在不影响有关冻结或扣押权力的前提下，该财产可被没收，最高金额以混合犯罪所得的评估价值为限。

Query_Text_en: 6 Income or other benefits derived from such proceeds of crime from property into which such proceeds of crime have been transformed or converted or from property with which such proceeds of crime have been intermingled shall also be liable to the measures referred to in this article in the same manner and to the same extent as proceeds of crime
Translation: 6 由犯罪所得转化或转换而来的财产，或与犯罪所得混合的财产所产生的收入或其他收益，应当与犯罪所得本身同样适用本条所述的措施，适用方式和范围与犯罪所得相同。

Query_Text_en: 7 For the purpose of this article and article 55 of this Convention each State Party shall empower its courts or other competent authorities to order that bank , financial or commercial records be made available or seized A State Party shall not decline to act under the provisions of this paragraph on the ground of bank secrecy
Translation: 7 为了本条和本公约第55条的目的，每一缔约国应授权其法院或其他主管机关，命令提供或查封银行、金融或商业记录。缔约国不得以银行保密为由拒绝按照本款规定采取行动。

Query_Text_en: 8 States Parties may consider the possibility of requiring that an offender demonstrate the lawful origin of such alleged proceeds of crime or other property liable to confiscation to the extent that such a requirement is consistent with the fundamental principles of their domestic law and with the nature of judicial and other proceedings
Translation: 8 各缔约国可考虑在不违反本国法律基本原则及司法和其他程序性质的前提下，要求犯罪嫌疑人证明其所涉犯罪所得或其他可予以没收财产的合法来源。

Query_Text_en: 9 The provisions of this article shall not be so construed as to prejudice rights of bona fide third parties
Translation: 本条款的规定不得被解释为损害善意第三方的权利。

Query_Text_en: 10 Nothing contained in this article shall affect the principle that the measures to which it refers shall be defined and implemented in accordance with and subject to the provisions of the domestic law of a State Party
Translation: 10 本条所述内容不应影响以下原则：相关措施的界定和实施应根据缔约国国内法律的规定，并受其约束。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall take appropriate measures in accordance with its domestic legal system and within its means to provide effective protection from potential retaliation or intimidation for witnesses and experts who give testimony concerning offences established in accordance with this Convention and , as appropriate , for their relatives and other persons close to them
Translation: 1. 各缔约国应根据本国法律制度并在其能力范围内，采取适当措施，为就本公约所确立的犯罪作证的证人和专家，以及在适当情况下，为其亲属及其他密切关系人，提供有效保护，防止其受到可能的报复或恐吓。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Providing evidentiary rules to permit witnesses and experts to give testimony in a manner that ensures the safety of such persons , such as permitting testimony to be given through the use of communications technology such as video or other adequate means
Translation: [ b ] 制定证据规则，允许证人和专家以保障其人身安全的方式作证，例如允许通过视频或其他适当的通讯技术进行证言。

Query_Text_en: 3 States Parties shall consider entering into agreements or arrangements with other States for the relocation of persons referred to in paragraph 1 of this article
Translation: 缔约国应考虑与其他国家签订协议或安排，以安置本条第1款所述人员。

Query_Text_en: 4 The provisions of this article shall also apply to victims insofar as they are witnesses
Translation: 本条款的规定同样适用于作为证人的受害者。

Query_Text_en: 5 Each State Party shall , subject to its domestic law , enable the views and concerns of victims to be presented and considered at appropriate stages of criminal proceedings against offenders in a manner not prejudicial to the rights of the defense
Translation: 5. 各缔约国应根据本国法律，在不损害被告人辩护权利的前提下，使受害者的意见和关切能够在对犯罪行为的刑事诉讼适当阶段得到表达和考虑。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 Protection of reporting personsEach State Party shall consider incorporating into its domestic legal system appropriate measures to provide protection against any unjustified treatment for any person who reports in good faith and on reasonable grounds to the competent authorities any facts concerning offences established in accordance with this Convention
Translation:
第三十三条 举报人保护  
各缔约国应考虑在其国内法律体系中纳入适当措施，为任何基于合理理由并出于善意向主管机关举报根据本公约所确立犯罪事实的人员，提供防止任何不当对待的保护。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 Consequences of acts of corruptionWith due regard to the rights of third parties acquired in good faith , each State Party shall take measures , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its domestic law , to address consequences of corruption In this context States Parties may consider corruption a relevant factor in legal proceedings to annul or rescind a contract , withdraw a concession or other similar instrument or take any other remedial action
Translation:
第三十四条 腐败行为的后果

在充分尊重善意第三方既得权利的前提下，每一缔约国应根据其国内法的基本原则，采取措施应对腐败行为所产生的后果。在此背景下，缔约国可将腐败作为法律程序中撤销或解除合同、撤回特许权或其他类似文件，或采取其他补救措施的相关因素予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Compensation for damageEach State Party shall take such measures as may be necessary , in accordance with principles of its domestic law , to ensure that entities or persons who have suffered damage as a result of an act of Corruption have the right to initiate legal proceedings against those responsible for that damage in order to obtain compensation
Translation:
第三十五条 损害赔偿  
缔约国应根据本国法律原则，采取必要措施，确保因腐败行为遭受损害的实体或个人有权对造成该损害的责任人提起法律诉讼，以获得赔偿。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 Specialized authoritiesEach State Party shall , in accordance with the fundamental principles of its legal system , ensure the existence of a body or bodies or persons specialized in combating corruption through law enforcement Such body or bodies or persons shall be granted the necessary independence , in accordance with the fundamental principles of the legal system of the State Party , to be able to carry out their functions effectively and without any undue influence Such persons or staff of such body or bodies should have the appropriate training and resources to carry out their tasks
Translation:
第三十六条 专门机构

各缔约国应根据本国法律体系的基本原则，确保设立一个或多个专门负责通过执法打击腐败的机构或人员。该机构或人员应根据缔约国法律体系的基本原则，享有必要的独立性，以便能够有效并不受任何不当影响地履行其职责。该等人员或机构的工作人员应具备履行其任务所需的适当培训和资源。

Query_Text_en: 1 Each State Party shall take appropriate measures to encourage persons who participate or who have participated in the commission of an offence established in accordance with this Convention to supply information useful to competent authorities for investigative and evidentiary purposes and to provide factual , specific help to competent authorities that may contribute to depriving offenders of the proceeds of crime and to recovering such proceeds
Translation: 缔约国应采取适当措施，鼓励参与或曾参与根据本公约所设立犯罪行为的人，向主管机关提供对调查和取证有用的信息，并向主管机关提供事实性、具体的协助，以有助于剥夺犯罪分子犯罪所得并追回这些所得。

Query_Text_en: b treaties between international organizations
Translation: 国际组织间的条约

Query_Text_en: j `` rules of the organization `` means , in particular , the constituent instruments , decisions and resolutions adopted in accordance with them , and established practice of the organization
Translation: “本组织规则”特别是指根据组织的组成文件、所作决定和决议，以及组织确立的惯例。

Query_Text_en: 2 The provisions of paragraph 1 regarding the use of terms in the present Convention are without prejudice to the use of those terms or to the meanings which may be given to them in the internal law of any State or in the rules of any international organization
Translation: 2. 本公约第一款关于术语使用的规定，不影响任何国家的国内法或任何国际组织规则中对相关术语的使用或其所赋予的含义。

Query_Text_en: c the application of the Convention to the relations between States and international organizations or to the relations of organizations as between themselves , when those relations are governed by international agreements to which other subjects of international law are also parties
Translation: c. 本公约适用于国家与国际组织之间的关系，或国际组织相互之间的关系，但前提是这些关系受其他国际法主体亦为当事方的国际协议所规范。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Non retroactivity of the present ConventionWithout prejudice to the application of any rules set forth in the present Convention to which treaties between one or more States and one or more international organizations or between international organizations would be subject under international law independently of the Convention , the Convention applies only to such treaties concluded after the entry into force of the present Convention with regard to those States and those organizations
Translation:
第四条 本公约的不溯及既往原则

在不影响根据国际法，独立于本公约之外，本公约所规定的任何规则适用于一个或多个国家与一个或多个国际组织之间，或国际组织之间所缔结的条约的前提下，本公约仅适用于在本公约对有关国家和有关国际组织生效之后所缔结的条约。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Treaties constituting international organizations and treaties adopted within an international organizationThe present Convention applies to any treaty between one or more States and one or more international organizations which is the constituent instrument of an international organization and to any treaty adopted within an international organization , without prejudice to any relevant rules of the organization
Translation:
第五条 国际组织成立文件及在国际组织内通过的条约

本公约适用于一项或多项国家与一项或多项国际组织之间作为国际组织成立文件的条约，以及在国际组织内通过的任何条约，但不得影响该组织相关规则的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Capacity of international organizations to conclude treatiesThe capacity of an international organization to conclude treaties is governed by the rules of that organization
Translation:
第六条 国际组织缔结条约的权能

国际组织缔结条约的权能由该组织的规则所规范。

Query_Text_en: or b it appears from practice or from other circumstances that it was the intention of the States and international organizations concerned to consider that person as representing the State for such purposes without having to produce full powers
Translation: 或者，依据实践或其他情况，可以看出相关国家和国际组织有意将该人员视为代表国家履行相关职能，而无需出具全权证书。

Query_Text_en: or b it appears from the circumstances that it was the intention of the States and international organizations concerned to consider that person as representing the organization for such purposes , in accordance with the rules of the organization , without having to produce full powers
Translation: 或者，依据相关情况，可以看出有关国家和国际组织根据该组织的规则，意图将该人员视为代表该组织履行相关职责，而无需出具全权证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Subsequent confirmation of an act performed without authorizationAn act relating to the conclusion of a treaty performed by a person who can not be considered under article 7 as authorized to represent a State or an international organization for that purpose is without legal effect unless afterwards confirmed by that State or that organization
Translation:
第八条 后续确认未经授权的行为  
由不符合第七条规定、无权代表国家或国际组织缔结条约的人所进行的与条约缔结有关的行为，除非事后得到该国家或该组织的确认，否则不具有法律效力。

Query_Text_en: 1 The adoption of the text of a treaty takes place by the consent of all the stateS and international organizations or , as the case may be all the organizations participating in its drawing up except as provided in paragraph 2
Translation: 除第2款另有规定外，条约文本的通过须经所有国家和国际组织，或视情况由参与起草的所有组织一致同意。

Query_Text_en: 2 The adoption of the text of a treaty at an international conference takes place in accordance with the procedure agreed upon by the participants in that conference If , however , no agreement is reached on any such procedure , the adoption of the text shall take place by the vote of two thirds of the participants present and voting unless by the same majority they shall decide to apply a different rule
Translation: 在国际会议上通过条约文本，须按照与会者商定的程序进行；但如未就该程序达成一致，则须由出席并投票的与会者三分之二多数通过该文本，除非同样多数决定采用其他规则。

Query_Text_en: or b failing such procedure , by the signature , signature ad referendum or initialling by the representatives of those States and those organizations of the text of the treaty or of the Final Act of a conference incorporating the text
Translation: 或者，如无法按照上述程序，则由这些国家和组织的代表在条约文本或载有该文本的会议最后文件上签字、附条件签字或草签。

Query_Text_en: or b failing such procedure , by the signature , signature ad referendum or initialling by the representatives of those organizations of the text of the treaty or of the Final Act of a conference incorporating the text
Translation: 或者，如未能按照该程序进行，则由这些组织的代表在条约文本或包含该文本的会议最后议定书上签字、附条件签字或草签。

Query_Text_en: 1 The consent of a State to be bound by a treaty may be expressed by signature exchange of instruments constituting a treaty , ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , or by any other means if so agreed
Translation: 一国同意受条约约束，可以通过签署、交换构成条约的文件、批准、接受、认可或加入，或经协商同意的其他方式表示。

Query_Text_en: 2 The consent of an international organization to be bound by a treaty may be expressed by signature exchange of instruments constituting a treaty , act of formal confirmation , acceptance , approval or accession , or by any other means if so agreed
Translation: 2 国际组织同意受条约约束，可以通过签署、交换构成条约的文书、正式确认、接受、批准或加入，或经协商同意的其他方式表示。

Query_Text_en: or c the intention of the State or organization to give that effect to the signature appears from the full powers of its representative or was expressed during the negotiation
Translation: 或者，国家或组织赋予签字以该效力的意图，已在其代表的全权证书中体现，或在谈判过程中表达。

Query_Text_en: b the signature ad referendum of a treaty by the representative of a State or an international organization if confirmed by his State or organization , constitutes a full signature of the treaty
Translation: b. 由一国或国际组织的代表以“待确认”方式签署条约，如经其本国或本组织确认，即构成对该条约的正式签署。

Query_Text_en: or b it is otherwise established that those States and those organizations or , as the case may be , those organizations were agreed that the exchange of instruments should have that effect
Translation: 或者，若另有证据表明这些国家和这些组织，或在适用情况下，这些组织已同意交换文书应具有该效力。

Query_Text_en: or d the intention of the State to sign the treaty subject to ratification appears from the full powers of its representative or was expressed during the negotiation
Translation: 或者，国家有意签署该条约但须经批准方能生效，这一意图已在其代表的全权证书中明确表示，或在谈判过程中已予以表达。

Query_Text_en: or d the intention of the organization to sign the treaty subject to an act of formal confirmation appears from the full powers of its representative or was expressed during the negotiation
Translation: 或者，该组织有意签署该条约，但须经正式确认程序的，且该意图已在其代表的全权证书中表明，或在谈判过程中已予以表达。

Query_Text_en: 3 The consent of a State or of an international organization to be bound by a treaty is expressed by acceptance or approval under conditions similar to those which apply to ratification or , as the case may be , to an act of formal confirmation
Translation: 3. 一国或国际组织同意受条约约束，可通过接受或批准来表达，其条件与批准或正式确认行为所适用的条件类似。

Query_Text_en: or c all the parties have subsequently agreed that such consent may be expressed by that State or that organization by means of accession
Translation: 或c）所有当事方随后同意该国或该组织可以通过加入的方式表示此类同意。

Query_Text_en: or c their notification to the contracting States and to the contracting organizations or to the depositary , if so agreed
Translation: 或者，若已达成一致，则将其通知发送给缔约国、缔约组织或保存人。

Query_Text_en: or c their notification to the contracting organizations or to the depositary , if so agreed
Translation: 或经协商一致，向缔约组织或保存人发出通知

Query_Text_en: 1 Without prejudice to articles 19 to 23 , the consent of a State or of an international organization to be bound by part of a treaty is effective only if the treaty so permits , or if the contracting States and contracting organizations or , as the case may be , the contracting organizations so agree
Translation: 在不影响第19至第23条规定的前提下，一国或一个国际组织同意受条约部分内容约束，只有在条约允许，或缔约国与缔约组织，或视情况由缔约组织相互同意的情况下，该同意才具有法律效力。

Query_Text_en: 2 The consent of a State or of an international organization to be bound by a treaty which permits a choice between differing provisions is effective only if it is made clear to which of the provisions the consent relates
Translation: 一国或国际组织同意受允许在不同条款之间选择的条约约束，只有在明确表明其同意适用于哪些条款时，该同意才有效。

Query_Text_en: or b that State or that organization has expressed its consent to be bound by the treaty , pending the entry into force of the treaty and provided that such entry into force is not unduly delayed
Translation: 或者该国家或该组织已表示同意受该条约约束，但须在该条约生效之前，并且前提是该条约的生效不会被无故延迟。

Query_Text_en: or c in cases not falling under sub paragraphs a and b the reservation is incompatible with the object and purpose of the treaty
Translation: 或者，若不属于a和b项的情形，该保留与条约的宗旨和目的不相容。

Query_Text_en: 1 A reservation expressly authorized by a treaty does not require any subsequent acceptance by the contracting States and contracting organizations or , as the case may be , by the contracting organizations unless the treaty so provides
Translation: 1. 经条约明确授权的保留，无需缔约国和缔约组织，或视情况而定，仅缔约组织的后续接受，除非条约另有规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 When it appears from the limited number of the negotiating States and negotiating organizations or , as the case maybe , of the negotiating organizations and the object and purpose of a treaty that the application of the treaty in its entirety between all the parties is an essential condition of the consent of each one to be bound by the treaty , a reservation requires acceptance by all the parties
Translation: 2 如果从缔约国和缔约组织的数量有限，或视情况而定，从缔约组织的数量有限，以及条约的宗旨和目的来看，条约在所有当事方之间全面适用是每一方同意受其约束的基本条件，则任何保留均须经所有当事方接受。

Query_Text_en: 3 When a treaty is a constituent instrument of an international organization and unless it otherwise provides a reservation requires the acceptance of the competent organ of that organization
Translation: 3. 当条约作为某一国际组织的组成文件时，除非条约另有规定，任何保留均需经该组织主管机构同意方可生效。

Query_Text_en: c an act expressing the consent of a State or of an international organization to be bound by the treaty and containing a reservation is effective as soon as at least one contracting State or one contracting organization has accepted the reservation
Translation: 一项表达一国或一个国际组织同意受条约约束并包含保留的行为，自至少有一个缔约国或一个缔约组织接受该保留之时起生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 For the purposes of paragraphs 2 and 4 and unless the treaty otherwise provides , a reservation is considered to have been accepted by a State or an international organization if it shall have raised no objection to the reservation by the end of a period of twelve months after it was notified of the reservation or by the date on which it expressed its consent to be bound by the treaty , whichever is later
Translation: 5 根据第2和第4款的规定，除非条约另有规定，某国或国际组织在被通知该保留事项后十二个月内，或在其表示同意受条约约束之日（以较晚者为准）未提出异议，则视为该国或国际组织已接受该保留事项。
